body.title: Knicks are cleaning house and OKC v San Antonio is a barn-burner
body.body:
Just like it was kind of expected things are turning out to be a pretty one-sided affair in the East and things are extremely competitive in the West.   

The bookies were predicting an Oklahoma City sweep but instead the Spurs threw us for a loop by winning game 1.   Since then the Thunders have won the next 2 straight with the last win looking very one-sided.   Does San Antonio have what it takes to get through to the final?  Well, bookies certainly don't think so 

<center> https://a.espncdn.com/media/motion/2026/0519/3075b858a553494a9aa515b81f81876610/3075b858a553494a9aa515b81f81876610.jpg
[src](https://a.espncdn.com/media/motion/2026/0519/3075b858a553494a9aa515b81f81876610/3075b858a553494a9aa515b81f81876610.jpg)</center> 

While they are only favored by a tiny bit at 2.5 points, the bookies are pretty certain that OKC has got this one in the bag and there are some reasons for that.  

In game one, the Spurs hadn't played OKC in quite some time so in a way you could say that it was a fresh matchup.  Victor Wenbanyama is a truly gifted player.  He is one of the new wave of really tall dudes that isn't just a meaty center who stands there and waits for a short pass, nah.  He can play anywhere and he does including being quite reliable on 3 pointers.   It's pretty rare these days that we see centers like Shaq or Patrick Ewing that were heavy tanks that couldn't really make shots from anywhere except in the paint.  I don't know how such a player would work out these days because the new lean centers that can play from the perimeter seem like the norm these days and Wenbanyama is a true weapon.

The thing is, it took OKC about a game to kind of figure him out and shut him down a bit.  

<center> 
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sports.guy55/23wM4WaB6ZrYveZyPaJhZ1fJwggQe1j2Vtj2bUYWRfdHe1h9yEBztWgwYdduvXP4tZcNc.png)
[src](https://dims.apnews.com/dims4/default/0b84e88/2147483647/strip/true/crop/6768x4512+0+0/resize/599x399!/quality/90/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.apnews.com%2F5e%2F60%2F456dce9983f93e8b4357ddc0c396%2F4502bcdf32284ef0a379d8a048712b04)</center>

Some doubters out there might try to say that this is incorrect on my part because the had 26 points in game 3 and to that I can only say that he had 41 points on the day they Spurs won and in SA's subsequent losses it did seem like they were struggling to find positioning for the big man and there were increased turnovers in what looked like trying to get the ball to him.

I could be wrong I guess but I think that is what is going on.  The Spurs need to find a way to free \

up or they are going to struggle.

On the other side of things the Knicks are kind of making the Cavs look a bit silly.  As I type we are seconds away from the Knicks taking this to 3-0.   While in game one the Knicks looked quite vulnerable when the Cleveland side went up by *more than 20 points* but then somehow the Cavs managed to lose that game.  It was truly extraordinary and I believe the Cavs have been kind of demoralized since then.  

The bookies are saying what they have always said and that is the the Thunder are going through and are going to win it all.   I could be fun to put a couple of bucks on the Knicks to win, which some people out there will certainly do because those odds are likely paying 10X of more should the Knicks do something amazing.  

We aren't in the final yet but I can all-but-guarantee that the most exciting games and the most competitive games are actually happening right now.  The Cavs are mentally broken and are likely going home tomorrow at around 9pm.   

San Antonio I suppose could figure something out but I believe that their offense is a bit too reliant on one person in order for that to happen.   Of course there is always the chance of some sort of injury on both sides of the bracket that could really change a lot of things.  The only team with real roster depth right now is OKC and they don't really need it.

body.title: Conociendo el Bosque Alemão | Curitiba - Brasil 📍🇧🇷 [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![1000279405.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/48JdigykpXEQ8u6sp93eqLTvnGkaNXAvGUTWRyX4Hx3E4dYHwJDaqwDr7EpkqqQCNF.jpg)
**_Imagen de mi propiedad editada en canva/Image of my property edited in canva_**
[//]:# (!worldmappin -25.40504 lat -49.28681 long Mi visita d3scr)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV76NVvUB2vveMfqDbpX8gfTGbWMSHHAHiWKxsf4PGuWt/_bienvenidos_a_mi_blog_.jpg)
   _Desde hace un tiempo hice una lista en mi celular con todos los lugares turísticos de la ciudad que quiero conocer, esto con el fin de que cuando llegara el momento pudiera tener una idea de que lugares visitar para aprovechar esos días libres, ahora que mis vacaciones llegaron me he dedicado desde el primer día a ir a estos lugares que tanto quería conocer y el día de hoy les mostraré el primero de ellos._ >_For some time now I've been making a list on my phone of all the tourist spots in the city that I want to visit, so that when the time came I'd have an idea of where to go to make the most of my free time. Now that my vacation has arrived, I've been dedicated from day one to visiting these places I've been wanting to see, and today I'll show you the first one._ _Mi primer lugar turístico a conocer fue el **Bosque Alemão** el cual quería visitar desde hace meses y finalmente pude hacerlo. Este es uno de los espacios naturales y culturales más emblemáticos de la ciudad (Curitiba), fue inaugurado en el año 1996 y está conformado por 38.000 metros cuadrados de extensión._ >_My first tourist destination was the **Bosque Alemão**, which I had wanted to visit for months and finally made it. This is one of the most emblematic natural and cultural spaces in the city (Curitiba). It was inaugurated in 1996 and covers an area of 38,000 square meters._ _La idea de la creación de este espacio nació para rendir homenaje a la población alemana radicada en Curitiba tras su migración a la ciudad, la cual comenzó desde el año 1833 cuando llegaron los primeros inmigrantes alemanes a esta región, siendo estos la familia **Schaffer** quienes eran dueños de una granja ubicada en lo que hoy en día es el famoso **Bosque Alemão** que a su vez forma parte del memorial de inmigración alemana._ >_The idea for creating this space arose to pay homage to the German population settled in Curitiba after their migration to the city, which began in 1833 when the first German immigrants arrived in this region, the Schaffer family who owned a farm located in what is now the famous Bosque Alemão (German Forest), which in turn forms part of the German immigration memorial._
![1000279448.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23vhybAgVJ3h49r7mBGq1dY8yWf1UHcjvsirf5Pbj3efMFnXxb77UTqwC9mtcWCDTdwML.jpg)
_El **Bosque Alemão** posee varios atractivos, los cuales me aseguré de no perderme durante mi visita y ahora les comentaré uno a uno cuales son. El principal punto para comenzar con el recorrido es el conocido como el **Portal** que es una réplica de la fachada de una típica casa alemana (enxaimel), esta también conocida como **Casa Mila**._ >_The **German Forest** has several attractions, which I made sure not to miss during my visit, and I will now tell you about them one by one. The main starting point for the tour is the so-called **Portal**, which is a replica of the facade of a typical German house (enxaimel), also known as **Casa Mila**._
![1000279449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/243LpPFk6F1G5RLpNuqKSLgXXA2cYatsdYhTGeTTRcZfrxoru6kcywX1NM1JMiiQCdJiP.jpg)
![1000279450.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/243q4Pb25SNMZ1vZ1R3fGMJCZAqq4YjoZAEzgSquR9hMCFxUUWorB8pbvXSgoDYmaNW3H.jpg)
![1000279451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23uFRUPtV5jeNXHYEpkLPqYgg4AUE2M3mjyw6dMT3KVq1tDTtai4UBZaJWdPo8SotGBE5.jpg)
![1000279452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23vsNFvegUs1CdYdaNY3cMuTZqRGjpsfeA6PXRDJquDkgRwuSKkKvDpk6drmPLP8N4ywY.jpg)
_Pasando el **Portal** nos adentramos al bosque, recorriendo a través de él el famoso **Camino del cuento**, siendo este un sendero asfaltado en el que no solo puedes caminar por el interior del bosque sino que a su vez se narra la historia de **Joãozinho e Maria** una adaptación del famoso cuento de **Hansel & Gretel**, escrito por partes exhibidas en paneles o tótems que van a lo largo del sendero, contando cada uno una parte de la historia hasta llegar al final del sendero._ >_Passing through the **Portal**, we enter the forest, walking along the famous **Story Path**, an asphalt trail where you can not only walk through the forest but also experience the story of **Joãozinho e Maria**, an adaptation of the famous **Hansel & Gretel** tale, written in parts displayed on panels or totems along the path, each telling a part of the story until you reach the end of the path._
![1000279453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23vhudi1B6hjR2aNDUDQPVsfWe3f8GibtbtCL2ZsGjGzBZhqEgvwZB4iGzu9fbVDjuYCQ.jpg)
![1000279454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23uFKXqKhC9Qd1bTta7sWNXZSQAX3uzezEJvxf5JCGjWjDJfmvmFKCgMVe2YeXAaGTAAB.jpg)
![1000279455.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23u5xXG2r9GwcfaewzoERJykveg2aD7XzqLhgtofJpeaqrb5GmB2M2LVwHKRL41FA2ZgL.jpg)
![1000279468.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23wqXqhPBv79kt84njJMKySQeHNEN2oUSyzpXWaXk1oAXRoitmibfstvfXgXrDssrTyCe.jpg)
![1000279469.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23u5vo5B4oBBdsZLcX6oG7HAerJkmDedb64xoM68KafsAxcmUX3zCs5CLGGGeMMnvxppT.jpg)
![1000279470.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23wC5mzbtuhibaBjY2YDESQ9rSJQii7fBBqymCCFQPt1Ncuz7iUy8Xxuv4292nPQaWTMH.jpg)
![1000279471.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EoK5mqsV2pmm3WrBii3XjtwdxGRTnfpqiuqfzYDZrXe1KqHyqARxZDEKJZQH74DdEH5.jpg)
![1000279472.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23wCBeCazASB73t9qapRZDJvsZGfpLavd3fyFRhR4cJXvmjwDdbUTvMfrPQkp381mR2ux.jpg)
_Al final del sendero encontramos la última parte del cuento y aunque este termina aquí el camino sigue. Caminando un poco más encontramos **La Casa Encantada** o tambien conocida como **La Casa de la Bruja**. Esta casa forma parte de la historia de **Joãozinho e Maria**, siendo esta la casa de la bruja mencionada en la historia. En su interior encontramos una biblioteca, lugar en el que los fines de semana sirve de centro de actividades y lectura de cuentos infantiles para el público._ >_At the end of the path, we find the final part of the story, and although it ends here, the journey continues. Walking a little further, we find **The Haunted House**, also known as **The Witch's House**. This house is part of the story of **Joãozinho and Maria**, being the house of the witch mentioned in the tale. Inside, we find a library, which on weekends serves as a center for activities and readings of children's stories to the public._
![1000279473.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EoK4PztJCJDpc1HsH2Nc5Kn1FxD7gWyUXCfzNt1nq6Yge29Nq5ArJMGYJX8Rpdv46ip.jpg)
![1000279474.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EpT2F8bZb71HpeyHK3kY3j7HJCnaKXnoh7Kk5T5V3gpi4n2kxHAAydaFxc9ajNcpbSP.jpg)
![1000279475.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23zGTzB1r8EkFJU5Mo4LWk16hvDBWLc82XyVrqwrPyNKtjDRiJBGAFRq8qt6ds6fjFVxo.jpg)
![1000279476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/Ep3cvn1QwU6eUgsdFFJt2tUoRSQLUGvGtbhFA6Jq2buZQeAGhb8mxDfeCF6peaw8M7o.jpg)
_Siguiendo el camino conseguimos una estructura de madera en forma de escaleras que nos lleva a la parte superior del camino._ >_Following the path, we find a wooden structure in the form of stairs that takes us to the top of the path._
![1000279477.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EogLurq31Z12QJYBoMKf7ZoXaMZgn4qx7QzkbQMigRcW9ChQhvDUbUSRYeC4LsVsqe8.jpg)
![1000279478.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/Eoc5yxHjXfaqcAgjF7YXBosBx7azxQoTBZ4AwEthPb7qUbz4sDuc96jUdPhLP5Xhdj1.jpg)
_Al final del camino llegamos a la famosa **Torre de los Filósofos**, un hermoso mirador construido de madera con una estructura en forma de torre que cuenta con unos 3 pisos de altura, desde la cual podemos obtener una vista panorámica del bosque entero así como de parte de la ciudad._ >_At the end of the path we arrived at the famous **Tower of the Philosophers**, a beautiful wooden lookout with a tower-like structure about 3 stories high, from which we can get a panoramic view of the entire forest as well as part of the city._
![1000279479.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23w2ebXjHEGd8afimj5nPZZyR7wM2r1YMLJMzMN8VQd2vtNdvJdVrBkhzU9EmjgVDTB55.jpg)
![1000279480.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23u611ybfmHEtdNTjCW3DrM6nFcbbePhgEjg3ANuRd3REKJSXzEWf9geVEpExs6WZTWCu.jpg)
![1000279481.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23wgDB3RPJVVwqdS1UoynDceHLfsWsuXtEjGyDrDVd3WBjpjP8yUKNRxmJjXfEvjteLM9.jpg)
![1000279484.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EqqsTg4f9ChWtVZ8uy3SoYTqLgCvunxY3sPcTxGzaqoHUHVtpvAKb3fHjBfgf7kMqSx.jpg)
![1000279485.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EqqtR9rh8qbsAYTw5JoPbJxEv1q5XV5jGc4Ce3vTALebfJRMjvLS4txBduHTsLxBtHC.jpg)
_Al final del mirador encontramos un puente que nos lleva al otro extremo de este lugar, saliendo por completo del bosque y llevándonos a la siguiente parada._ >_At the end of the viewpoint we find a bridge that takes us to the other side of this place, leaving the forest completely and leading us to the next stop._
![1000279486.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/243291Y9njA2mXNHhFFeiGgXv1dUAKJaF5WKZBWYkky3utN4Wj1YeFoS2fS2TcuVmy18W.jpg)
_El punto final del recorriso es el **Oratorio de Bach**, siendo esta una réplica de una iglesia presbiteriana que existió hace muchos años en el centro de la ciudad. Está construida en madera y tanto su diseño como su arquitectura reflejan la influencia de la cultura alemana en esta ciudad._ >_The final stop on the tour is the Bach Oratorio, a replica of a Presbyterian church that stood many years ago in the city center. It is built of wood, and both its design and architecture reflect the influence of German culture in this city._
![1000279490.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23x16wxZJruyJxthqquwNxKymHozwrvgmExFroqa2YXy5TYto2tX1xx75n7joEydtp4Kh.jpg)
![1000279491.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/23vsYmK73Z2jg5HMhiTGRQ3mvBvQqfizbnNwZca1YT7ZwCjpXJT6vR8svkxXomtuMTKhH.jpg)
![1000279487.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/245HWCWCdrV84AzQLBV4yPdUSaRNVXfpMBwNTpkbc3pb4MpaiUq1FrPc3TEgHtWLLgiCA.jpg)
![1000279488.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/244UabpvRq7MTyiTYLmz8wXatm4scjypd5ztzB4DrEE72wB4Rk27pLWr9dq4CHNwECj4N.jpg)
![1000279489.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EpzwGDe8fLcDq518wEByAkn75Evv8z3ipvkBd3di9GughBqzxDk3DJUCWmaBuD7MrBH.jpg)
_En resumen fue una experiencia bastante linda y tranquila, donde no solo conocimos un nuevo lugar turístico de la ciudad sino que aprendimos un poco de su historia a la vez que disfrutamos de la naturaleza y de los hermosos paisajes que nos brinda este lugar._ >_In short, it was a very nice and peaceful experience, where we not only discovered a new tourist attraction in the city but also learned a bit about its history while enjoying nature and the beautiful landscapes this place offers._
![1000279492.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/Eo8M7U8pEsgyisMo7Uv5GxtJ1gxVRCRkYbrbHXpJxe3fNEY6dkVYZGoRiLBcaizgwew.jpg)
![1000279493.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EpQvo3y5hG1k1uJUj9878rsdwcAMFWHNbYxSdMBMpeiEymVzdiget424QedtxB8Vo3f.jpg)
![1000279494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EpQuMJAw2bmB49361WX7u4b2W3ASz96RCu8yJFbmZe7ecDxbehEapbEJWGtUTt6RMsV.jpg)
![1000279495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EogLqCJzFzeiRKiuvZAB2kA9jP27YP24CXJzAWTYUVbPUN8fPxXsaQWQKzWj6TLaj35.jpg)
![1000279496.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariajcastro28/EogMqhaUKiTDSVWwC8D3XDMLMsT43qEFbet7ASGqUGVai3nUqVcpbFjFKa9AJru5AfN.jpg)

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 22 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/37ac0161-c958-4eff-b63e-070811244107.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Most of yesterday wasn't fun at all! I was working on something quite critical that was needed before the long week end. It wasn't working the way I needed it to (and still doesn't), so I wasted a lot of time on this. Anyways, I was able to take a short break in the yard, where Le Chat prefers drinking old rain water, instead of the fresh clean water in her bowl. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/f5b74224-50a7-48b0-b1de-19f84feb680e.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b05ef4d1-e9b1-441e-a68c-f169be502979.jpg) We also went towards the small forest behind the front yard. Since Kaia is on forced rest, that's the only place we can really go. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e3914b31-ccf3-402a-a089-32183fb218ca.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/99aeaf2f-72f1-42e5-a36e-595fd1f5f995.jpg) I couldn't get a better picture but Le Chat was in a climbing mood, going all the way to the top of that tree. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/17738a7c-c0b5-4b5c-87fb-98ee821dd814.jpg) At least, she's agile enough to climb down by herself. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8fc6ba23-d28a-4efa-b362-eb4bcc4cc6a7.jpg) And then it's cuddles time with Kaia! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/047fc776-7f54-41f3-a33c-b4b4a8741004.jpg) Like the last few days, we added a very short loop in the neighborhood. Not sure Kaia's getting better, but at least it doesn't seem she's getting worse. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5ad21c01-5c26-4950-9647-d4b30c572994.jpg) Well, not an interesting day, and very little activity, let's try and do better this weekend, although I will have to figure out this work thing that is still not fully working. As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.

body.title: Online habits I learnt
body.body:
Country is hard, people are finding it's hard to eat three square meal,yet what some can do in this pressing issue scamming their fellow human. We not only communicate online nowadays,it's has been a platform where we now shop,bank and lot more ,the way people lose their money,their account every dayl ,shows we need to very careful of whatever we do online. We have to learn some habits that would keep us safe online.

I have learnt habits of not Just clicking on any links any how online, if the link doesn't come from a trusted source ,I won't click it no matter what ,even when it brings me to update an app, I rather go to play store then type out the app and upgrade it there. This has been of the lesson I learnt after my Facebook page was hacked . 

Another online habits I learnt was not putting out all information about myself online, sometimes as a business owner trying to grow ,trying to make people believe me that I am real and not scam, I'm tempted to put everything that my clients will hold on to to give me that trust,at the same time I tell myself what if my clients is a prey, we hear kidnapping issues here and there ,So I decided that my customers won't pass me by,if they are meant to be buy from me they will stay, I can only put few details about myself out there.

And another one is online dating. Scammers use romance to scam people of their privacy, they act like they are in love,they lure you into getting your nudes and then ,come to blackmail you with it later. It has cause many their finances and even make them lose their mind, their lifes. 

We should stay alert and very very careful out there , especially about online stuff, scammers are becoming more creative everyday.

body.title: The Crypto Market And Metals Market Is Falling As Stocks Boom
body.body:
U.S. stocks continue their strong gains this year while cryptocurrency and precious metals markets pull back from recent highs. As of today, the S&P 500 has climbed to approximately $7,473, repeatedly landing record closes driven by expansive corporate earnings, particularly in technology, robotics and AI-related sectors.

Bitcoin has traded around $74,000–$77,000 amid broader crypto weakness, down significantly from 2025 peaks above $120,000 and reflecting deleveraging and capital rotation.

Precious metals have also corrected after sharp rallies. Gold hovers near $4,510 per ounce following earlier records above $5,000, while silver consolidates around $76 after extreme volatility that included triple-digit spikes and steep drops earlier in the year. A significant portion of silver’s volatility and year-over-year appreciation can be attributed to its growing demand within data centers.

Personally, I will be going forward cautiously. The Iranian conflict still persists and the midterms are definitely having an affect on US stocks. We'll see how crazy the next correction is.

body.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJ6p2TyTawGuuuF9XSELVkY1svMD7kLnw7DaXg8S2Ut7/image.png)

>Dozens of shots rang out near the White House on the 23rd (local time).
U.S. President Donald Trump was staying at the White House at the time of the incident, and Secret Service (SS), FBI agents and police officers blocked the scene of the incident and are investigating the details of the incident.

>According to CNN, SS officials said they were investigating after receiving a report of gunfire at the intersection of 17th Street and Pennsylvania Avenue NW outside the White House complex at around 6 p.m. that evening.
CNN said its reporters also heard gunshots near the White House, and reporters on the north lawn of the White House at the time were urgently evacuated inside the briefing room.
One reporter said the gunshots appeared to be coming from the direction of Eisenhower administration in the White House complex.
The SS then temporarily closed the White House and ordered reporters outside the building to evacuate.
\
said a U.S. media reporter, News Nation. \
\n\n>SS' press office told X (X, formerly Twitter) \

FBI Director Kathy Patel also wrote on X that the FBI has been on the scene and is supporting SS in response to shootings near the White House, adding that she will release additional information when possible.
While federal agencies such as the SS or the FBI did not disclose the details of the incident, Fox News reported that the shooter fired three pistols at the White House, and SS members fired back to subdue the shooter.

>A law enforcement official said, \

President Trump is said to be safe.
However, it was reported that a passerby was shot at the scene of the incident and taken to a nearby hospital, and no specific condition has been confirmed.
Earlier on the 4th, a suspect with a firearm fired at law enforcement agents at an intersection southeast of the Washington Monument, not far from the White House, and the agents responded and engaged.
On the 25th of last month, a gunman armed with shotguns, pistols and knives rushed through the search bar in a security check area near the Hilton Hotel dinner hall in Washington, where the White House Press Association dinner was held, and was overpowered by authorities shortly after it passed.
At that time, President Trump was present at the dinner hall, but he was evacuated safely.
#White House #CNN #Shots #Terrorism
Jeong Eui-jin (jej88@ikbc.co.kr )

Perhaps because the leadership is rooted in hatred, reports of shootings seem to occur with unusual frequency.
Fortunately, it is said that no one was injured, but
repeated incidents like these are enough to create a sense of unease.
I hope we can move toward a more united path.

body.title: Officiating Basketball Games in the  Beautiful Location  of  Valle Verde Residential Estate  in Lapu-Lapu City
body.body:
Greetings to all hivers in this community . 
Today I would like share my experience in officiating basketball in one of the nice basketball court and a very peaceful residential estate in Lapu-Lapu City ,the  valle Verde . 

![1000090583.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/48KbwuTKa6uQmLhnxmLvRRYfPatARbUz4R7ZVPcyQEreDyFYyS2k9Rns3XkyE4haWW.png)

Valle Verde Mactan Residential Estates  is situated beside Marcelo Fernan Bridge , the second bridge built during the reigned of President Joseph Estrada. This residential estate has a lot area of 5.3 hectares . Inside the area there are lot of mango trees that bear many fruits  and the  indoor basketball court which is also their  function hall. 
Its location is very strategic since, it is closed to  sea, bridge , malls , and only 2.5 km away from Mactan International Airport . 

![1000090564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoeDw91q7Tz33S7R7TYVqYohNQPZYoAhQCSPDgw4WXbmN7kxaeF8Pd5koj72qU4r2XA.jpg)

![1000090565.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpCAwuaZiaPASPANi6RD4sYE2ShFHYPbJzSua9LFZQMBXeiqE3EvbVowNrB7qjRUv4W.jpg)

![1000090566.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EoEsPngempAWXUnidX6czgePr84YCQNYAg9xj7jMYi3TJ4Ybbk6FNUZnL8yQfq5ptLf.jpg)
![1000090567.jpg](image-4-1000090567.jpg)

The basketball floor is made of maple hardwood with plywood as subfloor. The location of their indoor court is very nice because it is near to the sea across Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue City , and near to it is the Marcelo Fernand  Bridge that connects Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue. 
At the entrance gate of Valle Verde , it is very near  in the foot of the bridge in which under the bridge is the mini Plaza closed to the coastal area in which residents are doing their routine exercises like walking and jogging and others can do swimming. 
While I was inside the basketball court, It can't stop me to take some pictures of the stunning views of the sea and the bridge . 

![1000090568.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EqUfFnnMSnQUR5rn7qErb9NczLJjNDgbX8P3ewjBSF2avwdT84ZpZUGnpNMUWCZ7RFS.jpg)

![1000090569.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EqDk3XN9ZkvAzHz95oUv3qX5UUTARtz6xAK5GxBASapgn42pP1pHJoNHBiaaRPM1fwb.jpg)

![1000090571.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EpT5f1XBV62PfqdoqcZhUPoxaXbuYKRmskVzhEMJCBQKXLyYsuvhbJvCjChPU8pjfFD.jpg)

![1000090575.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EnWJWHKoWw7PQD4MniLWnDBFK7UavxR7AtfBmb4UUkL2AvmApsi5L6E4c6sAAq6HCFV.jpg)

On the ground of Valle Verde, you can absorbed fresh air from multiple trees and enjoy looking views of sea and the bridge and watching ships that passed by the sea beside the Lapu-Lapu mainland . 
One thing that made me wonder is that inside the residential estate , there are only very few residents . Then I asked questions about it ,it's because of the high price of the  lot . The lot is cut into 150 sqm and its prices accordingly is roughly 30,800 ,  32,250 to 46,000 per sqm depending on the location of the lot. So the lot prices is very expensive due to its nice location .
But once you  owned  the lot , it is very worth it due to its nice location. 

![1000090578.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EptbuEx8rYYmmgcyQHmKD9C8VKdokfXoXrMXskVRqMhJfqwyjsBtKPQuTrtCHiK4CKF.jpg)

![1000090580.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/EqDk1G4DhdPT2Q3c5bBpDuBrxJhDodhgHdCg2D2F8518uL1WGN9pN48hDSzjpHHrUTW.jpg)

![1000090582.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jovan1978/Epvkp6ZQVBPRyCi2GxxGg9nTeHHAudphvTvRm1Jc9yUTw8HA7oy9ttg8jeE9LyqbG5e.jpg)

These are all I can share for today friends. Thanks for visiting my blog . 
Till my next blog journey . 
God bless us all . 
Lead pictures are edited in canva and all are mine .

body.title: 💖 A Little Color, A Lot of Confidence
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXZQHoC72NsoUYZinBPCFSpv1n97H18WFqnbfXLxsdWUW/IMG_4484.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ6PkvMsoiqASUmGExTNQptiMR6DmuYsGU15x9JP6fg44/IMG_4777.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUxcAngfjcm9nMcnGgCyPRhdgT1eTT9raHVHsK2gqkpmy/IMG_4485.jpg 

Some outfits are more than just clothes.

They are little reminders that it’s okay to be bold, to stand out, and to wear the colors that make you feel alive.

Today was one of those days when I wanted something fun, something different, and something that reflected the energy I’ve been feeling lately. The bright pink pants instantly became the center of the look, and surprisingly, they gave me a boost of confidence before I even left home.

I’ve learned that fashion isn’t about following every trend. It’s about finding pieces that make you feel comfortable in your own skin and expressing your personality without saying a single word.

Life can get busy and stressful, but taking a moment to dress up, feel good, and enjoy the little details can completely change the mood of the day.

Sometimes happiness is hidden in the simplest things: a favorite outfit, a good mirror selfie, and the confidence to keep moving forward one step at a time. ✨

Thank you for stopping by and sharing this little moment with me! 💕

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hylda/-a-little-color-a-lot-of-confidence-2r1)

Un año más! Siempre agradecida por cada día,a pesar de estar lejos de mis hermanos y mis padres, ellos siempre se hacen presente, siempre estaré agradecida con Dios por darme la familia tan maravillosa que tengo, 

Este año lo compartí con mi esposo y mi hijo, esos seres que están a mi lado a pesar de las circunstancias que se presenten, los amo a todos, y siempre estaré agradecida por tenerlos. 

Les compartí un poco de mi pastel está súper rico, no quería compartir viendo una peli y mecateando! Un momento tan simple pero lleno de amor.

Inglés

Another year! Always grateful for each day, even though I'm far from my siblings and parents, they are always there for me. I will always be grateful to God for giving me such a wonderful family.

 This year I shared it with my husband and my son, those beings who are by my side despite the circumstances that arise, I love them all, and I will always be grateful to have them. 

I shared a bit of my cake with you all; it's super delicious! I didn't want to share it while watching a movie and snacking! Such a simple moment, but full of love.

body.title: Above the Clouds: Meet My Spirit Guide Team
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmedkRgCtZ3iefT3xRdAgtY4J3qz1RLhKhjZ62sUmPC9p8/1779588783300.jpg)

---

They came to me one at a time — in dreams, in meditation, in moments when the veil between worlds felt paper-thin. A masked guardian. A waddling sage. A great white bird riding the thermals. And a very enthusiastic dinosaur who has my back like no one else.

Together, they form **my spirit guide team**, and I wouldn’t trade a single one of them. Here’s who they are and what they bring to my life.

---

## ⚔️ Zorro — Gatekeeper · Protector · Threshold Guardian

Every spirit worker needs a Gatekeeper — the one who stands at the threshold between your world and theirs, deciding what gets in and what doesn't. Mine arrived in full costume: black cape billowing, sword drawn, the golden **Z** gleaming on his hat like a calling card. Dramatic? Absolutely. Effective? Without question.

Zorro’s energy is bold, decisive, and fiercely protective. He doesn’t negotiate with anything that hasn’t earned passage, and he has a flair for the theatrical that I’ve come to love. When I feel his presence, I know the space is sealed, the work is sanctioned, and nothing uninvited will cross that line. He is confidence made manifest — the part of me that knows its own worth and isn't afraid to mark it.

*His medicine: Stand in your power. Defend what matters. Leave your mark.*

---

## 🦆 Alfred — Animal Spirit Guide · Paradox & Curiosity

When Spirit sends you a platypus as a guide, you know you’re in for an interesting ride. Alfred is one of my animal spirit guides, and he embodies something I’ve come to treasure deeply: **the magic of not fitting neatly into any category.**

The platypus is famously paradoxical — a mammal who lays eggs, a creature with a duck bill and a beaver tail, one of the few venomous mammals alive. Scientists, upon first encountering a platypus specimen, thought it was a hoax stitched together from other animals. Alfred reminds me that the most extraordinary beings are often the ones that defy easy classification, and that being “too many things at once” is a superpower, not a flaw.

He’s grounding and gentle, always appearing when I need to stop trying to make sense of myself through other people's frameworks.

*His medicine: You are not a contradiction. You are a wonder.*

---

## 🕊️ Felix — Animal Spirit Guide · Messenger · Transition

There is something ancient and sacred about the stork. Long before modern mythology repurposed them into baby-delivery birds, storks were revered as souls in transit — messengers between the world of the living and the world of spirit. Felix arrived with his great wings fully spread, and I understood immediately: *this one carries messages.*

Felix is my bridge guide — the one who helps me receive transmissions from higher realms, ancestral wisdom, and the parts of my own intuition that live just above ordinary consciousness. His long neck stretches between worlds. His wingspan covers distances I can’t yet see.

He appears most strongly during periods of transition, when one chapter is closing and another hasn’t fully revealed itself yet, reminding me to trust the in-between. Stork energy is also tied to fertility — not just of the body, but of ideas, projects, and new beginnings.

*His medicine: What is being born through you right now? Trust the delivery.*

---

## 🦖 Mr. T — Protector Spirit Guide · Primal Force · Joyful Power

Yes, he’s a T-Rex. Yes, he has the exact energy of Rex from Toy Story — that glorious mix of **terrifying primal force** and **absolute puppy-dog enthusiasm**. And yes, this magnificent creature is my dedicated **Protector guide**.

Where Zorro guards the threshold — controlling what enters the sacred space — Mr. T guards *me*. He stands at my back with sixty-five million years of raw, unstoppable force behind him, and nothing gets to me without going through him first. The beauty of having a T-Rex as your Protector is that the mere suggestion of his presence tends to handle most situations before they even begin.

But Mr. T isn’t just brute force. He represents the deep, roaring, unashamed power that lives in all of us — the part that existed before self-doubt, before people-pleasing, before we learned to make ourselves small. He's ancient. He’s enormous. And he is *delighted to be here.* That paradox is exactly his gift: you can be powerful and joyful simultaneously. You can take up space without apology and still approach life with wide-eyed wonder.

He shows up when I’m overthinking, when I'm shrinking, when I’m trying to be polite to energies that deserve to be roared at. As my Protector, he doesn’t just defend me from outside threats — he defends me *from myself* when I forget how formidable I am.

*His medicine: You are not too much. You were never too much. I’ve got you. ROAR.*

---

> *“Above the clouds, my team gathers — sword drawn, wings spread, tail wagging, bill twitching — and I am never alone in the work.”*

---

Spirit guides don’t always arrive in the forms you expect. You might anticipate a wise elder in robes, a luminous angel, a serene spirit animal from some expected tradition. And then a T-Rex shows up grinning and you realize: *Spirit has a sense of humor, and it knows you better than you know yourself.*

Zorro holds the gate. Mr. T holds the field. Alfred reminds me that paradox is power. Felix carries my messages to and from the unseen. Between the four of them, I am guarded, guided, grounded, and never without a direct line to something greater.

I am well-guided. I am well-guarded. And the team, as you can see, looks absolutely magnificent above the clouds.

من أنا؟
اسمي معاذ، وأعمل في مجال تجارة وصقل العقيق اليماني الأصيل. هذا الحجر الذي يختزل تاريخاً ممتداً لآلاف السنين ليس مجرد مهنة بالنسبة لي، بل هو رسالة وشغف؛ حيث أتعامل مع أحجار طبيعية 100% بكر، كما خرجت من بطون الجبال دون أي معالجة حرارية أو أصباغ كيميائية. تبدأ رحلتي من تأمل الحجر الخام، ثم تقطيعه وتشيكله وصقله يدوياً بعناية فائقة لتبرز ألوانه الكبدية والرمانية النادرة وتفاصيله الربانية الساحرة، ليبقى محتفظاً بنقائه الطبيعي الأصيل.

عالمي واهتماماتي الأخرى:
بجانب كوني غارقاً في تفاصيل الأحجار الكريمة الطبيعية، أحب دائماً توسيع آفاقي وتغذية عقلي في مجالات متنوعة:
- الأدب والشعر: أعشق الكلمة الفصيحة والعميقة، وخاصة قصائد الشاعر اليمني الفذ \

، فكما أصقل الحجر، أجد في شعره صقلاً للروح والوعي.
- الأسواق المالية والرقمية: أتابع بحذر وشغف حركة شارتات العملات الرقمية وتحليل المؤشرات الفنية (مثل RSI و MACD)، معتمداً دائماً على التداول الفوري (Spot) الذي يتناسب مع قناعاتي وأهدافي الاستثمارية بعيدة المدى.

لماذا قررت الانضمام إلى Hive؟
بحثت طويلاً عن منصة تمنح المبدعين وأصحاب الحرف الحقيقية مساحة حرة للتعبير دون قيود المنصات المركزية وشروطها المعقدة. جئت إلى هنا لأشارككم تفاصيل وصوراً حصرية من عالم العقيق اليماني الطبيعي النقي، ولأتبادل المعرفة مع عقول راقية من مختلف أنحاء العالم.

أتطلع بشدة لدعمكم وتعليقاتكم، وأهلاً بكم جميعاً في عالم الأصالة اليمنية!

My name is Muath, and I am from Yemen. I specialize in trading and hand-polishing authentic, 100% natural Yemeni Agate (Al-Aqeeq). I deal strictly with raw, untreated gemstones right from the mountains, without any chemical dyes or thermal modifications. Turning these pure, natural stones into breathtaking gems while preserving their original organic beauty is my ultimate passion.

Beside my craftsmanship, I enjoy traditional Arabic literature—especially the deep poetry of Abdullah Al-Baradouni—and I keep a close eye on cryptocurrency spot markets and technical analysis. I chose Hive to find a free, decentralized home for my thoughts and to share the pure beauty of Yemeni gemstones with the world. Glad to be among you all!

body.title: Routine
body.body:
/>Routine can 'kill' in several ways- not just physically, but emotionally, mentally and socially. A life of routine that is too extreme will gradually sap creativity, motivation, energy and personal development. Here's a clear explanation for writing, or even your own reflection:

Routine helps us organize and provide structure. While important in some respect, a life of too much routine can also be detrimental. If people follow the same pattern everyday, their lives become monotonous and tiresome. This is seen in people's work life and personal life. A person gets up, goes to work, has the same lunch, and has the same meal, they sleep, and then they repeat it all the next day. Following such a cycle will gradually make a person feel imprisoned and unable to get out.

A person may find that too much routine slowly kills motivation and passion. When individuals do not have enough new experiences to spark interest in their lives and activities, they tend to get bored, and the interest begins to fizzle out.

They may feel constantly tired, even if they do not engage in rigorous work, due to the psychological strain of the same obligations over and over again. Too much pressure of this constant obligation could negatively affect the individual. People may become prone to anxiety and loneliness or feel depression since their lives don't seem very worthwhile anymore.

Finally, too much routine may kill creativity and the growth of individuals. They become comfortable with the everyday habit and lose all desire to try something new. They may shun opportunities and tasks that are difficult, as they fear moving away from their comfortable and 'safe' routine. In return, individuals do not further their learning or their skillset.

An individual may also find their relationships suffer as they can get consumed by work and day-to-day activities. They may be seeing their family and friends a lot less often, which leads to emotional distance and fraying relations.

Though routine is important to be both functional and successful, it is also important to be able to strike a balance. One must make time for relaxation, leisure, trips and friends, physical exercise, hobbies, etc. Making time for such activities is crucial for making one's life fun and more importantly, healthy. A good routine should support one's life and not take it over.

body.title: The Bitcoin Tug-of-War: Can Big Banks Control Digital Money?
body.body:
Imagine you are playing a game of tag. You invent a totally new, secret move that lets you run super fast and dodge everyone. For a while, you are winning every single game. But eventually, the other kids watch you, figure out your trick, and use their size to corner you.
Some people think this is exactly what is happening to Bitcoin right now.
#
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUxKTUTELKqtdA19Lu5N1prSCznLFwBXrr2N7Lg5io1Wd/Screenshot%202026-05-23%20at%204.17.09%E2%80%AFPM.png 

#

***Bitcoin was created to be a new kind of digital money*** that doesn't need banks or governments. However, some experts say that the world took so long to start using Bitcoin that big banks and powerful financial companies finally had time to study it. Now, those big companies might be ready to take over and control it. While that idea makes sense on paper, we have to look at how it will actually play out in real life. Here are three main points to consider.

---

### Point 1: Big Banks Are Buying In

First, it is true that powerful financial institutions are stepping into the Bitcoin world. For a long time, traditional banks ignored Bitcoin or said it was a bad idea. But because Bitcoin didn't go away, they changed their minds. Today, giant investment companies have created special funds (called ETFs) that let everyday people invest in Bitcoin through regular stock accounts. By doing this, these huge companies are becoming the gatekeepers. They are getting a lot of power over how Bitcoin is bought and sold, which means they can influence its price and how it is used.

### Point 2: Bitcoin’s Code is Hard to Change

Second, even though rich companies can buy a lot of Bitcoin, controlling the actual technology is a completely different story. Bitcoin runs on a giant, shared computer network called a blockchain. No single person, bank, or government owns this network. To change the rules of Bitcoin, thousands of computer owners all over the world have to agree. Because the system is decentralized (meaning it has no single boss), a big wall street bank cannot just press a button and change how Bitcoin works. The code protects Bitcoin from being easily controlled by any one group.

### Point 3: The Battle Between Old and New

Finally, the future will likely be a giant tug-of-war between the old financial system and the new digital world. In reality, big banks probably won't completely destroy Bitcoin, and Bitcoin won't completely destroy big banks. Instead, they might have to learn to live together. Banks will try to make Bitcoin follow strict government rules and look more like regular money. At the same time, people who love the original idea of Bitcoin will keep inventing new ways to use it privately and freely.

---

> **The Big Takeaway:** The powerful rulers of the old economy have definitely caught up to Bitcoin and are trying to build fences around it. But because Bitcoin was built to be independent, it won't be easily tamed. How it plays out in reality depends on who wins the daily battle: the giant companies buying it up, or the regular people using its unstoppable technology.

body.title: Solidaridad: el tesoro humano que escasea (esp-eng)
body.body:
​<center>![1000028593.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wX9hhSUahzu7myg16ff4t3fTYWe9TmGxoWHZq8mRTPPwcDqsia8Jie9KGCgLt22S22p.jpg)</center>

[¿Quién dijo que la solidaridad se ha perdido?](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/quien-dijo-que-la-solidaridad-se-ha-perdidoororwho-said-solidarity-is-lost), es la pregunta que plantea la amiga @damarysvibra en su trabajo reflexivo.

​En él, relata la visión que ha tenido al estar cuidando de su hermana convaleciente, donde cada noche diversos grupos de personas llegan a brindar ayuda de diversas maneras.
​Al leerla con detenimiento, fue imposible que un recuerdo pasado no llegara a mi mente, y es que en medio del desconcierto, el terror y todas las emociones revueltas de esa etapa, había una luz que venía de personas desconocidas.

​Nunca he relatado esta bella parte y quizás no era el momento hasta ahora.
​Muchos tienen conocimiento de lo que pasamos como familia con mi hija Julieta, quien a sus catorce días de nacida enfrentó una batalla con la muerte, misma que ganó con pura fuerza y coraje, y claro, también con las muchas plegarias que los bellos ángeles de #hive hicieron por ella.

​Y allí fue que nació la primera solidaridad, y es que la solidaridad no es ayudar de manera física siempre; también está la ayuda moral, esa que está a kilómetros y otorga parte de su tiempo para conectar con aquella persona que sufre. Es decir, pone su fortaleza, amor y creencia en elevar una plegaria por quien no conocen más allá de letras e imágenes, y esa es la solidaridad más bella que pueda existir.

​Lo mismo ocurrió desde la natal Argentina de mi esposo; allí sus amigos y conocidos, reunidos en plegaria, conectaban sus corazones para que el petitorio por la salud de Julieta resonara más fuerte en las puertas del cielo.
​Sin darnos cuenta, estábamos recibiendo la solidaridad a kilómetros de donde estábamos, con la fuerza de gente que nos conocía y otros que nos conocían por cuentos, relatos e iniciativas.

​Pero en el hospital no fue distinto, y es que allí muchos sufren, otros se alegran de la mejoría y otros sufren porque esta no llegó. Pero acá me quiero detener, porque en estas paredes blancas, de pisos y más pisos con escaleras infinitas y ascensores de cristal que dejan ver el cielo por más que esté nublado, existe la solidaridad en cada cimiento, en cada baldosa y en cada murmullo de sus salas.

​Al estar con mi niña intubada, nos encontramos con diversos ángeles que la cuidaban; como he dicho antes, ellos la apodaron como “la pequeña guerrera”, porque ella no se rendía y peleaba con todas sus fuerzas.

​En esa instancia, recuerdo que entró una señora de falda gris y suéter gris oscuro, su cabello algo cano sujetado en un moño. Entró a la habitación mientras mi esposo y yo, tomados de la mano, mirábamos a nuestra pequeña recostada en una enorme cama con tantas mangueras que aterraba.

​La señora entró con una sonrisa que calmaba el alma, nos preguntó si podía orar por nuestra hija y dijimos que sí asintiendo con la cabeza.
​Allí, ella abrió su Biblia y comenzó a orar por nuestra niña; la paz que esa señora emanaba era un bálsamo al dolor que teníamos. Al día siguiente nuestra niña comenzó a mejorar y allí, en ese acto de fe y solidaridad, le había regalado a nuestra hija y a nosotros una firme esperanza.

<center>![1000028594.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/EpQxJZLMxjVtkacLom9iEe2FNRX9TZyjNFrjmk278m3DYc1roVqYHFWb7iZaJMjh3ND.png)</center> 

​Una vez estuvo mejor y fue trasladada a otra habitación, la solidaridad continuó. Recuerdo que en la habitación había dos mamás con sus hijos, a los cuales les dieron el alta médica al día siguiente, pero como son hospitales, esos cupos se ocuparon velozmente.

​Llegó una mamá con su pequeño, que tenía quemaduras de segundo grado; ella se llama Camilla y nos hicimos compañía esa noche. Hablando de todo y nada, la soledad nocturna se hizo menos y al día siguiente sus dos hermanas llegaron, Maritza y Sara, así se presentaron, y desde esa tarde una conexión especial se dio.

​Estas tres hermanas, que parecían ser mis luceros, me adoptaron como a una cuarta hermana; me llamaban por teléfono al estar en el primer piso para preguntar qué me llevaban de comer, se preocupaban de mí para que estuviera fuerte para mi bebé, y es que mi esposo, entre que nos iba a ver al hospital, también cuidaba a nuestra hija mayor, que en esa época tenía apenas tres años.

​Estas hermanas, que adoraron a mi hija, la cuidaban como tías reales, de esas que están ahí sin que lo pidas, y esa solidaridad fue como si hubieran reforzado las paredes de mi fuerza rota.
​Por otro lado, otras personas también nos daban de su solidaridad a todos.

Cada sábado en la noche, sabiendo que las madres o padres que cuidaban a sus hijos no tenían nada caliente en sus panzas, iban con ollas gigantes repletas de delicioso consomé y café caliente, además de un sándwich de queso.
​Ellos iban a las salas y nos turnábamos con las mamás de la habitación; mientras una iba, las otras dos cuidaban, y así todas podíamos tener algo caliente en la barriga y recibir esa ayuda como un abrazo de amor delicioso.

<center>![1000028596.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uFHNycjbdseyFTyjCk2CG5Qu5NFyMP6UdSepXJxTbnyVBiVLnLsuiuDyDfqexb5S1yC.png)</center> 

​Recordando esto, siento que los hospitales guardan tantas historias como solidaridad, porque en el lugar donde todos sufren, la solidaridad se refuerza y se hace más grande, porque allí todos buscan reparar tu puente para que cruces más rápido al lado tranquilo y, del mismo modo, cuando uno ya está cruzando, sin darse cuenta ha ido dejando el puente más firme para que el que viene detrás no sienta tanto temor al cruzarlo.
***
### <center>English</center>
***

<center>![1000028593.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23wX9hhSUahzu7myg16ff4t3fTYWe9TmGxoWHZq8mRTPPwcDqsia8Jie9KGCgLt22S22p.jpg)</center>

​[Who said solidarity is lost?](https://peakd.com/hive-131951/@damarysvibra/quien-dijo-que-la-solidaridad-se-ha-perdidoororwho-said-solidarity-is-lost), is the question posed by my friend @damarysvibra in her reflective piece.

In it, she recounts the experience she has had whilst caring for her convalescing sister, where every night various groups of people arrive to offer help in different ways.
Reading it carefully, it was impossible for a past memory not to come to mind, and that is that amidst the confusion, the terror and all the jumbled emotions of that period, there was a light that came from strangers.

I have never recounted this beautiful part before, and perhaps now was the time.
Many are aware of what we went through as a family with my daughter Julieta, who, at just fourteen days old, faced a battle with death, which she won through sheer strength and courage, and of course, also thanks to the many prayers that the beautiful angels of #hive offered for her.

And that was when the first act of solidarity was born, for solidarity is not always about physical help; there is also moral support—that which comes from miles away and gives of its time to connect with the person who is suffering. In other words, it puts its strength, love and faith into offering a prayer for someone they know only through words and images, and that is the most beautiful form of solidarity that can exist.

The same thing happened in my husband’s native Argentina; there, his friends and acquaintances, gathered in prayer, connected their hearts so that the plea for Julieta’s health might resonate more strongly at the gates of heaven.
Without realising it, we were receiving solidarity from miles away, through the strength of people who knew us and others who knew us through stories, accounts and initiatives.

But it was no different at the hospital; there, many are suffering, others are rejoicing at their recovery, and others are suffering because that recovery never came. But I want to pause here, because within these white walls, with floors upon floors, endless staircases and glass lifts that let you see the sky even when it’s cloudy, there is solidarity in every foundation, in every tile and in every whisper in its wards.

Whilst with my intubated little girl, we met various angels who were looking after her; as I said before, they nicknamed her ‘the little warrior’, because she wouldn’t give up and fought with all her might.

At that moment, I remember a lady in a grey skirt and a dark grey jumper coming in, her slightly greying hair tied back in a bun. She entered the room whilst my husband and I, holding hands, looked at our little girl lying on a huge bed with so many tubes it was terrifying.

The lady entered with a smile that soothed the soul; she asked us if she could pray for our daughter, and we nodded in agreement.
There, she opened her Bible and began to pray for our little girl; the peace that this lady radiated was a balm for the pain we were feeling. The next day our little girl began to improve, and there, in that act of faith and solidarity, she had given our daughter and us a firm hope.

<center>![1000028594.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/EpQxJZLMxjVtkacLom9iEe2FNRX9TZyjNFrjmk278m3DYc1roVqYHFWb7iZaJMjh3ND.png)</center> 

Once she was better and had been moved to another room, the solidarity continued. I remember that in the room there were two mums with their children, who were discharged the following day, but as these are hospitals, those beds were quickly taken.

A mother arrived with her little boy, who had second-degree burns; her name was Camilla and we kept each other company that night. Talking about everything and nothing, the loneliness of the night eased, and the next day her two sisters arrived, Maritza and Sara, as they introduced themselves, and from that afternoon a special bond formed.

These three sisters, who seemed to be my guiding stars, took me in as a fourth sister; they would ring me from the ground floor to ask what they should bring me to eat, they looked after me so that I would be strong for my baby, and the fact is that my husband, whilst visiting us in hospital, was also looking after our eldest daughter, who was just three years old at the time.

These sisters, who adored my daughter, looked after her like real aunts—the sort who are there without you even asking—and that solidarity was as if they had reinforced the walls of my shattered strength.
​Meanwhile, other people also showed their solidarity with all of us.

Every Saturday night, knowing that the mothers or fathers looking after their children had nothing warm in their bellies, they would come with huge pots full of delicious broth and hot coffee, as well as a cheese sandwich.
They would go to the wards and we would take turns with the mums in the room; whilst one went, the other two would look after the children, and so we could all have something warm in our tummies and receive that help like a delicious embrace of love.

<center>![1000028596.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23uFHNycjbdseyFTyjCk2CG5Qu5NFyMP6UdSepXJxTbnyVBiVLnLsuiuDyDfqexb5S1yC.png)</center> 

​Remembering this, I feel that hospitals hold as many stories of solidarity as they do of suffering, because in a place where everyone suffers, solidarity is strengthened and grows greater, because there everyone seeks to repair the bridge so that you can cross more quickly to the peaceful side; and, in the same way, when one is already crossing, without realising it, one has been making the bridge more sturdy so that those coming behind do not feel so much fear when crossing it.
***
<center>![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/1000009838.png)</center>

<sub>El texto fue traducido en DeepL versión free.</sub>

Hello, friends of the #ShadowHunters community, thanks to our friend @melinda010100 for inviting us to this initiative in her Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest – Round 427.

  
### Shadows Beside the Pool

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdtxDagNuD9Gdwinbv6Un4mbxvoEBEXCX1riqCSFa1yAQ/screenshot_20260522_115950_01.jpg)

---

These days I continue staying at the hotel because of the fuel situation and the transportation difficulties that have become part of daily life. Walking through the hotel areas, many spaces now feel quieter than usual, especially around the pools.

---

Near one of them, there are several movable cabanas with lounge chairs inside, designed so tourists can rest protected from the strong Cuban sun. This time, however, what caught my attention was not the structures themselves, but the shadows they projected on the ground.

---

The morning light stretched the shapes of those cabanas across the pavement, creating geometric shadows that seemed almost more alive than the empty resting areas themselves. Even without tourists around, the shadows remained there, silently occupying the space and reminding me of the purpose those places once had every day.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ5P5edCkmSY2qmFPuruRzco1cZkRvXvNBwKK5DNPaUXi/screenshot_20260522_115945_01.jpg)

Hola, amigos de la comunidad #ShadowHunters, gracias a la amiga @melinda010100 por convocarnos a esta iniciativa en su Shadow Hunters SMASh Contest – Round 427.

### Sombras junto a la piscina

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdtxDagNuD9Gdwinbv6Un4mbxvoEBEXCX1riqCSFa1yAQ/screenshot_20260522_115950_01.jpg)

---

Por estos días continúo quedándome en el hotel debido a la situación del combustible y las dificultades con el transporte que ya forman parte de la rutina diaria. Caminando por las áreas del hotel, muchos espacios se sienten ahora más silenciosos de lo habitual, especialmente alrededor de las piscinas.

---

Cerca de una de ellas hay varias marquesinas móviles con tumbonas en su interior, pensadas para que los turistas puedan descansar protegidos del fuerte sol cubano. Esta vez, sin embargo, lo que llamó mi atención no fueron las estructuras en sí, sino las sombras que proyectaban sobre el suelo.

---

La luz de la mañana alargaba las formas de esas marquesinas sobre el pavimento, creando sombras geométricas que parecían tener más vida que las propias áreas de descanso vacías. Incluso sin turistas alrededor, las sombras seguían allí, ocupando el espacio en silencio y recordando el propósito que esos lugares tenían cada día.

---

body.title: The Most Expensive Thing Hive Can Do Right Now Is \
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lordbutterfly/EoCaPHbkurSEXKK3P6C36AnrJXQEewqbb7PDmN7JKsy7knC7xGw5Ry8bXgpw2kWnoHf.jpg)



Other chains are using AI to build their ecosystems right now. Not experimenting with it. Building. Protocol tooling, infrastructure, onboarding flows, market intelligence, documentation, outreach automation. We are living through the biggest shift in the history of building things and most of the Hive community is watching it from the sidelines.

The AI skeptics. They show up to every AI conversation to explain why the code can't be trusted, why you are too stupid to use the tools in front of you. Why it's a toy. Why they personally would never use it for anything important. Those that deter you from even attempting it. 
I can easily use a harsher word, but no softer word applies. They are fools. The proponents of horse backed carriages in the time of rockets to the moon. 
These people are actively costing the Hive ecosystem builders and valuable projects in a time where ideas no longer have a gap you could not fill between inception till execution.
**Their damage is not in them not taking charge, their damage is in convincing others they should not even try to.** 


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lordbutterfly/AKb9Gyo2jMTSUyiBBT8ZGjjPXzc4tAPcx6fvYiCzPqBxBcaqeM8PyneDmSNt7oy.png)</center>


They're a drag on everything that tries to move. 
A boulder of cynicism around everyone's neck trying to sink this chain due to their own fears.

We are right now having serious conversations about whether the problem with Hive growth is that it's called Hive.
Think about what that means. Think about the amount of energy going into that while other ecosystems are using AI to actually build products people use.
The name is not the problem. Not creating what the market actually needs is the problem. The inaction, the reliance on quick and easy ways out is the problem. 
**The absence of real products that real users outside our bubble actually want.** And many will apparently reach for every easy lever that exists before they accept that.
#### There is no easy solution. There never was one. The solution is work.

Most people will take the easy way. They will attach themselves to the stupidest, most misguided non-solutions as long as it doesn't require them to put in any work. There are no cure-alls, there are no magic words that will save us. 

**Superman isnt coming and Wonderwoman is canceled**.  

### There is NOTHING, there never was anything, there never will be anything, beyond working your fingers to the bone, that will ever lead the Hive blockchain beyond where it is right now. 

Great ideas and real work.  

And here is the insane part. The part that should actually scare you.
We are at the first moment in history where anyone can build anything they ever wanted to build. Not eventually. 
Right now. Today. The barrier between having an idea and building it has never been lower and it will never be this low again relative to everyone else because everyone else is figuring it out too.

Its about every idea that never became anything because the person who had it told themselves they couldn't build it.
That person exists in the thousands on every chain. People who have been here for years. Who understand Hive better than most. Who have seen exactly what is missing, exactly what would bring users here, exactly what this blockchain needs. And they never built it. Not because the idea was bad. Because the gap between idea and execution felt too wide.
**That gap is gone. It closed. You missed the memo.**
*And do read your memos because I know you missed to vote for the Magi proposal [#378](https://peakd.com/hive/@magi.network/magi-network-dhf-proposal-2026)*.

The window where doing this gives us an advantage over communities that haven't figured it out yet is closing.
Other communities are going for gold right now. We're arguing about a goddamn name, arguing about random nonsense and patting ourselves on the back because of how awesome we are. 

**But the real question is: Are you actually building something right now or are you waiting on someone else to save you?**

body.body:
>
![InShot_20260523_215942247.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRqwhQ6aT83yHnyvPRfgznbq4GJMstNormqqqNy7cp29i/InShot_20260523_215942247.jpg)
Creo que todos nosotros hemos vivido situaciones donde queremos que las cosas pasen como deseamos, queremos obtener el resultado que consideramos es el mejor... Incluso a veces tratamos de controlar todo, de direccionar los hechos y las personas para obtener lo que pensamos debe ser. Pero la vida no funciona así, toda situación, etapa o evento tiene su propia forma, su propio desenlace y todo fluye según debe ser... Debemos sembrar y actuar de una manera correcta y así tratar de obtener una buena cosecha, pero debemos aprender a soltar y aceptar que las cosas pasan según debe ser. Todo en esta vida pasa como debe pasar, en su momento justo y la hora perfecta, a veces nuestro deseo de controlar más que beneficiar obstaculiza el resultado, a veces por mucho que lo intentemos no podemos revertir lo que ha de ser, para bien o para mal así debe ser. Cuando tememos tanto de lo que puede pasar terminamos con una obsesion, nos autorobamos la paz y dejamos de disfrutar el viaje, vivimos en un mundo que nos hace creer que lo importante es el resultado, que es eso lo que nos va a dar felicidad... Olvidando que el proceso nos permite crecer, aprender, también nos da felicidad y es la vía para trabajar en nuestros sueños; es gracias al proceso y a cómo lo honramos que vamos a obtener un buen resultado. Eso sí debemos aprender que trabajar en el proceso no es lo mismo que perseguir nuestro sueño, porque aunque suene bonito la verdad es que lo que se persigue termina huyendo, porque hay una ley en la vida que se aplica para todo y es que cuando perseguimos algo eso nos huye, un ejemplo de esto es cuando buscamos el amor o cuando buscamos atrapar una gallina con su pollito, esto se nos esconde, nos huye; así que debemos trabajar pero sin caer en la obsesión o la presión, debemos llevar nuestra vida con equilibrio para atraer lo bueno. No es apatía, no es desinterés, es equilibrio, es confianza, es creer que las semillas que plantamos van a obtener el resultado que merecemos... Cuando le dedicamos más tiempo y más energía de lo debido a cualquier proyecto, situación u objetivo entonces vamos a perder la paz y nuestra paz no es negociable, y nada vale más que nuestra propia tranquilidad. Soltar no es sinónimo de rendirse, es entender y confiar en que en la vida todo tiene su proceso y su forma, que hay una fuerza superior que no podemos manejar y que controla todo, nosotros debemos hacer nuestra parte sí, pero sin perder nuestra paz, porque no hay éxito, no hay logros si nosotros no estamos bien internamente. Protege tu paz, tu energía, tu tranquilidad y confía en que las semillas que has plantado han sido las correctas y deja que la vida haga su magia, porque al final del día, de la vida o del proyecto, lo más importante no es el resultado sino el viaje. ______ ###

I think we've all been in situations where we want things to go our way, where we want the outcome we consider best. Sometimes we even try to control everything, to steer events and people in our favor to get what we think should happen. But life doesn't work that way. Every situation, stage, or event has its own course, its own outcome, and everything unfolds as it should. We must sow seeds and act in the right way to try to reap a good harvest, but we must also learn to let go and accept that things happen as they are meant to. Everything in life happens as it should, at the right time and in the perfect moment. Sometimes our desire to control, rather than benefit, hinders the outcome. Sometimes, no matter how hard we try, we can't change what is meant to be; for better or for worse, that's how it must be. When we fear so much what might happen, we end up obsessed, we steal our own peace, and we stop enjoying the journey. We live in a world that makes us believe that the result is what matters, that it's what will bring us happiness... forgetting that the process allows us to grow, to learn, it also brings us happiness, and it's the path to working on our dreams. It's thanks to the process and how we honor it that we will achieve a good result. We must learn that working on the process is not the same as chasing our dream, because although it sounds nice, the truth is that what we chase ends up eluding us. There's a law in life that applies to everything: when we chase something, it eludes us. An example of this is when we look for love or when we try to catch a hen with her chick; it hides from us, it runs away. So we must work, but without falling into obsession or pressure. We must live our lives with balance to attract good things. It's not apathy, it's not disinterest, it's balance, it's confidence, it's believing that the seeds we plant will reap the results we deserve. When we dedicate more time and energy than necessary to any project, situation, or goal, we lose our peace, and our peace is non-negotiable. Nothing is more valuable than our own tranquility. Letting go isn't synonymous with giving up; it's understanding and trusting that everything in life has its own process and way, that there's a higher power beyond our control that governs everything. We must do our part, yes, but without losing our peace, because there is no success, no achievement, if we aren't at peace internally. Protect your peace, your energy, your tranquility, and trust that the seeds you've planted were the right ones. Let life work its magic, because at the end of the day, at the end of life, or at the end of a project, the most important thing isn't the result, but the journey. _____ # ![1746651717170760710626541328692.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmetewFXFfpLPkHUT3bqXyuaa5BHUDoDt3Lm8aFTakkWSf/1746651717170760710626541328692.png) * Portada creada en Inshot con fotografía personal. * Demás imágenes utilizadas son de mi galería personal. body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g99d14e49aa4fcd427afae3fdd9e6641f6ec68a790aa743c5703fb1db8f01548f94c4f5f378210003a787cf0b14472cbc141ec2c3c678b34a78371513da969bb7_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Village

## Once upon a time in a tranquil valley...

There was a village named Melodia, where the people lived in perfect harmony. The villagers believed that harmony was the key to a joyful life, and they celebrated it every day through music, dance, and shared laughter. They worked together to cultivate their fields, build their homes, and raise their children. 

### The Secret of Harmony

The villagers of Melodia had a secret: they embraced their differences. Each villager brought unique talents and perspectives to the community. The baker created delicious bread, the weaver crafted beautiful fabrics, and the musician filled the air with enchanting melodies. They understood that harmony was not about uniformity but about blending diverse notes into a beautiful symphony.

### A Newcomer Arrives

One day, a traveler named Lira arrived in Melodia. She was captivated by the village's charm and the joyful spirit of its people. However, Lira was also a perfectionist, and she believed that true harmony could only be achieved through strict rules and conformity. 

Determined to improve the village, Lira began to impose her ideas. She suggested that everyone should dress the same, sing the same songs, and follow the same routines. At first, the villagers complied, hoping to please their new friend. But soon, the vibrant colors of their lives began to fade.

### The Dissonance

As the villagers lost their individuality, the once lively melodies of Melodia turned into a monotonous hum. The baker's bread lost its unique flavor, the weaver's fabrics became dull, and the musician's songs fell silent. The village, once filled with laughter and joy, now felt heavy with unspoken frustration.

### The Awakening

One evening, as the sun set over the valley, the villagers gathered to discuss the changes. They realized that while they had sought to maintain harmony, they had inadvertently stifled their true selves. They understood that harmony thrives on diversity, and that it is the interplay of different voices that creates beauty.

### The Return to True Harmony

With newfound wisdom, the villagers invited Lira to join them in a celebration of their unique talents. They encouraged her to embrace her own individuality as well. Together, they danced, sang, and shared their stories, rediscovering the vibrant spirit of Melodia.

From that day on, the villagers celebrated their differences while cherishing the bonds that united them. They learned that true harmony is not the absence of discord, but the ability to create a beautiful melody from contrasting notes.

## The Lesson

**In the pursuit of harmony, remember:**

- **Embrace Differences:** True harmony flourishes when diverse voices are heard.
- **Celebrate Individuality:** Each person's uniqueness adds depth to the collective experience.
- **Adapt and Reflect:** Harmony requires constant reflection and adaptation; it is a living, breathing entity.

### Conclusion

In the heart of Melodia, the villagers learned that harmony is not about conformity but about the beautiful dance of differences coming together. And so, they lived happily ever after, creating a symphony of life that resonated through the ages.

#### The Shadow of a Palm in the Morning

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekkbc5WhRvvwDH6onHg1wgAZhqMq4Qh5rodVJqX7aKgA/screenshot_20260523_203650_01.jpg)

---

Hello dear #ShadowHunters community,

This is my entry for the ShadowHunters SMASh contest number 427.

Some trips to the beach begin long before reaching the sea.

There are mornings when the road itself becomes part of the experience. The city is still relatively quiet, the air feels fresher than usual, and the sunlight begins to slowly take possession of the landscape.

This photograph was taken during one of those mornings.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbE1BxYWguoLdTNfXdimUXpEkY2MxtDVEZh5rsUNp5YWF/screenshot_20260523_203657_01.jpg)

---

On the way to the beach, I noticed this beautiful palm standing alone over the grass, illuminated by the strong light of the early sun. What immediately caught my attention was not only the shape of the plant itself, but the shadow it projected onto the ground.

The sun was still low enough to stretch its silhouette across the grass.

Its large fan-shaped leaves created a very defined shadow, full of pointed shapes and elegant lines. The contrast between the illuminated grass and the darker figure projected beside the palm gave the scene a very peaceful atmosphere.

There was also movement in the air.

The morning breeze gently moved the leaves, and with every small motion, the shadow changed slightly over the ground. It was as if the palm were quietly drawing over the grass using only sunlight and wind.

I stopped for a moment to observe it more carefully.

Sometimes during trips to the beach we focus only on reaching the sea as quickly as possible, forgetting that along the way there are also moments worth noticing. Small scenes created by light, vegetation and the calm rhythm of the morning.

That is something I appreciate more with time.

The beach eventually arrives with its brightness, its sound and its energy, but before that, the morning leaves behind these quieter details that often remain unnoticed.

That is why I decided to photograph this shadow.

Because in that brief stop along the way, the palm and the morning sun created a simple but beautiful composition made of grass, light… and shadow.

Up to this point my entry for this week’s contest. The images are my property and for the English version I use DeepL Translate.

---
Thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting content on Hive.

- - -
🇪🇸 En Español
- - -

#### La sombra de una palma en la mañana

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekkbc5WhRvvwDH6onHg1wgAZhqMq4Qh5rodVJqX7aKgA/screenshot_20260523_203650_01.jpg)

---

Hola querida comunidad de #ShadowHunters,

Esta es mi entrada para el concurso ShadowHunters SMASh número 427.

Algunos viajes a la playa comienzan mucho antes de llegar al mar.

Hay mañanas en las que el propio camino se convierte en parte de la experiencia. La ciudad todavía permanece relativamente tranquila, el aire se siente más fresco de lo habitual y la luz del sol comienza poco a poco a apoderarse del paisaje.

Esta fotografía fue tomada durante una de esas mañanas.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbE1BxYWguoLdTNfXdimUXpEkY2MxtDVEZh5rsUNp5YWF/screenshot_20260523_203657_01.jpg)

---

Camino a la playa observé esta hermosa palma elevándose sola sobre la hierba, iluminada por la intensa luz del sol temprano. Lo primero que llamó mi atención no fue únicamente la forma de la planta, sino la sombra que proyectaba sobre el suelo.

El sol todavía estaba lo suficientemente bajo como para alargar su silueta sobre la hierba.

Sus grandes hojas en forma de abanico creaban una sombra muy definida, llena de puntas y líneas elegantes. El contraste entre la hierba iluminada y la figura oscura proyectada junto a la palma daba a la escena una atmósfera muy tranquila.

También había movimiento en el aire.

La brisa de la mañana movía suavemente las hojas y, con cada pequeño movimiento, la sombra cambiaba ligeramente sobre el suelo. Era como si la palma estuviera dibujando silenciosamente sobre la hierba utilizando únicamente la luz del sol y el viento.

Me detuve un momento a observarla con más atención.

A veces, durante los viajes a la playa, nos concentramos únicamente en llegar al mar lo más rápido posible, olvidando que en el camino también existen momentos dignos de observar. Pequeñas escenas creadas por la luz, la vegetación y el ritmo tranquilo de la mañana.

Es algo que con el tiempo he aprendido a apreciar más.

La playa finalmente aparece con su brillo, su sonido y su energía, pero antes de eso la mañana deja estos detalles más silenciosos que muchas veces pasan desapercibidos.

Tal vez por eso decidí fotografiar esta sombra.

Porque en esa breve pausa del camino, la palma y el sol de la mañana crearon una composición sencilla pero hermosa hecha de hierba, luz… y sombra.

Hasta aquí mi entrada al concurso de la semana, las imágenes son de mi propiedad y para la versión en inglés utilizo DeepL Translate.

body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![N8xdaZsymRfE6ESt_d40de1493f057c51.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/yellowbird/images/N8xdaZsymRfE6ESt_d40de1493f057c51/N8xdaZsymRfE6ESt_d40de1493f057c51.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

这个周末，武汉下雨，下雨，继续下雨~~~只能窝在家里了。

我周六还有些项目的事情，上午一般督促阳坨完成家庭作业，一边我在电脑上干活。另外也没让打印机闲着，我周末的日常，总是会找点什么来打印，打印的过程本身就是很解压。

感觉有一个任劳任怨的员工在帮你干活。

这个周末我决定把很早就收藏的“刑具”模型，一把“真子弹”抢打印出来。圈子里很有意思，把很多抢的玩具都说成是“刑”，玩抢玩不好就会入刑的。

这个枪的作者是天福，真是个天才，懂机械结构，搞了这个个脑洞的玩具。我很快就打印出来，也迫不及待的验证可玩性。

把子弹装上，还真能发射出去，能打个四五米远~~~这都让我有点担心，千万在家里不能对着玻璃干，很可能就把玻璃干碎了。

更不能对着人，为了安全，我打印了个圆头的子弹，这样危险性稍微好点。

子弹会从弹壳里发射出去，然后留下弹壳。很像电视里抗日剧那样的玩步枪，放一个子弹进去，然后发射，只不过这是一只手枪。

阳坨也是玩的不亦乐乎，于是继续干，准备周末把阳坨之前想玩的一个左轮打印出来~~~~

| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |

|     Genus Amata      |      May 23, 2026      |       Vodrochol, Ullapara, Bangladesh      | 

Yesterday afternoon, I saw this small Handmaiden Moth in the grass in the bushes, and I took some pictures of it. Today, I am sharing the pictures of this moth with everyone. The orange-yellow spots on the black body and the unique design of the wings made it very attractive. I was sitting in an open space next to this bush with my elder brother and talking, when suddenly my eyes fell on this moth, and I captured this moth with the camera on my phone.

This is a moth of the Amata genus, which belongs to the Erebidae family. They are commonly called Handmaidens or Tiger Moths. Due to its bright spots and colors, this moth looked extraordinary, as if it were a work of art made by nature.

Since I saw the moth, the moth was sitting quietly on the tip of the grass, but this moment of this moth sitting quietly is really worth seeing. These small creatures are a beautiful part of nature's biodiversity, and it is never possible to enjoy their beauty without seeing them up close.

Now I am sharing some pictures of this insect below, I hope you like it and enjoy it.
