body.title: A Refuge from the Cuban Sun. Entry for the ShadowHunters SMASh Contest-round 427
body.body:
Hello Shadow Hunters community, once again I’m posting in this community and doing so to take part in the ShadowHunters SMASh Contest, round 427.

---

## ShadowHunters SMASh Contest – A Refuge from the Cuban Sun

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcojujQqx5G9ojSasNKFohubT2NpoGanaWTDngpeRtbDB/screenshot_20260523_211035_01.jpg)

---

These days the sun in Cuba feels extremely strong, and August—the hottest month of the year—has not even arrived yet.

At the beach the heat feels even more intense, but despite everything, going to the sea is still one of the few simple pleasures we can truly enjoy in this country. At least the beach itself is free, because transportation, food, or having something cold to drink is already another story.

Still, people keep going.

There is something special about the sea breeze, the sound of the waves, and the feeling of escaping routine for a few hours. And on days like these, finding a good shadow becomes almost as valuable as the beach itself.

That is exactly what caught my attention in this scene.

The palm umbrella projected a beautiful shadow over the sand, creating a small refuge from the strong sunlight. The contrast between the bright beach and the dark shape on the sand made the image feel calm and inviting at the same time.

Sometimes a shadow is not only a visual detail. Sometimes it becomes relief, rest, and protection.

While everyone searches for a place to cool down under the intense Caribbean sun, these simple spaces gain a special meaning.

And this is the shadow I want to share with you today for this contest.

---

Thanks to @melinda010100 for every call for this contest. 

Thanks for everything, and I declare that the images were taken with my mobile phone and the English translation is thanks to Google Translate.

---

## 🇪🇸 Versión en Español

---

Hola comunidad Shadow Hunters, una vez más estoy publicando en esta comunidad y lo hago para participar en el ShadowHunters SMASh Contest, ronda 427.

---

## Concurso ShadowHunters SMASh – Un refugio bajo el sol cubano

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcojujQqx5G9ojSasNKFohubT2NpoGanaWTDngpeRtbDB/screenshot_20260523_211035_01.jpg)

---

Por estos días el sol en Cuba se siente extremadamente fuerte, y eso que todavía no ha llegado agosto, que suele ser el mes más caluroso del año.

En la playa el calor se siente aún más intenso, pero a pesar de todo, ir al mar sigue siendo una de las pocas cosas simples que realmente podemos disfrutar en este país. Al menos la playa en sí es gratis, porque el transporte, la comida o tomarse algo frío ya es otra historia.

Aun así, la gente sigue yendo.

Hay algo especial en la brisa del mar, el sonido de las olas y la sensación de escapar de la rutina aunque sea por unas horas. Y en días como estos, encontrar una buena sombra se vuelve casi tan valioso como la playa misma.

Eso fue exactamente lo que llamó mi atención en esta escena.

La sombrilla de guano proyectaba una hermosa sombra sobre la arena, creando un pequeño refugio frente al fuerte sol. El contraste entre la claridad de la playa y la forma oscura sobre la arena hacía que la imagen transmitiera calma y descanso al mismo tiempo.

A veces una sombra no es solo un detalle visual. A veces también se convierte en alivio, descanso y protección.

Mientras todos buscan un lugar donde refrescarse bajo el intenso sol del Caribe, estos espacios sencillos adquieren un significado especial.

Y esta es la sombra que quiero compartir hoy con ustedes para este concurso.

---

Gracias a @melinda010100 por cada convocatoria de este concurso.

Gracias por todo, y declaro que las imágenes fueron tomadas con mi teléfono móvil y la traducción al inglés es gracias a Google Translate.

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

body.body: 용기는 큰 일에서만 필요한 것이 아니다. 매일의 작은 순간에도 필요하다.\

https://media.tenor.com/_0ULZfR4dysAAAAi/woah-woah-woah-woah.gif

Sere honesto, años atrás me vi la version Live action Japonesa y es una obra sublime, tanto trama, música, actuación y disparos de reacción llevados al extremo con una mentalidad de pensar demasiado cada accion al estilo death Note y detective conan.

Sobra decir que son episodios de casi 1 hora y en ella explican muy bien las cosas, tanto reglas, juagadas de cada participante y con plastilina de ser necesario, porque es super detallado.

Dicho esto son 2 temporadas y la película donde termina todo.

>I’ll be honest, years ago I watched the Japanese live-action version, and it’s a sublime work—the plot, music, acting, and reaction shots are all taken to the extreme, with a mindset of overanalyzing every action, much like *Death Note* and *Detective Conan*.
>
>Needless to say, the episodes are almost an hour long, and they explain everything very well—the rules, each participant’s moves, and even use clay models when necessary—because it’s incredibly detailed.
>
>That said, there are two seasons and a movie where it all comes to an end.


![liar game asia.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/Eorxqc8rPqq1ijVW5FdrPdde2JxpCGhy4Eem6tNDqBiNxmWvNuc2EUzvaNpZTkEdxfF.PNG)

Sobra decir que cuando empecé a ver la version anime, mi deception fue grande, pues el estilo de dibujo simple, las pocas emociones y la banda sonora tan simple no tienen el  mismo impacto que el live action.
La senti como una version Temu de la obra dibujada con bajo presupuesto.


Obviamente por la referencia de que ver y de tener la serie en Live action, eso dejo la bara muy alta para que traten de bajarla de el pedestal de Obra maestra.

>Needless to say, when I started watching the anime version, I was very disappointed, since the simple art style, the lack of emotion, and the boring soundtrack don’t have the same impact as the live-action version.
It felt like a low-budget, Temu-style adaptation of the original work.
>
>Obviously, given the reference to watching and owning the live-action series, the bar is set so high that it’s impossible to knock it off its pedestal as a masterpiece.
---


![liars.PNG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/janusmolinovsky/23yU4mnsb97N1iCujYyvz1iCezeED9oWSUvNY98d2MwJPdPzYg2GoErvRnLjXddUS3yHc.PNG)

Como digo el estrés psicológico que da el live action acompañado de la banda sonora es insuperable.

>As I said, the psychological intensity of the live-action footage combined with the soundtrack is unbeatable.

--


La verdad me vi como 3 episodios del anime, pero sigo prefiriendo la version actuada por todo lo vivido con ella, que esta version anime dudo que haga sentir el mismo drama.  

>To be honest, I watched about three episodes of the anime, but I still prefer the live-action version because of everything I experienced with it; I doubt this anime version will evoke the same sense of drama.  

---

https://media1.tenor.com/m/yrOc9pAYwcgAAAAC/liar-game-shota-matsuda.gif


Mi recomendación es simplemente que vean el live action y pues luego de eso no hay punto de comparación 
el Anime puede ser muy corto con 15 o 20 minutos tratando de condensar todo, pero no da tiempo a nada ya que ni intriga despierta.

>My recommendation is simply that you watch the live-action version—after that, there’s no comparison.
The anime might be very short, at 15 or 20 minutes, trying to cram everything in, but there’s no time for anything since it doesn’t even manage to build any suspense.

---

Aclaro que son apreciaciones personales, si disfrutas el anime continua viendolo, pero en dado caso de que quede continuara sin segunda temporada, lo mejor es ver el live action que esta completo.

>Just to be clear, these are my personal opinions. If you enjoy the anime, keep watching it, but if it ends without a second season, you’re better off watching the live-action series, which is complete.

body.title: The incredible world of grasshoppers 🚁
body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXKkB6ADu8QqnQP5eKpzt7sUvkU9AyFTF2ZaTqqANU4WJ/1779586318068.jpg) No matter how diverse the nature around us is, the tiny grasshopper that we often ignore, fluttering its wings on the tip of the green grass or on the bank of a pond, is actually a perfect creation of nature. From a distance, they may look like just a colorful insect, but their lifestyle and hunting techniques are no less than any thrilling story. Grasshoppers are said to be nature's most skilled aviators. They can control each pair of wings separately. As a result, they can fly straight up, down, left, right, and even backwards. They have the strange ability to hover in one place in the air Which has also served as inspiration for many modern helicopter technologies. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT6MPem4VbC4qV81itJJqDnsXTS78yG7TUGDa9Txm2cDy/1779586318134.jpg) Although grasshoppers may seem calm and harmless, they are among the most deadly predators in the insect world. Their success rate in catching prey is about 95% much higher than that of a tiger or lion. They can catch mosquitoes, flies, and other harmful insects while flying in the air. Eat it. Therefore, their role in keeping our environment and crop fields free from diseases and pests is immense. The two giant eyes of the grasshopper are actually made up of thousands of small eyes. Grasshoppers existed on Earth about 300 million years ago, but the wingspan of the grasshoppers at that time was almost the same as that of an eagle. With the urban sprawl, it has become increasingly difficult to see grasshoppers. This beautiful friend is disappearing due to the filling of water bodies and excessive use of pesticides. It is extremely important for us to be environmentally conscious to preserve these living sculptures of nature.

body.title: The sex appeal of artificial intelligence.
body.body:
If someone had told me, until recently, that artificial intelligence could reach cinemas using a sexualized approach (more specifically at a renowned movie festival), I would have refuted any possibility almost immediately (after all, we still live - *despite all the socio-political-cultural advances* - in a society that is still very conservative in different aspects). Ironically, didn't that happen?
<center>[Let’s Data Science](https://letsdatascience.com/news/cultpix-debuts-ai-created-vintage-adult-film-at-cannes-2ef24e4f)</center>
Recently, at the **Cannes Film Festival** (in parallel), some of the erotic photo essays published no less than five decades ago gained a version that is, to say the least, quite unusual. The images were transformed into short movies (but without any kind of explicit sexual action, obviously) using artificial intelligence... And this opens a precedent that had never happened before in the history of cinema.
Through a Norwegian company, **Multiformat**, **Thomas Meier** was in charge of leading this entire daring project. Using generative artificial intelligence tools, the images from the photo essays (in the famous vintage style) came to \

into complete videos (and here I am referring more specifically to synchronized movements, some dialogues, narrations and sounds) for the big screen.\nThe entire collection was released by the streaming platform **Cultpix**, and according to **Rickard Gramfors** (who is CEO and co-founder of this digital channel), the main idea behind this production is to promote (or at least try to do so) a kind of \

between the different generations that coexist in our society about how they view erotic images today (and consequently how sexuality is implicit in all of this, which is a broad context).\n<center>[X](https://x.com/Cultpix1/status/2056725172858630478/photo/1)</center>\nThe \

that different generations will possibly feel is something to be expected, because since any and all concepts about morality and ethics are mutable within this sexualized segment, what might have been shocking to many people before may now be totally irrelevant considering the easy access that anyone can have to this type of material. The idea in its context is even interesting, but I think it's a project that won't hold up.
---
<center>**El sex appeal de la inteligencia artificial.**</center>
Si alguien me hubiera dicho, hasta hace poco, que la inteligencia artificial podría llegar a los cines con un enfoque sexualizado (más concretamente en un festival de cine de renombre), habría descartado cualquier posibilidad casi de inmediato (al fin y al cabo - *a pesar de todos los avances sociopolíticos y culturales* - seguimos viviendo en una sociedad muy conservadora en muchos aspectos). Irónicamente, ¿no fue así?
Recientemente, en el **Festival de Cannes** (paralelamente), algunos de los reportajes fotográficos eróticos publicados hace ya cinco décadas cobraron vida en una versión, cuanto menos, inusual. Las imágenes se transformaron en cortometrajes (sin ningún tipo de acción sexual explícita, obviamente) mediante inteligencia artificial… Y esto abre un precedente sin precedentes en la historia del cine.
A través de la empresa noruega **Multiformat**, **Thomas Meier** fue el encargado de liderar este audaz proyecto. Utilizando herramientas de inteligencia artificial generativa, las imágenes de los reportajes fotográficos (con su característico estilo vintage) cobraron “vida” tras ser meticulosamente “convertidas” en vídeos completos (y aquí me refiero más concretamente a movimientos sincronizados, diálogos, narraciones y sonidos) para la gran pantalla.
La colección completa fue lanzada por la plataforma de streaming **Cultpix**, y según **Rickard Gramfors** (CEO y cofundador de este canal digital), la idea principal detrás de esta producción es promover (o al menos intentarlo) una especie de \

entre las diferentes generaciones que coexisten en nuestra sociedad sobre cómo perciben las imágenes eróticas hoy en día (y, por consiguiente, cómo la sexualidad está implícita en todo esto, un contexto amplio).\nEl \

que posiblemente sientan las diferentes generaciones es previsible, ya que, dado que cualquier concepto sobre moral y ética es mutable dentro de este segmento sexualizado, lo que antes pudo haber sido chocante para muchos ahora puede ser totalmente irrelevante considerando el fácil acceso que cualquiera puede tener a este tipo de material. La idea en sí misma es interesante, pero creo que es un proyecto que no se sostendrá. ---
**O sex appeal da inteligência artificial.**
Se alguém me dissesse, até pouco tempo atrás, que a inteligência artificial poderia chegar aos cinemas fazendo uso de uma abordagem sexualizada (mais especificamente em um festival de cinema renomado), eu teria refutado qualquer possibilidade quase que imediatamente (afinal, nós ainda vivemos - *apesar de todos os avanços sócio-políticos-culturais* - em uma sociedade que ainda é muito conversadora em diferentes aspectos). Ironicamente, não é que isso aconteceu? Recentemente, no **Festival de Cannes** (de forma paralela), alguns dos ensaios fotográficos eróticos publicados há nada menos do que cinco décadas ganharam uma versão que é, no mínimo, bem inusitada (para dizer o mínimo). As imagens foram transformadas em curtas-metragens (mas sem nenhum tipo de ação sexual explícita, obviamente) com o uso da inteligência artificial... E isso abre um precedente que até então nunca havia acontecido dentro da história do cinema. Através de uma empresa norueguesa **Multiformat**, quem ficou encarregado de comandar todo esse ousado projeto foi **Thomas Meier**. Usando ferramentas de inteligência artificial generativa, as imagens dos ensaios fotográficos (no famoso estilo vintage) ganharam “vida” depois de terem sido meticulosamente “convertidas” em vídeos completos (e aqui eu me refiro mais especificamente a movimentos, alguns diálogos, narrações e sons sincronizados) para as telas grandes. Toda coleção foi lançada pela plataforma de streaming **Cultpix**, e segundo **Rickard Gramfors** (que é CEO, e co-fundador desse canal digital), a principal ideia por trás dessa produção é promover (ou ao menos tentar fazer isso) uma espécie de “debate” entre as diferentes gerações que coexistem em nossa sociedade sobre como elas enxergam as imagens eróticas hoje em dia (e consequentemente como a sexualidade está implícita em tudo isso, que é um contexto amplo). O “choque cultural” que as diferentes gerações possivelmente irão sentir é algo esperado, porque uma vez que todo e qualquer conceito sobre moral e ética é mutável dentro desse segmento sexualizado, o que antes poderia ser chocante para muitas pessoas hoje pode ser totalmente irrelevante considerando o fácil acesso que qualquer pessoa pode ter a esse tipo de material. A ideia no seu contexto é até interessante, mas eu acho que é um projeto que não se sustentará. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/the-sex-appeal-of-artificial-intelligence-ceu)

body.title: ​Día de compras en Lara: Apostando al éxito de un nuevo emprendimiento|Shopping Day in Lara: Betting on the Success of a New Venture
body.body:
> ¡Hola, amigos! ¿Qué tal están? ¡Feliz sábado para todos! El día de hoy tocó viajar muy temprano a la ciudad vecina, en el estado Lara. Una de mis tías decidió emprender y comprar mercancía para vender, así que decidimos ir al estado vecino, donde generalmente se consiguen muchas más ofertas y mayor variedad. Nos fuimos aproximadamente a las 7:30 de la mañana; al llegar, notamos que el día estaba bastante nublado, pero decidimos no preocuparnos ni desanimarnos, porque, total, ya estábamos allí.
Hi, everyone! How are you? Happy Saturday to all! Today we had to leave very early to go to the neighboring city in Lara state. One of my aunts decided to venture into the world of retail and buy merchandise to sell, so we decided to go to the neighboring state, where there are usually many more deals and a wider variety. We left around 7:30 in the morning; when we arrived, we saw that the day was pretty cloudy, but we decided not to worry or get discouraged, because, after all, we were already there.
​En este caso, ella iba a comprar franelas y bisutería. Aunque no lo crean, nos costó un poco conseguir algo similar a lo que ella tenía en mente, buscando siempre un modelo que le gustara, hasta que finalmente encontramos uno no tan económico, pero sí rentable. Nos quedamos seleccionando diferentes piezas durante unas dos horas; fue un poquito agotador, la verdad, aunque el vendedor tenía una energía increíble: te hacía sentir en casa y te generaba mucha confianza.
In this case, she was going to buy T-shirts and costume jewelry. Believe it or not, it took us a while to find something close to what she had in mind, always looking for a style she liked, until we finally found one that wasn’t exactly cheap, but was still a good deal. We spent about two hours picking out different pieces; it was a little exhausting, to be honest, although the salesperson had incredible energy: he made you feel at home and inspired a lot of confidence.
​Luego de eso, decidimos ir a McDonald's a almorzar. La verdad tenía mucho tiempo sin comer allí y recordar ese sabor particular fue bastante agradable; además, no podía faltar mi tradicional barquilla. Después, nos fuimos a buscar la bisutería. En esa zona sí había un montón de tiendas, con una cantidad abismal de precios y, así como de precios, también de calidades. Esto es algo delicado, porque muchas veces encontramos piezas muy bonitas, pero se dañan en la primera postura, así que es un aspecto que hay que cuidar mucho, y más si es para la venta.
After that, we decided to go to McDonald’s for lunch. To be honest, it had been a long time since I’d eaten there, and it was really nice to revisit that distinctive taste; plus, I couldn’t pass up my usual McFlurry. Afterward, we went to look for costume jewelry. There were tons of stores in that area, with a huge range of prices—and just as much variation in quality. This is a tricky thing, because we often find really pretty pieces, but they break the first time you wear them, so it’s something you have to be very careful about, especially if it’s for resale.
​Total que llegamos a una tienda donde también nos trataron súper bien. La ayudé a escoger varias piezas y allí pudimos terminar de cumplir con el objetivo. Fue un día sumamente agotador, pero también bastante bueno. Ahora solo queda tomar las fotografías y empezar a publicar. Así que nada, les dejo un abrazo fuerte; ese fue nuestro día de hoy, un día bastante productivo y, aunque cansado, muy satisfactorio. ¡Saludos!
So we ended up at a store where they treated us really well, too. I helped her pick out a few items, and that’s where we were able to finish up what we set out to do. It was an extremely exhausting day, but also a pretty good one. Now all that’s left is to take the photos and start posting. So anyway, big hugs to you all; that was our day today—a pretty productive day, and although tiring, very satisfying. Cheers!

Image edited using AI in the Gemini app.* Estoy viendo la serie From. Cuando puedo. Cuando la UNE me deja. Para los que no la están viendo, les pongo un poco el contexto: hay un pueblo viejo y misterioso del que nadie puede salir por circunstancias tenebrosas aún no reveladas. Al pueblo se llega “accidentalmente”. Pero una vez dentro, no puedes huir. Es un pueblo impróspero y al caer la noche tiene que esconderse todo el mundo herméticamente en las casas y poner en la puerta un amuleto. ¿Por qué? Porque desde el bosque emergen unos cuantos bicharracos con forma humanoide que se comen a la gente…. Ahí se los dejo, rápido y mal. Se las recomiendo. A mí en lo particular no me asustan los bichos que se comen a la gente. Pero me paso la serie dando gritos de horror porque en ese pueblo abandonado, maldito, misterioso, viejo, espantoso, aterrador… no falta la luz ni el agua. ¡Y me da un miedo que se la quiten! ¡Me da un miedo de que encima de lo que tienen arriba esos personajes tengan que cargar el agua en pepinos, encender carbón para cocinar, echarse aire con un cartón o alumbrarse con chismosas! Ellos se quejan de su desgracia, pero no tienen ni idea de los desdichados que serían si en vez de ese pueblo hubieran llegado a Cuba. No valoran lo que tienen. Vaya, que si no fuera porque la carretera que conduce al pueblo aparece de la nada, mañana mismo salía pa allá pa ver si descanso un poco y me baño con tranquilidad a chorro de agua abierto. Y si algún monstruo de esos se me acerca, le digo: “Me puedes comer, pero te advierto que debo tener gusto a picadillo MDM… y eso, macho, eso no te va a gustar.” Las imágenes utilizadas en la publicación fueron dadas ls fuentes. Puedes encontrarme en los siguientes perfiles de redes sociales: [Twitter](https://twitter.com/capote_iran?s=09), [Instagram](https://instagram.com/irankpotter?igshid=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ==).
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

I’m watching the series *From*. Whenever I can. Whenever the UNE lets me. For those of you who aren’t watching it, here’s a bit of background: there’s an old, mysterious village that nobody can leave due to sinister circumstances that haven’t yet been revealed. You arrive in the village ‘by accident’. But once inside, you can’t escape. It’s a desolate place and, when night falls, everyone has to hide away securely in their homes and place an amulet on the door. Why? Because a few humanoid creatures emerge from the forest and eat people… There you have it, quick and dirty. I recommend it. Personally, I’m not scared of creatures that eat people. But I spend the whole series screaming in horror because in that abandoned, cursed, mysterious, old, dreadful, terrifying village… there’s no shortage of electricity or water. And I’m so scared they’ll take it away from them! I’m so scared that, on top of what those people have up there, they’ll have to carry water in gourd bottles, light charcoal to cook, fan themselves with a piece of cardboard or use oil lamps for light! They complain about their misfortune, but they’ve no idea how wretched they’d be if, instead of that village, they’d ended up in Cuba. They don’t appreciate what they’ve got. I mean, if it weren’t for the fact that the road leading to the village appears out of nowhere, I’d be heading over there tomorrow to see if I can get some rest and have a proper wash under a running tap. And if one of those monsters comes near me, I’ll say: ‘You can eat me, but I’m warning you, I must taste like MDM mince… and that, mate, you’re not going to like.’ The images used in the publication were provided by the sources. body.body:
<center>

![portada soul de ojos azules.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rinconpoetico7/23x1HcoUQ5FtmxXqrvZPFyFuJ1XJe6eNRKQSH95LmKdVp6FHGBmt1u47Z2WFfyzoBoRY1.jpg)

***

![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

***
<center>Español
#### Soul de ojos azules</center>

<div class=\

>

De entre las melodiosas notas y enérgicas del soul y de esa emotividad pasional, una mezzosoprano se levanta como un ángel, encanto que hipnotiza, y una fuerza vocal que nos lleva el éxtasis de la emocionalidad.

En cada canción se entrega hasta lo más íntimo de su alma. Las notas recorren cada resquicio de cuerpo, cada poro por donde se deslizan, se infiltran como gotas de lluvia que caen en un día tormentoso. Siente el vibrar del sonido que tanto ama, se mueve al vaivén del suave murmullo. Sus manos vuelan en el aire ante el sonido, ¿queriendo tocar las estrellas? ¿Su alma? ¿La esencia de la vida?

Se mueve con pies descalzos, entre nubes musicales decoradas solo para ella. La rubia se transporta a otro mundo, uno que solo ella ve, uno que es su escape de la realidad. Los bellos ojos se cierran para dejarse llevar por las melodías que tanto ama, ojos azules que se transmutan al alma, esa alma que respira belleza musical, que respira un tiempo pasado, un soul que volaba por el aire, por el aire de Memphis, Detroit, Chicago y Nueva Orleans. 

Respuestas y preguntas surgieron y se convirtieron en melodías, ritmos que la gente bailaba, hipnotizada por las voces que encantaban a multitudes. La rubia nace de ese legado, respirando soul por cada poro, apasionada por cada sensación, cada expresión, cada letra, cada canción nacida del talento y la fuerza de su emotividad.

Ella encanta, ella es un vehículo para llevar a cada oyente a ese mundo vibrante, rítmico, emocional y pasional. Ella es el ángel del soul que toca el alma con su voz, con aquella voz llena de matices, que eriza la piel como una onda eléctrica, que recorre el cuerpo, llegando a lo más íntimo de cada existencia.

La rubia sonríe con su nacarado encanto, brillan sus ojos cristalinos, al son de una nueva melodía, que ansía interpretar y le da su toque único, un toque de autenticidad, que solo ella puede dar a cada interpretación. Canta con el alma, canta con la pasión, canta con cada fibra de su ser, canta, canta, elevando sus sonidos a lo más alto, a un paraíso, un paraíso que pinta con su voz para quien la escucha, e inevitablemente hace que los movimientos se apoderen de cada cuerpo, esos movimientos que bailan el soul. El subconsciente responde a esa evocación de aquella voz con ese vibrato natural, con ese fraseo relajado que excita los tímpanos, desde los más inocentes hasta los más maduros.

Afortunados quienes pueden deleitarse con el sonido de su privilegiada voz, que mueve sentimientos y fibras existenciales. Afortunados quienes pueden verla danzando entre notas armoniosas con un tinte oscuro. Afortunados quienes pueden reflejarse en aquellos ojos azules, aquellos ojos cristalinos que son espejos de un alma blanca. Afortunados quienes pueden presenciar de aquella sonrisa amplia, evidencia tangible de sencillez y pasión por la música, dejando a un lado el dinero y la fama, solo disfruta de lo que la hace única entre millones.

La voz potente de la rubia seguirá resonando por entre el tiempo y el más allá, donde las almas vuelan y flotan con su música, sus canciones, su fraseo, su armonía y su interpretación apasionada. El soul acoge aquella voz magistral, la integra, la hace suya, la guarda entre los tesoros talentosos que han hecho grandes el género. La rubia sigue danzando y cantando para todos aquellos que la admiran, se entrega a ellos y ellos se entregan a sus canciones y a su voz.


***
![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

***
<center>English

#### Blue-eyed soul</center>

<div class=\

> Among the melodious and energetic notes of soul and that passionate emotionality, a mezzo-soprano rises up like an angel, a charm that hypnotizes, and a vocal force that brings us the ecstasy of emotionality. In each song she gives himself to the most intimate of her soul. The notes run through every crevice of the body, every pore through which they slip, infiltrate like raindrops falling on a stormy day. She feels the vibrating of the sound she loves so much, moves to and fro of the gentle murmur. Her hands fly in the air at the sound, wanting to touch the stars? Her soul? The essence of life? She moves with bare feet, among musical clouds decorated just for her. The blonde is transported to another world, one that only she sees, one that is her escape from reality. The beautiful eyes close to let themselves be carried away by the melodies they love so much, blue eyes that are transmuted to the soul, that soul that breathes musical beauty, that breathes a bygone time, a soul that flew through the air, through the air of Memphis, Detroit, Chicago and New Orleans. Answers and questions arose and became melodies, rhythms that people danced, hypnotized by the voices that enchanted crowds. The blonde is born from that legacy, breathing soul through every pore, passionate about every sensation, every expression, every lyric, every song born of talent and the strength of her emotionality. She enchants, she is a vehicle to take every listener to that vibrant, rhythmic, emotional and passionate world. She is the angel of soul that touches the soul with her voice, with that voice full of nuances, that bristles the skin like an electric wave, that travels through the body, reaching the most intimate of every existence. The blonde smiles with her pearly charm, her crystalline eyes shine, to the sound of a new melody, which she longs to interpret and gives her unique touch, a touch of authenticity, that only she can give to each interpretation. She sings with her soul, sings with passion, sings with every fiber of her being, sings, sings, raising her sounds to the highest, to a paradise, a paradise that she paints with her voice for those who listen to her, and inevitably makes the movements take over every body, those movements that dance the soul. The subconscious responds to that evocation of that voice with that natural vibrato, with that relaxed phrasing that excites the eardrums, from the most innocent to the most mature. Lucky are those who can delight in the sound of her privileged voice, which moves feelings and existential fibers. Lucky who can see her dancing between harmonious notes with a dark tint. Lucky are those who can be reflected in those blue eyes, those crystalline eyes that are mirrors of a white soul. Lucky those who can witness that wide smile, tangible evidence of simplicity and passion for music, leaving aside money and fame, just enjoy what makes her unique among millions. The powerful voice of the blonde will continue to resonate between time and the afterlife, where souls fly and float with her music, her songs, her phrasing, her harmony and her passionate interpretation. Soul embraces that masterful voice, integrates it, makes it its own, keeps it among the talented treasures that have made the genre great. The blonde continues dancing and singing for all those who admire her, she gives herself to them and they give themselves to her songs and her voice. *** ![bannerhive.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVHP6CkxhCEAu67zAoPbfRAJc6QCPZdGNXvJLHraenhgL/bannerhive.jpg)

Here in Venezuela, a cultural music event was held—specifically focused on urban music and rap—featuring various local artists who showcased their musical, rhythmic, and vocal skills. However, this event sparked discontent among the population. 


> Welcome to this edition of \

by FoneStreet


# A polarizing event 


![1000037951.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fonestreet/AKCGdKpZeNJprZqdHJmwBz9fFT73fLfWsQtgyuPsoXoSY8h45oUGuKZTDfB2RwK.jpg)


Those of you who are outside this continent, outside this country, outside your state, and outside this town may not understand the ethical and moral weight that comes with being an artist in Venezuela, especially given the political context that surrounds us. 


I’d like to mention that the event held last weekend in the city of Caracas was entirely organized, produced, and sponsored by political entities at a venue that is supposedly a cultural space in the country; however, we are well aware of the entire history and background of what goes on there. 


I, FoneStreet, posted the following on my Facebook page: 


https://www.facebook.com/fonekilla


![1000037953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fonestreet/AKKSYZrVxVASPRQKAPzjwtE15bACb6ikSmZvLauyjVrMUFvzS9NYdc99W28aDv8.jpg)


At that event, a rapper staged a protest and directly criticized the system. My comment is an observation describing a real phenomenon, as I study political science with a focus on hybrid or modern authoritarian systems—where power does not seek to suppress 100% of criticism but rather to manage it. 


Allowing certain spaces for protest—even if insults and rebellious comments are deleted—also serves as an outlet for social frustration in the eyes of the international community. The government can use the existence of that criticism to argue that there is full freedom of expression because people criticize it and nothing happens. It is from this perspective that direct, head-on protest runs the risk of being instrumentalized by the very system it seeks to challenge.


My response addresses the fatigue and excessive demands—there are comments laden with irony that is very valid because it exposes the accumulated exhaustion of artists and citizens who feel that whatever they do will never be enough or right in the eyes of public opinion.


If an artist protests directly, they are accused of being an unwitting democratic trophy for the government, as my post argues; but if the artist decides not to speak about politics—to prioritize their safety, to make a living from their art, and simply to entertain—they are accused of being apathetic, complicit, and a sellout. 


If an artist seeks to survive economically by working in public or private spaces, their morality is subjected to relentless judgment, and the idea of attempting to create a strict code of conduct and dress is satirical, as it reflects the frustration with an environment that demands an ideological and moral purity that is impossible to achieve. 

Given this landscape and the debate surrounding the sociology of art and politics, possible ways out of this ethical labyrinth can be proposed, and one of them is to abandon the need to please everyone, since it is mathematically impossible. Artists who manage to survive artistically tend to accept that they will always be criticized by some sector and choose to define their own internal ethical framework rather than seek external approval. 


![1000037952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fonestreet/23ynSNNxBygE7tqe9SDugHcudqvTqRWazuFCnsfFuVZDbb5Cgd8gWxR9JPzVZ7S89tvp7.jpg)


The analysis I present here demonstrates that in complex situations, art ceases to be a mere pastime and becomes a minefield where personal authenticity is often the only reliable compass.

body.title: Hull City are Back
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmesD2wZ7TL1AXdMWrx7n15HaTq2rs2iPN4H591Z5xspSq/1779585993261.jpg)

Hull City vs Middlesbrough တို့ရဲ့ playoff Final ပွဲစဉ်မှာတော့ Hull City က ၁-၀ ဖြင့် အနိုင်ရပြီး EPL တန်းတက်ခွင့်ကို ရရှိသွားခဲ့ပါပြီ။  Hull City အတွက် ၁ လုံးထဲသော အနိုင်ဂိုးကို ၉၀+၅ မိနစ်မှာ McBurnie က သွင်းယူပေးခဲ့တာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ၂၀၁၆ တုန်းက playoff အဆင့်မှာ ဗိုလ်စွဲပြီး တန်းတက်ခဲ့သလို ၁၀ နှစ်ကြာပြီးနောက် ၂၀၂၆ မှာ ထပ်မံ၍ တန်းပြန်တက်နိုင်ခဲ့ပါပြီ။ EPL ကို EFL ကနေ ၃ သင်း တန်းတက်လို့လာပါပြီ။ တိုက်ရိုက် နေရာကနေ Coventry, Ipswich တို့၊ playoff ကနေ Hull City ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ 

တန်းတက် ၃ သင်း သိရပေမဲ့ EPL ကနေ တန်းဆင်းရမယ့် ၃ သင်းကတော့ မသိရသေးပါဘူး။ ၂ သင်းသာ စောစောစီးစီး အဖြေပေါ်ပြီး ကျန် ၁ သင်းက ဒီနေ့ EPL Round 38 ပွဲစဉ်ပြီးမှ သိရမှာပါ။ Tottenham လား၊ West Ham လားပေါ့။ ကြားရက် ပွဲစဉ်မှာ Arsenal က Burnley ကို ၁-၀ ဖြင့် နိုင်ပြီး City က Bournemouth နဲ့ ၁-၁ သရေကျသွားခဲ့တာမို့ Arsenal တို့ ချန်ပီယံ ဖြစ်သွားခဲ့ပါပြီ။ ချန်ပီယံ အဖြေပေါ်ပေမဲ့ တန်းဆင်းရမယ့်အသင်း အဖြေမပေါ်သေးတာပါ။ 

Tottenham က Everton နဲ့ အိမ်ကွင်း၊ West Ham က Leeds နဲ့ အိမ်ကွင်း အသီးသီး ယှဉ်ပြိုင်ကစားရမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ Tottenham အနေဖြင့် သရေကျရင်ကို EPL မှာ တင်ကျန်မှာ ဖြစ်ပေမဲ့ West Ham အနေနဲ့က အနိုင်ရမှကို ဖြစ်မှာပါ။ ဒါပေမဲ့ ကိုယ်က အနိုင်ရရင်တောင် Tottenham ရဲ့ ပွဲရလဒ်ကို စောင့်ကြည့်ရဦးမှာမို့ ကိုယ့် ကံကြမ္မာက သူများ လက်ထဲမှာ ဖြစ်နေပါတယ်။ Tottenham သာ ကြားရက်က Chelsea နဲ့ပွဲကို သရေ ကျအောင် ကစားနိုင်ခဲ့ရင် နောက်ဆုံးပွဲစဉ် မကစားရခင်မှာ အဖြေက ပေါ်နေမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ခုတော့ Round 38 ထိ ဆက်သွားကြည့်ရမှာပေါ့လေ။


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaC5jWwUpVaYbQo6HrUjCxvQV1iGYknvrX64VZwCgnDsH/1779585993290.jpg)


ကျန် EPL ပွဲစဉ်တွေကတော့ ထူးထွေပြီး ရင်ခုန်စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားဖို့ ကောင်းနေမှာ မဟုတ်ပါဘူး။ ရာသီသိမ်း ပွဲစဉ်တွေ ဖြစ်နေတယ် ဆိုပေမဲ့ ဇယားထိပ်ပိုင်း အသင်းတွေက အပြောင်းအလဲ ဖြစ်ဖို့ မရှိသလောက် နည်းသွားခဲ့ပြီကိုး။ ဒီနှစ် အမှတ်ဘယ်လောက်ရပြီး အဆက့် ဘယ်လောက်နဲ့ ရာသီသိမ်းနိုင်ခဲ့တယ် ဆိုတဲ့ မှတ်တမ်းအတွက် ကစားကြရမှာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

Women's UCL Final ပွဲစဉ်မှာတော့ Barcelona women အသင်းက OL Lyonnes အသင်းကို ၄-၀ ဖြင့် ဂိုးပြတ် အနိုင်ရပြီး ချန်ပီယံ ဖြစ်သွားခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ဂိုးပြတ်လို့ ခြေပြတ်နေတယ် ပြောလို့ မရပါဘူး။ ဒီ ၂ သင်းက ကစားအား ကစားပုံ အတော်လေး ကောင်းကြပါတယ်။ အပြန်အလှန် ထိုးဖောက် တိုက်စစ်ဆင်မှုတွေကိုလည်း မြင်ခဲ့ရပါတယ်။ ဒါပေမဲ့ ယခုပွဲစဉ်မှာတော့ UCL ရဲ့ အအောင်မြင်ဆုံး အသင်းဖြစ်တဲ့ OL Lyonnes ထက် Barcelona women အသင်းက ကစားတာ ပိုကောင်းနေခဲ့ပါတယ်။ ဒုတိယပိုင်း ၅၅ မိနစ် နောက်ပိုင်းမှာမှ သွင်းဂိုးတွေ သွင်းယူနိုင်ခဲ့တာ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ Congratulations Barcelona women Team.

_(photos from EFL & women's UCL pages)_

body.title: 学校参加合唱团排列
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![KjViSlmX9hQjP017_bxw3.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/KjViSlmX9hQjP017_bxw3/KjViSlmX9hQjP017_bxw3.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

上周老师在班里询问谁有兴趣参加7月份的合唱团，孩子报名了。然后老师就联系孩子妈，因为合唱团需要家长和学生一起参加，周末要去学校排练，孩子妈就把我给报名上去了。我完全不知道是怎么一回事，然后孩子妈才通知我有这么一回事。刚开始我是拒绝的，因为要排练一上午，早上8点多就要到学校，一直排练到中午11点，相当于半天时间没有了，而且我也从来没有学过唱歌。但是孩子特别想去，考虑到合唱团人多，我就算不会唱，在人堆里配个口型也能凑合。

这个周末孩子妈带孩子去北京旅游，我在家于是就去排练了。周六早上8点15分我来到学校门口，已经有一堆家长在门口等待。来了一位老师把我们带进学校，接着来到演播大厅。先是统计人数，从一年级到六年级都有家长参加，看起来人数不少，有50~60人左右呢。人来的差不多了，有一个音乐学院的在读学生站到舞台上做自我介绍，他负责这次合唱团的排练。刚开始做一些发声练习，唱的是交响乐，没有歌词，全程发音“啊”就行了，但要用正确的音准和节奏。

练习到10点多，大家休息一会。此时我喊得嗓子都干了，赶紧喝水。休息15分钟接着又开始了，还是发声练习，说实话挺枯糙的。好不容易坚持到11点，终于可以回去休息了。刚开始只需要家长排练就行了，学生们后面排练。演出时候还要身穿礼服，可我压根没有礼服还不知道怎么办呢，到时候再看吧。

---

![QkiyP5beZnHvzUNh_IMG_20260522_125454.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/QkiyP5beZnHvzUNh_IMG_20260522_125454/QkiyP5beZnHvzUNh_IMG_20260522_125454.webp)
![oj7eIKy5H6p5Gxy3_IMG_20260522_125140.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/oj7eIKy5H6p5Gxy3_IMG_20260522_125140/oj7eIKy5H6p5Gxy3_IMG_20260522_125140.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

所谓上山容易下山难，开始在水泥路上去不是很累，但是走了二个小时了！老公说我们才走了三分之一都没有，我们还想上山顶，好远的感觉！最后老公居然带我去抄小路回去，老骗我快到了！看是近路，却是没有开发的小路，也是很多驴友打卡走的林间小道！走起来特费劲，每一步我都感觉我都踩不稳，也不知道怎下脚！一不小心就畔到脚！

开始的时候路上的花花挺漂亮的，还挺平整的泥土地面！后面就惨了，弯弯曲曲的小路上！主要山路太陡峭，很多坑洼，又多树枝[捂脸]我找到树枝支撑我，没事，我累了！人的精神和脚趾头都绷紧，有时候抓住森林里的大树木和抓住草又！

我真的差点儿，大概十几次摔倒吧，还好我站的稳，就是太累！怪不得陡峭啦！上山一路都是十八弯的，走一个大弯才爬升几十米，这南香山可是有南焦山美誉，听说比白云山还要高！怪不得爬得半死还没一半，就抄个小路下山！我老公还是高估我，哈哈～看是小路，对我来说都是危险重重啊！好几次我老公见我走的踉跄，直接说背我下去，我自己走都难，他背着我也更难了！

他还一直骗我说快到了快到了！小树林风景真是美，有林间小蝴蝶，一层自然而然的花朵，美的我都来不及欣赏，我只想快点下山回家睡觉！我家老头说我没苦硬吃啊！说什么来爬山！我们还路过一个天坑，最后才出到山脚下，一个果园，遇到恶犬吓得我一跳，还好我有打狗棒，路上捡的杵着拐杖下山的，这个可以护身下！到山下实在走不动了，我选个地方坐下，让我老头去买点水吧！早上装的水早早喝完了！

所以落到目标地方，饮水吐了，还吃了糖果！不知道太累还是老公买的水问题，什么鬼牌子！ [捂脸]我坐石头上，太累了，好想念家里的大床！今天运动量够够了！不知道明天脚会不会疼！

---

body.title: Sunrise  (a Short Story) | LMAC FreeStyle Collage No. 164
body.body:
>

The rising sun cast a rosy hue across the morning sky. Golden fingers of sunlight painted its portrait of the perfect day to come as it lit up the scene below.

I'd already risen, given thanks to God for touching my shoulder, then guiding my mind to consciousness.

Afterward, I tended to my morning health needs as the first rays of sunlight burst through my front door. 

My pitiful whistling was no match for the chorus of melodic birdsong drifting in as I prepared to leave for work. An instant twinge reminded me of the restless night I spent debating a stressful, unresolved situation at work. The solution evaded me. 

Even though the lovely sunrise cast its glow on my face as I headed out to work, a darkness descended in my thoughts. Immediately, I phoned my Lucia, my girlfriend. The exchange as always lifted my spirits.

During the past few days, the can I'd kicked down the road wouldn't budge. It expanded until I couldn't maneuver around. I'd come to a crossroad. Performance in my unit dipped the past two months.

The week stretched on forever. Each day, another incident was reported during my shift. I've never encountered an individual so possessed with antagonizing and belittling others. The underlying reason had yet to reveal itself. I wasn't a student of psychology, so his motives battled me.

Convincing myself it was none of my business, I prepared for the weekend. Office politics left a sour flavor on my taste buds. I had enough to manage than attempt to figure out the machinations two shops over. I'd no authority to censure or reprimand another manager's staff.

But a cloud of mistrust blanketed my unit. Rumors then surfaced. Why would I allow someone else in the company to enter our workspace, harass, belittle, and threaten my employees? murmurs asked.

However, threatening another person was a tactic I abhorred. The threats broadened from personal to intimidating rejection of work products for rework with no evidence of inferior workmanship. Dismissing the cross-departmental toxic situation was no longer an option.

Relying on my previous work experience, I knew I had to escalate the matter to the next level leadership. Taking back control of my unit was imperative. Any threats to my employees' performance or operational delays were unacceptable. Providing a safe and productive work environment for my employees' well-being was part of my management duties. I wasn't going to allow any outside interference.

Putting words into action, I advised my people to document every interaction with the antagonistic co-worker. That way, we'd have concrete proof of that person's unauthorized entrance into our unit. Citing safety concerns, I received approval to restrict access to our specialized unit without prior authorization.

With documentation and first-hand knowledge secured in my office, I scheduled an upper-management meeting the next week. Perhaps other units had experienced that individual's hatred of his fellow man; maybe life in general. I knew first hand of workplace violence. I barely escaped an event five years ago. A similar situation now reared its ugly head. It was in my power to try to prevent it.

With a heavy weight on my chest, I clocked out that evening, stepped outside, and gazed up at the skyline.

The beautiful sunset God provided stared back. My thoughts. The sun will rise tomorrow morning whether I'm woke or not to witness it. 

And with it comes another glorious sunrise that promises a beautiful day ahead and another opportunity to right a wrong under my watch.

<center>![262866.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23swXV8TTdSfCAMefZgEG2MHmtqq9ibT4QeFL1viVbJRuMz1ESKLDzDm4NkSDENoFbtBM.png)</center>

My style of collage is a Freestyle. Although I wasn't required to utilize any contest photo in my design, I usually do. However, if you'd like to join in visit: [Let's Make a Collage - A Contest for All Creatives on Hive - Round 251 - ✨45 HIVE in the Prize Pool!](https://peakd.com/hive-174695/@lmac/lets-make-a-collage-a-contest-for-all-creatives-on-hive-round-251-45-hive-in-the-prize-pool). For my current collage, I wanted to share a theme involving happenings at sunrise. The only event I can think of that equals the ethereal beauty of a sunrise is a sunset. In between, we must navigate the path of life and consequences of our actions or lack thereof.

<center>![rinreMr4T-dividerline-Resized.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/justclickindiva/23tv8hvCs9XJ6jvySDHoq8PqyG4YaAkLbtNT5rMVejff3KMvBDdAtpvqbHwZFE1k5MRdW.png)</center>

In preparing my theme, I wanted to include the image from the current LMAC contest that showed a lovely sunrise. My intended use was as a background feature. I located other images from the #LIL database that fit my sunrise theme. Rounding out my design were two pure fractals I created utilizing the advanced fractal rendering program, Apophysis 7X.

body.title: Valorar nuestra verdadera identidad.
body.body:
# <Center>¡Saludos amigos!</Center>

#

Espero que se encuentren muy bien el día de hoy. Estoy aquí para compartir con ustedes una reflexión. Espero que les guste mucho.

#

<Center>![Valorar nuestra verdadera identidad_20260523_211329_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXpH75RLK6DM4M13oKVfR4Z1P8Zg5ft969AaYgfM61F2y/Valorar%20nuestra%20verdadera%20identidad_20260523_211329_0000.png)</Center>
<Center><sub>Imagen diseñada en CANVA</sub></Center>

#

Muchas veces somos muy desconfiados con las personas, y eso se entiende perfectamente; así como hay personas buenas, también están las malas que siempre van a buscar la manera de destruirte. Ahora bien, hoy en día eso se ve más que nunca; los jóvenes ocultan lo que de verdad sienten, como lo es el enojo, y sin duda es muy feo porque ha traído muchas consecuencias feas, como lo es el asesinar a sus propios amigos por “venganza”. Es verdad, no podemos confiar en las personas. Muchas veces nos encerramos mucho en esas sonrisas falsas, en esas falsas amistades, y nos llevamos toda una vida falsa ocultando hasta cómo te llamas, y es la verdad. No todo el mundo es malo, y como ya lo dije, debemos pensar bien en quién confiar. Sabemos la maldad del mundo, pero por ese mismo miedo nos llevamos todo el mundo falso, y no te creas, pero eso puede también llevar a problemas con la familia y con esos amigos que de verdad quieren un bien para nosotros, y de eso de verdad que no nos damos cuenta. Pero, a pesar de todo, no debemos ocultar quiénes somos en realidad; el mundo nos debe querer tal y como somos. Los defectos son los que nos hacen únicos y admirables; eso demuestra que siempre queremos luchar para salir adelante.

#

Una cosa es ser doble cara y otra, ocultar toda una vida. Ya hablé de las personas de doble cara, de cómo ocultan el odio a la otra persona, y lo hablan con otras personas. Esa es la diferencia: tú, cuando te ocultas de la vida, te ocultas de todo el mundo, incluso de tu familia; está mal. Nadie es nuestro enemigo, y debemos ser felices, y eres una persona muy llorona, no lo ocultes; te aseguro que muchos te admiran por eso, y a los que no les gusta, bueno, que vayan a llorar para otro lado, jaja. Pero ese es el punto, ser únicos; el ocultarnos del mundo siempre nos va a afectar y muy feo, no nos vamos a sentir cómodos con nada en el mundo, pero cuando les digo nada, es absolutamente nada. Debemos ser felices, y eso va para los jóvenes; desde pequeños deben aprender a ser felices tal y como son. La opinión de los demás nunca va a importar si no es buena; eso siempre me lo ha dicho mi mamá y sin duda le agradezco porque aprendí mucho. Yo también soy una persona desconfiada, pero siempre busco la manera de salir adelante y ser único. No le oculto mi verdadera identidad a las personas; eso me hace único y me siento feliz sin importar malas opiniones.

#

<Center>![Valorar nuestra verdadera identidad_20260523_211415_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ9F7J6e6u8jQwZF3B6YWPvUqHwYxXn2aPyGihWDti1ea/Valorar%20nuestra%20verdadera%20identidad_20260523_211415_0000.png)</Center>
<Center><sub>Imagen diseñada en CANVA</sub></Center>

#

Así que ya saben, amigos, sean felices tal y como son, eso es el verdadero valor. La desconfianza es algo que no llena todo el cuerpo, pero debemos ser felices en el mundo en el que estamos y salir adelante. Siempre están esas buenas personas que quieren un bien para ti; solo aprende a elegir bien. Así que bueno, nada de ocultar falsas identidades, al menos que seas un espía secreto, jeje.

#

Hasta aquí dejo yo mi publicación. Espero que les haya gustado mucho a todos ustedes, y les sirva de mucha reflexión y bendiciones.

#

# <Center>Greetings, friends!</Center>

#

I hope you're all doing well today. I'm here to share a thought with you. I hope you enjoy it.

#

<Center>![Valorar nuestra verdadera identidad_20260523_211329_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXpH75RLK6DM4M13oKVfR4Z1P8Zg5ft969AaYgfM61F2y/Valorar%20nuestra%20verdadera%20identidad_20260523_211329_0000.png)</Center>
<Center><sub>Imagen diseñada en CANVA</sub></Center>

#

We are often very distrustful of people, and that's perfectly understandable; just as there are good people, there are also bad ones who will always look for ways to destroy you. Now, nowadays, this is more evident than ever; young people hide what they truly feel, like anger, and it's undoubtedly awful because it has led to many terrible consequences, such as murdering their own friends in \

It's true, we can't always trust people. We often get caught up in fake smiles, fake friendships, and we lead a whole fake life, hiding even our own name, and that's the truth. Not everyone is bad, and as I said, we must think carefully about who we trust. We know the evil in the world, but because of that same fear, we embrace a whole false world, and believe me, that can also lead to problems with family and with those friends who genuinely want what's best for us, something we often fail to recognize. But, despite everything, we shouldn't hide who we really are. The world should love us just as we are. Our flaws are what make us unique and admirable; they show that we always want to fight to get ahead.

#

There's a difference between being two-faced and hiding your entire life. I've already talked about two-faced people, about how they hide their hatred for others and then talk about it with other people. That's the difference: when you hide from life, you hide from everyone, even your family; it's wrong. No one is our enemy, and we should be happy. And you're a very emotional person, don't hide it; I assure you that many admire you for it, and those who don't like it, well, they can go cry somewhere else, haha. But that's the point, to be unique; hiding from the world will always affect us, and badly. We won't feel comfortable with anything in the world, and when I say anything, I mean absolutely nothing. We should be happy, and that goes for young people; from a young age, they should learn to be happy just as they are. Other people's opinions will never matter if they're not good; my mom has always told me that, and I'm certainly grateful to her because I learned a lot. I'm also a distrustful person, but I always find a way to get ahead and be unique. I don't hide my true identity from people; that's what makes me unique, and I feel happy regardless of negative opinions.

#

<Center>![Valorar nuestra verdadera identidad_20260523_211415_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ9F7J6e6u8jQwZF3B6YWPvUqHwYxXn2aPyGihWDti1ea/Valorar%20nuestra%20verdadera%20identidad_20260523_211415_0000.png)</Center>
<Center><sub>Imagen diseñada en CANVA</sub></Center>

#

So, you know, friends, be happy just as you are; that's true value. Distrust isn't enough to fill you up, but we should be happy in the world we live in and keep moving forward. There are always good people out there who want what's best for you; just learn to choose wisely. So, no hiding behind false identities, unless you're a secret agent, haha.

#

That's all for now. I hope you all enjoyed it and that it gives you much to reflect on and brings you blessings.

body.title: Buttercup Mauler Decorative Flower Quilling Technique [Eng-Esp]
body.body:
> ##### **Hello to all my Hive friends... 🐱**
Today I am with you again to show you my art, I love every week to go through this wonderful world of magic, color, and lots of Splinterlands characters to look for new elements or characters to build different crafts such as jewelry, accessories, 3D figures and other things that motivate me, inspire me and activate my creativity and thus be able to create for you. >Today I’m sharing a new piece of art with you. I decided to create a decorative flower inspired by the character “Buttercup Mauler,” using the 2D quilling technique. If you want to know more about the game, I leave you my reference link to enter it and navigate through this wonderful world: https://splinterlands.com?ref=dayadam ***Hoping you like my work, without further ado, I leave you with my creative process.*** >> **Let's start:😃**
![Separador (92).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpT3dBgHiHS4gnE99c46Zfb924JQvYzcCbd16QvWxsrgYmifqaqx5VHJYYkLf4BNZAH.png)
##### **Hola a toda mi gente de Hive... 🐱**
Hoy estoy con ustedes nuevamente para mostrarles mi arte, me encanta semana a semana pasar por ese maravilloso mundo de magia, color, y muchísimos personajes de Splinterlands para buscar nuevos elementos o personajes para construir diversas manualidades bien sean bisutería, accesorios, figuras en 3D entre otras cosas que me motiven, inspiren y activen mi creatividad y de esa manera poder crear para ustedes. >Para hoy les traigo un nuevo trabajo de arte, decidí realizar una flor decorativa inspirada en el personaje \

, en 2D en la técnica de quilling. Si quieren saber más con respecto al juego les dejo mi enlace de referencia para que ingresen en él, y naveguen por este maravilloso mundo: https://splinterlands.com?ref=dayadam ***Esperando les guste mi trabajo, sin más preámbulos, les dejo mi proceso creativo.*** >> **Comencemos:😃**
![300.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48RsB7a2RU9bFukMdZYSvyS8B7QarK9wU2RKyaQaJPTeRx5bGFxzApGFmCbqFvECaU.png)
![Buttercup Mauler.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKusAzdVpQ5NUiks6rYLeJCDvcTtafRo5fwJhhAfyX1Joqq8W4ozAcvSwWcrdKN.jpg)
--- ---
[Buttercup Mauler Source / Fuente](https://splinterlands.com/card-detail/716/regular/14/?tab=lore)
|| |-| |![1000256126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKVX7DB6t7BnMjprbTdX6VYgNpcGbc8LPuCEuvEAbQAamXufpsju3NTu5bbak8F.jpg)| || |-| |![1000256130.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/AKbG2bBYPsFDxjxFB5kjB9h1afoDhJJWeorNPLZhFLmsHgpYNv5MuBpAo4ELDXN.jpg)| || |-| |
![4c7b129e409842698185d18a7d75bce8.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/23ydANcB5ompfUwF3vE8k78PzBauzMSxmucG573a2ziPwpQcykz7trZLe6NWNfmSKujG3.gif)
|
![296.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48Rs5bTmSjU8Nzvhs9YCxXbwp8wwVcoMSQ3oW4KV6YQ5AyepLGE8Nr32UEnkNLGq8d.png)
>• Cintas para quilling. • Aguja para quilling. >• Cartulinas. >• Guillotina de cortar papel. >• Cristal de bisutería. >• Pega blanca extra fuerte (de carpintería). >• Pincel. >• Tijera. >
• Quilling paper. • Quilling needle. • Cardstock. • Paper cutter. • Beads. • Extra-strong white glue (woodworking glue). • Paintbrush. • Scissors.
![297.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48TK52xS2E6XGyscXNKVL5NmUJxmRLZFR1r3McVpqFHQnQQozZa3p4KCnzMWrW83r8.png)
• Start by taking 5mm-wide yellow and orange quilling paper. Using the quilling needle, roll one of the strips until you reach the end; remove it from the needle, loosen it slightly, and secure it with extra-strong white glue to form an open circle. You’ll need 6 yellow and 6 orange circles, all the same size. • To form the petals, shape each circle into a teardrop. Then, attach a yellow teardrop to an orange one by applying glue in the middle. To finish shaping the petal and make it stand out more, wrap a 5mm-wide strip of black ribbon around the two pieces. • Arrange the petals in groups of three, and then join the two groups together to form the flower.
![298.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48Sq6rtuXN1rfb1fJeap2JhadgEwvK6pyp2VNYpUAZbiK1Xno5954vuBLVAm3u2Ehi.png)
• Comenzamos tomando cinta para quilling de color amarillo y color naranja de 5mm de ancho, con la aguja para quilling enrollaremos una de las cintas gasta llegar al final de la misma, sacamos de la aguja, soltamos un poco y sellamos con pega blanca extra fuerte, para obtener un círculo abierto. Necesitaremos 6 de color amarillo y 6 de color naranja todos del mismo tamaño. • Para formar los pétalos moldearemos cada circulo en forma de gotas, luego procedemos a unir una gota amarilla y una naranja aplicando pega en el medio, para terminar de formar el pétalo y que resalte más pase un trozo de cinta negra de 5mm de ancho alrededor de las dos piezas. • Uniremos en grupos de 3 los pétalos, y luego unimos los dos grupos para formar la flor.
||| |-|-| |![1000256119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EopwHW6xM5dQ36K4jhejfEAjpCrbqshPiL7dcXT1ZpEHGspxJk81nmWbvsHoNZ1F7me.jpg)|![1000256120.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EoAeYDMseMhj3acptudyVdRMmU3faPFkpQjTuB76azoHf8wsS5r1duA8SoMwZTg944m.jpg)| ||| |-|-| |![1000256121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EogRAMZ3d1wcTqWGUG5tcm4KKskDg15cPRuEoMW6gwtXrTTb7rQ6wZ3qy15riGyADa3.jpg)|![1000256122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EogQesimm3TqHHcTHayQ66nhwvZ3yHwRkcruKTuA3F47sYEgs9mRQJrFcRw6repCd8t.jpg)|
• To make the center of the flower, I took 1mm-wide beige and black ribbon, joined them together to form a single strip, and wound it around the needle, starting with the beige ribbon, to create a closed multicolored circle. I glued this in the center of the flower. • I made two leaves to adorn the flower by creating two open circles with 5mm-wide light and dark green ribbon; I made one larger than the other, then shaped them into leaves and glued them to the sides of the flower. >> **• And just like that, we have this 2D decorative flower I made, inspired by the flower held in the hands of the character from the card ***“Buttercup Mauler”***.**
![Separador (92).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpT3dBgHiHS4gnE99c46Zfb924JQvYzcCbd16QvWxsrgYmifqaqx5VHJYYkLf4BNZAH.png)
• Para realizar el centro de la flor tomé cinta de color beige y de color negra de 1mm de ancho, uno ambas para formar una sola cinta, enrollé con la aguja empezando por el color beige para formar un círculo cerrado multicolor. Este lo pegué en medio de la flor. • Realicé dos hojas para adornar la flor, realizando dos círculos abiertos con cinta de color verde claro y oscuro de 5mm de ancho, hice uno más grande que el otro, luego los moldee en forma de hojas y procedí a pegar a los lados de la flor. >> **• De esta manera tenemos lista esta flor decorativa en 2D que elabore, inspirada en la flor que lleva en sus manos el personaje de la carta ***\

***.**

I hope you did, I hope you liked my explanation, procedure and photos, I made them with love for you.

body.title: [EN/PT] A Day to Celebrate Life
body.body: > # [EN] Today is my wife’s cousin Gabi’s birthday. She invited us out for pizza so the date wouldn’t pass by unnoticed. My wife, who absolutely loves pizza, didn’t think twice before accepting the invitation. And me, who isn’t the biggest fan of these outings, went along anyway, already knowing that, in the end, the bill always ends up in the husbands’ hands. HUAHAUHAUA! While we were there, I kept thinking that if we had ordered the pizza through an app, we probably would have spent at least half of what we paid at the pizzeria. But I didn’t say anything because the women wanted to go out, chat, and enjoy the moment. In the end, we realized we weren’t just paying for the pizza, but for the experience and the company as well. Despite this little “financial inconvenience,” what truly matters is celebrating life. My wife’s cousin is turning 29 years old, and that is definitely something worth celebrating. Actually, the official birthday celebration will be tomorrow during a family lunch, and we’ve also been invited. Even so, today was already a special day, filled with good conversations, laughter, and enjoyable moments alongside someone very dear to us. ---- # [PT] Hoje é aniversário da prima da minha esposa, a Gabi. Ela nos chamou para comer uma pizza para não deixar a data passar em branco. Minha esposa, que ama pizza, não pensou duas vezes antes de aceitar o convite. E eu, que já não sou tão fã dessas saídas, fui junto mesmo sabendo que, no fim das contas, a conta sempre sobra para os maridos. HUAHAUHAUA! Enquanto estávamos lá, fiquei pensando que, se tivéssemos pedido a pizza pelo aplicativo, teríamos economizado pelo menos metade do valor que pagamos na pizzaria. Mas nem comentei nada, porque as mulheres queriam sair, conversar e aproveitar o momento. No fim, percebemos que não pagamos apenas pela pizza, mas pela experiência e pela companhia. Apesar desse pequeno “inconveniente financeiro”, o mais importante é celebrar a vida. A prima da minha esposa está completando 29 anos, e isso merece ser comemorado. Na verdade, a comemoração oficial do aniversário será amanhã, em um almoço em família para o qual também fomos convidados. Mesmo assim, hoje já foi um dia especial, cheio de boas conversas, risadas e momentos agradáveis ao lado de uma pessoa muito querida. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@elderdark/en-pt-a-day-to-celebrate-life)

title.title: Celebrate With beers || Beersaturday#464
title.body:
> **Greetings, #beerlovers! I wish you all the best. I’m back in this great #beersaturday community to share my beer moments with you—from my weekend outings—as part of this initiative, week 463**.
![1001713617.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23wMYHvubNnBt6k6Fpg5h1aEJ8VgH8gEEiAv3CMj3VJiP1md7TSFhMK7EE7K4m1g45CBt.jpg)
Beer is always a must at celebrations, so when a dear friend’s birthday rolled around, I called my friends and we threw him a surprise party. I called him and made a reservation at a restaurant in town very close to our homes.

> ![1001713622.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoyMymZrW7EZhU7nGQJ9Q92NUa3oWRGERe7NtXHVF3gFDSuYu1TDZbHze6svQwLcYUQ.jpg)
He left work and went straight there, and we gave him a pineapple cake—his favorite. This restaurant only serves Polar and Zulia beers. I chose Zulia, which costs 1,530 BSF. It has an alcohol content of 4% ABV, comes in a green bottle with an eagle logo, and is made with water, pure malted barley, hops, and stabilizers. It has a smooth, balanced, and refreshing taste.
![1001713612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23vhyiirrJZiNGCjqjTmE9JaKByJZhpZ9E5u5CxRnDgYJWH1wpKhgkEsidh6iqELt4NZx.jpg) ![1001713609.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/Eou8AqhHAXrnUg5jsX7WwFCAM2Q82DdWQ63zzHgSojP82JumVb2bhW9AzguHzovqwyT.jpg)
When I get together with my friends, it’s the best therapy—laughing and drinking lots of beer. We recharged with good vibes and enjoyed ourselves—once again with great beers—this weekend.
![1001713624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23wC1GBiihazY8ARWpUdUWB9yFSu5Wm3Dyi7dWrPsoSzs4VyJVSF5RPGtAijMt9Wsy3Zj.jpg)

> I’d like to invite my friend @yolimarag to treat us to a post about the #BeerSaturday challenge—Week 464, an initiative of the beer community and the incomparable @detlev. 🍻😎

![1001713614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/EoeEWDoZPg7C5UAYH4B8JQRwsz6sw2pXtQrGgqJfGve9oz2m5gg3QcrNyoqmLaeeLzk.jpg)

> >! [Spanish, Saludos #beerlovers les deseo lo mejor, nuevamente en esta gran comunidad de #beersaturday mostrándole mis momentos con la cerveza, en mis salidas del fin de semana, en esta iniciativa semana 464. En las celebraciones nunca faltan las cervezas,así que llegó el cumpleaños de un querido amigo, llamé a mis amigas y le hicimos una sorpresa, lo llamé y coté en un restaurante de la ciudada muy cerca d e nuestras casas, salió de su trabajo directo al lugar, y le regalamos una tora de Piña, su favorita. Este restaurante solo ofrece cervezas Polar y Zulia, elegí Zulia con un costo de 1, 530 bsf. tiene un grado alcohólico de 4° G.L. su botella verde y su logo el aguila, con sus ingredientes agua, cebada pura malteada, lúpulo y estabilizantes, la cual tiene un sabor suave, equilibrado y refrescante. Cuando me reuno con mis amigos es la mejor terapia para reir, y beber muchas cervezas. Nos recargamos de buena vibra y disfrutamos, nuevamente con buenas cervezas, este fin de semana. C Me gustaría invitar a mi amiga @mafalda nos deleite con una publicación sobre el reto #BeerSaturday - Semana 463, una iniciativa de la comunidad cervecera y del incomparable @detlev . 🍻😎

title.title: Una vitrina llena de ternura /A display case full of tenderness
title.body:
La imagen de la semana es una tierna vitrina con una gran variedad de peluches como para complacer y consentir a nuestros pequeños o enamorar a los más grandes, porque los peluches no tienen género ni edad, no hay nada más tierno que recibir o regalar un peluche de nuestro personaje favorito, recuerdo que en los tiempos de mis hijos pequeños los de moda eran snoopy, Hello kity, garfield, osito cariñosos, los looney tunes, pitufos, peluches de animales que nunca pasan de moda y nunca fallan a la hora de dar un obsequio., perfectos también para coleccionar. >This week's image is a charming display case filled with a wide variety of plush toys, perfect for delighting and spoiling our little ones or captivating the grown-ups. Plush toys transcend gender and age; there's nothing sweeter than receiving or giving a plush toy of our favorite character. I remember when my children were little, the most popular ones were Snoopy, Hello Kitty, Garfield, Care Bears, Looney Tunes, Smurfs, and animal plushies that never go out of style and are always a perfect gift. They're also ideal for collecting. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcnnVonVBtSCWxi27wzK4TUtZtGyrq8oJSjX3JrKT3BTW/1779585072051.png)
_Imagen propiedad @lanzjoseg_
Hoy en día siguen estando a la orden para el entretenimiento de nuestros chicos mi nieta Amaya tiene varios en su colección y juega con todos, en esa imagenque nos trae el amigo @lanzjoseg gracias a mi nieta puedo reconocer algunos entre ellos: Gatitos mofusand, capibara, peluche almohada, loopy de miniso , hangyodon, pokemones, little Pony, Hello kitty entre otros más. Los peluches de minnie mouse creo que son los preferidos de mi nieta tiene tres iguales pero en diferentes colores, no puede salir sin ellos como son grandes les pone zapatos de cuando ella estaba más pequeña, aunque también tiene un oso amarillo que le regalaron cuando estaba recién nacida ya esta envegecido de tanto lavarse pero siempre lo tiene entre sus favoritos. Realmente los peluches nunca pasan de moda, abrazan el alma, cada uno cuenta una historia, llevan sonrisas, ternura, consuelo y compañía llenan de suavidad y amor los momentos de ansiedad y estrés, quien puede resistirse a tanta ternura, si a mi a esta edad que tengo me regalan un oso de peluche realmente me alegran el día y me llenan de felicidad. >Today, they're still a popular way to entertain our children. My granddaughter Amaya has several in her collection and plays with them all. In the picture shared by our friend @lanzjoseg, thanks to my granddaughter, I can recognize some of them, including: Mofusand kittens, a capybara, a plush pillow, a Miniso Loopy, Hangyodon, Pokémon, My Little Pony, Hello Kitty, and many more. I think my granddaughter's Minnie Mouse plushies are her favorites. She has three identical ones in different colors. She can't go out without them; since they're big, she puts shoes on them from when she was little. She also has a yellow teddy bear that she was given when she was a newborn. It's aged from so much washing, but it's always among her favorites. Stuffed animals truly never go out of style; they embrace the soul. Each one tells a story, bringing smiles, tenderness, comfort, and companionship. They fill moments of anxiety and stress with softness and love. Who can resist such tenderness? If someone gives me a teddy bear at my age, it truly brightens my day and fills me with happiness.
>
_¡Gracias por leer!_
>
Hasta una próxima oportunidad .
>
_Thank you for reading!_
>
Until next time.

**Hoy se corrió la segunda edición de la carrera OneRun en Venezuela, fue de varias distancia y en esta ocasión estuve corriendo 21 kilómetros.**

**Después de una semana larga con malestares de calambres que no me dejaron entrenar como quería, estaba sobre cargado por los entrenamientos de la semana pasada y que no tome un buen descanso para recuperarme debido a mi trabajo también y el día martes empecé con los calambres, estuve tomando agua con limón y sal para aliviar los calambres pero el día miércoles amanecí bien estable y quise entrenar pero al comenzar volvieron a aparecer los calambres y decidí dejar el entrenamiento, solo hice 3 kilómetros y para los siguientes días durante el díame daban pequeños calambres pero seguía consumiendo el agua con limón y sal, el día viernes en la entrega de materiales me ofrecieron un producto para aliviar los calambres nuevo en el mercado llamado pickle juice, y bueno me lo tomé el día de hoy antes de comenzar el calentamiento antes de la carrera, ya que apenas llegando al evento me dieron unos calambres y bueno si hizo efecto y me ayudó bastante ayudándome a qué no me dieran calambres durante la carrera.**

**La carrera estuvo bastante fuerte por el calor, a pesar de que estaba nublado y sufrí un poco el recorrido y ma que todo el temor de que me dieran calambres pero logré llegar a la meta Pero caí llegando si la sensaciones no se sintieron bien porque sentía un poco el cuerpo con hormigueo y si que baje el ritmo que llevaba, y bueno hice un excelente tiempo igual un minuto más de mi mejor tiempo, ya para la próxima arreglar esos detalles que nos hacen frenar en las competencias, igual como siempre se disfruta mucho de todo el evento.** 😁💪🏻

body.title: Film Review: Starship Troopers 3: Marauder (2008)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/qFbvKNLiI2ej0OP84CXCpfDecwl.jpg)


When Paul Verhoeven was tasked with adapting Robert A. Heinlein’s beloved literary classic of military science fiction, he seized the opportunity to craft a savage satire of US chauvinism and militarism. He could scarcely have imagined how prophetic his 1997 film *[Starship Troopers](https://peakd.com/film/@drax/retro-film-review-starship-troopers)* would become within mere years, as the Global War on Terror saw his most exaggerated satirical strokes play out in sobering reality. That satirical edge was all but lost in the 2002 direct-to-video sequel *[Starship Troopers 2: Hero of the Federation](https://peakd.com/hive-121744/@drax/film-review-starship-troopers-2-hero-of-the-federation-2004)*, a low-budget affair which utterly fails as fan service by abandoning social commentary for generic horror. However, it is not entirely absent from *Starship Troopers 3: Marauder*. Here, the brutal satire returns with a vengeance, resulting in a film which is deeply flawed, predictably inferior to Verhoeven’s masterpiece, but nevertheless very entertaining, frequently funny, and, once appreciated on its own modest terms, can be thoroughly enjoyed as a “guilty pleasure”.

The film is written and directed by Ed Neumeier, the screenwriter of the 1997 original, who thus attempts to steer the franchise back towards its satirical roots. The plot unfolds eleven years after the events of the first film. The protagonist, Johnny Rico (Casper Van Dien, the only original cast member to return), has advanced through the ranks of the Mobile Infantry to Colonel. As an experienced veteran, he and his unit are dispatched to the agricultural planet Roku San, where United Citizen Federation forces are successfully holding the Arachnids at bay. There he reunites with an old friend, Intelligence officer Dix Hauser (Boris Kodjoe), just as the immensely popular and charismatic Sky Marshall Omar Anoke (Stephen Hogan) arrives for a morale-boosting visit. Catastrophe strikes when the base’s defences inexplicably fail and the planet is overwhelmed by bugs. Rico manages to fight a desperate rearguard action, buying just enough time for a successful evacuation.

Anoke is evacuated aboard a spaceship commanded by Fleet Captain Lola Beck (Jolene Blalock), who is both Dix’s fiancée and Rico’s former girlfriend. En route, the ship is apparently attacked by Arachnids, forcing Beck to abandon it. Anoke, Beck, and a handful of survivors end up stranded on the surface of the remote planet OM-1. Meanwhile, Rico is made the scapegoat for the disaster on Roku San. Admiral Enolo Phid (Amanda Donohue), worried about public morale after years of an unpopular war, suppresses the news of Anoke’s disappearance. Dix begins a clandestine investigation, while Rico, sentenced to death for dereliction of duty, is offered a chance to redeem himself—and save his life—by leading a top-secret mission. This mission involves piloting experimental exoskeleton power armour suits known as Marauders.

Made in South Africa with a decent budget for a direct-to-video sequel, *Marauder* is obviously inferior to the first film’s lavish production values. Yet, it plays as a more honest and decidedly better follow-up to Verhoeven’s vision than the second film. Where Phil Tippett used Heinlein’s universe merely as a backdrop for a generic action-horror story, as noted in a review of *Hero of the Federation*, Neumeier consciously tries to continue painting the Federation’s dystopian future as a funhouse mirror reflection of the post-9/11 and Iraq War era. Verhoeven had already constructed this world with brilliant efficiency, so Neumeier can concentrate on introducing new satirical innovations. The most notable of these is Christianity, represented by Beck’s fanatically devout flight attendant, Holly Little (Marnette Patterson). Initially frowned upon by the totalitarian Federation, this faith is later cynically co-opted for war propaganda, much as certain religious sentiments were harnessed for political purposes during the Bush years. This adds a layer of contemporary relevance that was sorely missing from the second instalment.

However, Ed Neumeier obviously lacks Verhoeven’s directorial panache and visual audacity. The film often feels rough around the edges, with pacing that sags in the middle and action sequences that lack the visceral punch of the original. At times, the satire becomes too broad and obvious, losing the delicious subtlety that made Verhoeven’s film so insidious. A prime example is the character of Elmo Gonif (John Vaz), a wheelchair-bound war veteran turned militant peace activist, who is so transparently modelled on real-life figure Ron Kovic that he feels less like a satirical creation and more like a clumsy caricature.

The cast, however, is more than solid. Casper Van Dien slips back into the role of Johnny Rico with ease, portraying a weary, disillusioned commander who has seen too much. Jolene Blalock, best known as T’Pol in *Star Trek: Enterprise*, brings a steely, no-nonsense authority to Captain Beck. Amanda Donohue is splendid as the ruthlessly pragmatic Admiral Phid, a military leader with a hidden—and probably very dark—agenda. Yet the show is utterly stolen by Irish actor Stephen Hogan as Sky Marshall Anoke. Hogan delivers a marvel of a performance, portraying a leader visibly slipping into messianic insanity while never losing an iota of his magnetic charisma. His rendition of the film’s propaganda song is a highlight, making Anoke the most memorable character in the entire film.

The special effects are decent for a mid-2000s direct-to-video production, but they inevitably give away the film’s inferiority to the 1997 work. The CGI bugs are serviceable but lack the tangible, repulsive physicality of the original’s blend of practical and digital effects. The Marauder suits themselves, while a welcome addition, have a slightly clunky, video-game aesthetic.

Klaus Badelt’s score is relatively unremarkable, but the film’s greatest auditory asset is undoubtedly “It’s a Good Day to Die”, the ultra-patriotic hymn performed diegetically by Sky Marshall Anoke. With lyrics that are deeply ironic in context, the song has taken on a life of its own. Through various YouTube tributes, it has been stripped of its satirical context and applied unironically to real-world militaries and conflicts—a bizarre and perfect example of life imitating art imitating life, and perhaps the ultimate testament to the film’s satirical point about the power of propaganda.

*Marauder* also pays direct homage to Verhoeven’s film with a scene where Johnny Rico and his soldiers, including female troopers, appear nude as they undergo neural linking procedures for their exoskeletons—a clear nod to the earlier film’s infamous co-ed shower scene. More significantly for fans of the source material, the film introduces the Mobile Infantry’s powered exoskeleton suits, which were conspicuously absent from the 1997 adaptation. These “Marauders” represent Neumeier’s attempt to make amends and offer an olive branch to purist fans of Heinlein’s novel, who had long lamented their omission.

Released straight to DVD in 2008, *Starship Troopers 3: Marauder* received generally mixed reviews from critics, who acknowledged its ambitions but bemoaned its execution. However, this did not prevent it from attaining a certain cult status among fans of the franchise who appreciated its return to political satire. Its relative success even paved the way for two further sequels, albeit in a different format: the 2012 CGI animated film *Starship Troopers: Invasion* and the 2017 follow-up *Starship Troopers: Traitor of Mars*.

*Starship Troopers 3: Marauder* is a fascinating, flawed curio. It lacks the budget, directorial genius, and cultural impact of Verhoeven’s original, and its satire is often less scalpel and more bludgeon. Yet, by earnestly trying to resurrect the franchise’s critical spirit and by engaging directly with the geopolitics of its time—the cynical use of faith, the cult of personality around leaders, the endless war for dubious reasons—it stands as a far more worthy successor than the forgettable *Hero of the Federation*. Bolstered by a game cast, a few genuinely clever ideas, and the undeniable pleasure of seeing Rico back in action, it achieves its primary goal: it is entertaining. For those willing to meet it on its own B-movie terms, it offers a hearty, if slightly cheap, dose of satirical sci-fi action. It is, in every sense, a guilty pleasure—but one with just enough brains behind its brawn to make you feel slightly less guilty about enjoying it.


RATING: 6/10 (++)
