body.title: I Turned $2 Into A Numismatic Investment | Part 1
body.body:
In the world of numismatics, people have their own reasons for collecting currency. Some choose coins out of historical reverence, while others are drawn to certain pieces because of personal bias or sentimental value. Yet one thing remains true: many forms of currency are worth more than their face value.

One thing is certain: the melt value of coins can be surprisingly valuable. Unlike paper currency, which lacks significant intrinsic worth, coins have the advantage of being made from metal. Beyond their metallic value, however, collectors often seek coins for their year, luster, rarity, or historical significance.

With that being said, I took the dive and decided to turn the two dollars I had in my pocket into a numismatic investment.

# The Initial Two Dollars


![image.png](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/esecholo/7b83a950d1f5ed029c3e8ce83329c69f487153d8.png)


The first two dollars were nothing special. They did not carry a star note, nor did they have interesting serial numbers or unusual features. Of course, they did not contain any printing errors either. They were two simple, generic dollar bills. Sure, I could have kept them and sealed them away in a proper case, but I figured, why not see where those two dollars could take me?

Later in the day, I went to the store and asked the clerk to exchange my two dollars for seven quarters and five nickels. I probably caught them off guard with the nickels, but I got what I wanted. Technically, I walked away with a slight loss in melt value, but what about face value? In the end, I had simply exchanged two dollar bills for two dollars in coins. I suppose the two minutes spent making the exchange counts for something. Time is money, or something like that.

Anyways, I took my coins and checked my loot. Honestly, I was pleasantly surprised by what I saw...


![image.png](https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/esecholo/4415256a6816c5e5dd30767c2d18b06faa4fac96.png)

Here are some of the coins that I received that were fairly common and generic. There is not much special about them other than, perhaps, their luster and, in some cases, their quality. However, some of them are also too recent. 

If I were to sell any of these to collectors, I could reasonably estimate their total value at around $4. To be honest, if I tried selling them online, they likely would not sell due to shipping costs. Realistically, even if I found a buyer willing to purchase them all for four dollars, it would probably take years before I could come out ahead. It truly isn't worth it.

Six out of the seven quarters were duds; Two out of the five nickels were uninspiring. So, that leaves us with four coins left... for the next article!

***
If you want to get involved in coin collecting, it's as simple as collecting the coins in your pocket change! Try it out and see what you find!
***
Slowly I am building my coin collection. If you want to help expand my collection, please upvote and support me by following! 

Also support @freevoluntarist to combat fake news!

body.title: Inspirational Story: A Struggling Student
body.body:
Greetings Education Community. 

I hope everyone is well. By the grace of God, I am also well. Today I want to share the story of a struggling student with you. 


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRvYhEQYN7esyGXkPwQumL262sKiZWmvpX6XN6QTHCmRT/1000099943.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/joyful-graduation-moment-in-blue-and-gold-32067327/)


Originally, there was a student in our village. His family was very poor and they had only one house to live in. The father of that poor family only worked in agriculture. The father was almost 60 years old and he is now almost old. However, his father had a great desire that he would educate his son in a healthy education and make himself proud of being a working father. 

The boy whose name I am telling the story of was Majnu. Majnu is the son of a poor family and he continued his education with great difficulty. The headmaster in the primary school was very distressed seeing his poverty. A large amount of donations were arranged for Majnu in the school. Majnu was distributed free books and along with this, notebooks and pens were provided from the school. Along with this, a stipend was arranged.

Majnu was a very good student. Since he was the son of a poor man, Majnu was very patient and continued his education with great difficulty. When he was admitted to class six, his education expenses increased. He was even deprived of the grant that was given to primary school. At one point, Majnu started making beli flower garlands. There is a large beli flower garden next to our house. The women of the village go to that garden to collect flowers and sell them for 50 paisa per piece. Majnu started making flower garlands and by selling them, he earns 50 to 100 taka daily. 

Along with making flower garlands, I saw Majnu raising some goats. Majnu took goats to a garden and I saw him sitting with a book and reading. The goats eat grass in the mango garden and I saw Majnu reading using a mat. One day I asked him, can one earn his livelihood by raising goats only? 

 Then Majnu replied to me, I am only raising goats to continue my studies and I am making flower garlands.

I was very happy to hear Majnu's words. He is only doing partial work to continue his studies. But his main work was to study and make himself self-reliant. 





At one point, Majnu passed the Higher Secondary Examination in 2015 and received an honor by getting an A plus. And this honor impressed the entire locality. Because how can a child from such a poor family get such good results? 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc615PtBNBnps3sJM9xFCz9t2AMt7PKhUoKSZNi4ozbvB/1000099944.jpg 


[Source](https://www.pexels.com/photo/guy-in-robe-holding-graduation-certificate-12294215/)



Basically, today's story is a real-life story. Today's story is written based on the true events of our village. </liketuimages>

改弟是谁，就是我的痴呆母后了。

今天早晨四点，痴呆母后常规的从凌晨四点起床，然后开始推我的门，一直操作到七点我起床，这个时候，我听到大门外，有声音，原来是三姨妈在门口，三姨妈来了

三姨坐在椅子上问，这么好得院子，为啥弄的这么脏，这么恶心，看到都令人恶心，一顿批评，说的是老畜生，其实也是批评我的意思，没收拾好院子，其实院子收拾好了，很漂亮的别墅，但是老畜生每天都去外面捡拾很多恶心人的碎石头放院子里，弄的恶心人，老畜生上厕所还不进厕所，别墅盖了两个厕所，老畜生把院子的水桶摆开，在院子里东西都放了十来个水桶，他无论白天还是黑夜，不进厕所直接随时随地，在水桶撒尿，家里有儿媳妇和孙女，老畜生依旧如此，我说他，他还想打我，想把我赶走，不让我住这个家里，想让我妹妹把痴呆母后接走，他自己独自住这个院子，这个老畜生很不是个东西，没有我和痴呆母后，水电费谁给你交，这个老畜生不是个人，我很后悔花很多钱，把他从医院救活。

三姨妈一顿批评，我象征性的干了一会，收拾了几个，把很多垃圾扔掉了，痴呆母后说她三姐，你咋不在他在的时候说他，三姨说，他在我也说他，这么好得院子，才几天，弄成这个样子，你天天外跑干啥

这几天，痴呆母后总是自己悄悄的流出院子，去后街找她三姐，她自己是个傻子，找不到，被三姨的邻居送回来，表哥也给我打电话，让我看好她，不能让他小姨出门，可是我每天还要开店啊，老畜生骑车就跑，不管他老婆，我和老畜生不说话，我也不知道该如何解决

我想把痴呆母后，带在身边，可是痴呆母后不在店铺带，需要带出去溜圈，我给妹妹打电话讲述，妹妹生气，你给我讲这些干啥，她觉得她承受了很多，她不想听，我理解，于是赶紧挂了电话

说到底，人与人之间还是缺失了信任和真诚，人心难测。

自己强大了，周围的人和事才是美好的，人落难了谁都想踩你。

知耻而后勇，还不算晚，我也才四十岁，姜子牙也是80岁才出道。加油，又是元气满满的一天。

---

body.title: Golo Curu: The Sacred Catholic Pilgrimage and Magical Sunrise of Ruteng
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcLg5MsSxnuzb8y1VufGV11MnUNtJR5mA6KQogwCQpJYC/1000705513.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRbYwV78oRs3dV3fhwrCqsjdjZDsdDk8XGpmzjgLRwUR1/1000705520.jpg 

When traveling deep into the highlands of the Manggarai region on Flores Island, you will quickly discover that its true beauty lies not just in the scenery, but in the deep connection between the local heritage, nature, and faith. One of the most iconic places to experience this spiritual harmony is Golo Curu. Located in Karot, Langke Rembong District, just on the northern outskirts of Ruteng, this prominent hill stands as a revered sanctuary and a highly popular Catholic pilgrimage destination.
​A Sacred Sanctuary at 1,136 Meters Above Sea Level
Sitting majestically at an altitude of 1,136 meters above sea level, Golo Curu offers a profoundly serene atmosphere. At the very peak of the hill, a beautiful 2-meter-tall statue of the Virgin Mary stands gracefully, overlooking the valley below. For decades, it has been a sacred space of prayer, reflection, and quiet pilgrimage for locals and visitors alike. Walking up this hill in the cool, silent air provides a unique sense of peace that is hard to find anywhere else.
​Where Morning Fog Meets Panoramic Glory
Aside from its immense religious significance, waking up early to ascend Golo Curu rewards you with one of the most breathtaking sunrise experiences in the highlands. As the first light of dawn pierces through the freezing cold, a thick, mystical blanket of white fog slowly rolls across the lowlands, completely transforming the view.
​From this high vantage point, the majestic panorama of Ruteng town gently unfolds. You can watch the town's rooftops emerge from the mist, perfectly framed by lush green valleys, steep mountain ridges, and the sweeping emerald rice fields below. Standing near the statue in the quiet morning while watching the sun paint the sky in gold is a deeply moving experience that slows down time.
​A Perfect Escape for the Soul and Lens
Whether you come as a pilgrim seeking spiritual reflection or a traveler hunting for cinematic scenery, Golo Curu delivers an unparalleled slow-living retreat. It invites you to stop rushing, brave the highland chill, and admire how devotion and natural wonders blend beautifully into a single horizon.
​Below is a quick cinematic glimpse of the misty morning vibes and sacred peace up here on Golo Curu hill, Karot!
​https://3speak.tv/shorts?v=yordan96/haj1c5rt
​Thank you for exploring the peaceful highlands of Flores with me. If you ever find yourself traveling through Ruteng, make sure to slow down your journey, head up to Karot, and spend a quiet morning embracing the serenity of Golo Curu.

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

body.title: A plate of crunchy happiness and a mouth-watering feeling 🤤
body.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ4BzSvhKAQmoxeaqh8fgTavkCrorWM28CebZv47XiwVT/1779583386234.jpg) There are hundreds of royal arrangements in the world of food, but the joy of eating a plate of fuchka while standing at a street corner in the dim afternoon light is perhaps unmatched by anything else. Phuchka is not just a street food, it is our passion, our chat and another name for pure love. This afternoon, when I suddenly remembered Phuchka amidst the steamy tea chat Then I couldn't control myself anymore. I went with my friends to a familiar snack shop. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaBYPKZDwnQQb1vftpxNYv2yQ6gBYuEGiJKZkSvvvSp6E/1779583386381.jpg) When the fuchkas arrived one by one on the plate, the surroundings changed instantly. The crispy fuchka shell, the delicious potato and pea filling inside, and the fried jhuribhaja and egg slices spread on top, all combined to create a wonderful scene. The moment you put the first puff in your mouth is the most magical. The crunchy sound of the puff breaking under the pressure of your teeth and the immediate explosion of the sweet and sour tamarind juice inside. In an instant, all the fatigue seems to wash away and the mind becomes refreshed. The real secret of Phuchka lies in its tamarind chutney or sour water. Just when the intensity of the sauce brings tears to the corners of your eyes, the touch of sourness soothes your mouth. This perfect balance of sourness and sweetness is what makes Fuchka unique. One Fuchka after another goes into your mouth and each time it seems like the taste is getting more intense. Finally, sipping the extra spices and a spoonful of sour water on the plate is a royal ending to the phuchka episode, forgetting all the mental stress of a busy life. The wonderful feeling of sharing a plate of fuchka with friends with a smile is truly incomparable. It not only fills the stomach, but also fills the mind with a strange peace. 📸 Photography| Details 📸 |-|-| |Camera used|Smartphone| |Model|Realme-C53| |Location| Bangladesh| |Photographer|@queen88|

body.title: Replacement of the water tank pipe [Eng/Spa]
body.body:
> Hello, friends at Hive and Home Solutions, how is everyone? My dad’s in hospital, but thank God he’s getting better and I’m trusting in God that he’ll be discharged on Monday, because I have to stay with him every night and it’s impossible to sleep there – it’s been three nights now, so I’m really tired. I’ve been meaning to post this for days about the job I told you I did, replacing the pipes on the tank I repaired recently at home.
ESPAÑOL

Hola amigos de Hive y Home Solutions, cómo están todos? Yo con mi papá hospitalizado, pero gracias a Dios mejorando y confiando en Dios que el lunes le den el alta ya porque me toca quedarme todas las noches con él y es imposible dormir ahí y ya van tres noches así que estoy muy cansado y desde hace días tenía pendiente de publicar este post del trabajo que les dije que hice con el cambio de tuberías del tanque que reparé hace poco en la casa.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmckVAr2CdZGdwFWexFm1dqkBDQD2CYh16ePSspbcEF1av/1779584443607.png) https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png In my last post on the forum, I told you that I’d repaired a crack in the tank where all the water was leaking out, and it turned out perfectly – it doesn’t leak at all and has lasted as long as it should. However, I needed to replace a few pipes; I just had to wait for the tank to empty and do the job before refilling it, so I took the weekend to get it done. To reattach the pipework to the tank, I had to buy a new water outlet fitting, because the one I had had broken a while ago and I’d stuck it back together with a bit of pipe glue to make it last a while. In fact, it lasted nearly five years, as I’d already told you, but to get everything sorted and prevent it from breaking again, it was time to replace it.
ESPAÑOL

En el último post en la comunidad les conté que había reparado una grieta del tanque por donde se nos iba toda el agua, y quedó perfecto, no filtra nada y nos duró lo que debe durar, pero yo tenía que hacer un cambio de unos tubos nada más que tenia que esperar que el tanque se vaciara y antes de volver a llenarlo hacer y eso, y aproveché el fin de semana de hacer ese trabajo. Para instalar la tubería nuevamente al tanque tuve que comprar la pieza de salida del agua, porque la que tenía se había partido hace tiempo y está se había pegado con un poco de pega para tubería para que aguantará un tiempo, de hecho aguantó casi 5 años como ya les había contado, pero para ya dejar todo listo y evitar se rompa era tiempo de cambiar eso.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQJQA3bvPXXDG6SdkptxeLq6xkRbHF8cu68nNksrw38ZT/1779583221079.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ1e8zjkGrZvJkXA1p5atyFhYwfDaxNaeoEMW8K1HzY1H/1779583221151.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdNxpcwtMQ5GFcLuYmKPe59JCgKsQ221PYnyf6ps9vYvC/1779583221210.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSqXx6un4viy1p8RLyC4vWUJxt7gposiiYdM8dKXmWvJC/1779583221269.jpg) https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png Once I had the new part, I set about installing it. I started by fitting the outer section first, screwing the threaded pipe all the way in so that the rubber seal—which prevents water from leaking—was tightly secured. Then, on the inside, I fitted the ring with the other rubber seal and tightened it until it was snug; then, with my son’s help, we turned the tank over and positioned it where the pipe goes. The original pipe had a 3/4\

la cual servía para alimentar el tanque, pero está llave estaba dañada y no la compré, estoy quedó pendiente para después, y además de ésta llave, había otra llave que servía para conectar una manguera o llenar un recipiente, decidí quitarla porque nunca se usaba.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb3u2ZdQteDEdyqVbDTnxNRTtdVtWX9dcrBPoGSyyRXuC/1779583221327.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmahM15vNN3QvsLahWKDsuBo7w9aLDHfhKnc98i6U6i7Kn/1779583373382.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcw9FbX1qwpQQGbYvUrBRUsx7EcdLPpuwpgwsPgSDHc8G/1779583373525.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb3u2ZdQteDEdyqVbDTnxNRTtdVtWX9dcrBPoGSyyRXuC/1779583373453.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwk7Surxsb3z8dTmamnYfhTCHgsvmcPK9Re1oqWhwpw4/1779583373592.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwk7Surxsb3z8dTmamnYfhTCHgsvmcPK9Re1oqWhwpw4/1779583739255.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme6qr9bS9mMhBBTtAJGnz7a4bHEEd2VT2yDkfvVjWykmc/1779583373658.jpg) https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png I had some fittings at home that I could use to replace the valve, so I refitted the shut-off valve on the tank that supplies the water, then fitted the fitting I had at home and two reducers to reduce the pipe from 3/4\
with a glue joint. I then cut the 1/2\

dónde iba la llave, coloqué pega de tubería y las conecté. Después de unos minutos procedí a alimentar el tanque con una manguera y verificar que no hubiese fuga, todo quedó perfecto y lo puse a llenar nuevamente, que eso lo hacemos conectando la bomba de otro tanque que tenemos en el patio. Bueno amigos eso es todo por hoy. Saludos y hasta otro momento.

body.title: Rainy day makes for sushi and seafood making : May 22 2026
body.body:
A grey day. Perfect weather to take my wife shopping. She is still not allowed to drive - moonboot rules. Got the shopping done - lining up seafood for the day. A nice snapper and sashimi salmon ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/425ef3e6-382a-4fe6-b09a-4a7d34a6e970.jpg) Have had a sushi kit in the cupboard for a few years now. Dug it out and set about preparing the rice. Simple enough - cook the sushi rice. Let it stand 10 minutes. Mix in the rice vinegar while still hot. Separate out seaweed shet and lay on the mat. Layer in the rice and your preferred ingredients ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e931b1e4-c3d1-49fe-bf60-5ee53743effc.jpg) Also did salmon nigiri. The salmon had been cut into small pieces. Next time check the packs and get one with longer pieces. The age of the kit is evident from the roll - dark brown - not green and hard to separate the layers- hence the holes ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2826fa19-1958-444c-88f4-f86a4b35ebc4.jpg) Walked up to shops to buy fresh seaweed sheets. Camellia raindrop walk it was ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1a78f0ca-13ea-4f2d-82aa-c079647ee7f5.jpg) These from the apartment garden. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d27a7da5-cf70-4939-8fbe-eba60b8de5ec.jpg) Try again - salmon, cucumber and avocado for the centre. Photo shows did not quite get it right. Need to leave about one inch of sheet at thr top end. That way the rice stays inside the roll when rolling is done ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/efff9608-b6e9-42c2-a544-53f163f3adae.jpg) Cut across ready to serve. Keeps well in the fridge one day. Did cook the whole snapper for dinner. No photos. Simple tomato and basil dish. Chop onions and celery and garlic. Saute that until onion softens. Add in a little white wine to deglaze the pan. Then some chicken or vegetable stock. Get that hot - then a generous handful of cherry tomatoes halved. When that is a good tomato sauce lay in the fish and cook each side 5 to 7 minutes. Well - keep going until you can see the flesh flaking. Turn over and do same again. Just before serving lay on some shredded basil leaves - be generous. With them. Serve with potato mash.
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@carrinm/actifit-carrinm-20260524t005111441z)_

body.title: (ENG/ESP) TUTORIAL: BEAUTIFUL PENDANT MADE WITH RECYCLABLE MATERIAL USING THE CROCHET TECHNIQUE.
body.body:
(ENG)

Hello everyone, I hope you're having a wonderful day, full of good things. I'm happy to be with you all. Today I'm here to show you a very pretty project that combines several craft techniques, resulting in a beautiful and eye-catching piece. It's a lovely pendant, inspired by a heart, that we could use on wallets, purses, keychains, and more. In short, it's very useful, allowing you to make your accessories more distinctive and stand out from the rest. It incorporates recycling, jewelry-making, and crochet techniques. I invite you to follow me, and I'll show you how easy it is to make. I hope you enjoy the tutorial.

 ![1000364179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EpEKen8eBBTaMhjeNbx42VNbQTjDzNbcQwDL7nukLV7PSSgRJ6tZ6srGiiqRHp4KVYE.jpg)

Materials used:

. Fabric scrap, from blue jeans.

. Yellow knitting yarn.

. Skein of yellow yarn.

. Knitting needle.

. Stuffing.

. Two pink wooden beads.

. Heart charm.

. Pencil.

. Heart cut from recycled cardboard.

. Scissors.

 ![1000364178.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/AKuv4aYBKSxw24o9itZwa28Jw5kF2MThNtgE3pspMBWVLduWQQ2tRvbFn5gNbYX.jpg)

Procedure (step by step)

1.) It's important to mention that, before the first step, I selected a piece of cardboard, drew and cut out the shape of a heart. Next, using a pencil, I traced the heart onto a piece of blue denim fabric, cut it out, and traced another one to make a pair of hearts. This piece of blue denim fabric is from a children's pair of jeans that had hearts attached or painted on them; that's where the idea came from.


 ![1000364237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EocAqVjDWtkERb1PFaDDE5vALaboncnYB268syWJCioqZBZKVa8QHMKUm9wBtUoMndT.jpg)

2.) I make a small hole at the bottom of the heart, holding both pieces together, and begin with the help of the knitting needle. I make a loop and for the next hole, I separate with a chain stitch. I continue until a few centimeters from the starting point, then I stop.

 ![1000364238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EogRfczcuLF4Gt5KhowLuvbHVeuq7Grcy3X1x7wMjKhydTg9hCSihHreCPnhHwLoNAQ.jpg)

3.) Place the stuffing inside the hearts and continue working until you reach the starting point. Make a slip stitch. Work a second round until you reach the halfway point and stop.

 ![1000364239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EoK9gndC76ev7yUo7SHXo9M8BM2q7H8QAhzNCoTEV99RZxzEwiWrHERpMHM1jh16Pgp.jpg)

4.) Chain thirty, slip stitch to the first chain, and create a long pendant. Continue crocheting, and at the bottom, chain three and fasten off, leaving a small hole of chain stitches.

 ![1000364240.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EoySQxeS5h3QV7hqYVaYegdXUEg4jWnVncPjufRfLAjeLt3UoVTHE6bvHKxBLsxA2FG.jpg)

5.) I attach the first bead to the pendant. Using one side of the heart-shaped cardboard, I wrap the skein around it until it's completely used up. Then, I create a fringe with the remaining yarn, thread a bead onto it, and tie it to the bottom of the heart, where I made the hole with the chain, and make a delicate bow.

 ![1000364247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EoeHm9u5yWttfn6gTezmBKpdMMbqMhY5xxVfXqjemxwLXyxAsfNc4WjGuQ4RYXTaL7J.jpg)

6. Finally, I place the gold charm on top, and it's now ready to wear.

 ![1000364252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EouBcavb2T16tWRmCs87o55eU9FNu52jPWUawcNREcQDWPLuiLS39a1hTse5nD1hsLC.jpg)

It was a pleasure to show you this beautiful and delicate project, a handcrafted item, after some time away. It's always a pleasure to have you visit my blog. I hope you enjoyed it. Until next time.




              ( Esp)




Hola a todos, deseo este sea un gran día, lleno de cosas muy buenas. Me complace estar con todos ustedes, hoy vengo a mostrarles un muy bonito, proyecto, dónde combiene varias técnicas manuales, dando un resultado muy bonito y llamativo. Se trata de un hermoso colgante, inspirado en un corazón, que podríamos usar en carteras, bolsos, juegos de llaves entre otros, en fin, es de gran utilidad, permitiendo hacer tus accesorios más representativos y diferenciarlos de los demás. Dando uso de las técnicas de reciclaje, bisutería y crochet. Sin más la invitación en a seguirme y les muestro lo fácil de su elaboración. Deseo disfrutes el recorrido.



![1000364179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EpEKen8eBBTaMhjeNbx42VNbQTjDzNbcQwDL7nukLV7PSSgRJ6tZ6srGiiqRHp4KVYE.jpg)


Materiales usados:

. Recorte de tela, de blue jeans.
. Hilo para tejer, color amarillo.
. Madeja de color  amarillo.
. Aguja para tejer.
. Relleno.
. Dos cuentas de madera, color rosado.
. Dije de corazón.
. Lápiz.
. Corazón en cartón reciclado, ya recortado.
. Tijeras.



![1000364178.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/AKuv4aYBKSxw24o9itZwa28Jw5kF2MThNtgE3pspMBWVLduWQQ2tRvbFn5gNbYX.jpg)


Procedimiento ( paso/paso)

1.) Es importante, mencionar, que, anterior a el primer paso, seleccioné un trozo de cartón, dibuje y recorte, la figura de un corazón. Seguidamente, con el lápiz, marque sobre el trozo de tela de blue jeans, recortó el corazón y marco uno más, para obtener un par de corazón. Este recorte de tela de blue jeans, es un pantalón infantil, que trajo adheridos o pintados corazones, de ahí la idea.


![1000364237.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EocAqVjDWtkERb1PFaDDE5vALaboncnYB268syWJCioqZBZKVa8QHMKUm9wBtUoMndT.jpg)


2.) Hago una pequeña perforación en la parte inferior de el corazón, tomando, ambas piezas, y comienzo con ayuda de la aguja de tejer, tómalo lazada y para el siguiente orificio separo con un punto cadenas. Continuo, hasta unos centímetros de el punto de partida, hago un alto.



![1000364238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EogRfczcuLF4Gt5KhowLuvbHVeuq7Grcy3X1x7wMjKhydTg9hCSihHreCPnhHwLoNAQ.jpg)


3.) Coloco el relleno dentro de los corazones y continuo el recorrido hasta alcanzar el punto de partida y tejo un punto deslizado, Realizó una segunda vuelta, hasta llegar a la mitad y hago un alto.


![1000364239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EoK9gndC76ev7yUo7SHXo9M8BM2q7H8QAhzNCoTEV99RZxzEwiWrHERpMHM1jh16Pgp.jpg)


4.) Levanto treinta puntos cadenas, bajo a el primer punto cadena y tejo un punto deslizado, formando un largo colgante. Sigo tejiendo y en la parte inferior levanto tres puntos cadenas y cierro. Dejando un pequeño hoyuelo de puntos cadenas.



![1000364240.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EoySQxeS5h3QV7hqYVaYegdXUEg4jWnVncPjufRfLAjeLt3UoVTHE6bvHKxBLsxA2FG.jpg)


5.) coloco a el colgante una primera cuentas. Usando uno de los lados de el cartón con figura de corazón, doy vueltas con la madeja, hasta agotar en su totalidad, luego armó un flequillo, con el hilo residual, introduzco una cuenta y ato a la parte inferior de el corazón, dónde realice el hoyuelo de cadenas, y hago un delicado lazo.



![1000364247.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EoeHm9u5yWttfn6gTezmBKpdMMbqMhY5xxVfXqjemxwLXyxAsfNc4WjGuQ4RYXTaL7J.jpg)



6. Finalmente, coloco el la parte superior, el dije dorado, quedando de esta manera, listo para ser usado.



![1000364252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/katiuskamata/EouBcavb2T16tWRmCs87o55eU9FNu52jPWUawcNREcQDWPLuiLS39a1hTse5nD1hsLC.jpg)


Fue un gusto, mostrar, luego de algún tiempo, ausente, este bonito y delicado proyecto, manual. Siempre es un gusto su visita a mí blog. Deseo haya sido de su agrado.Será hasta una próxima oportunidad.

body.title: Recommendation  The Curse of Widow's Bay: unsettling and cringe-worthy. [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
> **Hello again, TV lovers!** I hope you’re all doing well. Personally, I love mystery, horror and thriller series, so whilst I’m waiting for all the remaining episodes of *From* to be released, I decided to start watching a new Apple TV series that blends horror with dark comedy, called *The Curse of Widow’s Bay*. ![17795830374615019698425930460465.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23zGgJWN61JKAyzadU5aY2s9QhF6sg3Ctq4kbd4QeYPFxYtTkd96aW5x68WCKFTmvS2mG.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33332385/mediaviewer/rm3124811010/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_2 )
The story is set in a village called Widow’s Bay, located on a small island near New England. Although it looks like a picturesque village, ideal for getting away from it all, the truth is that it’s falling apart: the infrastructure is crumbling, they have no internet, and the island is cursed. Every resident of the village clings to the superstition that there is something evil and sinister in the village, that the village is under an ancient curse, but despite this, they carry on with their lives. The protagonist is the mayor, Tom Loftis, who, it should be noted, was not born in the village (an important fact, because apparently those born in Widow’s Bay cannot set foot on the mainland). Tom is little respected, perceived as weak and a nuisance because he wants only one thing: to save the village’s economy, turn it into a tourist destination, and thus provide a better future for his son. But soon a strange and sinister fog begins to envelop the town, and the old horror stories become reality. ![17795831991336393872500209423600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23tGbn6ozFD6yPLU65B4SXUxxH5xvEGVG9JSTkM8CWKrCSTfpwjP2DffdYK7RcL8oM3GN.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33332385/mediaviewer/rm1497147138/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1 )
The story is a blend of folk horror and dark comedy, featuring a mayor trying to turn a haunted island into a family tourist destination, but with the legends coming to life and the town’s rather murky past, the characters’ lives become worse than the fact that the power keeps cutting out. And all hell breaks loose when Tom achieves his goal, turning Widow’s Bay into an ideal holiday destination. But the tourist season descends into a chaos of terror, and the monster, the entity and the possession begin to disrupt the peace. ![17795832396267984005685885528585.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23t797Rz45ocSjc9AkrB5ThhrFed8xdPTA4wAdhsQkUxdQhvZnXujFk2T2vsk9FGKK2dQ.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33332385/mediaviewer/rm2805713154/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_1)
Something I really like is how they combine horror with humour; in other words, it’s unsettling but funny, light enough to watch, to scare you or to make you laugh. It’s funny one moment but then becomes unsettling and murky, which makes it quite entertaining, though the shift in tone can be a bit drastic and some of the scares aren’t particularly impactful. I really like the dynamic between Mayor Tom and the villagers, with him struggling to attract people to the village and the villagers challenging him to say ‘ugly Hortense’ so that his ungrateful reflection might appear to him. But that reflects the disparity between modernity and old customs. ![17795832920084676112050195215187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23uQtND15rWjxbdDWYs36Aep8D71TTs68Rj4DhhUrDk7t8CKvxtaXnaiskwLLX6e2XeSz.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33332385/mediaviewer/rm2788935938/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1_3)
Throughout the story, there is a constant sense of unease about what is happening, and although there is humour, that dark and malevolent ‘something’ never disappears—something the laughter cannot mask. And with Tom’s scepticism and the town’s terrifying legends, everything just gets weirder and darker.And although I don’t get scared very easily, it was quite entertaining.
![1000167922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23wr7T13K3akYgwrutQkHPN5SNsieBsDHDD9FoQ3F9KfbF6nzU7aoj8HhfhHT5egriMVb.jpg)
**¡Hola otra vez, amantes de la televisión!** Espero que se encuentren bien. A mi en lo particular me encantan las series de misterio, terror y suspenso, así que mientras espero que entrenen todos los capítulos que faltan de From, decidí ponerme a ver una nueva serie de Apple TV que mezcla terror con comedia oscura, llamada: La maldición de Widow’s Bay. ![17795830374615019698425930460465.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23zGgJWN61JKAyzadU5aY2s9QhF6sg3Ctq4kbd4QeYPFxYtTkd96aW5x68WCKFTmvS2mG.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33332385/mediaviewer/rm3124811010/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_2 )
La historia se desarrolla en un pueblo llamado Widow’s Bay, ubicada en un pequeña isla, cerca de Nueva Inglaterra. Aunque se ve como un pintoresco pueblo, ideal para alejarse del mundo, lo cierto es que se está cayendo a pedazos: la infraestructura se está cayendo, no tienen internet y la isla está maldita. Cada habitante del pueblo vive aferrado a las supersticiones de que hay algo malo y siniestro en el pueblo, que el pueblo tiene una antigua maldición, pero a pesar de esto siguen con sus vidas. El protagonista es el alcalde Tom Loftis, quien aclaro, no es nacido en el pueblo ( hecho importante, porque aparentemente los nacidos en Widow’s Bay no pueden pisar tierra firme), Tom es poco respetado, percibido como débil y molesto debido a que Tom solo quiere una cosa, salvar la economía del pueblo, convertirlo en un destino turístico y así poder darle un mejor futuro a su hijo. Pero pronto una extraña y siniestra niebla empieza a rodear al pueblo y las viejas historias de terror se convierten en realidad. ![17795831991336393872500209423600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23tGbn6ozFD6yPLU65B4SXUxxH5xvEGVG9JSTkM8CWKrCSTfpwjP2DffdYK7RcL8oM3GN.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33332385/mediaviewer/rm1497147138/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1 )
La historia es una mezcla de terror folclórico con comedia oscura, con un alcalde tratando de convertir una isla hechizada en un destino turístico familiar, pero con las leyendas cobrando vida y el pasado bastante turbio del pueblo, la vida de los personajes se pone peor que el hecho de que se les vaya la luz a cada rato. Y todo se desata cuando Tom logra su objetivo, convierte a Widow’s Bay en un destino Ideal para vacacionar. Pero la temporada turística se convierte en un caos de terror y el monstruo, entidad y posesión de pasada empiezan a alterar la tranquilidad. ![17795832396267984005685885528585.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23t797Rz45ocSjc9AkrB5ThhrFed8xdPTA4wAdhsQkUxdQhvZnXujFk2T2vsk9FGKK2dQ.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33332385/mediaviewer/rm2805713154/?ref_=ttmi_mi_2_1)
Algo que me gusta mucho es como combinan el terror con el humor, es decir es inquietante pero graciosa, bastante ligera para ver, para asustar o para reir. De repente es graciosa pero se vuelve inquietante y turbia, lo que la hace bastante entretenida, pero el giro del tono puede ser algo drástico y algunos sustos no muy impactantes. Me gusta mucho la dinámica entre el alcalde Tom y las personas de pueblo, el colapsando intentando traer gente al pueblo y los pueblerinos retándolo a que diga “fea Hortense” para que se le aparezca su ingrato reflejo. Pero eso refleja, la disparidad entre la modernidad y la viejas costumbres. ![17795832920084676112050195215187.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valsalazar/23uQtND15rWjxbdDWYs36Aep8D71TTs68Rj4DhhUrDk7t8CKvxtaXnaiskwLLX6e2XeSz.jpg)
[IMDb]( https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33332385/mediaviewer/rm2788935938/?ref_=ttmi_mi_1_3)
En la historia hay un desconcierto constante con lo que sucede y aunque hay humor no desaparece ese “algo” oscuro y maligno, que las risas no pueden tapar. Y con el escepticismo de Tom y las leyendas del pueblo aterrando, todo solo se pone más raro y oscuro. Y aunque en lo particular no me asusto si fue bastante entretenida.
🔅 Cover in/Portada en [IMDb](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt33332385/mediaviewer/rm3124811010/?ref_=ttmi_mi_7_2), 🇺🇸Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

Golo Curu is a popular Catholic pilgrimage and religious tourism destination located in Karot, Langke Rembong District, Manggarai Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (Flores). Sitting at an altitude of 1,136 meters above sea level, this sacred hill is famous for its 2-meter-tall statue of the Virgin Mary at the summit. 

This short cinematic aerial view captures the majestic morning atmosphere of Golo Curu, showing the peaceful chapel surrounded by lush green hills, rolling white clouds, and a beautiful panoramic outlook of Ruteng town and the mountain ridges below. A truly serene sanctuary for the soul in the heart of Flores!

---

Cada país tiene sus leyendas fantásticas acerca de lo que habita en sus desconocidos bosques, junglas y demás terrenos donde casi no hay presencia de la humanidad.
Every country has its fantastic legends about what inhabits its unknown forests, jungles, and other terrains where human presence is almost nonexistent.

En estos lugares apartados, se nos advierte que la presencia de estos entes paranormales castiga la intrusión de los humanos que rara vez se atreven a entrar dentro de sus dominios.
In these remote places, we are warned that the presence of these paranormal entities punishes the intrusion of humans who rarely dare to enter their domains.

Como era de esperarse, Brasil no escapa de este patrón cultural que se repite en casi todas las naciones con territorios salvajes y misteriosos.
As one might expect, Brazil does not escape this cultural pattern that repeats itself in almost all nations with wild and mysterious territories.

En este país suramericano abundan las historias de criaturas sobrenaturales que protegen la selva amazónica y castigan a quienes osan profanar su santuario natural.
In this South American country, stories abound of supernatural creatures that protect the Amazon rainforest and punish those who dare to desecrate their natural sanctuary.

Esta canción que se ha vuelto muy popular trata específicamente de esto, capturando la esencia de esos relatos ancestrales en su letra y su ritmo.
This song, which has become very popular, deals specifically with this, capturing the essence of those ancestral tales in its lyrics and rhythm.

\
nos narra acerca de los monstruos del Amazonas y un poco de sus animales, transportando al oyente a ese universo místico y temible de la selva.\n\

tells us about the monsters of the Amazon and a little about its animals, transporting the listener to that mystical and fearsome universe of the jungle.

Todo esto está envuelto en un ritmo de afrobeat, una fusión musical que aporta una energía contagiosa y un groove profundo que invita al movimiento.
All of this is wrapped in an afrobeat rhythm, a musical fusion that brings contagious energy and a deep groove that invites movement.

Junto a mi banda en el bar donde tocamos regularmente, un espacio llamado Skybox, hemos interpretado esta pieza en múltiples ocasiones con gran aceptación del público.
Together with my band at the bar where we regularly play, a space called Skybox, we have performed this piece on multiple occasions with great acceptance from the audience.

La combinación de la temática amazónica con el ritmo africano crea una experiencia única que celebra tanto las raíces culturales como la fusión global de sonidos.
The combination of the Amazonian theme with the African rhythm creates a unique experience that celebrates both cultural roots and the global fusion of sounds.

Espero que disfruten de esta versión que les comparto, capturando un poco de esa magia selvática y ese ritmo vibrante que caracteriza a \
.\nI hope you enjoy this version I share with you, capturing a bit of that jungle magic and that vibrant rhythm that characterizes \

.

¡No olviden comentar, rebloguear y votar si esta fusión de leyendas amazónicas y afrobeat también los hace viajar con la imaginación a lo profundo de la selva brasileña!
Don't forget to comment, reblog and vote if this fusion of Amazonian legends and afrobeat also makes you travel in your imagination to the depths of the Brazilian jungle!

body.title: Guinea Pig saying Hi
body.body: It has been close to six months since the little one has been with me. Good Morning.. How has your Weekend been? Meet the male Californian Guinea Pig. It has a dark spot on the nose that makes it quite valuable here in Malaysia. I've had a few Guinea Pigs, and now the whole Guinea Population is at 5 at the moment. Two born by my existing Guinea Pigs. This guy is a male Guinea Pig. When I got him from the Pet Shop at around 2 months old, the pet store told me that it was a female Guinea Pig. After a while, I went and had a good look to find out what its gender is, and it clearly shows that it's a male Guinea Pig. It has red eyes, which indicates a bit of a Himalayan Guinea Pig origin.

/> Look at those adorable eyes. One of the things I usually do is to clean the enclosure whenever I can. I have a layer of pine wood as the substrate to reduce urine smell. I usually spend a bit of time filtering out the poop. They poop a lot. I tried to put in the pot for my plants as fertilizer but I think there needs to be another process that has to be done before completely putting the fertilizer on the soil. They tend to decay.
/> This is one of the puppies that have been born here at my house. 8 in total and already given away to rehome. So, this is one of the ones left at the moment.
/> Quite small at the moment. It tends to eat a lot of food. Usually, we prepare lots of food. Her parents also tend to eat alot.
/> The little one is quite cute at the moment. I guess I have lots of animals at home. Somehow, it's quite a fun activity just to see how they swim around and move around.

/> The molly tank. This is a smaller tank, and it is full of Molly fish. Molly fish tend to breed at a rapid rate. Can you spot some of the little Molly fish in the tank? If you look closely, you can see some little eyes looking at you. There is some aquatic plant inside for the little mollies to be able to hide.

/> Can you spot them? This picture is clearer. Mollies usually have bulging bellies when they are going to give birth? I originally only had 5 in this tank. At this point of time, there could be almost a 100. Planning to sell some of them out soon.
/> Thank you very much for reading my post. Have a great day ahead. @luueetang YouTube : www.youtube.com/luueejanice Tiktok: www.tiktok.com/@luueejanice

body.title: Bonnie And Clyde (1967) Is One Of The Most Important Crime Films Ever Made Because It Changed Hollywood At The Perfect Time. Even Though Parts Of It Feel A Little Corny And Stylized Today, It Is Still A Personal Classic To Me Because Of Its Energy.
body.body:
Bonnie And Clyde Is One Of The Most Important Crime Films Ever Made Because It Changed Hollywood At The Perfect Time. Even Though Parts Of It Feel A Little Corny And Stylized Today, It Is Still A Personal Classic To Me Because Of Its Energy, Performances, And Lasting Influence.

![IMG_1943.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNiD6vTTTeHHr3gbahRRYnQgmDKeNHhGCpUjdFGKCjyrU/IMG_1943.webp)

Released in 1967 and directed by Arthur Penn, Bonnie and Clyde arrived during a major shift in American cinema. Older Hollywood styles were fading, audiences were changing, and movies were becoming more daring and realistic. This film helped push that transition forward in a huge way. At the time, it shocked audiences with its violence, tone, and antihero characters.

Warren Beatty stars as Clyde Barrow, the charming but reckless outlaw who dreams of escaping poverty and becoming famous through crime. Beatty gives Clyde confidence and charisma while also showing the insecurity underneath the bravado. He is not portrayed as some unstoppable criminal mastermind. He is flawed, impulsive, and often in over his head.

Faye Dunaway plays Bonnie Parker, and honestly the movie does not work without her performance. Dunaway gives Bonnie intelligence, frustration, and excitement all at once. Bonnie is tired of ordinary life and sees Clyde as an escape from boredom and limitation, even if that escape leads somewhere dangerous.

The chemistry between Beatty and Dunaway carries the entire film. They make Bonnie and Clyde feel romantic and exciting while also showing the cracks underneath the fantasy. That balance is important because the movie constantly shifts between glamour and harsh reality.

The plot follows Bonnie and Clyde as they travel across Depression era America robbing banks, gathering a gang around them, and slowly becoming media sensations. At first, the crimes almost feel playful and reckless, but as the story continues, the violence and consequences become much darker.

Gene Hackman is excellent as Clyde’s brother Buck Barrow, bringing humor and unpredictability to the gang dynamic. Estelle Parsons also gives a memorable performance as Buck’s wife Blanche, whose panic and emotional breakdowns add tension and realism to the story.

Arthur Penn directs the film with a style that was groundbreaking for its time. The movie mixes comedy, romance, violence, and drama in ways Hollywood rarely attempted before. One moment feels light and funny, and the next becomes brutally intense. That unpredictability gives the film its unique energy.

Visually, the movie still stands out because of its combination of classic Hollywood framing and more modern editing techniques. The final ambush scene especially became legendary because of how raw and violent it felt compared to earlier studio films.

That ending changed cinema in many ways. The sudden explosion of violence shocked audiences in 1967, but it also forced Hollywood to move away from sanitized portrayals of crime and death. You can see the influence of Bonnie and Clyde in countless crime movies that followed.

Now yes, some parts of the movie definitely feel a little corny today. Certain romantic moments and bits of dialogue have that very sixties dramatic style that can feel exaggerated compared to modern films. But honestly, I think that stylization is part of the movie’s identity.

![IMG_1941.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZQWUFgeWghnfxkksH6pEdnXp9E7VZiVUgSgtfyZV2n1R/IMG_1941.webp)

The film almost feels like a myth being told rather than strict historical realism. Bonnie and Clyde become symbols of rebellion, freedom, and self destruction all at once. That larger than life feeling gives the movie its lasting appeal.

What also makes the film special is how it critiques celebrity culture long before social media existed. Bonnie and Clyde become famous because of crime, attention, and public fascination. The movie understands how quickly society can turn criminals into legends.

The Great Depression setting also matters because it explains why some ordinary people saw the gang as folk heroes. Banks were widely hated during that era, and the film captures that frustration without pretending Bonnie and Clyde were purely heroic figures.

Over time, Bonnie and Clyde became recognized as one of the defining films of the New Hollywood era because it helped open the door for more creative, risky filmmaking in the late sixties and seventies. Without this movie, a lot of later classics probably do not happen the same way.

In the end, Bonnie and Clyde remains a classic to me because it is stylish, emotional, funny, tragic, and deeply influential all at once. Even with a little corniness around the edges, the movie still feels alive in a way many modern crime films do not.

![IMG_1940.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXDEZvATY6TSgrvDzW8QQABctT6UGxNDmX2AKxwiy76Zr/IMG_1940.webp)

It is not just a story about outlaws robbing banks. It is about fame, rebellion, desperation, and the dangerous line between romance and destruction. That is why it still holds up nearly sixty years later.

body.title: The Hidden Message of Mortal Kombat: Snow Blind  /ESP-ENG
body.body: I liked an anime movie that I watched last weekend. It is called Mortal Kombat Legends: Snow Blind. I liked it because it has a very interesting post-apocalyptic atmosphere. First of all, in the animated movie I identified a lot with Sub-Zero, although here he no longer uses that name. The character has practically abandoned both the suit and the title because, during a battle when he was still Sub-Zero, he used his freezing powers to kill monsters, but he lost control. Practically no one survived in the city; civilians died along with the monsters.\n\n

>Source Here, the ice warrior has lost all honor in using his powers to help others. Now he lives a quiet farm life, raising chickens and growing corn. He has gone unnoticed in the village where he lives because what happened affected him deeply. The world he lives in now is almost entirely deserts, giving the movie a very dark and hopeless atmosphere. Now let’s talk about Kenshi. He is a young man who wanted to become the greatest fighter. He is proud and fully confident in his abilities. Kenshi is so confident that he faces three bandits who arrived to terrorize the town. These men were subordinates of King Kano, who in this world was the greatest villain and leader of the Black Dragon.

>Source After the three villains are defeated, they go back to Kano to tell him that there is someone causing problems. Then they send a fourth member, a huge and muscular monster who easily defeats Kenshi. After being defeated, Kenshi is deceived by a sorcerer, who was actually Shang Tsung in disguise. He tells him about a sword with supernatural powers, supposedly stronger than Kano himself. However, it was all a trap. The sorcerer ends up blinding Kenshi. At that moment, all of Kenshi’s pride collapses because he can no longer see or fight the way he once did.

>Source The former Sub-Zero refuses to fight or confront Kano. He is afraid of losing control again and freezing innocent people. He even suffers nightmares about the day he destroyed everyone using his powers. Because of this, he has completely lost the desire to interfere in the battle against Kano. However, when he meets Kenshi, the young man who lost his eyes, he slowly begins to recover his desire to help others. He accepts Kenshi as his disciple and decides to teach him how to survive while being blind. Here Kenshi begins training with Sub-Zero. He learns discipline, patience and, above all, how to use the Sentō sword. One of Kenshi’s most interesting abilities is that, when he holds the sword, he can partially recover his sense of sight and perceive the world differently.

>Source During the training, he improves his speed and learns many techniques from his master. But he does not only improve physically; his desire to fight and help others also grows stronger. Kenshi regains confidence in himself and, after mastering the sword, decides to confront Kano because he cannot remain silent while Kano continues spreading cruelty everywhere.

>Source Then the young man, now fully determined, fights against all the villains. He starts strong, defeating many members of Kano’s army. However, after showing his new abilities, he is also severely injured during the battle and loses two fingers from his hand. Even so, he keeps fighting. Now he has an important ally: the former Sub-Zero, who changes his mind and returns to the battlefield. Kenshi’s desire to help others inspires Sub-Zero to regain his strength and purpose. Because of this, the spirit of Scorpion also joins the battle.

>Source This is where the movie truly delivers its best fights. When Kenshi, Sub-Zero and Scorpion fight together, you can see Kano slowly weakening and the real possibility of finally defeating him. The battle is ultimately won by Kenshi, Sub-Zero and the spirit of Scorpion. After the fall of the Black Dragon, Kenshi proves himself worthy of the Lin Kuei legacy, becoming proof that there is still hope left to protect Earthrealm. Now, the spirit and will of Sub-Zero live on through a new generation of warriors. One thing I really liked about this movie is how it shows that even the strongest people can feel guilt, lose the desire to fight or hide themselves from the world. But it also teaches that there can always be a second chance to rise again and help others. Lessons Learned This story carries many lessons because it reminds us of how Sub-Zero became someone who no longer wanted to use his powers because of something terrible he did in the past and because he feared becoming that same person again. It made me reflect on something very human: how a person can regret mistakes from the past and wonder if they will always remain that same version of themselves or if they can truly become someone different in the present — more disciplined, with new hopes and a new perspective on life despite past mistakes. I also reflected on Kenshi’s concept of being a hero. What truly makes him strong is not only his ability to fight, but his desire to help others, to sacrifice himself and to not allow injustice to continue existing in the world. He wants to do something. He wants to fight for people who cannot defend themselves. It is exactly that spark and determination that inspires Sub-Zero to return to battle once again. In addition, the movie made me think deeply about how pain and strong emotions can pull someone out of darkness and suffering. Kenshi transforms pain, loss and darkness into strength, discipline and personal growth. Instead of giving up after becoming blind, he finds a new way to move forward and becomes a better version of himself. All of this is what I learned from this movie, and I think one of the most interesting things about it is how it shows that even after making mistakes or going through painful moments, there is always the possibility to change, rise again and find a new purpose in life.
Lee la versión en español aquí.

Me ha gustado una película de anime que estuve viendo el pasado fin de semana. Esta se llama Mortal Kombat Legends: Snow Blind. Me gustó porque tiene un toque postapocalíptico bastante interesante. Primeramente, en la película animada me identifiqué con Sub-Zero, aunque aquí no usa este nombre. El personaje prácticamente ha abandonado el traje y el título porque tuvo una batalla cuando era Sub-Zero en la que usó sus poderes de congelamiento para matar a unos monstruos, pero se salió de control. Prácticamente no quedó vivo nadie en la ciudad; murieron civiles al igual que los monstruos.

>Fuente Aquí, el personaje de hielo ha perdido todo honor en usar sus poderes para ayudar a los demás. Ahora se dedica a una vida de campo, teniendo gallinas y sembrando maíz. Ha pasado desapercibido en el pueblo donde vive porque le afectó muchísimo haberse salido de control. El mundo en el que está ahora es prácticamente puro desierto, lo que le da a la película un ambiente muy oscuro y desolador. Ahora conozcamos a Kenshi. Él es un joven que quería ser el mejor peleador; es orgulloso y confía plenamente en sus habilidades. Kenshi está tan seguro de sí mismo que se enfrenta a tres bandidos que llegaron a azotar la ciudad. Estos eran subordinados del rey Kano, quien en ese mundo era el mayor villano y líder del Dragón Negro.

>Fuente Luego de que los tres villanos son derrotados, ellos van donde el rey Kano para decirle que hay una persona causando problemas. Entonces envían a un cuarto integrante, un monstruo musculoso y extremadamente fuerte que prácticamente derrota a Kenshi sin dificultad. Después de ser derrotado, Kenshi es engañado por un mago, que en realidad era Shang Tsung disfrazado. Él le habla sobre una espada con superpoderes, supuestamente más poderosa que Kano. Sin embargo, todo era una trampa. El hechicero termina dejándolo ciego. Ahora todo el orgullo de Kenshi se viene abajo cuando ya no puede ver ni pelear como antes.

>Fuente El antiguo Sub-Zero se niega a pelear contra todos y a luchar contra Kano. Tiene miedo de perder el control y congelar nuevamente a inocentes. Incluso tiene pesadillas sobre el día en que acabó con todos usando sus poderes. Por eso ha perdido todo deseo de intervenir en la lucha contra Kano. Sin embargo, cuando conoce a Kenshi, el joven al que le arrebataron los ojos, comienza a recuperar lentamente el deseo de ayudar. Además, admite al joven como discípulo y decide enseñarle a sobrevivir siendo ciego. Aquí Kenshi comienza a entrenar con Sub-Zero. Aprende disciplina, paciencia y, sobre todo, a usar la espada Sentō. Una de las habilidades más interesantes de Kenshi es que, cuando sostiene la espada, puede recuperar parcialmente el sentido de la vista y percibir el mundo de otra manera.

>Fuente Durante el entrenamiento comienza a mejorar su velocidad y aprende muchas técnicas del maestro. Pero no solo mejora físicamente; también aumenta su deseo de luchar y ayudar a los demás. Aquí Kenshi recupera la confianza en sí mismo y, una vez dominada la espada, decide enfrentar al villano Kano porque no puede quedarse sin hacer nada ante toda la crueldad que está causando.

>Fuente Entonces, el chico, ya decidido, se enfrenta a todos los villanos. Comienza bien, derrotando a muchas personas del ejército de Kano. Pero, después de demostrar sus nuevas habilidades, también resulta gravemente herido durante la batalla y pierde dos dedos de la mano. Aun así, sigue peleando. Ahora cuenta con un aliado importante: el antiguo Sub-Zero, quien cambia de opinión y vuelve a la batalla. El deseo de ayudar de Kenshi inspira a Sub-Zero a recuperar sus fuerzas y su propósito. Gracias a esto también aparece el espíritu de Scorpion para unirse al combate.

>Fuente Es aquí donde la película realmente muestra sus mejores batallas. Cuando Kenshi, Sub-Zero y Scorpion luchan juntos, se puede ver cómo Kano comienza a debilitarse y cómo finalmente existe una verdadera posibilidad de derrotarlo. La batalla finalmente es ganada por Kenshi, Sub-Zero y el espíritu de Scorpion. Tras la caída del Dragón Negro, Kenshi demuestra ser digno del legado del Lin Kuei, convirtiéndose en la prueba de que aún existe esperanza para proteger la Tierra. Ahora, el espíritu y la voluntad de Sub-Zero viven a través de una nueva generación de guerreros. Algo que me gustó mucho de esta película es cómo muestra que incluso las personas más fuertes pueden sentirse culpables, perder el deseo de luchar o esconderse del mundo. Pero también enseña que siempre puede existir una segunda oportunidad para volver a levantarse y ayudar a otros. --- ## Aprendizajes Aquí esta historia maneja mucho aprendizaje, porque recuerda cómo era el personaje de Sub-Zero: alguien que no quería volver a usar sus poderes por algo que cometió en el pasado y por el temor de no ser el mismo otra vez. Entonces aquí veo una reflexión muy humana: cómo una persona puede arrepentirse de algo que hizo en el pasado y preguntarse si siempre se quedará siendo esa versión de sí misma o si realmente puede convertirse en alguien diferente en el presente, más disciplinado, con nuevas esperanzas y con otra visión de la vida, a pesar de los errores cometidos. También reflexiono sobre el concepto de héroe que representa Kenshi. Lo que realmente lo hace fuerte no es solamente su habilidad para pelear, sino su deseo de ayudar a los demás, de sacrificarse y de no permitir que las injusticias continúen existiendo en el mundo. Él quiere hacer algo, quiere dar batalla y luchar por las personas que no pueden defenderse. Es precisamente esa chispa y esa determinación lo que hace que Sub-Zero vuelva nuevamente a la batalla. Además, la película me hizo pensar mucho sobre cómo el dolor y las emociones fuertes pueden sacar a una persona del fondo, de un pozo lleno de dificultades. Kenshi transforma el sufrimiento, la pérdida y la oscuridad en fuerza, disciplina y crecimiento personal. En lugar de rendirse después de quedar ciego, encuentra una nueva manera de seguir adelante y se convierte en una mejor versión de sí mismo. Todo esto he aprendido de esta película, y creo que una de las cosas más interesantes es cómo demuestra que incluso después de cometer errores o pasar por momentos difíciles, siempre existe la posibilidad de cambiar, levantarse nuevamente y encontrar un nuevo propósito.

Check out this video I'm sharing with you: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vvqx3-1G9Rw I hope you enjoy it! Let me know your thoughts in the comments below! --- The writing is original. Translated with DeepL. Below each image, I share the link

body.title: Birding photo-hunt in a local park: mating, nests... and chicks!
body.body:
I have some wonterful fresh stuff from a park walk. Spring is not in the air - now it is in the water, in the grass, in the trees... i.e. everywhere. I directed my telephoto lens (as usual) at the street life AND at the birds life as well -- this indeed is a very special time. Without any special hunting and explorations after a few hours walk I returned back home with so much stuff I am very, very pleased with. 

![2026-may-1878w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23zGo7g6EHG27EhaqAqXsvvYKJbKWkjLGN3PSXrnUHqvSoogVYkDFypNacChj7pR7XdUz.jpg)
This spring time has a very special colour that I love very much; everything is so clear, light, tender, and delicate before 'all the world is green' phase.

![2026-may-1883w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23uRBMNC3v3uC8ByLXz4GYAbfc6NgrXDPPiy48vBLyqeLMzu9MKpTwXkT2h7Yxu6XJyms.jpg)

Seagulls. Might be doing some quirky business!

![2026-may-2115w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23wMey64ZQK9kiocX6Dt7oHW49UvgR3UqxSzVoATFahexSkiwTsfteGEz2kHjEM85P4w2.jpg)

The thrush let me be his companion for just one minute - I watched he was preening and cleaning the beak (or maybe he was *sharpening* it? looked a bit so!)

![2026-may-1892w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/EocBSSmNjTxHdzwbnLnCSEJnwFjHr61FyVLdF8rywkMAqrAvWbq1PbCagCLEbfTejU7.jpg)

Чомга на гнезде.

![2026-may-1873w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23w2wjT4giQe3PSQnBhszcwYJJoSnUyya8R31VkWet2mD7SVqSm4Yprcy2hhhh7oKkEwG.jpg)
Havent seen the mullard's nests - just a lot of mating pairs (as always).

![2026-may-1887w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23tmQFRFiLdkXeyjWXS97gMvrCVhSoCx6F3egG4vfvppoznx1c1bJDG8PmuW7BRUf8AWt.jpg)
Coots, crested grebe ducks and seagulls may be quite spectacular, and, you can see that at least I can approach them -- well, not at hand's distance, but to the range which is good for my telephoto lens to do the job.

My guess is, there must be some rivalry for the best spots for setting down the nests, and in my opinion the coots have seized the best part - cause, well, they are such fighters that other birds prefer not to quarrel or argue with them :)

![2026-may-1891w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23yJLyH6uQdyMFNEbfrfrT7hdjLtdFD3ksxUJpg2Y2uGLzeSE6qgUt2PwS8oSPDGMAoHQ.jpg)

Look how pleased she looks like! I even see her smiling :)


![2026-may-1903w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23xp6YrAwkbXqcornVUEuwTf3Eiphw5HqVLyXJRHn1GhauhHp7oVgjagCDu6eW5asFvBH.jpg)

The seagull is forced to settle for a simpler spot — a leaning tree near the shore, which I'd say is quite reachable to human hands and therefore less desirable. But personally, I was pleased pretty much — the photographing distance was very, very tempting and benefitted to the captures a lot. (Though I could not ignore the risk of dropping down into the water with my camera. Happily it did not happen!) 

![2026-may-1913w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23tmHsDUJs1FVzKFz3bnJiftokjMF47QhsBtEemmZh9yr5nv3qty8BFEQrfCATBKEUAUC.jpg)

You can practically see the seagull's pupil in the photos! Anyway, my daughter liked it the most :)


![2026-may-1944-CROP.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/EogQetVArM9qWsTr3FvZin96Wvomi9Ag76gX3JcdZWsGnyME7pRQrnzTzfukAt3HJfc.jpg)

I met a few toddlers who already ventured to go out of their nest but havent lear to fly yet.

<div class=\

>

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/242DQXSoXbi2BZwKeiUo8f74mmUC526KHNETJUMsxsxToG7rYuUXs6NEEigRwAdkMpe19.jpg A thrush chick was sitting under a pine...

>

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/242DJamT278asPhgrSvqyjqWyeq2FhSyhAqcE7PBV9JQ6gcSUXKTGsnaKWcsgAjcTcrLz.jpg ...and a little jackdaw was hiding in dandelions.

--------- I took so many cool captures that simply cannot decide which ones I want to share ... they dont fit into a single post. Besides that I cant edit _all of them_... so I have to choose -- and I selected these. But let me round up my post with another one; count it as a teaser: ![2026-may-2215w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23wgDcEJx9RmqpuzYf2ffNZJpatk8gP24B3ye6bufyqJKVssB3cWovTGtbnLZw99wA4TX.jpg) I stumbled upon a coot's freshly-minted family! Actually, I HAVE to made a special post about it, just could not but underline -- I had a desire to shoot them for a long time, about 4-5 years, and now I can say this geshtalt is happily closed! everything comes to the one who waits. ![2026-may-2291w-h.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23xAZh4TqZcEseMbvMbVkPzmpdDJrnwy4gakZn5h4LTFNFvfTLAZMS6vCWpK3FyiD8eei.jpg)
![feathrr.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/qwerrie/23tbEu7i6Lg5oczZxiEhAUnstEz7Ut3gXgnYVTh5BN9Re3h7KRZgHuxxQFKQmK7VhnWSX.png)
This post goes for ['Show me a photo (of a bird)'](https://peakd.com/hive-106444/@nelinoeva/feathered-friends-show-me-a-113918556cd94) contest, round #271 (wow, already 271 ?!?!?) Suggested topic was **'Young bird'** -- and it is almost a perfect match to the stuff I recently shoot.

body.title: Batalla en autoduelo y nuevas tareas - Squad Busters [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
> ![auaa.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvogGMswaM42RNTbZgk5coHbjr9q8XrWHvLv6FNt7VZu/auaa.jpg) Saludos amigos, estamos comenzando unan nueva semana de tareas en este juego y por eso ya se actualizaron todas las tareas, donde están seis de ellas disponibles donde cada una cuenta con un toque de dificultad y por eso es importante planificarse y de esa manera durante toda la semana poder terminarlas o si se puede antes es mucho mejor, ya que así nos dan las recompensas que están ofreciendo. Con tan solo una partida que realice para probar unos personajes, ya logre completar la primera de las tareas que consistía en eliminar a 5 enemigos, siendo algo muy bueno porque seguramente podré completarlas todas en un tiempo récord. >Hello, friends! We’re kicking off a new week of challenges in this game, and all the challenges have already been updated. There are six available, each with its own level of difficulty, so it’s important to plan ahead so you can finish them throughout the week—or even sooner if possible, which is even better, since that’s how you’ll earn the rewards on offer. With just one match I played to test out some characters, I already managed to complete the first task, which was to eliminate 5 enemies—which is great because I’ll surely be able to complete them all in record time. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfDGv39gMuncv9NTdpyk9i2F5vuCwDwr1YRXTLfVDVA3V/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNnUTkngKqhJcMkJfUUrczEUFjyxXP8BC3WgzoC9gwDuz/image.png) Lo bueno de todas las recompensa que uno va recolectando dentro de ellas salen muchas cartas de los personajes que tengo disponibles y forman parte de mi equipo, donde en este punto es importante tenerlo todos mejorados, por el mismo hecho de que los rivales también se están volviendo fuerte. Por eso tenía 214 cartas del personaje Greg, la cual eran perfectas para así poder mejorarlo y con todas esas llevarlo al nivel dos. Este es un personaje que muy poco uso, ya que su tarea es simplemente cortar árboles durante las batallas y eso puede retroceder a todo el equipo, pero tengo que tenerlo mejorado, por el hecho de que uno nunca sabrá cuando nos tocará usarlo. >The great thing about all the rewards you collect is that they include lots of cards for the characters I have available and who are part of my team. At this point, it’s important to have them all upgraded, simply because the opponents are getting stronger too. That’s why I had 214 cards for the character Greg, which were perfect for upgrading him and taking him to level two. This is a character I rarely use, since his role is simply to chop down trees during battles, and that can slow down the whole team, but I have to level him up, because you never know when we’ll need to use him. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdmafXGFR2CUu3pb74ediTXCeEZw6QwvB8JtWsAECywqx/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUCwvZHEMsty2nHBbyV4BMtFvY955VZREXCa5dTKejotz/image.png) Tengo varias modalidades de juego y en cada una de ellas se pueden hacer cosas distintas, probar combinaciones o en la mayoría de todas poder ganar recursos de una manera mucho más sencilla, sin embargo dentro de todas esas la modalidad de duelo muy pocas veces las que he jugado, ya que es bastante difícil por el mismo hecho de que es uno contra uno, hay pocos cofres y solo se cuenta con el personaje de rey que uno tenga y del resto toca sobrevivir o matar al enemigo antes de que se termine el tiempo. Esta vez comencé moviéndome para así poder tomar algunas monedas extras y abrir cofres para que mi equipo creciera, pero era imposible porque mientras se hacía eso había que ir derrotando al otro jefe y por eso un mínimo error todo se daña. La partida fue bastante buena, a pesar de que perdimos, pero nos sirvió de experiencia. >I have several game modes, and in each one you can do different things, try out combinations, or—in most cases—earn resources much more easily; however, out of all of them, I’ve rarely played the duel mode, since it’s quite difficult simply because it’s one-on-one; there are few chests, and you only have the king character you’ve unlocked, so the rest of the time you have to survive or kill the enemy before time runs out. This time, I started by moving around to collect some extra coins and open chests to level up my team, but it was impossible because while doing that, I also had to defeat the other boss, so even the slightest mistake ruined everything. The match was pretty good, even though we lost, but it was a good learning experience. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmanoKVHp8NHPLMRBgni35mL374KRthjrRmrc3yfrW7GHS/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbq9eqvcuK3CxFD9FZz3aMxSGLVja7m2E2PipstFGy55g/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQMfBihCfA9Lo8byH89B6Mf1yDLksFy6cFKHtTmmvvRQk/image.png) Contamos con una clasificación en este juego, la cual me parece interesante, ya que, por una parte, se pueden ver los que han ganado batallas en este juego, pero a la vez para ver ese progreso que uno pueda llegar a tener en este juego, donde en mi caso tengo muy pocas batallas ganadas que no son lo suficiente para poder estar dentro del top 20 de jugadores de este juego, la cual es una muestra de que tiene años jugando y apostado tiempo. Sin embargo, toca seguir dando lo mejor y poder aprovechar cada batalla que se pueda hacer y así poder ir subiendo de escalón en esa tabla. >This game features a leaderboard, which I find interesting because, on the one hand, you can see who has won battles in the game, but at the same time, it lets you track your own progress. In my case, I’ve won very few battles—not enough to make it into the top 20 players—which shows that those players have been playing for years and have invested a lot of time. However, I need to keep giving it my all and make the most of every battle I can, so I can keep climbing the ranks on that leaderboard. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVe2fsYdwgg2Yb4LyQgmUpcdL3Kdb212VmECLboSTXR2T/image.png) Del resto las cosas van muy bien en este juego, donde se ha podido notar una gran diferencia desde que comencé a jugar, siendo algo muy bueno, además el equipo sigue creciendo y cada vez más fuerte, donde hoy en la tienda salieron algunas ofertas interesantes que voy a estar pensando si las compro, ya que es una manera extra de poder conseguir carta de los personajes que me hacen falta, así que cada moneda que sume será de gran ayude y a la vez poder completar esa semana de tareas del juego. >Otherwise, things are going really well in this game. I’ve noticed a big difference since I started playing, which is great. Plus, my team keeps growing and getting stronger. Today, some interesting deals popped up in the store, and I’m going to think about whether to buy them, since it’s an extra way to get the character cards I’m missing, so every coin I earn will be a big help and will also let me complete that week’s in-game tasks.
