body.title: Welcome to Magangué: Warm land and Home of the Rivers. 🌅🌍🇨🇴
body.body:
>

Hello friends, today I want to tell you about the many things I've learned about our sister country, Colombia. I, for one, have had the pleasure of visiting two different places in Colombia five times. About four years ago, I went to Cúcuta to meet a relative, and it was really just a one-day trip, but for the first time I had the pleasure of seeing at least our border.

>***Hola amigos, hoy quiero contarles las muchas cosas que pude conocer de nuestro país hermano, Colombia. Yo, por mi parte, he tenido el gusto de ir 5 veces a 2 sitios distintos de Colombia. Hace unos 4 años, fui a Cúcuta, a recibir a un familiar, y realmente fue algo de solo un día, pero por primera vez tuve el gusto de conocer al menos nuestra frontera.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/Eopts9ajsgoQQjt9wM8TuLZDak6UxSQo7UJGXXKZ6U7hJucwbEWNDupFFibFrE6fqmF.png)

<div class\

>

Three years ago, after having already visited Cúcuta, and following a minor emotional crisis due to not having seen my sister for so long, I decided to spend December 2023 with her and meet my nephews who live there. I don't have any photos of myself with my sister from that time, but this one was taken on January 31st of this year, at a festival in town, and we went out together that day.

>***Hace 3 años, luego de ya haber conocido Cúcuta, y después de una pequeña crisis emocional que me dio por tener demasiados años sin ver a mi hermana, decidí ir a pasar diciembre de 2023 con ella y así conocer a mis sobrinos que viven allá. No tengo fotografías propias con mi hermana de aquellas fechas, pero esta fue el día 31 de enero de este año, en un festival que hubo en el pueblo, y ese día salimos a compartir juntos.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

>

I come from a home with strong family values, and having the opportunity to spend time with my nephews has been one of the best things I've ever had. They are three very special children, and I can say with complete joy that the affection has been mutual. These children are wonderful people, with good values and an excellent upbringing that they have never lacked.

>***Vengo de un hogar con valores familiares, y tener la oportunidad de convivir con mis sobrinos ha sido de las mejores oportunidades que he tenido, son tres niños muy especiales y con todo el gusto puedo decir que el cariño ha sido mutuo. Estos niños son una calidad de personas, con buenos valores y con una educación excelente que no les has faltado nunca.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/ALLHprWGd9RrUrEWfaBjXFRqfnuFPpZ9v7L7Hf28LKoDq9BctPKDSTePYdj4Xfy.png)

<div class\

>\n\nWhen I traveled to Magangué, Bolívar State, I never imagined the magnitude of this place and how important it is specifically for Colombians in general. As a Venezuelan, I had never heard of it. Here in Venezuela, it's common to know about Bogotá, Cali, and Barranquilla, and thanks to the telenovela \

(Without Breasts There Is No Paradise), we know about Pereira. In other words, my general knowledge had limited me to seeing beyond those cities.\n\n>***Cuando viaje a Magangué, Estado Bolívar, jamás me imaginé la magnitud que guarda este sitio y lo importante que es específicamente este lugar para los colombianos en general. Yo como venezolano, jamás había escuchado de este sitio, aquí en Venezuela, es común tener conocimiento sobre Bogotá, Cali, Barranquilla y gracias a la novela \

conocemos Pereira, o sea, la cultura general me había limitado a ver más allá.***

Magangué is home to the Magdalena River, the largest river in Colombia, and going daily to spend a hot afternoon at the old terminal makes you admire the grandeur that this place holds, and from here you can admire the fishing activity that is very popular in the area and something very characteristic.

>***Magangué es el hogar del Río Magdalena, el río más grande de Colombia, e ir a diario a pasar una tarde calurosa al terminal viejo, te hace admirar la grandeza que guarda este sitio, y desde aquí se puede admirar la actividad pesquera que es muy popular en la zona y algo muy característico.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\
>\n\nIf you visit this site, it's essential to see the \

Cathedral. This cathedral is one of the most popular in the entire country, thanks to its architecture and the beautiful sunsets that can be enjoyed here daily.\n\n>***Si visitas este sitio, es crucial conocer la catedral \

. Esta catedral es de las más populares en todo el país, por su arquitectura y su hermosa vista bajo los hermosos atardeceres que a diario se encuentran aquí.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/Ep1YNQNf9Rcqkj2mLH8vwpEGo6enqDd9hhFDiBDqCNSFVV5FsKXueqDA9zkNj5SmDt8.png)

<div class\
>\n\nOn January 31st, the town held its annual \

a celebration designed to boost the local economy and traditions. At the festival, visitors can admire a wide variety of local handicrafts that honor the culture and history of Magangué, serving as a personal brand for each of its inhabitants.\n\n>***El 31 de enero hubo en el pueblo el \

, que se celebra todos los años, para impulsar la economía y tradiciones que tiene este pueblo. En este festival, podemos admirar una alta variedad de productos artesanales locales que honran la cultura y la historia de Magangué, como una marca personal que acompaña a cada uno de los habitantes de este lugar.***

For example, this beautiful painting I'm sharing here. And since I had the opportunity to speak with the artist, he told me that the painting represents Magangué of the past, a place that could be admired in all its spectacular glory. With the current construction there, this has been overshadowed over time, making it a glimpse of the town's natural and architectural splendor. It's somewhat regrettable that this view, as depicted in the painting, is no longer there, thanks to the current political climate.

>***Por ejemplo, este hermoso cuadro que aquí comparto. Y como tuve la oportunidad de hablar con el artista responsable, este me contó que el cuadro representa el Magangué pasado, aquel que se podía admirar de manera espectacular, y con las actuales obras que allí se encuentran esto se ha ido opacando con el pasar de tiempo, siendo este un guiño de la gloria natural y arquitectónica. Es un poco lamentable que ya hoy en día esta mirada que muestra el cuadro ya no esté, gracias a la intervención política que se encuentra hoy.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

>

Among the wide variety of artisanal products at this festival, I must confess I succumbed to the allure of alcohol. Licores Magey is a local artisanal liquor brand that is, to say the least, delicious. I bought a bottle of Ginger Liqueur, a flavor I had never tried in alcohol before, and I still keep the bottle as a lovely memento of that day.

>***Entre la gran variedad de productos artesanales que hubo en este festival, debo contar que caí en las garras del alcohol. Licores Magey es una marca de licor artesanal local muy delicioso para no decir más. Yo compré una botella de Licor de Jengibre, un sabor que no había probado en alcohol, actualmente conservo la botella como un lindo recuerdo de este día.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EpT79VHRgP2QZpQ6xJKKMwndwmgj6RjdSwdCLhB7im2V75keaySrhSTUC4RjT7mSrxd.png)

<div class\

>

I'm from Barquisimeto, known as the twilight city, with sunsets of varied colors, and I've always said that Magangué has nothing to envy my city; this town truly has a mesmerizing magic every day, undoubtedly one of my favorite places.

>***Yo soy de Barquisimeto, conocida como la ciudad crepuscular, con atardeceres variados en colores, y siempre he dicho que Magangué no tiene nada que envidiar a mi ciudad, este pueblo de verdad tiene una magia hipnotizante cada día, sin duda de mis lugares favoritos.***

<center>

![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

</center>

<div class=\

> And finally, I want to say that this place has given me the opportunity to start a business selling desserts and tequeños, and I'm very grateful for the support I receive from the people of Magangué. Thanks to them, I've had the chance, for the first time, to start a business that I truly love. Even though I'm in Venezuela, I have customers there who still write to me to ask when I'm coming back, to keep buying from me and supporting me. I've definitely been a lucky guy in Colombia, and obviously, I'll be back soon. >***Y para finalizar, quiero contar que este lugar me ha dado la oportunidad de emprender con postres y tequeños, y estoy muy agradecido por el apoyo que me dan las personas de Magangué, porque gracias a ellos he tenido la oportunidad por primera vez de emprender en algo que es totalmente de mi agrado. Aunque estoy en Venezuela, tengo clientes allá que aún me escriben para saber cuando vuelvo, para seguir comprándome y apoyándome, sin duda he sido un chamo con suerte en Colombia, y obviamente, pronto volveré.***
![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)
***GOOD KITTEN VIBES*** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/23wWwEen4BsUivVpRLtu3H3DLC4hg3u5x2Ewi5Lo9HQ3NDRm6XpYvGMJzdbSCa8zZxzCx.png)
![IMG-20230909-WA0010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/culebro/EonosK9htPi7qwPGjS5zrY6stuEZAAChBap5CJDbgn1v4ThLrvoLEonRCoyGPMkoVTr.jpg)

body.title: Pizza A Slice of Madness Brawl Report: 5th Place!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQXxxnCtPvmQQ4Q8Kfq6gXmBbDvSFcdttfV4fCuSg2FUZ/image.png)

Greetings to all Splinterlands players and hive gaming community! This is my report for Pizza A Slice of Madness brawl. We are a guild that plays for fun, competitions and rewards. We play in the weekly guild brawls where we fight with other guilds for the fun challenge and rewards. This is our battle report for the week.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Overall Guild Rank: Fifth Place***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVKN4FZEqY4VCFa8iZ8UraXnmRBSe39DJ1skqxKf3pPPT/image.png)

After our first place rank last week, we're in a more modest ranking in this week's brawl in fifth place. We were not able to sustain our performance and finished in a much lower position than the week before. We had 73 wins while fourth and third place guilds both had 75 and 76 wins respectively. Note that they both had more losses than us indicating that they joined more frays. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Top Brawl Participants*** 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRHJFa6wHA1DHKzYkNQcp45XpTFvsHysszvRx1gtfg1sH/image.png)

I had an outstanding brawl, tied in 2nd to 4th place in our guild's top brawl participants. I had a 7-1 win loss record that contributed to our efforts. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Selected Games***

Here I present two of the games that I won.

**Game 1**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeMuwz8uDWy91LiBE5TRAdsRcKHiTRBM4NgqrjRk9Zy6i/image.png)

The first game saw a Water vs Water game. It had an Equalizer modifier so my strategy was to put as many cards as I can without sacrificing attacking power. I decided to put two cards with no attack to take attacks. Then a two mana gladiator card was next. The main attacker was in last place, Mystic Scaleweaver was my trump card with four magic attack. My opponent only used two cards that put him at a disadvantage. They spent time killing my tanks while my attackers were unbothered. All units had seven life at the start of the game and they only killed one of my cards.

Game link: https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_FF6IvT5JJLLcTvfXh4zg?ref=iamchessguy



**Game 2**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRCwtd4L2nhvpmdizq9Sp4xm5bT3h3YUgomJLvzdz2zou/image.png)

Game 2 had an Explosive Weaponry modifier. I had a common gladiator while my opponent had a legendary one. I thought at first that I was going to lose but my team was faster and killed my opponent units before they can attack. In addition, my opponent did not have a Deflect skill against Blast. These were the edges I needed and won the game.  

Game link: https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_S3FwUj0ULTcY8GuNsK0g?ref=iamchessguy



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Spending the Rewards***

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYgFWrGCNXwrmfiJ4QSU2oGspTW4wHCFpGWaFYpq2frat/image.png)


I bought two packs again and got one epic card. I like to get more legendary cards but an epic is also good. This card is strong position two card with Reach skill. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)



***Conclusion***

We earned 3,556 merits and 26 SPS from the brawl. The reward is generous that we get just from joining and playing brawls. With regular brawls, it adds to my weekly SPS stake. I'm grateful to the Pizza guild for accepting me as a member and gave me a regular spot to join the brawls and earn rewards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***Join a Guild***

If you are a player with few cards in your deck. Join a guild that can assist you to grow in Splinterlands. You can join brawls to earn SPS, enjoy reward multipliers and shop discounts. Since joining a guild, I'm adding my cards by buying from the shop and the market. This makes the game more fun and add progression. If you're not a guild member yet, now is the time to find one.

As a guild member do your part by having the right cards and showing up in the fray you have joined in brawls. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2x6Ui9aG1QMGHoD3weawfV1T5BYM5zeZsQXcA7rXqTb/image.png)

***My Referrals***

If this post interests you and you are not playing Splinterlands yet, please consider joining this wonderful game using my referral.

https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=iamchessguy

Be active. Walk or run and earn afit tokens! Join me at actifit.io

https://actifit.io/signup?referrer=chessguy-actifit

body.title: 🌿 Building My Life One Step at a Time
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPiiKfkzUhxCeJuFkTehDaTpek9DPLCEjEUKt9w1YTbsd/IMG_5996.jpg 


Sometimes people see confidence and assume the journey was easy.

What they don’t see are the long nights, the difficult decisions, the sacrifices, and the moments of doubt that came before the growth.

As a lawyer and a single mother, I’ve learned that life rarely follows the plans we make. There have been unexpected turns, challenges that tested my strength, and days when simply getting through everything felt like an achievement.

But every challenge has taught me something valuable.

It taught me how to stand on my own feet.
It taught me how to trust myself.
And most importantly, it taught me that resilience is built one day at a time.

Looking at this photo, I’m reminded that growth is often quiet. It doesn’t always happen in dramatic moments. Sometimes it happens in ordinary days when you choose to keep moving forward, even when no one is watching.

I may not have everything figured out, but I’m proud of the woman I’m becoming. Strong enough to face challenges, independent enough to create my own path, and grateful enough to appreciate every lesson along the way.

The journey continues, and I’m ready for whatever comes next. ✨

# Tags

#lawyerlife #singlemom #independentwoman #selfgrowth #confidence #womenempowerment #lifejourney

body.title: 23 May 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3112: I am the owner
body.body:
/>

Capt. R.E. Ludlow expected five-year-old Lil' Robert Ludlow to get up and have milk with coffee with him, and of course snuggle right down in his lap and go to sleep, any day and every day. Sometimes seven-year-old Amanda also got up and joined – “I don't want any coffee, but I hear from Rob that the snuggling is elite,” she said one day, and had her grandparents going in and out of fits of laughter all day about these two little Ludlows who knew how to use elite in a sentence more or less correctly, that early in the morning! Six-year-old Grayson's mastering the vocabulary to win the first-grade prize for the Lofton County Virtual Spelling Bee had several aftereffects!

Meeting ten-year-old Andrew, who tended to sit up late and be thinking even after going to bed, was a surprise after tucking Lil' Robert and Amanda back into their beds.

“So I had a question, Papa, about today,” he said.

“Well, did you want some milk with some coffee?” Capt. Ludlow purred with a smile.

“I think I just need some water, because I'm probably going back to bed,” Andrew said. “But I need to know: how are you going to feel tomorrow when you hear about 'The Ludlow Bubbly,' and you are still the Ludlow, but you can't say 'I am the owner'?”

Capt. Ludlow thought about this.

“Well, I don't walk around saying that anyhow,” he said. “I don't think I've ever started or ended a conversation that way. I kind of lean on what we have in common: the Ludlow part.”

Andrew considered this with a smile.

“Well, yeah, that is the strong part, Papa,” he said, and gratefully received a tousling of his sandy brown hair from his grandfather. “And I know your favorite title is Papa. I was just asking because Eleanor and I were reading abut business people and how proud they are to own stuff while other people don't, and after tomorrow you won't be able to say that any more.”

“Here is the problem, grandson: comparison. If you can't have what you have and let go of what you have unless you check and see what somebody else has or doesn't have, you are in a trap you built yourself.”

“Oh,” Andrew said. “I was just checking because a lot of those people didn't come out well.”

“Of course not,” Capt. Ludlow said. “Trying to play God compared to other people does not end well.”

“Oh, is that what's going on with racism, sexism, and classism too?” Andrew said.

Capt. Ludlow heard half his bloodline shrieking at him from beyond the grave – and cut the line anyhow.

“Yes, it's all coming from people like me wanting to feel more like God than people like our friends and business partners – and that is encouraged by Satan, who wants to replace God. It's all going to fail. Now, there may be ways we choose to live and choose not to live that we see others adopting or are part of their culture. There may be things out of our family or national or ethnic heritage we want to preserve. But we do not have the right – and I say this as a recovering, born-and-raised racist and sexist and classist, blue-blood to the core – to presume we are just better than everyone else and that our way should be imposed on everyone else. That's God's right only – and even He is allowing people to be different from one another and come to Christ as He calls them, and stay different, still. Since He likes variety, and since we are supposed to conform to Christ only, we better get to liking it.”

“Is that harder for you because you were kinda old when we watched you figure this out?” Andrew said.

“Well, in the Army I had it, because I had to focus on the unit,” he said, “and then Grandma really is having no foolishness out of me, being the liberal San Franciscan she is. Is it naturally harder? Sometimes … but I also grew up on the mountain for half my childhood with my Lee-of-the-mountain grandmother and all her friends and their children, and it never was a problem there. But, yes, Andrew, I grew up in a time in which continuing the lines of men like me being better than all women and everyone else not like me was the expectation and not pushed back on openly until 1974. I was almost a grown man by then, because civil rights came really late to Lofton County. So, I've gone back and forth, depending largely on whether I was thinking straight, or not – but I am done wobbling. I have learned my lesson. Christ flatly forbids me to raise you as I was raised, which means no more wobbling for me. But it begins, grandson, no matter who anyone is, with refusing the temptation of pride and comparison.”

“Is this also why you will not allow us to be getting mad over little comparison type of things and picking on each other and fighting?” Andrew said.

“Yes,” Capt. Ludlow said. “That's natural human nature and in adulthood it goes on under many guises, but it is like I tell you: we are one family, and we had to fight to be together, so we're not going to mess it up fighting each other. There is also one big family in the world: the human family, so we're not going fight different humans just because they look different or believe different things except if self-defense is needed. We're also in the family of God, and God will not have His children out here fighting each other when the job is to represent Him so well other people want to be adopted into the family.”

“That stuff works, too, because Glendella came right down the road looking for us and hasn't even thought about going back,” Andrew said. “She fit right in and loves us and we love her.”

“That's the whole idea, demonstrated at our level,” Capt. Ludlow said. “And I do not have to be a big businessman tomorrow to live in the wonder of all of that – that's enough, and a blessing beyond comparison.”

“Thanks, Papa,” Andrew said. “I can go back to sleep now. Understanding is like a big, soft blanket for my brain.”

“Let me just wrap it for you, nice and tight,” Capt. Ludlow said, and smiled as he glimpsed his grandson's pre-hug grin before giving his grandson a big hug.

맑은 샘물 흐르며

별빛의 꿈을 노래해.

산과 들을 감싸고,  
모든 생명에 스며들어

사랑을 피워내리.

body.title: 抗单车的美女
body.body:
![IMG_20260508_113900.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZKvnw3d18qJhka3WnFvQi66cHyZ3MqQrodDnHfpQTKBy/IMG_20260508_113900.jpg)
姐妹说物美超市晚上有打折活动，然而我当时只听了这句，忽略了八点后哈哈哈哈哈，买了些凉皮还有小零食就出来了，没有多点VIP，也没啥优惠

​

超市门口就是马路，还有个红绿灯🚥，我走在辅路上，抬头看见骑单车的美女正在过十字路口，想着自己赶不上这趟绿灯，就慢悠悠的走着，还没走两步，马路正中间的美女下单车了，在那里不知道干什么

​

心里有点儿好奇，走到十字路口时，对方还在那里捣鼓，也看见了美女的民族风长裙被搅拌到单车里了，她在想办法拽出来，可能越急越出错，一直没成功，红绿灯从绿变成了红灯，马路上开过来的车子陆续停了下来

​

美女貌似更急了，扭头看了一圈，也不管裙子了，直接把单车给扛起来，匆匆卖过十字路口，哈哈哈哈哈哈好逗，给我看笑了

​

她看着大概170的样子，双手一提单车，有种扛起来的感觉，裙子好长，还穿着平底鞋，走到对面辅路才重新和裙子单车奋斗😂

​

生活处处有惊喜啊！美女的裙子也好好看，没看出是哪个少数民族的，好时髦(别说即使停车等着看美女的时间也很养眼呢

​ps今天在liketu上无法选择中文社区了，心痛

**感谢阅读！祝你阖家安康！财源滚滚🤑**

body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
***

> The winter air in Budapest has a bitter chill that takes your breath away, but as I stepped into that covered market, the cold dissolved into a mist of aromas that promised refuge. My steps, still unsteady from the fatigue of the journey, led me to a stall whose table was adorned with a pink floral tablecloth reminiscent of the region’s traditional embroidery. It was there that my eyes fell upon a metal vessel overflowing with dark, golden and vibrant colours.
# ***
The Feast of the Ancestors in the Heart of Budapest
*** In the centre of the dish, planted like a victory flag, a small pink pennant read: *“Disznótoros Tál”*. I was mesmerised by the musicality of those words I couldn’t quite decipher. “Jó napot!” greeted the waiter, a man with large hands and a warm smile. “Fancy a feast, my friend?” “I’m tempted, but I’m even more intrigued by the name,” I replied, pointing to the pennant. “What language is this, and what secret does that message hold? It sounds to me like an ancient spell.” The man let out a hearty laugh that echoed amongst the spice stalls. “It’s Hungarian, or *magyar*, as we say. It’s not a spell, though for the stomach, it might well be, my friend.” *“Disznótoros Tál”* literally means “Pig Slaughter Platter”. It’s a tradition in our villages; when the cold weather arrives, the community gathers, shares the work and celebrates abundance. What you have before you is the history of my country served on a platter.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPzq3WEXyzxkknaCCLXjV8Yi7k6pKPthNaqmgJuJMt5sj/freew.jpg) [Image of the initiative, courtesy of @wakeupkitty](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freewritehouse/EoptpDUg9xH32RQw1PkHnmV1mEn4XgbLmg5BCqexYwehQeovTFMRgoabQUMeD8fwGex.jpg)
He explained to me, pointing to each item with pride, that what I saw as simple sausages were in fact *májas hurka* (liver sausage) and *véres hurka* (blood sausage), accompanied by the iconic *kolbász*, that red, spicy sausage that is the soul of Hungary. As I sat down, the sight was a spectacle. I studied the composition of the dish with interest: *the two dark, almost black sausages, with their crisp, glossy skins, flanked a bed of stewed red cabbage that looked like dark velvet. The potatoes, browned to perfection, peeked out from between the yellow and red peppers, stuffed with fermented cabbage that added a touch of visual freshness*. What a marvellous dish! I felt a mixture of awe and admiration. As I took my first bite of the Hungarian sausage, the smoked paprika—the famous *paprika*—exploded in my mouth, warm and deep. But the real surprise was the *véres hurka*. As I broke through the casing, the filling was creamy, spiced with a delicacy I hadn’t expected from such a rustic dish. The contrast was perfect; the rich, comforting fat of the meat met the sharp tang of the *savanyúság* (pickled vegetables), cleansing the palate and preparing it for the next feast. As I ate, the waiter approached again. ‘Can you feel the heat of the stove in your blood?’ he asked. ‘I feel as though I’ve just come home, even though I’ve never been here before,’ I replied honestly. That afternoon I realised I was savouring centuries of history, of long winters and joy, of sharing what the earth offers across the globe. I left the market with a satisfied soul and the taste of *paprika* still dancing on my lips, keeping in my memory that little pink flag which, more than a menu, turned out to be an invitation to the heart of a village. I’m sure that when I return to Europe, I’ll visit those places again. *** ***
##
Come ɑnd pɑɾticipɑte becɑuse γou still hɑve time… #
[A Pictuɾe Is Woɾth A Thousɑnd Woɾds](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@freewritehouse/a-picture-is-worth-a-thousand-words-tf43zb)
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.steempeak.com/file/steempeak/freewritehouse/pWnSxYsV-A20picture20is20worth.jpg Cover of the initiative.
*** ***
🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆****🔆
## I am dedicated to all those who contribute daily to make our planet ɑ a better world.
*** ***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZBwqobe8b8c61GkPFacLNQsR4BSQ1uw1cf1yooraumzc/avatar512.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif)
*** *** ***

> El aire de Budapest en invierno tiene un filo gélido que corta la respiración, pero al entrar en aquel mercado cubierto, el frío se disolvió en una neblina de aromas que prometían refugio. Mis pasos, todavía torpes por el cansancio del viaje, me llevaron frente a un puesto cuya mesa estaba adornada con un mantel de flores rosadas que recordaba al bordado folclórico de la región. Fue allí donde mis ojos se toparon con una vasija metálica que rebosaba de colores oscuros, dorados y vibrantes.
# ***
El Festín de los Ancestros en el Corazón de Budapest
*** En el centro del plato, clavado como una bandera de victoria, un pequeño banderín rosa rezaba: *“Disznótoros Tál”*. Me quedé hipnotizado por la musicalidad de esas palabras que no lograba descifrar. —*Jó napot!* —saludó el camarero, un hombre de manos grandes y sonrisa franca—. ¿Le tienta el banquete, amigo? —Me tienta, pero me intriga más el nombre —respondí, señalando el banderín—. ¿Qué idioma es este y qué secreto guarda ese mensaje? Me suena a un antiguo conjuro. El hombre soltó una carcajada que resonó entre los puestos de especias. —Es húngaro, o *magyar*, como decimos nosotros. No es un conjuro, aunque para el estómago, bien podría serlo, amigo mío. *“Disznótoros Tál”* significa literalmente *\

*. Es una tradición de nuestros pueblos; cuando llega el frío, la comunidad se reúne, se comparte el trabajo y se celebra la abundancia. Lo que tiene frente a usted es la historia de mi país servida en una fuente.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPzq3WEXyzxkknaCCLXjV8Yi7k6pKPthNaqmgJuJMt5sj/freew.jpg) [Imagen de la iniciativa, cortesía de @wakeupkitty](https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/freewritehouse/EoptpDUg9xH32RQw1PkHnmV1mEn4XgbLmg5BCqexYwehQeovTFMRgoabQUMeD8fwGex.jpg)
Me explicó, señalando cada elemento con orgullo, que lo que yo veía como simples embutidos eran en realidad la *májas hurka* (morcilla de hígado) y la *véres hurka* (morcilla de sangre), acompañadas de la emblemática *kolbász*, esa salchicha roja y especiada que es el alma de Hungría. Al sentarme, la vista era un espectáculo. Observé la arquitectura del plato con interés: *las dos morcillas oscuras, casi negras, de piel crujiente y brillante, custodiaban un lecho de repollo morado estofado que parecía terciopelo oscuro. Las patatas, doradas a la perfección, asomaban entre los pimientos amarillos y rojos, rellenos de col fermentada que aportaban un toque de frescura visual*. ¡Qué plato tan maravilloso! Sentí una mezcla de reverencia y admiración. Al dar el primer bocado a la salchicha húngara, el pimentón ahumado —el famoso *paprika*— estalló en mi boca, cálido y profundo. Pero la verdadera sorpresa fue la *véres hurka*. Al romper su piel, el relleno era cremoso, especiado con una delicadeza que no esperaba de un plato tan rústico. El contraste era perfecto, la grasa rica y reconfortante de la carne se encontraba con la acidez punzante de los *savanyúság* (los vegetales encurtidos), limpiando el paladar y preparándolo para el siguiente festín. Mientras comía, el camarero se acercó de nuevo. —¿Siente el calor de la estufa en la sangre? —preguntó. —Siento que acabo de llegar a casa, aunque nunca antes haya estado aquí —respondí con sinceridad. Aquella tarde comprendí que estaba masticando siglos de historia, de inviernos largos y de alegría, de compartir lo que la tierra ofrece a lo largo del planeta. Me retiré del mercado con el alma satisfecha y el sabor del *paprika* aún bailando en mis labios, guardando en mi memoria aquel banderín rosa que, más que un menú, resultó ser una invitación al corazón de un pueblo. De seguro, cuando regrese a Europa, visitaré nuevamente esos parajes. *** ***
##
Ven a participar, aún estás a tiempo… #

body.body:
![Bitcoin's V-Shaped Recovery](https://ipfs.io/ipfs/Qmc4p4Gt1JAWXDn26XGMD8PDNJMTi4s7j9ZsTgLb8grrpw)

# Bitcoin Surges Back From $74K as Iran Peace Deal Ignites Crypto Rally

**May 23, 2026 —** In one of the most dramatic single-day reversals in recent crypto history, Bitcoin staged a powerful comeback Saturday after tumbling to its lowest level since April 20. The cryptocurrency, which briefly dipped to $74,305 amid mounting ETF outflows and escalating Middle East tensions, rebounded sharply to $76,700+ following President Trump's announcement of a negotiated peace agreement with Iran.

The turnaround underscores just how sensitive crypto markets remain to geopolitical developments — and how quickly sentiment can flip when the threat of supply disruption fades.

## The Plunge: ETF Outflows and Geopolitical Fear

Earlier Saturday, Bitcoin had shed roughly 4% from its recent range, falling to $74,305 — a level not seen since April 20. The selloff was driven by two converging pressures:

**Massive ETF redemptions.** U.S.-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs have bled more than $2.26 billion over the past two weeks, with a staggering $1.26 billion withdrawn this week alone — the largest single-week outflow since January. The previous week saw roughly $1 billion in redemptions as well. This sustained institutional pullback has been a persistent headwind, particularly as Treasury yields climbed and traditional fixed-income assets regained their appeal.

**Iran conflict fears.** Speculative money has been flooding into commodities like oil, copper, and sulfur as markets priced in potential supply disruptions through the Strait of Hormuz. Bitcoin, caught in the broader risk-off environment, was left behind as investors fled to safer havens.

## The Reversal: Peace Deal Announcement

The mood shifted almost overnight when President Trump took to Truth Social late Saturday afternoon, writing: *\

*

The news sent Bitcoin surging from the $74,300 lows back above $76,700 within minutes. The V-shaped recovery was a textbook example of geopolitical risk premium evaporating in real time — and crypto markets reacting with characteristic speed.

## Broader Market Context

Beyond the headline geopolitical drama, several other developments are shaping the crypto landscape:

**Bitcoin vs. Traditional Assets.** Former Credit Suisse CIO Mark Connors argues that Bitcoin has broken out of its longest-ever stretch of underperformance against the S&P 500, which ended in early May. With persistent inflation and a \

interest rate environment pressuring bonds, Connors sees BTC positioned to outperform stocks, bonds, and gold once again.

**Altcoin Momentum.** Hyperliquid (HYPE) crossed $50 for the first time since September, while AI-focused crypto tokens are drawing renewed interest. Trader Michael van de Poppe sees these as signals of a broader return of risk appetite across the altcoin market.

**Regulatory Developments.** The Clarity Act continues to generate debate, with proponents arguing its restrictions on yield-bearing crypto products could actually spur innovation in AI-driven compliant yield infrastructure. Meanwhile, Congress has launched an insider trading probe into prediction markets Polymarket and Kalshi.

**Fed Transition.** Kevin Warsh was sworn in as the new Federal Reserve chairman, marking a significant shift in monetary policy leadership at a critical moment for risk assets.

## What's Next?

Bitcoin currently trades around $74,326 — still roughly 10% below its May 6 high of $82,500. Technical analysts point to $77,000 as the next key resistance level, with some models targeting $82,979 by late May if momentum holds.

The Iran peace deal provides a near-term tailwind, but the structural question remains: can Bitcoin reclaim its recent highs while ETF outflows continue and Treasury yields stay elevated? The answer will likely depend on whether the geopolitical relief proves durable — or if new risks emerge to test this fragile recovery.

For now, the crypto market is breathing easier. But as Saturday's whipsaw proved, in today's environment, calm can turn to chaos and back again within hours.

body.title: It is necessary to nurture the worthy, and ...
body.body:
>

>Destroy the predator... Trust as a couple is one of the topics that generates the most debate, and I understand why. Look, we live in an age where stories of betrayal are everywhere and where protecting yourself emotionally is easily mistaken for wisdom. But there is a huge difference between choosing someone wisely and entering a relationship already expecting them to fail you. The first is emotional intelligence, the second is a wound that is still active directing decisions that should be made from another place, watch out for that... Ya!!! I had to live it, at least one learns from this. This is one of my personal mottos. We don't always decide what will happen in our lives, hopefully we try to choose how to deal with it. And my starting point with EVERYTHING is how can I learn from what happened to me? Especially of those things that I do not enjoy in any link that may be with the relationship of couple, family, with friends... There are times when we take advantage of events that seemed unfortunate and we say “everything happens for a reason”, but there are terrible things that I think should never have happened, but even in those cases I think that if we have already had to live it, have the experience, the best way to reduce its damage or impact is by learning from it. Even though learning does not erase the pain, but allows it to become useful, fruitful, nourished, and not sterile. And if we look at it correctly, EVERYTHING TEACHES, and everything is learned. We may even learn how not to do something, or what we should do so that it does not happen again. Today, if you have to face challenges or difficulties, allow yourself to ask the question, what can I learn from this? No one heals in the same place where they broke up pretending that everything is fine. I think I'm not the only one who wants to live in peace, start a family and live with the love of my life for the rest of my life? It's not that hard, the hard thing is to really connect with someone. Because although trusting is not a guarantee of anything, it is a decision that is made knowing that the other is human, that they can make mistakes, and that if something goes wrong you have the internal solidity to handle it. *Love is not forced. It is sustained with security, presence and deservedness*. If there is anything more beautiful than to love, it is to be loved while you love. There are people who love you when everything is easy, and accompany us when only at parties. And there are people who choose you when it hurts, when you tremble, when you make a mistake. I invite you, to look for the second ones, because they support you even in the storm. Janitze 🌹

ENGLISH VERSION (click here!) Hello, travelers from around the world. ![InShot_20260522_183245530.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbZsCmuYdykLNbJVXFxuGCiF5s7LTmAuNJCJyr1kAYgsM/InShot_20260522_183245530.jpg) After our disappointment in the city of Mérida and not being able to ride the cable car, we set off on a new path toward a different destination. But surrounded by mountains and pleasant weather, our last day in Mérida began to look promising. We arrived at the Sacred Forest or, as I call it, the Enchanted Forest located in El Valle, very close to the La Culata Paramo. ![20260404_100301.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSMxZY1S1N1HT7V6ckZvk66mFcGCGRTCRtbD1sZsHz4kZ/20260404_100301.jpg) ![20260404_100426.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVnD5qv1z9VW7oJFg1gHuw3xpXfJ71JPBpUBs3ji9Web/20260404_100426.jpg) ![20260404_100459.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR77TNZ53VcWaUoGMgjvY1wgcDpJSYmRh9uhPpUHa9s2o/20260404_100459.jpg) ![20260404_100904.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme2G24NF5rNzKwAYCTcG4jcgcTqr9CHrC3fFthXkdq1M6/20260404_100904.jpg) We found out that we were supposed to have booked a visit in advance, but after telling one of the owners that we hadn’t been able to ride the cable car, we somehow touched his heart, and he let us join a group that was about to enter the forest in a few minutes. The cost for the tour was $5 per person; we paid $10 since there were two of us. ![20260404_101155.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW7qdSSp1RvNkxBqJnGeuHwSXHhJqMjms2iZXcEX5hVqL/20260404_101155.jpg) ![20260404_101930.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaevNwjHUguEmsw1XKm8sDtYcRmszqRmjUXYhqLZrJpA4/20260404_101930.jpg) ![20260404_101959.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma9muw8qRrGCiD8cxCYRbhwiuQF1rPEu1fCTLXHcbCB24/20260404_101959.jpg) Before entering the Sacred Forest, its creator and historian William Marcano, a graduate of the University of the Andes, gave us a brief overview of how, for the past 9 years, he has been carving living trees in the forest on his land. At that time, he had no intention of showing them to the public; it wasn’t meant as art, but rather he wanted to give each tree a certain identity to connect with them, since trees are pure energy. ![20260404_102440.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUoqpfSsJ673iBuwURmXfSjcA84yzwKG5Qap1TU6vuV7r/20260404_102440.jpg) He made all the carvings during the waning moon, when the sap of the trees concentrates in the roots. First, he asked each tree for permission, felt the energy, and once he sensed acceptance (when his skin no longer prickled), Mr. Marcano peeled back the bark and made each carving superficially into the sapwood. Over the years, the tree regenerated itself, giving the appearance of a hole, though none was actually made; some carvings took approximately six months. ![20260404_103150.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ9ZUP7aZmkzSH3nsBVTSincB8YinWPprGJQ6RwSwBe2U/20260404_103150.jpg) After his brief introduction, our tour of the Sacred Forest formally began, with the group walking one behind the other along a path. Upon entering, we were greeted by the image of a goblin on one of the first carved trees; it wasn’t just the trees that had identities the rocks did too. ![20260404_102452.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP11zuX9BqWnsHAbCqcXgBkueN7NS46pLdfVM7uaHZK2E/20260404_102452.jpg) ![20260404_102505.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNNoo4N1XvjJMJgMMM8xAetTV88BdUSw3EWj4pT9XfcVV/20260404_102505.jpg) ![20260404_102543.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSYGqsUD4sPoBEjJLxcQrG5i2J6H2Lf295SpjMaekzPMy/20260404_102543.jpg) ![20260404_102737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbjKzYzPVacBQr25PczwcZ5gGcHTAgLGoqGneqF3AopLM/20260404_102737.jpg) ![20260404_102754.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZPAWhgEaKZHwYvLjJunmUzcCGXyR628JEkEwHCsCYkZp/20260404_102754.jpg) ![20260404_102812.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWyLNsxC2eKNw7HEiQGYfsr2W3rphpGxiHgfczkvyTqcM/20260404_102812.jpg) ![20260404_110804.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSmwHJiUEqfhyghWgA6m6xcJWK1xhEtmXmQZKCSiGFdtE/20260404_110804.jpg) As I examined each carving in detail, I was surprised by how real these faces looked; it was as if they were emerging from inside the trees, and it felt as though they were staring straight into your eyes. One of them reminded me of an old sorcerer. ![20260404_110712.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc9c6guNPaXNwFhk3D41emW7Tx8ZNn5qG6BvT7XQ4MfcR/20260404_110712.jpg) ![20260404_102847.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXP1VqeRLxQjVFHtL9dDfHA5oz4UrLpGrtv5RnTvQxPsc/20260404_102847.jpg) ![20260404_102833.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2tpdv9n5TpdCdhKypDmjCn6pHX2roQVjMTegUXASzy6/20260404_102833.jpg) ![20260404_102911.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4jyfn98LaR24QcecSNfq5DpzpjSuDcyTczD2WcM8V62/20260404_102911.jpg) We made our way through the forest, and my skin crawled when I saw some shamans, indigenous people, Chief Guaicapuro, Native Americans, and even a Buddha—but my favorite was Momoy, the protector of nature, and I took a photo with him. ![20260404_102955.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT1ZvimCcjYYJ68CfFTPaSAECxdgezGepTXd9aPH5pFVT/20260404_102955.jpg) ![20260404_103141.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWCGa7jqTnB8snmwrhjzenVPkAAXsu8uCV3PU5KNfKFAB/20260404_103141.jpg) ![20260404_103156.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV2QafEv6eW2dfYUHkLR7ywAq9czEgfGfYbZ2udYMDbKy/20260404_103156.jpg) ![20260404_103405.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd8Y1eh7NNjgj8N8NdHN2Ua8qWRQqYifDDfUqfzR1uxpr/20260404_103405.jpg) ![20260404_103915.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfM5DMvKXRxnEjhin994V99HUpov1y5fHFnKau2injdkR/20260404_103915.jpg) ![20260404_103947.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYZWyZFo4gyrgujyreim5XT78DJQ5g3k28g8K8YvD1kTG/20260404_103947.jpg) ![20260404_103958.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTFE3wBAASxQhQmqwMwins9DaZxJunXKpJCUhVHogAKXg/20260404_103958.jpg) --- Photos taken with a Samsung Galaxy A35. Collage created in [Inshot](https://v.inshot.com/invite) Content owned by me. Translation by: [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com/es/translator)

>

Hola viajeros de todo el mundo.

![InShot_20260522_183245530.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbZsCmuYdykLNbJVXFxuGCiF5s7LTmAuNJCJyr1kAYgsM/InShot_20260522_183245530.jpg)

Luego de nuestra decepción en la ciudad de Mérida y no poder subir el teleférico emprendimos un nuevo camino hacia un sitio distinto, pero entre montañas y un clima agradable nuestro último día en Mérida empezó a pintarse bonito, llegamos al Bosque Sagrado o como yo le llamo Bosque Encantado, ubicado en El Valle muy cerca del Parámo La Culata.

![20260404_100301.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSMxZY1S1N1HT7V6ckZvk66mFcGCGRTCRtbD1sZsHz4kZ/20260404_100301.jpg)

![20260404_100426.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYVnD5qv1z9VW7oJFg1gHuw3xpXfJ71JPBpUBs3ji9Web/20260404_100426.jpg)

![20260404_100459.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR77TNZ53VcWaUoGMgjvY1wgcDpJSYmRh9uhPpUHa9s2o/20260404_100459.jpg)

![20260404_100904.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme2G24NF5rNzKwAYCTcG4jcgcTqr9CHrC3fFthXkdq1M6/20260404_100904.jpg)

Nos encontramos con el panorama de que debíamos agendar previamente una visita, pero luego de comentarle a uno de sus dueños que no habíamos podido ingresar al teleférico, de cierto modo tocamos parte de su corazón y nos permitieron acceder con un grupo que ingresaría al bosque en los siguientes minutos, el costo para hacer el recorrido fue de 5$ por persona, nosotros cancelamos 10$ ya que eramos dos.

![20260404_101155.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW7qdSSp1RvNkxBqJnGeuHwSXHhJqMjms2iZXcEX5hVqL/20260404_101155.jpg)

![20260404_101930.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaevNwjHUguEmsw1XKm8sDtYcRmszqRmjUXYhqLZrJpA4/20260404_101930.jpg)

![20260404_101959.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma9muw8qRrGCiD8cxCYRbhwiuQF1rPEu1fCTLXHcbCB24/20260404_101959.jpg)

Antes de ingresar al Bosque Sagrado, su creador e historiador William Marcano graduado de la Universidad de los Andes, nos hizó una breve reseña de como realizó desde hace 9 años en el bosque de sus tierras un tallado en los árboles vivos, en ese momento fue sin intención de mostrarlos al público, no como algo artístico sino que quiso darle de cierta forma una identidad a cada árbol para conectarse con ellos, ya que los árboles son energía pura.

![20260404_102440.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUoqpfSsJ673iBuwURmXfSjcA84yzwKG5Qap1TU6vuV7r/20260404_102440.jpg)

Todos los tallados los realizó con la luna en cuarto menguante cuando la sabia de los árboles se concentra en las raíces, primero le pidió permiso a cada árbol, sentía la energía y cuando ya había aceptación (que ya no se le erizaba la piel) el Sr. Marcano despegó la corteza y realizó cada tallado superficialmente en la albura y con los años el árbol creo su propia regeneración lo que le da una apariencia de como si hubiera hecho un agujero pero no fue así, algunos tallados demoraron 6 meses aproximadamente. 

![20260404_103150.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ9ZUP7aZmkzSH3nsBVTSincB8YinWPprGJQ6RwSwBe2U/20260404_103150.jpg)

Luego de su breve reseña inició formalmente nuestro recorrido por el Bosque Sagrado, donde el grupo íbamos uno detrás del otro en un sendero, al entrar nos recibió la imagen de un duende en uno de los primeros árboles tallados, no tenían identidad sólo los árboles también las rocas. 

![20260404_102452.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP11zuX9BqWnsHAbCqcXgBkueN7NS46pLdfVM7uaHZK2E/20260404_102452.jpg)

![20260404_102505.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNNoo4N1XvjJMJgMMM8xAetTV88BdUSw3EWj4pT9XfcVV/20260404_102505.jpg)

![20260404_102543.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSYGqsUD4sPoBEjJLxcQrG5i2J6H2Lf295SpjMaekzPMy/20260404_102543.jpg)

![20260404_102737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbjKzYzPVacBQr25PczwcZ5gGcHTAgLGoqGneqF3AopLM/20260404_102737.jpg)

![20260404_102754.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZPAWhgEaKZHwYvLjJunmUzcCGXyR628JEkEwHCsCYkZp/20260404_102754.jpg)

![20260404_102812.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWyLNsxC2eKNw7HEiQGYfsr2W3rphpGxiHgfczkvyTqcM/20260404_102812.jpg)

![20260404_110804.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSmwHJiUEqfhyghWgA6m6xcJWK1xhEtmXmQZKCSiGFdtE/20260404_110804.jpg)

Mientras observaba detalladamente cada tallado, me sorprendía lo reales que se veían estos rostros, era como si salieran de adentro de los árboles y daba una sensación de estarte mirando fijamente a los ojos, uno de ellos se me hizó parecido a un viejo hechicero.

![20260404_110712.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc9c6guNPaXNwFhk3D41emW7Tx8ZNn5qG6BvT7XQ4MfcR/20260404_110712.jpg)

![20260404_102847.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXP1VqeRLxQjVFHtL9dDfHA5oz4UrLpGrtv5RnTvQxPsc/20260404_102847.jpg)

![20260404_102833.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc2tpdv9n5TpdCdhKypDmjCn6pHX2roQVjMTegUXASzy6/20260404_102833.jpg)

![20260404_102911.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4jyfn98LaR24QcecSNfq5DpzpjSuDcyTczD2WcM8V62/20260404_102911.jpg)

Avanzabamos por el bosque y mi piel se erizaba al ver a algunos chamanes, indígenas, el Cacique Guaicapuro, indios nativos americanos, incluso un buda pero mi favorito fue el Momoy, el protector de la naturaleza y me tomé una foto con él. 

![20260404_102955.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT1ZvimCcjYYJ68CfFTPaSAECxdgezGepTXd9aPH5pFVT/20260404_102955.jpg)

![20260404_103141.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWCGa7jqTnB8snmwrhjzenVPkAAXsu8uCV3PU5KNfKFAB/20260404_103141.jpg)

![20260404_103156.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV2QafEv6eW2dfYUHkLR7ywAq9czEgfGfYbZ2udYMDbKy/20260404_103156.jpg)

![20260404_103405.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd8Y1eh7NNjgj8N8NdHN2Ua8qWRQqYifDDfUqfzR1uxpr/20260404_103405.jpg)

![20260404_103915.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfM5DMvKXRxnEjhin994V99HUpov1y5fHFnKau2injdkR/20260404_103915.jpg)

![20260404_103947.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYZWyZFo4gyrgujyreim5XT78DJQ5g3k28g8K8YvD1kTG/20260404_103947.jpg)

![20260404_103958.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTFE3wBAASxQhQmqwMwins9DaZxJunXKpJCUhVHogAKXg/20260404_103958.jpg)

![20260404_104048.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyc5HdXpViEgvknq7Phb8SU3ZULx4QWDUi7RyQ3CGTJL/20260404_104048.jpg)

![20260404_104127.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcA7NQ1RsLSUCQh235idtC5iRzLDmnqmfCfVYwLMABsYX/20260404_104127.jpg)

![20260404_104714.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWWkJPss4wvEEYrz5dLvDN9DCYaeZuWQ4KS8gKhS4RePM/20260404_104714.jpg)

![20260404_103237.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfDw9B6K1epRtCLcnw8ktPUV2wNSNbgNyS7eqsx2PafWx/20260404_103237.jpg)

![20260404_110129.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZMGbgcUjM44VbAysrpqj8TFE7fS1KbkwmmwTtPFY4MSw/20260404_110129.jpg)

Nuestro sendero del Bosque Sagrado terminó muy cerca del tallado de un alienígena donde había un hermoso río, provocaba darse un buen baño.

![20260404_104721.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSUK93BZqPgwmMDfhmSPQmzJqA8wGDJYcHEnfSeAowiGN/20260404_104721.jpg)

![20260404_105317.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeygh2Bi8tLW7UPW8Yqs1Bg2xnZTJWNmyL4wGJmrZBfPD/20260404_105317.jpg)

![20260404_105503.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX5AyasJTCrui361Ey41MFDNjgdyghK18pLsTJqjgoPju/20260404_105503.jpg)

Para finalizar el paseo regresamos a la casa de los dueños y paseamos un rato por su jardín donde habían algunas flores como hortensias y otras muy curiosas que eran muy lindas y estaban colgando.

![20260404_105740.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWGhgBCHvGcfTbB9e6YN3oWkXh3c1qWXSBx7c5v9ybeV7/20260404_105740.jpg)

![20260404_111011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjLLvzS61rD1oJ2WekMMNPFSBgAH2rYmsSgrVnHCTdcD/20260404_111011.jpg)

![20260404_111059.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNZguTkM4mwEYV6tncwiRKoLNWfRhkxiNPZDah4ojmg1y/20260404_111059.jpg)

![20260404_111128.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT9ynqr8QMDQggu2jiLQvMg3JSgBserkHp3fgPLwzkngu/20260404_111128.jpg)

![20260404_111146.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbieMRnFiAqYBp46RDyKXru2x8HAJzhu4xxUpktdnJz6P/20260404_111146.jpg)

Me sentía agradecida con la vida por ese cambio de planes que nos llevo a conocer este Bosque Sagrado.

body.title: Paraíso de suaves colores
body.body:
>

<center>
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/Eo8TpAT28wJgb1tNbtPa4QwK3g9z1SfxayzWwb3vnousayAbrLJ23kkkwfj4oYGxs6b.png
<sub>Imagen propiedad de @lanzjoseg </sub>
</center>

Desde que era niña me han gustado muchísimo los peluches, debo admitir que desde entonces no he tenido gustos tan comunes en otros aspectos, siendo los peluches la excepción mi familia por tomar el camino fácil terminaba regalándome peluches para no tener la difícil tarea de adivinar que otra cosa me podría gustar, recuerdo que cuando cumplí 10 años en la reunión familiar la mesa se llenó de regalos y casi todos eran peluches 😄, para mi ese fue mi mejor cumpleaños. 

<center>
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>

Con el tiempo la situación cambió y de adulta yo misma empecé a cómprame mis peluches, pero debido a dificultades económicas deje de hacerlo progresivamente hasta llegar a un punto donde incluso tuve que regalar y vender algunos de ellos, no es que tuviera demasiados pero si les tenia cariño a cada uno, por lo menos los que regalé fue a mis sobrinos así que se que aun los conservan y mantienen bien, los otros los vendí a desconocidos por Internet asi que no sé si aun existan.

<center>
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
</center>

Actualmente sufro de rinitis por lo cual no debería tener ningún peluche pero mantengo la costumbre de tener uno para dormir, el actual es una vaca que tiene ya muchos años conmigo y este año pensaba darle jubilación pero aun no he podido, sin embargo, siempre que voy a una tienda es parada obligatoria para mi en el área de peluches para ver si hay alguno que se robe mi corazón y este dentro de mi presupuesto para ser el próximo peluche que me acompañará, alli entre tantos peluches me parece estar dentro de un paraíso de suaves colores. 



<center>
https://i.imgur.com/CWx3RWZ.png
Esta es mi entrada al [Concurso. Observa Piensa Escribe.](https://peakd.com/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-b8a6d3fe6dda6)
</center>

body.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes la participación del equipo de Fundación en El Torneo Apertura de 2da División, que se está realizando en el municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to our friends at Hive and @fulldeportes. Today I’m going to share with you the Fundación team’s performance in the Second Division Opening Tournament, which is currently taking place in the municipality of Zamora, Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260523_193413732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23ynUGqLP7ASbYaDz4krcLhuoX2g8YdwswPxCB44KeQ1ywKX7T3NUadM2BtfUNjzF2Tbo.jpg) Cabe destacar que en esta ocasión Fundación tenía planificado dos partidos en la categoría Sub 18 contra la delegación de Bael y Sub 14 con Colorados en la cancha del sector La Coromoto, de la parroquia Villa de Cura. Cómo el tiempo estuvo lluvioso, el partido se retraso un poco, para iniciar a las 10:00 am, Sub 18 de Fundación vs Bael, el cual se encuentra en la primera posición en la tabla de posiciones. >It is worth noting that on this occasion, Fundación had scheduled two matches: an Under-18 fixture against Bael and an Under-14 match against Colorados at the La Coromoto ground in the Villa de Cura parish. As the weather was rainy, the match was delayed slightly, kicking off at 10:00 am: Fundación’s Under-18s vs Bael, who are currently top of the league table. ![IMG_20260523_111017.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xehc4cFbxHEifoehUe8XAquemcvRRhx3gMQ8VAeNiruEH5FGMgX3hdnmM1s8WXJp26x.jpg) ![IMG_20260523_111059.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xKvVsePv3bVFNfD4x438xrfJ5GMGdFow8VK4yxBzzFNvj8otq1hPXBStDfMhUnATP4Y.jpg) Asimismo, se desplegaron en la cancha los cinco jugadores titulares de Fundación vs Bael, para iniciar el partido, en un juego muy cerrado, Fundación mantuvo una buena defensa, pero el equipo rival, constantemente intentaba patear el balón hacia la portería, el cual eran detenidos por el portero de Fundación, pero debido a un error al hacer un pase, Bael inició el marcador con su primer gol. Después Fundación no mantuvo la intensidad del juego y los delanteros no regresaban a defender, aprovechando Bael, para concretar dos goles más, perdido 4 X 0. >The five starting players for Fundación took to the pitch against Bael to kick off the match. In a very tight game, Fundación maintained a solid defence, but the opposition constantly tried to shoot at goal, with their attempts thwarted by Fundación’s goalkeeper. However, following a misplaced pass, Bael opened the scoring with their first goal. After that, Fundación failed to maintain the intensity of the game and the forwards did not track back to defend, which Bael took advantage of to score two more goals, resulting in a 4–0 defeat. ![IMG_20260523_111434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wWvpcFzSJMsedcwKXZRXGAEVJrPU4GYUoZqpzzfpuNpdgSuxEsHSLVvu5NbnWfXgsSD.jpg) ![IMG_20260523_122739.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23vsNB7Cxed4vQzFBSEDNHEUXHAHNQV4iDpmXVxcE7nLiSDUJDPx4g2HkNmbJdF9Mayex.jpg) Luego el técnico hizo un sólo cambio de los jugadores titulares, para mantener la misma intensidad del partido, sin embargo el jugador que entró no demostró la rapidez, contra la delegación de Bael, que aumento el marcador a cuatro goles. Al preguntarle a los árbitros el tiempo de juego, estos manifestaron que quedaban cinco minutos, obligando al técnico de Fundación a realizar los cambios para los demás jugadores suplentes jugarán también. >The manager then made just one change to the starting line-up in an attempt to maintain the same intensity in the match; however, the substitute failed to show the necessary pace against the Bael side, who extended their lead to four goals. When asked by the referees how much time was left, they stated there were five minutes remaining, forcing the Fundación manager to make further changes so that the other substitutes could also get some playing time. ![IMG_20260523_112703.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wgKhYFqgnvcHcGPrhYf5iGHsz7myVFQzfe1NB1iRaPQedcKr4TF65odDgDuNUwpZ1nL.jpg) ![IMG_20260523_122355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xVHJCjn2sHvPB7ADshXHnULms8sS8gVFSJvMTAwiP1pghxTBm72Ry2fSK4jtUU2xdGe.jpg) Asimismo, en ese cambio, el equipo de Fundación, marca su primer gol, pero los jugadores suplentes no mantuvieron la intensidad del juego y Bael en poco tiempo obtuvo dos goles, por la floja defensa por parte de Fundación. En vista de que quedaba tres minutos de juegos, los dos técnicos de ambos equipos deciden finalizar el partido debido a la lluvia, perdiendo Fundación 6 X 1 contra la delegación de Bael. Los demás partidos fueron suspendido por las lluvias que afectaron la superficie de la cancha. >Furthermore, during that phase of play, the Fundación team scored their first goal, but the substitutes were unable to maintain the intensity of the game and Bael quickly scored two goals, capitalising on Fundación’s weak defence. With three minutes of play remaining, the managers of both teams decided to end the match due to the rain, with Fundación losing 6–1 to the Bael side. The other matches were suspended due to the rain, which had affected the pitch surface. ![IMG_20260523_112533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23ynNMe4GyP1xDvt6nffiZ2ALjpHathVJQNMJPmtaeNq5N46h5wACCFrd3DSGf9jtxqBj.jpg) ![IMG_20260523_112702.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xVHDVjmh3eik7FQ1FuzRNn2fhxVSz6q4X89pSYQ1PKyTbeb8ybZmjtxDuTqqBw8adL4.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. body.title: Explorando este desafiante Hack Rom: Zelda Ultimate Trial 🎮 - Gameplay [ES-EN]
body.body:
> ###
ZELDA ULTIMATE TRIAL #1
###
ESPAÑOL | ENGLISH
¡Hola, comunidad de Hive Gaming! De vuelta por acá después de un largo tiempo sin pasar a compartir con ustedes. A veces el día a día nos absorbe, pero la pasión por los videojuegos nunca se va, todos tenemos un sitio seguro al que ir cuando estamos agotados del día a día en el trabajo y las responsabilidades, para mi, los videojuegos es mi sitio seguro y de descanso. Hoy finalmente me animé a grabar, sentarme a jugar y traerles un gameplay de un proyecto que me tenía bastante intrigado y con ganas de probar. Para este regreso no quería traer un juego convencional. Si, me gustan muchísimo los juegos retro y toda esa estética que me traiga nostalgia, así que quería hoy probar algo diferente, quería algo que me pusiera a prueba, que me sacara de mi zona de confort. Por eso, decidí adentrarme en el fascinante mundo de los Hack-Roms, específicamente uno basado en una de las mayores obras maestras de la Nintendo 64: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. El título de este hack rom se llama Ultimate Trial, y créanme que si hace honor a su nombre, ya que en español se titularia ''La Prueba Definitiva''. > Hello, Hive Gaming community! I’m back here after a long time without stopping by to share with you all. Sometimes daily life gets in the way, but the passion for video games never fades. We all have a safe haven to turn to when we’re worn out from the daily grind of work and responsibilities—for me, video games are my safe haven and place of respite. Today I finally decided to record a session, sit down to play, and bring you some gameplay from a project that had me pretty intrigued and eager to try out. > For this comeback, I didn’t want to bring a conventional game. Yes, I really love retro games and all that nostalgic aesthetic, so today I wanted to try something different—something that would challenge me and push me out of my comfort zone. That’s why I decided to dive into the fascinating world of Hack-Roms, specifically one based on one of the greatest masterpieces of the Nintendo 64: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. The title of this hack ROM is called Ultimate Trial, and believe me, it lives up to its name—in Spanish, it would be titled “The Ultimate Trial.” *** *** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kato-san/23tSS5c78qnavV9oXv94m1hjMuWWJpFSGuxTHtaw2GWUbwFJr1LcRVBxhEbHYMyPPhcPT.png) *** Para los que quizás no estén tan familiarizados con el término ''HACK ROM'' este es una versión modificada de un juego original creada por fanáticos. Los desarrolladores independientes toman el motor gráfico, las mecánicas y los recursos del juego base y alteran los mapas, la dificultad, la historia o los acertijos para ofrecer una experiencia completamente nueva. Es, esencialmente, un juego nuevo construido sobre los cimientos de un clásico. Ocarina of Time es un juego que me sé casi de memoria, y precisamente por eso elegí Ultimate Trial. Quería romper con esa familiaridad y volver a sentir la incertidumbre y la emoción de no saber qué hay en la siguiente esquina. > For those who may not be familiar with the term “HACK ROM,” it refers to a modified version of an original game created by fans. Independent developers take the graphics engine, mechanics, and assets from the base game and alter the maps, difficulty, story, or puzzles to offer a completely new experience. It is, essentially, a new game built on the foundation of a classic. Ocarina of Time is a game I know almost by heart, and that’s precisely why I chose Ultimate Trial. I wanted to break away from that familiarity and feel the uncertainty and excitement of not knowing what lies around the next corner. *** *** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kato-san/23tS2tBz35DaTL4Csm9Qu45QgViwcKR9uvFs6vA1NxqhGb54ddrsCRW9vaVu8izbQvhuJ.png) *** Desde los primeros minutos de juego, Ultimate Trial te deja claro que no ha venido a tomarte de la mano. Si el juego original de Nintendo 64 tenía una curva de dificultad amigable y progresiva, este mod asume que ya eres un veterano de Hyrule y te lanza directo a los lobos. En el video que les comparto hoy, van a poder ver mis primeros pasos (y mis primeras muertes, para qué mentirles) en este exigente entorno. A pesar de que conozco muy bien el juego original, esta versión me resulto muy desafiante, enemigos que aparecen sorpresivamente, no poder recuperar corazones en plena partida de combate, sin duda alguna es todo un desafío. > From the very first minutes of gameplay, Ultimate Trial makes it clear that it’s not here to hold your hand. While the original Nintendo 64 game had a gentle, gradual difficulty curve, this mod assumes you’re already a Hyrule veteran and throws you right into the deep end. In the video I’m sharing with you today, you’ll get to see my first steps (and my first deaths, why lie to you?) in this demanding environment. Even though I know the original game very well, I found this version to be very challenging—enemies that appear out of nowhere, not being able to recover hearts in the middle of combat—it’s definitely a real challenge. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kato-san/23vsFeBkUaLcRyT2dtgGyTqsdBFrRQXeWtS6WodmUUSxHFajCzTZow2y53dajEDKJemsN.png) Visualmente, el juego mantiene toda la esencia de la Nintendo 64, lo cual me encanta porque la atmósfera nostálgica sigue intacta, pero la jugabilidad se siente fresca, tensa y sumamente adictiva. Espero que disfruten de este gameplay tanto como yo disfruté grabándolo. Si les gusta este tipo de contenido de retos y modificaciones de clásicos, háganmelo saber en los comentarios para seguir trayendo el avance de esta aventura, de verdad que lo disfrute bastante aprovechando mi día de trabajo y de descanso, seguiré compartiendo con ustedes de este avance en mis ratos libres, cuídense mucho muchachos y bendiciones para todos! > Visually, the game captures the essence of the Nintendo 64, which I love because the nostalgic atmosphere remains intact, but the gameplay feels fresh, intense, and incredibly addictive. I hope you enjoy this gameplay as much as I enjoyed recording it. If you like this kind of content—challenges and remakes of classics—let me know in the comments so I can keep bringing you updates on this adventure. body.title: Beneath the Shadow of a Flamboyant Tree. Entry for Shadow Hunters SMASH Contest-round 427 [EN/ES]
body.body:
- - - 
### Beneath the Shadow of a Flamboyant Tree
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqw7upZrmYU6NLqv9LaaQyPsmYy3XKFK56BNSREuDSqA/screenshot_20260523_194223_01.jpg)

---

Hello #ShadowHunters community,
Once again I’m taking part in this shadows contest, this time in round #427.

Some shadows are more than shapes on the ground—they become small refuges from the heat.

This time, during a walk through Varadero, I stopped near a flamboyant tree, known for its wide branches and intense red-orange flowers. At this time of year, the tree is in full bloom, transforming the landscape into something vibrant and impossible to ignore.

Under the strong sun so common in Varadero, its shadow stretched generously across the ground. While the flowers above captured the eye with their color, below, the shadow offered something equally valuable: relief from the heat.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYekP9T87rPnBYHFveoQvGYEhFZGcGDzzLBMempBYGbdv/screenshot_20260523_194240_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8D864QurGS3b8qCkrq4YcD1S9PkB67r5FWB1GBFSqAu/screenshot_20260523_194235_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSEuMK33XU7HxcWpYonQoQyywHRmyFgThJf1kytrrW5Wb/screenshot_20260523_194228_01.jpg)

---

I found it interesting how the same tree could create two completely different sensations at once. Above, brightness and intensity. Below, calm and shelter.

For a moment, I remained there, appreciating the contrast between the burning sunlight and the coolness beneath the branches. The shadow moved softly with the wind, changing shape little by little, as if the tree itself were breathing together with the afternoon.

Perhaps that is why certain trees become unforgettable. Not only because of how they look, but because of how they make us feel when we stand beneath them.
- - - 
I declare that the images shared in this post are my own, captured with my mobile phone.
Since my native language is Spanish, I used Google Translate for the English version.
- - - 
***Thank you for welcoming me into your light,
and for allowing me to explore with you the poetry of shadows***.
---
https://vote.hive.uno/@thebbhproject

Support the witness and vote for TheBbhProject carried out by @bradleyarrow

- - - 
***Spanish Version***
- - - 

### Bajo la sombra de un flamboyán

- - -

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZqw7upZrmYU6NLqv9LaaQyPsmYy3XKFK56BNSREuDSqA/screenshot_20260523_194223_01.jpg)

---

Hola comunidad de #ShadowHunters,
Una vez más participo en este concurso de sombras, esta vez en la ronda #427.

Algunas sombras son más que formas sobre el suelo: se convierten en pequeños refugios frente al calor.

Esta vez, durante un paseo por Varadero, me detuve cerca de un flamboyán, un árbol conocido por sus ramas amplias y sus intensas flores rojo-anaranjadas. En esta época del año se encuentra completamente florecido, transformando el paisaje en algo vibrante e imposible de ignorar.

Bajo el fuerte sol tan común en Varadero, su sombra se extendía generosamente sobre el suelo. Mientras las flores arriba llamaban la atención por su color, abajo la sombra ofrecía algo igualmente valioso: alivio frente al calor.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYekP9T87rPnBYHFveoQvGYEhFZGcGDzzLBMempBYGbdv/screenshot_20260523_194240_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS8D864QurGS3b8qCkrq4YcD1S9PkB67r5FWB1GBFSqAu/screenshot_20260523_194235_01.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSEuMK33XU7HxcWpYonQoQyywHRmyFgThJf1kytrrW5Wb/screenshot_20260523_194228_01.jpg)

---

Me pareció interesante cómo un mismo árbol podía crear dos sensaciones completamente distintas al mismo tiempo. Arriba, brillo e intensidad. Abajo, calma y refugio.

Por un momento permanecí allí, apreciando el contraste entre la luz ardiente del sol y la frescura bajo las ramas. La sombra se movía suavemente con el viento, cambiando poco a poco de forma, como si el árbol respirara junto con la tarde.

Quizás por eso ciertos árboles se vuelven inolvidables. No solo por cómo lucen, sino por cómo nos hacen sentir cuando permanecemos bajo ellos.

- - - 
Declaro que las imágenes compartidas en este post son de mi propiedad, capturadas con mi móvil.
Como mi lengua materna es el español, utilicé Google Translate para la versión en inglés.
- - - 
***Gracias por recibirme en su luz,
y por permitirme explorar con ustedes la poesía de las sombras***.
- - -
