title.title: (ENG/ESP) 😺❤️‍🩹✂️ No sewing required: How to make a post-operative bodysuit for cats / Sin costura: Cómo hacer un body post operatorio para gatos 😺❤️‍🩹✂️
title.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to all members of this community and cat lovers! I received some wonderful news upon returning from my trip: Cleo's spaying surgery was scheduled for a few days from now. This was a huge relief, as Ying, her male companion, has been neutered for years, so it was time to ensure Cleo's well-being, since she was originally a stray kitten. Thankfully, the surgery went well, and to keep the wound covered, Cleo will be wearing a bandage or bodysuit.
![1000422975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xKza4dPuhmHphefceJtC5EG6TV5GjanpdWDDBpSstuAtJZfmrRWTDyxoZYQxkF3Be7a.jpg)

To make this piece, you don't need any sewing skills; all you need is an old cotton shirt and a good pair of scissors. The shirt must be made of cotton, as this type of fabric allows perspiration to escape, and it shouldn't have any kind of print, since some prints are made with a plastic-like material that could clog the fabric fibers.
![1000422944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tmPx5YxMDTgaewjBQURKcoeVdvZY5FXFBTVQucTCL5JrNX6pDStp7iqCANXSd9CWF8Y.jpg)

The first step is to remove the sleeves and separate the fabric at the sides and shoulders. This will give you the front and back of the shirt, from which you can make two bodysuits. In my case, since one side was patterned, I kept the unpatterned piece. Fold the piece and cut along both sides, aligning them until you have roughly a square.
|![1000422945.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tSch961QxLoPxrrkSM4JZ4KLUGvgxz4XFnJJe8Nat5KYikX56N2sVpxR1XUaVrj9ajA.jpg)|![1000422946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tc3ewC8AsnRBpNeVsh9i9souc3rzTXbd7hmwLFehK8Hpmr5dtGWdBp985YHtiwMBH4f.jpg)|![1000422947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tvngJU8JFYhCc8xj6Jeejj61mY5QKtHMeqb4T9P3csA3JETKirWZHCFbCTy3QL8zSbA.jpg)| |-|-|-|
Along the folded edge, make two horizontal slits for the cat's paws. The slits should be small and cross-shaped to allow for easy movement of the limbs. It's best to enlarge the slits later to avoid making them too wide.
|![1000422948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23u6BVMW6BJKJAE6657rCBgAQWSeeHUZDdBuDCRXusx3BxKJxjSJMmqgXAYmr9ikqXZqv.jpg)|![1000422949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tmUArBf7UTQqnopxkvMTxhEUi1pH65Hv5jLEXMiLehPptHZdqyrrYUb8URcWNmg2Rvi.jpg)|![1000422957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eo4EPqHd21GQ5ejwLTqgE2Gy8xkCfYPf9zxEDsakCmah83qkRWR6N2wkGVzLJqSLoxn.jpg)|![1000422956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xyXWH3g7higdfhtFiVD7UEfCoGdJCUh3w5bKwMqkher5xsBUxhFn1x6x5tK5TgYb7sP.jpg)| |-|-|-|-|
Once that's done, from the opposite side where the leg cuts were made, make long cuts to create the tie straps. I cut them freehand, without any measurements. Then, cut diagonally on both edges to create a curve for the neck and rear of the cat. When you open the bodysuit, it will look like we've made a spider, haha.
|![1000422952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23vsWhk38CiZx8ex32x56dZsueTjsEZxJCjBpBjr5bHzdiD2wkCnru7kyPe8tmvz7NgUG.jpg)|![1000422953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23uFcSC13EmUXcNqJNanDsKSqAwnCUZvRiJfYVPm3YEbF3hZJWZErue2Enks7V2RdmjqD.jpg)|![1000422960.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2qfW4py1BhNbHpg9y4oZGm8mdy1oHWbUGrXG6H3KaFYrVtc4UZwA2mvXtgF75nvKpY.jpg)| |-|-|-|
And so, the straitjacket... I mean, the post-operative bodysuit or girdle, is finished ✨ When putting it on, you can trim the excess fabric, being very careful not to cut the cat's fur 😬 also the knots have to be made in such a way that the cat cannot remove the piece, but not too tight, to avoid discomfort.
|![1000422938.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpC9rnYW3uptvuzoMP2WioVDif1yUnqKY7Xdc3MJp6g8LBa7npD8BdhT4m799zF8Epd.jpg)|![1000422939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoyPvP9gn57envZi9Q5U8WYJndjJ1LiXMUKKexEuc8NfDE1GM8PowxA8t397EJPSkP3.jpg)|![1000422940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Ep5nfWPGG5qQw8TSiASseAiMjrdV7iW2r1LyNGnYDxDLEg6piVtbfYfnbSEUMW8e6jb.jpg)| |-|-|-|
It's perfect for preventing cats from licking their wounds, especially when they have stitches. Remember, their tongues are like sandpaper, so it would be harmful if they licked them. Cleo has already tried, but she only ends up licking the fabric, so the wound is safe while it heals. Remember: Spaying or neutering pets is an act of love 😉

#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad y amantes de los gatos! Una buena noticia que recibí cuando llegué tras mi viaje, fue que la operación de esterilización de *Cleo*, estaba pautada para dentro de unos días. Eso me hizo sentir aliviada, ya que *Ying*, el gato macho que le hace compañía, tiene años castrado, así que era momento de asegurar la salud de Cleo, quién inicialmente era una gatita callejera. Gracias a Dios, la operación resultó bien y para mantener la herida cubierta, a Cleo se le debe dejar colocada una faja o body.
![1000422975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xKza4dPuhmHphefceJtC5EG6TV5GjanpdWDDBpSstuAtJZfmrRWTDyxoZYQxkF3Be7a.jpg)

Para elaborar esta pieza, no se necesita tener un conocimiento en costura, basta con una camisa vieja de algodón y unas buenas tijeras. La camisa, tiene que ser estrictamente de algodón, ya que es un tipo de tela que permite la transpiración, así como no debe de tener ningún tipo de estampado, ya que por lo general, algunos estampados están hechos como de un material plástico, que podría bloquear las fibras de la tela.
![1000422944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tmPx5YxMDTgaewjBQURKcoeVdvZY5FXFBTVQucTCL5JrNX6pDStp7iqCANXSd9CWF8Y.jpg)

Lo primero que se hace, es retirar las mangas y separar también en los laterales y en la zona de los hombros. De esta forma, tendremos lo que sería la parte delantera y trasera de la camisa separadas, de allí, se pueden sacar dos bodys. En mi caso, como uno de los lados estaba estampado, me quedé con la pieza no tenía. Se dobla la pieza y se corta de ambos lados, emparejando hasta obtener más o menos un cuadrado.
|![1000422945.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tSch961QxLoPxrrkSM4JZ4KLUGvgxz4XFnJJe8Nat5KYikX56N2sVpxR1XUaVrj9ajA.jpg)|![1000422946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tc3ewC8AsnRBpNeVsh9i9souc3rzTXbd7hmwLFehK8Hpmr5dtGWdBp985YHtiwMBH4f.jpg)|![1000422947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tvngJU8JFYhCc8xj6Jeejj61mY5QKtHMeqb4T9P3csA3JETKirWZHCFbCTy3QL8zSbA.jpg)| |-|-|-|
En la parte del doblez, se procede a realizar dos cortes en horizontal, los cuales son para que se metan las patas del gato. El corte debe ser pequeño y en forma de cruz, lo cual facilita la movilidad de las extremidades. Es preferible agrandar el corte después y no correr el riesgo de que quede demasiado ancho.
|![1000422948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23u6BVMW6BJKJAE6657rCBgAQWSeeHUZDdBuDCRXusx3BxKJxjSJMmqgXAYmr9ikqXZqv.jpg)|![1000422949.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23tmUArBf7UTQqnopxkvMTxhEUi1pH65Hv5jLEXMiLehPptHZdqyrrYUb8URcWNmg2Rvi.jpg)|![1000422957.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eo4EPqHd21GQ5ejwLTqgE2Gy8xkCfYPf9zxEDsakCmah83qkRWR6N2wkGVzLJqSLoxn.jpg)|![1000422956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xyXWH3g7higdfhtFiVD7UEfCoGdJCUh3w5bKwMqkher5xsBUxhFn1x6x5tK5TgYb7sP.jpg)| |-|-|-|-|
Una vez hecho esto, desde la parte contraria desde donde se hicieron los cortes para las patas, se realizan cortes largos con el fin de crear lo que serían las tiras de amarre. Yo las corté al ojo por ciento, sin ninguna medida. Luego, en ambos bordes se corta en forma diagonal, para crear una curva para la zona del cuello y de la parte trasera del gato. Al abrir el body, parecerá como si hubiéramos realizado un arácnido jaja.
|![1000422952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23vsWhk38CiZx8ex32x56dZsueTjsEZxJCjBpBjr5bHzdiD2wkCnru7kyPe8tmvz7NgUG.jpg)|![1000422953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23uFcSC13EmUXcNqJNanDsKSqAwnCUZvRiJfYVPm3YEbF3hZJWZErue2Enks7V2RdmjqD.jpg)|![1000422960.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2qfW4py1BhNbHpg9y4oZGm8mdy1oHWbUGrXG6H3KaFYrVtc4UZwA2mvXtgF75nvKpY.jpg)| |-|-|-|
Y de esta forma, la camisa de fuerza... quiero decir, el body o faja post operatorio, está terminado ✨ A la hora de colocarlo, se puede recortar el excedente de tela, con mucho cuidado de no cortar el pelaje del gato 😬 también los nudos se tienen que hacer de forma que el gato no se pueda retirar la pieza, pero no muy ajustado, para evitar incomodidad.
|![1000422938.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EpC9rnYW3uptvuzoMP2WioVDif1yUnqKY7Xdc3MJp6g8LBa7npD8BdhT4m799zF8Epd.jpg)|![1000422939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoyPvP9gn57envZi9Q5U8WYJndjJ1LiXMUKKexEuc8NfDE1GM8PowxA8t397EJPSkP3.jpg)|![1000422940.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Ep5nfWPGG5qQw8TSiASseAiMjrdV7iW2r1LyNGnYDxDLEg6piVtbfYfnbSEUMW8e6jb.jpg)| |-|-|-|
Es perfecto para evitar que los gatos se laman las heridas y más cuando estas tienen sutura, recordemos que sus lenguas, son como lijas, así que sería perjudicial que se laman allí. Ya Cleo lo ha intentado, pero sólo acaba lamiendo la tela, así que está segura la herida mientras se cicatriza. Recuerden: Esterilizar a las mascotas, es amor 😉

>

***If you don't know how to be alone, then you'll never be free.***
Yes! There are people who are afraid of loneliness and who get depressed because they don't know how to be alone. At first, I didn't understand it. But, after several years, you understand; they say if you can't beat them, join them. Isolated from everything and everyone... And what if you need someone or need to rely on someone? 
- 1. When I've needed it, there have been no answers.
- 2. And when I do receive answers, it creates distance.

***You can't just go through life bothering other people, but you can choose not to..*** 

Sometimes I wonder where all this thinking will lead me. My grandma would have told me, \
Because crazy people end up in the loony bin. 😂 I miss her a lot; although I miss everyone, but will everyone miss me? We won't know, maybe at some point they'll call or write to say: \

Because I, for one, don't think I'll keep doing that... So, isolated from everything and everyone, as I always have been.
A friend told me a few days ago, \

I wanted to reply sarcastically; I can't even stand myself, let alone go out and deal with others. 😂 Then I realized I'm a bitter, repressed person, isolated from everything and everyone...

Are these just excuses? Or am I being too hard on myself? I don't know, but right now I really don't care. What I need to deal with now is my lack of time, money, and space.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 A shooting erupted outside the White House Saturday evening, and the whole thing went from routine press coverage to chaos in seconds. A gunman opened fire near Gate 17 on the west side of the complex around 6:30 PM ET, and Secret Service responded immediately with overwhelming force. The lockdown was lifted roughly 15 minutes later, but not before reporters on the grounds were diving for cover.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The key sequence is pretty straightforward and ugly: the shooter reportedly fired about three shots from a pistol, then Secret Service returned fire in a barrage and neutralized him. One civilian nearby was apparently hit during the exchange. That matters because this wasn’t just a perimeter scare — there was real collateral danger in a heavily secured zone around one of the most protected buildings on earth.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The most vivid detail came from reporters already on site. ABC’s Selina Wang said she was recording from the North Lawn when the shots rang out and described it as sounding like “dozens of gunshots.” Press on the grounds were ordered to gather and sprint into the briefing room. That tells you how fast the situation escalated: no drawn-out standoff, just immediate confusion, cover, and lockdown protocol.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 Federal response was instant. FBI Director Kash Patel said the FBI was on scene supporting the Secret Service. CNN reported the lockdown was lifted around 6:45 PM ET. The article also ties this to broader security tension: President Trump had posted less than two hours earlier that he was in the Oval Office working on an Iran peace deal, and it notes another recent gunfire incident tied to a White House Correspondents’ Association Dinner about a month earlier.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 Bottom line: this was a short, violent security breach near the White House perimeter, stopped quickly but serious enough to injure at least one bystander and send the press scrambling for shelter. It’s also a reminder that even the most fortified locations are one bad actor away from mayhem for a few brutal minutes. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/23/us-news/white-house-on-lockdown-after-dozens-of-shots-fired/)\n\n#threadstorm

title.body: 1/5 🧵 America’s “nothing good happens after midnight” economy might be reversing — but only barely. Late-night fast food got wrecked during COVID, never really recovered, and now a few chains are testing whether the 2 a.m. burger run still has a pulse. The catch: demand exists, but the old 24/7 model got a lot less profitable.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The collapse was brutal. Restaurant sales fell **47% in April 2020** versus a year earlier, and operators slashed hours to survive. That wasn’t just a temporary panic move: from **2020 to 2024, 24-hour restaurant service dropped 18%**. A lot of those “open all night” signs basically became museum pieces.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The real villain here is economics. Food-away-from-home prices in U.S. cities are up **nearly 30% since 2020**, while restaurants are getting squeezed by labor, food, rent, insurance, and energy costs all at once. Years ago, a skeleton crew overnight could still make sense. Now? Higher wages and thinner margins mean staying open all night can be more expensive than shutting down and reopening.

title.body: 4/5 🧵 There’s also a demand shift, not just a cost shift. Experts argue consumers aren’t behaving like they did pre-pandemic: more people are eating out less, health priorities are up, and younger people are drinking less. That matters because a decent chunk of late-night fast-food traffic used to come from exactly the kind of chaos that happens around **2:30 a.m.** Less bar-fueled demand = weaker overnight economics.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 Still, the comeback isn’t fictional. Traffic has reportedly ticked up since 2023, and chains like **Wendy’s, McDonald’s, Burger King, and Taco Bell** have been expanding late-night hours in at least some locations. The likely future isn’t a full return to universal 24-hour dining — it’s a more selective version focused on **high-traffic zones** near highways, airports, and major cities. Convenience is back, but only where the math works. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/23/lifestyle/americas-late-night-fast-food-culture-may-be-making-a-comeback-following-years-long-drastic-decline/)\n\n#threadstorm

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Trump’s headline is the optimistic part. The actual substance is messier: a deal to end the Iran war is **“largely negotiated,”** but the biggest issue — Iran’s nuclear program — is still unresolved and kicked 30 days down the road. That’s not peace locked in. That’s a ceasefire-shaped IOU.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The core claim is that Trump, after calls with Egypt, Jordan, Turkey, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and separately Netanyahu, says the framework is close and that **the Strait of Hormuz “will be opened.”** That matters because Hormuz is one of the world’s most critical oil chokepoints. Reopening it would calm energy markets fast, at least in theory.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The catch: the hardest question got postponed. Iran’s nuclear capacity wasn’t settled in this round, so both sides now have a 30-day window to fight over the part that actually determines whether this becomes a durable agreement or just a temporary pause. In plain English: the war piece may be cooling, but the nuclear piece is still a live grenade.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 Critics on Trump’s own hawkish flank are not subtle about it. Lindsey Graham argues that if Iran keeps the ability to threaten Hormuz and Gulf oil infrastructure, then any deal risks making Tehran look stronger, not weaker. Mike Pompeo goes even harder, calling the floated terms the opposite of “America First” and framing them as rewarding a regime that still wants leverage, cash, and room to maneuver.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 The real read: this is a **tentative diplomatic breakthrough**, not a clean resolution. Trump is selling momentum; skeptics see a dangerous deferral. If the final terms truly reopen Hormuz *and* constrain Iran’s military/nuclear leverage, it’s a major win. If not, this just buys 30 days while the hardest problem keeps breathing. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/23/us-news/trump-says-iran-agreement-largely-negotiated-after-call-with-middle-east-allies-the-strait-of-hormuz-will-be-opened/)\n\n#threadstorm

title.body:
![89630.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morenow/23tve5HTpY3dTKyEAXuYhgP5UosFG8CA3C4aPysANvB6krVTg8XFCbsGQdc4GbmSUQbsu.jpg)


Sábado, un buen día para descansar y recargar energías.

Hoy regrese del trabajo a las 9:30 am y antes de ir a casa estuve compartiendo un par de cervezas con colegas de trabajo que además son paisanos (también de Venezuela), luego llegué a casa ordenando y preparando algunas cosas. Cuando me desocupe ya eran las 2 de la tarde y me acosté muy cansado intentando dormir, pero lamentablemente solo pude descansar una hora ya que no paraban de llamar a mi puerta. La razón era que mis vecinos tenían planificada una pequeña fiesta para celebrar el cumpleaños numero 7 de su hijo y me solicitaban diferentes favores. Se han portado tan bien conmigo que no podía negarme a pesar del cansancio. 

Luego fui a buscar unas mesas y sillas con mi vecino a cierto lugar y al regresar me fui a hacer un pequeño mercado. Las horas han ido pasando y sigo sin descansar. 

Al momento de escribir el post estoy compartiendo en la pequeña fiesta. La verdad ya no siento el cansancio como lo sentía temprano, pero si me encantaría estar en mi cama. 

Sábado de descanso sin descanso, ya será el domingo, eso espero.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 The Mets didn’t plan a youth movement this early. Injuries forced it, and suddenly they rolled out an all-rookie outfield — **Carson Benge, A.J. Ewing, and Nick Morabito** — together for the first time at any level. That’s not a quirky lineup note. That’s a franchise admitting the kids matter **right now**.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The debut as a trio wasn’t pretty on paper: they combined to go **1-for-9** in a **2-1 loss** to Miami, with Ewing getting the lone hit besides Juan Soto. But one game isn’t the story. Morabito also made a diving catch that likely saved a run, which is the kind of detail teams cling to when young players are learning on the fly.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The real driver here is attrition. With **Francisco Lindor, Jorge Polanco, and Luis Robert Jr.** out long term, Carlos Mendoza’s hand has been forced. Still, he didn’t sound reluctant — he said the rookies “continue to earn it.” That matters. This isn’t framed as charity innings. It’s framed as performance creating opportunity.

title.body: 1/5 🧵 The wild part wasn’t OKC winning — it was **how fast they erased disaster**. The Thunder spotted the Spurs a **15-0 lead** in a Western Conference Finals game, then calmly turned it into a **123-108 win**. That’s the kind of response that says “panic is for other teams.” [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/23/sports/thunder-climb-out-of-early-hole-to-beat-spurs/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 **Shai Gilgeous-Alexander ran the game like a surgeon.** He finished with **26 points and 12 assists**, setting the tone once OKC stopped sleepwalking through the opening minutes. The bigger point: he didn’t just score — he stabilized everything. After the Spurs’ crowd-fueled burst, OKC’s answer was poise, not chaos. That mattered more than the box score flash. [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/23/sports/thunder-climb-out-of-early-hole-to-beat-spurs/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The real knockout punch came from the **Thunder bench**, which absolutely buried San Antonio’s second unit **76-23**. That’s obscene. **Jared McCain scored 24**, **Jaylin Williams added 18**, and **Alex Caruso chipped in 15**. OKC did this **without Jalen Williams**, who sat with left hamstring soreness, which makes the depth story even louder. This wasn’t a star solo — it was a roster flex. [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/23/sports/thunder-climb-out-of-early-hole-to-beat-spurs/)

title.body:
>  ![376619.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/48QuBLg4QKaJFoCpDubCmha8wCvXRwVpQZUXxuz92Zoo86rXRi4mCcJtDS1GL9VdjW.jpg) Holisss, ¿qué tal? ¿Cómo es esta linda comunidad de Family Friends? Por acá, todo muy bien, gracias a Dios, descansando de un largo sábado, y digo largo porque pasé todo el día en la computadora y para mí fue bastante largo de tantas tareas de la universidad, pero aquí estamos súper feliz.  Hoy tengo algo lindo que contarles a todos ustedes. Saben que yo nunca había participado en el Global Pizza Day; de hecho, apenas voy a cumplir un año en Hive y desconozco muchas cosas, entre ellas cómo se celebraba este día, pero gracias a la invitación de mi prima @rlathulerie y la hermosa compañía de 2 amigas @floreudys79 y @denissemata vivi esta experiencia por primera vez.
Hey there, how are you all? How’s this lovely Family Friends community getting on? Over here, everything’s going really well, thank goodness. I’m taking a breather after a long Saturday – and I say ‘long’ because I spent the whole day on the computer, and for me it felt quite long with all the university work, but we’re absolutely chuffed here.  Today I have something lovely to tell you all. You know I’d never taken part in Global Pizza Day before; in fact, I’m only just about to mark my first year on Hive and there’s a lot I don’t know, including how this day was celebrated, but thanks to the invitation from my cousin @rlathulerie and the lovely company of two friends, @floreudys79 and @denissemata, I got to experience it for the first time.

title.title: Ruteng: The Chilly, Serene, and Misty Highlands of Flores Island
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVfvJoPEjJqKgdCTeGRUXYPFjbWcmhVf2yKEtfiC95EJa/1000705439.png 

When people talk about Flores Island in Indonesia, their minds almost instantly drift toward the tropical heat, the sun-kissed beaches of Labuan Bajo, or the ancient Komodo dragons. However, if you dare to travel deeper into the heart of the island, ascending into the highlands of the Manggarai region, you will experience a completely different world. Welcome to Ruteng, a small mountain town wrapped in perpetual chill, peace, and timeless serenity.
​A Chilly Escape from the Tropical Heat
Sitting at an altitude of approximately 1,200 meters above sea level, Ruteng proudly defies Indonesia’s typical tropical weather. The air here is beautifully crisp, cool, and incredibly refreshing.
​The most magical moment in Ruteng happens in the early mornings. As the sun slowly climbs behind the massive peaks of the surrounding volcanic hills, a thick, white blanket of fog gently rolls through the empty streets and covers the town's rooftops. It creates a mysterious, calm, and almost cinematic atmosphere. In this town, a thick jacket and a warm cup of local Flores coffee are not just options—they are your best companions to start the slow-living day.
​The Capital of Serenity and Heritage
What truly defines Ruteng is its deep-rooted tranquility and slow pace of life. Unlike the chaotic traffic and loud noises of modern big cities, life in Ruteng feels deeply grounded and peaceful. The town itself is beautifully laid out, surrounded by lush green valleys, steep mountains like Poco Likang, and the historical footprints of the Manggarai culture.
​Every corner of Ruteng breathes a quiet charm. Whether it is the sound of church bells echoing through the cold air, the gentle smiles of the local people welcoming you, or the magnificent sight of misty hills enveloping the neighborhood, this place feels like a sanctuary for the soul. It is a perfect destination for those looking to disconnect from the modern rush and reconnect with nature.
​I have captured a glimpse of this peaceful highland magic from above. Check out the short cinematic aerial view below to feel the chilly morning atmosphere of Ruteng!
​https://3speak.tv/shorts?v=yordan96/65tg7vtk
​Thank you for reading my story, and I hope this video can bring a piece of Ruteng’s serenity directly to your screen. If you ever travel across Flores, make sure to slow down, stop by this beautiful town, and breathe the crisp mountain air.

What motivates me to go out every day with my camera is the unexpected: the reactions, the fleeting moments. Not every day is a good day, but every single day has something waiting to be discovered. title.title: A Failed Rescue. (TLOZ: The Wind Waker)
title.body: Hellow gente gaming de Hive, espero que esten bien, doy paso a el segundo post de TLOZ: The Wind Waker.\n\n<span class=\
>Hellow my Hive Gaming people, I hope you’re doing well. I now move on to the second post of TLOZ: The Wind Waker.\n\n
>Con el objetivo de salvar a su hermana, Link emprende un viaje con los piratas y el primer destino seria la isla del diablo, donde se rumorea que retienen a todos los prisioneros.
>With the goal of saving his sister, Link embarks on a journey with the pirates, and their first destination would be the Forsaken Fortress, where it is rumored all the prisoners are being held.

>Debido a un pequeño desajuste en el plan de ejecución para ingresar a la isla, Link pierde su espada y el juego te hace ver totalmente vulnerable, impidiendo incluso que puedas huir si un enemigo te tiene en su campo de visión. Y es aquí donde se emplea una mecánica un tanto diferente a los que nos tiene acostumbrado esta saga pero que dicha mecánica no es la primera vez que se utiliza porque también la vimos en la Ocarina del tiempo. A ver, hablo de ese modo de juego que tendremos que pasar desapercibido con sigilo para que no nos detecten.

>Due to a slight mishap in the execution plan to enter the island, Link loses his sword, and the game makes you feel completely vulnerable, even preventing you from escaping if an enemy has you in their line of sight. This is where a somewhat different mechanic is employed compared to what this saga usually offers, though it’s not the first time we’ve seen it, since it also appeared in Ocarina of Time. I’m talking about that gameplay style where you must remain unnoticed, using stealth so you won’t be detected.

/>

En fin, tendremos que pasar a escondidas, evitando los focos y escondiéndonos dentro de barriles hasta llegar a la cima de la fortaleza.

<span class=\
>In the end, we’ll have to sneak our way through, avoiding the spotlights and hiding inside barrels until we reach the top of the fortress.\n\n

>Luego de llegar al objetivo nuestra misión se ve obstaculizada por un pajaro gigante que nos expulsa de la isla. En el mar, a merced del inmenso océano nos rescata un barco parlante que, como no puede faltar en ningún juego de la saga Zelda, nos ah de acompañar en toda la aventura.

>After reaching the objective, our mission is hindered by a giant bird that expels us from the island. At sea, at the mercy of the vast ocean, we are rescued by a talking boat which, as is tradition in any Zelda game, will accompany us throughout the entire adventure.

>Bueno, llegamos a la isla que es el centro de comercio de todo el juego. En esta abundan misiones secundarias y recursos para abastecernos, vamos, para que nos podamos desviar un poco de la historia principal. Luego de dar un par de vueltas y darme cuenta que apenas puedo hacer algo porque estoy prácticamente en el inicio del juego, conseguí una cámara fotográfica. Nos hicimos con la vela y partimos hacia el mar a nuestro primer destino. Que cual era? ni idea, supongo que lo sabre en el próximo post.

>Well, we arrive at the island that serves as the trading hub of the entire game. Here, side quests and resources abound to keep us supplied—basically, to let us wander a bit away from the main story. After roaming around and realizing I can barely do anything since I’m practically at the beginning of the game, I managed to get a camera. We also obtained the sail and set off into the sea toward our first destination. Which one was it? No idea—I guess I’ll find out in the next post.

\n\n

/>

Bueno chicos, hasta aqui el post de hoy, gracias por acompañarme en esta aventura animada. Que tengan lindo dia. Nos vemos en la proxima.

<span class=\
>Well guys, that’s it for today’s post. Thank you for joining me in this lively adventure. Have a great day, and see you next time.

title.title: Just sublime
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWeeKQKHSgXcepbNyY6WWNwNdHFBcWpvgr2ici8Y4BWP3/1779573382912.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZRqFGNUzCoegvdao2vGN8Bbzp6CF2gMMLBjXJ87uDRHf/1779573404473.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYKhVuC49wim3CsicHcSr3mJBNMt5L2dyy8ALNFFuaEBv/1779573429826.jpg)




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcJ8ReB8XDoTJS1gcMTykVBuPSxPuVUuDGsD1RuKdf1KW/1779573451717.jpg)


What do you think? Isn’t it beautiful? I assure you that the reality was even more impressive than what the photograph can show.

I would have truly loved to have more powerful equipment to faithfully capture all the nuances of this exceptional sky.

However, even if the image does not fully do the scene justice, it still gives a sense of its unique beauty. At sunset, the sky turns into a living masterpiece. The colors blend gently, shifting from warm, bright tones to deeper, more soothing shades.

You can also notice, within this celestial composition, subtle colored circles, perhaps formed by the movement of clouds or by light itself passing through the atmosphere. Whatever their origin, the result remains unique and fascinating.

What makes this spectacle even more striking is its fleeting nature. Everything changes so quickly, in just a few moments: the shapes transform, the colors fade, and the sky already takes on a new appearance.

It is a fleeting, almost unreal beauty that reminds us how unpredictable and artistic nature truly is.

////
Qu’en pensez-vous ? N’est-ce pas magnifique ? Je vous assure que la réalité était encore bien plus impressionnante que ce que la photographie peut laisser entrevoir.

J’aurais sincèrement aimé disposer d’un équipement plus performant afin de capturer fidèlement toutes les nuances de ce ciel exceptionnel.

Cependant, même si l’image ne rend pas pleinement justice à la scène, elle permet tout de même d’en percevoir la beauté singulière. Au moment du coucher du soleil, le ciel se transforme en une véritable œuvre vivante. Les couleurs s’entrelacent avec douceur, passant de tons chauds et lumineux à des nuances plus profondes, presque apaisantes.

On distingue également, dans cette composition céleste, de subtils cercles colorés, peut-être créés par le jeu des nuages ou par la lumière elle-même en traversant l’atmosphère. Quelle qu’en soit l’origine, le résultat demeure unique et fascinant.

Ce spectacle est d’autant plus saisissant qu’il est éphémère. Tout évolue rapidement, en quelques instants à peine : les formes se transforment, les couleurs s’atténuent, et le ciel adopte déjà une nouvelle identité.

C’est une beauté fugace, presque irréelle, qui rappelle à quel point la nature est à la fois imprévisible et profondément artistique.

title.title: When mistake that almost stopped me from driving again
title.body:
![1001365807.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/corneliusoke/1001365807.png) Hello everyone, welcome to my blog. Sometimes in life we are faced with some challenges or situations that keep us stuck down memory lane and so make it difficult for us to face future challenges head-on. Growing up as a child, I always fancied the idea of driving, and each time I saw my dad driving, I would imagine myself on the steering wheel. When I turned 18, my dad started to teach me how to drive using his car, which was an automatic car, and I started getting really comfortable moving the car around. I was so excited that I was finally learning to drive that I literally started washing the car as a morning routine just to make my dad allow us to go for the next driving class. I got carried away after a few months of driving classes, and where my dad parks the car is a really tight angle, so if he lets me drive, he would be the one to park the car. Until one day we got back, and he showed me the technique that he used to park the car, and after parking, I felt like a superhero, and the next day my dad praised me for learning so quickly. And then he wanted to bring the car out, but I insisted I could, and unlike him, he didn't resist, so I got in the car, started it, and started backing out. Now there was drainage on both sides of the road, which meant I had to cross a small concrete slab that was constructed over the drainage. As soon as I was out, instead of stepping on the brake, I accidentally stepped on the accelerator, and the next minute, one tire of the vehicle was in the gutter. It happened so fast that the whole incident sent chills down my spine. I came out from the vehicle literally shaking with fear for what my dad would do to me and also for the fear that I must have damaged something. ![1001364020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/corneliusoke/1001364020.jpg) But luckily nothing was damaged, and instead of being mad at me, my dad actually made a joke of me and laughed at me while also encouraging me that it was a mistake. But I took it seriously, and the shock made me not touch the steering wheel for months because that day's event kept playing in my head. But thank God my dad kept talking to me and telling me I could do it and kept saying things like who will drive me when I finally get my car. Those words made me man up, and gradually I was able to start driving again, and since then I have driven quite a number of times and still do. In the end, we all have had moments that have made us take some decisions to protect ourselves, but sometimes if you don't face those fears, you can't move beyond where you are. And trust me, facing those fears doesn't come so easily; we have to deliberately seek help sometimes, speak words of affirmation, and go for therapy sessions to overcome them. Thanks for stopping by. The first image was generated using AI, and the second image is mine.
Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@corneliusoke/when-mistake-that-almost-stopped-me-from-driving-again-enw)

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Kyle Busch’s death wasn’t some vague “medical episode.” His family says the 41-year-old former NASCAR star died from **severe pneumonia that progressed into sepsis** — fast, brutal, and devastating. That’s the headline, and it hit the sport like a truck.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The sequence matters. Busch was hospitalized with what the family first described as a serious illness and withdrew from Charlotte weekend activities. Later details said he became unresponsive while testing a racing simulator in Concord, North Carolina. The family’s updated statement says the pneumonia spiraled into sepsis, causing rapid complications.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The article also shows this didn’t come completely out of nowhere. Busch had been dealing with a sinus issue for days, and it was noticeable during recent race weekends. At Watkins Glen on May 10, he said he needed to see a doctor, and by the All-Star Race last Sunday he was still coughing and clearly not right. What looked like “just a sinus problem” turned into something far more serious.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 On the racing side, the loss is massive. Busch was a **two-time Cup Series champion** (2015, 2019), sat **ninth all-time in Cup wins with 63**, and owned **234 wins across NASCAR’s top three national series** — the most ever. “Rowdy” wasn’t just successful; he was one of those drivers people loved, hated, argued about, and never ignored. That’s star power.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 The human part is the one that lands hardest: he leaves behind his wife Samantha, son Brexton, and daughter Lennix. The stats make the Hall of Fame case. The family statement makes the tragedy real. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/23/sports/cause-of-death-revealed-for-ex-nascar-star-kyle-busch/)\n\n#threadstorm
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Two Mets icons walk into the Hall of Fame still sounding like old roommates, not polished legends. That’s the fun part here: Bobby Valentine and Lee Mazzilli aren’t giving museum answers — they’re reliving the weird, funny, messy human side of baseball. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/23/sports/bobby-valentine-lee-mazzilli-reflect-on-core-mets-memories-and-beyond/)
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 The core of it is their bond. They clicked instantly as Mets teammates in the late ’70s, and both frame it as one of those immediate locker-room connections that just made sense. Valentine jokes that Mazzilli was already “that dude” while he was barely hanging on after a broken leg, but the respect is obvious. It reads less like nostalgia theater and more like two guys who actually lived through some shit together.

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The best story is brutal and perfect: Mazzilli is literally out on the beach with Valentine when he gets the call that he’s been traded to Texas. That’s baseball in one ugly snapshot — one minute you’re living your life, the next the business side smacks you in the face. Mazzilli says that first trade is the hardest because players still carry the fantasy they’ll stay with one team forever. They usually don’t. Baseball can be sentimental in public and cold as ice in private.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 There’s also a great window into old Mets chaos. They laugh about Joe Torre’s strange stint as player-manager in 1977, including a moment where the team apparently took the field with only eight players and Valentine had to sprint off to find Ed Kranepool. That’s the kind of story fans love because it reminds you these teams weren’t always clean, mythic machines — sometimes they were glorified improv with uniforms.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 The emotional weight lands hardest around bigger baseball memories. Valentine talks about watching Mazzilli homer in the 1979 All-Star Game like a proud parent, while both men revisit the 1986 Mets with a mix of joy and honesty. Even in victory, Valentine admits Bill Buckner’s infamous error complicated the moment for him because of their personal history, and Mazzilli goes out of his way to defend Buckner as a great player treated unfairly. That’s the thread running through the whole piece: memory without bullshit, affection without pretending the game was ever simple. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/23/sports/bobby-valentine-lee-mazzilli-reflect-on-core-mets-memories-and-beyond/)\n\n#threadstorm
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 1/5 🧵 Game 3 isn’t just “important” — it’s the hinge of the entire series. The Knicks are up 2-0, but nobody on either side is pretending Cleveland is dead. The Cavs already climbed out of an 0-2 hole once this postseason, and that makes Saturday less of a coronation and more of a pressure test for New York.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 2/5 🧵 Cleveland’s case is pretty simple: they’ve done this before, and they’ve been nasty at home. Dan Gilbert publicly pushed the “we’ve seen this movie” line, and Donovan Mitchell backed it up — the Cavs have already survived two Game 7s and don’t see 0-2 as some impossible cliff. Their formula is blunt: defend home court twice, turn it into a best-of-3, then drag the Knicks into deep-water stress.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 3/5 🧵 The home-court angle matters. Cleveland is 6-1 at Rocket Arena this postseason, with only one home loss noted in the previous round. That’s why Game 3 carries so much weight: a Cavs win resets the mood instantly. Suddenly it’s 2-1, Cleveland has life, and the Knicks head into Game 4 with the series no longer feeling under control. One result, totally different emotional landscape.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 4/5 🧵 The article also throws a little cold water on New York’s 2-0 lead. Yes, the Knicks are rolling — nine straight wins and flirting with their first Finals trip this century — but Game 1 was basically stolen with a huge comeback after Cleveland controlled most of it. That’s the warning label here: a 2-0 lead can look dominant on paper while still being fragile if one of those wins came from surviving rather than dictating.
title.author: askrafiki

title.body: 5/5 🧵 New York’s mindset is the smart one: Karl-Anthony Towns says they’re treating it like 0-0 and that the next game is the only one that matters. That’s exactly right. If the Knicks win Game 3, they’re basically gripping the East by the throat. If they lose, this stops being a feel-good surge and becomes a real series again. That’s the whole story. 📎 [Source](https://nypost.com/2026/05/22/sports/knicks-acknowledge-game-3-tall-task-given-cavaliers-proven-comeback-success/)\n\n#threadstorm

title.title: Solidaridad ante la indiferencia del mundo | Solidarity in the Face of the World's Indifference 🫂 [ESP/ENG]
title.body:
##### Solidaridad ante la indiferencia del mundo. 


![1000030337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23xARkCLp2DFJXpKF94RNMqZSNLSyn9Y1qB2AtygJ8AfZeTzcU5MambbvvYqsAmcrSp28.jpg)


Hola amigos de Holos & Lotus, espero que estén teniendo un bonito fin de semana. Yo he estado llena de tareas de la universidad pero siempre busco un tiempo para poder escribir en Hive. Estuve leyendo el post de nuestra amiga @damarysvibra sobre la solidaridad. Soy de las personas que en algunas ocasiones piensa que esa palabra es casi inexistente hoy en día dentro de la sociedad. Ahora que estoy estudiando se me han abierto muchas cosas que probablemente vine a sanar y también a aprender de los demás. Yo he tenido personas muy solidarias que me han ayudado en los momentos más difíciles y por esa razón pienso que deberíamos siempre tener la solidaridad y la empatía como parte de nuestra forma de convivir con otros. 

Recuerdo hace un tiempo que no podía valerme por mi misma, necesitaba la ayuda de varias personas para hacer cosas que en lo cotidiano podria ser normal. Fue una situación de salud que me enseño no solo a valorar la posiblidad de poder hacer las cosas por mi cuenta, sino también a aprender que la vida puede cambiarnos a todos en cualquier momento y que siempre vamos a necesitar de otros para avanzar y aprender lecciones importantes. Ese capítulo de mi vida me hizo ser menos egocéntrica, menos reactiva, menos egoísta. Al darme cuenta de que antes era de muchas maneras una persona desagradecida y también una persona que no aceptaba lo que Dios me había dado. 

Recuerdo que aprender a caminar de nuevo me llevo a necesitar ayuda de los demás, sobre todo de quienes siempre han estado cerca y me acompañaron en ese momento. No es sencillo el verte en una situación tan vulnerable, nunca quería verme como alguien vulnerable hasta que la vida me hizo detenerme y aprender que no todo se puede realizar de manera solitaria. Aceptar que otros me vieran así fue difícil pero me enseño que la parte más humana de mi siempre había deseado el tener un tiempo de pausa, solo que la opinión externa y mi propia forma de ver la vida me hacían exigirme más de lo que podía dar. Detenerme me hizo reflexionar y aprender que no todo era malo y que había muchas personas solidarias ayudándome aunque yo nunca lo esperaba. 


![1000030336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/243M79UjmHdEEPEutMFhjH7PwWc4M3e71dkny8PJjd8qBjNwPmxbs192QKjCmA514SZ2M.jpg)

En la universidad hay una situación con un muchacho que está dentro del espectro autista, el tiene un gran intelecto, sabe muy bien aprender de cada tema que nos ha tocado, participa en clases. Pero tiene problemas de conducta, suele ser muy reactivo, se altera fácilmente y algunas veces no sabe controlar sus impulsos. En el salón la mayoría intenta llevar las cosas con calma, algunos mantienen de vez en cuando conversaciones con el, pero hay otros que prefieren no estar muy cerca de él y mantener la distancia. Esto es algo respetable pero también un poco triste en su caso, al intentar relacionarse y no conectar con nadie lo lleva a aislarse más. 

Esta situación me ha llevado a pensar en lo difícil que debe ser para el con su condición estar en la universidad y además adaptarse a conocer nuevas personas y además lidiar con todas las emociones que llegan de golpe y le generan ese malestar que siempre se le refleja. Veo que muy pocas personas tienen intenciones de colocarse con él en las pruebas o grupos de trabajo. Me toca una exposición con él y aunque al principio me sentí un poco nerviosa por no saber cómo abordar la situación, luego recordé que aunque nos genere cierto temor conocer personas con algún trastorno o neuro divergencia, es algo que indudablemente vamos a ver cómo futuros profesionales y debemos tener en cuenta la solidaridad y la empatía. 

Aunque es mi primera vez tratando con una persona con esta condición, decidí continuar con el trabajo en grupo y dejar que cada persona decida poner de su parte para que la exposición salga de la mejor manera, tomando en cuenta que el chico puede tener sus limitaciones pero también carece de inteligencia y puede hacer esto y muchas otras cosas si se lo propone. Entonces, pienso que ahora es que nos va a tocar ser más solidarios, no solo con las personas que tienen necesidades especiales, sino con todo el que nos toque relacionarnos. La vida no es solo lo que conocemos, hay muchas cosas en el mundo que necesitan verse con más sensibilidad y más solidaridad. Intento dar lo que alguna vez necesite y recibí, creo que así deberíamos ser todos cómo sociedad. 


![1000030338.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/245n1JiwCCYch3hdEMzXnrjV9tBvpK7Lh8VeQ9abbfDvq45UPa5HRAgt6vzuTHWsZsJVk.png)


##### Solidarity in the Face of the World's Indifference.

![1000030337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/23xARkCLp2DFJXpKF94RNMqZSNLSyn9Y1qB2AtygJ8AfZeTzcU5MambbvvYqsAmcrSp28.jpg)



Hello, friends of Holos & Lotus, I hope you are having a nice weekend. I have been swamped with university homework, but I always find some time to write on Hive. I was reading our friend @damarysvibra's post about solidarity. I am one of those people who sometimes thinks that this word is almost non-existent in today's society. Now that I am studying, many doors have opened for things that I probably came to heal and also to learn from others. I have had very supportive people who have helped me in my most difficult moments, and for that reason, I think we should always have solidarity and empathy as part of our way of coexisting with others.

I remember a time ago when I couldn't fend for myself; I needed the help of several people to do things that would usually be normal in daily life. It was a health situation that taught me not only to value the ability to do things on my own, but also to learn that life can change for any of us at any moment, and that we are always going to need others to move forward and learn important lessons. That chapter of my life made me less self-centered, less reactive, and less selfish. It made me realize that before, I was in many ways an ungrateful person and also someone who did not accept what God had given me.

I remember that learning to walk again led me to need help from others, especially from those who have always been close and accompanied me at that time. It is not easy to see yourself in such a vulnerable situation; I never wanted to see myself as someone vulnerable until life made me stop and learn that not everything can be done alone. Accepting that others saw me that way was difficult, but it taught me that the most human part of me had always wished for a moment to pause, it was just that external opinions and my own way of looking at life made me demand more of myself than I could give. Stopping made me reflect and learn that not everything was bad, and that there were many supportive people helping me even though I never expected it.

![1000030336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/243M79UjmHdEEPEutMFhjH7PwWc4M3e71dkny8PJjd8qBjNwPmxbs192QKjCmA514SZ2M.jpg)

At the university, there is a situation with a young man who is on the autism spectrum. He has a great intellect, he knows very well how to learn about every topic we cover, and he participates in class. However, he has behavioral issues; he tends to be very reactive, gets upset easily, and sometimes doesn't know how to control his impulses. In the classroom, most people try to handle things calmly; some occasionally have conversations with him, but others prefer not to be very close to him and keep their distance. This is respectable, but also a bit sad in his case; trying to relate to others and not connecting with anyone leads him to isolate himself further.

This situation has led me to think about how difficult it must be for him, with his condition, to be at the university, adjust to meeting new people, and also deal with all the emotions that hit him all at once, creating that discomfort that is always reflected in him. I notice that very few people have any intention of pairing up with him for exams or group work. I have an upcoming presentation with him, and although at first I felt a bit nervous about not knowing how to approach the situation, I then remembered that even if it causes us some fear to meet people with a disorder or neurodivergence, it is something we will undoubtedly encounter as future professionals, and we must keep solidarity and empathy in mind.

Even though it is my first time dealing with someone with this condition, I decided to go ahead with the group work and let each person choose to do their part so that the presentation turns out the best way possible, taking into account that while the guy may have his limitations, he certainly doesn't lack intelligence and can do this and many other things if he sets his mind to it. So, I think that from now on, we will have to be more supportive, not only with people who have special needs, but with everyone we interact with. Life is not just what we know; there are many things in the world that need to be viewed with more sensitivity and more solidarity. I try to give what I once needed and received; I believe that is how we should all be as a society.

![1000030338.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naath/245n1JiwCCYch3hdEMzXnrjV9tBvpK7Lh8VeQ9abbfDvq45UPa5HRAgt6vzuTHWsZsJVk.png)

Y la imagen de hoy es...
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/Eo8Tio46hy22URVVaqVzmKSKvGdDUh8D719ZfisEYm5q6qGRvam8CaNFT47pEMHP5E5.png) [Imagen propiedad de @lanzjoseg](https://peakd.com/@lanzjoseg)
![cooltext508815627578399.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/neotopher/23w2q3umScMb88D88A5khL8n7hDyQPfZKbt683F5buu2x3GqzwoFETYMwKDPbay7QkMTP.png)
Hace mucho mucho tiempo, una niña y su madre cruzaron fueron a una juguetería local en la ciudad de Maracay. En las vitrinas, peluches tejidos en hilos suaves se vendían con un 20% de descuento. Los ojos se posaron en un oso de peluche: Un pequeño oso polar abrazable. Con un susurro, la niña se acerco a su madre y le dijo: ***“Mamá, ¿puedo llevármelo?”*** Pero la respuesta fue un ***NO*** En ese instante, la tristeza la inundo, bajo el destello opaco de la negación, Se hizo un juramento. La niña se hizo la promesa. ***“Cuando sea grande, compraré todos los peluches que quiera”*** Y así se determino en convertirse en quien quería ser, su capricho infantil no disminuyo en su adolescencia, la llama se mantuvo encendida y ardiendo cada día. Pasaron los años, y la niña creció: Se convirtió en una joven adulta, funcional en el ritmo implacable de la sociedad. Sin embargo, en su corazón tenia muy presente ese pacto secreto. Su niña interior movía los hilos de su ambición. En algún momento tras conseguir un empleo comenzó a coleccionar peluches, compro cada uno para si misma en nombre de esa promesa infantil. Convirtió su departamento de soltera en un refugio de ternuras, al crecer, cumplió su sueño de la niñez. Cada abrazo que le daba a sus 83 osos de felpa antes de dormir, era su sueño hecho realidad. Una oda a la persistencia de un deseo puro. Y así, entre cientos de peluches, ella, como dueña de vida, vivió siempre rodeada de tiernos peluches cómodamente, sin importar lo que dijeran los demás de su extraña colección, ella estaba contenta a su manera.

The metal restraints clicked open, freed Abby's hands. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSzuKepRjX2VECYSgBcuf74VL3Ad62pQ3xbMYhhToaRhc/screenshot_17_.png) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma6LLYhMP9KGKUpbMAiHef1jksEtM4LEFiejzam2iy5Fk/screenshot_18_.png) Abby told Nora that she needed some medical supplies for Owen, mentioning he got basement syndrome from his recent severe injuries, which was a lie. And then Nora said Abby could find some medical supplies at the ground floor, mentioning if Abby get caught, Nora had nothing to do with this. We'll check what happens next in another post. --- Image Source: In game screenshots. End of the post. Peace. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=bong1011/6abab87f)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmekrYHLahrjcrCdZGauswtj55GiVrBzkQwRfKtZ8g17ze/1779576002135.jpg)
[Picture Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/person-holding-green-covered-book-aKjAbP8DrMw)

Two students - James and his friend Max were dragging a fancy thick cover notebook found lying on the corridor in front of their class. Everyone in the class was even surprised that these two fellows will be claiming ownership of a document, even though a fanciful one. 

The issue was degenerating to the extent of a fight which their Class Rep could not contain. He promptly collected the book from James who was initially the founder and handed it over to their head teacher. 

The next day, the head teacher stormed their class with the book in contention. As fate may have it both friends - James and Max was in the class. After general greetings and exchange of pleasantries the head teacher announced the reason why he was in their class that morning.and requested the two friends to present evidence of ownership so as to legally lay claim to the book.

Everyone was quiet as the sonorous voice of the teacher could be heard. The two waring friends did not budge. Everyone in the class became amused by their sudden and surprised silence. None of them came forward to claim the book with evidence of any sort. 

With the sudden silence Anne stood and said \

. Everyone looked towards her corner with some even laughing heartily. The whole affair has taken a new dimension. Another 'mysterious' owner had appeared.

But Anne did not budge. She maintained her stance and to buttress her point she produced a copy of a receipt bearing her name which also stated that the bearer had bought five copies of fancy thick cover notebooks.

Anne handed the receipt to the head teacher for examination and as that was going on she opened her bag and brought out two other copies of fancy thick cover notebooks which is very similar with the one in contention. The head teacher scrutinized the two and even showed the class to also check. 

There was an irresistible conclusion that the notebook belongs to her. The head teacher then gabe it to her and the whole class erupted into wild laughter of joy.

title.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - I am the owner
title.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - I am the owner. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSRYIMQiQqIPBbh3DltGX6fczlHCMzSaZugJGuFmxItig&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSRYIMQiQqIPBbh3DltGX6fczlHCMzSaZugJGuFmxItig&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSRYIMQiQqIPBbh3DltGX6fczlHCMzSaZugJGuFmxItig&s=10)

Taking ownership is something everyone must learn as we grow up. It's a responsibility and also aer character trait. Everything has 2 sides, thus the same apply to taking ownership. We have to aswer for both the great and the undesirable outcome, whichever way the result turn out to be. 

When you say I am the owner and stake claim to a item. You are in another chance declaring you are answerable to the event that's related to it.

I recalled the pet phase of my former colleague was to ask, who owns this item in meeting when an action item pop up in the meeting, and he will note it down in the minutes of meeting. Thus based on this record, the next meeting owers would be invited to provide updates.

Another factor that gave rise to ownership declaration is from the rise of terror related attacks, thus when we enter enclosed area, we should not leave our belongings unattended, as this give rise to fear and tension, and when you say I am the owner when authority are involved then you might be required to provide statement.

Therefore, please bear in mind, I am the owner comes with responsibility.

title.title: [ES/EN] Splinterlands | Hunting Merits: Opening Chests to Reach My 100 Gladius Case Goal!
title.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdECnC97d9o9MQve4Qy31oiir5AEb6vtcmBcBDVabHv8w/Portada%20-%20Hunting%20Merits.png</center>

<center>A few days ago, I shared with you a detailed breakdown of my Gladiator card collection in my post titled [**My Collection of Gladiator cards – May 2026 - Season 159**](https://hive.blog/hive-13323/@durlan/esen-my-collection-of-gladiator-cards-may-2026-season-159-lnb). In that post, I told you about a goal I set for myself in the game: to carry out a massive opening of **100** Gladiator packs all at once. Without a doubt, these cards linked to Guild battles and the Brawls format are an indispensable pillar for any competitive player, but accumulating the necessary amount of resources to upgrade them to maximum level is a feat that is no easy task.</center>

><center>Hace unos días compartí con ustedes un desglose detallado de mi colección de tarjetas Gladiators en mi publicación titulada [**My Collection of Gladiator cards – May 2026 - Season 159**](https://hive.blog/hive-13323/@durlan/esen-my-collection-of-gladiator-cards-may-2026-season-159-lnb). En ese post les comenté sobre una meta que me he propuesto en el juego: llevar a cabo un opening masivo de **100** packs Gladiators de una sola vez. Sin duda, estas cartas ligadas a las batallas de Guild y al formato Brawls son un pilar indispensable para cualquier jugador competitivo, pero acumular la cantidad necesaria de recursos para subirlas a nivel máximo es una hazaña que no es tarea nada fácil.</center>

<center>To open **100** Gladiator packages, an astronomical amount of Merits is required. Specifically, my current objective is to calculate real progress and determine how close this opening session left me to completing the remaining **64,000** Merits I need to reach my goal. One of the most logical paths in the current game economy is to go to the rewards shop and spend our Glints on **Ultimate Chests**, known for housing large sums of Merits. However, chance in **Splinterlands** chests always holds surprises, and in this article, we will analyze with mathematical precision the results, the theoretical probabilities versus the reality of my account, and a surprising finding of efficiency when comparing **Ultimate Chests** with **Major Chests**.</center>

><center>Para abrir **100** paquetes Gladiators se requiere una cantidad astronómica de Merits. Específicamente, mi objetivo actual es calcular el progreso real y determinar qué tan cerca me dejó esta sesión de apertura de completar los **64,000** Merits restantes que necesito para alcanzar mi meta. Una de las vías más lógicas en la economía actual del juego es acudir a la tienda de recompensas y gastar nuestros Glints en **Ultimate Chests**, conocidos por albergar grandes sumas de Merits. Sin embargo, el azar en los cofres de **Splinterlands** siempre guarda sorpresas, y en este artículo analizaremos con precisión matemática los resultados, las probabilidades teóricas frente a la realidad de mi cuenta, y un sorprendente hallazgo de eficiencia al comparar los **Ultimate Chests** con los **Major Chests**.</center>

### <center>The Prior Mathematics: Theoretical Expectation (Optimistic vs. Pessimistic) | Las Matemáticas Previas: Expectativa Teórica (Optimista vs. Pesimista)</center>

<center>Before showing what was obtained in my chests, it is essential to sit down with pencil and paper to understand what we are facing. The official statistics of **Splinterlands** stipulate that **Ultimate Chests** have a **15%** probability of containing Merits.</center>

><center>Antes de mostrar lo obtenido en mis cofres, es fundamental sentarse con lápiz y papel para entender a qué nos enfrentamos. Las estadísticas oficiales de **Splinterlands** estipulan que los **Ultimate Chests** tienen una probabilidad del **15%** de contener Merits.</center>

<center>If we apply this mathematical constant to a closed lot of **30** **Ultimate Chests**, theory tells us that the exact average appearance should be **4.5** chests rewarded with this resource. Since we cannot open half a chest in the game, I structured my projections using two realistic scenarios based on variance: a pessimistic framework of **4** chests and an optimistic framework of **5** chests. Knowing that each **Ultimate Chest** configured with Merits grants a minimum of **1,000** and a maximum of **3,000** Merits, these were my statistical expectations:</center>

><center>Si aplicamos esta constante matemática a un lote cerrado de **30** **Ultimate Chests**, la teoría nos dice que el promedio exacto de aparición debería ser de **4.5** cofres premiados con este recurso. Dado que no podemos abrir medio cofre en el juego, estructuré mis proyecciones utilizando dos escenarios realistas basados en la varianza: un marco pesimista de **4** cofres y un marco optimista de **5** cofres. Sabiendo que cada **Ultimate Chest** configurado con Merits otorga un mínimo de **1,000** y un máximo de **3,000** Merits, estas eran mis expectativas estadísticas:</center>

- **The Most Pessimistic Scenario (Bad Luck)**: Obtaining only **4** rewarded chests, and having all of them drop the minimum of **1,000** Merits. This would give me a guaranteed floor of **4,000** Merits.

>- **El Escenario Más Pesimista (Mala Suerte)**: Obtener únicamente **4** cofres premiados, y que todos arrojaran el drop mínimo de **1,000** Merits. Esto me daría un suelo asegurado de **4,000** Merits.

- **The Most Optimistic Scenario (Good Luck)**: Achieving **5** chests with Merits, and having fortune smile upon me by giving me the cap of **3,000** Merits for each one. This ideal result would have catapulted me with **15,000** Merits directly into my balance.

>- **El Escenario Más Optimista (Buena Suerte)**: Conseguir **5** cofres con Merits, y que la fortuna me sonriera dándome el tope de **3,000** Merits por cada uno. Este resultado ideal me habría catapultado con **15,000** Merits directos a mi balance.

<center>Of course, this is a strictly statistical and linear calculation. In **Splinterlands**, there is always the latent risk of suffering a streak of terrible luck and falling below the minimum, or conversely, spending all the month's luck in a single afternoon to break the algorithm and pull out more than **5** rewarded chests.</center>

><center>Por supuesto, esto es un cálculo estrictamente estadístico y lineal. En **Splinterlands** siempre existe el riesgo latente de sufrir una racha de pésima suerte y quedar por debajo del mínimo, o por el contrario, gastarse la suerte de todo el mes en una sola tarde para romper el algoritmo y sacar más de **5** cofres premiados.</center>

### <center>Chronicle of the Opening: The 30 Ultimate Chests in Action | Crónica del Opening: Los 30 Ultimate Chests en Acción</center>

<center>With expectations clear, I proceeded to perform the opening of the **30** **Ultimate Chests**, divided into rounds or sub-openings to monitor the behavior of the algorithm:</center>

><center>Con las expectativas claras, procedí a realizar la apertura de los **30** **Ultimate Chests**, divididos en tandas o sub-aperturas para monitorear el comportamiento del algoritmo:</center>

## <center>**Opening #1 (10 Ultimate Chests)** </center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTx9XLWzVjN3gvVrsADJ9A8GSqkYK7F34FbaRNjiwtFVW/1%20V2.png</center>

<center>I started strong by opening the first decade. Fortune granted me one rewarded chest that added **1,973** Merits. A solid drop, very close to the midpoint of the possible range.</center>

><center>Inicié con fuerza abriendo la primera decena. La fortuna me otorgó un cofre premiado que sumó **1,973** Merits. Un drop sólido, muy cerca del punto medio del rango posible.</center>

## <center>**Opening #2 (5 Ultimate Chests)**</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXYccRWNgRh9ooKNFiAcwS4kyshcHdLM3BzZHKbVj6ZQ5/2%20V2.png</center>

<center>In the next reduced round, the streak remained stable and I got a second chest, this time with **2,122** Merits. Up to this point, the progression was going wonderfully.</center>

><center>En la siguiente tanda reducida, la racha se mantuvo estable y conseguí un segundo cofre, esta vez con **2,122** Merits. Hasta este punto, la progresión iba de maravilla.</center>

## <center>**Opening #3 (5 Ultimate Chests)**</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQ5TLiEgn7vXyEGANPRCBidkgKPnAvieHEhBjD4o5Bvd7/3%20V2.png</center>

<center>This is where the game's variance showed its bitterest side. The **5** chests were opened and the result in the Merits box was a resounding zero. Not a single Merit obtained.</center>

><center>Aquí es donde la varianza del juego mostró su lado más amargo. Los **5** cofres se abrieron y el resultado en la casilla de Merits fue un rotundo cero. Ni un solo Merit obtenido.</center>

## <center>**Opening #4 (5 Ultimate Chests)** </center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSMLEc3mFm6WyDK27k3hSoC93WND3HQng42KF9PX8TNj6/4%20V2.png</center>

<center>Repeating the previous dose, the cold streak continued. Another **5** chests opened and, once again, zero Merits for the collection. Frustration was beginning to show.</center>

><center>Repitiendo la dosis anterior, la racha fría continuó. Otros **5** cofres abiertos y, de nuevo, cero Merits para la colección. La frustración empezaba a asomarse.</center>

## <center>**Opening #5 (Last 5 Ultimate Chests)**</center>
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPu6NA17fbdyEXsVTNV1eDqa7pQsWmw6GZD2fg3Rzr6B3/5%20V2.png</center>

<center>To close this first massive batch, the final **5** chests somewhat relieved the drought by granting me a third rewarded chest with **2,632** Merits.</center>

><center>Para cerrar este primer lote masivo (Batch), los últimos **5** cofres aliviaron un poco la sequía al otorgarme un tercer cofre premiado con **2,632** Merits.</center>

### <center>Net Result of the First Batch (Ultimate) | Resultado Neto del Primer Batch (Ultimate)</center>

<center>When averaging the complete experience, the cold numbers demonstrate that my luck was notably below the theoretical average. Instead of the **4** or **5** chests dictated by the **15%** probability, I only obtained **3** chests with Merits in a total of **30** attempts. Fortunately, the individual amounts of those three chests were relatively high, which left me with a grand accumulated total of **6,727** Merits. Although I surpassed the floor of the worst mathematical scenario thanks to the value of the drops, the appearance frequency left me wanting.</center>

><center>Al promediar la experiencia completa, los números fríos demuestran que mi suerte estuvo notablemente por debajo del promedio teórico. En lugar de los **4** o **5** cofres que dictaba la probabilidad del **15%**, solo obtuve **3** cofres con Merits en un total de **30** intentos. Afortunadamente, los montos individuales de esos tres cofres fueron relativamente altos, lo que me dejó con un gran total acumulado de **6,727** Merits. Aunque superé el piso del peor escenario matemático gracias al valor de los drops, la frecuencia de aparición me dejó debiendo.</center>

### <center>The Unexpected Twist: Enter the 48 Major Chests | 3. El Giro Inesperado: Entran los 48 Major Chests</center>

<center>After exhausting my options with the Ultimate chests, I decided to change my strategy and give the **Major Chests** a chance. I began opening them consecutively until completing a total of **48** **Major Chests**. To my surprise, the luck that I had lacked in the first round manifested here, granting me a very striking accumulation of **4,028** Merits.</center>

><center>Tras agotar mis opciones con los cofres Ultimate, decidí cambiar de estrategia y darles una oportunidad a los **Major Chests**. Comencé a abrirlos de manera consecutiva hasta completar un total de **48** **Major Chests**. Para mi sorpresa, la suerte que me había hecho falta en la primera ronda se manifestó aquí, otorgándome un acumulado muy llamativo de **4,028** Merits.</center>

<center>This finding is highly interesting and deserves a deep technical analysis. Just like the Ultimates, **Major Chests** maintain the same base **15%** appearance probability for Merits in each slot. The fundamental difference lies in the fact that **Major Chests** grant a smaller amount of Merits per individual chest due to their lower rarity scale. However, when we analyze this from the perspective of Glints cost per resource earned, the outlook changes drastically.</center>

><center>Este hallazgo es sumamente interesante y merece un análisis técnico profundo. Al igual que los Ultimate, los **Major Chests** mantienen la misma probabilidad base del **15%** de aparición para los Merits en cada ranura. La diferencia fundamental radica en que los **Major Chests** otorgan una cantidad de Merits menor por cada cofre individual debido a su escala de rareza inferior. Sin embargo, cuando analizamos esto desde la perspectiva del costo de Glints por recurso ganado, la perspectiva cambia drásticamente.</center>

### <center>Economic Efficiency Analysis: Ultimate vs. Major | 4. Análisis de Eficiencia Económica: Ultimate vs. Major</center>

<center>For **Splinterlands** players, the numbers from this opening reveal an optimization factor that the community must keep very much in mind when managing their monthly Glints. Let us do the real mathematical comparison based on shop costs:</center>

><center>Para los jugadores de **Splinterlands**, los números de este opening revelan un factor de optimización que la comunidad debe tener muy en cuenta a la hora de gestionar sus Glints mensuales. Hagamos la comparación matemática real basándonos en los costos de la tienda:</center>

|||||||
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|**Chest Type** / Tipo de Cofre|**Glints Cost (Base)** / Costo Base|**Quantity Opened** / Cantidad|**Total Glints Spent** / Glints Totales|**Merits Obtained** / Merits Obtenidos|**Ratio (Glints per Merit)** / Ratio|
|**Ultimate Chest**|**10,000** Glints|**30**|**300,000** Glints|**6,727** Merits|**44.59** Glints / Merit|
|**Major Chest**|**2,500** Glints|**48**|**120,000** Glints|**4,028** Merits|**29.79** Glints / Merit|

<center>The analysis of the table is blunt. To acquire the **30** **Ultimate Chests**, a massive investment of **300,000** Glints is required, managing to harvest **6,727** Merits. On the other hand, when acquiring the **48** **Major Chests**, the outlay was just **120,000** Glints, managing to extract the remarkable figure of **4,028** Merits.</center>

><center>El análisis de la tabla es contundente. Para adquirir los **30** **Ultimate Chests**, se requiere una inversión masiva de **300,000** Glints, logrando cosechar **6,727** Merits. Por otra parte, al adquirir los **48** **Major Chests**, el desembolso fue de apenas **120,000** Glints, logrando extraer la notable cifra de **4,028** Merits.</center>

<center>Basically, by spending only **40%** of the Glints on **Major Chests** compared to what was invested in the Ultimates, I obtained around **60%** of the total Merits. This demonstrates that, due to the lower acquisition cost per unit of the **Major Chests**, the volume of attempts you can purchase allows you to cushion the algorithm's bad luck streaks much better, making opening **Major Chests** a substantially more cost-effective option for the pockets of Merit hunters.</center>

><center>Básicamente, gastando tan solo el **40%** de los Glints en los **Major Chests** en comparación con lo invertido en los Ultimate, obtuve cerca del **60%** de los Merits totales. Esto demuestra que, debido al menor costo de adquisición por unidad de los **Major Chests**, el volumen de intentos que puedes comprar te permite amortizar mucho mejor las rachas de mala suerte del algoritmo, haciendo que abrir **Major Chests** sea una opción sustancialmente más rentable para el bolsillo de los cazadores de Merits.</center>

### <center>Conclusion</center>

<center>Summing both efforts (**6,727** from the Ultimates and **4,028** from the Majors), this session left me with a total loot of **10,755** Merits. ---

<div class=text-justify>

Este 22 de Mayo se celebró a nivel Mundial el Pizza Day, también conocido como el Bitcoin Pizza Day. Un día lleno de fiesta y sí, mucha Pizza gratis. Pero como lo dije a través de un hilo en [mi perfil de X](https://x.com/i/status/2057853011750277150), más que pizzas, lo que se celebra ese día es el acontecimiento que cambió por completo como se veían las cryptos y el Bitcoin, haciendo posible un intercambio entre lo digital y lo real, convirtiendo así al Bitcoin en \

. En Portoviejo no podíamos dejar pasar por alto este evento, así que junto a PizzaDAO, celebramos el Global Pizza Party 2026, siendo el 4to año consecutivos celebrando la Pizza Party en esta ciudad, con la esperanza de motivar a más personas a sumarse al ecosistema Web3. |![1000987335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xVPiPSptHASRaLkv6jgPs9vCsbNRvcMRGgSuJjYrHmEXbVm82iFUpyU1kFgbn8Q8Sej.jpg)|![1000987337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wX38V7SEyDM2W3Rvc1Y1MUG635Bkg6UzeDuVrpBmXJDaWYgTpz88pjYgbtrWwneAPVX.jpg)|![1000987346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23tbppkcVCxwozmgHv95k49CwJQWvxVo4DDZPpc8BDVaHwUNLHwUrYQV1qVVpuLmdni56.jpg)| |-|-|-| ![1000987345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xp4AwBUp8u67y98PogwLupZQxLSQueDY7VLrtjaJphJx3NYGqzbn3Fe7BzV5wEaVhax.jpg) Nuestra reunión comenzó un poco tarde y con algunos imprevistos (a diferencia del año pasado). Por un momento me sentí en Venezuela, ya que justamente cuando estaba dando la Charla de apertura se fue la energía eléctrica, pero aún a oscuras y con las linternas de los teléfonos, seguí dando mi charla y educando a la comunidad presente sobre Web3, Blockchain y las oportunidades que tenemos. Algo muy cool, fue que aunque no teníamos Sponsor para hacer una fiesta más grande y con mejores cosas, se sumaron emprendedores de la ciudad ofreciendo un producto o servicio como premio y realizamos una rifa entre los presentes. Fueron 8 premios en total, para 8 diferentes ganadores. El momento de los premios fue el más divertido, todos querían ganar, pero solo 8 fueron los afortunados.
![1000987504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xySzUGatTWodAWKe8sU5Y9UVzAt7TzHbrkWTcJPY6TEUDtk6m46fQSWqa4C8Jnc3KoH.jpg)

También el presupuesto fue menor que años anteriores, pero se logró realizar la actividad con éxito, pese a algunos imprevistos, ya que junto con las pizzas, se restauró el sistema eléctrico. ![1000988052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xKvd8sCsZLuTpCq7drz4v9MTC4thGdrQbaMFXkQYF7p1yJK4AcLQXaZEUouzfrSALqG.jpg)|![1000988050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23uFRd3BQzcSpLTDYyfiApcDwrdShjFP41yX2np5xZx7uRa5QttYaQi9jA6WqfxDayijD.jpg) -|- ![1000987538.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23wqkWE8K2xaDLDSUgk1eho3Nfpt19KVYjfDQfPPH9PwebHH8CtSWy2JkVibKSJHygzuD.jpg)|![1000987412.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23ywnkGK3i7MYmh4vcogeqF6mpQLkTngZHEiwJXBWoUBf8QPwrku7iE7Dj7fUfHTw2x8S.jpg) A manera de reflexión: Cuando asistas a un evento cómo este, lleva tu mejor actitud, disposición y ánimo.
