title.title: A completed mission on a random Saturday
title.body:
by isalifestyle on Girly Isabella 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/girlyisabella [![A completed mission on a random Saturday](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/dd62bfcf-cf2c-4890-9927-49d6b6eb14c6.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/nsNvJokCBGvkEspScGu68j) 
 
 Yeah, I played football today just like I said I would yesterday 😑 

We got to the school field early, around 8am, like we always do. But when we got there, some girls were already on the field doing their training. There’s this unwritten rule on the field – if a group is there before you, you can’t just chase them off. You have two choices. Either you join them and play together, or you wait if you came with your own team and want to play among yourselves.

This time it was a training session, not even a match, so we couldn’t just jump in. That meant we had to sit and wait. We waited till about 9:45 before they finished and left. It’s normal there, whoever comes first gets first turn, so we just had to time them and be patient 😕

When it was finally our turn, we played from around 10 till 1pm. After that I went home, and from 1pm till about 6pm I was just on my phone, chilling. Later in the night I had to go to the kitchen and prepare something to eat for myself.

So that’s how today went. Most of the morning was just waiting, but at least we still got to play for a few hours. It wasn’t a bad day overall.
Thanks for visiting  
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/nsNvJokCBGvkEspScGu68j)

title.title: Traumatic Experiences
title.body: > Experience with trauma is never easy. It's not something anyone would ever want to go through. The post-traumatic effects are a lot to bear, manage or handle. Some go on to battle this for close to a lifetime. For others, it's a long period of time and for some who are fortunate to find some ways and help to curtail this, they experience it for a shorter period of time. The effects are however experienced and felt. Battling post-traumatic effects is one of the most challenging situations people face. It touches a person's psychological, emotional and mental aspects, and these parts of people are hard to fix, not easily at least. It takes some through therapy and for some even more than that to come out strong. Even strong people have been shattered by traumatic experiences, which leaves one wondering if there's really an exception. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQwRw4ktLj3J7GiabJw2bEC1vT7eQirx6ncwjYJ2ouDSU/anemone123_trauma_3491518_1280.jpg) [Image Source.](https://pixabay.com/photos/trauma-injured-tear-traumatized-3491518/) I've not quite had the experience of some sort. But I definitely had times and situations that took a toll on me, making me go into deep thoughts and considerations about the things in that regard. I can't help but imagine what it actually feels like for people who have really gone through trauma and the effects of this experience. I learnt this comes from the likes of the loss of loved ones, relationship and marital issues, financial matters, and so on. A few people have shared with me some life concerns and I could tell it was eating them up. I could also say it was traumatic for some. I've also heard of stories of what I could say was a case of trauma, though I didn't have direct knowledge. Some of these stories are of those who are into trading and somehow faced serious losses that nearly got them bankrupt or even did, in some cases. Not many might understand this kind of trauma, but traders do. Others are relationship and marital concerns. Like the story of a lady almost taking herself out of this life because the relationship that was leading to marriage failed at the brink of the wedding day. Or even the case of people finding out some unpleasant things about the person they were involved with, and such things got to them so badly that they couldn't just bear it, leading to trauma and serious effects. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmStxRsygGSpf8ifnpnSYx1TJVExQnhqAwur4BAamcBENz/photo_1638274749450_30c893afe3d1.jpeg) [Image Source.](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-woman-covering-her-face-with-her-hands-qL0t5zNGFVQ) For some, it's the toll of trying in life and not getting the result. Worse of all is when they have people around doing well with less effort. And to some of the most painful ones I've heard or witnessed, involving the loss of loved ones. I was at a place some months back and I heard of how a woman broke down due to the pain of the loss of her son. She had been bearing that pain since his demise and she had gotten traumatised by it. As I said, trauma isn't something anyone should want to go through. None of us would want even those we love to experience it. It can get deadly when not dealt with appropriately. When something involves a person's psychological and mental state, it can get ugly really quickly. So, therapy and some necessary measures should be made available to help people going through trauma. Even the comforting presence of others can help. --- ###### Thank you for reading!

title.title: Why some family members are never trust worthy..
title.body: Hello guys, good day all, welcome to my blog.. What will you do when you trust a family member to an extent of you sending him/her Money to build something for you,maybe a house, company, or a business, and after a long time you come back and find out that he/she did nothing, they have been lavishing you hard earn money on something else??. ‎

/>[img sur](https://unsplash.com/photos/two-boys-in-pajamas-standing-on-a-bed-VNvEI1AH4_4) ‎i will like to share a true story of an incident like this that lead to enemity and hatred between two brothers.. ‎a brother was working overseas, he has been there for years. one day, he contacted his younger brother and shared the idea of him building a house in his hometown, so he could come visit and feel comfortable. ‎His younger brother told him it was a good ideas and say he will love to support in anyway he could. the elder man overseas was very happy, then he began to send money to his brother, to contant an engineer and start the building.. ‎ ‎when ever the elder brother ask for a vedios, his brother look for a video of a building under construction and send to him. this continued for about six months and it's time for his elder brother to come back, he reaches his home town and his brother welcome him well, they ate and drank together.. it's was now time to show him his house, his younger brother took him to another man's house which is already furnished and told him it was his house. ‎he was happy thinking he now owns a house in his home town.. untill, the owner of the house came out and told him to go out he wants to drive out ‎the elder brother was shocked, and quietly went out to avoid insults.. ‎

/>[img sur](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-in-black-crew-neck-shirt-deKttEYFWjw)

‎He ( the elder brother) went back to the younger one and told him want happened then asked for his real house.. that was when his brother open up to him telling him he used the Money for his own house instead of his brother's house.. (if it was you, what will you do??)..

‎His elder brother became angry, because he spent millions of naira on his house project and we was duped by his own brother... But he did nothing to his younger brother, instead he vow never to come to his home town again..  
‎  
‎was that a good decision??

Thank you for reading...

title.title: My division 6 on efootball
title.body:
by Khing Addy on Adrians Lifestyle 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/adrianslifestyle [![My division 6 on efootball](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/3319a831-3c29-4380-b385-7df72fc5759f.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/tHpaBTkkTDnyHUS8RdHmBa) 
 
 Played a division game on eFootball today, Division 6, and it went better than I expected.

I’ve been trying to figure out how to play when the other person has a stronger squad than me. What helped today was keeping my defenders deeper, almost on the same line as my goalkeeper. When I do that, they don’t get dragged out of position easily and they stay more active. 

Once I set that up, I saw that most of their attacks were coming from my left side. Every time they attacked there, they were getting through and causing trouble. So I moved my defensive midfielder a bit to that side to give extra cover. He wasn’t sitting right in front of the defense the whole time, just shifting over to help block that wing.

That small change really worked. Normally in games like this, teams just run through my left side, but today they couldn’t break me down there. Because of that, my defense stayed solid and I felt more calm going forward.

I was leading 2-0 up to the 85th minute. They scored one late to make it 2-1, but I didn’t let it shake me. Then in the 90th minute I got another goal to make it 3-1. Their goal came from a mistake by their keeper that almost turned into an own goal, so I guess I got a bit lucky there.

In the end, the plan worked out and it felt good to see it hold up for almost the whole game. Winning 3-1 made today’s match feel really solid.
Thanks for visiting 😑🙂

title.title: My project: Chess and Maths /Mi proyecto de Ajedrez y Matemáticas
title.body:
** Greetings to all my Hive friends! Today I want to tell you a little about my project that I started this year, 2026. At the beginning of the year, taking advantage of the holiday period in the coastal region of Peru, and currently being in its capital, Lima, in the district of San Juan de Lurigancho, I noticed that there was no one nearby offering chess lessons. So I decided to combine several of my passions: teaching, mathematics, and chess. I mustered up the courage and commissioned a poster, which, after a bit of a struggle, turned out like this
        **
     
       Saludos a todos mi amigos de hive hoy quiero contarles un poco de mi proyecto que inicie este año 2026. Empezando el año aprovechando que era el  periodo vacacional en la región de la costa en Perú y actualmente encontarndome en su capital Lima en el Distrito de San Juan de Lurigancho revisando que no había nadie cerca que dictara clases de ajedrez  decidí unir varias de mis pasiones como lo son enseñar, las matematicas y el ajedrez. Me armé de valor y mandé a hacer un cartel que despues de batallar un poco quedó  de la siguiente manera
     


![cartel1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/odic3o1/23xyi7GW5RjA5guBJS3Wx1enb8KKfgaLkybZWccXuV8sDwRmqY4qve2sDk7KhGrmeyMzg.jpeg)

**I ordered a giant poster or sign, waited two days and they brought it to me. I put it next to my house where I live and where many people pass by.

**

Mandé a realizar uan gigantografia o cartel espere y a los dos días me la trajeron  y lo coloque al lado de mi casa donde vivo y pasa muchas personas. 


![cartelVentana1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/odic3o1/23wCDwHeTu3Jwi4HykpJxwn8DWVvCWACHfTuk4rVvAAffaSJWcmJZ2Z68fy3mRFnwPkD6.jpeg)


**In the afternoon, I bring out a table and stand next to the sign and explain to the neighbors what my project is about and how I want to help the children improve their understanding of mathematics and how chess complements learning, helps focus and teaches them life lessons such as time management, cause and effect, among others.

**
En horas de la tarde saco una mesa y me coloco al lado del cartel y le explico a los vecinos en que consiste mi proyecto y como quiero ayudar a los chicos a que mejoren su comprensión de las matemáticas y como el ajedrez complementa el aprendizaje, ayuda el enfoque y les enseña temas para la vida como uso del tiempo, las causas y el efecto entre otras.


![Cartelymesa.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/odic3o1/23uQvsFU6ckZAm7A2S4g899m25vkxzNtAmUsWQy2nLo26JrVVuN6zaQZXSJ2FoBDeU3np.jpeg)

**Little by little, they've started asking questions, and I now have four students I teach math and chess to on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays. I've been reviewing a lot of literature focused on teaching chess to young children. Now it's up to me to make chess and math a window and a tool for their lives, something they can then independently choose to do or develop.**


Poco a poco han ido preguntando y tengo ya cuatro alumnos que les doy Matemáticas y Ajedrez martes. jueves y viernes he estado revisando mucha literatura avocada a la enseñanza de parvulos y ajedrez. Ya que ahora de mi depende que el ajedrez y las matemáticas sean una ventana y una herramienta para sus vidas de forma independiente que decidan luego hacer o desarrollar. 


![alumnos.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/odic3o1/23xyNtog8Hs3rYebF1VKnPd2mpKfTwGKavzw3ZiRXui6QPgnTgreKUcvMFCu73ZWUDCvc.jpeg)

**I hope you like my project, and I hope to gather the necessary funds to purchase what's needed. Any suggestions or ideas are welcome. I hope to develop this initiative with the children of this community. Thank you for reading. A hug, and I'll leave you with my favourite proverb for chess: \

**


Espero les guste mi proyecto y espero reunir lo necesario para ir comprando lo que se requiere , cualquir sugerencia o idea sea bienvenida espero desarrollar con los niños de esta comunidad esta iniciativa gracias por leer un abrazo y les dejo mi proverbio preferido para el Ajedrez. \

> But after some time I understood something painful — people make time for what truly matters to them.

I read this and it just hit me how true this statement is.  Everything you talk about is truth.  I've always been the one in the past generally making the contact with a person or people, often coming up with no reply from them.  It really hurts when it's someone in your own family who should always make the time for you, just as I would always make time for them.

I can count on one hand, the number of people who I can truly call my friends.  I'm sure there are some with more than that, and maybe unfortunately, some with fewer.  Nonetheless, our joy in life should not be chasing after people who are supposed to care.

Thank you for writing this and hopefully, it will be food for thought for the many who might be dropping the ball in their own relationships with others.  Take care and have a lovely day!  !LADY

title.title: Vila Nova Foz Côa - City Center / Riding Portugal
title.body:
![COVER.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244yCXTVUCxgq7xmuqMd63jjpNsd9Sti2VoBeedtPR4vPduZsQ3xc9toVU7aeh3EpBaGA.jpg) ##### Hello everyone and welcome to my blog :-) Returning to Vila Nova de Foz Côa was a strange experience from the very first minutes. The only memories I had of that place came from childhood, already quite blurry, almost reduced to small, isolated images without much context. And perhaps that's why the initial impact was precisely that. Everything seemed smaller than what I had stored in my head. ##### PT Voltar a Vila Nova de Foz Côa foi uma experiência estranha logo desde os primeiros minutos. As únicas memórias que tinha daquele lugar vinham da infância, já muito desfocadas, quase reduzidas a pequenas imagens soltas sem grande contexto. E talvez por isso o impacto inicial tenha sido precisamente esse. Tudo me pareceu mais pequeno do que aquilo que tinha guardado na cabeça. --- ![20260328_151317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zktnidrfY1oQbePvdfzghgJfPVjYymkP6nKdTTwJv1C2dvWsvy7yZM2xgF27RPekF2x.jpg) ![20260328_151404.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xevCmmHNLnyUUypJTkr8J1y6HazNNfZNAuDRJvHKguGdg8itPFrzYphhFgyZJmnUTkx.jpg) ![20260328_151344.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xySz6kZT2GBsPVtUvKA1Zt88GvpELFnNLATMgaRJypMMpGRK6fxVZKEzEf3w7FW5ow1.jpg) ![20260328_151330.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xp8Z4VhHmVG1K5pxejHZExXjGgHs7R5jbPWXXwAANmGXvaJ4uDxARnhCvbfEkznFjCU.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) But this often happens when we return to places linked to childhood. When we are small, spaces grow disproportionately with us. The streets seem enormous, the buildings imposing, the distances endless. Then we return years later and realize that memory also exaggerates dimensions. ##### PT Mas isso acontece muitas vezes quando regressamos a sítios ligados à infância. Quando somos pequenos, os espaços crescem connosco de forma desproporcional. As ruas parecem enormes, os edifícios imponentes, as distâncias intermináveis. Depois voltamos anos mais tarde e percebemos que a memória também exagera dimensões. --- ![20260328_151530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23yJNkzwotq9Fsfi5CCSxyN9oPkovJUbvSmgNzRnSUCJSKumyXSEoQ3skEBptAZZ5k7br.jpg) ![20260328_151441.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zknCxqNBYRan1Q5GVJ9MYPf5GEAjmEEJ7y42XaMrwyVwuqidoVSeswEwR3PMQkWhsHB.jpg) ![20260328_151616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zm167VQXT42ek2961d7qFyoD3YtmqSwxf795eDPwDYp4o1FYYV2Wb9o7GB6bdovcjN5.jpg) ![20260328_151422.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xpAutbAKdZ6rDTDdip7QA9TFYszB7BTcnuLqgR48n9sJf7Xs61dDaRFrL9ehvKbEPH3.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) Even so, Vila Nova de Foz Côa maintains its personality. It's noticeable that much has changed over the years. There are more modern buildings and interventions that, in certain points, clash somewhat with the traditional architecture of the village. There are recent facades that are too neutral, urban solutions that are more functional than beautiful. Not everything fits together. But that's not enough to erase the character of the historic center. ##### PT Ainda assim, Vila Nova de Foz Côa mantém a sua personalidade. Nota-se que muita coisa mudou ao longo dos anos. Existem edifícios e intervenções mais modernas que, em certos pontos, destoam um pouco da arquitetura tradicional da vila. Há fachadas recentes demasiado neutras, soluções urbanas mais funcionais do que bonitas. Nem tudo encaixa. Mas isso não chega para apagar o carácter do centro histórico. --- ![20260328_151952.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23wMWWHSkr5msNovVNv9Zr7KdQQB3H53Xqu3La3hRfkmXYpALM5niDMcW5Vf371azMsbd.jpg) ![20260328_151801.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23x19PCKd4ZKvHFotAHGM27mZPnJ1ezCB834ajoAzBQDa8PxLaC5tX7b2V7NAvdXMcHEG.jpg) ![20260328_151624.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/241td42weWb7Hz72aQPX8ZVAGpYgGDJqnjkjXZvVHEUAGRXy8DtJSJJeaNgtXRnn5ph3k.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) It was precisely there that I began to recognize things. First, the Parish Church of Vila Nova de Foz Côa; just seeing it immediately brought a familiar feeling that's hard to explain. Not a concrete memory, but a kind of automatic recognition. The light-colored facade, the tower, and that square in front brought me a lot of nostalgia. ##### PT Foi precisamente aí que comecei a reconhecer coisas. Primeiro a Igreja Matriz de Vila Nova de Foz Côa, bastou vê-la para surgir imediatamente uma sensação familiar difícil de explicar. Não uma memória concreta, mas uma espécie de reconhecimento automático. A fachada clara, a torre e aquela praça em frente trouxeram-me muita nostalgia. --- ![20260328_152217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xyTCbVHPkG737s7XHn5RB4iCeHR6gD5w2YsbDkKbCHKPhGE8ShQndUg9US81GfZ7cY5.jpg) ![20260328_152239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xyUvQhBq2Py78mbP1yEZ4f1VKhtMUxupqxDsNnN8BGmUwQ3SDNXgzKSxPDatqRU78hw.jpg) ![20260328_152151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zGcDrQN7R8EfegRNAjawQiK9KgADmgndcd26pnq9rFDFc8TWPCd9HmVmUqHjCYxtEqh.jpg) ![20260328_152208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xL9XinduQBTQSAYrPQr8egHkYJ4cHhncdj382sLiDcKS8NVSSt2eBwqtCzriUasU1d5.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) I stood there for a while, observing the movement and remembering. People crossing the square slowly, short conversations near cafes, cars passing by in their routine. The atmosphere was calm, and that hasn't changed practically since my childhood. ##### PT Fiquei algum tempo ali parada a observar o movimento e a recordar. Pessoas a atravessar a praça devagar, conversas curtas junto aos cafés, carros a passar na sua rotina. O ambiente era calmo, e esse não mudou praticamente nada desde os meus tempos de infância. --- ![20260328_152319.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23yTb3LYH9Dtj3xpZAZWKykoFD1RdFZHoHyZpKRB6zgFLoKToXDTF1EYwAZhfZ9T9p25H.jpg) ![20260328_152306.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xefT94wGn8ANRVdjefuMdCAfEw9uf68ahCDk3ToDD1yDRSxh1LTmDX3r7qmMVVA32Md.jpg) ![20260328_152322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23yThMaADCdWfAf9Z8Lic9EqXbDK5AMg7CTPKXm8HyztHr1kCgdnp6GMv5dL9EeT543FE.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) The pillory of Foz Côa was another element I recognized immediately. I can't explain exactly why, but I have vague memories of running around it in some kind of game—I don't remember which one—or perhaps because certain images remain stored somewhere in memory even when everything else disappears. ##### PT O Pelourinho de Foz Côa foi outro elemento que reconheci imediatamente, não sei explicar exatamente porquê, mas tenho memórias vagas de correr à volta dele numa espécie de jogo, não me recordo qual, ou talvez porque certas imagens ficam guardadas em algum lugar da memória mesmo quando tudo o resto desaparece. --- ![20260328_152418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244oXBzjt8FU2WbfWyRjQDnRcDZdZsTAo18gefaLnuYWM28TEUo6omS88YpSRfA5xerV6.jpg) ![20260328_152434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/244UcyDKfwV73EqgxV3njSvmSeT3qrAEDfQizX1n1xAMZcLpCseKSd9RDNvAYhorbNPjG.jpg) ![20260328_152340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23vshsx9c8cHFH4ik8KMYuhPwyJkbD8uSpaKKdftzhBKB8Stbvo35PK7qPE4izFF7megj.jpg) ![20260328_152409.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/242Nj7GQSGGXbXsyAkr15q9xMoaRAA7F6nFNQUkk14N1UTLDEQKQLyPTcxgzuzisXdLFB.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) Further on, the 19th-century Town Hall building continues to visually dominate part of the historic area. I particularly liked the contrast between that more classic architecture and the simplicity of some adjacent streets. In certain places, the weight of local history is clearly felt. In others, one perceives an attempt to adapt to modern times that is not always very elegant. ##### PT Mais adiante, o edifício oitocentista da Câmara Municipal continua a dominar visualmente parte da zona histórica. Gostei particularmente do contraste entre aquela arquitetura mais clássica e a simplicidade de algumas ruas adjacentes. Em certos pontos sente-se claramente o peso da história local. Noutros, percebe-se uma tentativa de adaptação aos tempos atuais nem sempre muito elegante. --- ![20260328_152738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23ynSaVpqYHoDxaw74zZjdsAF8DFAZir5rsQhxxJLzWyCVGXvLuCtXyUktaAEst3gX5SA.jpg) ![20260328_152537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/242DNXKg55vWq5vfLwvcy5CLATJPbgkLCd6Sq7y9bnrFoEkMZh5xAg3AzEJiuM46hv8SR.jpg) ![20260328_152602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23yd69ikwnuX8QpzGPUUp1DQzdvMCKYcKGwErdUKc5T5TN5iTZ4EnD7bmYUWL8v7FwFQv.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) The smell of the heat mingled with the aroma coming from nearby cafes and restaurants. There was also that typical silence of inland villages during the afternoon, interrupted only by footsteps, doors opening, or more distant voices. ##### PT O cheiro do calor misturava-se com o aroma vindo de cafés e restaurantes próximos. Havia também aquele silêncio típico das vilas do interior durante a tarde, interrompido apenas por passos, portas a abrir ou vozes mais distantes. --- ![20260328_152909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zS5QN7UaxQtcKgdsv2XZ2oSgCWgVKUjfQiM36oR9G7FGrimoDcnUiKfHc71oSaQyuEH.jpg) ![20260328_152823.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23ywyUYczjksXtCTLwLzuXfnh19yj3ciy15FJW2BnH94eQA8tpJzw8dFgNCwJSQZ3jsQ7.jpg) ![20260328_152918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23y8wfRbiqh1d7Yy5ZdjkpZrcySuvDEkxGe53eGBU7YCM7CChJE1MmAag4oJMggoRAxGm.jpg) ![20260328_152926.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23x19Jmzk3i63Qah7Ey4DPaEdmVAhx2edJB5jKtzy7Kjn8JhEYGAP1V8kHE1v268W4CLZ.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) I sat on a bench for a few minutes and tried to understand to what extent those memories were real or reconstructed by nostalgia itself. I didn't reach any conclusion, but it wasn't important either. What I felt was simpler to explain. Although she recognized parts of the place, she was clearly seeing it for the first time as an adult. And that completely changed the experience. ##### PT Sentei-me num banco durante alguns minutos e fiquei a tentar perceber até que ponto aquelas memórias eram reais ou reconstruídas pela própria nostalgia. Não cheguei a conclusão nenhuma, mas também não era importante. O que senti foi mais simples de explicar. Apesar de reconhecer partes do lugar, estava claramente a vê-lo pela primeira vez enquanto adulta. E isso mudou completamente a experiência. --- ![20260328_152956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23xemsuUPpFkzWneTakNZLNHdMUXXZEx9M4DdY3QT1iRjUS73aGHrWnpUsVSrt6trLGsU.jpg) ![20260328_153106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23yJNv9bF2eVhEZk3F6cHoP8mNGEJcWDBiVp3tKJscbFNe4mNvUc49mJAyQgso59XnWdF.jpg) ![20260328_154417.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/23zkgBWkFVtU1Ktmhcq3oDXM8qB4EiWz4pKCxnbzFJRg43K8UyEL6Z5zQsMjehgG3EveR.jpg) ![20260328_154602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/242NmUc52ubCdHrW1zGygTCManVv6nkk6EGEoE1J2cucctgKcKyFq7Dmc3qdSYdMArXqK.jpg) ![20260328_154615.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/241QGrYvEDiyvEFfkEELsyW579VCrgaFMQGjEdMGrJPSzyXALE6jEbGgusKScVibab3UZ.jpg) ![Untitled-1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/onyfest/EnymeWrmhSU78wMzJahA3HNMn7fja3hxMQGfPEyMEZJM3KLTfXNA89yMUNpMgmZyvpY.png) It was a partial, incomplete reunion, but enough to realize that some connections remain even when almost all the details disappear. ##### PT Foi um reencontro parcial, incompleto, mas suficiente para perceber que algumas ligações permanecem mesmo quando os detalhes desaparecem quase todos.
I hope you enjoyed. See you around. Wishing you much peace and health > Those who pass by us do not go alone. They leave a bit of themselves, taking a piece of us.\
The Template cover used in this post is from Canva - Created by Misia\

body.title: I AM THE OWNER
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQAxyVQf1E6Q58de1twV4fQFU2FfT31Hz2QH5YyDUAsgk/1779568889333.jpg)
[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-close-up-of-a-person-wearing-a-bracelet-h_ssRPj8UZo)

I have been looking for my bracelet for a very long time now. I didn't know where it fell off. Maybe it was in the school or on my way to the house or I feel when I was playing football. I didn't know.

 Two weeks later, I saw one of the cleaners in our school holding a bracelet. It was as if she was looking for the owner of it. My friend called me to confirm whether it was my bracelet.  I rushed. My friend called me to confirm whether it was my bracelet. So I rushed. 

I went to meet the cleaner and asked to show me the bracelet. She showed me and I found out. And she asked who was the owner. I told her that I was the owner, that I'm the owner of the bracelet. She told me that she saw it at the walkway while she was cleaning. I was so happy. I thanked her so much. And she told me never to be careless next time. And that was how I found my bracelet.

body.title: 🏃‍♀ Hermosas Imágenes de Nuestras Runners 😍 con Nano Banana
body.body: /> * * * Saludos comunidad. Queremos compartir con ustedes, algo que hicimos con mucho cariño para nuestras corredoras. Esto fue un obsequio que nos ayuda a aumentar el sentido de pertenencia, hacia nuestra comunidad de Hive Run. Estas imágenes generadas con Nano Banana de Gemini, reflejan nuestro espíritu deportivo, dinámico y alegre. El promt lo ajustamos a nuestras características. Se incluyen los logos de @hiverun y de @lpgrunners en los casos que a meritan. Para las chicas de Caracas se eligió el Parque del Este, que es ícono reconocido del running en la capital. Prácticamente todo runner caraqueño ha corrido en el Parque del Este. También tenemos una hermosa playa de fondo, exclusiva para @mcookies que corre en Carúpano. Incluimos los logos a modo de Totem en 3D. Buscamos fotos con las camisas de marca, para que tengan sus uniformes. Aunque @erilej y @enmy que fueron las primeras, se les hizo con el último post en ese momento, luego Enmy pidió otra con la camisa de Hive Run. Las chicas de @lpgrunners tienen sus bellas camisas y totems de ambos logos. Estas se les hizo en formato vertical para que la luzcan en Instagram. Nos gustaría ver más aplicaciones de este bello promt. * * * @mcookies =========

> * * * Promt Nano Banana: ------------------ > Transforma la imagen de referencia proporcionada en una composición acogedora, al estilo de un álbum de recortes, conservando a la chica, la identidad y la iluminación de ensueño y el fondo del parque del este de Caracas. > > Añade varios personajes pequeños en «versión mini» de la misma persona (estilo chibi o de muñeco), colocados de forma natural por toda la escena (sobre objetos, un hombro, etc.). Estas mini figuras deben coincidir en todo momento con el rostro, el peinado, color de pelo, la vestimenta y el estilo de la chica, con un diseño de figuritas coleccionables en 3D. Muéstralas realizando diferentes actividades de running (estirando, corriendo, tomándose fotos). > > Superpón garabatos y anotaciones de estilo manuscrito por toda la imagen: flechas, corazones, estrellas, destellos, iconos y leyendas divertidas relacionadas con los elementos de la escena. > > Utiliza una paleta de colores rojo, negro y gris > > Mantén el encuadre visualmente rico y lleno, pero equilibrado y limpio. > > Estilo: iluminación cálida y acogedora, estética de álbum de recortes de Instagram de ensueño, profundidad de campo suave, muy detallado, pulido pero divertido. > > El resultado final debe parecer la MISMA persona original mejorada con mini alter egos y anotaciones estéticas. > > La chica (@enmy) está sentada en el césped del parque con su camisa naranja de HIVE RUN . A su lado está el logo grande de HIVE RUN como un tótem en 3D y todo el texto en relieve.

/>

Nos encantaría ver más creaciones con este promt (no solo de Hive Run), si te animas la dejas en comentarios 😍

This was easy to write, because I live so close to a boat harbor that feeds into the Atlantic Ocean. I'm so happy you liked this, because you certainly do know writing :)

body.title: Trauma Sticks to Us!
body.body:
![Yelllow and Blue Modern Geometric How To Design Youtube Thumbnail (50).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23xVEvvTiNxFhnDa28P1LzGU74CH3D7CGtKnR69JQXzEacQcFN7zBxorfeRoJEjie1eAw.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) Omo… PTSD is real ooo! And it’s something that, in one way or another, we experience. Even if we’re not the ones personally experiencing it, we know someone or a group of people who are suffering from one form of trauma or the other simply because of something that they were forced to endure in the past. It’s not a happy experience at all, because it can hinder the way we live the rest of our lives. Trauma is like a scar that, at select times, feels like an open wound. Sometimes, it’s just there, quiet and dead. And other times, when we get a form of trigger, we find ourselves back in the same scenarios, trapped in our minds as we struggle in a situation that, physically, we’ve already overcome and left in the past. PTSD is real, and for many of us, it follows us everywhere. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) For me, my own source of PTSD is the group of people that should never even be in such a conversation. And majorly Law Enforcement, especially police. One of the most dangerous phases of a man’s life in Nigeria is when he’s a young man. Because while he would have to be scared of bandits, terrorists, robbers, and cultists, he would also be scared of the Police, the drug agency, and EFCC. These guys talk about how they’re all our friends, but time and again, I’ve seen how they handle people and what they do to them. I’m not a fraudster nor do I take drugs, so I’ve never had an issue with the drug agency or the EFCC. I’m not a criminal either, but I can tell you that I’ve had multiple brushes with the police. And my crime? Just existing. Back when I was in school, you could simply be walking home from class, and a bus would pull up, and you’d be arrested. Just like that! If you try to resist, you’ll be beaten black and blue. ![IMG_20230528_113916~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/242rM25kCuPuDkPWm9n5gHpAAPogvwjTWUku1doohfp2fhue6c7LALoA4JzWXAQqJ3sb8.jpg) The most terrifying experience was when they had a raid in our lodge. Two brothers fought one Saturday morning, and it was a bad fight that involved knives. That morning, the police were called, but they never showed up. Not until midnight, when the brothers had already settled their fight, and everyone was sleeping. That’s when they came to the lodge. And they didn’t even go for the brothers who fought; they went from room to room, kicking doors in and looking for any reason to pick anybody. In my life, I had never been so terrified. Imagine sleeping peacefully, and then you wake up to hear someone kick your door in for no reason at all. But in my case, I wasn’t even asleep, so I could hear them moving from room to room, picking people up, as they came closer and closer. The only reason I wasn’t picked that day was that their shuttle bus was full. And that’s usually how it is. Many times, just being in the same vicinity as these guys is enough to get you arrested. This was one of the reasons I left Owerri the moment I graduated, because the trauma was just too much. ![IMG_20231108_155024~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23tbibjRyBKU1uU57GueHt8WJTEQkJJcRzxeqfUHYZGgmVfZE9gYw5VT4WyWvCRuma9KT.jpg) It wasn’t the one event for me, it was a series of events during the course of my time in school. And by the time I left, there were marked changes in me. As I speak to you now, when I see a black shuttle bus on the street, my heart would first of all skip. I can’t ever trust a Toyota Sienna. And then, every time I see an officer, I always mentally check myself, and I remind myself that I don’t have to run because I didn’t do anything. The amount of damage these guys have done to young men is just heartbreaking. And the frustrating thing is that there’s no point at all. Just for money! When you’re taken, if you’re innocent, investigations will not clear you. Your bail will. On another day, we’ll talk about how EFCC has a habit of breaking into people’s houses in the dead of the night. But for now, let’s just focus on the police. They remain my constant source of PTSD. ![IMG_20231116_202004~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23vhRXNa3ZmAs3xWVAM8BsZ6fD6z1CQ5Q59eLcLpwMbEQ5hHjVV8D4J4tAfDJrFmSekRG.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.
***
Watch My Engaging Stories on: [Facebook](https://web.facebook.com/brunokemaofficial), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@bruno_kema), and [TikTok]( https://www.tiktok.com/@bruno_kema?_r=1&_t=ZN-91fKKHrMpuw).

body.title: Dua Lipa, muchísimo más que un rostro y un cuerpo hermoso... [ESP[
body.body:
>Es joven, hermosa, talentosa, millonaria, inspiradora y sobre todo, el objeto de deseo de muchos. Sí, Dua Lipa es sin duda una de las artistas mejor posicionadas de la actualidad más reciente pero también de los últimos 10 años. De hecho, este post surge de la admiración que yo guardo hacia ella. Creo que es una mujer fascinante e impecablemente bella. Combina sensualidad con ese toque de picardía, que nosotras, las chicas amamos tanto. Pero estas líneas no van acerca de sus dotes como mujer, vamos, por su figura...

*\n\n*

>No, de hecho, me he inspirado en lo que ella es como cantante y artista. Que para quienes no la conocen tanto, es talento puro. Dejaré a lo largo y ancho del post clips donde se puede observar lo que su voz puede hacer. La nena puede bailar, coreografiar sus propios vídeos y provocar aplausos, gritos y arrebatos de idolatría pero sobre todo es una músico en todo el ancho de ese significado. Y ésto, precisamente, es lo que vengo a rescatar. El pop es un género que goza de una vanidad, que solo es igualado por quizá lo que podemos ver desde el reggaetón.

* https://youtu.be/fZB-ptAnoQc?si=zmq0ZDDzZizo51Eq https://youtu.be/Dnu1P0rzpmY?si=6UWGV2BYx9Fe8B1d *

>Sin embargo, del pop han surgido artistas tan incuestionablemente inmortales como: Madonna, Lionel Richie, Tina Turner e incluso, la magnánima Cher. Sí, podemos cuestionar algunos trucos de exageración de marketing que emplea comúnmente el pop como género, pero de que hay calidad, hay calidad... Oh, casi dejo afuera a la diosa de Lady Gaga...Grave error, no me perdonaría como fan si así fuese. Pero retomando, la enorme artista que es Dua Lipa, desde mi perspectiva se explica de entender perfectamente el mercado.

*\n\n*

>Para aquellos que no lo saben, ella es una artista desde hace bastante más tiempo de que se tiene consciencia... Hay vídeos musicales de ella, cuando la fama la había alcanzado todavía, y la diferencia entre lo que aplicó y lo que hacía en su momento es notable. No la hace ni mejor ni peor, sólo la hace más cercana a su audiencia. Que en definitiva es lo que hizo que explotará su brillante talento e hiciera que la chica despegara cual cohete hacia el espacio. Meteóricamente, se transformó de una chica con un tono más asociado al blues y al vibrato de Joss Stones (¿Se acuerda de ella?) que a la reina pop que es hoy.

* https://youtu.be/-rey3m8SWQI?si=q29LiUU_1lArNJP- https://youtu.be/57bNHupO3MU?si=Msq6bJ62a2Keqbei *

>¿Ese cambió la hizo mejor o peor? En mi opinión, indudablemente mejor. Las colaboraciones que ha tenido con productores como Calvin Harris, Snoop Dogg, y los mejores compositores dentro de la industria la han hecho pulir lo que naturalmente poseía desde su naturaleza como cantante. Jamás podría asegurar o decir que lo que ella como artista es un \

. Todo lo contrario, hizo una mezcla fascinante en la voz con poder y tonos nostálgicos de antaño con la vibra y estética del pop que todos nos imaginamos.

*\n\n*

>La voz de Dua Lipa hace que los escalofríos en tu piel sean incontrolables. Y eso sólo es posible cuando hay talento, belleza, técnica y muchísima ejecución. Cualidades que solo los verdaderos músicos poseen. La música no debería ser entendido como una especie de teoría \

, sino como lo que es; un ejercicio humano, subjetivo y de múltiples causas. Para algunos de ustedes, queridos lectores de HIVE y de esta comunidad, pensarán que ella es una artista más del montón, pero para otros, sonreirán al estar de acuerdo conmigo. Eso es lo hermoso de estar unidos por y para la música, ¿no lo creen?

*\n\n*

>Yo creo que el Reino Unido, (país de donde es originalmente Dua) es la cuna de mujeres con voces poderosas e impactantes. Amy Winehouse, Adele y Dua Lipa, son la Santísima Trinidad, para mí. Pero también está Lilly Allen, por sólo dar otro ejemplo menos conocido. Hay mucha fuerza, talento bien desarrollado y autenticidad en lo que vemos. Dua Lipa, amigos míos, es muchísimo más que lo que vemos en los videos musicales, es la habilidad, la belleza de su cuerpo pero la inteligencia de su naturaleza bien entremezcladas para ser disfrutado por nosotros, por mí, sin lugar a dudas; por todos, estoy convencida.

* https://youtu.be/j2QWHlKjBeY?si=EyeE4BAY33M9Eeld https://youtu.be/vZYVkitGXBU?si=Q_0dZxnuxP_D4rYN

body.title: Mi entrada al concurso TopFiveFamily Observa Piensa Escribe: De un peluche al amor.
body.body:
Esta es mi entrada al concurso #TopFiveFamily Observa Piensa Escribe, coordinado por @lanzjoseg.
<center>![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbUr42C5bYKnomd5HcxE1zZRZzv46u3AdaoeVsXJqNw5u/image.png)</center>
<center>Imagen propiedad @lanzjoseg</center>
# <center>***De un peluche al amor***.</center>

<div class=\

>Ver esta imagen me hizo recordar un pedacito de mi vida que quiero compartir con ustedes. Resulta que hace varios años yo asistí a una feria en mi pueblo. Entre las atracciones había una especie de bazar donde se compraban unos papelitos con unos números. En el momento de la ronda, el señor iba sacando números y, si coincidían con el que tenías en el papelito, te ganabas un peluche.

Fueron pasando rondas y yo no ganaba, pero un chico bien parecido se había ganado un Hello Kitty. Cruzamos miradas. Mi cara lo decía todo, la de él feliz porque había ganado. Me aparté del bazar, pero a los pocos minutos el chico se me acercó y me regaló el peluche que se había ganado. Me pareció un gesto muy bonito de su parte. Entablamos una conversación muy amena; intercambiamos números de teléfono. Nació una bonita amistad que, con el tiempo, se convirtió en amor. Un peluche llama la atención porque está hecho de tela suave y relleno de algodón o de alguna fibra esponjosa, y al tacto se siente la delicadeza. Por lo general, se regalan tomando en consideración el gusto por animales, personajes animados, que tienen el papel de adornar o ser un compañero emocional. Grandes o pequeños, son los favoritos para regalar en cumpleaños, día de los enamorados; son una especie de comodín: siempre serán bien recibidos. Así como hay personas que adoran los peluches, hay otras que consideran que quitan espacio en la habitación, que acumulan polvo y otras micropartículas que causan alergias.

body.title: Saturday blog 230526
body.body:
Its nearly the end of May and finally we are getting some nice weather. +22'C is a hot day for a Canadian like me, looking forward to the cooler evening breeze when the day is done.

I see some rain clouds 🌦 in the distance, providing some nice shade where I am right now. I stopped for a Barqs Slurpee. While I have been anti-plastic after last years research and detox, these paper straws are absolutely intolerable for slurpees. Luckily I found a spare plastic straw I kept in my bag just for an occasion such as this.

Using my soap and water spray bottle I thoroughly washed the plastic straw out, so now I can enjoy my Barqs ice beverage to chill my insides. I've also been dicing cucumbers and cantaloupe weekly as an alternative to eating candy and chips. I took a cellular health test at the end of December, and a follow up test in April with the results complete last week.

Some markers have improved, others not as much. Its good to have the baseline to compare the follow up with, and while I am a bit disappointed that there is still room for improvement, I processed my order and will resume taking the remedy. If I dont keep following through then minor improvements won't compound into major results.

So I continue working and taking my medicine, reducing my impulse expenses and try to exercise more. Big changes don't happen immediately, they take time and persistence and commitment to the choices I previously made. Can I stay accountable to myself?

A veces los antojos terminan convirtiéndose en pequeñas aventuras, y eso fue exactamente lo que nos pasó buscando tacos para almorzar en la ciudad. Después de nuestra primera parada en el bar Cafetería Fajardo, donde lamentablemente no tenían tacos disponibles en ese momento, recordé un lugar que desde hacía tiempo quería conocer: Álbum Café 1910, ubicado en la Plaza de la Marqueta, una de las zonas gastronómicas más movidas y bonitas de nuestra ciudad.

Sin pensarlo demasiado, mi amiga Yessica y yo decidimos ir hasta allí. Apenas llegamos sentí curiosidad por el ambiente, y enseguida supimos que habíamos tomado una buena decisión. Nos sentamos en la parte interior porque sinceramente no soy amante del resplandor ni del exceso de luz; prefiero los espacios más acogedores y tranquilos.

Desde el primer momento quedé encantada con la estética del lugar. Las paredes negras, los asientos verde oscuro, las luces cálidas y los instrumentos musicales decorando cada rincón le daban una personalidad muy especial. Era uno de esos bares donde dan ganas de quedarse conversando durante horas.

Claro, no pude evitar pedir un capuchino. Siempre ando en la búsqueda del mejor café de la ciudad, y este definitivamente me sorprendió. Desde que llegó a la mesa me enamoré de la taza, tenía una presentación preciosa, y el sabor estaba delicioso. Aunque debo admitir que todavía no logra superar el capuchino del Café Trovando ni el del Fajardo, sí se ganó un buen lugar en mi lista personal.

Finalmente llegó el momento más esperado: los tacos. Yessica y yo pedimos unos tacos estilo 1910, preparados con carne de cerdo, aunque también existían opciones de pollo y camarón. Para acompañarlos pedimos una piña colada.

Solo con ver los tacos me emocioné muchísimo. El olor era increíble y bastó la primera mordida para confirmar que habían valido totalmente la pena. La carne estaba muy bien sazonada y la salsa picante que servían para añadirle elevaba aún más el sabor. Honestamente, estaban deliciosos.

La piña colada también fue una experiencia agradable. Me encantó que la sirvieran en un recipiente con temática de piña, un detalle sencillo pero muy bonito. El sabor estaba rico, refrescante y natural. Quizás no era perfecta, pero agradecí muchísimo que estuviera hecha con piña natural, porque eso cambia completamente el resultado.

Entre música suave, buena conversación, comida rica y un ambiente acogedor, terminamos pasando una tarde realmente especial. Lo que comenzó como una simple búsqueda de tacos terminó convirtiéndose en uno de esos pequeños momentos que alegran la rutina y se quedan guardados en la memoria.

A veces no hace falta un gran plan para ser feliz. Basta una buena amistad, un lugar bonito y ese antojo que finalmente logra cumplirse.


# English Version 




Sometimes cravings end up turning into small adventures, and that was exactly what happened to us while looking for tacos for lunch in the city. After our first stop at Cafetería Fajardo bar, where unfortunately they did not have tacos available at the moment, I remembered a place I had been wanting to visit for a long time: Álbum Café 1910, located in Plaza de la Marqueta, one of the busiest and most beautiful gastronomic areas in our city.

Without thinking twice, my friend Yessica and I decided to go there. As soon as we arrived, I became curious about the atmosphere, and we immediately knew we had made a good decision. We sat inside because honestly I do not like bright glare or excessive light; I prefer quieter and cozier spaces.

From the very beginning, I was fascinated by the aesthetics of the place. The black walls, the dark green seats, the warm lights, and the musical instruments decorating every corner gave it a very special personality. It was one of those bars where you feel like staying for hours talking.

Of course, I could not resist ordering a cappuccino. I am always searching for the best coffee in the city, and this one definitely surprised me. From the moment it arrived at the table, I loved the cup presentation, and the flavor was delicious. Although I must admit it still does not surpass the cappuccino from Café Trovando or the one from Fajardo, it definitely earned a good place on my personal list.

Finally, the most anticipated moment arrived: the tacos. Yessica and I ordered the 1910-style tacos, prepared with pork, although there were also chicken and shrimp options available. To accompany them, we ordered a piña colada.

Just seeing the tacos made me really excited. The smell was incredible, and the first bite confirmed they had been completely worth it. The meat was perfectly seasoned, and the spicy sauce they served on the side made the flavor even better. Honestly, they were delicious.

The piña colada was also a pleasant experience. I loved that it was served in a pineapple-themed container, a simple but beautiful detail. The taste was refreshing and natural. Maybe it was not perfect, but I truly appreciated that it was made with natural pineapple because that completely changes the result.

Between the soft music, the good conversation, the delicious food, and the cozy atmosphere, we ended up spending a truly special afternoon. What started as a simple search for tacos became one of those little moments that brighten everyday life and stay in your memory.

Sometimes you do not need a huge plan to feel happy. A good friendship, a beautiful place, and finally satisfying a craving can be more than enough.

body.title: REVERSE AGING
body.body:
***Another three years have gone by since I last did a post on Hive. Last time was a test post after my previous three year gap. The relentless down-voting always got to me. This was such a well designed blockchain, that about every three years I get curious to see if it's usable yet, or if it's still just a down-vote zone.

I'll leave the rewards on and see what happens!

I have a new blog these days here - https://sift666.blogspot.com

Here is a post partly describing what I've been up to lately:***


![147579.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/23tGaDSmTTtiDHCquhcYN3KBfkQJjbGjibujfrYNytW2NjXnY9RCLMJD2RCYPBcSMg5c4.jpg)


REVERSE AGING

Aging is such a gradual process that we often barely notice the process of doing slightly less day by day until one day we suddenly realise what a decrepit old fart we have become.


Reverse aging is very subtle as well.

Since making a major dietary shift, mainly cutting out all fruit and vegetables, and eating a near carnivore diet for the past two months, I've had a bunch of improvements, some strikingly sudden, but some so subtle I only just realised.

It's not as if I was coming from a \

(SAD) or anything. For the past 20+ years I've had no gluten, no sugar, no coffee, no alcohol, and no nightshades, as well as being mostly organic and low carb, with no artificial sweeteners or additives. I have also always taken care to drink good quality spring water and avoid fluoridated tap water like the plague.

But I still had some chronic aching, along with poor gut health, and low energy.

After just one day of no fruit I had a huge reduction in hip pain, and after a month of this semi-carnivore diet I was able to markedly increase my previously limited physical activity.
 
My own tendency is often to notice negative things while completely ignoring positives (yes, I know that is not optimum!)
 
 Here are the three biggest changes I've had over the past two months:


1. NO MORE SEIZURES 

The biggest improvement was that I stopped having grand mal seizures.
 
They go back nearly 20 years and for the past four years they had become an almost monthly set back. (That is another story in itself, but I won’t get into that any further here). So far those have now ceased for the longest time in over three years (fingers crossed that continues), and I have high hopes of never having another one.

2. ABLE TO DO MORE EXERCISE

At first I kept noticing how weak, unfit, and tired I was, but what I wasn't noticing that for the first time in over four years I was doing some physical activity every day, rather than only doing something about every three days and spending the rest of my time trying to recover from it.

Now when I do some exercise or physical work I do feel sore and tired afterwards, but the next day, I feel like I’m recovering and becoming stronger. Previously I was getting sorer and feeling weaker for at least two to three days each time.

3. MENTAL IMPROVEMENTS

The third thing that I didn't consciously notice for over a month was my gradual mental improvements. As with the physical stuff what I first noticed was that I was struggling to do things I could do 10 years ago. “I'm turning into an idiot” I thought.

Then I realised that I was attempting to do things at a level I was last at over 10 years ago, which was difficult because I hadn’t been doing them very well for a long time.

Every day now, I'm noticing more, making more connections, improving my skills, and just plain wanting to learn and develop. Previously that had almost stopped happening. Writing a positive summary like this is part of that process.

Yes I realise cutting out fruit and vegetables sounds extreme and sort of mad. We are constantly told they are good for us (notice a reoccurring pattern here?) but I have several friends who have also spectacularly transformed their health by doing just that, and I'm now cautiously giving it a try.
 
The carnivore diet is constantly bashed by the mainstream media as part of their relentless sickness industry mind programing - eg.  \

. 

Until recently I've always thought that humans are omnivores, but I now seem to be gradually revising that deep seated belief. I'm not fully onboard though. No fruit is a sticking point.
 
While I could happily not eat any vegetables (I never really liked them anyway, apart from kumera), I do miss fruit and hope to be able to reintroduce some of that again, but probably in very limited amounts.

Most days I'm carefully reintroducing one new food and testing the results. Sometimes they seem to be fine so I'm then able to continue to eat something new. One of those foods which tested OK was several forms of dairy which I had been completely avoiding for the past few years. 
 
Several diary foods actually seem to be pretty good for me, such as cheese as long as it's made with animal rennet, but not if it's made with vegetarian rennet, which many cheeses now are. That stuff is like a poison to me, causing severe aching within a day.


![9414832131022_01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/AKmKiJhRnhF6che7eKnGjwiiiBeg9JyqCbrseCuTAF3s5gpXG1XRy7SFQDuKnt7.jpg)

 
Mainland Tasty is still made with animal rennet but many cheeses (including most other Mainland cheeses) are not, so check the ingredients carefully. 
 
Some foods that I expected would be OK have been major fails - all coconut products, even good quality pure coconut milk, cause me immediate problems. We used to sell coconut oil and coconut flour so that was an unpleasant surprise!

This is all still a work in progress, but big thanks to 

Joachim Bartoll - https://bartoll.se/nutrition-quickstart/

Max German (NZ) - https://www.youtube.com/@max.german/videos 

for posting so much helpful nutritional information.


![chomps_carnivorediet.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/frot/EouDYY63hRCie86m97bj44E528iPbNWznVEfM5M2Qu26Y3UsLbBX7SMiXcdK91UGfTX.jpg)

body.body: Scammers are everywhere around the world, diving into diverse aspects of life as they explore new ways to scam people, and that's why we need to be proactive about our safety and security, because scammers aren't only online; we've them in the physical, too. And personally I've made it a point of duty to protect myself against every possible scam that could come my way so that I won't fall victim, because in our struggles and challenges we might get overly enticed by some of the tricks of these scammers, and before you know it, one will fall victim. ![1000887337.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vickoly/242Y3BUHGEMLNvXtAFjcefvuagjBhBpVUSKC5Ftgaqe4N3ro3hjLNb8RXPSkMyBBEAw4f.png) When it comes to things I do to protect myself from scammers, the first thing is to work on my own intelligence, thereby making sure I'm twice as smart as I used to be. Continuous learning helps me learn new things, including new ways scammers operate. Secondly, I also work on myself, but in this aspect it's about being content. I make sure I'm contented with what I have so that I won't get carried away by the enticing tricks of the scammers that could make it easy for anyone to fall victim to their evil plans and agenda. Lastly, I abstain from clicking any phishing or suspicious links; that's one of the important ways of staying safe from scammers. I've, on several occasions, encountered scammers, especially online, and what usually happens in all cases I've experienced to date is that I somehow escape their tricks to the point where some even get angry because I usually act like their trick is working on me, but when it gets to the part where I pay, send valuable information or click a phishing link, I'll just keep giving them different excuses until they can't take it any longer. Talking about the most common type of scam that's out there, I really don't know, but I think identity theft is trending at the moment with the use of artificial intelligence that even makes it easier for them to fool people who aren't observant and people who always verify things multiple times before jumping to conclusions, because this technology has made it easier for them to do literally different believable things that could get one caught, and that's why we must be one step ahead of them when it comes to smartness. *** ### Image is generated using Gemini AI. ***

body.title: Church Culture
body.body:
The world has evolved and so has the church. There has been a gradual drift in the culture and worship atmosphere as it imitates the secular system. The Bible described the early church as a place of prayer, solution, provision, healing, and love, but that's not what some of the churches represent today. Instead of solution, there's burden; instead of prayer, people seek fun, and the place of worship has become a place where the secular system of music has slipped in. The church has lost its power while trying to seek validation from society.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ8mnmHtVQiQB3BspEDbxZh8FmdJ3V4mE18urSkBEjrgY/1779573693014.png)

**Image gnerated using Gemini AI**

The culture the church was known for is gradually being replaced by strange cultures introduced by a body of people to suit their lust and greed. They tell you to pay back evil with evil because it makes one smart; they tell you one who loves is a fool and is always cheated on; they tell you you'll need to buy your way into deliverance or that our sin has been redeemed already. There's been so much confusion that even those who are strong in faith begin to doubt the very thing they once believed. The old ways, which were filled with power and grace, are ridiculed, and the church now looks like a thing of mockery.

But there's hope for the Church. While a few have deviated from the faith, a generation is coming that is hungry for the old ways. A generation like the great apostles that sought power, not for their gain, but to restore the hope and faith of many whose faith is faint. The church was built and there's a promise that covers it even against the gates of hell. The culture may be drifting, but there are a few others who keep the lamp burning regardless, like the ten virgins. The church culture may have thorns in it, but among them are ones of good report—hold onto them.

body.title: Ending the mean.
body.body: > ![IMG_20260522_105547357_HDR_PCT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/Eq348x39ci4jmejdTq2pcsB1PHo57MYftvmpE6a71oFb7JgrBk9fDNtNeXZHwDt6Jbb.jpg) Yeah, I talk about it too often. I know. I try not to, but the idea of a blog is to talk about one’s life, too, and it’s definitely and absolutely a big chunk of my life right now, on all accounts. But I feel like I’m getting closer to ending it. There are certain signs. As I walked out of the courthouse yesterday once again, having kindly asked them to not to forget to do the job that they’re paid for (nothing is done if not requested personally), I felt like electronic music. But not Stoto, though I love them. I thought of Kalkbrenner, Berlin Calling. And asked myself why I never listened to anything else by Kalkbrenner. Maybe because of the movie. It’s nostalgic. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TYoTpboRf3g So I went for Essence. And I’m glad I did. Earplugs in, walking to the “Cotacachi” letters. The platform there is perfect to practice the three Tang Soo Do forms I learned so far. The weather was pleasant, but honestly, with this kind of music, it could’ve rained and I’d been happy. Just the right vibe at the right moment. Forms are like dancing. So I danced. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2xP1xhbqG_4 Forms can be done in many ways. Fluid like water. Fast like wind. Slow like the earth. Powerful like fire. Rigid like metal. I enjoy forms because they’re detailed. Multiversal, you can use each movement in so many different situations and for many different purposes. And muscle memory will take care of most of it. If ever necessary, which I hope I’ll avoid. ![IMG_20260522_110020583.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/245cTyZn1cD3MfsfGAQpFCUM9DrmasWc1yWjk8E6uKff5PqiJnML7stZgd9ky6kWrxMBR.jpg) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LeGl4RYcCpA I walked around a little bit before going home and having a lazy day. Listening to this music. Now, I’m writing this, listening to it again. And it’s such a great album to listen to, easily, while doing whatever. Just like Stoto. For walking around, working, spacing away, background music while talking with friends, or while having a beer. And probably pretty awesome in a club. We don’t have those here. Not for electronic music. Would be cool to organize one, though, just among friends. I know a few who like their Trance parties. And a location could be organized, too. Hm… Okay, one more for the road. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vWlNPNPkk1c That’s it. Enjoy your Saturday! ___ Post written for the #saturdayselections by Galenkp inviting us to share music in the [Weekend Experiences community](https://peakd.com/c/hive-168869/created) on Saturdays. Please feel free to engage in any original way, including dropping links to your posts on similar topics. I'm happy to read (and curate) any quality content that is not created by LLM/AI.

body.title: Calculating Sunflower Land Chapter Tickets
body.body: > ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc8kWQfaDu8TyD6BB3732yXm3ioKvG232DB1w1peUF9G3/calculating_sunflower_land_chapter_tickets.jpg) While Sunflower Land is a farming game where the objective is to manage resources like crops, ores, and animals, another management element is added to the players' missions during the chapters: Tickets. Every 3 months a new season arrives in Sunflower Land, bringing many new features. In the current season, we have a new resource: SALT, mainly used to make Aged Fish, which is the new source of XP in the game. In addition to the new features and resources, we also have the arrival of new items in the Stella Store, which is the chapter's shop. This time Stella's main items are: the Crystal Altar (-5% crustacean processing time), Deep Sea Salt Cave Background (+5 Salt), and finally the Bubble Aura, which has two buffs: the first -20% processing time in the Fish Market and the second a 20% chance of +1 fish processed. Sequentially, the costs of these items are 3000, 6000, and 10000 tickets. All of these items are NFTs and cost Tickets that are obtained during the season. Last season, I myself ended up miscalculating the number of Tickets I needed, finishing the season with more Tickets than necessary to get the item I was looking for. This caused me to spend extra money during the chapter because I didn't calculate correctly beforehand, which is one of the reasons I tried to complete the track and didn't focus solely on the item. Looking back now, it probably would have been better to just focus on the item and not try to complete the entire track... I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

> ## Calculating Sunflower Land Chapter Tickets Considering the difficulty I myself had in the last chapter, let's roughly calculate all the ways to get Tickets during the chapter. Some observations: the chapter lasts around 90 days, but the first week has no deliveries, so it's about 12 weeks, with one week having no bounties because it's auction week.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeVqkKarnYxa1RDoyURzTX7KQHhsCAa8a86bC9ZQQNrUe/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Starting with the animals, which is one of the points of variation, because not all players will be able to deliver all the animal bounties. During the week, beginners can do the easier animal missions, such as cows and sheep, which are more expensive, while chickens can be delivered as many as possible. The barn gives around 15 tickets a week, possibly more or less depending on the required levels. The Hen House is likely to yield between 20 and 26. That's around 45 tickets per week. With that, we already have 500 tickets just from the animals.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwsJZ8nvS7WGvvPstwBBA6Fmjwcz3V4xTUfMB5TEYZRD/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Regarding deliveries, the tip is to avoid the most expensive ones, around 2 flowers each, unless you're looking for the most expensive items in the chapter. Completing about half of the delivery missions should earn you around 25 tickets per day, totaling approximately 2100 tickets. Adding the daily chest ticket, you'll have around 2200 at the end of the chapter. Double deliveries add another 300 tickets, bringing the total to 2500 from deliveries and the chest.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmThc1cEaiFw8jxRobqrqZUFTWHrvoFqnbP7rFgs3fT9dy/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
For bounties, there's a noticeable difference in delivery costs. Some bounties, like fish, flowers, and fruits, are obtainable without a significant flower cost and are quite easy to complete, costing around 50-60 tickets per week, totaling around 700, with some extra tickets available. Furthermore, we also have bounties that have a certain cost, such as dolls, crustaceans, and the more expensive exotic and obsidian bounties, which few people end up doing, opting instead for the cheaper ones. This should yield around 600 tickets.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRnydTddK7Xfmnp3afwaAGkLttk2zxqri935XNB3gqQ8y/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Here with bounties, things get uncertain because they change every week. There's also the uncertainty of deliveries, as some are more expensive than others. Finally, we have Chores, which also change their requirements every week and are generally quite difficult to complete, at least half of them. If you focus on the simpler ones, you should get around 40 tickets per week, which is about 500 tickets. In the end, adding up all the ticket sources, including the track tickets (around 240), we get: 500 (animals) + 2500 (deliveries and chests) + 1100 (bounties) + 500 (chores). This amounts to around 4800, which already guarantees the 3000 monument. The calculations considered the 2x +1 items and being VIP, doing the simpler missions. If you get the last +1 item and do a few more missions, it's quite possible to reach 6000 tickets for the +5 Salt NFT. Use these calculations to make your own plan, thinking about how many +1 ticket items you will get, which missions you will do, and make your own assumptions. The final tip is to keep track of how many tickets you've made during the week to know if you're on track or not. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc8kWQfaDu8TyD6BB3732yXm3ioKvG232DB1w1peUF9G3/calculating_sunflower_land_chapter_tickets.jpg) Por mais que o Sunflower Land seja um jogo de fazenda, em que o objetivo é a gestão de recursos como plantações, minérios e animais, durante os capítulos uma outra gestão é adicionada nas missões dos jogadores, que são os Tickets. A cada 3 meses uma nova temporada chega ao Sunflower Land, trazendo muitas novidades. Na temporada atual, estamos com um novo recurso que é o SAL, usado principalmente para fazer o Aged Fish, que é a nova fonte de XP do jogo. Além das novidades, novos recursos, temos também a chegada de novos items na Stella Store, que é a loja do capítulo. Dessa vez a Stella tem como items principais: o Crystal Altar (-5% time crustáceos), Deep Sea Salt Cave Background (+5 Salt) e por fim o Bubble Aura que tem dois buff, o primeiro -20% do tempo de processamento do Fish Market e o segundo 20% de chance de +1 peixe processado. De forma sequencial, os custos desses items são 3000, 6000 e 10000 tickets. Todos esses items são NFTs e tem um custo justamente em Tickets que são obtidos durante a temporada. Na última temporada, eu mesmo acabei errando por muito na quantidade de Tickets que eu deveria conseguir, terminando a temporada com mais tickets do que o necessário para conseguir o item que eu buscava, o que me fez ter um gasto extra durante o capítulo, porque não realizei as contas de forma correta e previamente, sendo um dos motivos que eu tentei completar o track e não foquei apenas no item. Analisando agora, teria sido melhor ficar apenas no item e não ter tentado completar o track inteiro provavelmente.... Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

> ## Calculando os Tickets do Capítulo Sunflower Land Considerando a dificuldade que eu mesmo tive no último capítulo, vamos calcular aproximadamente todas as maneiras de obter Tickets durante o capítulo. Algumas observações: o capítulo dura cerca de 90 dias, mas a primeira semana não tem entregas, então são cerca de 12 semanas, com uma semana sem recompensas porque é a semana do leilão.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeVqkKarnYxa1RDoyURzTX7KQHhsCAa8a86bC9ZQQNrUe/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Começando pelos animais, que é um dos pontos de variação, porque nem todos os jogadores conseguirão entregar todas as recompensas de animais. Durante a semana, os iniciantes podem fazer as missões de animais mais fáceis, como vacas e ovelhas, que são mais caras, enquanto as galinhas podem ser entregues em maior quantidade. O celeiro rende cerca de 15 bilhetes por semana, possivelmente mais ou menos dependendo dos níveis necessários. O galinheiro provavelmente renderá entre 20 e 26 bilhetes. Isso dá cerca de 45 bilhetes por semana. Com isso, já temos 500 bilhetes só dos animais.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXwsJZ8nvS7WGvvPstwBBA6Fmjwcz3V4xTUfMB5TEYZRD/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Em relação às entregas, a dica é evitar as mais caras, que rendem cerca de 2 flores cada, a menos que você esteja procurando pelos itens mais valiosos do capítulo. Completar cerca de metade das missões de entrega deve render aproximadamente 25 bilhetes por dia, totalizando cerca de 2100 bilhetes. Somando o bilhete do baú diário, você terá cerca de 2200 ao final do capítulo. Entregas duplas adicionam mais 300 bilhetes, elevando o total para 2500, considerando as entregas e o baú.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmThc1cEaiFw8jxRobqrqZUFTWHrvoFqnbP7rFgs3fT9dy/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Para as missões de recompensa, há uma diferença notável nos custos de entrega. Algumas recompensas, como peixes, flores e frutas, podem ser obtidas sem um custo significativo em flores e são bastante fáceis de completar, custando cerca de 50 a 60 bilhetes por semana, totalizando cerca de 700, com alguns bilhetes extras disponíveis. Além disso, também temos recompensas que têm um custo específico, como bonecas, crustáceos e as recompensas exóticas e de obsidiana mais caras, que poucas pessoas acabam fazendo, optando pelas mais baratas. Isso deve render cerca de 600 bilhetes.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRnydTddK7Xfmnp3afwaAGkLttk2zxqri935XNB3gqQ8y/image.png)
[Sunflower Land](https://sunflower-land.com/play/?ref=RionWeb3)
Aqui, com as recompensas, as coisas ficam incertas porque elas mudam a cada semana. Há também a incerteza das entregas, já que algumas são mais caras que outras. Por fim, temos as Tarefas, cujos requisitos mudam semanalmente e que geralmente são bastante difíceis de completar, pelo menos metade delas. Se você se concentrar nas mais simples, conseguirá cerca de 40 bilhetes por semana, o que dá aproximadamente 500 bilhetes. No final, somando todas as fontes de bilhetes, incluindo os bilhetes de trilha (cerca de 240), obtemos: 500 (animais) + 2500 (entregas e baús) + 1100 (recompensas) + 500 (tarefas). Isso totaliza cerca de 4800, o que já garante o monumento de 3000. Os cálculos consideraram os 2 itens +1 e o status VIP, realizando as missões mais simples. Se você conseguir o último item +1 e fizer mais algumas missões, é bem possível alcançar 6000 bilhetes para o NFT de Sal +5. Use esses cálculos para criar seu próprio plano, pensando em quantos itens de +1 bilhete você conseguirá, quais missões realizará e fazendo suas próprias suposições. A dica final é acompanhar quantos bilhetes você conseguiu durante a semana para saber se está no caminho certo ou não. ---

body.title: The Need To Be Safe from Online Scammers
body.body: *** ___ ___ ___ One thing I have realized is that greed is the reason why people fall victim to scammers especially online scammers, I am not saying this out of head knowledge, I am saying this out of experience and I can attest that I was greedy that was why I got scammed too. I can not remember the full details but one hot afternoon I came back from school feeling hungry and had just a thousand naira on me, but for some reasons I came across a post asking us to send the money to be able to receive double of the money, like I said, I can not remember the full details, but yeah I ended up sending the last money on me and when I tried to reach out back after an hour, to get a double of the money, I realized I was scammed, whomever it was blocked me after receiving the money and till today I am painted that i let myself get scammed by that. The good thing is I learnt my lessons and never indulge in such act, meanwhile I have seen people who never back down from such, they just have so much trust in that and they keep giving until it becomes too late Many people like myself have gone through the same tricks or even worse, and every time I hear such stories I realise it was greed, that pushed us to become victims of scammers. ___ ___ ___ Yeah, a system is supposed to be set up to be able to catch those who are involved in this acts but the truth is no matter how many is caught the existence of scammers especially online scammers is not and never going to go into extinction any time soon as it has come to stay especially in this state where the economy is terrible and people are drained trying to survive, they would be ready to do anything that won't need them doing too much again. The best we can do for ourselves is to not be greedy and be very conscious and smart about everything we see online, make verification from the right source, and never be in a hurry to do anything, once you are being rushed to do it, take a brief pause to think hard and deep, and then do the needed cross-checking to be sure you are safe. It's not going to be easy, but to be on the safe side, it would be better to take the necessary precautions, ask questions, verify information, Google, and make sure you are not in a rush or being rushed. Be careful, even when you do not see the need, because they could strike any day and at any time, without warning. ___ ___ ___ I won't forget how the other day I was called and told to that I was invited to join a particular class that was scheduled to happen on WhatsApp and such every member of the group was sent a code, to be able to access the meeting, and then the caller asked me to call out the code number that was sent to my phone to his hearing, indeed the class was real because it was scheduled to happen that evening but I knew something was wrong when I was asked to call the codes back to the sender, indeed, I saw the code but instead I told him I didn't and so he sent again a asked that I call it, so I did but another number, a random number. When he realized that it wasn't what he sent, he cussed me out and ended the call on me, and that was how I escaped that, later that day, the admin warned everyone to not listen to anyone who says them and says he was from the group, that she was the only one allowed to call anyone and we didn't need any codes to be able to be in the meeting. I just couldn't help ask myself, what the person wanted to achieve by doing what he did, and what if I had fallen for his tricks and called out the codes, what were his intentions? With the way AI is taking over everything, every scam is dangerous especially online scam, because once they have access to your important details, you are at their mercies and I am going to say with the way my country is, it is hard to get a swift help from service providers, so instead of being at the risk or at their mercy, be conscious of where you put in your details and who you give it to, because it can be used to rob one of their hard earn money. ___ ___ ___ This is my entry to [Indiaunited new contest and last contest results](https://ecency.com/hive-197685/@indiaunited/indiaunited-new-contest-and-last-ca3e7ff9610e) click on the link to be a part of this week's contest. ___ ___ ___ ***The image used is mine*** ___ ___ ___
