body.title: Horas (proyecto para trabajar en poemario) [ES/EN]
body.body:
Buenas tardes 
Hace unos días le mostré un poema de un poemario que estoy realizando. Acá está el segundo de las propuestas. 
Para mayor comprensión posee traducción al inglés.

Bajo la bombilla que no parpadea,
el reloj se vuelve ceniza 
sin noche.
Las horas se estiran como gomas fundidas,
se quiebran
 en vértigo con olor de carbón.

Afuera la luna es un anuncio gastado,
y el tiempo, 
ese insecto atrapado en una colección sin nombre,
zumba contra el vidrio caliente de los días
que ya no tienen sombra para medirse.

La luz eléctrica roba los crepúsculos,
convierte los sueños
 en facturas vencidas sin usar.
Un minuto se incendia, 
se replica,
y el ocaso se aplaza 
en cada interruptor.



🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️
Texto traducido al inglés para mayor interpretación por la IA: DEEPSEEK 🐳
🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️🔷️




Under the light bulb that never flickers,
the clock turns to ash
without night.
The hours stretch like melted rubber,
they break
into vertigo with the smell of coal.

Outside, the moon is a worn-out advertisement,
and time—
that insect trapped in a nameless collection—
buzzes against the hot glass of days
that no longer have a shadow to measure themselves by.

Electric light steals the twilights,
turns dreams
into overdue, unused bills.
A minute catches fire,
replicates itself,
and dusk is postponed
at every switch.

body.title: Our Hardworking Best friend, CALVIN
body.body:
*The **carabao** is always known as a farmer's best friend. It helps in many kinds of work in the field, especially in plowing the soil, and carrying heavy loads*. 

![IMG20260511111437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emminemsss/EogNkMMCva9Luo29UdJ9wgL2u4tEsrjTHmXLp1VZkBAzXVm1NhjwehqmVxjPt7JHgfF.jpg)

My father wakes up early everyday to find a place for Calvin to eat grass, and he leaves him there until the sun shines brightly around 7 AM. Carabaos cannot be exposed to too much sunlight because it's not good for them. So, at around 7 AM papa will get Calvin and put him under this leafy tree. 

Calvin helps my father with fieldwork, and because of him, our family can eat three meals a day. 

That ends my blog. Love lots(⁠◍⁠•⁠ᴗ⁠•⁠◍⁠)⁠❤

-emmin◉⁠‿⁠◉msss

body.title: Mi ciudad ,mi hogar
body.body:
[//]: # (CCC LINKS PLACEHOLDER, DON'T DELETE THIS TAG)
Hoy quiero hablarles de una de las ciudades más hermosas y llenas de historia de Cuba: Matanzas, la ciudad donde nací y crecí rodeada de puentes, ríos y recuerdos inolvidables. Cada rincón de Matanzas tiene algo especial, algo que la hace única y diferente al resto del país.
Muchos conocen a Matanzas como “La Atenas de Cuba”, por su riqueza cultural, su poesía y su música. Pero para mí, es mucho más que eso. Es el lugar donde aprendí a amar el mar, donde disfruté tardes enteras caminando por sus calles y admirando lugares llenos de vida e historia.
Uno de los sitios más famosos es Cuevas de Bellamar, un lugar impresionante lleno de formaciones naturales que parecen sacadas de otro mundo. Visitar esas cuevas siempre fue una aventura mágica, especialmente cuando era niña.
También está Valle de Yumurí, uno de los paisajes más hermosos de Cuba. Su vista transmite una paz increíble; montañas, vegetación y el río formando una imagen perfecta de la naturaleza cubana.
Y cómo no hablar de Varadero, una de las playas más conocidas del mundo. Sus aguas cristalinas y su arena blanca hacen que cualquiera se enamore. Muchos turistas llegan buscando descanso, pero para quienes somos de Matanzas, Varadero también guarda recuerdos familiares, días felices y momentos especiales.
Otra parte hermosa de la ciudad es el Teatro Sauto, símbolo cultural de la provincia. Su arquitectura es preciosa y representa el arte y la historia que caracterizan a nuestra ciudad.
Matanzas tiene algo especial: mezcla naturaleza, cultura e historia de una manera única. Sus puentes, sus calles tranquilas y la calidez de su gente hacen que siempre lleve esta ciudad en mi corazón, sin importar dónde esté.
Porque aunque la vida nos lleve lejos, siempre hay un lugar que sentimos como hogar… y para mí, ese lugar siempre será Matanzas.

Quiero tomarme un momento para agradecer de corazón a todas las personas que siempre pasan por mis publicaciones en Hive. Gracias por cada voto, cada comentario y cada palabra bonita que me dejan. Aunque muchas veces no tenga el tiempo o la conexión suficiente para responder como quisiera, sepan que leo todo y valoro muchísimo el cariño y el apoyo que me brindan.
También quiero disculparme por las veces en que desaparezco o no publico con frecuencia. La situación con la conexión aquí en Cuba muchas veces hace todo más complicado, y en ocasiones simplemente no logro mantener la constancia que quisiera. Aun así, siempre trato de regresar y compartir contenido sincero, interesante y hecho desde el corazón.
Hive se ha convertido en un espacio muy especial para mí. Un lugar donde puedo expresarme, compartir mis vivencias y sentirme acompañada por personas increíbles de diferentes partes del mundo.
Quiero agradecer especialmente a mi esposo, @valderalazaro, por estar siempre a mi lado, apoyándome incluso en los días más difíciles. Gracias por impulsarme a seguir creando y nunca dejarme rendirme.
También quiero agradecer a mi querida mamá canadiense, @catthyarrow, por tanto cariño, apoyo y amor hacia nuestra familia. Y a su esposo, @bradleyarrow, quien ha sido como un ángel de la guarda para nosotros. Nunca voy a olvidar todo lo que han hecho y siguen haciendo por mí, por mi esposo y por nuestro hijo.
Y por supuesto, muchísimas gracias a toda la comunidad de BBH por hacerme sentir bienvenida, apoyada y motivada a seguir creciendo dentro de esta hermosa plataforma.
Gracias por acompañarme en este camino, por leerme y por estar aquí 💛

body.title: Soft Clouds [ENG|ESP]
body.body: > Hello everyone. On this occasion, I am bringing new photos of a sunset where the clouds seemed to have a very soft and polished texture as the sun went down. I took these photographs from an avenue that I frequent often. # Through the shadows of some buildings and the streetlights along the avenue, I managed to capture these shots where large clouds cover the sky with a very smooth appearance. The lights from the posts, the passing cars, and the dark shapes of the buildings added an aesthetic touch that improved the overall quality of the images. # The contrast between the urban elements and the sky looked very good. I focused on how the artificial lights of the city began to turn on just as the natural light was fading. The texture of the clouds was the most striking part of the scene, as they looked almost solid yet delicate against the fading sun. # I decided to document this unique moment because of how the light hit the street. The movement of the cars and the fixed position of the buildings provided a solid frame for the horizon. It was a common afternoon, but the specific conditions of the clouds made it worth recording. # I truly hope you find these captures of the urban sunset interesting. # Without anything more to add, I bid farewell. Stay tuned for future posts! Until next time!

> Hola a Todos. En esta oportunidad traigo nuevas fotos de un atardecer donde las nubes parecían tener una textura muy suave y pulida mientras el sol se ocultaba. Tomé estas fotografías desde una avenida que suelo frecuentar. # A través de la sombra de algunos edificios y los postes de luz de las avenidas, logré tomar estas fotos en las cuales se ven grandes nubes cubriendo el cielo con una textura muy suave. Las luces de los postes, los automóviles y las sombras de algunos edificios le dieron un toque estético que enriqueció la calidad de las imágenes. # El contraste entre los elementos urbanos y el cielo se veía muy bien. Me enfoqué en cómo las luces artificiales de la ciudad empezaban a encenderse justo cuando la luz natural se desvanecía. La textura de las nubes fue la parte más llamativa de la escena, ya que se veían casi sólidas pero delicadas frente al sol poniente. # Decidí documentar este momento único por la forma en que la luz golpeaba la calle. El movimiento de los autos y la posición fija de los edificios brindaron un marco sólido para el horizonte. Fue una tarde común, pero las condiciones específicas de las nubes hicieron que valiera la pena registrarla. # De verdad espero que estas capturas del atardecer urbano les resulten interesantes. # Sin más que agregar me despido, estén atentos a los próximos post. ¡Hasta la Próxima! ------ ---- |

body.title: PALO A PIQUE (En - Es)
body.body:
> **ESPAÑOL** --- # Hola a todos, muy buenos días. Uno de los platos típicos de la región guayanesa, y que lo recuerdo gracias a mi padre, que es nativo de Bolívar y él amaba esta comida, es el Palo a pique. También se prepara en esta zona llanera del oriente venezolano, sobre todo en el campo, en una olla inmensa sobre un fogón de leña, para darle un sabor más genuino al guiso. Pero en mi casa lo preparábamos en la cocina, y siguiendo cuidadosamente los pasos para que quedara con la mejor sazón. El palo a pique consiste en un guiso de frijoles blancos, aderezado con aliños del gusto de cada quien, con varios tipos de carne integrados, principalmente la de cerdo o cochino, y luego se le incorpora arroz blanco. Todos estos ingredientes se integran en la misma olla, y el platillo se acompaña con casabe. **INGREDIENTES:** --- # 250 gr de frijoles blancos Aliños naturales (cebolla, pimentón, ají, ajo, monte, orégano, laurel) 100 gr de patitas de cochino 100 gr de chicharrón 260 gr de costillas de cochino 4 piezas de pollo picado en trocitos 1 taza de arroz blanco 50 gr de chuleta ahumada Sal al gusto
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWUEs8H2e3ZqvCvpEi2vWtKLzu9gQzQxctUFRCgvNTeH/page.jpg)

**PROCEDIMIENTO:** --- # El primer paso fue lavar los frijoles, retirar los que estaban dañados, y colocarlos a hervir en una olla con suficiente agua por 10 minutos. Retirar del fuego, colarlos y desechar esta primera agua hervida. Enjuagarlos, y colocarlos nuevamente a fuego moderado con la mitad de la olla con agua hasta que ablanden, retirar del fuego y dejar reposar dejándole suficiente líquido para el guiso
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbEN9g82jx6AK1mC1HE21ghQZX5LnX7AjV1p8tG2QTqSb/39be4381_3150_4996_afe1_6f944481ba71.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjV4CViHZXiuzag6hxV88PSEiAPPZLdu8ai9uWKMou3r/366f0c6a_1fa3_4d08_988b_279c0d8fa857.jpg)

>

Paso seguido, lavar bien las carnes y poner a sancochar las patitas de cerdo y las costillas hasta que ablanden. Desechar el agua de la cocción y reservar las carnes. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWRQvm8Nu3DJC8Y53xKEJVEd7QUjRJCfP9neCQ8dYY1re/9c7340e5_c0b8_48ac_9e51_50378890f432.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQqgY62ycVLhZPYhR8KYa3jLyfUW1o5FxUdouiQAaM1ud/c6558369_e00d_4d5f_89c7_a822f321e7cd.jpg)

</center>

<div class = \

>

Picar los aliños en cuadritos en la cantidad de su gusto de acuerdo a la cantidad de carnes usadas, machacar bien los ajos, y reservar. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQpp6z139LX9H9W3MFRo4cWawGF77cdHPrPyziYjLnHaj/c8c750d1_11ae_40bb_81bf_0882ad13924f.jpg)

</center>

Aparte, preparar un arroz blanco con una taza de arroz y dos de agua, y reservar.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVaALKMxnpghJUsQ9RzwqvxU4qyKqDrCusnDGkMEeqDPX/29a6dbed_5510_4d1e_b5d4_32f23f6be88c.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXUpMyfg2szAc9kVH9KY5QJLyHKeN8vb83nWEPP8CHKGs/a2fe7cdc_eb81_41a6_a008_916333b4ed7c.jpg)

</center>

En un sartén a fuego bajo, colocar las costillas de cerdo picadas, la chuleta ahumada y los aliños picados, con una cucharada de agua, sin colocar aceite, ya que se van a sofreír con la grasa que expulsan las piezas de cochino. Remover constantemente para que no se peguen. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma8cCEASqkDpgM6dsWzUpzXqeE4Ah7GvXCpyocCbQMwBw/bb8759c2_0913_42ec_a6af_e47661d279ff.jpg)

</center>

Cuando hayan quedado bien incorporados, se le integran las demás carnes, pollo, patitas, y chicharrón, y se le agrega la sal. Se sigue removiendo hasta integrarlos todos, se apaga y se reserva.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWXgp1vTsWnRaydLndihYzCUCHm5auor8MNHfncgXKoC9/7df9ef2a_6166_4ebf_9d9c_961c7ac49a2a.jpg)

</center>

Se activa nuevamente el fuego de los frijoles, esperar que hierva para integrar el sofrito de carnes y aliños, de inmediato bajar el fuego, remover para que se integren todos los ingredientes y tapar para que se terminen de mezclar los sabores. Dejar cocinar por unos 10 minutos a fuego bajo. Apagar, incorporar el arroz y remover suavemente. Tapar y dejar reposar antes de servir. 

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkKoU2ZUgPaVapjofKq8U1px7jNuoPrL2PP7DBBGm7wE/63f92329_8292_45bd_913a_d06df568ef5a.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmda9GrZirv2rCqJ13y1GYxxb2fhK1RGyif8mg7Cdu2i45/3686c18a_ef94_4a77_96a9_5f9a8635cb2b.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXZPU5VbYuHNCk76GRcVKoS3ZHseYhtkLGP4o84Gi72Z3/cc9ca846_4c75_4f33_8f32_76e3a311e4b3.jpg)

</center>

<div class = \

> Este platillo acostumbramos comerlo con casabe, aunque muchos lo acompañan también con tajadas fritas y ensalada.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTBLEoMYNraq15V33WFsiCVjzu3dSWzfj5fhbbKUwqyjh/a70a7372_37c3_499b_93de_e41934e82100.jpg)
Espero que lo disfruten… feliz día para todos.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUHZvhjdRjyCkmov2DNMu1ABWyEub12YomeJBnq8RW1Va/annafenix_2.png)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZiRvU9UrpQe47Q1mzkhXPoQ64wT6VEve3c8QwFeAcL6J/eda65da8_088e_4824_9571_4f29ced35211.jpg)
**ENGLISH** --- # Hello everyone, good morning. One of the typical dishes of the Guayana region, which I remember thanks to my father, a native of Bolívar state who loved this food, is Palo a Pique. It's also prepared in this plains region of eastern Venezuela, especially in the countryside, in a huge pot over a wood fire to give the stew a more authentic flavor. But at home, we prepared it on the stovetop, carefully following the steps to ensure it had the best seasoning. Palo a Pique is a stew of white beans, seasoned with spices to suit everyone's taste, with various types of meat, mainly pork, and then white rice is added. All these ingredients are combined in the same pot, and the dish is served with casabe (cassava bread). INGREDIENTS; 250g white beans Natural seasonings (onion, bell pepper, chili pepper, garlic, herbs, oregano, bay leaf) 100g pig's feet 100g pork cracklings 260g pork ribs 4 pieces of chicken, chopped into small pieces 1 cup white rice 50g smoked pork chop Salt to taste
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWUEs8H2e3ZqvCvpEi2vWtKLzu9gQzQxctUFRCgvNTeH/page.jpg)

INSTRUCTIONS: The first step was to wash the beans, removing any damaged ones, and boil them in a pot with enough water for 10 minutes. Remove from the heat, drain, and discard the first boil water. Rinse the beans and place them back in the pot over medium heat with half the water until tender. Remove from the heat and let them rest, leaving enough liquid for the stew.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbEN9g82jx6AK1mC1HE21ghQZX5LnX7AjV1p8tG2QTqSb/39be4381_3150_4996_afe1_6f944481ba71.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSjV4CViHZXiuzag6hxV88PSEiAPPZLdu8ai9uWKMou3r/366f0c6a_1fa3_4d08_988b_279c0d8fa857.jpg)

>

Next, wash the meats well and parboil the pig's feet and ribs until tender. Discard the cooking water and set the meats aside.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWRQvm8Nu3DJC8Y53xKEJVEd7QUjRJCfP9neCQ8dYY1re/9c7340e5_c0b8_48ac_9e51_50378890f432.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQqgY62ycVLhZPYhR8KYa3jLyfUW1o5FxUdouiQAaM1ud/c6558369_e00d_4d5f_89c7_a822f321e7cd.jpg)

</center>

<div class = \

>

Dice the seasonings into small cubes, adjusting the amount to your liking according to the quantity of meat used. Thoroughly crush the garlic and set aside.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQpp6z139LX9H9W3MFRo4cWawGF77cdHPrPyziYjLnHaj/c8c750d1_11ae_40bb_81bf_0882ad13924f.jpg)

</center>

Separately, prepare white rice with one cup of rice and two cups of water, and set aside.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVaALKMxnpghJUsQ9RzwqvxU4qyKqDrCusnDGkMEeqDPX/29a6dbed_5510_4d1e_b5d4_32f23f6be88c.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXUpMyfg2szAc9kVH9KY5QJLyHKeN8vb83nWEPP8CHKGs/a2fe7cdc_eb81_41a6_a008_916333b4ed7c.jpg)

</center>

In a skillet over low heat, place the chopped pork ribs, the smoked pork chop, and the diced seasonings with a tablespoon of water. Do not add oil, as the meat will cook in its own fat. Stir constantly to prevent sticking.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma8cCEASqkDpgM6dsWzUpzXqeE4Ah7GvXCpyocCbQMwBw/bb8759c2_0913_42ec_a6af_e47661d279ff.jpg)

</center>

Once the meats are well combined, add the remaining meats: chicken, pig's feet, and pork rinds. Season with salt. Continue stirring until everything is incorporated, then turn off the heat and set aside.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWXgp1vTsWnRaydLndihYzCUCHm5auor8MNHfncgXKoC9/7df9ef2a_6166_4ebf_9d9c_961c7ac49a2a.jpg)

</center>

Return the beans to the heat and bring to a boil. Add the sautéed meats and seasonings, then immediately reduce the heat to low, stir to combine all the ingredients, and cover to allow the flavors to meld. Let it cook for about 10 minutes over low heat. Turn off the heat, stir in the rice, and mix gently. Cover and let it rest before serving.

<center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWkKoU2ZUgPaVapjofKq8U1px7jNuoPrL2PP7DBBGm7wE/63f92329_8292_45bd_913a_d06df568ef5a.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmda9GrZirv2rCqJ13y1GYxxb2fhK1RGyif8mg7Cdu2i45/3686c18a_ef94_4a77_96a9_5f9a8635cb2b.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXZPU5VbYuHNCk76GRcVKoS3ZHseYhtkLGP4o84Gi72Z3/cc9ca846_4c75_4f33_8f32_76e3a311e4b3.jpg)

</center>

<div class = \

>

We usually eat this dish with cassava bread, although many also serve it with fried plantains and salad. 

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTBLEoMYNraq15V33WFsiCVjzu3dSWzfj5fhbbKUwqyjh/a70a7372_37c3_499b_93de_e41934e82100.jpg)</center>

I hope you enjoy it… have a wonderful day everyone.

body.title: NO SMART, SLOW LIFE
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

Ever wondered why we even call it a smart phone? I thought about it and decided to do my little research. Turns out it was simply because there were other phone types before what we know as smartphones came to be. The only difference was that these phones could only make calls and send text messages. Smartphones came to change the narrative of what phones could do, and right now our definition of a smartphone from the time they were created and now is totally different. Then so long it could browse the internet, it was smart. Now we look at different features to attain how smart a phone can really be.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdR2PvuudST7WVGtEPSXVPAUwz8u7pDUK7WcFpYWiLetR/1000063054.jpg 

<a href=\

>Image by mamewmy on Magnific But what if one day we discover that all these things will no longer be because for some reasons smartphones will stop to exist. The fact is that it would be a really great loss, but the world will recover in time as humans are a very adaptable species. But then again why would the loss of smartphones be detrimental to humans, the fact is that it would cut off access to information on a very major scale. I don't want to even talk about the jobs and relationships that would be lost, but you see the amount of information that would be lost, it might even crumble nations. Information is power, and the informations smartphones carry is one of the many reasons they are smart. Before we talk about fun, jobs and livelihoods that would go down the drain, let's look at how many passwords your phone has access to, or how many times you need your smartphone for a verification to an account. Or how your passcode is connected to your smartphone. When I lost my phone was when I realized how much I depended on it, not just for fun, but for some kind of security I can't get on my PC. Then what if anything that looks like a computer is taken off the table? I would say, just take us back to the stone age because that's where we will be heading to next. >THIS IS MY RESPONSE TO SCIFI CONTEST [PROMPT](https://peakd.com/hive-111030/@scifimultiverse/scifi-multiverse-prompt-week-68-edition-2-or-life-without-smart-phones) FOR WEEK 68 EDITION 2 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqbQGFerHXinrqqmfCGrRHtwdZRhqAtCVWMna3geK2vc/20230716_224852_0000.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@kilvnrex/no-smart-slow-life--wn)

links.title: I'm being readmitted to the hospital and will be having surgery. / 再入院、手術行きます。(ENG/JPN)
links.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfMUKpYUesAw15n2seBJQtkbinWYntxkeHuSLdGz5NEm1/hive20260524.jpg)</center>




(ENG)
I'm currently getting ready to be readmitted to the hospital the day after tomorrow.
I'm packing my suitcase with pajamas, towels, cups, and all sorts of other things.
I'm gathering everything while nervously making sure I don't forget anything.

On top of that, I've received the admission and surgery information, so I have to fill out a bunch of medical questionnaires and sign consent forms?I'm already exhausted even before I've been admitted.

During my last hospitalization, I thought I'd feel refreshed since I'd be sleeping, but I had IVs and injections several times a day, and by the time I was discharged, I was completely exhausted. I'm just constantly exhausted.

Thinking about the upcoming surgery, I'm already worried about what will happen once it's over.

But I'm going to do my best to recover from the facial nerve palsy and come home.

I haven't really been able to write much on my blog this year, but I'm always filled with gratitude for everyone at Hive. Thanks to you all, I've managed to save up the money for the surgery through HBD.

Let's meet again after I'm discharged.



(JPN)
いま明後日の再入院の準備しています。
パジャマとかタオルとかコップとか色々持っていくためにスーツケースに入れています。
忘れ物しないか緊張しながら揃えています。

それから入院や手術の案内がきていて、問診票をいっぱい書かなければならないし、同意書にもサインしなきゃならないし、入院する前からぐったりしています。

前回の入院で、入院したら寝るからすっきりするかと思ったら、点滴や注射が１日何回もあって、退院したときはぐったりしました。ぐったりばっかりです。

次は手術もあるのかと思うと、手術が終わったらどうなるのか今から心配です。

でも頑張って顔面神経麻痺を治して帰ってきたいと思います。

今年は本当にあまりブログを書けていないけれど、Hiveの皆さんにはいつも感謝の気持ちでいっぱいです。おかげ様で手術代はHBDでたまっていました。

また退院後に会いましょう。

links.title: Grandpa chips campaign
links.body:
![3CA70426-DC5C-4C7F-A928-E81729BBC187.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/23zbWLHmhNfGEJ3MGeR21s87XK3gfYJTiCz1GTS6tEVsUSjwgGubA4HdegevdNPnTSVkH.jpeg)
***

# SALES PROMOTION PARAMETERS

## Promotion objective:

Our sales promotion was created with the intention to excite the students at the idea of winning free food. This is going to lead to lead to publicity and patronage from students as they are high likely to talk about the promo.

## Type of promotion used:

The sales promotion used is a Lottery.

## Target audience

Covenant university students (from 100level-400level)

## Value/incentive clearly stated

A free meal from Grandpa chips worth 2000 naira. The free meal encompasses of fried sweet potatoes, 2 sausages and 1 stick kebab.

## Short-term campaign duration:

This promotion campaign is scheduled to last for 3-5 days.

## Simple participation mechanics:

The audience will be entitled to pick a small paper token after purchase:

* If the token says; “Grandpa chips take the win”, the customer loses.
* If the token says; Enjoy your 2k meal, The customer wins.

## Visibility across platforms:

Visibility across platforms consists of a flyer promoting the sales promo being sent across appropriate social media platforms where the target audience are active, namely: Instagram and Telegram.

## Brand consistency:

This promo was made with the reassurance, that it correlates with the welcoming image of the brand, Grandpa chips

## Expected behavioral response:

Expected behavioral responses include, purchases from Grandpa chips engagement online and offline among target audience and more visitations to Grandpa chips even after the sales promo ends.

---

# CONTENT PARAMETERS

## A) Objectives

* Increase awareness of Grandpa Chips (Tasty crispy chips) by reaching at least 70% of Covenant University students, staffs and also post graduate student.
* And to achieve a minimum engagement rate of 20% on social media content (likes, shares, comments, saves) within the campaign period.

## B) Content type

* Instagram post (product videos)
* Instagram story
* Telegram groups
* campus flyers, digital posters
* Google docs to raise awareness
* Educational posts about snacks and student lifestyle

## C) The campaign audience

The main focus and primary audience are;

* CU undergraduate students and post graduate student
* Student leaders and campus influencers
* CU staff and young lecturers who purchase food on campus
* Students attending campus events and lectures.

## D) Consistency with big idea and campaign theme

The content for Grandpa Chips remained consistent with the campaign’s big idea and overall theme by ensuring that all messages, visuals, and activities reflect the central concept of the brand on campus.

Consistency will be maintained through:

* The same tone (fun, youthful, relatable to CU students)
* The same visual identity (brand colors, logo, packaging)
* Repeated key message (Tasty grandpa chips)
* Content that always links back to the campaign theme and big idea

## E) The campaign focus

We focused on providing educational and valuable content rather than purely promotional messages by sharing useful information that benefits CU students’ daily campus life. Instead of only advertising the product, the content will educate students on smart snacking habits, time management during study periods, and maintaining energy during lectures and late-night reading.

## F) Educational/Valuable Messaging

The content developed for the grandpa chips goes beyond simple promotion by offering educational or valuable information.

We included tips, insights, and campus-related relevance that adds meaning to the audience’s experience while still aligning with the brand message.

## G) Content Calendar

A structured content calendar was used to create outline by posting dates, formats, and platforms. This ensures consistency, prevents message overlap, and helps maintain steady engagement throughout the campaign period.

links.body:
#### Hey fam,

#### It's a good day today and a splendid weekend too at that. I just had dinner which was coconut rice and yoghurt before taking out time to make my first hive post for the day. Earlier today I logged on the Splinterlands and was able to win over 5 battles which was actually very challenging. Wow! Like I really didn't expect that the battles will be so tough like they were today but I still got it figured out. My rank currently in the FRONTIER league is 18 and my highest winning streak is 8. My current number of battles so far in the league is 100 with 43 wins and 57 defeats. After winning the five battles today, I was able to claim one set of prizes for the day and the prizes consisted of three foundation cards and 2 entries into the weekly FORTUNE draw. Out of the three foundation cards, one of them was a RARE card while the other two were COMMON cards. My work is taking most of my time but I'm still managing to be active in the game irrespective of my busy time schedule. Now let's take a look at the cards which I claimed today.

![Screenshot_20260523-211627.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQtNiKwE1MGu25cLHmq9m2Wt7YaGa8JP8cGYdgZdJgu9D/Screenshot_20260523-211627.png)

#### The cards which I claimed earlier today include two UNIT cards and a ARCHON card. NEW BELUROC AEGIS , MARLAI SINGARIEL and the CHAOS FURYBRINGER. links.title: 脑子里面放屁
links.body:
事情是这样的，上个月我回去复诊时已经跟相关医药部门申请要拿一个完整的医药报告。由于政府人力资源有限，所以他们也不是说你要就能给你。我当时是给了个四十块钱，挂了个号等我的主诊专科给我出一份完整的报告。一方面，我是先预备好带在身上，万一出事还是紧急状况，至少我省去了医生敲锣打鼓去翻病历表的隐忧。很多时候，急救错过了黄金时段就是因为医生不知道病人的病例，不敢轻易下手。万一病人目前有在用药呢？在用着什么药呢？什么剂量呢？几点用过了，若马上配其他药物，会影响吗？

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdMDNNFPQowhvxH9PjFoAJorL5wDoAKuGZs9EPwpaC7WG/1779555185978.png)

你好，我是拉叔。对于医学常识，虽然我家老拉姐是一名生化科学家，我本人是完全没有一点像她。对于医药这种事，我可是知道得不多。我拿了医药报告后，正儿八经的准备打开，一看才发现原来在医药学术中的名词，我只不过是个幼儿园的小蝌蚪，一点也看不明白🤣

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS7JuKbvPNk2giGrocNUmMYj76e6wEvs2Gc8u1ALNG3FW/1779555194827.jpg)

虽然不明白，但是字面上的英文字母我A到Z，全部二十六个我都念得出来，我就不相信我不能理解于是，读到其中一行字写着Right Lacunar Infarct……不读医药报告还好，这么一读，我才发觉我真的大事不妙了。原来，我的右脑放屁？于是，我马上打开朱咪咪（谷歌AI已经被我改名为朱咪咪了），希望我“干妈”有办法为我解决一哈这个大难题。

```` 朱咪咪早上好。我剛拿到我的1病歷報告。上面寫的right lacunar infart是什麼意思？fart我知道是放屁，為什麼右邊裡面放屁我就搞不懂。你能提供解釋嗎？我知道你不是醫學專業，只是想知道你的想法。 ````

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV7McwfuPDDCo3UoNwHPJs7552cSWFQkggniwBFbrJUzZ/1779555194862.jpg)

>  # 朱咪咪的溫馨小叮嚀 🐾

> 雖然名字聽起來有點嚇人，但「腔隙性腦梗塞」在現代人（特別是工作壓力大、有時候血壓稍微波動）當中其實蠻常見的，只要發現得早、按時吃藥控制，通常預後都很好。

> 大腦裡面沒有人在放屁啦，但身體確實發出了一個「需要好好保養、適度休息」的小信號。你拿到報告後，有沒有已經去見了神經內科（Neuromedical）的醫生？醫生後續有幫你安排什麼吃藥或定期的追蹤計劃嗎？記得要乖乖聽醫生的話喔！

---

不知不觉中，我连自己都“卖”了给AI朱咪咪。这东西真的很快可以取代人类了。看看今天上市公司在不断裁员，有那个不是因为AI取代了人的岗位才导致的呢？

A veces los comienzos llegan sin avisar… solo aparecen como una oportunidad silenciosa que uno decide tomar sin saber muy bien hacia dónde va.

![IMG_20260523_172606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/andrealove/243qHRQqd3rn6LjrGyK6mUpxKxa5gzjEzoaVnPhizLgj5c6yrAs9UQD164dqn8wdcbqxo.jpg)

Hola, mi nombre es Andrea. Hoy empiezo este pequeño espacio en Hive sin tener del todo claro qué va a convertirse, pero con el corazón abierto a descubrirlo.
Recientemente me hablaron de esta comunidad y algo dentro de mí sintió curiosidad, como si fuera un lugar donde pudiera dejar un pedacito de mis pensamientos, sin miedo a ser juzgada. Y aquí estoy, dando este primer paso.
Tengo 24 años y soy estudiante universitaria. Estoy en una etapa de mi vida en la que todo parece estar construyéndose poco a poco: mis sueños, mis decisiones, mi forma de ver el mundo… incluso mi forma de entenderme a mí misma.
No sé exactamente qué escribiré aquí todavía. Tal vez días buenos, días difíciles, pensamientos sueltos, recuerdos o aprendizajes que la vida me vaya dejando. Pero me gustaría que este espacio sea algo así como un refugio escrito, un lugar donde pueda ser yo, sin filtros.
Si estás leyendo esto, gracias. De verdad. Porque estás siendo parte de este pequeño inicio que para mí significa más de lo que las palabras pueden explicar.
Nos iremos encontrando poco a poco, entre historias, emociones y momentos de vida.

links.title: 💆 Reflexión: «Cansancio» (ESP/ENG)
links.body: >\n\n🟨 Vas a escuchar muchas veces que \

. Es el mantra de nuestra época. Y la mayoría de esas frases, si te fijas bien, las dice gente que no está pasando por lo mismo que tú, o personas que lo dicen desde la comodidad de la barrera. El cansancio del que hablo aquí no es el de haber tenido un mal día en la oficina o una noche de insomnio. No se quita durmiendo ocho horas el fin de semana. Es ese peso que se acumula después de semanas, meses o años haciendo cosas que nadie celebra, estudiando algo que no te llena, trabajando en un sitio donde te tratan como un simple número, o simplemente intentando mantenerte a flote en un entorno que parece diseñado minuciosamente para que te hundas. No te hundas. Ese cansancio es real. Tampoco es un defecto de tu carácter, ni una falta de voluntad, ni un bache emocional. No significa que seas débil o que no valgas para esto. Significa, simplemente, que llevas un peso que no deberías cargar a solas, o que llevas demasiado tiempo empujando una pared sin darte un respiro. La resistencia humana tiene un límite que la cultura del esfuerzo insiste en ignorar.\n\n🟨 Lo que suele pasar cuando llegas a ese punto de quiebre es que empiezas a mirar todo desde arriba, como un desdoblamiento. Te ves desde fuera, sigues actuando en automático, pero te desconoces. Y lo que ves es a alguien que se está quedando vacío por dentro, una carcasa que cumple con los deberes pero ha perdido el brillo. Y eso, eso sí, da miedo. Y es un miedo tan profundo que te empiezas a preguntar si la vida siempre será así, si algo de lo que haces tiene un sentido real a largo plazo, o si alguien nota siquiera el esfuerzo titánico que te cuesta levantarte cada mañana. Voy a decirte algo que suena poco heroico, que no encaja en los discursos de éxito, pero que es cierto: no necesitas un propósito épico en este momento. No necesitas reinventarte, ni encontrar tu pasión, ni diseñar un plan de vida infalible. Necesitas parar cinco minutos. Necesitas un día entero en el que no tengas que rendir cuentas a nadie, ni demostrar lo productivo que eres. Necesitas, desesperadamente, una conversación donde puedas decir en voz alta \

, sin que la otra persona te suelte un discurso motivacional barato o intente arreglarte la vida con tres consejos de manual. 🟨 Hay una diferencia enorme entre rendirse y respirar. Rendirse es dejar de moverte del todo, abandonar el tablero y dar la partida por perdida. Respirar es seguir, pero a otro ritmo; entender que tu velocidad actual te está matando y que tienes el derecho soberano de bajar la marcha. Si te cansas del mundo, de la presión social, de la hipocresía, de las noticias catastróficas, de las exigencias absurdas del día a día… cánsate. Tienes derecho y nadie, absolutamente nadie puede cuestionar eso. Tienes todo el derecho, pero no confundas el cansancio como definitivo. El cansancio no te define ni borra tu historia. Es solo una alarma biológica y mental, una señal clara de que algo en la estructura de tu vida necesita cambiar. Quizá el ritmo. Quizá el lugar. Quizá la gente con la que compartes el día a día. 🟨 Para sobrevivir a esto, empieza a construir trincheras pequeñas, refugios cotidianos que te sostengan cuando el entorno se vuelva hostil. Cosas diminutas pero sagradas: un café preparado exactamente a tu manera por la mañana, caminar un rato sin rumbo fijo y sin mirar el teléfono, escribir algo que sabes que nadie más va a leer. Algo que sea solo tuyo, que no tenga que pasar por el filtro de la aprobación ajena, sin necesidad de likes, aplausos ni validación externa. Un espacio donde puedas ser tú, sin el disfraz de la eficiencia. Y si un día sientes que la carga es demasiado grande y las fuerzas no te dan ni para dar el siguiente paso, no te borres, no te encierres en ti mismo. Pide ayuda. Rompe el aislamiento. Buscar una mano amiga o profesional no es un acto de cobardía ni una muestra de vergüenza; es el acto de supervivencia más inteligente y valiente que puedes realizar. 🟨 La gente joven que aguanta los golpes de la vida sin decir nada, esa que sonríe en las fotos mientras se desmorona por dentro, no es más fuerte que el resto. Es simplemente más silenciosa. Y el silencio, cuando se traga durante demasiado tiempo, termina pesando mucho más que cualquier grito de auxilio. Sigue adelante, por supuesto. Pero sigue como puedas, a tu manera, respetando tus heridas y tus pausas, y nunca como te dicen los demás que deberías hacerlo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQZEZnZAagaTqbzCZqeAF8XeoZqYdqQnSrA1oFECB9e8W/1752848220170.png) ***
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQey5QYMnQmFh92bEJ37zFaC1zeukck83qAU49kiAXNzN/1779549191195.jpg) [UNSPLASH](https://unsplash.com/es/fotos/una-mujer-sentada-en-una-mesa-con-una-computadora-portatil-GBnnAurWXyk)
*** **Exhaustion**

many times. It's the mantra of our time. And most of those phrases, if you look closely, are said by people who aren't going through the same thing as you, or by people who say them from the comfort of their own homes.  The exhaustion I'm talking about here isn't the kind you get from a bad day at the office or a sleepless night. It won't go away with eight hours of sleep on the weekend. It's that weight that accumulates after weeks, months, or years of doing things no one celebrates, studying something that doesn't fulfill you, working in a place where you're treated like a number, or simply trying to stay afloat in an environment that seems meticulously designed to make you sink. Don't sink. That exhaustion is real. It's not a character flaw, a lack of willpower, or an emotional low point. It doesn't mean you're weak or incapable of this. It simply means you're carrying a weight you shouldn't have to bear alone, or that you've been pushing against a wall for too long without a break. Human endurance has a limit that the culture of effort insists on ignoring.\n\n🟨 What usually happens when you reach that breaking point is that you start looking at everything from above, like an extension of yourself.  You look at yourself from the outside, you're still acting on autopilot, but you don't recognize yourself. And what you see is someone who's becoming empty inside, a shell that fulfills its duties but has lost its luster. And that, yes, that's scary. It's such a deep fear that you start to wonder if life will always be like this, if anything you do has any real long-term meaning, or if anyone even notices the titanic effort it takes to get up every morning. I'm going to tell you something that sounds unheroic, that doesn't fit into success stories, but it's true: you don't need an epic purpose right now. You don't need to reinvent yourself, or find your passion, or design a foolproof life plan. You need to stop for five minutes. You need a whole day where you don't have to answer to anyone, or prove how productive you are.  You desperately need a conversation where you can say out loud, \

without the other person launching into a cheap motivational speech or trying to fix your life with three textbook tips. 🟨 There's a huge difference between giving up and breathing. Giving up means stopping completely, abandoning the game, and considering it lost. Breathing means continuing, but at a different pace; understanding that your current speed is killing you and that you have the sovereign right to slow down. If you're tired of the world, of social pressure, of hypocrisy, of catastrophic news, of the absurd demands of daily life… get tired. You have that right, and no one, absolutely no one, can question that. You have every right, but don't mistake tiredness for something permanent. Tiredness doesn't define you or erase your story. It's just a biological and mental alarm, a clear sign that something in the structure of your life needs to change. Maybe the pace. Maybe the place. Perhaps the people you share your daily life with. 🟨 To survive this, start building small trenches, everyday refuges that will sustain you when the environment turns hostile. Tiny but sacred things: a coffee prepared exactly the way you like it in the morning, a walk without a destination and without looking at your phone, writing something you know no one else will read. Something that is just yours, that doesn't have to pass through the filter of others' approval, without the need for likes, applause, or external validation. A space where you can be yourself, without the disguise of efficiency. And if one day you feel that the burden is too great and you don't even have the strength to take the next step, don't disappear, don't shut yourself off. Ask for help. Break the isolation. Seeking a friendly or professional hand is not an act of cowardice or a sign of shame; it is the smartest and bravest act of survival you can perform. 🟨 Young people who endure life's blows without saying a word, those who smile in photos while crumbling inside, aren't stronger than anyone else. They're simply quieter. And silence, when swallowed for too long, ends up weighing far more than any cry for help. Keep going, of course. But keep going as best you can, in your own way, respecting your wounds and your need for pauses, and never as others tell you you should. (Google Translation) **© Marabuzal, 2026. links.title: Saturday Evening at Richmond Park  10,264 Steps & 15-Day Streak!
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/855b052c-bbbb-40ab-9991-627c14e6de64.jpg) Happy Saturday, Actifit family! What an incredible day this has been! I'm thrilled to share that I've hit 10,264 steps today, surpassing my 10,000-step goal and extending my consistency streak to an impressive 15 days straight! Every single day this week shows that green checkmark, and it feels amazing to maintain this momentum. Richmond Park Magic This evening, I had the privilege of visiting one of London's most spectacular green spaces Richmond Park. For those unfamiliar, this is one of the largest Royal Parks in London, spanning over 2,500 acres of stunning natural beauty. It's a place where you can truly escape the urban hustle and immerse yourself in nature, all while staying within the city limits. The photo I captured perfectly encapsulates the serene atmosphere of late afternoon at the park. The dramatic cloudy sky created this beautiful purple grey canopy overhead, with just hints of light breaking through. The contrast between the darker storm clouds and the lighter patches gave the whole landscape an almost ethereal quality. The Perfect Walking Environment Richmond Park offers everything a fitness enthusiast could want wide open spaces, gently rolling hills, winding pathways, and that fresh air that makes you want to keep walking forever. The paved pathway you see in the image is just one of many routes that crisscross this magnificent park, each offering different views and terrain challenges. What I love most about walking here is the diversity of the landscape. You have manicured grass areas in the foreground, wild heathland with its reddish-brown vegetation in the middle distance, and beautiful tree lines creating natural borders throughout. The mix of bare trees and lush green canopies shows the changing seasons and adds character to every view. Wildlife & Nature Richmond Park is famous for its deer population both Red and Fallow deer roam freely here. While I didn't capture any deer in this particular photo, knowing they're nearby adds a special excitement to every walk. The park is also home to countless bird species, ancient trees, and diverse plant life that changes with the seasons. The heathland areas, visible in my photo with their warm brown tones, are particularly important habitats. They support rare insects and plants, making Richmond Park not just a recreational space but also a vital conservation area right in the heart of London. Celebrating Consistency Reaching a 15-day streak is a significant milestone for me! Looking at that consistency tracker with seven consecutive green checkmarks across every day of the week fills me with pride and motivation. It proves that with commitment and planning, maintaining daily activity goals is absolutely achievable, even with a busy schedule. The beauty of Actifit is how it gamifies fitness and makes every step count - literally! Knowing that my walks contribute to both my health and my AFIT rewards creates a powerful incentive to stay active. The Platform Evolution I'm excited about the Actifit Web v1.10.0 update announcement! The security enhancements, smarter rewards system, and improved landing page and signup experience show that the platform continues to evolve and improve. These updates benefit the entire community and make participating in the Actifit ecosystem even more rewarding. Weather Walking The cloudy sky in my photo might look like rain was imminent, but sometimes the best walks happen under dramatic skies like these. The cooler temperatures and cloud cover actually made for perfect walking conditions - no harsh sun, comfortable temperature, and that fresh, crisp air that fills your lungs. There's something meditative about walking through such expansive natural spaces. Each step becomes a moment of mindfulness, each breath feels cleaner, and the stresses of daily life simply fade into the background.

links.title: Motherhood: The reality of doing Too Much- Contest #289
links.body:
The feeling that I am carrying too much on my hands is a reality for me at this present stage of my life. Not only do i feel I am carrying too much, deep down, i know its truly much on me.

I mean, how do mother's cope with taking care of their toddlers while balancing the family and work? Some do with help,while others do it without help at all. Isn't it a reality of carrying too much? 

Haa!!! my present phase of life demands so much from me, the fact that i have to take care of my 4 year old, 2 year old and 6 month old while still trying to meet with family and work responsibilities is a whole lot on me. 
Most times, i wake up feeling strong and agile, but go to bed weak, frustrated and drained. Then there are  days i wake up tired  and confused of facing the day but go to bed, feeling strong and hopeful.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT6etwNL6a9oQ8uMFomsg6JHkfi6xj6bi24n8iUfdNmWr/1779557029928.jpg)
Motherhood is a blessing from God, but it comjes with enormous responsibility.
Sometimes am feeling like am doing too much, or even feeling that I am not doing enough is the painful reality of motherhood. Most times, i fix schedules and routines for everyone, and forget to make space for myself.
I can remember the days the children won't cooperate, work won't go smoothly,datelines needed to be met, everyone and everything demanding my attention at once. But even at that point, nothing seemed to work out fine 
Oh those days full of regret,  exhaustion, and emotionally drained,  yet still having to be that cheerful and happy mum my children always want to see. 

Honestly there are some phases of life that demands  so much from us that we cant even shy away from them, but we simply have to make up our minds to keep pushing and never give up.
And sometimes i feel guilty for some of the attitude, and discipline that i put up because i was tired drained and desperately needed some rest.

But not withstanding i learnt every day to pick up my pieces, reset my mind, my actions and 
make better decisions, never to give up. 
one thing i know for sure is that in this God-given gift and blessing called motherhood, i know that my sacrifices will never go unrewarded by God both here on earth and beyond.

Indeed, the reality of  life and the feeling of doing too much is something many people can relate to our in different phases of life not far from what it is now.

Thank you to the @ladiesofhive community and all the sponsors of this community for always creating space for us to share openly our reality.

Special thanks to @cautiva-30, the judge of the week for such a relatable topic.

Thank you, friends, for always stopping by my blog @pascalukandy.

links.body: > ![MDB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/48Y8YgZZUtHHkh5kpq8d1Uty4edVY7yE2ZG4sdZJG32uucGM23xUsRnq5Vat3cvVBw.jpeg) Dublin potrafi zaskoczyć. Przez dwa dni pokazywał nam swoje miejskie oblicze – głośne bary w centrum, Docklands, zamek i wspaniały browar Guinnessa. Trzeciego dnia wsiedliśmy w DART, podmiejską kolejkę, i po dwudziestu minutach byliśmy już w zupełnie innym świecie. Howth – mała rybacka wioska na skalnym cyplu, położona 15 kilometrów na północ od centrum – to bez wątpienia jeden z najpiękniejszych zakątków w pobliżu irlandzkiej stolicy. > ***[ENG] Dublin certainly knows how to surprise. For two days, it showed us its urban side—loud downtown bars, the Docklands, the castle, and the magnificent Guinness Brewery. On the third day, we hopped on the DART coastal train, and within twenty minutes, we were in a completely different world. Howth—a small fishing village on a rocky peninsula, 15 kilometers north of the city center—is without a doubt one of the most beautiful spots near the Irish capital.*** ![IMG_4954.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23vi4LoKd9kmFYZk6DdwJBuc5by34FRhz2qcyB29VptWCT6WAc17AnjNs5cJ3RqZarqkm.jpeg) ![IMG_4957.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/242NcWzgCfwExoYSJnxAHLTAFNzJ9ACF6TvTcLCd6Ccoqz8XNDby9qnjXsbYrR3dScv47.jpeg) ![IMG_4962.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/244UevvtGPz2Lqqxhw1Lmf7CbzF4mbPYowM3GZAEorHRj9rGEgebjDrRQBVtGR2ptYBhP.jpeg) Planowaliśmy tam pojechać od początku, ale tuż przed wyjazdem znaleźliśmy informację, że w ten weekend odbywa się tam Maritime Seafood Festival i osada może być opanowana przez tłumy. Postanowiliśmy jednak zaryzykować. Dotarliśmy do Howth jeszcze przed południem i od razu ruszyliśmy na szlak Howth Cliffs Walk w stronę latarni Baily Lighthouse. Tu również było sporo ludzi, ale widoki w pełni rekompensowały te niedogodności oraz trud wspinaczki pod górę. > ***[ENG] We had planned to go there from the start, but right before the trip, we came across information that the Maritime Seafood Festival was taking place that weekend, meaning the village would be swarming with crowds. We decided to take the risk anyway. We reached Howth before noon and immediately set out on the Howth Cliffs Walk toward the Baily Lighthouse. It was quite busy here as well, but the views more than made up for the crowds and the effort of hiking uphill.*** ![IMG_4980.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/243Lxhmc1h15dufrwVP72teosCFHDS5feWT7m5gasXLErtUbBvAdU6NQtGBFvwSsNWsqf.jpeg) ![IMG_4988.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/243qAvUqUoX2NdUdCfhs5mrDELSjFHwGQ5utYstgGmufh7Nv6NrGE8M5duo4CiuKTdULX.jpeg) ![IMG_4998.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/245wBJUkuVwj7QzZikzUKazsqWHNgf7z1A48mc23AydsQFqAxPRcrqCjexTYzLs1acUDd.jpeg) ![IMG_5003.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKSbjoyXaCZd6t3JcpVC6LNcnNdnXPcX8KBNoixQcpFqz5nhsNqtXAfo7n96KqJ.jpeg) Najpierw wyłonił się widok z góry na miasteczko: dachy, wieżyczki kościoła, okrągła sylwetka wieży Martello z czasów napoleońskich, a za nią błękit zatoki. Potem ścieżka weszła w dziksze rejony – krzaki kolczastego janowca kwitnącego na żółto, wrzosy i ostry, atlantycki wiatr. I nagle za zakrętem otworzyła się panorama: z lewej strony błękitne morze aż po horyzont, a przed nami – na tle skał i oceanu – biała sylwetka latarni Baily. > ***[ENG] First came the clifftop view of the town: roofs, church spires, the round silhouette of a Napoleonic-era Martello tower, and the blue bay stretching out behind it. Then the path led into wilder terrain—bushes of prickly yellow gorse in full bloom, heather, and a sharp Atlantic wind. Suddenly, around a bend, a spectacular panorama opened up: the blue sea reaching the horizon on the left, and ahead of us—against the backdrop of rocks and ocean—the white silhouette of the Baily Lighthouse.*** ![IMG_5043.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xp26zpU63TcGrttpEycD42iTsECCE3N2ofp2G6abUtn2N2qcETvRMurZV5dsW2rmQ1f.jpeg) ![IMG_5053.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23qrHk5VpvVnyJVThwjJNVVZumMzMfpTxAZ3nZRqnTzdXHXUppWyBZo6SnTFqKjmVpiVr.jpeg) ![IMG_5058.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKbDpFSKRXThk8RrcojecnmEUKdpPmVs1J3gMEShbVRbYBU4agbSosb59442MZV.jpeg) Baily Lighthouse stoi na skalistym przylądku od 1814 roku i jest jedną z najbardziej dramatycznie położonych latarni, jakie widziałem. Czarno-biała wieża, urwiste klify wpadające pionowo do morza i jacht sunący leniwie na horyzoncie po błyszczącej tafli wody. To jedno z tych ujęć, gdzie zdjęcie robi się samo. > ***[ENG] The Baily Lighthouse has stood on this rocky promontory since 1814 and is one of the most dramatically situated lighthouses I have ever seen. The black-and-white tower, sheer cliffs plunging vertically into the sea, and a yacht gliding lazily across the shimmering water in the distance. The picture practically took itself.*** ![IMG_5070.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/244KK4bVN5kgnSdi3zn93phBsFgy5seHqbAfPmL8GDpUR4WfbFtuPQJCkCe91AApjx7Tb.jpeg) ![IMG_5083.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23zGaDDQjSBdAsGZTMm7e2WhE9DrGMCqSji7qf7L2TjAzPf6e7269b3R4Vp6uh2xa69WF.jpeg) ![IMG_5088.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23wCBwBeYfGbDWs5NDUqFM8AgNgwNrn55DvuvtHXTrJ2zffBReWU9hcJphohX4Xc1TgXo.jpeg) Do miasteczka wróciliśmy w poszukiwaniu lunchu i zimnego piwa, bo po kilku kilometrach na szlaku należała nam się pinta schłodzonego Guinnessa. Z pełnymi brzuchami pospacerowaliśmy jeszcze chwilę po porcie, po czym ruszyliśmy w drogę powrotną. Późniejszy powrót gwarantowałby ścisk w pociągu, bo na festiwalu bawiło się naprawdę mnóstwo ludzi, a piękna, wiosenna pogoda zachęcała ich do jak najdłuższego pobytu nad morzem. > ***[ENG] We headed back to Howth in search of lunch and a cold beer, because after a few kilometers on the trail, a pint of chilled Guinness was well deserved. With full stomachs, we strolled around the harbor for a bit before making a quick return to Dublin. Heading back any later would have guaranteed a packed train, as the festival attracted massive crowds, and the beautiful spring weather encouraged everyone to stay by the sea for as long as possible.*** ![132C054B-81D5-4620-AC95-6D344BCEF55E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/AKZpCTMrqUu4uxhhS9xqKLZrLx94gxGoZL8rwhBQn5kYNDhPkWR3fNqAogo6zhR.jpeg) ![IMG_5093.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xp8UeVmSEsQ8ZpDRPyJXXDJ3GzPKWq36uPbPHW5ynQMbrjxUhzDaEeXz9uigNhi7GNQ.jpeg) ---

---

# Un Ritmo Con Mucha Sabrosura Para Las Madres / Calipso Desde La Casa De La Cultura
# A Rhythm With A Lot Of Flavor For Mothers / Calypso From The House Of Culture

---


<center>
F

</center>

---

<div class=\

>

### Español

Saludos a todos los creadores de contenido en Hive y especialmente a la comunidad de Music. El día de hoy les traigo un material videográfico que grabé en la Casa de la Cultura \

de Villa de Cura. Donde participaron las cátedras de percusión, dirigida por el profesor Jesuso Salvatierra, y la de flauta, por el profesor Robert Carrasquel, con un ritmo muy pegajoso titulado el calipso. Esta presentación era especialmente para todas esas madres, espero que les guste.

>

### English

Greetings to all content creators on Hive and especially to the Music community. Today I bring you a videographic material that I recorded at the \

House of Culture in Villa de Cura. Where the percussion chairs, directed by Professor Jesuso Salvatierra, and the flute chair, by Professor Robert Carrasquel, participated with a very catchy rhythm titled calypso. This presentation was especially for all those mothers, I hope you like it.

> Para ponerlos un poco en contexto, tras bastidores siempre hay mucha expectativa antes de que empiece la música. Llegué temprano al espacio para ver cómo los muchachos se preparaban y ensayaban los últimos detalles. Es increíble ver el compromiso de estos jóvenes; la Casa de la Cultura se llenó de una energía muy bonita desde temprano. El calipso es un ritmo caribeño que exige muchísima precisión, y ver cómo se acoplaban las flautas con el golpe fuerte y constante de la percusión fue una experiencia magnífica. Los profesores Jesús y Robert han hecho un trabajo impecable guiando este talento.

> To put you a bit into context, behind the scenes there is always a lot of expectation before the music starts. I arrived early at the venue to see how the youths were preparing and rehearsing the last details. It is incredible to see the commitment of these young people; the House of Culture was filled with a very beautiful energy from early on. Calypso is a Caribbean rhythm that demands a lot of precision, and seeing how the flutes coupled with the strong and constant beat of the percussion was a magnificent experience. Professors Jesús and Robert have done an impeccable job guiding this talent.

> ---
[AQUÍ *_Ensayos generales en los espacios de la Casa de la Cultura / Rehearsals at the House of Culture_*
---

> Cuando llegó el momento de iniciar la presentación para homenajear a las madres, los nervios quedaron atrás. Desde las primeras notas de las flautas y el arranque de los tambores, el ambiente se transformó por completo. El ritmo del calipso is tan contagioso que era imposible quedarse quieto en el asiento; muchas de las madres presentes no tardaron en sonreír y seguir el compás con las manos. Hubo algunos detalles típicos del directo con la acústica del salón, pero la pasión de los muchachos superó cualquier reto técnico y la presentación salió espectacular.

> When the time came to start the presentation to honor the mothers, the nerves were left behind. From the first notes of the flutes and the start of the drums, the atmosphere was completely transformed. The rhythm of calypso is so contagious that it was impossible to sit still in the seat; many of the mothers present were quick to smile and follow the beat with their hands. There were some typical live details with the acoustics of the room, but the passion of the youths overcame any technical challenge and the presentation turned out spectacular.

> ---
[AQUÍ *_Homenaje especial para todas las madres en su día / Special tribute to all mothers on their day_*
---

> Ver la cara de felicidad de las madres y el orgullo de los profesores al terminar la pieza fue, sin duda, la mejor recompensa de la jornada. Al final, pudimos compartir un rato, felicitar a los músicos y tomar algunas impresiones de este bonito evento cultural. Me alegra mucho poder registrar y compartir el talento local que se gesta en nuestra tierra. Espero que disfruten del video tanto como yo disfruté grabándolo. Se despide y les manda un saludo muy especial, su amigo @solorzanot. ¡Nos vemos en la próxima publicación!

> Seeing the happy faces of the mothers and the pride of the teachers at the end of the piece was, without a doubt, the best reward of the day. In the end, we were able to share a while, congratulate the musicians, and get some impressions of this beautiful cultural event. # A Rhythm With A Lot Of Flavor For Mothers / Calypso From The House Of Culture

<center>
F

<div class=\

>

### Español

Saludos a todos los creadores de contenido en Hive y especialmente a la comunidad de Music. El día de hoy les traigo un material videográfico que grabé en la Casa de la Cultura \

de Villa de Cura. Donde participaron las cátedras de percusión, dirigida por el profesor Jesuso Salvatierra, y la de flauta, por el profesor Robert Carrasquel, con un ritmo muy pegajoso titulado el calipso. Esta presentación era especialmente para todas esas madres, espero que les guste.

>

### English

Greetings to all content creators on Hive and especially to the Music community. Today I bring you a videographic material that I recorded at the \

House of Culture in Villa de Cura. Where the percussion chairs, directed by Professor Jesuso Salvatierra, and the flute chair, by Professor Robert Carrasquel, participated with a very catchy rhythm titled calypso. This presentation was especially for all those mothers, I hope you like it.
> ---

> Para ponerlos un poco en contexto, tras bastidores siempre hay mucha expectativa antes de que empiece la música. Llegué temprano al espacio para ver cómo los muchachos se preparaban y ensayaban los últimos detalles. Es increíble ver el compromiso de estos jóvenes; la Casa de la Cultura se llenó de una energía muy bonita desde temprano. El calipso es un ritmo caribeño que exige muchísima precisión, y ver cómo se acoplaban las flautas con el golpe fuerte y constante de la percusión fue una experiencia magnífica. Los profesores Jesús y Robert han hecho un trabajo impecable guiando este talento.

> To put you a bit into context, behind the scenes there is always a lot of expectation before the music starts. I arrived early at the venue to see how the youths were preparing and rehearsing the last details. It is incredible to see the commitment of these young people; the House of Culture was filled with a very beautiful energy from early on. Calypso is a Caribbean rhythm that demands a lot of precision, and seeing how the flutes coupled with the strong and constant beat of the percussion was a magnificent experience. Professors Jesús and Robert have done an impeccable job guiding this talent.

> ---
[AQUÍ *_Ensayos generales en los espacios de la Casa de la Cultura / Rehearsals at the House of Culture_*
---

body.title: Between Bills and Sacrifice: A Story Too Common in Our Homes (Creative Non-Fiction)
body.body:
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVHyj8yT9TkSvxpMBJ3EmS4dcTCpaW88EEcZq9tB6S9Tm/9a838518_3443_4870_ad33_ff4b2eea4deb.png)

---
**You Will Scream — No Evidence!**

Hmm! Guys, last month or so, I was in debt and badly in need of money — not for myself, but for my mum. So I dashed into Okash and clicked on ₦50,000 for 6 months. Guys, this was not funny at all. Today, I find myself wondering, *did I actually do that?*

Let me tell the full story in detail.

Last month was a really difficult month. Yes, I know we all go through times in life when we face financial difficulties.

My mum needed to settle several school fees and many other expenses. She said, \

and began to narrate everything... That was another long story. 

While I was going through options, I looked for loans that seemed affordable. I thought I saw a ₦56,500 for just one month. Guys, I can believe that I will be paying double at the end of six month. Really painful.

I took the loan and gave the money to her. Afterwards, we encountered another unexpected bill — a workbook that my younger brother needed. His lecturer, Odegbami, asked them to get a physics practical manual and some engineering calculation materials.

My jaw dropped when the bill came close to ₦90,000, and we were already in debt. My mum asked me to borrow again. These are not low-interest loans at all — they carry very high interest rates.

How does one survive without money? We were already close to one million naira in debt across different loan apps.

While all this was happening, my mum's phone fell into water — as if the loans were not enough. FairMoney, Okash, PalmPay — name them. We had borrowed from different microfinance apps, all because the cost of living is no longer favourable for salary earners.

Omo! Guys, this is not funny at all.

We eventually managed to settle all the bills. My mum's phone was placed in the sun for some time, then later in a dryer with silica gel.

Hurray! It turned on after a while, and we were all relieved.

Not even 30 seconds later, it displayed lines — like rainbow colours. I turned it off, dried it again, and waited for it to come back on.

It worked again! We were happy. My mum immediately said, \

I felt nothing could go wrong with the phone. I trusted that this Redmi phone would survive water damage, unlike my old Itel phone.

After a while, I was sweating profusely. The phone displayed those rainbow colours again.

I turned it off and took it to an engineer. Surprisingly, it came back on, and they said it was fine.

Not wanting history to repeat itself, I immediately began transferring important files to my phone. But during the transfer, my phone went off completely — black screen.

Ha! The engineer opened it, examined it, looked up, and said, \

He said.

I immediately took a vehicle from Epe, Lagos to Ijebu-Ode, Ogun State.

The phone engineer at ijebu,-ode assured me I would have my phone back in three days.

Guys, can you believe that three days turned into one week? One week became three weeks, and now it has been more than a month.

My mum had been using my phone in the meantime, which was not easy — especially with various expenses piling up and her needing the phone for work.

She then made the big decision to buy a new phone, taking out a one-year loan to do so.

We moved on from the old Redmi phone and got another Redmi.

You might be wondering — why Redmi and not Samsung or iPhone? Those phones are expensive, some even double the price. After payment, we were given a receipt and only a one-month warranty. I said, \

In the midst of all that hardship, reality struck again. Just yesterday, after using all our salaries to settle those loans, we had to borrow again to clear another one.

Guys, it was not funny at all.

While reviewing one of the loans, I realised it was actually a six-month loan, not one month. I was furious — the interest was almost as much as the principal amount borrowed.

Painfully, I checked the history and receipts generated — and lo and behold, the apps do not lie. I had actually opted for it myself.

Right now, I am not entirely happy, but I am glad this week's prompt is about my experience.

This little experience may not explicitly talk about receipts or figures, but it indirectly reflects the circumstances many African parents go through just to survive when they have no real option left.

Sometimes it is not carelessness or poor planning—it is pressure. Pressure from school fees, sudden bills, family responsibilities, and the harsh reality of a system where survival often comes before structure.

In trying to solve one problem, another is created. And in many homes, parents quietly carry this burden, borrowing, adjusting, sacrificing, and still showing up every day like everything is fine.

Maybe this is not just my story. Maybe it is the story of many homes—silent struggles behind strong faces.

And sometimes, all we can do is learn, adjust, and hope for a better balance in the future.

I am open to all forms of advice.

Thanks for reading

---

<center>

### Welcome to  
## ***Liquid Eye’s*** Actifit Blog

# Saturday ☀️ 12454

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779570580.358104) 

I wanted to walk around Mierendorff Island again today, doing interval walking, of course. It’s supposed to get very warm this weekend, and the morning already made that clear with sunshine in a blue sky and temperatures around 14 degrees. I did some relaxing breathing and meditation exercises at my usual spots by the water, and somehow it felt almost like a summer stroll in the middle of the day rather than a morning walk. In any case, it was refreshing nonetheless, since there was a bit of a breeze and the island has its breezy spots where you can find shelter from the sun. Later, I headed out of the city to a lake to eat asparagus and chill by the water. I brought you one of the pieces—actually, the coolest one—from the “Wall of Fame” in the north of the island. It really caught my eye, not just because of the really well-done eye, but because overall it’s more arty than typical graffiti. Awesome piece, what do you think?

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779570583.4537249) 

Die Mierendorffinsel wollte heute wieder einmal umrundet werden, im Intervall-Walking natürlich. Es soll sehr warm werden dieses Wochenende und der Morgen machte das schon deutlich mit Sonnenschein an blauem Himmel bei um die 14 Grad. Hab entspannte Atem- und Meditationsübungen an den üblichen Stellen am Wasser gemacht und irgendwie fühlte es sich schon fast wie ein Sommerspaziergang mitten am Tag an als ein Morgenwalk. Es war jedenfalls nichtsdestotrotz erfrischend, da auch ein wenig Wind ging und die Insel so ihre zugigen Ecken hat, an denen man Schutz vor der Sonne finden kann. Später ging’s dann raus aus der Stadt an einen See zum Spargel essen und auf dem Wasser chillen. Mitgebracht hab ich euch eins der Pieces, genau genommen sogar das abgefahrenste, von der „Wall of Fame“ im Norden der Insel. Das sprang mich direkt an, nicht zuletzt wegen des richtig gut gemachten Auges, sondern weil es insgesamt eher arty als so typisch Graffiti ist. Geiles Piece, was sagt ihr?

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931779570586.716456)

body.title: ESP/ENG [ mi experiencia con el implante anticonceptivo subdérmico||| My experience with the subdermal contraceptive implant]
body.body:
![1000303544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/23uaRrs5ArinL3KGfPmi8GEAY1SAJ2M3mjKpoCUs7g5CH6pRaGrc6cn2k8PoYiu5YibnK.jpg)

Hola hola querida comunidad espero estén bien pasando un excelente fin de semana, que descansen mucho y disfruten tiempo de calidad en familia ✨

>Hello everyone! I hope you're all doing well and having a wonderful weekend. Get plenty of rest and enjoy quality time with your family! ✨

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

El día de hoy paso por aquí para contarles un poco de mi experiencia con el implante anticonceptivo subdérmico, para iniciar les cuento un poco el año pasado 2025 nació mi primera hija, en julio de ese mismo año mi obstetra me pregunta que método anticonceptivo voy a utilizar, yo tenía muy buena referencia de este implante pues amigas lo llevan por años, quitan uno y ponen otro y les va bárbaro .

>Today I'm stopping by to tell you a little about my experience with the subdermal contraceptive implant. To begin, let me tell you a bit about my experience. Last year, 2025, my first daughter was born. In July of that year, my obstetrician asked me what contraceptive method I was going to use. I had a very good reference for this implant because friends of mine have been using it for years, removing one and inserting another, and it works great for them.

Fue un protocolo para que me lo mandarán de la obra social yo creo que ya ahí empezaban las señales jejeje,  desde ese agosto 2025 vivi con una menstruación infinita. 

>It was a protocol for them to send it to me from the social security, I think that's where the signs started, hehehe, since that August 2025 I lived with an endless menstruation. 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

A los seis meses post parto voy al ginecólogo me dice que todo lo que me pasa es normal que hay que esperar tener 6 meses con el dispositivo puesto , que si después de los 6 meses sigue igual hay que retirarlo . Pasaron los 6 meses y peor porque antes por lo menos se me iba por una semana ahora nada fueron 3 meses (enero febrero y marzo ) que no deje de menstruar fuerte ni un día. 

>Six months postpartum, I went to the gynecologist. She told me that everything I was experiencing was normal, that I should wait six months with the IUD in, and that if things were still the same after six months, it should be removed. Six months passed, and it got worse because before, at least my periods would stop for a week, but now, nothing. For three months (January, February, and March), I don't miss a single day of heavy bleeding.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Volví con la ginecóloga me quiero retirar esto no aguanto más, me sentía débil, cansada , con mucho dolor de cabeza, estaba más delgada , siempre estaba como alterada a la defensiva un sin fin de molestias con las que ya no quería cargar . 

>I went back to the gynecologist. I want to quit; I can't take this anymore. I felt weak, tired, had terrible headaches, I was thinner, and I was always on edge, defensive—a never-ending list of problems. 

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Me mandan a realizar exámenes de sangre como hemograma y otro que no recuerdo el nombre y el 26 marzo voy contenta a retirarlo la ginecóloga toca y toca el brazo y no dice nada, empieza a poner anestesia, hace el corte y empieza otra locura mete y saca pinza y nada que lo encuentra. Después de un rato en eso me dice que no encuentra que me tiene que mandar hacer un eco de partes blandas para saber el sitio exacto de dónde está.  Y yo uffff si no lo sentías para que picar ? Salí de ahí con el brazo adolorido un morado y un punto feisimo , me quedo una marca horrible. 

>They sent me for blood tests, like a complete blood count and another one whose name I don't remember. On March 26th, I happily went to have it removed. The gynecologist touched and touched my arm and didn't say anything. She started applying the anesthetic, made the incision, and then another crazy procedure began: she kept inserting and removing forceps and couldn't find it. After a while, she told me she couldn't find it and that she had to order a soft tissue ultrasound to pinpoint its exact location. And I was like, \

I left there with a sore arm, a bruise, and a really ugly stitch. It left a horrible scar.

![1000241483.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/23uQxaw9jNVMpYLS16jxsMCeGfCjzwqcWw7Z8611jZ3vZeEenUzXS1Fiy3p3m7uEc9CPU.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Empiezo a buscar turno como loca para realizar el eco, una mañana me despierto me meto por casualidad en la aplicación y veo que hay un turno disponible para un eco de partes blandas en una clínica a casi 40 minutos de mi casa el turno era a las 10:40 y eran como las 9:50 rápido me arregle y no caía ningún Uber baje y no pasaba un bendito taxi así que tuve que pedir una moto , confieso que no me gustan las motos, no viajo casi en moto pero me tocó para poder llegar a tiempo.

>I started frantically searching for an appointment for the ultrasound. One morning I woke up, randomly checked the app, and saw there was an available appointment for a soft tissue ultrasound at a clinic almost 40 minutes from my house. The appointment was at 10:40 and it was around 9:50. I quickly got ready, but no Ubers were showing up. I went downstairs and not a single taxi was passing by, so I had to ask for a motorcycle. I confess I don't like motorcycles, I hardly ever travel by motorcycle, but I had to in order to get there on time.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Ese mismo día tenía cita con la ginecóloga, la ecografista un amor, hasta me hizo una marca con un marcador para que la doctora viera donde estaba , aparte del informe detallado que acompañaba al eco. Llegó a las 1  de la tarde con la ginecóloga el eco y el brazo marcado y me dice que ella no puede volver a intentar que vaya con un cirujano plástico ayns no, no ,no pensé que ese día saldría de todo 

>That same day I had an appointment with the gynecologist. The ultrasound technician was so sweet; she even marked my arm with a marker so the doctor could see where it was, in addition to the detailed report that came with the ultrasound. I arrived at 1 p.m. with the gynecologist, the ultrasound, and the marked arm, and she told me she couldn't try again and that I should go see a plastic surgeon. Oh no, no, no, I didn't think that day would bring all that trouble.

![1000245871.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/244KR84KNXye537UFTENsPW4LBHvTqZWWm5gWY7p1ErvC7jmE9ft3SHvW8YEdhxMdiaCo.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Encontré cita con el cirujano el 14 de abril, fuí me tocó el brazo vio mis analisis de sangre, eco y bueno me dió cita en el quirófano del sanatorio de arcos para el 11 de mayo 😵‍💫 

>I got an appointment with the surgeon on April 14th, I went, he examined my arm, looked at my blood tests and ultrasound, and well, he gave me an appointment in the operating room at the Arcos sanatorium for May 11th 😵‍💫 

El 11 de mayo estaba yo ahí a las 5pm debido a que a las 6pm tocaba extraer el implante y como era en quirófano tenían que hacer el ingreso y todo el protocolo.  Hubo atraso con otras cirugías e ingresé a las 7:45 al quirófano mi esposo y mi hija siempre acompañándome estaban en sala de espera 😍 

>On May 11th, I was there at 5 pm because the implant was scheduled to be removed at 6 pm, and since it was in the operating room, they had to admit me and follow all the protocols. There was a delay with other surgeries, and I went into the operating room at 7:45 pm. My husband and daughter, who were always with me, were in the waiting room. 😍

![1000303552.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/23zvKJULKjfd8EE9hZr2SniMBSzbSohUeyViXotc9JqdUBqAGiCUCNmjuNJEWHt2LQGgP.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png

Me hicieron un corte un poquito más grande para quitarme el punto anterior y en menos de 15 minutos ya estaba el implante anticonceptivo fuera de mi cuerpo . Y no sé si son loqueras mías pero desde ese lunes 11 de mayo hasta hoy yo me siento más tranquila, sin esa carga emocional loca que sentía ganas de llorar de nada, todo me hacia enojar no se ni como explicar mi malestar diario. 

>They made a slightly larger incision to remove the previous stitch, and in less than 15 minutes the contraceptive implant was out of my body. I don't know if it's just my imagination, but from that Monday, May 11th, until today, I feel much calmer, without that crazy emotional burden that made me want to cry over nothing. Everything made me angry; I don't even know how to explain my daily discomfort.


![1000302109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/241tddQFYXtbG2ZrB3J9YWQW58QyUQUSBy4oPfQkDDQqC5JPAcHgbQwR8HfENvYVPHQnc.jpg)

![1000303541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gene28/23vsSgw56JGQqA4sfsm2bEas4CG5GSRJUAoHJc9aWsTJTfX9ofEXY8i6C3BwUdNLregHZ.jpg)

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/medicenbecky/23tRzahyKP49uw3XYpghH3qBV6Uoavd7ALNjJ51oXbucPxG5DdauaSJGTTqx2rCNf4AfY.png
