links.title: Burning The Unwanted || A part of my weekend duties
links.body:
![IMG_20260523_134113_540.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23xp6cGbZYdZr2ztbXAcsm4GyYAh1yr1Jw3cvVnw1oQRvNGrPuRkWvQ8K2sa5uWM26AoW.jpg)


So yesterday my former landlord called me and asked me to return his house keys because he heard that I had moved out of the apartment. He also promised to refund my remaining house rent for one month.

Today, I went to my old apartment and saw how littered everywhere was due to the moving, so I decided to sweep the entire place and do some packing of unwanted items.

I packed everything with the assistance of my neighbor's son, who came to help me pack those unwanted items outside, I was able to finish packing them on time.

I bought a new lighter and used it to lit fire on those unwanted items. To my amazement, the fire burnt very well untill it began to affect my landlord's plantain. 

I was beginning to be scared then I asked myself why I did give a good distance between where I dumped those unwanted items with the plantain plantation.

My landlord who also came around, noticed a part of his plantain had shrinked due to the heat of the burning flames was unhappy.


![IMG_20260523_134051_962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/244KeAmDPMumUwj3LCGLfCdBSt6C2bh3k6SXyfVJ2SxbrfECZLS4ScFVFAef4dCnWDTd2.jpg)


He asked me to allow the flames to subside before adding more unwanted items to the fire in order no to destr0y his plantains in totality.

But the little I added to the flame, the higher it burnt. I felt bad at some point for the plantain, because for me I couldn't withstand the heat of the flames but the plantain did not have the legs to run away like I did each time I added new stuffs into the burning flames.

I touched the body of the plantain and it was very hot as if it was being cooked. I felt that my landlord might not return my remaining rent to me because I burnt his plantain. I don't know yet though, but I don't think so too, he is a good man, he will return my remaining rent.

I made sure I burnt every unwanted thing to ashes, after which I returned the house key and that was how my weekend went.


![20260522_200556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pinkbeee/23uQrdsjhRwt8Eq4afqJnL3JLPfbuR8q7WpNuG3LU8oMYwkUCToAh7dA4DwoAWdkjA9pC.jpg)

links.title: Unrepaired things
links.body:
Today I thought I had an easy task. To replace the capacitor on our lawnmower. Because it stopped working. The way it sounded, I immediately suspected the capacitor. But in the end, it was still broken. And while I was thinking about what to do next, an idea came to me. 
Do you have, are you holding any broken things?
 It doesn't matter if it's a mug without a handle waiting for you to glue a handle to it or some more complex electrical device waiting for you or a handyman to fix it.

![20260523_155340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AKKT9YmyaiMCRMPLbpoLa7N7rZf7pct4VCbhmDZ1avdnXiMTSPmy7PmcrcriXYE.jpg)


I'm an electrician by trade, so I keep a few unrepaired things. Which I'm sorry to throw away. Maybe I could fix them and give them to someone. I think that's a great idea. I have, for example, my grandmother's cake baking machine. My wife was cleaning it and I opened it to look at some wires that were sticking out. Something or someone distracted me, I mostly just put the machine together and left it without repair. In the meantime, we bought another larger machine and this one has been waiting in a part of the workshop where I keep unrepaired things.
I also have a cup from my childhood that I keep in the attic. It's probably all dusty in a corner. The handle fell off, which fell apart, so I keep the cup as a backup. Emotional, broken things. Maybe someone keeps it for that reason,like I do that cup.


![20260523_162649.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/markone85/AJpkUpeFGttcxaBrMadLnBJfdmh777qQMWKCaDTfBBR7fZhSodCBwdUZ36KEjVq.jpg)

Let's get back to the lawnmower. I have a yard of about 12-13 ares and I need a lawnmower.
Of course I own a sickle and a scythe.
But did you know that riding a scythe burns the most calories of any profession. That it can be a tough job.
Since it's not a condenser, I took the mower apart and saw that it had wrapped a string around the shaft and pulled it in. And that string is probably preventing the shaft from moving, or maybe even the shaft bearing is damaged. But that will have to wait until Monday when I can bring the mower motor in and borrow the tools to completely disassemble the motor.
Oh, I hope this thing doesn't stay broken, because I really need it.
---
Thanks for reading.
Until next time.
Stay healthy.
Markone85.
---

links.title: 【生活】赏花啦
links.body:
![IMG_8592.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaK32ud8zjdeLD7zxLXAjFrCWPVFxVM28VRUPG5scFJYe/IMG_8592.jpeg)

现在正是玫瑰花盛开的季节，在brandywine park 的河边就有一个规模不小的玫瑰园。里面种了各种不同品种的玫瑰花。去年的时候，我和某生路过那里才发现原来这里有个这么美的玫瑰园。所以，现在母亲过来，我们是一定要带她去的。 

![IMG_8599.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWMWuoaRqcxcMkEHmKYnuw2j1B7prXZy9JNySeevpLE4Y/IMG_8599.jpeg)

![IMG_8590.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNNdV4kkWNctSgMLByxdjrkmdsKXKQtNn4GDSBFbLMZBz/IMG_8590.jpeg)

某生的母亲也在这周来我们这里。要到国庆节的时候才会回去。这下家里热闹了很多。我母亲在上次来的时候也跟某生的父母见过面。现在某生的父亲已经去世，这还是我们第一次在上次奔丧的时候见到她。

![IMG_8589.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma4kH5dxnTs3PSXzNHpvCnCfUXhRoPwEYDJXPwtxd9VZJ/IMG_8589.jpeg)

![IMG_8588.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZrsAYLihH8Debj6HeDviFWoKBtcBZ7Ft9MDJbdMcmVAj/IMG_8588.jpeg)

![IMG_8586.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZi8LErZyqQ9vMRUHV8KkkWM8fTVY7qM14tpEzTmS64Aq/IMG_8586.jpeg)

某生的母亲在某生的父亲去世后，对家里做了很大的变化。她把所有的家具全部都换掉，连家里的墙壁都全部粉刷了，面目一新。某生给我看了照片，变化之大完全看不出原来的面貌。某生的母亲照顾某生的父亲几十年，在过去的几年特别难。现在终于可以为自己活。她这样我们也开心。 

![IMG_8578.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbivEbZmmkoLEf5gL56j8RpzCk5qVnZhGKD8FUnbFTfPB/IMG_8578.jpeg)

![IMG_8573.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZEL1XYLFEqkcdP889JhL8zb6bALA7p9NkAzchkLDSpro/IMG_8573.jpeg)

![IMG_8570.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQAjYReQTRE5dRkrRBSSDty11G4xezsbNz4dGxurTZZ57/IMG_8570.jpeg)

这几天一直下雨，好在也有短暂的停雨时间。某生看着天气预报的app，就选了个时间段带着我们三人一起去。某生前不久才做的膝盖手术，某生的母亲和我母亲也不能走太久的路，所以，去这个玫瑰园刚刚好。

![IMG_8566.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNxTs3Pfdq6qwRwyqscdYYag7ESTNNki9P397fZW2PoNZ/IMG_8566.jpeg)

![IMG_8569.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQAApvyTy85Ad2t2ubLPjUmCsmngQtxaCJEyv1sYCLWLy/IMG_8569.jpeg)

![IMG_8567.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP9yJqx3s6ezNQKvN78oyAinsN9XZkS74aTqdZMonq5Bd/IMG_8567.jpeg)

因为下雨， 有不少玫瑰花已经被打落在地上。但是，还是有不少开着正艳的花，而且还有很多还在酝酿中的花骨朵，估计这花期还有几周的时间。真好，春天就是好，这周是长周末，周一的memorial day 就代表着夏天的来临。今年的春天因为一直在服用抗敏感的药和治疗，虽然有时候还有轻微的过敏症状，但是，现在不需要禁足，可以大胆到外面踏春，赏花，真好！

Hi Hivelearners friends.
The early days of marriage are beautiful and we all know that whether it is an arranged marriage or a love marriage, we start seeing problems in both. After some time, however, we see more problems in love marriage because those people do not think or understand anything at that time and get married and later it is not easy to maintain the marriage at all. Many difficulties have to be faced and if only those people can maintain this relationship who support each other.
We have seen many problems where the boy and the girl run away and get married, and the boy is not able to earn money yet, but they marry out of love for each other, and then after that we see that when the family matters start going bad because it is impossible to run the house without money, and when the boy stops working, the girl also starts to worry, and then due to the shortage of money, things also start going bad,
Because of which the boy thinks that I have difficult circumstances, this woman is not supporting me, then because of this they separate from each other, this is one of the major reasons for the end of the marriage, and then we go crazy thinking that everything was fine for a few months after the wedding, so how did this happen? Then the biggest disadvantage is that if the girl finds someone else who has more money, she then leaves the boy.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-in-blue-dress-shirt-beside-woman-in-black-jacket-En1Is3KsRZw)
So what I am saying here is that marriage is a lifelong commitment, so all of us should think about everything in advance before getting married. If this continues to happen, there will be more problems for people in the future. So if we look at it in comparison, our arrangement is too long. After marriage, one person is living in extreme distress, who is fulfilling the relationship with all his heart, and the other person is not fulfilling it.
In many cases, we have also seen that the initial days of marriage are good for each person, but when a year or two pass, then love for each other starts to fade. Then we see that the boy also starts looking for another girl, and this is very wrong. When promises are made to spend the rest of their lives with each other, then it is most important to support each other even in difficult situations.

/> \[Source\](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-group-of-people-that-are-sitting-in-the-grass-\_XSSgw1MGPY)
In good situations, everyone is with each other, but in difficult situations, no one is with each other. In this world, we find every person whose nature is different. We have also seen many such people who have spent their entire lives with each other for the sake of each other. The problems in the lives of these people are more than ours,
But when they think of supporting each other, then they support each other. That's why I always say here that before starting a relationship, you should think about everything in advance. Good times and bad times happen in life, so choose the person who will be with you in good times and bad times.

links.title: Series progresivas, escuchando mi cuerpo.😎🙌🏽🏃🏻‍♀️
links.body: > Les comparto mi entrenamiento del dia viernes. Generalmente no entreno intervalos los viernes, pero debido a ocupaciones personales tuve que modificar un poco mi entrenamiento, y en la semana no habia entrenado intervalos, por lo que hoy me tocaba. Inicie mi entrenamiento con unos kilometros de calentamiento, mientras calentaba en el parque contemple un hermoso amanecer, y varias personas activas entre jovenes, adultos caminando, trotando por el parque esto me anima mucho, ya que se siente un ambiente muy emotivo. Al terminar mi calentamiento me fui al estadio, gracias a Dios ya estaba abierto, algunos atletas ya entrenando. Me hidrate un poco y comence las series, hoy presentia que no iba a rendir mucho ya que no sentia el cuerpo bien, creo que se me esta aporximando un virus, porque me sentia sin fuerzas, pero me dije voy hacer el entrenamiento completo no importa que no tenga el rendimiento esperado, pero esto es para trabajar mi mente. --- Y tal cual asi sucedio, nada mas inicie el primero y me dije no que va, pero bueno, ya cuando vi en cuanto termine el primer intervalo de 400 mts, en 2:30 minutos, estaba superior a lo que en estos momentos mi rendimiento da, pero bueno, me dije vamos a trabajarlas diferentes, me enfoque en tratar de que cada serie bajara un poco esos 2:30 minutos, y asi sucedio, no llegue a la optima, lo mas cercano que estuve fue de 2:04 minutos, pero bueno escuche mi cuerpo y hoy no estaba para darme mas, y no podia exigirme porque no es la idea, es un entrenamiento, mas bien me felicite por no abortar el entrenamiento, estuve a punto de hacerlo cuando en el parque mientras calentaba no me sentia bien. En total realice 8 series de 400 metros con descanso de un minuto.Realice unos kilometros de enfriamientos con posterior estiramiento pasivo. Seguimos amigos runners con los entrenamientos. 💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ --- . >Greetings and blessings.! >

>Here’s a look at my Friday workout. I don’t usually do interval training on Fridays, but due to personal commitments, I had to tweak my routine a bit, and since I hadn’t done any intervals all week, today was the day. I started my workout with a few kilometers of warm-up. While warming up in the park, I watched a beautiful sunrise and saw several active people—young people and adults—walking and jogging through the park. This really cheers me up, since the atmosphere feels very uplifting. When I finished warming up, I went to the stadium. Thankfully, it was already open, and some athletes were already training. I hydrated a bit and started the sets. Today I had a feeling I wouldn’t perform very well since my body didn’t feel right. I think I’m coming down with a virus because I felt weak, but I told myself I’m going to do the full workout no matter what, even if I don’t perform as expected—this is to train my mind. --- >And that’s exactly what happened. As soon as I started the first one, I told myself, “No way,” but anyway, once I saw that I’d finished the first 400-meter interval in 2:30, I realized it was faster than my current performance level allows. But I told myself, “Let’s approach these differently,” and I focused on trying to shave a little time off that 2:30 in each set, and that’s what happened. I didn’t reach the optimal time—the closest I got was 2:04—but I listened to my body, and today I just wasn’t up for pushing myself further. I couldn’t push myself because that’s not the point; it’s just a workout. Instead, I congratulated myself for not calling it quits—I was on the verge of doing so when I wasn’t feeling well while warming up in the park. In total, I did 8 sets of 400 meters with a one-minute rest.Run a few kilometers to cool down, followed by passive stretching Let’s keep at it, fellow runners.💕💕🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ --- --- Todo el contenido es de mi autoría y las imágenes son de mi propiedad Fotos fueron tomadas con mi HONOR X6a Plus Separador editado en Canva Traducido con [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > All content is my own and the images are my property. > Photos were taken with my HONOR X6a Plus > Translated with [Deepl](https://www.deepl.com) > Publisher edited in the application Canva [Puedes chequear mi actividad en Strava](https://strava.app.link/8RgvFSKKn3b) --- [ You can check my activity at Strava](https://strava.app.link/8RgvFSKKn3b) ![SRL-image-14.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTN93piGhVsStGYqyRaiGAqHLC4oXUyMuBepEzJJrRW59/SRL-image-14.png) --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@mcookies/series-progresivas-escuchando-mi-cuerpo)

> > El material disponible en internet sobre esta mariposa es algo escaso. En alguna página leí que era una rara mariposa, aunque la bibliografía especializada indica que se encuentra distribuida a lo largo de la zona neotropical en alrededor de 16 países.

> I was able to investigate that it feeds on various species of plants, among them Samanea saman, or as it is colloquially known, Samán, which is a common tree in the area where I observed it, hence its presence in the area is logical. ***

> The information I found was very repetitive, so this limited my ability to provide more details about this beautiful insect. In any case, it was a very pleasant surprise to find it along my way. ***

links.title: Green Rice Leafhopper (Nephotettix nigropictus)
links.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Nephotettix nigropictus*** | May 19, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdSnaswrpM81eoqYq9xqLAn4eNhyHHTzSqcZ3CMd849q7/mix_20260524_012506.jpg)


On the afternoon of May 19th, I was taking a walk in my orchard. Suddenly, I looked at a banana tree and saw a small, bright green insect. It blended in with the green color of the banana tree in such a way that it was difficult to see with the naked eye without very sharp vision. It had some beautiful black spots or patterns on its back. I took several pictures of it very carefully with my macro lens. Later, I checked its pictures on the Internet and the i-Naturalist app and found out some great information.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWFZ8Zk6p9k4x723FZfzsNNeod5iuTKQJ1vGLgCphTbFU/mix_20260524_012634.jpg)


​Name and Identification:
 According to the Internet, its official English name is **Green Rice Leafhopper** and the scientific name is ***Nephotettix nigropictus***. According to the classification of scientists, this insect is a member of the **Cicadellidae** family and its genus or genus is **Nephotettix**. That is, the name and genealogy are all in one, it is a leafhopper moth.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSYFpBfk43Fb8o2eeNLNo3gFSeMY9KwUkpRv1Y3tiH67F/mix_20260524_012902.jpg)

​Home and Habitat:
The home of these insects is mainly the tropical region of our Asian continent. They can be seen in almost all countries of Southeast Asia, starting from Bangladesh, India, Nepal. Their main habitat is rice fields, grassy fields, damp places on the edge of wetlands, and various crop fields (such as millet). However, sometimes they get lost or fly in the wind and land on nearby banana trees or other fruit trees like in my garden.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ5QQu2FLSrLjrxNvBWpp8kTQc8JTse3qxtkPqYxZJo7V/mix_20260524_012726.jpg)

​Food:
They do not bite or chew leaves like other insects. Their mouths are shaped like needles. The main food of these insects is the liquid sap inside the young leaves and stems of plants. They sit on the leaves of the plant and insert their needle-like mouths and suck the sap continuously. Their main food is mainly rice plants, grasses and millet plants.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb2y1tkCCfzvNJzQJPNCv7q8Bqj4S4Qqh15HtZB1nVJpv/mix_20260524_013027.jpg)

​Reproduction:
Their reproduction process is quite interesting. The female leafhopper lays small eggs in rows by making a small hole in the middle of the leaves of grass or rice plants or in the tissue of the stem. After a few days, the eggs hatch and very small babies or 'nymphs' come out. These babies gradually grow up to become full-fledged green leafhoppers by changing their shells several times and spread their wings to fly.

​Benefits:
Although they do not directly benefit humans, they play a big role in maintaining the food chain or ecosystem of nature. These insects play a very beneficial role as the main food or prey for various garden spiders, frogs, lizards and small birds to survive every day.

​Harms:
Although they look so beautiful and peaceful, they are a terrible harmful insect or pest for the agricultural sector. They cause great damage, especially in rice fields. They not only suck the sap of the plants, but also spread deadly diseases or viruses (such as rice tungro virus) from one plant to another. This results in great damage to the farmers' crops.

Every small creature in nature has its own story. This little insect in my garden taught me that lesson. Do you see such insects in the fields and fields of your area? You can tell me in the comments.

I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)
.

links.title: Lazy Farm Update
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>


![IMG_5710.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/Ep1VxBmpeZFrCPP2Di8e7ProsXxXQi5hxB1q4jacKtnsZQQn5DfNFb7Z1GJQhn1Xuet.jpeg)
<sup>here, I was wishing a coconut would just fall and make my day</sup>

This is me doing a very lazy farm update because I’m honestly exhausted as I write this.


![IMG_5712.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EoyNWuVqaws1xSEqLNWuPX4GhCQk65i1u9ApPKsMQR5hroy1BCc1smnjJx7jPs75pXD.jpeg)

So this year, I decided I would keep visiting my parents’ house until it’s finally time for corn harvest. I’ve never really been around during harvest season before, which means I’ve missed out on all the fun, eating freshly boiled corn straight from the farm and actually experiencing the harvesting process itself. And honestly, that feels like a crime considering how much I love corn. Lol.

![IMG_5708.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EoiTKxSgtj8AFiCKVLDUHkvtefMFzJWrvUnE3u9rDyp9AdkTVcbLnfRAnH16bNHdrpQ.jpeg)

So yeah, I’ve been home more often lately, even though the plants are still very young.

![IMG_5702.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23wMYHtR6NJdCSMsPs5hZDB7PXvc7nwRk3aoDCWwiF2wNbvMqGp1dTARqiYuQXiLtkHqB.jpeg)

Today, my mom and I went to the farm to get some African pumpkin leaves for soup. We could have bought them from the market, but after the last experience we had, absolutely not. The last leaves we bought nearly sent all of us to the afterlife through nonstop stooling. Till today, I strongly believe the farmer overloaded them with fertilizer or something equally suspicious.

![IMG_5693.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/244UmmeSkRFNXqo2CQ6APCPXQXczRxc7zauayEi6LRhTy1cqaAaFzpNVwxZFNvnTWXR6x.jpeg)

So this time, we decided to play it safe and get fresh leaves directly from my mom’s farm. The walk there was actually enjoyable. I loved the calm breeze, open paths, greenery everywhere, twas very peaceful. But the sun almost peeled my scalp off my head though. Next time, I’m definitely wearing a sunhat because what was that heat?

![IMG_5701.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23wCA1FtyNtiFXSpcauWHSsC3fYZHxj4S3wHWRCJgfrTEBcZRrTXGA9V8g2CzSyZrNC5R.jpeg)

Anyway, we finally got to the farm only to meet pure heartbreak. Some people had allowed their goats to roam around freely and those animals had absolutely no respect for boundaries. They damaged so many of our crops. They chewed through some of the corn plants, destroyed a good amount of the pumpkin leaves, ate the waterleafs, and even dug up planted cassava.

![IMG_5699.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tveWSxRVu5mW4UdUuYJNEtFxNb73DXfTgRyrHHnLwYDh7GCjbh2pwn8ApjcvoKtzLLL.jpeg)

For a moment, my mom just stood there staring in disbelief before the anger finally landed. She immediately called out the owner of the goats and let’s just say, the conversation that followed was not peaceful at all. There was a very heated exchange right there on the farm.

![IMG_5706.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tbo3bev51M1ibEe4bmhwMgyAjBZpUVpem6B245TDEi8Ce3cknP7uXZRFvatF6cvZbYd.jpeg)

I understand her frustration because farming is already stressful enough without animals treating your hard work like an all-you-can-eat buffet.

![IMG_5704.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EoiVh1g4yqFkKhc84bAp31hJefsr4faB4g8r7HtC1Emt2APbPFUYcqTS38z2U7vSFgj.jpeg)

Anyway, we eventually gathered the little pumpkin leaves that survived the attack and headed back home not too long after. Hopefully, the goat owner keeps them under control moving forward because letting animals trespass into people’s farms and destroy crops is honestly unfair.

![IMG_5700.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/243LriaTm1R6EhSxVHvA253xYmAj9ACLF1t3oVc2LGDX1GjK5fpiLzvNZomneMnXEKBEy.jpeg)

Right now, I’m mostly worried about the corn plants. I really hope the damage doesn’t affect their growth or stop them from yielding properly when harvest season finally comes around. Because after all this anticipation, I deserve my fresh boiled corn in peace. 

![IMG_5705.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23zkdyEhKpmkFgBoRuk3AeCeghmLoo1TYgeRCmp4q1J6sB14Btu3971c8Ur9TEUkjSG7N.jpeg)
<sup>bye, I love mangoes</sup>

I don’t know but I hope this is lazy enough or maybe I have done too much. Uggh!



</diva>

links.title: How I Protected Myself from Online Scammers!
links.body:
Greetings, everyone!

Yes, online scammers are everywhere, especially on social media platforms today, either to hack people's accounts or get money from online businesses or crypto, and then disappear from the platform. They are everywhere, some are pretending or disguising themselves to show the right thing to do to make money, but in mind they know what they are doing. 



![file_0000000037d871f58fb4d1ad203d0e65.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23xKvZdRdMrpEZmZ7tmhp93tFmSGA2KGeD3zTZoWmxM8PSYUdZeKMLxkDChhQdG3cbKPo.png)


However, staying safe online is very important and we should be mindful of the links we follow or click to avoid our accounts being hacked. Stay alert, wise, and updated too. Ask questions when the need arises in order not to be in trouble.

# What steps do I need to take to stay safe online 

As I said earlier, carefulness is required. Personality, I don't click links anyhow online and I can't share my details on Facebook or WhatsApp with anybody.

# Have I ever faced an online scam?

Many times in different disguising ways, 😂 it is actually funny.

There was a day, my phone rang, and I picked up the call. The guy introduced himself as one of my church members. He mentioned my church name and mentioned that he got my contact from the Mass Choir group where I belong, and he was very true. He said he has dropped a link for me on WhatsApp to follow a group. I said okay. He ended the call. Immediately, I called my Pastor and reported the case. My pastor said, I shouldn't mind him that he is a scammer. What? The man called again, and I asked him which branch he was worshipping. He ended the call and never called back again. This was how he would have hacked my WhatsApp, if I had followed his instructions. God is watching them.

Another one happened on my Telegram. When my boss's telegram account was hacked, the scammer used the account and sent a link for me to follow, which I would see my pictures when I opened the link. Thank God for wisdom. Immediately, I called my boss and asked him about the link on Telegram. He said I shouldn't follow that his account was hacked. I knelt down and thanked God for calling him first before clicking the link.

# Which scam is most dangerous today?

* Investment and fake AI/crypto trading scams. 

This one involved money and can drain or cause mental and physical damage to the owner. I have been hearing a lot about online investment, and in the long run, everything has gone without a dime. This one is very painful, imagine investing all your billions, hoping to get double the investment, before you knew it, all your money was wiped away, and you became dumbfounded and mad about it. 

Just recently, I have started hearing some guys on Facebook talking about AI trading. I said let me try my best. I followed the link, and they said I should deposit, and I asked how much, and they said $10. I said okay, I left the group and deleted them. 

# Safety Tips 

Please be careful, don't be a victim. This year don't let anybody use you and shine or become rich. Ask questions before you follow any link and listen to your inner voice.

One interviewee said she was passionate about upcycling. I should have mentioned the cardboard being upcycled from the streets. Mainly the streets of Camden Market in the 6pm-8pm window between local businesses putting their rubbish out and the Camden council bin collectors taking it away. The biggest contributing shop by far is Guitar Guitar, for which they have their own [Blond Card](https://blondcards.com/). If the shop had a letterbox, they would have received one by now.

/> \nI also had a [new series of Kozmic Records 12 inch vinyl](https://edgeworth.blog/2026/05/19/kozmic-records-lps-1-to-24/) which John, the owner, saw today when stopping by to chat. I gave him a small Kozmic Records Blond Card for his birthday the other week. It's currently up in his shop. The Kozmic Records Blond Card is my most popular artwork, apart from the [Nirvana ones](https://edgeworth.blog/canvas/nirvana/). \n

/>The mother of a Crewe Alexander football player took a Blond Card today. There was a repeat customer from Golders Green, near me, who makes surreal artwork herself. A guy from New York, who I advised look out for @ronthroop Ron Throop doing [Free Art Frees Art](https://freeartfreesart.com/) over there. The lady he was with has a cousin at Oswego University, right near [Ron](https://blackivory.org/ron-throop/), where Ron's already done a Free Art Frees Art giveaway. I advised she also look Ron up as he may be back there at some point. Both Ron and @offgridlife had artworks of them taken at Camden today. \n

/> \nThere was a law student who does performance art. Alan, the legendary town crier briefly took a Blond Card. As is becoming more and more popular, a French tourist decided to answer the questions in French. A 52 year old dyslexic PhD student gave a moving interview about how art helped her after her son died. The last two interviews happened as I was packing up. \n

/>  \n  \nThe first was a driving instructor who video interviewed me first for a film he and the lady he was with are making. In the interview I was asked a question about the Highway Code that if I got right, would net me £10 in prize money. I didn't know the answer and couldn't say now what the question was. I think it was \
Apparently it's a Toucan Crossing. I've never heard of a Toucan Crossing and have held a full driving licence since 1995. \n

links.title: How I Stood Out
links.body:
‎Hello there!  Having to be the best I can be humbles me, but it gives me the opportunity to learn more.
‎
![geralt-customer-3864809.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/somuchgrace/EowMR7i4Si5MVUhJ4L3hgp9BvXU96hYaZMSEW3AX6j74QAVaWEJoWmvKCHihyRzGYr4.jpg)

‎[Image](https://pixabay.com/images/download/geralt-customer-3864809_1920.jpg)
‎When I was working as an assistant administrative officer at the Nigerian Christian Corper Fellowship in Enugu during my service year, I only thought that the job was just about keeping files and scheduling meetings. Three weeks in, I realized administrative work can either keep an organization running smoothly or break it down. I did not want to fill it so that I could also hand over the position to some other person without breaking it down, so I was very persistent about my work, so I needed to do extra, and these things helped me achieve a lot.
‎
‎
‎I documented everything the same day.
‎If anything happened today, I filed it today. Waiting even 24 hours meant I was going to scramble to remember details later. I set a rule: before I close for the day, my inbox, meeting notes, and staff schedules are updated and saved. That one habit cut my retrieval time in half and stopped me from missing deadlines.
‎
‎
‎
‎I also kept one master schedule and stick to it. 
‎I used to have dates in my notepad, some in my WhatsApp, and some in my head. It was not that easy. Now I ran everything from one master calendar in MS Word/MS Project. If it’s not on that calendar, then I will not do it. People working with me knew where to check, and I stopped double-booking people.
‎
‎I communicated a lot; I did not assume things; silence creates a lot of problems. If a meeting was moved, I sent a message. If a document was delayed, I gave a heads-up. Clear, short updates will always prevent 80% of the “why didn’t you tell me?” moments. Communication is free, but fixing misunderstandings costs a lot of time.
‎
‎I built systems; I did not just make to-do lists. A to-do list can be forgotten when you’re busy. But a system keeps working. For records, I created a simple naming format: `YYYY-MM-DD_Event_Type`. For staffing, I used a weekly check-in sheet. Once the system was in place, the work became repeatable and less stressful.
‎
‎I reviewed every Friday.
‎Fridays were for a 20-minute review. What was done? What was delayed? What did I need to move to the next week? Without this, small issues would have piled up into big ones. This habit made me proactive instead of reactive.
‎
‎These habits aren’t fancy, but they’re the reason I was able to increase the organization’s activities and improve records and staffing. Good administration is not about working harder. It’s about working smart so the team can focus on the actual work.
‎
‎
‎

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome back to my blog!

This week, our guild has just concluded our recent brawl. We finished in improved to fifth place this week compared to last week's deplorable seventh place finish. In today’s post, I’ll break down our overall results, highlight my personal performance, and showcase one of my favorite battles.

***


# Guild Rank and Personal Performance

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeJg3zRcCqHFtPwmye7NSBSCcnVzpDWdqjdwpzP3ME3wG/image.png)

Our performance improved in this week's brawl compared to last week. We finished in fifth place compared to last week's seventh place. We won ninety five battles and and lost seventy six. It was not a bad performance but could be better improved.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQHXDhu28PF1vRqvpnE6W4yiDKGWKCMF6JUmTKEfuJY8G/image.png)

Personally, I did not do too well. I only won five battles out of nine in today's brawl. Having improved our performance as a guild, we increased our rewards to 5.2k merits and 57 SPS. It's still a decent reward for playing brawls. 

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNerizNfj16svevWuqhoQUY62eaktMii7t4qtomemMz4r/image.png)

The battle had Rise of the Commons ruleset and had a mana cap of only seventeen. These conditions severely limited my line up. I chose the Earth splinter and low mana units with Katrelba Gobson as my gladiator. She is probably the strongest common gladiator card because of her Sneak and Double Strike abilities. She targets the enemy backline and destroys them while her Bloodlust ability triggers.

The enemy also had Earth but only had two units including his gladiator, Palidon Rakk. They both have high health but can only attack one at a time per round since his other melee unit cannot attack from second position. This gave me the advantage since one of his units was inactive during the battle and was only able to attack when his first position unit was defeated.


[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_7nB7L6YOH7pySkOa1LpL?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. Buying a spellbook allows you to earn SPS tokens and use the  market to sell in game assets. Also, we will both get 500 Credits which can be used top purchase cards once you buy a spellbook.

links.title: Dailyprompt: I am the owner
links.body:
My junior brother was saving to buy a phone, he didn't give it to anyone. So he bought the phone after up to two years of savings. And he started using the phone in secret. I was the only one that knew that he had the phone. He kept hiding it from our parents. I was using the phone.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmamCc8tMSXfpWRPBupqRsBfgQ6Vx2grWFioST9eYK77wo/1779566954176.jpg)
[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-in-red-white-and-blue-plaid-scarf-wearing-black-sunglasses-holding-black-smartphone-rNAQCfh-UjA)

A day came where he was charging the phone in our room, then my mom came inside basically and stole the phone. He started asking questions about how the phone came about and where the phone was.

He called my junior brother, my junior brother was already shaking, he didn't know what to say, he was afraid. Immediately he was scared. He came inside and was scared to say it. Then I came from the door and shouted that I'm the owner.

Told her that I was the owner of the phone.
He felt surprised and asked why didn't I tell her that I got another phone. I said I just wanted to use it for support, that my other one got support.

 I had to lie to cover for my junior brother and I warned him never to allow them to see the phone. Then he got his phone again. He thanked me so much because he was afraid of what might be if they find out that it
was his phone.

links.title: CODM: Rapid Fire 🔥
links.body:
by @samye2 on Simpson Plays 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/simpsonplays1 [![CODM: Rapid Fire 🔥](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/78a0f9f5-7873-47c6-8a3b-6227c8ee18d2.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/1NbSZzAw2rEeYcvkaE1Ytg) 
 
 https://youtu.be/Lh8P3cGPYss?si=cDEMWSkK0Y_5bAPt
*****
Yesterday night an old friend of mine logged in to the game and she invited me, when I stopped playing Call of Duty Mobile she also stopped and now I'm beck she also came back few days ago. I wanted to sleep because it was late but seeing her invite wiped away the sleep from my eyes and I was more active than ever, I did not perform well in most of the games we played obviously because my network is always bad and my phone is leggy but those games throughout yesterday night with her wasn't about winning but about cruise.
We got tired of Battle Royale and moved to Multiplayer but shockingly she performed even better than me which is unusual. But for the Multiplayer we won every match we played. Some of her friends also logged in and wanted to play Multiplayer Ranked, my rank was to low to play with them and the suggested of kicking me from the room, in Multiplayer I sit at Elite rank which is very low then I started reminiscing on those days when I was an all time legendary player but look at me now. After everything I have made a decision to download Multiplayer Ranked maps and grind up to legendary again but this means I'd have to stop playing Battle Royale since my phone would freeze whenever I play. Thanks for visiting by the way.
***** 
 ***
[**Check out today's video..!**](https://blurt.media/w/1NbSZzAw2rEeYcvkaE1Ytg)

links.title: Un juguete adorable
links.body:
>Estupendo día sábado lleno de salud, energía, ideas maravillosas, magia. Encuentros con tu propio ser y mucho entusiasmo en cada actividad que realicen.

[Te invito a participar, es divertido y sencillo](https://peakd.com/hive-192096/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-b8a6d3fe6dda6)
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://i.ecency.com/DQmdPxE7QESSgnBkbR5eZSyHTZYDDJEfSYKR7qSn1t6Xrm7/imagen.png
Imagen propiedad de @lanzjoseg
https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/1751/1751885tt65ozcos7.webp

>Un peluche, de todos los tamaños y colores, de diferentes figuras o formas. Siempre ha sido parte de cada hogar desde siempre. Tener peluches es una ilusión de toda persona, a veces niños o adultos que cuando niños quisieron tenerlos pero no era considerado juguete.

\n\n

>Otros lo utilizan para acompañar en las noches como parte o adorno de la cama donde se va a descansar. Otros lo coleccionan, de tipos, colores, de moda, siempre están al día con estos juguetes.

\n\n

>Aunque otra cara de estos juguetes, por la calidad de sus telas o rellenos tiende a crear alergia en los niños o adultos, comienzan por estornudos o se presentan rosetas en la piel. Médicos recomiendan no tenerlos en la habitación para dormir, menos en las cunas de los más pequeños.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/1751/1751885tt65ozcos7.webp

>Otras veces es inútil no caer en la tentación de regalar uno de estos, aunque a veces parece que los llevan al mercado con formas que son raras, bueno a mi me parecen raras, igual así llaman la atención, siempre un regalo de última hora, para esa persona que se quiere halagar por una fecha importante o simplemente para alegrar el día a alguien.

\n\n

>Lo que si sé es que en mi casa están aún los de mi hija, llegaron por regalos porque fui de las madres que consideré no importante un peluche, no tanto por lo que representaba sino porque mi hija presentaba alergias, para evitar ciertas complicaciones y medicamentos para este tipo de infecciones, la frase era prevenir que lamentar. Tampoco son muchos, como cuatro, y después de ya cierta edad. Pregúntenme si le interesan, la otra vez los vio y dijo: ¿Por qué no los han regalado?

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/1751/1751885tt65ozcos7.webp

links.title: My Creative Stationery travels to Space  / Mi Papelería Creativa viaja  hacia el Espacio
links.body:
>

🚀 🚀 🚀 I'm currently expanding my personal brand into structural papercraft, creating 3D figures and models from cardboard to support elementary and high school students' presentations. With this addition to my product offerings, I can now provide traditional presentation boards, eye-catching lapbooks, triptychs, models, and even 3D figures to enhance the aesthetics, quality, and academic level of their school presentations. I have three children and have always been very involved with their schoolwork, homework, and presentations, so this growth has been completely natural and obvious; it was the next step, and I hadn't realized it until now. Since I posted some of my work on my WhatsApp status, I've been inundated with requests for my services, like this one for a space-themed presentation. A client asked me to make a 3D rocket in gold and silver, very striking, and with fun stickers to give to their classmates. Today I'll tell you about the process and how it turned out... Welcome!

>

🚀 🚀 🚀Actualmente estoy ampliando mi Marca Personal hacia el Papecraft Estructural, creando figuras y maquetas en 3D con cartulina, para atender y apoyar las exposiciones de estudiantes de básica y secundaria. Con esta innovación en mi oferta de productos, ahora puedo ofrecer las tradicionales láminas de exposición, los más llamativos Lapbooks, Trípticos, Maquetas y hasta figuras 3D para elevar la estética, la calidad y el nivel académico en sus presentaciones escolares. Tengo 3 hijos y siempre fui muy comprometida con sus colegios, tareas y exposiciones, así que este crecimiento ha sido totalmente natural y obvio, era lo siguiente y no me había dado cuenta hasta ahora. Desde que publiqué en mis estados de WhatsApp algunos trabajos que he hecho, no han dejado de llegar solicitudes de mis servicios, como esta para una exposición sobre el espacio, un cliente me pidió que le hiciera un Cohete en 3D, que fuese dorado y plateado, muy llamativo y con Stickers divertidos para regalar a sus compañeros. Hoy les contaré el proceso y cómo quedó... Bienvenidos.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tveJNBLMzY7v9hT4vACqNWzi8AU7K9QQeYLo8KNC3j6QVYWHh1SJsdoUFTuTjXBVasi.png)
> * Rocket papercraft template * Silver and gold metallic cardstock * Hot glue and liquid glue * Scissors, craft knife, ruler, and awl * Inkjet printer * Self-adhesive photo paper

> * Plantilla de Papercraft de Cohete * Cartulinas metalizadas plateada y dorada * Silicón caliente y silicón líquido * Tijera, cúter, regla y punzón * Impresora de inyección de tinta * Papel fotográfico autoadhesivo

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tvW472qTK2pVWUobhKoExxLAxeY7ifMLEQ55X9qP1pMzq15MR71kZzXutmYovCGwTKj.png)

>

Friends of Hive, we need to invest in resources, we need to prepare ourselves. Having the right tools is crucial, but so is taking courses and workshops, whether in person or online, to prepare ourselves and advance in whatever we do. I'm currently taking several courses that include digital resources, and I'm constantly learning and practicing. This Rocket project is truly beautiful; I loved it, and I was able to import the PDF into my favorite editing app, Canva, and print all the pages from there.

>

Amigas y amigos de Hive, hay que invertir en Recursos, hay que prepararse, tener herramientas es importantísimo, pero también lo es hacer cursos, talleres, bien sean presenciales o virtuales, para prepararnos y avanzar en lo que sea que hagamos. Yo estoy realizando varios cursos que incluyen los recursos digitales, y constantemente estoy aprendiendo y practicando. Este Cohete es realmente hermoso, me encantó y pude llevar el pdf a mi App de edición favorita que es Canva, desde ahí imprimí todas las hojas.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wgctKH5JRMPJbAx31cBj6fZvKUJeNEbNXpr7vu6DdmsYHJRdJYB97bcJ3YsuR5ZPynt.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tSuc5xrM1NLxboVQ5NQWBeD4Sqo7UEsx8Fx69zRAhRsmh1XBkt1LLkTbjNjYAuyqPyr.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tHXNL5TvZhWTRJPqEUrgkE9ZZyfJChAJ5A8rvhww5V9bqRNoB3Uv7Z3dHfKdfT2PWJw.png)| |-|-|-|

>

I printed the sheets on regular paper, since I'll be using them as templates. I cut them out and assembled what I call the \

of my project, to properly test the measurements and make any necessary adjustments. Once I've fully assembled the rocket on regular paper, I'll have the certainty and knowledge about the assembly process.

>

Las hojas las imprimí en papel normal, ya que las usaré como plantillas, Las corté y armé lo que llamo el \

de mi proyecto, para probar bien las medidas o hacer los ajustes necesarios. Una vez que armé completamente el Cohete en papel normal, ya tengo la certeza y el conocimiento sobre el armado.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xyXNaHPPw6VkDoYnTVghWqXWRLDSxzNWCeepNoidCTkGknFMuXcnVXBnozoJ3Si1nfJ.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23x1DAtPwZdvitqPzUndgCsBUK3GUoFwRg13EMXmRKjA5WsCG7jxcgbRT2k12A46xGeDc.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23viAh9yDJEvCwA8jZG1HaADMWdJJ4tNbqJyheEBPLKPxrcd4awrCeWyF45kxd1Ru8AWC.png)| |-|-|-|

>

I cut out all the rocket pieces from the gold metallic cardstock and the silver-colored cardstock, according to the placement I decided on in the design. After analyzing each piece, I proceed to mark and fold each one, following the assembly pattern and joining them with liquid silicone or hot glue.

>

Corto todas las piezas del Cohete en la cartulina metalizada dorada y en planteado, de acuerdo a la ubicación que decidí dejar en el diseño. Analizando cada pieza se procede a marcar y doblar cada una de ellas, y seguir el patrón de armado, uniendo con silicón líquido o silicón caliente.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23zknd61DyPChkLm1S6DQi9FQssqWqKYtcu3P7Wca4VHF1BTFiuYp2eH26JBJgTL51ajV.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/242Y7YySxgVGsX5wk3pNETZSpWqUBfpqYgG5ZdycwkhYXCNDHjT2dfVXmSNTwooUnPK5g.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/245wSCJrSMfbaSpyqgaDtidK5AN8gfAJzkv7PhPsXTREnrNGGgHv2uxQuuXVps5aawaQy.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xAbybEmq7qUppcDddFZNBYbTdBiXNLDiFiLKkDr9MS9kyGQXLCnHn3px111LnFd9e5N.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

To keep the design, colors, and order clear, I like to print out an image of the design and jot down notes on what I consider important, which in this case were the piece numbers. This helps me a lot; even if I have to stop to take care of something, I can pick up right where I left off when I return.

>

Para tener claro el diseño, los colores y el orden, me gusta imprimir una imagen del diseño y tomar las notas que considero importantes, que en este caso fueron los números de las piezas. Esto me ayuda muchísimo, incluso si debo pararme eventualmente para atender algo, al regresar puedo retomar sin contratiempos.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/2432QD9d5euaXJEPo1YCphqb78Hg5snzJzjjcKhHdCJugj2YenceD4HMy2K87ACZMr4MV.png)

>

Following the design, I continue cutting, marking, folding and gluing each piece with its corresponding piece.

>

Siguiendo el diseño, continúo cortando, marcando, doblando y pegando cada pieza con la que corresponde.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xKvZiKvT5eowbppxtHuptXawWM3chD9U241LziBrqcTBntSUoLseo2iVg2qPgcayPfM.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wgHvq5QVefTZPWWu3pyQvvWyC7pd3NJ7gAEZfzvFVPbo3T96nsfLyZXqLjbMQJsL65W.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/244AAhJREi5WRb87cyEP4JnewCrzqGE3yCdRejF4SVPdH9m1ZCNX1736ogpcMKEHkatgY.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/2423wzU6kKjfYrPAGqxZPhJQ6AhJU6KAMGrYwABRYtzeZsJuC63vnrMJF1F4oEHnML7Lu.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

In this rocket design, the most complicated part was the two tips, as they have a somewhat complex shape, but with analysis and a lot of attention it can be achieved.

>

En este diseño del Cohete, la parte más complicada la representaron las dos puntas, ya que tiene una forma algo compleja, pero teniendo análisis y mucha atención se logra.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wqnMqN74NL6w99Vzqf7D6s5nJKEMe8A1uaMDgS5DcXTmFKFCmUt8j6Z7DmG1f9eyigD.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23uFXv4XqoRXkUpaCSjg7oyib2hV4YUaiTGwM2cEGzbSxAdxqVQEq6gB51kfcLPpjVkfm.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vsN1zdE9Pj3Nixj3MQtEutTpcgAs5bApPXhWyzPw661rCBgh7MzVTZUNp1tRDYL2DSe.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xVMSHNkCJxQDMS1zbv5L1yLqqZyLnowQsL1MBDZ6wNUfNxyQh8LYUXJ9hNrCGzSLVkW.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

The final part isn't the previous points; it's two circular bases with different shapes that are joined and glued at the bottom. And that's how I finished making this rocket, whose challenge was precisely assembling circular shapes while the design gets thinner or thicker.

>

La parte final no son las puntas anteriores, son dos bases circulares con diferentes formas, que se unen y se pegan en la parte de abajo. Y así terminé de hacer este Cohete, cuyo reto fue precisamente armar formas circulares mientras el diseño se pone más delgado o más grueso.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xyXHmuzXoUiYu23vjGBq5tEKnJQ1vKGbzoJG6Z5nQ8v87oszpQvSNDaf2MBghRRgjrY.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xKxZRcXdTtYSwP4iLw3Pstz8Hg7xp9UGQfAn8C4ZzJ26YkQZQyJyqjrd55zrXeSwY4G.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vhz7QQWRNz1dzpPNWDsAuVTxYdiyFqZzLwDg2bac5aKmsAYSTN27NjKAGr5nYPwdfXE.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/243MBCf5G4K5ouJaoLJ6X1tAJT5v3P4ajAU46d6b14jqD8j8H9W1fDe1Q7SKbZcZ394Sk.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

The stickers, which were a client request, were created using both free and paid elements in the Canva Pro version. They have a large library of options available.

>

Los Stickers, que fueron una solicitud del cliente, los hice con los elementos gratuitos y los pagos, en la versión de Canva Pro. Tienen a la disposición un gran banco de imágenes disponibles para sus usuarios.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23zkkLrjZLM3SzdgDDe4k32oJo9obyqStid4yrGCoaCJpXtCCRTEUcsSvfZa5M7DCckJi.png)

>

The rocket looks great, it's gorgeous with that color combination, and the quality of the metallic cardstock is excellent. All of this worked together to create a great final product. Some stickers were added to decorate the school presentation.

>

El Cohete se ve genial, está precioso con esa combinación de colores, y la calidad de las cartulinas metalizadas son excelente y todo esto trabajó a favor para lograr un buen producto final. Algunos stickers para ambientar la presentación escolar.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/243MJ7m9eGXXF5QXtckPpJtrKshAkr23LkoBEUXtph6ZUCrVDWyDpDadrcrWMYFUTWcnE.png)

>

I put the stickers in small, transparent bags; they're really fun and will make an excellent gift for classmates. They'll make the whole experience of visiting the exhibition much more dynamic, with the beautiful setting and these gifts.

>

Los Stickers los coloqué en unas bolsitas pequeñas y transparente, son realmente muy divertidas y serán un excelente obsequio para los compañeros y compañeras, y hará muy dinámica toda la experiencia de haber presenciado esa exposición, con la ambientación tan bella y estos obsequios.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wX7qse5UUXC9cDReRbqC9ue6SYVTWNdFdSVaaqJkksfsSPqerifurUTvRRrohNk1VeP.png)

>

I hope you liked it; I personally really enjoyed making this rocket, and finding an activity that I really like, which is Creative and Structural Stationery.

>

Deseo que les haya gustado, personalmente disfruté mucho hacer este Cohete, y haber encontrado una actividad que me gusta mucho como lo es la Papelería Creativa y Estructural.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xVFDi5Box4m25Y5rHy9EyK6C971hMeaWAVtvSveKqVeb8nLwA3YRUoydnARxpEBVh1v.png)

>

This line from the movie Batman Begins resonated deeply with me, as I understood that my experience and knowledge, those things I carry within me, don't define me, nor do they define my present. What defines me, my present, and my future is what I am capable of DOING.

>

Esta frase de la película Batman Inicia, resonó mucho en mí, ya que entendí que mi experiencia y conocimientos, esos que llevo en mi interior, no me definen, ni definen mi presente. Lo que define mi persona, mi presente y mi futuro es lo que soy capaz de HACER.

---

links.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779527047160-0e2bebc16870747a.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=zeyr-gamer/1838efd9)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=zeyr-gamer/1838efd9)


---

I played the game Bravo Warrior Castle, an offline adventure full of intense combat. Inside the castle, I faced fierce enemies guarding their fortress. The battle between me and the castle warriors was tough, but my strength and skill led me to victory 🏰  

The brave warrior breaks free from captivity and fights atop the castle roof to reclaim his freedom. Surrounded by enemies wielding swords and daggers, he stands tall against the darkness  every strike brings him closer to victory 

I jumped down from the tall rooftop and landed right in front of the castle gate. The guards standing at the entrance didn’t stand a chance I took them down one by one with my sword and skill. The fight was fierce, but my courage burned brighter than their blades 

After entering the castle I encountered two guards standing far ahead. They tried to escape my arrows but none could outrun my aim. One by one, I took them down from a distance  precision, focus, and vengeance guided every shot  

After defeating the smaller soldiers, I faced the ultimate challenge  three massive warriors stood in my way. The fight was intense blades clashing and power shaking the ground. But with skill and determination I ended the battle and claimed victory 🏰 

When I played the game, what amazed me the most were the three giant characters and the way I defeated them  

👉 Thumbnail edited in(capcut)

Thank you

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=zeyr-gamer/1838efd9)

links.title: Найбільш ізольований паб у світі 🌊
links.body:
/>

Ірландці побудували паб… посеред моря.

Серйозно.

У 1835 році біля узбережжя графства Clare звели маяк Fastnet Lighthouse — просто на скелі посеред Атлантики.  
І це вже було б достатньо божевільно.

Люди мали жити там місяцями.  
І ірландці подумали:  
— Ну не можуть люди страждати настільки сильно.

Тому всередині маяка облаштували маленький паб для доглядачів.

Тобто десь посеред Атлантики люди:  
• запалювали маяк;  
• слухали шторм;  
• і сиділи в пабі на скелі, яку океан намагався змити щозими.

І в цьому весь характер Ірландії.

Інші країни будують щось “найвище”, “найдорожче” або “найтехнологічніше”.

А ірландці можуть побудувати маяк у місці, де нормальна людина не поставила б навіть намет…  
і подумати:

— А паб тут точно потрібен.

links.title: ​Cuando las palabras pesan. | When words weigh. [ESP - ENG]
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUQGRrSHkcuvX6jgq2J9H93aWxPUztphggN2cdtuFV5ny/1779564839626.png) ​Las palabras tienen su propia gravedad; no se las lleva el viento, sino que se quedan suspendidas en el aire, ganando densidad hasta encontrar un lugar donde aterrizar. Es en esa permanencia donde descubrimos su verdadero impacto, una dualidad constante donde el lenguaje puede ser tanto el plomo que hunde como el suelo firme que sostiene. ​
~ ~ ✦ ~ ~
Por un lado, existe un peso que se siente en el pecho como una carga invisible: esa frase hiriente o esa crítica destructiva que nos dijeron hace años y que, a veces, seguimos cargando en silencio como un equipaje ajeno que nos resta fuerzas. En el reflejo de esa misma realidad, nos toca mirar hacia adentro y reconocer cuántas veces hemos lanzado palabras al aire sin medir su gravedad, olvidando que un comentario dicho a la ligera puede romper la confianza o el día de otra persona. ​
~ ~ ✦ ~ ~
Sin embargo, cuando las palabras pesan, no siempre es para herir; existe también una solidez hermosa que nos rescata. Hay palabras que pesan porque están llenas de verdad, empatía y amor puro: es el peso reconfortante de un \
en medio de la tormenta, la fuerza de un \
cuando dudamos de nuestras propias capacidades, o la sanación de un \

sincero que repara los cristales rotos del alma. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbWC6pEppaWj3Xw24toFAezFJhLmAJ1kiR2SeK7BDydcs/1779564407027.png) ​Esas palabras no aplastan, sino que nos dan raíces, se transforman en refugio y nos recuerdan que el mismo idioma que tiene el poder de debilitar, posee también la maravillosa facultad de levantarnos y hacernos crecer. ​
~ ~ ✦ ~ ~
Las palabras son una herramienta de doble filo, y la elección de su calibre siempre está en nuestras manos. Me gustaría saber: ¿Cuál ha sido la palabra o frase más hermosa que alguien te ha dicho y que se convirtió en tu suelo firme en un momento difícil? (Las imágenes fueron creadas con Nano banana 2.0.)

— English Version —

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP5PEvcPPaFHY9sPCcDqoXQKxsm1AYByHzUrT5oWJLxHb/1779565135618.png) [*Words have their own gravity; they are not carried away by the wind, but remain suspended in the air, gaining density until they find a place to land. It is within that permanence that we discover their true impact, a constant duality where language can be both the lead that sinks us and the firm ground that holds us up.*] ​
~ ~ ✦ ~ ~
[*On one hand, there is a weight felt in the chest like an invisible burden: that hurtful phrase or destructive criticism told to us years ago that, at times, we continue to carry in silence like someone else's luggage draining our strength. In the reflection of that very same reality, it is our turn to look inward and recognize how many times we have thrown words into the air without measuring their gravity, forgetting that a comment made lightly can shatter another person's trust or break their day.*] ​
~ ~ ✦ ~ ~
[*However, when words weigh, it is not always to cause harm; there is also a beautiful solidity that rescues us. There are words that weigh because they are filled with truth, empathy, and pure love: it is the comforting weight of an \
in the midst of the storm, the strength of an \
when we doubt our own abilities, or the healing of a sincere \

that repairs the broken glass of the soul.*] ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbWC6pEppaWj3Xw24toFAezFJhLmAJ1kiR2SeK7BDydcs/1779565822957.png) [*Those words do not crush us, but rather give us roots, transforming into a refuge and reminding us that the very same language that holds the power to weaken us also possesses the wonderful faculty to lift us up and make us grow.*] ​
~ ~ ✦ ~ ~
[*Words are a double-edged sword, and the choice of their caliber is always in our hands. links.title: Nueva ruta de la banda 17 - Historia [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>




La Banda 17 disfrutó de cada segundo del viaje en tren, mientras sus canciones seguían sonando de fondo, donde Michelle tenía una gran sonrisa, Dani apoyó lentamente la cabeza contra el vidrio de la ventana y todavía no podía creer todo lo que estaban viviendo, Lucas soltó una pequeña risa y tomó con fuerza su guitarra y Stewie seguía grabando cada lugar que pasaban como recuerdo de la banda.



El tren avanzó durante horas atravesando montañas y túneles, hasta que una voz anunció la llegada —Próxima parada Portugal— Michelle abrió los ojos de inmediato, Dani sonrió lentamente mientras miraba por la ventana y ahí estaba Portugal, un lugar muy bonito, colorido y la estación de tren era toda una obra de arte y finalmente el tren se detuvo y cuando la Banda se bajó, el ruido y los aplausos eran muchos por la cantidad de fanáticos que había en ese sitio.



>Band 17 enjoyed every second of the train journey, their songs playing softly in the background. Michelle beamed, Dani slowly leaned his head against the window, still in disbelief at the experience, Lucas chuckled and clutched his guitar, and Stewie continued recording every place they passed as a memento of the band.

#

>The train traveled for hours, winding through mountains and tunnels, until a voice announced their arrival: \

Michelle's eyes widened, and Dani smiled as she gazed out the window. There it was: Portugal, a beautiful, colorful place. The train station was a work of art. Finally, the train stopped, and when the band stepped off, the roar of the crowd of fans erupted in cheers and applause.



![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23uFM2YE6hDYTVxxz1cN6uPHp7UpHrCqfvFY48tyiYhXCR3tsucWHUHmyW1qVjWsNJSAt.jpeg)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/train-railroad-station-passengers-7859021/)







Lograron avanzar y moverse por las calles de Portugal, pero a lo lejos se escuchaban baterías y guitarras, cuando se acercaron había una gran tarima en una de las plazas más importante de portuguesa. Dani quedó paralizado y comentó —¿Todo esto es para nosotros? Uno de los organizadores se acercó y en voz baja les dijo —Portugal quería darles la bienvenida como se merecen— y la gente seguía gritando —¡BANDA 17! ¡BANDA 17! ¡BANDA 17!



Lucas sintió miedo, pero a la vez estaba viviendo una experiencia única, Dani respiró y recordó cómo meses atrás tocaban en pequeñas calles y ahora tenían una tarima gigante esperándolos en otro país. La Banda subió mientras las luces comenzaban a moverse por todos lados y allí fue cuando Michelle tomó el micrófono y comenzó a cantar, mientras toda la plaza seguía el ritmo con aplausos.




>They managed to make their way through the streets of Portugal, but in the distance they could hear drums and guitars. As they approached, there was a large stage in one of the main squares. Dani froze and exclaimed, \
One of the organizers approached and quietly said, \

# >Lucas felt a pang of fear, but at the same time, he was experiencing something truly unique. Dani took a breath and remembered how, just months before, they had been playing in small streets, and now a giant stage awaited them in another country. The band took the stage as the lights began to move all around, and that's when Michelle grabbed the microphone and started singing, while the entire square clapped along to the rhythm. ![image.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/davidpena21/23vhsYaKeE2hxGBtJ4UukeLwferC1rEvUGCocjkc9LHNC4f2XhHX5bZnv2fjK7beFS8X1.jpeg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/photos/audience-band-concert-crowd-1853662/) Los ojos de Michelle se llenaron de lágrimas de la felicidad, Dani bajó la mirada intentando contener la emoción, Lucas simplemente sonrió y en ese instante comprendieron, que su música ya estaba a nivel mundial y ahora les pertenece a todos. Todos estaba listo para comenzar con el espectáculo y la Banda 17 comenzó uno de los conciertos más emocionantes de toda su vida mientras Portugal entero vibraba junto a ellos. >Michelle's eyes filled with tears of joy, Dani lowered his gaze trying to contain his emotion, Lucas simply smiled, and in that instant they understood that their music had reached a global audience and now belonged to everyone. Everything was ready to begin the show, and Banda 17 launched into one of the most exciting concerts of their lives while all of Portugal vibrated with energy alongside them.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)
**Post de Risingstar**

links.title: Completing missions, quests, and end-of-season events in Call of Duty Mobile
links.body:
> Hello everyone. In the final weeks of each season in Call of Duty Mobile, several challenges, missions, or tasks usually appear to make it easier to complete the battle pass using experience points. And, with just a few days left until the update and the highly anticipated collaboration with The Boys next season, new missions and game modes are already available to help us speed up completing any remaining tasks. Since I hadn't played for a few days, I was able to take advantage of this time to check everything out and play a few matches with friends and have some fun. So today I'll tell you a bit about it. >Hola a todos. En las últimas semanas de cada temporada en Call of Duty Mobile, suelen aparecer varios desafíos, misiones o retos a modo de que se facilite lo que es completar el pase de batalla por medio de los puntos de experiencia y, pues, justamente teniendo ya pocos días para la actualización y la esperada colaboración de la temporada próxima con The Boys, ya hay disponibles misiones nuevas, así como modos de juego para completar más rápido las cositas que tengamos pendientes. Y yo, que tenía unos días sin jugar, pude aprovechar un poco para ver todo esto y jugar, ya que por fin se me dio unas partidas con amigos y pasar un rato divertido, por lo que hoy les contaré un poco de todo esto.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmQbxcqtFaXDg9Hi765BrPEZeXnt8NTE3nw4nchSZVxvQw/1779566674877.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmPa2aTmCAWHJVzKuJU4gGRdCsQJKAbPWG33WUyNUu8YNr/1779566694382.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmbwNaxGFkjqF28cZ8Gn9cHomXUqRnzQoiMZfyj3UsLHSF/1779566711330.jpg
To begin with, a few days ago I met up with some of my sister's friends, with whom I've been gradually getting to know better. We took advantage of a good connection to play together. The skins weren't visible because I had recently deleted some data to free up some space on my phone, but aside from that, we played Checkpoint mode and a mode where the idea is to get kills while switching weapons. This can be tricky for those of us who aren't completely proficient with a specific weapon, and in my case, it's with certain types of shotguns and melee weapons. Even so, we found it fun, especially me, since I was really looking forward to playing with friends. >Para empezar, hace unos días me reuní con unos amigos de mi hermana y con quienes poco a poco me he estado integrando. Aprovechamos un momento de buena conexión para jugar juntos. Para esto no se veían las skins, puesto que recientemente había borrado algunos datos para liberar un poco el teléfono, pero fuera de esto jugamos la modalidad punto de control y una donde la idea es ir haciendo kills conforme se va cambiando de arma, lo cual para quienes no dominamos por completo algún tipo en específico suele complicar, y en mi caso es con cierto tipo de escopeta y armas cuerpo a cuerpo, y aun así se nos hizo divertido, y más para mí, que ya tenía muchas ganas de jugar con amigos.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmRv8xYM8sTb5bZqVLx8BTr6LMdaHuyt4jtfZLZqN3bPCV/1779566207565.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmTs99hp7kTqb3Ej1LJnN1s1fZKKvjacEeq8u3jPND6dyR/1779566227479.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmNQoqzChN88XZCZTnYEJTu3KH9U9KjqX1NuSVMzijeHvc/1779566242513.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmPRmJXubMmPHMbXkbmHEB9ssRY81HzKHPty38aY2o5ZBh/1779566261622.jpg
On another note, the new collaboration with The Boys for the next season has already been announced, which will include plenty of roulette wheels and other features. Several missions have also been enabled, starting with the winner's bonus. Playing certain matches on specific days and times will help us climb the ranks and earn rewards. There's also a small event called Tabletop Tactics, where players use dice and spend CP to advance the dice rolls, similar to a board game, and collect various rewards. >Por otra parte, ya se nos anunció lo que será la nueva colaboración con The Boys para la siguiente temporada, donde habrá muchas ruletas y demás. Así mismo, se habilitaron diversas misiones, comenzando con el bono del ganador, en el cual, a medida de ciertas partidas en horas y días específicos, nos ayudarán a subir de rango en lo que es el rango, así como también con recompensas, como también un pequeño evento llamado Tácticas de mesa, el cual es de algo y en el cual, por medio de dados, gastando CP, se irán avanzando dados como si fuera un juego de mesa y así recoger recompensas varias.
https://i.ecency.com/DQmNrJVgjnsrmptTx9QYUzXGKoF12qc9px1WFusRgmKWevu/1779566381121.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmZ8ycnF7DhJwn9yZEP7Qy5s8kWZ3cqi7NkLMSAPtPxUgQ/1779566455095.jpg
https://i.ecency.com/DQmQjsocSZCekTpbjhuo5dCfXuTUmgz6gGuhUPiSaQc9G4j/1779566474227.jpg
Among other events, there's also the game update rewards event, where we reserve rewards until the start of the new season, which usually appears every month, and the infinite elimination event, where using the shotgun earns rewards. I also took advantage of this time to complete my pending missions, like the one for the highly sought-after flip-flop as a secondary weapon, which I really needed to get before it ran out. And, of course, I played the Mythic Drop roulette with legendary weapons to get more points. Personally, I'm expecting a lot from what's coming in the new season. I don't know if the collaboration with The Boys will bring free items or good skins, but we'll just have to wait and see. So, without further ado, and hoping you enjoyed this post, thank you very much for reading it. >Entre otros eventos, también está el de recompensas por actualización de juego, donde reservamos recompensas hasta el inicio de nueva temporada, el cual suele aparecer cada mes, y el evento de eliminación infinita, en el que utilizando el arma escopeta shotgun se obtienen recompensas, así como también aproveché para completar lo que eran mis misiones pendientes, como la de la tan buscada chancla como arma secundaria que ya necesitaba conseguir antes de que se acabara, y, claro está, las ruletas de entregas míticas con armas legendarias para así conseguir más puntos. Personalmente, en lo que son las cosas que se avecinan en la nueva temporada, espero muchas cosas. No sé si la colaboración con The Boys traerá cositas gratuitas o buenas skins, pero es cosa de solamente esperar, así que bueno, sin más y esperando que sea de su agrado, muchas gracias por leer este post.

https://i.ecency.com/DQmS12uesU4jJsJEHqC2gR38nX6nfWSfaTVFtimkDZd1K1H/1779566549526.jpg

links.title: The Trouble with Turning Everyone into Investors
links.body:
Britain has one of the lowest personal savings rates among rich countries now, and possibly the way we tend to talk about financial risk is part of the problem. 

If you try to open up any sort of investment account in the UK you are warned, very clearly, that your capital is at risk, and this might just scare everyday would-be investors so much that they decide it’s safer to do nothing. 

And instead of inviting people to invest, those words push them toward cash accounts, where inflation quietly eats away at their money.

A lot of young people now associate investing with gambling, quite possibly linked to their social media feeds being full of crypto-hype, most of which is, you know it's true, gambling! 

But if this is becoming the default norm then increasing numbers of people are missing out on benefitting from steady investments which yield well over the long-term, even while stocks fluctuate month to month and year to year, most of my safe stock market Vests have trended up much faster than the rate of inflation. 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23xKp7i8UU3qTFCUE8e3cwa7jcW48TCfjrTUeXG8Rdw85V4aLxk2zkKQaJcNF2QbAydGU.png)


### The Problem with Cash...

Cash may feel safe, but so many people have thousands of pounds stashed in low interest accounts, and their losing money relative to the cost of living. Over 5,10 and especially 20 years, £100 000 becomes £80 000 or less, without you even realising it! 

So maybe people need to be issued more warnings about the risks of 'doing nothing'!?!? 

This is especially important now that people are expected to take care of their own finances in retirement - the idea that the government is always going to take care of you is fading, so people need much more in-your-face warnings about the erosions of inflation. 

There's also the fact here that it's the poor who are more likely to hold what little savings they do have as cash, so they are going to be impacted hardest by this cost of doing nothing! 

### Final thoughts.... 

If you want people to invest, you have to strike a balance. Tell the truth about market risk, but don’t let “your capital is at risk” scare everyone away from taking steps that—over time—actually help. Modern economies rely on people investing for retirement and the future. But if people get overwhelmed, or think the system is rigged, they’ll just hide out in cash, even when that hurts them in the long run.

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVDvCKHCu8knMHfkiLwEMhxuinxrwrjj2KbGQF2zys4Rt/1779560813527.jpg)</center>

Hello everyone. For my entry in this contest, I am sharing a photo I took very close to where I live. It is a shot taken from ground level at a Cuban organoponic that has been under development since November of last year. My intention here was for you to see the interaction between the irrigation tools, the red soil rich in iron oxides, the serpentinite rocks that are abundant in this region, the workers, the sky, and the beautiful countryside.

​As it is a location controlled by the military, I was very cautious when taking this photo. I am genuinely interested in the destination of the harvest being produced there.

​I used my Xiaomi mobile phone camera with the following settings:

​f/2.2
​1/1484s
​ISO100



***
***

**Español**

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVDvCKHCu8knMHfkiLwEMhxuinxrwrjj2KbGQF2zys4Rt/1779560813527.jpg)</center>


Hola a todos. En mi entrada de participación de este concurso traigo una foto que tomé muy cerca de donde vivo. Es una toma con una perspectiva desde el nivel del suelo en un organopónico cubano que se encuentra actualmente en desarrollo desde noviembre del año pasado. Aquí mi intención fue que vieran la interacción entre lo que utilizan para el riego, la tierra roja rica en óxidos de hierro, las rocas serpentiníticas abundantes en esta región, los trabajadores, el cielo  y el bello campo. 

Como es un lugar controlado por los militares fui muy cautelosa en tomar esta foto. Realmente estoy interesada el destino de lo que se está obteniendo en la cosecha. 

Usé la cámara de mi celular Xiaomi con los siguientes parámetros:

f/2.2
