links.title: 🧸Los peluches son protección y amor😌/🧸Stuffed animals are protection and love😌[Esp~Eng]
links.body:
>👋 Hola como se encuentran todos en este día de sábado,y aun hay un tiempo con ganas de llover pero hay un brillante sol,y hay mucho calor,ya quiero que esté clima mejore pronto. Para hoy les estaré compartiendo mi tercera a publicación en esta comunidad,desde luego formando parte de la iniciativa que nos invita a observar una imagen en la que podemos interpretar nuestro pensar sobre ella,para mí es muy entretenido esta actividad,siento que además de solo pensar,escribir y observar,se puede también dar esa oportunidad de ser escuchado,en este caso leído, muchas gracias . Comencemos 😎** # > 👋 Hello everyone! How are you all doing on this Saturday? It's still a bit threatening to rain, but the sun is shining brightly, and it's very warm. I'm really hoping the weather improves soon. Today I'll be sharing my third post in this community, as part of the initiative that invites us to observe an image and interpret our thoughts about it. I find this activity very enjoyable. I feel that in addition to just thinking, writing, and observing, it also offers the opportunity to be heard—in this case, read. Thank you very much. Let's begin! 😎 ---
![1000274652.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcnnVonVBtSCWxi27wzK4TUtZtGyrq8oJSjX3JrKT3BTW/1000274652.png)
# # **

>Cuando ví la imagen de esta ocasión,pensé que ahora sí está algo difícil,y la verdad solo vi muchos peluches,y me dió ganas de comprar un peluche así como los del mostrador. Luego pensé en cuando era pequeña y había peluches que quería pero no tenía los recursos para tener uno. Ahora hoy en día ya que soy adulta tengo peluches que me fueron obsequiados,tengo tres ositos pero me gusta más uno que es más pequeño y es un osos marrón oscuro,se parece al primer peluche que fue nombrado( oso Teddy) y fue muy popular en su momento, siendo un juguete para niños y niñas por igual. Claro ya después con el tiempo el osito Teddy fue evolucionando,y poco a poco fueron existiendo más peluches que no eran solo ositos, ahora hay peluches hasta de pulpitos que se le da la vuelta y es otro pulpito de otro color, ahora hay tantas opciones de peluches para todos los gustos.** # > When I saw the picture this time, I thought it was really difficult to find one, and honestly, I only see a lot of stuffed animals, and it made me want to buy one like the ones on the display. Then I thought about when I was little and there were stuffed animals I wanted but didn't have the money to get. Now that I'm an adult, I have stuffed animals that were given to me. I have three teddy bears, but I like one the most; it's smaller and dark brown. It looks like the first stuffed animal that was named (Teddy Bear), which was very popular at the time, a toy for boys and girls alike. Of course, over time, the Teddy Bear evolved, and little by little, more stuffed animals appeared that weren't just teddy bears. Now there are even octopus plushies that you can turn inside out and it's another octopus in a different color. Now there are so many options of stuffed animals for all tastes. --- #
![1000274676.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ6BmQak3mSDYojgyiNdYAYfTHDYPey5W9SasdxYz1WgZ/1000274676.jpg)
# **

>Ahora bien los peluches con el tiempo se empezaron a usar para demostrar que una persona está enamorada,y entonces cuando son esas ocasiones especiales regalan un peluche incluído chocolates y flores,y hasta venden los peluches con la palabra amor,o vienen con una bocina adentro diciendo te amo,o algo parecido. Cuando yo era joven vendían unos peluches que se llaman pelanas,y son unos perritos con unas tremendas orejas y unos grandes ojos. Yo nunca tuve uno,pero mi hija tienen dos,uno pequeño y uno mediano.<div>**

#

> Now, stuffed animals have come to be used to show that someone is in love, so on special occasions, people give a stuffed animal along with chocolates and flowers. They even sell stuffed animals with the word \
on them, or they come with a speaker inside that says \
or something similar. When I was young, they sold stuffed animals called \

which are little dogs with enormous ears and big eyes. I never had one, but my daughter has two, a small one and a medium one.







---

#


**<div class =\

>Hoy en día los peluches han brindado consuelo y cuidado para los niños,siendo un peluche una herramienta clave en la salud mental y el crecimiento. Si han visto que un niño lleva su peluche a la escuela, déjelo, porque eso le está brindando seguridad. No han visto la caricatura de Winnie pooh, se trata de una historia de la vida real,en el que un padre se inspiro en como su hijo interactuaba con sus juguetes de peluches,en sus momentos de juegos el hablaba con sus peluches imaginando aventuras,y eso fue lo que inspiró al padre a crear la famosa caricatura de Winnie pooh,muy linda está caricatura,yo la veía con mi hija la mayor, porque cuando ella nació Winnie pooh estaba todavía en su fama, ahora ya ni las caricaturas dan,pero los momentos de cada episodio eran muy entretenidos. Los peluches siguen siendo una revolución hoy en día, ahora hay más variedad,y tamaños,no solo han mejorado el material si no que también son adaptados y personalizados para cada persona,siendo parte de una decoración o para regalar.** # > Today, stuffed animals provide comfort and care for children, becoming a key tool for mental health and development. If you see a child taking their stuffed animal to school, let them, because it provides them with security. Have you seen the Winnie the Pooh cartoon? It's based on a true story, where a father was inspired by how his son interacted with his stuffed toys. During playtime, he would talk to his toys, imagining adventures, and that's what inspired the father to create the famous Winnie the Pooh cartoon. It's a very cute cartoon; I used to watch it with my eldest daughter because when she was born, Winnie the Pooh was still very popular. Now, even the cartoons aren't as popular, but the moments in each episode were very entertaining. Stuffed animals continue to be a revolution today. Now there's more variety and sizes. Not only have the materials improved, but they're also adapted and personalized for each person, serving as decoration or as gifts. --- # **

>Si te detuvistes en mi post,espero te animes a participar en esta iniciativa,sería muy entretenido ver los pensamientos y puntos de vistas de cada uno de nosotros. Gracias por leer y espero te hayas entretenido con la lectura y mis anécdotas 👋🌹** # > If you stopped by my post, I hope you'll be encouraged to participate in this initiative. It would be really fun to see everyone's thoughts and points of view. Thanks for reading, and I hope you enjoyed the post and my anecdotes 👋🌹 # **

links.title: The Tale of Molly - ENG- SPA
links.body: > \n\nBeing a celebrity trainer isn't easy, but it's not impossible either. Just ask Molly, who's been doing this job for seven years. When she runs into journalists on the street and they have a conversation, several ask her, \

She recently gave an interview to one of these journalists to explain what her work entails and how she got started. Since she's a very popular figure in the music industry, thousands of people watched the interview to learn something about her life that, until now, had been almost a closely guarded secret. Her motivations for starting this career were more painful than many could have imagined before the interview. She began by answering the question of what her job involves so everyone could understand. According to her, the job consists of training celebrities. This means training them with physical exercises, such as weightlifting, running, planks, and abdominal exercises. As a personal trainer, she also has the responsibility of motivating her clients, who in this case are music stars. That is, singers, producers, writers, and all kinds of people in the music industry. She only works within the music industry.

> Ser entrenadora de estrellas no es una tarea fácil, pero tampoco imposible, sino que le pregunten a Molly que lleva haciendo este trabajo desde hace 7 años. Cuando se topa a periodistas por la calle y tienen una conversación son varios los que le preguntan ¿Cómo es ser una entrenadora de estrellas? Recientemente ella concedió una entrevista a uno de estos periodistas para contar en qué consiste su trabajo y cómo fue que comenzó. Dado que ella es una persona muy popular en la música miles de personas vieroAn esa entrevista para poder enterarse de algo de vida que hasta ahora era casi un secreto bien guardo. Las motivaciones para que empezara en esto fueron más dolorosas de los que muchos podían siquiera pensar antes de esa entrevista. Ella comenzó respondiendo la pregunta de que en que consiste su trabajo para que todos pudieran entender. Según dijo el trabajo consiste en entrenar a estrellas, eso quiere decir que las entrena con ejercicios físicos, es decir pesas, correr, planchas, y abdominales. También como entrenadora personal tiene el trabajo de motivar a sus clientes que en este caso son las estrellas de la música. Es decir cantantes, productores, escritores, y de todo tipo de personas del sector de la música. Ella solo trabaja dentro de la música.
![anastase-maragos-aclkvEMIfL8-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/242Y3PYkcLB9bE8E4de6zWiw5UveeqA2TnecYT1eSyE9D3rJPcMX7aJyrj8Tg2fpFUU56.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> 

Upon hearing that answer, several journalists agreed that her work training singers is quite unusual, as it's not every day you see trainers who work exclusively in that field. This sets her apart and makes her somewhat unique. The next question she was asked was one of the most painful, yet also the most secret and revealing. The answer would shock many who knew her because not even her closest friends or clients were aware of it.

The question in the interview was: \

As she answered, tears welled up in her eyes, and she had to stop several times to cry because she had a lump in her throat and could barely speak. She explained that it was all because of her father. He was a great singer, an older gentleman, but at the peak of his career. Fame came to him somewhat late, as his career didn't take off when he was older. But the fact that he started late didn't matter; the important thing was that success had finally come, and better late than never. His father, for his part, had always spent a lot of time sitting down without exercising. Because of this sedentary lifestyle, he developed several illnesses that, in his old age, all came together and worsened. He died prematurely from these illnesses, because he wasn't that old yet; he was only 55. The sad thing about his case was that, because he didn't exercise in time, he died at his peak, when his musical career was truly beginning and success was on the way.

> Al escuchar esa respuesta varios periodistas concordaron en que ese trabajo que hace ella de entrenar cantantes no es muy común, ya que no se ven todos los días a entrenadores de personas que trabajan en ese sector únicamente. Así que eso la diferencia bastante del resto y la hace hasta un poco única. La siguiente pregunta que le hicieron fue una de las más dolorosas y la más secreta y reveladora. La respuesta conmocionaría a varios de los que la conocían porque ni sus amigos más cercanos o sus propios clientes tenían conocimiento de ello. La pregunta que le hicieron en la entrevista fue: ¿Qué te motivó a dedicarte a entrenar cantantes en el ejercicio físico? Mientras respondía esto se le salían las lagrimas y tuvo que parar varias veces para llorar y porque se le hacia un nudo en la garganta y casi no podía hablar. Ella contó que todo fue por motivo de su padre. El era un gran cantante, era un señor mayor pero estaba en su mejor momento. A el la fama le llegó un poco tarde porque no vino a despegar cuando estaba un poco mayor. Pero que haya empezado tarde no importaba, lo bueno es que el éxito le había llegado y más vale tarde que nunca. Pues su padre en su vida siempre había pasado mucho tiempo sentado sin hacer ejercicio. Por culpa de ese sedentarismo desarrolló varias enfermedades que cuando llegó su vejes se unieron y se reforzaron todas. A causa de esas enfermedades murió prematuramente, porque aún no estaba tan mayor, solo tenía 55 años. Lo triste de su caso fue que por no hacer ejercicio a tiempo murió en su mejor momento, cuando su vida musical estaba comenzando de verdad y los éxitos llegaban.
![dlxmedia-hu-Gz4AEq4QN5g-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23tkZAvHmZdZkmFBSxy5hRQc8fZ7KCEmcbBeff8VfvuNzsF9p2fQoW1Uk6uR9XV82BZgD.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> 

Her father's death motivated her to dedicate herself to this work. She wished she could have helped her when she had the chance and given her the motivation she needed to prevent her from falling into the sedentary lifestyle that ultimately ended her life unexpectedly. That's why she started working as a trainer—to save young athletes from the same fate as her father and to do something for them in time. She's been doing this for seven years now, and in that time she has saved many lives and restored strength and vitality to many people.

She is proud of her achievements. The interview ended with one last question: \

With that, the interview concluded. Now that people know her story, they are more motivated to continue fighting for their own well-being and that of their loved ones. Molly will continue to train everyone who needs it, but especially the stars.

> La muerte de su padre fue quien la motivó a dedicarse a esto, ella hubiera deseado haber podido ayudarla cuando podía y haberle dado la motivación a tiempo para que no llegara a ese estado de sedentarismo que terminó con su vida cuando menos se lo esperaba. Entonces fue por es que ella empezó a trabajar como entrenadora. Para salvar a las estrellas a tiempo de terminar como su padre y poder hacer algo a tiempo por ellos. Lleva ya 7 años en esto, y en ese tiempo ya ha salvado muchas vidas, y le ha devuelto las fuerzas y la vitalidad a muchas personas. Ella se siente orgullosa de sus logros. La entrevista terminó con una última pregunta, ¿Qué le dirías a los que te están viendo ahora en sus casas? Ella dijo, “Que no esperen a que sea demasiado tarde, es mejor actuar cuando se puede, y si no quieres o no tienes el deseo solo llámame”. Con eso se acabó la entrevista. Ahora que las personas conocen su historia están más motivadas a seguir luchando por su bienestar y por el de lo suyos. Molly continuará entrenando a todos lo que lo necesiten, pero en especial a las estrellas.

I think I might be a little different.  

I grew up surrounded by nature.  Walking through forest, watching rivers and fish, looking at the dragonflies that flittered from place to place.  

Even now as I am older I start every day walking my dog through a beautiful park and do the same every evening.

With my wife I will often go on long hikes through the forest, mountains, lakes and rivers near where I live.

I have rural farmland in both the Philippines and British Columbia so I have walked through old growth forests with trees 80m high and 5m around on my personal property and been lucky enough to walk near Sitka spruce which are probably 500 years old.  This summer on my property I'll be walking through it looking at and trying to catalog all the different plants and trees....trying to get rid of the thistles and dogbane while keeping the useful ones... and watching out for bears and such while doing it.

I think it is fair to say that I love nature... a lot :D

If ever you get the chance to come to Canada I really hope I can show you what I call the \

part of my land in the Northwest of British Columbia.  It is so lush and green and the light that filters through gives a hundred shades of green all around with tall trees, moist air, moss, ferns and a general surreal feeling.

... but I've wrapped my arms around some of the big old cedars and douglas fir on my property.... I've walked barefoot through the grass and.... Not my thing :)

<hr>
<hr>

My connection with nature is different.  I value it because it helps me remember that there is an order to things, a time for everything, and a beauty in the world around us.  If we forget our place or focus too much on ourselves ... that focus inward only makes us anxious and stressed.  Looking outward and looking upward frees us from getting locked within ourself.

links.title: Silent Beauty of Mosques: Calligraphy, Courtyards and Freshness from Istanbul to Ankara
links.body:
For a long time, I like to get to know cities not only by their streets, parks or views, but also by their quiet stops. Sometimes, while walking in a city, a person's path falls into a mosque and at that moment, you suddenly leave the crowd of the city and enter a completely different atmosphere. For me, mosques eat exactly like this. Special places where I find peace and enjoy watching their architecture for a long time.


![IMG_1316.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23vhoQaJY7nGMM926SzAKCbxzC4nWu7psemkwXrzrSEp58WYe9JqAcee42tdKEhx5UCeY.jpeg)


Actually, I don't want to talk only about mosques in this post. I want to talk about the fine workmanship on the mosques, the calligraphy on the walls, the spaciousness that high ceilings give people and the unique atmosphere of the courtyards. Because when I enter a mosque, one of the first things that catches my attention is that it is not just its size. Sometimes the calligraphy on a wall, sometimes the fine decorations around the mihrab, sometimes the light filtering in through the windows makes people think for a long time.


![5E97ABEB-CAC5-41FD-8C97-50D6CF18F02E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23vhwMtzrBumn7mf4tJuVbhMdmgcZtd1sprDd4bsw57Jjx7FuCM6op45CeWx8qxzNxvCm.jpeg)

![A8053EB1-8291-4F56-ABA6-56C9DAE1C10E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23xefJYhyEE8kwTWQBnxvUrYVr5pqKNSvLcVVxbQpsuG1qV2SUSjFTMpjt1Q172QTcrW9.jpeg)


There are different mosques from Istanbul and Ankara in these photos. I visited mosques with different spirits such as Teşvikiye Mosque, Süleymaniye Mosque and Yeralti Mosque in Istanbul. In Ankara, I spent time around the Hacı Bayram-ı Veli Mosque, saw Melike Hatun Mosque and experienced a very beautiful mosque atmosphere on the Bilkent side. Each of them had a different atmosphere, but they all had a common feeling: freshness, calmness and aesthetics.

![IMG_1312.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23uFeZcW98ssrrnjFEvbrRGD8ScqYX4ZqWiY6Ai1LCiyX5iSRxzYwnYF81yvEQwVWe9m4.jpeg)

![IMG_1303.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/242hYMG1zpd3U7ZAg8qJcbBeX5FC7Q2eGDbGbDad4qnRE4S3pcGcTH91JS3DQQCrQv4iN.jpeg)

![IMG_1310.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23x195NS7FLbiY2CAWf1PDGTuTNQ12z6TSup4JVRnaZoSDJcT9MJ6q3sD49X7jaxR5Anm.jpeg)


One of my favorite things about mosques is that there is no building divided in layers inside. The fact that the ceiling is very high gives a person an incredible feeling of spaciousness. In daily life, we often live in closed spaces, small rooms, narrow corridors. But when you enter a mosque, when you raise your head, that height, that dome, that emptiness opens a bigger space for you to breathe. That's why the interior of mosques always gives me a sense of freedom. It is as if the human soul expands a little.


![IMG_2152.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpA2yd331cWXpVnCaUTEcX4uQk7rZZfY9YNs13pHDtoZG6ziAZs5tzPtN2f7a1GJj32.jpeg)

![903F43AC-0501-49F4-924D-F27E4455FCBC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23w2gxsdiv7AZYqq4LRMuzNiTARBAnzntLuqNU8o8zisK8GZ2jPZ76eLqS84jGvw9ELeV.jpeg)

![IMG_2244.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep1UwYJ5ECwRK3gqbjBXDN12YViXTzmAwBd2hCo6KCVYZ1RatsxohuFM2TrBaJ1aDas.jpeg)


I experienced this feeling stronger, especially in large buildings such as Süleymaniye Mosque. It is already very impressive from the outside, but when you enter, when that large dome, chandelier, windows and large floor come together, you just want to stop for a while. Without talking, without haste, just watching... I love it in mosques. Sometimes I sit in a corner and watch around. People worship, some pray quietly, some travel as tourists, some just rest. But everyone meets in the calm of the same place.


![IMG_2249.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23yd9qLXEFfdPywKGzHEXrSPa6Ns6BjyBxwJM8peehCByAB2hNt5QN8LctCmyvYTrjnMx.jpeg)

![IMG_2248.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23viALMenSMftdvRf3RevoAiBr8SryooJApiW48wjjjQefdxPkQJ88G51xx3joiiFV2KE.jpeg)

![IMG_2247.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/243Be47x4j6kSoQ5RmXvx2bfBHK2h2aV3sBD1UAHJKLyLrQRxPfv2qMFGorfXjowioSkb.jpeg)


Calligraphy is a special beauty for me. The writings we see on the walls of the mosques, around the dome, at the entrances or in the mihrab section are not just an ornament. They are also an art that completes the spirit of space. The curve of the letters, golden details, sometimes writings written on a dark green background, sometimes simple but strong lines on white marble... All of them attract attention separately. When I look at these writings, I like to think not only about the letters, but also about how that writing makes sense in the building.


![IMG_2252.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoGwvDZfe7XxfyuRQZPiEinhLH4qcxAw1jDkVCQM8dYGH7tZfbVepsG1Tc8aBWDZNiN.jpeg)

![IMG_2253.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eos2GNTDcv1mEDb1bCn4jQuT4eGvG1AZKN8MkiRZNrVnTEHYpopU3W5AnBN6LLTD4iG.jpeg)


In some mosques, calligraphy appears very clearly and strongly. For example, in one of the photos, the big writings around the mihrab looks very impressive with lighting and decorations. It seems that not only architecture, but also light, writing and color have come together there. Gold details, white surfaces and thin patterns make the interior of the mosque look very elegant. In such places, people inevitably want to take pictures, but they also want to stop for a while and see that beauty with their eyes before taking pictures.


![IMG_2256.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eos1NhFG4TSnqGPnchbVFXYHp91T7GvF5w99mjgJLGWkKEfTDTGwJJQPqgARx5Fy97A.jpeg)

![IMG_2257.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep5mDmH7SMzMPHaRaf31zCxczuLWkBiTH9knJCbADm5JBNH1M7nuiUynGjLPUpK4nZR.jpeg)


Courtyards are also one of the most beautiful parts of mosques for me. Especially in Istanbul, the courtyards of large mosques are very lively. Tourists take pictures, those who come for worship enter the mosque, some people wait at the fountain, some sit in the shade. The courtyard is like a transition area between the outside world and the inner world of the mosque. The sound of the city is still heard, but the calmness of the mosque is slowly starting to be felt.


![IMG_2258.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep7siDFDTjBX5pSJJWdo9T6C5tJdKjwYTMFyJFLBzrSqeukLwe2WHgL9b3CTZ2V8izD.jpeg)

![5910CFF0-35C3-41B9-9D2D-050FCF1A87A0.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23z79UF1G5W5g3gsZpGRMfgMHBA3MZZMjVyWKnmE9AjKakwNmxepHi6Wk2jThAeV6d6Ur.jpeg)


The Hacı Bayram-ı Veli neighborhood in Ankara also left a very beautiful mark on me. When a mosque, a mausoleum, people, birds and historical atmosphere come together there, a very special feeling is formed. The area where the Hacı Bayram-ı Veli Tomb is located affects people not only with its architecture but also with its spiritual atmosphere. Time seems to flow a little slower there. People want to pray and watch around.


![4C833EC4-1CAE-4692-963A-0581BB63B842.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23vsSgwjv4pZsJdRC3XkMQ6aZz5HiSbU9TgoXYivUv8TcacUt67wmoe2nziaeCSm2LLYx.jpeg)

![46394CBA-6882-4044-A2E6-7518DA321C96.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23xeti4KMCk2XAyDEeKxjH1NQwi6CB7HoUaPWXxhF2vgDKbq78rms4GPRmGC6KE9s7C3J.jpeg)


The writing and history information at the entrance of the Underground Mosque was one of the details that caught my attention. In the light of the night, those writings became more pronounced. The writing \

gives a very strong feeling of introduction with its Hijri and Gregorian histories. Sometimes you start to feel the past of a building even before entering the door. For me, this is one of the best parts of city trips. A building does not only consist of stone, door and wall. It carries time, effort, faith and memories.

![IMG_2264.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoChZiCat9q1RfB2eMg7bTLP9SAjSiMj7rdEa2qsD26G56yB9P5MPFebqCoxwX6nhWS.jpeg)

![IMG_2266.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23tmNNwZMCyYjjv1Gi2Gqh2AA41aJWm6qQUcVYnh6YDa6qn5CLtizmqbBsC4h7qa79Ngh.jpeg)


Teşvikiye Mosque, on the other hand, shows a different side of Istanbul. It has its own calmness in the busy life of the city, despite the activity around it. Mosques in Istanbul are not only on the historical peninsula; they appear in different districts, with different spirits. This makes the city richer. Not every mosque feels the same. Some are very magnificent, some are simpler, some are very crowded, some are quieter. But in each of them, it is possible for a person to find a corner of his own.


![76A25D63-AB48-46BA-9F77-D2AD6F0CC8A4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23t7qX5d1sZUQSL285bRKu584aS9YafbsDcLRzSoZ3qtwUUHQa7HoG1LbTzFkBKtonqYg.jpeg)

![IMG_2284.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpvjKHfv1Tmtr9CBhimSWTgoqrHtgKsJBNNQh2kCJ9V5aLmjwfA9Ht1cwRPYphZCriF.jpeg)


In modern mosques in Ankara, a cleaner, wider and orderly architecture caught my attention. Marble surfaces, large arches, bright courtyards and high ceilings create a very spacious view. Especially light-colored stones and large spaces make the inside and outside of the mosque look very bright. Even walking in such places is good for people.


![IMG_2280.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpnDLz4RUWyVhDjuzT2sTBea84jDSUYiGYKMm8UFqiMcLcR64tTFeksPfFyqhaxzF2C.jpeg)

![IMG_2281.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpT4iB8xCNQR4To3Z39U5pAoUfFvbCVcUc3YCT8ZYxSeEVZCSsgAkzLKv7Y8qk3iG1r.jpeg)


When I visit mosques, I see it not only as a place of worship, but also as a city memory. Because mosques also show the past of cities, the understanding of art, human relations and daily life. When you look at the people sitting in the courtyard of a mosque, you actually see a small summary of the city. Tourists, the elderly, children, worshipers, photographers... Everyone is in the same place, but the reason why everyone is there is a little different.


![IMG_2298.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23tmG28LdC8p9sk7Fy5KqRjY9FyMaMqQxiRCpJjpUvpbY1kKrdm4S3xzYRZx1oAKYEgdM.jpeg)

![IMG_2299.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23tvkR9RJ49gFjrYahgQtnhTRFZv3qb3XVHSFJ6ESS6b4evDeMpXMfMQzyXPCurur6MTR.jpeg)


That's why I like to go to mosques. Sometimes to find peace, sometimes to look at the architecture, sometimes just to breathe a little under the high ceilings. Watching calligraphy, domes, chandeliers, courtyards and light is very good for me.


![IMG_2304.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoAadNqJEZzKPs7WBswuQbgWPtFXndKXoUghnt6g9zZNA4HgN8GxirymE1ufzzXgRgg.jpeg)

![IMG_2445.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23yweS8B1HfdbfGQDWLyYPyCbBNcUEGFFdx1sZbJKkC7ZUYAXnvsog6BpMbURxMX1nWqe.jpeg)

![IMG_2446.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23zbRkkdGbTgtWA4KRMUb6rNbjRSnpBnZ5QmJG4Hs8F1n6BBhrtDiwUzaCSDGdkHxC4uU.jpeg)


This sharing was like a small but very meaningful journey between Istanbul and Ankara for me. Thanks to the mosques, I had the opportunity to see the cities from a quieter place. Sometimes to understand a city, it is necessary to go to the quietest corners, not the most crowded squares. Mosques are one of those quiet and beautiful corners for me.

links.title: Children Grows Faster
links.body:
Sometimes I sit and watch my children do some of the things on their own, and it hits me in the quietest moments how fast they are growing. It’s strange because as a mother, I spend years being needed for almost everything. From tying shoelaces to helping with homework, from comforting tears to answering endless questions, my whole world revolves around being there for them.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmR7g27rB9x4YjTuQ3WoQ7XAPdgzxyQC3dQ7ex3hhedgNQ/1000219187.jpg 

> blockquote
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/mum-child-family-nature-asian-7344070/)

Then one day, little by little, they stop needing much of my help in the same ways. The little kids of yesterday can now eat by their selves, put on their trousers without needing my help.

Honestly, it’s a bittersweet feeling. Part of me feels proud seeing them become more confident and independent. It means I must have done something right. But another part of me aches a little because every new thing they learn to do on their own is also a reminder that they are growing up faster than I’m ready for.

Nobody really talks about this side of motherhood enough. People talk about sleepless nights, diapers, school runs, and the stress that comes with raising children. But they don’t always talk about the emotional side of watching your children slowly build lives that no longer revolve completely around you. And honestly, that realization can be hard.
 
And I know this is just the beginning because there will come a moments when I will miss the younger versions of them just like my mama do, the days when they would hold my hand everywhere we went or call out for me over the smallest things.  Even though I used to feel exhausted sometimes and wished for a little more quiet. But those noisy little moments were some of the most precious parts of motherhood I think.

Just like my mother said that I should remind myself that this is exactly what parenting is supposed to do. We raise our children so they can become strong enough to stand on their own. We teach them how to make decisions, how to face challenges, and how to believe in themselves. Love is not only about holding on tightly, sometimes it’s also about slowly loosening your grip, even when your heart wants to do the opposite just like she did.

What I’m learning is that love changes as children grow. When they are little, love looks like protection and constant presence. As they get older, love becomes trust, support, encouragement, and giving them space to become who they are meant to be.

That doesn’t make the love smaller. If anything, it becomes deeper. No matter how independent my children become, I know a part of me will always worry about them, pray for them, and hope life is kind to them. I’ll always be their mother, even when they no longer need me in the same ways they once did.

And maybe that’s the quiet beauty of motherhood, learning how to let your children grow while still carrying them in your heart every single day.


**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

links.title: Street Vibes - PhotoFeed Contest Street Photography 171
links.body:
Yesterday's field work took me around the ever-busy *Cemetery Market*. As usual, my eyes were scanning, and my phone was handy to capture moments. 

Getting to the market junction, I spotted it: two events were happening at the same spot. On one side, a Bitters company was running a market activation of their bitters drinks. On the other side was Lush haircare products' vendor selling extensions, creams, and everything in between. 

My camera focused on the Bitters activation because they got the vibes. Lol. 

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdYubFG5SegL3CoYGit99Lm15Em83sB8U28M8FQ1NirfS/1000297653.jpg 
 ***


https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVHdnj9nnTYEFEpVm1QWWp69w378CmodERJYmWn8WjKap/1000296421.jpg
 
You could see it all in the shots — the tent, the sales team, the DJ, the MC on the mic hyping the products, and the dancers pulling people in with their funny steps.

They were doing exactly what street activations are meant to do: stop people, make them smile, and get them curious about the product. 

https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPb4QLPjTivBiaUpaAP9TUxY8r6ckVdKRJdcdPPoHcxFp/1000297804.jpg


One of the products I noticed was Zazzu Bitters. Funny name, though. Lol. 

After capturing the moment, I moved on, but not without pitching my radio station to the sales rep. Hopefully, they'll do business with us. 

That’s the thing I love about being on the street — the opportunity to capture moments for my blogs, while also doing my work. 

***

If you love what I share here, I encourage you to hit the streets; there’s always something to capture and share.


***

*Thanks for coming around.*

links.title: ¿Sientes el eco en tu pecho? La melodía de las que tenemos alma de cristal ✨
links.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmejY7QPdXiTALtmMKhRfvf7xnAhnyirBUtRz1HoQScVdr/1779564910601.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaxKJEfTeHDsefoPPJ9HDBxioJ8XWL1TWatyD8s5k6jMp/1779564910758.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb5PhrR7Mn96QY7htKtB44vr3G3EyCSirXZKcUdxctRxW/1779564910956.jpg)


​<center>✨ 🤍 🌟 🤍 ✨ 🌟 ✨ 🤍 🌟 🤍 ✨</center>

Hay personas que caminamos por la vida con una luz diferente, no somos de piedra, ni llevamos corazas; al contrario, algunas tenemos almas de cristal, almas puras, transparentes y delicadas,  🤍

Somos como esos vasos de cristal fino y auténtico Si los tocas con delicadeza, o incluso si reciben un pequeño golpe, emiten un sonido hermoso, agudo y cristalino que no se apaga rápido; se queda vibrando en el aire por largo tiempo, resonando con fuerza. Así somos nosotras. Cuando algo nos toca el corazón, ya sea una alegría o una tristeza, ese sentimiento no desaparece al instante, se queda vibrando dentro de nuestro pecho, resonando por días, porque no sabemos sentir a medias.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYsacFUQBUBZ6Ezgsfaw6f4AWdGtC5b69a3R8PLb6DJ4x/1779565023122.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT6KjgnLPv6DvdeApFJC6S4doHgtFGqNGGY61ZoMUTZvR/1779565023162.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQma6RgawdumCcgQUcWmVDfyHzwAi9ZZjgJh75z7jU2aBBK/1779565023204.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUUrccW726sYnD1r2pW1kudw4j31VNrZs2pFc66n33ksN/1779565023245.jpg)

​<center>✨ 🤍 🌟 🤍 ✨ 🌟 ✨ 🤍 🌟 🤍 ✨</center>

Hoy en día es fácil cruzarse con personas que parecen no inmutarse ante nada, alguien a su lado puede estar pasando por un momento difícil, cayéndose a pedazos o sufriendo, y ellos simplemente no reaccionan; siguen de largo, fríos, con un alma inamovible porque piensan que si no les está pasando a ellos, simplemente no importa, son personas que se blindan en su propio egoísmo.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWGPVYTyjTdqTwp61xgxL6ayGKZrLEpJRrSuSNidUZeGD/1779564979478.jpg)

Sin embargo, el alma de cristal reacciona inmediatamente, no podemos mirar hacia otro lado. 

Por eso, a menudo lloramos mucho, lloramos por alegría, por nostalgia, o por impotencia. Quizás los demás nos miren y nos llamen débiles, pero no entienden que nuestras lágrimas no son cobardía; son el resultado de conectar con el alma del otro de una forma única. 

Tenemos una sensibilidad tan expuesta que el sufrimiento ajeno lo sentimos en el pecho como si fuera nuestro propio sufrimiento, no necesitamos palabras para saber cuándo alguien la está pasando mal; su dolor nos atraviesa y nos mueve a actuar, a abrazar, a sentir.

Es verdad que somos delicadas, un roce brusco, una mala intención o una palabra hiriente pueden resquebrajarnos por dentro. Sin embargo, hay algo hermoso en nuestra naturaleza: incluso en nuestras grietas, la luz sigue brillando, y es precisamente a través de esas fisuras por donde aprendemos a sanar y a iluminar a los demás.

A veces el mundo nos pide que nos \

o que dejemos de ser tan sentimentales, pero nuestra fragilidad no es debilidad, es empatía pura,
es la valentía de vivir con el corazón expuesto, de amar con honestidad y de mantener la limpieza en el alma en un mundo que a veces se olvida de ser auténtico y leal.

​<center>✨ 🤍 🌟 🤍 ✨ 🌟 ✨ 🤍 🌟 🤍 ✨</center>

Me despido por hoy, querida comunidad de Liketu. Gracias por leerme, por recibir mis fotos y, sobre todo, por abrirme un espacio donde puedo compartir un pedacito de mi corazón con tanta libertad, les deseo a todos un día lleno de luz, de momentos reales y de conexiones verdaderas. 

¡Nos leemos en la próxima publicación! Un abrazo enorme para todos. ✨🌸

links.title: Slip Streaming Passenger Aircraft
links.body: /> [source](https://x.com/airlinerslive/status/2029836191722266708) An article caught my attention the other day and it is fascinating what is taking place behind the scenes with regard to saving fuel costs. Not only the fuel costs but the amount of carbon emissions the airlines will be taxed on. We have seen how well slip streaming in sports such as formula one and cycling works so why not with passenger aircraft? The problem is safety and why it has not been a good idea up till now due to dirty air left by the leading aircraft that will result in severe dangerous turbulence for the secondary trailing aircraft. How dangerous is the turbulent vortex that is created by the wing tips of a large aircraft? Well they create unstable air similar to a tornado that can create severed down draft making air drop at 500ft per minute and can last up to 2 minutes depending if there is wind or not. This is why there is a minimum set period of time between take offs and landings at airports. Heathrow used to have a plane taking or landing every 30 seconds, but they have multiple runways which makes this possible. Pilots will take off prior to the previous planes take off point and land on a slightly higher gliding path landing further on the runway than the previous plane. Interesting as I did not know this. Airbus have been playing around with this with a project called Fello'Fly which is basically something the US Airforce have used in the past known as Vortex surfing. The slipstreaming plane has to be close enough which in this case is 3 kilometers or to make you understand the distance better approximately 20 seconds apart. The trailing plane has to be slightly higher so it receives the upward airflow generated by the leading plane. The test done earlier in the year from Toulouse in France which is where the Airbus factory is situated to Montreal in Canada. Apparently the idea is based on the Geese formation flying which conserves the energy of the Geese. The test flight was successful with the second trailing aircraft saving roughly 5% fuel over the trip. The problem is obvious and that one would need special onboard flight control software, route planning and timing like clock work to make this happen. Unless you have pilots who can do this who stay awake for the entire flight not using auto pilot then we have to wait for this to be developed before this actually happens. Airbus reckons by 2050 this will be normal flying practice and my head is telling me just charge me 5% more than placing me 20 seconds apart from another airline who could be 20 seconds away from another aircraft.

/></center>

[source](https://www.flightradar24.com/45.83,-57.37/2)

Looking at Flight Radar this evening you could see how this could easily work as most aircraft follow set routes controlled by air traffic control. Many of these flights are travelling at different altitudes in order to avoid collisions and turbulent air especially if there are much bigger planes around like the A380.

I have to admit not all ideas are good ideas and this sounds like one of those that it may not be practical. Safety should always be the first concern over cutting costs and this sounds like the health and safety is being tossed out the window. The good news is the technology is not around yet and the reason why planes have so many different wing tip designs is to try and get rid of the dirty air moving it away from your own aircraft. Now they need to design wing tips to help favor planes following them plus the on board flight software. 

To give you an idea an airline like British Airways would spend around $11 billion per annum on jet fuel so a 5% saving is $550 million. Still it does worry me that they think this is a good idea.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cryptoandcoffee/slip-streaming-passenger-aircraft--2wo)

links.title: The joy of photographing birthdays at home
links.body:
![PhotoCollage_1779565447622.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmat194qzqGLQDA1C3rm97NvpNxd3R4EVVqCa2YvpnAHvP/PhotoCollage_1779565447622.jpg

hello friends I hope you are feeling great and full of energy. I am very happy to be with you. 
Today I want to share one of my photography experiences with you. 
Some time ago, one of my dear clients had prepared a small ceremony at home with some relatives and friends on the occasion of his wife's birthday and asked me to go to their house to take some souvenir photos.

![a (6).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS8JeVgkqg9qyP4nCJkoUCxMbmZGB2PbSHzs2ud3BYsfS/a%20(6).jpg)
In adult birthday parties, emotions are much deeper and much more natural.
In my opinion, photographing an adult's birthday together with his wife has a more strange and better feeling. 
A person with his life partner may feel better on his birthday and feel the need for a companion better.  

The first shot I showed you, I wanted them to look at the 30th birthday cake in their arms and show a completely natural feeling.




![a (2).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxmZgau8MKNh8RnjzShySCEe1Bz4EK4QeqJgw68m8HhP/a%20(2).jpg)

The simple gesture of being together and hugging each other, next to the cake table and the balloons they made, is one of the simplest figures. 
Sometimes adults also like to have balloons for birthday parties, and I always welcome these pure feelings.


![a (3).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR7rzFwvrH1PiFaZRuHokkFNysywAqzvhW8vN5cENZ1w2/a%20(3).jpg)


![a (4).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcMbSHjmHg7U9bohDvRuLLgYNUyQdRPf4GboDxxRKCTEW/a%20(4).jpg)

For her husband's birthday, this dear lady wanted me to make the poses a little different and not all the poses be simpleI also wanted a lady and a gentleman to stand closer to the camera and the opposite side to stand at a distance from the first person, so that I want to give depth of field to the photo with the camera lens and highlight the subject that is closer to the camera. 

First, I wanted the dear lady to be closer to Dobin and hold the cake in her hand and look once at the camera and once at her husband who is standing behind her. And in these two photos, I changed the resolution of the subject using the camera zoom.
I really liked the combination of colors. And since the lady wore a beautiful bow on the back of her hair, I wanted the back of her head to be seen as well. It was a really beautiful photo. I liked it myself.


![a (5).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjqrygcnnwWNcqtRhKtmiT76YDi2dY8Qe6vjpCpkffsB/a%20(5).jpg)

Now it is the turn of the owner of the birthday cake. This time the man stood ahead of the woman and we made the feelings a little stronger and I asked the man to hold the hand of the woman and look at each other with many smiles. In this pose, the gentleman preferred to look at his lady rather than at the camera. This means a strong feeling.



![a (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTDfsfbT4Wxy3w4jBEHDWSHPRMmHPzpBx6ckFRhDnsuak/a%20(1).jpg)
For the last pose that I am uploading here, I wanted them to get closer to each other and hug each other and with a loving look at each other, bring the birthday cake with both hands towards the camera so that I can take my shots. Smiles full of pure emotion make the photos more beautiful and I always ask all the clients who come for photography to smile with their mouths open. 

I want to say very sincerely, I have been photographing for several years, each photography session has its own passion and mood for me. And the feeling I experience in every session is as if it is new.

At the end of this photography session, I was very happy because I thought, I recorded good shots and when I was choosing the photos, the smile of this couple was more attractive to me. 
I hope you liked this photography session. I would be happy to know your opinions to advance my work.

You @nupulse, @theturtleproject, @risingstargame (Jux) created a beautiful game that made me feel like an artist, and I say it whenever I can: that's what made me fall in love with the game—the music, NFTs that could play music. For me, that was wonderful.

Thank you for everything, guys. Thank you for the security you made us feel. The whole market is going downhill, and you were there fighting the good fight. Many projects with huge budgets or massive communities vanished in the blink of an eye, and you kept going without flinching. Thank you for that stability in this ever-changing world. Thank you for your patience, for clarifying our doubts, helping us solve problems, and for protecting us like the great leaders you are. Thank you for releasing new NFTs every month without fail. Thank you for supporting my content. Thank you for all the legendary cards that brought me so much joy in the packs. Thank you for everything.

Best of luck. You guys are the best!

links.title: Having Wild cards is important again!
links.body:
<center>
![temp1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23tGdwPRXUozjN3qYnhWE77H39C8pkReFxcSPZYRDda65SwBabV9fMvncrv7LY2YK4H6R.jpg)
</center>

Hey everyone, what do you think about the fairly new 'Outsider' ruleset in which ONE Wild unit can be used in our Modern battles?

I think it's awesome and it's a great move from the team because this ruleset not only brings entertainment but is also brings a little extra demand for key Wild cards!
What cards are key you may ask? Well.... Cursed Windeku, Unicorn Mustang, Djinn OShannus, Iziar, Baakjira, Djinn Chwala, Deeplurker and Swamp Spitter, just to name some of them!

So, having Wild cards is important again but the way I've managed my accounts, I had a problem with this ruleset because all my GOOD Wild cards are on my Wild account, managed by XBot... and not in my Modern account, so in the last week I've started buying some of these key cards for this account and they're a lot cheaper than back in the day! 

<center>
![teeth banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23w2kqTN8gBpWz7rz7ZmFQEDWAiPGQLJues1o7u42f9bzzU4qSUaFjgPSVQRN5NV5UDFV.png)
</center>

<center>
![Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23w2aeT1szjzTSYN3RoDbKB1PKk6vCVGiRMz16wTfPAxmmM1zxK9kH45jBuhkTVYB3ZBY.png)
</center>

A couple of days ago I was grinding my ranked battles and the Outsider ruleset was coming up A LOT and I really liked it, I also read someone who didn't like that it came out that much but I guess that's someone without Wild cards or the knowledge about them, and it's something older players really have a benefit with - owning the older reward cards and more importantly, the knowledge about these cards and when to use them. It's been a long time though so it takes some heavy thinking, the couple of Wild Brawl battles I do every week are helping with this so I didn't completely forgot, it's just that my Modern account doesn't own a lot of the high powered older cards.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23t7DRehNnRRfgtBnaRuamL53BBoCJWB8ZWG27R2tq48RwSXeqAASVyoyp8xXRXbfJ49t.png)
</center>

In one of those Outsider battles, I met @iluvwvmountains, a players that's been around for a long time as well and I started the battle with a level disadvantage, Gold level vs. Silver level... Good choice of the Wild card too, Coastal Sentry, another one of those bangers! I used to pair her up with Possibilus the Wise to give her the *Reach* ability, good old times!

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/Eo45HnTExjBeu9Q7so4Q35FJzyVP4oSoTguRF1pW6gTaykNcUQPhmUnUi7cujH7yPCm.png)
</center>

The Sentry killed my tank way too fast, bringing my MVP to the front where it's vulnerable to get the armor destroyed, but my Swamp Spitter can repair it! Good thing I killed the enemy tank as well, now quickly, kill the Sentry before she can use her *Double Strike* again!

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/Eo6CevivXxr7VVP1UoxYtWdXnuEHNuxgyGEiswDnHr82WUtWQskEiPBXaDUMrK1z9kZ.png)
</center>

We both had a nice support team in the back line, I had a healer and a armor repair, my opponent used two armor repairs but it was mitigated by Slade's double attack with Piercing, all my damage was intentionally directed to the front, well expect for the sniper but I just had to use it because it teams up well with the Shock Trooper, and soon the enemy frontline collapsed, basically when you're not using a tank with the *Shield* ability or a strong magic team, or both... you're screwed against a Elias / Slade team.

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/Eo8KfiZeekGbr5nuCqrus4p57fxcSx4Ux88m7Y6mDKKBhMETm5pjdFkYC5r6ZffoD49.png)
</center>

The man himself had the honor of delivering the final blow, another win for me!

[You can watch the battle unfold here for yourself.](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_50926a444c44e3be19bee357cd75eb8a?ref=nozem)

How is the new season going for you? I had a horrible start in the early days, my win rate last season was really high but so far it's really bad with only 45% 😅

links.title: Some Experience Leave Invisible Scars.
links.body:
Hello Community, 

There are some experiences that happen once but somehow stay with you for a very long time, even when life moves on, a small reminder can bring back memories you thought you had already forgotten.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdECEqLsSGmFMzg4emJbitvTgeHJYn2XM3dw1kurrZiPd/1779565216816.jpg)

I would not say that  I have gone through clinical PTSD, but I have had experiences that affected me mentally, and one that comes to mind is a road accident I witnessed a years ago, I was not involved, I was close enough to see everything, It was one of those moments where everything seems normal one second and then completely changes the next, The sound, the panic, the crowd gathering and the confusion all stayed in my mind.

At first I thought I was fine and I went home that day, I continued with life as usual, then I noticed something strange, anytime I was in a vehicle and the driver suddenly applied the brakes hard, my heart would start racing, Even when there was no danger I would feel uneasy, whenever I heard tires screech on the road my mind would go back to that day,I realized that some experiences leave marks that're not physical.

People often expect healing to happen quickly, they think that because an event is over, the mind should move on, It doesn't always work like that, sometimes your body and mind are still trying to process what happened long after the event has ended.

For a while I became more anxious when I travelled, I paid attention to how people drove and found myself constantly watching the road, it wasn't something I planned to do, but what helped me eventually was time, talking about it.

I found that keeping everything inside didn't really help, the more I discussed the experience with friends and family, the less power it seemed to have over me, hearing other people's perspectives also helped me realize that my reaction was normal, Another thing that helped was simply continuing to live life instead of allowing fear to control me,If I had completely avoided travelling because of that experience, I think the fear would have become even stronger. Instead, I gradually became comfortable again by facing those situations repeatedly and reminding myself that not every journey would end the way that incident did, I also learned something important from that experience.



People carry invisible battles that we know nothing about.


Sometimes someone reacts strongly to a situation, and we assume they are overreacting, meanwhile, we don't know what memories or experiences that situation may have triggered for them, that realization made me a little more patient and understanding toward others, looking back now, the memory is still there, but it no longer controls how I feel, I can think about it without the anxiety that came with it before.

I think healing is rarely about forgetting. Most of the time, it is about learning how to live with a memory without letting it dominate your present, and honestly, that lesson alone is something I will probably carry with me for the rest of my life.

[Image Credit](https://unsplash.com/photos/animal-skin-condition-kyyWGv9t2L4)

links.title: Reincarnation and the Akashic Records
links.body:
For many year I have held the theory that what is believed to be 'reincarnation' is merely a strong link to a historical thread contained within the akashic records. 

In the decades I have spent exploring the meaning of life I have found two things related to this: 1) No one has contradicted this theory, possibly because... 2)  No other person or document has linked these together. 

This is surprising to me as most other theories I have discovered in my own thinking have already been described in various forms, terminologies, or loose allusion. (This both confirms that my self discovery is expansive, but also creates frustration that everything already seems to have been discovered in one form or another. Of course, holding a thing and knowing how to use or apply it are not necessarily one and the same, but I digress.)

The topic of reincarnation was refreshed in my awareness this afternoon as I read *The Romeo Error* by *Lyall Watson*. In the chapter on *Possession Within Other Bodies* is commentary on reincarnation. Watson comments:

\

the body of every individual has a physical and a supra-physical component; and when the energy exchange between these two components ceases to existe, the physical body dies. But the supra-physical body does not die ... because it consists of an order of matter which is not subject to the process which we call 'death'.\
\n\nJoan Grant's husband, a hypnotic regression psychiatrist, admits that ... \

.

My own theory appears to solve this problem quite effectively. By suggesting that reincarnation is merely a connection, of various degrees of psychic/energetic clarity, between an individual and previous life histories stored within the akashic records, I remove both the need for reincarnation and the presupposition that an individual must have lived a life prior to their current earthly existence. My theory also does not prevent or negate the possibility of reincarnation, it merely makes it irrellevant. 

That's not to say that an energetic entity would not choose to re-enter our physical realm after already experiencing it one or more times previously. I can see an individuated entity choose another 'shot at life' because they were unable to attain a certain experience in a previous lfe path, which completely fits with my theory of The Great iSM, the answer to the meaning of life.

I would readily welcome comments regarding this view of reincarnation and the akashic records. Although I have looked widely, I am constantly finding new information hitherto beyond my scope of exploration.

Namaste,
Dave

links.title: Deep Cuts Before Deployment
links.body:
The team at @mantequilla-soft and I are getting ready to move away from the legacy way of handling videos on @threespeak. While this change won't radically alter the user experience on the surface, under the hood it requires some serious reworking of our codebase. Lots of careful cuts.

![5dae5b31-0065-4dd5-b963-21bdc6d6c8c0.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbyKCwYNi6yGgZhGEgwNLhbRpg1JkE4b6SKqYqhf6p4EG/5dae5b31-0065-4dd5-b963-21bdc6d6c8c0.png)

If you've used shorts on either @snapie or @threespeak, you already know the direction we're heading in. The swap, however, isn't quite ready yet.

The best way I can describe the current issue without leaning too hard into nerdistics — a language I've been told is incredibly boring — is that upload performance on the new system is still rough. The uploads work, but patience is not exactly a universal virtue, and it may be wise not to test the limits of people's tolerance in that department.

For the past few days I've been reworking the upload process, changing not only my own logic, but even the libraries the system depends on. Deep cuts, to be clear.

As I type this, I'm preparing to press the button while also keeping a rollback plan close by.

No matter how much one tests a system, you never really know until you know. At least in my experience, no amount of testing can make software truly bulletproof. That doesn't mean we shouldn't try our best anyway.

With that said, since I won't be touching the legacy uploads for @threespeak just yet, and these changes are currently focused on shorts, I want to apologize beforehand for any issues that might appear along the way.

I also want to encourage people not to be shy about reporting bugs or strange behavior. A reply on Hive will do just fine, but if necessary, you can also reach me on Discord.

It's time to pour another hot cup of joe and see what happens.

MenO

links.title: Geometría de lo opuesto. Décimas
links.body:
Geometría de lo opuesto 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSqBKiMKsaTozFFrkMS9cmmW1gMY6Ne56LKCH9c9FYEkM/1778171397957.jpg)





En tu luz mi sombra habita,  
y en mi calma tu tormenta;  
tu risa que me sustenta  
cuando mi pena se agita.  
La distancia se marchita  
si tu abrazo me reclama,  
y aunque el miedo reprograma  
lo que el coraje sostiene,  
tu verdad siempre mantiene  
mi duda lejos del drama.


Soy silencio, tú alboroto,  
soy invierno, tú verano;  
pero al tomarte la mano  
se equilibra todo el roto.  
Tu ternura es el remoto  
que enciende mi claridad;  
y en la frágil dualidad  
de querernos sin medida,  
tu caos ordena mi vida,  
mi paz sostiene tu andar.


Eres fuego, yo marea,  
tú desbordas, yo contengo;  
cuando ardes, yo me vengo  
a enfriar lo que golpea.  
Mas tu llama me moldea  
y mi agua da sentido;  
somos borde y recorrido,  
dos pulsos que se equilibran:  
tu ímpetu que me vibran,  
mi calma que te ha elegido.


Soy noche, tú mediodía,  
yo me escondo, tú apareces;  
cuando mi sombra oscureces  
tu claridad me desvía.  
Pero en esa geometría  
de opuestos que se entrelazan,  
tu luz a mi sombra alcanza  
y en mi sombra a ti te nombro;  
somos frontera y asombro,  
dos mitades que se abrazan.

Nota: La foto es de mi propiedad.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

links.title: Saturday Hivechess Tournament
links.body:
Today was the 18th round of the Saturday Hivechess tournament but it was not a good one for me. Started with a bang of two straight wins and then they were all losses from there on. After 3 losses, I pulled out of the tournament because that was it for me. I did not have the zeal to keep pushing. So this left me with finishing in 13th place with 6 points and that's it. From there on, it was just rating performance of 2102 and a 40% win rate on a 100% berserk.

At first I slept off which was sign that I was going to miss it and yet I was quick to remember but it was too late for me, at least there was 50 minutes left when I jumped but I could not make anything out of it. 


![Screenshot_20260523-200543.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23tHQmbiLELAfEopkKEA9dEZzGPBbXqfwykeGEiWEB1o5um3T5LcmmuZj8MDa5S1234ZN.jpg)

I got paired against the host of the tournament and the game was a pretty interesting one and should be in the museum for games on opposite side attacks. We both castled to the opposite direction and that was a signal for disaster as both players will be looking for the fastest means to launch an attack on the opposing side's king. Unfortunately the attack that led to fruition was not mine. It was king that got checkmated first. I underestimated the threat of his pieces on my kingside with the mindset that I would get a break on his queenside where he castled his king, sadly it was not the case. 


![Screenshot_20260523-201347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23tHR4Q5rrjwG7W61iRZrGbZoQY3UbgE8iHNTMEzxsx8iNLREAAaHbTnPPft9gJ4Lv72E.jpg)

When the rook sacrifice came in, I knew there was serious problem at this point and I should be hopeful if I escape from this one. I could not because after the rook sacrifice, my opponent played more moves that made it hard for my king to survive. 


![Screenshot_20260523-201744.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23tHR8fKik96DQgv1rAQPZm6aTjjT5HinVuWEi6xBcVhJk6A5k79QTqW9gpnq68ind4GN.jpg)

Hey you, checkmate is already close. That was all I could hear from my opponent's black pieces at this point. That was the case and it was checkmate, a couple of moves later on. 


![Screenshot_20260523-202307.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23wXBZn88vq8xP4g3ABW4xUqKAcjuDU6QTSSYXtVA6h8B9Agn9p1mbNCoqp3dcotWNg8m.jpg)

Yet another game with a strong player where the position was balanced and all I had to do was hold but no I could not do that. Rather I went for a one move blunder and that was it. Pushing my pawn, thinking I was preventing some checkmate that might arise, not knowing was only making things worse. This time, it was a knight sacrifice on my kingside. I saw more problems than solutions if I took the knight so I just want ahead to resign. 

At this point was giving up on playing more games.

links.title: Calamity, the beast for low-mana battles
links.body: **Why Calamity Is So Important in Low-Mana Battles in Splinterlands** Low-mana battles in Splinterlands are some of the most challenging and strategically demanding in the game. When the mana cap is tight, every card needs to deliver maximum value. In this environment, the legendary Dragon Calamity has become one of the strongest and most efficient cards in the modern meta. At just 4 mana, Calamity offers something few cards can match: * consistent magic damage, * solid speed, * strong survivability, * and exceptionally powerful abilities. **The Power of Magic Damage** In low-mana matches, many tanks have limited health or minimal armor. That's exactly where Calamity's magic attack makes all the difference — it hits enemy health directly, bypassing armor entirely. This allows her to: * take out support units quickly, * apply pressure from the very first rounds, * and shift the pace of a battle within just a few turns. In short fights, a single magic unit can decide the entire match. **Life Leech: The Secret to Her Survivability** One of Calamity's most powerful abilities is Life Leech. Every time she deals magic damage, she grows her own health pool. The result: * she stays alive longer, * becomes increasingly difficult to eliminate, * and grows stronger as the battle progresses. In low-mana rulesets where cards typically die fast, Calamity can snowball into a threat that's nearly impossible to stop. **Speed and Efficiency** Small battles are often decided by who removes an enemy card first — which is why speed matters so much. Calamity brings together: * solid damage output, * reliable speed, * and a low mana cost. This combination lets her attack before most budget cards and build an advantage early. **The Flexibility of the Dragon Splinter** Another major strength is her Dragon element, which allows her to be paired with a wide range of splinters. This makes her: * an incredibly versatile card, * effective across multiple strategies, * and a strong investment for ranked play and tournaments. Many players consider her one of the most valuable cards to own in the modern format. **Dominant in Special Rulesets** Calamity also shines in rulesets like: * Little League, * Equalizer, * Weak Magic, * and Aimless. In Little League especially — where only low-cost monsters are allowed — she can become one of the most dangerous cards on the battlefield. **Conclusion** Calamity has firmly established herself in the modern meta thanks to her remarkable efficiency. Her combination of magic damage, Life Leech scaling, and low mana cost make her one of the best options for fast, high-stakes battles. In Splinterlands, where every point of mana can mean the difference between a win and a loss, Calamity proves exactly why she's considered one of the strongest legendary cards for low-mana play. I'm including a sample match because I thought it would be interesting to see how the card performs in low-mana-cost matches. links.title: Movie Night
links.body:
## Predator: Badlands

On a remote planet, a young Predator, cast out by his own clan, finds an unexpected ally in Tia and embarks on a dangerous journey in search of the ultimate opponent.

https://youtu.be/43R9l7EkJwE?is=MnprumsXVj29w6yX

🟢🟢🟢🟢

* Great chemistry between Elle Fanning and the Predator.
* Strong overall performance by Elle Fanning in both roles.
* You can really feel the director of Prey taking risks here, and for the most part, it pays off.
* For the first time, we see the story through the Predator’s own perspective.
* Visually captivating.
* The world-building by Dan Trachtenberg is stunning, with intense action scenes and imposing landscapes.
* I liked the sense of honor and the code the Predators seem to follow.
* The creature design is very well done.

🔴🔴🔴🔴

* At times, it has a strong video game aesthetic.
* Unfortunately, it is not as bloody as I would have liked.
* In some moments, it falls into a safer style of storytelling, even though it clearly has the potential to take bigger risks.
* It leans more toward digital effects rather than practical ones.




## Heated Rivalry

At the heart of *Heated Rivalry*, two ice hockey stars, Shane Hollander and Ilya Rozanov, are locked in what seems like an unstoppable battle for the top.
However, away from the spotlight and the cold ice rink, their relationship evolves into something far more than a simple rivalry: an intense, secret, and deeply romantic connection that will test the limits of career, love, and self acceptance. 

https://youtu.be/lKO26odltss?is=pHoyf_ZgkdQojmZb

🟢🟢🟢🟢

* It touches on deeper themes such as masculinity, society’s expectations, and professional pressure.
* I actually enjoyed the storyline of Scott Hunter and his partner more, especially the way it developed in episode 3, and I would have liked to see their love story explored further.
* I liked that it felt more human and avoided turning the characters into caricatures. It also leaned into emotion.
* The season length felt right considering the number of episodes.
* Plenty of sex scenes 😅
* From a directing standpoint, there are some really good moments, especially the long takes that amplify the tension of a scene.
* Beautiful cinematography.
* Hudson Williams brought a strong sense of emotional restraint and inner depth to Shane Hollander.

🔴🔴🔴🔴

* The final episode disappointed me. It felt completely lifeless, aside from one small reveal.
* The ending was also very flat and did not create anticipation for another season.
* Sorry, but I personally did not feel any chemistry between the two main characters.
* I wanted more hardcore sex scenes. It felt too familiar and safe.
* I’m not sure how much audiences will truly relate to these characters as they were presented.

links.body:
***Truthful Route: Session 28! We meet the last Sovereign, Zhuqiaomon who took control of our partners, and told us how humans failed him and his friends.***


-------

**Digimon Survive** is a Digimon Visual Novel with Turn-based strategy battles. It follows a group of children stranded in another world. They form bonds with the creators there called Digimon as they desperate attempts to find a way back home. I already finished one route of the game, and now I'm publishing my playthrough of the Truthful Route!

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZwsm6oJru4JJ2hMH5Kr14bKRVvmgHARdGvvd5nyC1zjc/1000072744.webp 


Digimon Survive is the darkest piece of Digimon media I ever consumed while still being PG13. What I love the most about **Digimon Survive**, is how it uniquely blends Digital Monsters with Japanese folklore. It's amazing how the idea of \

integrates seamlessly with Digimon lore. The specific Digimon they choose for this game enhance this theme.

Digimon Survive is the closest modern entry to the *old school* Digimon anime vibes. Though, more than the earlier Digimon anime series, the game reminds me more of **Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Survivor** series. In that series too, characters may die depending on your actions.

Below you can watch my playthrough of Digimon Survive, and the link to the whole playlist.

**THIS PLAYTHROUGH IS MODDED:** I installed the [Improved Translation Mod](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459533) and the [Quirky Dialogue Font Mod.](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459571) This playthrough should look a bit different from the official version.


----

### Watch on YouTube:


https://youtu.be/-A_h4Rh2rRQ


**Playlist:**

```
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt3R7_tP1xaH9mASCoJsRIYN96RihTAtI
```

### Truthful Route - 28:  Sovereign of West, Zhuqiaomon

What I love about this part the most is how different all the sovereign beasts and their partners are... They all witnessed the same events of them failing to stop the master, but while some of them resigned to their fate, others like Zhuqiaomon resents the humans for what they did... His story is parallel to Garurumon's in a way...

Now we have the power of all four sovereings, only the master, Haruchika, is left to fight!

links.body: @luchyl, “You no dey Naija?” basically means “Are you not in Nigeria?” or more loosely, “You sure say you sabi how things dey here?” In that thread, paired with “Watin you talk, I no sabi that one o,” the vibe is mild disbelief: “What you’re saying doesn’t sound familiar to me, so are you even in Naija?” That usage fits common Nigerian Pidgin patterns like **“I no sabi” = “I don’t understand / I don’t know”** and **“Naija” = Nigeria**, as explained by the [British Council](https://www.britishcouncil.org/voices-magazine/nigerian-pidgin-words-phrases). The InLeo search didn’t surface a direct thread on that exact phrase, but the slang itself is standard Nigerian Pidgin rather than some secret code from [InLeo posts](https://inleo.io/).

links.title: MY \
WENT FROM CHILL TO CHAOTIC IN 30 MINUTES
links.body:
Hello Weekend Experiences fam,💘💕😊👋

I planned to have a slow, productive Sunday. 
What I got was a full-on “adulting” comedy show.

It started simple. I was going to deep clean, do laundry, and meal prep for the week. 
Famous last words 😅


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZAS7devva1HXkkCsttZd5mzgUKnSpFrA1UbuaRPgcNLL/1779562898201.png)



Step 1: The Bathroom “Music Show”
I decided to scrub the bathroom first. Somehow, scrubbing tile turns into singing at full volume. 
The acoustics are unmatched. If my neighbors didn’t hear me, they’re lying.




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNb4eZDUqs6fqkaSSVXHnXMwnuyWogJVNVmmn8dWB8JXe/1779562940406.png)



Step 2: Kitchen War Zone
After the bathroom, I moved to the sink. The dishes were… a situation. 
Soap everywhere, scrubber doing overtime. I swear the sink judges me every time.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXtayKGUzVHnPda1B3i6D2sXAVUQFVcRxvPMvh1zvbH4P/1779563045459.png)




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbiVeRATpxUkiJ7xcyMdJ1dy8UHhkA2UxWXjeoKsYqAR3/1779563066830.png)



Step 3: Self-Care That Actually Happened
Between the chaos, I remembered I need to be a human too. 
Fresh toothbrush, Nivea lotion, and deodorant because cleaning is sweaty work.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYcADCMd9ALGuzfcSAZXD5XjaMWQSnVrnu3dqv4vyB3PX/1779563093823.png)





Step 4: Meal Prep Reality Check
I tried to blend pepper and onions for stew. The blender fought back. 
Now I’ve got pepper in my eyes and onions in my soul. 
But at least the sauce is ready for the week.





![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfCac1MjkBKS4iLpmv1Pv6datESvxBo98rSFd4ReGkLmi/1779563574808.png)





Step 5: The Reward – Spaghetti That Saved My Weekend

After all that cleaning, scrubbing, and fighting with the blender, I was starving. 
This was my “you deserve this” meal.

Simple spaghetti, spicy pepper sauce, and a bit of fish. Nothing fancy, but after a chaotic Saturday, 
it tasted like a 5-star restaurant meal. 

Sometimes the best part of a “weekend reset” isn’t the cleaning… 
it’s sitting down to enjoy the food you made with your own two hands.



Weekend done right ✅ Mess cleaned, sauce made, belly full. 



What’s the most chaotic thing you’ve done on a weekend that was supposed to be “relaxing”? 
Drop your story below - I need to feel less alone 😂

links.title: A massive power outage has hit almost the entire island of Sumatra since Friday (May 22, 2026) at 6:44 PM WIB. As of Saturday evening, several areas were still reportedly experiencing power disruptions and had not yet returned to normal.
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQFwm55cs2Wkx4ize4s9yna1Dwf9gsTNrhvjE71aZaVZ5/Pemadaman%20listrik%20massal%20melanda%20hampir%20seluruh%20wilayah%20Pulau%20Sumatera%20sejak%20Jumat%2022-5-2026%20.webp 



PLN explained that the blackout occurred due to extreme weather that disrupted the 275 kV Muara Bungo–Sungai Rumbai transmission network in Jambi. The impact spread to various regions such as Aceh, North Sumatra, West Sumatra, Riau, Jambi, and parts of South Sumatra. This condition disrupted residents' activities because the supply of electricity and clean water was also interrupted, plus the hot weather made it difficult for many people to rest without fans or air conditioning. 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfPgzbA6Pkp8cDY2EkknymBj3KakVrGCghmgPV6LhEzne/HJA1TAvasAAEgOA.jpeg 


In response to public complaints, PLN apologized and stated that the restoration process was ongoing. As of Saturday (May 23, 2026) at 10:00 AM WIB, approximately 8.3 million of the total 13.1 million affected customers were reported to have regained power. However, several areas that had previously had power were reported to experience blackouts again on Saturday evening, allegedly due to the rotating blackout system. Residents also hope that the electricity supply will be fully restored soon.

links.title: Entry to the Round 272 Reflection Hunters Contest - Reflections in the Mud / Reflejos en el Lodo
links.body: > Believe it or not, my community is just a few meters from downtown, yet its streets are still unpaved. As a result, they bear the marks of a harsh natural environment that is untamed. They are constantly overgrown with weeds, and their surface is uneven; but when it rains, the water shows no mercy, as pits and puddles form randomly, with varying depths, turning travel through this space into a true adventure.

> Aunque parezca increíble, mi comunidad se encuentra a pocos metros del centro de la ciudad, pero aun así sus calles siguen siendo de tierra. Por lo tanto, están marcadas por las inclemencias de un entorno natural que es indomable. Constantemente se llenan de maleza, su superficie es irregular, pero cuando llueve el agua no da tregua, puesto que se forman pozos y charcos de manera aleatoria, con profundidades diversas, lo cual hace que transitar por este espacio se convierta en un verdadero juego de aventuras.
![1-IMG_20260429_172040_HDR (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23tviXEGkg3whemqLBogbmkpbc47etLw5gNCoSVFg5mkVByq8ug6KKcGHkzVJdiZ6oHYp.jpg) ![1-IMG_20260429_172040_HDR (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eo8Ts1ALTGSr9VUQRUeB9SFqZXT5LPZUPh48dWyGENQEKY3LMSBzsbYwDvaBmGJNVxU.jpg)

> But at the same time, the water, the puddles, and the daylight give us a golden opportunity to capture those reflections that are part of this natural environment, since the liquid surface, when still, becomes a true makeshift mirror, which projects directly toward the sky; yet at the same time, on some occasions we manage to discover other elements, such as walls, cables, and poles.

> Pero al mismo tiempo el agua, los charcos y la luz del día nos regalan la oportunidad de oro para capturar esos reflejos que forman parte de este ambiente natural, puesto que la superficie líquida, al mantenerse sin móvil, se convierte en un verdadero espejo improvisado, el cual proyecta directamente hacia el cielo; pero al mismo tiempo, en algunas ocasiones logramos descubrir otros elementos, como paredes, cables y postes.
![IMG_20260429_171951_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/Eo8TGwZg6fA7KiLkt82nVPpihuKXgjMtMFTPd1h8GH63ZWbgWKdXGqzseF6kHSnoJpz.jpg) ![IMG_20260429_172035_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoEr1kb5XLmk9aZyjEgLQedKUKfdARCYrKx2g7kFbyFv9gWmYvgFTbFgqtGoaoagXcL.jpg)

> This is a land with an incredible level of absorption; for this reason, the reflections formed in the makeshift pools don’t usually last very long. Therefore, hunting for reflections under these conditions becomes a race against the clock, since in the blink of an eye the ground is close again, the water disappears, and the dust rises.

> Esta es una tierra que cuenta con un nivel de absorción increíble; por esta razón, los reflejos formados en los pozos improvisados no suelen durar mucho tiempo. Por lo tanto, cazar reflejos bajo estas condiciones se convierte en una actividad contra el reloj, ya que en un abrir y cerrar de ojos la tierra vuelve a estar cerca, el agua desaparece y el polvo se levanta.
![IMG_20260429_171902_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoK6GutzYqieyGyBeRcscaagQwj8rohLmWuEWb5qeMjL4kJ7nfVNcKvzuxVcVfDA4Fw.jpg) ![IMG_20260429_171907_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/EoK7GSuARWwZiMndT3rFBq9sDDctnVvmHBCqBhyHGEuFqsf6tLBfpRqtV7FZ3W7LY5e.jpg) ![FUkUE5bzkAZT3HzV5tJDiU2ik81PCd4JCyhWnRcDN8XJsVFY3UNB8DCg43AbXDuHD2o1pSFmw9t6dCJZXRjDbN9aPZzKb2txM6rGEuPnKkx8GfXnLduM6tAzK3DNLBdCNF2RY6M647qH2B1qbjaJ97h6csSDeEmwq9rE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yorgar/23wgaEdSXsbReeZGB99u1dBBzwFduZr1FZWS3kfueTbv4JABv7TcSLkfsJydhwzuHZvm8.jpg)
