> ### English Hello, friends of the Black and White community! Weekend at last. I just finished my last class of the week, which ran from 7 AM to 9 AM. It’s an enjoyable class because it’s a social media workshop for photographers, and I am learning a lotespecially about how to market myself, sell my work better, and find my target audience by creating buyer personas and developing a strong photographic identity. That’s how the beginning of my day looked. It started very early, at 5 AM, and right now the sleepiness is starting to kick in. Today is a rest day, because tomorrow, Sunday, it's time to hit the gym again and go out to shoot. Today's gallery is a series featuring a lot of framing, full of love, good vibes, and careful composition. I'm always looking to capture the very best in my photographs for you, which is what matters most. I hope it is to your liking, and that you can observe and feel the exact same thing I felt when taking each photograph. I wish you a beautiful weekend, and may your homes be filled with joy. I look forward to writing to you again soon! ### Español ¡Hola, amigos de la comunidad en Blanco y Negro! Fin de semana al fin. Recién terminó mi última clase de la semana, que tenía de 7 a 9 de la mañana. Es una clase bastante agradable porque funciona como un taller de redes sociales para fotógrafos y estoy aprendiendo muchísimo para poder marketearme, vender mejor mi trabajo y buscar mi público objetivo, construyendo el *buyer persona* y definiendo mi identidad fotográfica. Bueno, eso ha sido un poco el comienzo de mi día. Comenzó muy temprano, a las 5 de la mañana, y ahorita ya como que está pegando el sueño. Hoy es un día de descanso, porque mañana domingo hay que volver a entrenar al gimnasio y salir a fotear con todo. La serie de hoy es una muestra de mucho *framing* (encuadre), que viene con mucho amor, mucha vibra y bastante composición, siempre buscando tener lo mejor de mis fotografías para ustedes, que es lo que más importa. Espero que sea de su agrado, como siempre, y que puedan observar y sentir lo mismo que yo sentí al tomar cada fotografía. Les deseo un hermoso fin de semana y que todo sea alegría en sus hogares. ¡Ya tengo ganas de escribirles de nuevo pronto! > **¡Kachkaniraqmi!** — *(Quechua: Until we meet again)* ![linea separadora hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cabzphoto/23u5LMZycR2ks1nWRqsVWJkcVyTpYcmV9JKkGrKrTj1mTsSwXWn33PjZ99nQYGWJQaLRV.png)

title.title: At The Restaurant Mala Flor -  Bogota, Colombia.
title.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![3laBRChaohY52PH2_4940903306599533703.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/marialeovalless/images/3laBRChaohY52PH2_4940903306599533703/3laBRChaohY52PH2_4940903306599533703.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

A little night out at Mala Flor restaurant in Bogotá, Colombia.

I went to a really cute restaurant. I love unique experiences, and of course, going to this restaurant was a total experience. From the moment you walk in, the interior is beautiful. Basically, the whole place has a rustic vibe with large stones used as decor, which gives it that look. Although it was rustic, it also had a delicate side—the wood of the tables added a subtle and elegant touch.

---

<div class=\

> --- From the moment I arrived, I got the impression that it was going to be a lovely experience, and I felt comfortable in the space—it also felt cozy, because it was quite cold outside, so you could say it’s warm both to the eye and to the touch. On the menu, I found a good variety of food that blends a bit of Mexican and Japanese cuisine, which makes the place quite interesting. I noticed many great options on the menu, among which was what I really wanted to eat: pork ribs slow-cooked for 12 hours and glazed in teriyaki sauce, served with mashed potatoes and Thai salad. Honestly, for something that took 12 hours to cook, they were incredibly tender and absolutely delicious—they practically melted in my mouth. Oh my gosh, I don’t even know how to describe how delicious it was, haha, I loved it. ---

> --- On the other hand, the price was pretty high—I couldn’t afford to do this very often right now, because it’s a restaurant that’s, let’s say, a bit pricey for my current budget, haha—but it’s totally worth the cost. I loved it. The thing is, I’m a bit of a food adventurer, and a place has to be really, really good for me to go back; I usually like to try a different place every time. ---

>


---

Salidita social, restaurante Mala Flor, Bogota, Colombia.

Fui a un restaurante demasiado lindo, me encantan las experiencias diferentes y por supuesto que ir a este restaurante fue una experiencia total, desde que entras su estructura es muy bonita, básicamente todo el lugar es bastante rustico con piedras grandes como decoración, lo que hace que su aspecto se vea de esa manera, aunque era rustico tambien tenia su parte delicada que la madera de las mesas hacia que se viera la parte sutil y elegante.

---

<div class=\

> --- Desde que llegue me dio la impresión de que iba a ser una bonita experiencia y sentí comodidad en el espacio, tambien la sensación de calorcito, porque afuera el clima estaba bastante frio, así que también se puede decir es es cálido tanto ala vista como a la sensación. En el menu me encontré una buena variedad de comida que mezcla un poco de la comida mexicana y comida Japonesa, por lo que esta bastante interesante el lugar, en la carta me fije en muchas buenas opciones, entre las cuales estaba lo que realmente quise comer y fueron unas costillas de cerdo cocinadas en cocción lenta durante 12 horas bañadas en salsa teriyaki, acompañadas con pure de papa y ensalada thai, la verdad es que para llevar 12 horas de cocción están bastante blandas y demasiado deliciosas pareciera que se deshacían en la boca, dios mío no se como explicarles lo delicioso que estaba jaja me encanto. ---

> --- Por otro lado el precio si fue bastante alto, no me podría permitir hacer esto tan seguido ahora, porque si es un restaurante digamos que costoso para mi bolsillo actual jaja, pero vale totalmente lo que cuesta, me encanto, el detalle es que yo soy aventurera de la comida, y el lugar si tiene que ser extremadamente buena para yo volver, generalmente me gusta conocer siempre un lugar diferente. ---

>

title.body: China has begun developing a new technology, namely gestational robots, a type of robot designed to undergo the pregnancy process like a normal human. Later, this robot can become pregnant using an artificial womb, complete from the process of fetal development to delivery. Nutrition for the fetus will also be distributed through a special tube system.\n\nThis project is being developed by Kaiwa Technology in Guangzhou. The scientific team in this project is led by Zhang Qifeng, an alumnus of Nanyang Technological University (NTU) in Singapore. The prototype is targeted to be introduced to the public in 2026. However, on the other hand, many question the ethical side, such as the emotional relationship between mother and child, the origin of egg and sperm cells, and the psychological impact on babies born from artificial wombs.![Image](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUfDuCtegT3duuhWKrnSXVuBHQRndPDP1F57J71fvaPb2/c6151918_336c_4efc_96d9_acc03a73f014.png)

Two days ago I decided to quit sugar from my diet and started taking healthy diet. The reason behind this change is my lipid profile test report. Unfortunately I gained four kg weight in last couple of months. And my cholesterol level and truglesrides have crossed bkrder line. My report was a serious concern for me. Because bad cholesterol and truglesrides were hivh and good cholesterol wad low. It was quite unexpected situation for me. I was feeling little pain in my chest at left side. I was feeling little difficulty in taking breath. O it was squite alarming situation for me. I went to DHQ hospital Mianwali and went through from different tests and examined myself thoroughly. I went through from lipid profile test, Echo test and ECG test. Alhamdolillah Ecg and echo test was nlrmal while as I said earlier lipid profile test was bit abnormal. Here I am sharing my echo report in the picture below. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWskD9X79WREFjSsRc83EGAUCknwxtPVivgGupdfewLd2/1779553459511.jpg) Now I have changed mu routine and started brisk walk in the evening while I do different exercises in the morning to remove belly fat. I am trying to be consistent in it. Now I realised where I went wrong. I did physical activities but I didn't quit sugar. That's why tge cholesterol level was high. Ad my belly fat also increased. Today I started my brisk walk from cricket ground a Pai Khel playground. Later I climbed on my favorite track that is called canal track. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVBatzgLAyWFrrBHsPHANmG7LyR9Z7aBDUJ3n6Eb32MiJ/1779553777516.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmc3DguzkBmBM83Nc4Me8dLJK5GFREWaJLiU1CX4dr3aY1/1779553777591.jpg) The clouds were wandering in the sky. title.title: [ENG - ESP] Strawberry Caramel Donuts 🍩 (Delicious Flavors)
title.body:
# Hello, hello hivers and veganlovers community 🥰💕.

![46047264-CE5E-4E74-B721-50170446C8F4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynmVZGEMDvzkPoSpnmYtHGantvrFmWJGYuJnW76Fd8XZ99aAt7UcJTXeUKJ2kvJZgnR.jpeg)

![B569017E-E2FE-4C87-99D3-BD57F6E60FEB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zm7QQgaPLNyvk2CQF3NA3iHkpAoRL2n1QtXQH1MWAEgR6ASi5Zch91Vdw9yydqqQvQZ.jpeg)

![17963B19-B4AA-4D04-9427-E29A000F2A0B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243g9fQo95zz76v5ypRoDsnCPvPYRcg3Dtev24fZhZJowD2sHbHyj1WuRpKMbXWWBcgBm.jpeg)

Hope you all are good enjoying wellness, and thank God it is another Friday almost weekend, when we take out time to enjoy something delicious.

And it has been a while I share donuts 🍩 here. A simple snacks we can prepare for tea 🍵 time breakfast, for little hunger time or even one to treat guests, making it fresh from the oven when we bake them. 

This strawberry flavored donuts are dipped into sugar syrup caramel once it came out fresh from the oven, allowing the caramel to drip and circulate with the hotness because when it comes to baked donuts 🍩, adding caramel to them can help make them more delicious and yummy 🤤.

![FC1B9E8F-4E71-4BF0-82FA-FBACB3F4C97C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23r227QP9WpsofyfwEu5wVNbwmm5jhCrjDSQ8n7Sg3wsZwrsYxTbMW7dBgUqcoPfY4Qna.jpeg)

I made this donuts earlier this morning for tea 🍵 time breakfast and will be keeping others in the oven to stay warm since the weekend has kick started and we need to relax and enjoy to energize.

Below are the detailed step by step procedure for baking this strawberry flavored donut with caramel dipping.

# INGREDIENTS: (Three servings)

![1B6B68E4-0335-4198-9F3D-BF2F2A0C541A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2jHLSQXnxYSfD7taKoe5KfG5cu8aTakP2bYKYNyWeywDXnqhEX4VZtJdS4qaHna67U.jpeg)

![2A4C67C7-B5DF-4EF1-91A4-3CDF53B65521.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xyVGcYR6Quw7iuyDmRk7xXjC16UEkGCraZKtqkiTnpo7qA5d3ioYbUeHYagFSJxjFV7.jpeg)

250 g of all purpose flour 
2 teaspoon of strawberry extract 
1 sachet of non dairy creamer milk
4 tablespoons of premium sugar 
1:4 teaspoon of salt 
12/2 teaspoon of dry yeast 
1/2 cup of warm water 💦 
5 ml cap of vegetable oil 

# STEPS  FOR PREPARATION:

Step 1.

![8AA6766A-BED4-4656-A282-9EB0D18D1AB4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2432YadPXYDs121iBZqur6jEcEBd8jZ2ZwYWNjNmni6n6ro4HJZt5hF1cQbWMicULrxMe.jpeg)

![4CE74DC0-D89A-4A61-8552-CC66FF0E5E5E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL36G73gZue4jVstrGqiY2qw1K1tDzCoaaf1g4p1UTAKrxjh23BqCAwSkGXhdep.jpeg)

We start the recipe by taking the flour into the bowl 🥣 above .

![6AF82DA3-BC07-499F-B266-3B3E3ADF886D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK56nZxWEUi2pJqiGLJUxNn1XFKKnZdLeLDuXvjHLtQd68fVAWsmBjjQqXexZD2.jpeg)

We add the dry ingredients. The salt, sugar and the yeast. As above.

Step 2.

![4C58024D-D37F-415A-A0B1-07FD77BB903D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK9QUAsbLdVnpXc8k4CxbCc9vgyjHP4ZL8aXdm3fgFxBJvkBvbUHc5Lj3ujeBRe.jpeg)

We stir to incorporate the dry ingredients, adding the non dairy creamer milk.

![36C14AD1-251D-46D0-BCC6-FD3E0461F20B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMaXAet8p8ePw41Wd3LhVsji17YpDD97aHZCKkrUAWS7cctifh6aG9WzjqVHTGaN7Uy.jpeg)

Stir and also incorporate.

Step 3.

![5C3CF27C-C110-4E59-A9BA-03E5D7F17E74.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJmswaK2yJfmzfHvsjANPjG7VTiBeyMMjpbEXi3Wnw3ohDGu9mFiY1toGwZsLKi.jpeg)

We add our strawberry 🍓 extract for delicious aroma and flavor.  And incorporate 

Step 4.

![E3DAB2F0-C028-4A4C-958B-360B62EDD95C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJj1WCMmdvCHkXHcAiF4tKPadHZRLihmM8xqrm6MFG1eKDT1UpS5CuJqdyKhkHi.jpeg)

To prepare and obtain our dough, we add the warm water gradually here above 

![C23AA2EA-6137-4898-BFA7-E2EBCDB46D16.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK56TBvB8ak7cREUNSavneRtLZyejgBXWQxg7GCaqD2LgFQg4N4w1TeEuzuA5Jt.jpeg)

![8A55FEED-40B4-47BA-BF09-B3D5FC2520EA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x176egtAmuaaB8nUXaufv9AswMUEUgUpS2ufMn4L8yL58pd5b4xD3DcbQpyXwZxZ3d3.jpeg)

![98EE0602-A523-4B74-8B9E-588F0DCFF319.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243qY7gjAG9nQdqGPZx7h2k4r4ZHpUnWZiAmpbZSNHq4KG5XmX3ski1mFLjWDaGwWo4Sc.jpeg)

Add our vegetable oil to help knead into a fine dough .

Step 5.

![ED215E68-7817-4E62-A904-E53125CF5B5B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJj2VMjEJL1gdmwsT24viZhP1qrit5D3wqCeQbjqZE9iaXX3noWuoiwyv1rVCTK.jpeg)

Next, we cut the dough into two equal part and one part into three  to start molding the donut 🍩.

![31B8A5F7-3427-4F4F-A874-CC970E31A9E4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xek3o3AhY8W4o6bCH2DMtDRraKetoab4SGBJGbA1sRZ55DGXH1AF9gWg4kM2T4beCbp.jpeg)

And here have the donut 🍩 shape with a hole made at the middle.

Step 6.

![293395BC-0DDA-4A92-8DE1-6949F0697C67.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wqnVrqEuq7LJAsDrCFjsnru4qqumd8Tcs4ZMZiWnRrjewdiNGwz5KNfgaYTBcN3UGkg.jpeg)

![FF718607-17C1-4096-9543-493DF93EEADD.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMckrWFa3gZRoWUPQhK4m9bs5DLezbdffFhuHUWQ17diNHQaacC4yaFkx1D8k5zHc8J.jpeg)

We place the donuts in a floured baking pan, Allow to double 

![3799E64F-C693-4722-ABF3-BC7D215C3C6C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zGgScdLS4EEc83664K9tPwFRBo93mW69BGE2qz4aioYoFCxaaePKB5U1qBNUTJniMyC.jpeg)

Then we take it into the preheated oven and bake for 15 - 20 minutes . 

![20ABFDAB-F72B-46D2-B4EE-F990A495482C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242DQXTLsj9yCSiiZxoFXMXvUhNNePgMhCXAVvrKmf5emzKM1iz8pZZyCAjWXKtMYiEWx.jpeg)

Here above.

Step 7.

![B632B94D-E821-4765-84F8-91E7D5750775.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK56BfXLjwyYhnJ8DJyRakyP2pS4vu8iBZQtRTGbFzr4fbq34LehAUzQQWpB7a4.jpeg)

We add two teaspoon of sugar in a plate to caramelize in the microwave.

![72ED8F77-0C1D-4FFE-BDF2-BD73A9ED97F2.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynWTXkjM7ns7Jf63Npuifrp23uqAm7UDtFmH5ArC7zjsh7JUdQEoQJXkFFoa8X9mzcK.jpeg)

As here above.

Step 8.

![63A71482-FDC7-45DD-83B2-2FA213C95895.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xAXxjLBwBhdZhwMVLBYLCPFxCH5SoT5rSmGzp9XA1gPWdafcEvjriDshLJQ1DMhgF63.jpeg)

![0A921F37-9BD9-4B79-BF10-92F135A1A03C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMcP4xgwgv83pCRKg8QeuoAergiMUQqv4vQmp99NEHdAjHrJw3iwMrvj5uuUhHUWzRA.jpeg)

Once it’s ready, we dip the donuts 🍩 into the caramel here above.

![96385BA8-3F2A-4046-BD89-44A55D6DCD4E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242YBk1Bta83w8PS3m2bBeyETeGR5dYrs3FvJGaAUazVqUyEfp6QQu5ZweAqR689W2dTy.jpeg)

And its all ready and delicious 😋.

![837124FC-1F2F-4C72-84F7-7646CB07A5F1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zm7QQgaPLNyvk2CQF3NA3iHkpAoRL2n1QtXQH1MWAEgR6ASi5Zch91Vdw9yydqqQvQZ.jpeg)

This strawberry caramel dip glazed donuts 🍩 makes the best breakfast. Full of delicious flavors  that you will love ❤️ to always make it. 

![A5C9E0F8-A7D7-4BA1-92E3-053CA8D95CA7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242sAMiX6iHTUiqoZzfWaqRUugpaVZf9ZtcYJaVwRzPL6DYFdzuQmDkaDBYNExMeWTNWn.jpeg)

Simple, quick and straightforward recipe without too many ingredients, making it one inexpensive breakfast recipe you can fall back to at anytime.

## Hope you enjoyed coming with me friends. Sending hugs 🤗 to you all 🥰

## Best Regards @sunshine29 🧡

Images are mine 

![644B12AF-77DE-49B6-B6A0-BA7549DB5EFA.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wrCDE2h44bLTEYSEBGxB6ZehD3N2pQsNLmW9rQUmRRK84pKoeCsTcUMgKE4vVnsSq4X.gif)



### Espanol Version

## Hola, hola, amantes del invierno y del veganismo 🥰💕.

![46047264-CE5E-4E74-B721-50170446C8F4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23ynmVZGEMDvzkPoSpnmYtHGantvrFmWJGYuJnW76Fd8XZ99aAt7UcJTXeUKJ2kvJZgnR.jpeg)

![B569017E-E2FE-4C87-99D3-BD57F6E60FEB.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zm7QQgaPLNyvk2CQF3NA3iHkpAoRL2n1QtXQH1MWAEgR6ASi5Zch91Vdw9yydqqQvQZ.jpeg)

![17963B19-B4AA-4D04-9427-E29A000F2A0B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243g9fQo95zz76v5ypRoDsnCPvPYRcg3Dtev24fZhZJowD2sHbHyj1WuRpKMbXWWBcgBm.jpeg)

Espero que estéis bien y disfrutando de vuestro bienestar, y menos mal que ya es viernes, casi fin de semana, cuando nos tomamos un rato para disfrutar de algo delicioso.

Y hacía tiempo que no compartía donuts 🍩 por aquí. Un tentempié sencillo que podemos preparar para la merienda 🍵, el desayuno, para picar algo o incluso para agasajar a los invitados, recién salidos del horno cuando los horneamos. 

Estas donas con sabor a fresa se bañan en sirope de azúcar caramelizado nada más sacarlas del horno, dejando que el caramelo gotee y se funda con el calor, porque cuando se trata de donas horneadas 🍩, añadirles caramelo ayuda a que queden aún más deliciosas y apetecibles 🤤.

![FC1B9E8F-4E71-4BF0-82FA-FBACB3F4C97C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23r227QP9WpsofyfwEu5wVNbwmm5jhCrjDSQ8n7Sg3wsZwrsYxTbMW7dBgUqcoPfY4Qna.jpeg)

Esta mañana temprano he preparado estas rosquillas para el desayuno y la hora del té 🍵, y voy a dejar otras en el horno para que se mantengan calientes, ya que el fin de semana acaba de empezar y necesitamos relajarnos y disfrutar para recargar energías.

A continuación, te explico paso a paso cómo preparar estas rosquillas con sabor a fresa y salsa de caramelo.

# INGREDIENTES: (Tres raciones)

![1B6B68E4-0335-4198-9F3D-BF2F2A0C541A.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23w2jHLSQXnxYSfD7taKoe5KfG5cu8aTakP2bYKYNyWeywDXnqhEX4VZtJdS4qaHna67U.jpeg)

![2A4C67C7-B5DF-4EF1-91A4-3CDF53B65521.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xyVGcYR6Quw7iuyDmRk7xXjC16UEkGCraZKtqkiTnpo7qA5d3ioYbUeHYagFSJxjFV7.jpeg)

250 g de harina para todo uso 
2 cucharaditas de extracto de fresa 
1 sobre de crema vegetal
4 cucharadas soperas de azúcar extra 
1/4 de cucharadita de sal 
12/2 cucharaditas de levadura seca 
1/2 taza de agua tibia 💦 
5 ml de aceite vegetal 

# PASOS PARA LA PREPARACIÓN:

Paso 1.

![8AA6766A-BED4-4656-A282-9EB0D18D1AB4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/2432YadPXYDs121iBZqur6jEcEBd8jZ2ZwYWNjNmni6n6ro4HJZt5hF1cQbWMicULrxMe.jpeg)

![4CE74DC0-D89A-4A61-8552-CC66FF0E5E5E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AL36G73gZue4jVstrGqiY2qw1K1tDzCoaaf1g4p1UTAKrxjh23BqCAwSkGXhdep.jpeg)

Empezamos la receta echando la harina en el bol 🥣 de arriba.

![6AF82DA3-BC07-499F-B266-3B3E3ADF886D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK56nZxWEUi2pJqiGLJUxNn1XFKKnZdLeLDuXvjHLtQd68fVAWsmBjjQqXexZD2.jpeg)

Añadimos los ingredientes secos: la sal, el azúcar y la levadura. Como se ha indicado anteriormente.

Paso 2.

![4C58024D-D37F-415A-A0B1-07FD77BB903D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK9QUAsbLdVnpXc8k4CxbCc9vgyjHP4ZL8aXdm3fgFxBJvkBvbUHc5Lj3ujeBRe.jpeg)

Removemos para mezclar los ingredientes secos y añadimos la leche vegetal.

![36C14AD1-251D-46D0-BCC6-FD3E0461F20B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMaXAet8p8ePw41Wd3LhVsji17YpDD97aHZCKkrUAWS7cctifh6aG9WzjqVHTGaN7Uy.jpeg)

Remueve y mezcla bien.

Paso 3.

![5C3CF27C-C110-4E59-A9BA-03E5D7F17E74.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJmswaK2yJfmzfHvsjANPjG7VTiBeyMMjpbEXi3Wnw3ohDGu9mFiY1toGwZsLKi.jpeg)

Añadimos nuestro extracto de fresa 🍓 para darle un aroma y un sabor deliciosos.  Y lo incorporamos 

Paso 4.

![E3DAB2F0-C028-4A4C-958B-360B62EDD95C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJj1WCMmdvCHkXHcAiF4tKPadHZRLihmM8xqrm6MFG1eKDT1UpS5CuJqdyKhkHi.jpeg)

Para preparar y obtener nuestra masa, añadimos el agua tibia poco a poco aquí arriba 

![C23AA2EA-6137-4898-BFA7-E2EBCDB46D16.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AK56TBvB8ak7cREUNSavneRtLZyejgBXWQxg7GCaqD2LgFQg4N4w1TeEuzuA5Jt.jpeg)

![8A55FEED-40B4-47BA-BF09-B3D5FC2520EA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23x176egtAmuaaB8nUXaufv9AswMUEUgUpS2ufMn4L8yL58pd5b4xD3DcbQpyXwZxZ3d3.jpeg)

![98EE0602-A523-4B74-8B9E-588F0DCFF319.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/243qY7gjAG9nQdqGPZx7h2k4r4ZHpUnWZiAmpbZSNHq4KG5XmX3ski1mFLjWDaGwWo4Sc.jpeg)

Añade nuestro aceite vegetal para ayudar a amasar hasta obtener una masa fina.

Paso 5.

![ED215E68-7817-4E62-A904-E53125CF5B5B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/AJj2VMjEJL1gdmwsT24viZhP1qrit5D3wqCeQbjqZE9iaXX3noWuoiwyv1rVCTK.jpeg)

A continuación, cortamos la masa en dos partes iguales y una de ellas en tres, para empezar a dar forma al donut 🍩.

![31B8A5F7-3427-4F4F-A874-CC970E31A9E4.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23xek3o3AhY8W4o6bCH2DMtDRraKetoab4SGBJGbA1sRZ55DGXH1AF9gWg4kM2T4beCbp.jpeg)

Y aquí tenemos la forma de rosquilla 🍩 con un agujero en el centro.

Paso 6.

![293395BC-0DDA-4A92-8DE1-6949F0697C67.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wqnVrqEuq7LJAsDrCFjsnru4qqumd8Tcs4ZMZiWnRrjewdiNGwz5KNfgaYTBcN3UGkg.jpeg)

![0A921F37-9BD9-4B79-BF10-92F135A1A03C.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23wMcP4xgwgv83pCRKg8QeuoAergiMUQqv4vQmp99NEHdAjHrJw3iwMrvj5uuUhHUWzRA.jpeg)

Cuando esté listo, mojamos los donuts 🍩 en el caramelo de aquí arriba.

![96385BA8-3F2A-4046-BD89-44A55D6DCD4E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242YBk1Bta83w8PS3m2bBeyETeGR5dYrs3FvJGaAUazVqUyEfp6QQu5ZweAqR689W2dTy.jpeg)

![837124FC-1F2F-4C72-84F7-7646CB07A5F1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/23zm7QQgaPLNyvk2CQF3NA3iHkpAoRL2n1QtXQH1MWAEgR6ASi5Zch91Vdw9yydqqQvQZ.jpeg)

Estas rosquillas glaseadas con salsa de caramelo y fresa 🍩 son el desayuno perfecto. Están llenas de sabores deliciosos que te encantarán ❤️ y que querrás preparar siempre. 

![A5C9E0F8-A7D7-4BA1-92E3-053CA8D95CA7.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sunshine29/242sAMiX6iHTUiqoZzfWaqRUugpaVZf9ZtcYJaVwRzPL6DYFdzuQmDkaDBYNExMeWTNWn.jpeg)

Una receta sencilla, rápida y fácil de preparar, sin demasiados ingredientes, lo que la convierte en una opción económica para el desayuno a la que puedes recurrir en cualquier momento.

Caracas vibró alto hoy y cruzar la meta en el emblemático Paseo Los Próceres con un tiempo oficial de **50:04** es una recompensa enorme a tanta constancia. 💪🏽🔥 Correr estos 10 kilómetros bajo la mirada de los monumentos y rodeada de una energía tan increíble fue mágico. ✨

title.title: Three Parts, One Purpose: Qurbani for Humanity and Allah’s Pleasure
title.body: > Eid al-Adha is near and Muslims are buying halal animals for sacrifice. I also went to the livestock fair on Sunday and Friday. When I arrived at the livestock fair, there were thousands of goats, sheep, and goats there. I also wanted to buy an animal for sacrifice, but when I asked the prices to buy the sacrificial animals, the prices were very high and each animal was being sold for millions of rupees, but I did not have enough space. I returned from the Sunday market without buying any animal, but there were all kinds of animals in the cattle market. There were animals of all weights. There were beautiful animals and any animal that Muslims like. Eid al-Adha, which we also call the Eid of Sacrifice and we also call it the Big Eid, every Muslim remembers the Sunnah of Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) on this Eid because this Eid is followed in the Sunnah of Hazrat Ibrahim (AS) and halal animals are sacrificed in the way of Allah and then the meat of the animals is distributed to the poor, relatives, and the person who is sacrificing keeps it for himself. In this way, after sacrificing the animal, the meat of the animal was divided into three parts. On this Eid, when Muslims sacrifice and distribute the meat, then the meat that comes to the sacrificer's share, he cooks different dishes from this meat and then feeds it to his friends and relatives. Similarly, Eid lasts for three days and friends visit each other's houses and meet and also congratulate them on the Eid of Sacrifice. This day of Eid also encourages us to show love, sincerity, brotherhood and help each other. Sacrificing animals is not just for this purpose, but the purpose is only to remember the sacrifice that Allah's Prophet Hazrat Ibrahim (peace be upon him) made on the command of Allah and to follow this Sunnah. And whoever makes all these sacrifices, Muslims do it only for the pleasure of Allah. Some buy a big animal, some buy a small animal, but the purpose of buying it is only to sacrifice it for the pleasure of Allah. And thus, if any person, rich or poor, sacrifices to show people, his sacrifice will never be accepted. Showing off is never accepted. Even if you do whatever you do, Do it with pure intention, honestly, sincerely and only for the pleasure of Allah. Just as we say that if you are helping a poor person, you will help the poor person for the pleasure of Allah and not to show people. If you do any good deed to show people, if you do it with pride and arrogance in front of you, it will never be accepted from you. Always sacrifice with humility and modesty and this is the philosophy of this sacrifice. ![IMG_20260510_091451.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmexJSzqrhV2CBdnDSDsXdmbHDWc7irprrbQeo6MrNzPj3/IMG_20260510_091451.jpg) You are also seeing beautiful animals in these pictures. How beautiful are sheep and goats? They look very cute. People raise them with great love. Some even keep them in their homes for the whole year. So, when Eid al-Adha, the Eid of Sacrifice, comes, they will sell these animals and make some profit. Similarly, whenever a person goes to the livestock market, there are also traders there. We call traders those people who buy animals, raise them for the whole year and then bring the livestock to the market so that people can buy them and make a profit. But one thing I am writing here with great regret is that inflation has increased a lot in our country, Pakistan, and the poor and middle class people no longer have the power and income to buy animals for sacrifice because the prices of animals were in millions of rupees, and in our country, the average income of a poor person is It is from 200 to 300 dollars. I am talking about the income of those who are rich, but the income of most of the working class is around 150 dollars, which is very low, and they sacrifice in this income. title.body: ![Engin_Akyurt is the author of this picture/Source: Pixabay](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/02/05/11/04/woman-4820864_1280.jpg) I don't wish to turn my PeakD channel into another red-pill hangout, because I know that women have their fair share of problems; but I've come across a group of videos that talk about how average-looking men and especially homely-looking men get ostracized, discriminated against, and marginalized in American society in every way, shape, and form. These arguments are not completely without merit, but, at the same time, I find this topic to be more complicated than anyone can possibly imagine. While it may be true that ugly people have to work much harder than attractive people to acquire their milestones in life, I have also found that ugly people can gain large levels of power if they have people that give them those same advantages. These ugly people can also become extremely malicious in their demeanor when they do achieve such stature within their peer circles. I don't want to seem shallow, because I know that I have my set of flaws myself. However, I will not set aside any bad experiences I have had throughout my life with ugly people who have become inebriated with power after a group of elites have given them that degree of status. The fact of the matter is that, yes, it is easier for an attractive person to convince others to open doors for them in life that would not normally be accessible to the average or less-than-average individual in the looks department. At the same time, when an ugly person manages to slip through those same doors that are normally off limits to their kind, they can be really hateful and destructive in the way they treat others that are less fortunate than them. ## 1.  The Hate And Hostility Against Both Average-Looking And Ugly People A YouTuber that goes by the user name of Losermaxxing believes that society loves it when ugly men struggle. I don't know if I can completely agree with him on this point, but here is his video below anyway. YouTuber Losermaxxing Accuses Society Of Engaging In Epicaricacy Against Ugly Men https://youtu.be/1Lp3mDnKjEc?si=pv66nDXjGSS8NTo3 Now, if YouTuber Losermaxxing is exclusively describing what ugly men and average-looking men go through, then perhaps I can see some wisdom to his claims. However, if he is also talking about ugly and average-looking girls and women despite that the title of his video indicates that he is focusing on men, then I have to beg to differ with him. When I was in middle school, I knew this one girl named Renee. She was somewhat homely; but when I first met her, she was friendly with me and we became friends. However, by the time that I was in the tenth grade, she became very crass and even contemptuous with me. I made the mistake of believing that I could somehow win her friendship back, and sometimes it seemed as though she was coming around; but ultimately she made it clear to me that she looked down upon me. Renee would say defamatory and mendacious things about me to her friends. This reprehensible demeanor of hers went on all the way through my last year of high school. I haven't seen her since the day I graduated from high school. I don't attend my high-school reunions. I really don't care if I ever see her again. I wouldn't really know what to say to her at this point in time other than that I recall her as being stuck-up and callous in the way she behaved toward me. When she was a teenager in her last three years of high school, Renee thought of herself as someone high and holy. She would get me so angry sometimes that I would draw pictures of her, making her look like a tadpole inasmuch as she did look like a tadpole. How she ever found a husband is beyond my comprehension. She once called me the school disgrace, when she was never anything to look at or anyone deserving of praise or admiration. Betrayal was her middle name. I may not have been trendy in my appearance back when I was 15 years old, but I knew that I drew more attention from the opposite sex than Renee ever did back then. Throughout high school, I never knew even one boy that was interested in her. Perhaps she was bitter because of it, and she decided to single me out as her psychological punching bag. It only goes to show you how insecure she was with herself. Renee lived in my community when I was a teenager. I had always suspected that her parents were from humble beginnings and had worked hard to build themselves up financially so that they could give Renee and her siblings better lives than they had. There is nothing wrong with that. However, in the process, I believe that they probably spoiled Renee rotten insofar as she had to look for a fall guy for her lack of humanity. I should never have really cared what Renee thought about me, because she was never going to be friends with me again. She had become sour grapes by the time she and I were both sophomores in high school. I don't do high-school reunions, so I probably will never see her again; but she makes a good example of what I'm trying to explain herein. Another YouTuber who goes by the user name of AxionPortal posted a video on his channel about lonely men never having any love. His major complaint is about never having been in the arms of a girl or a woman throughout his life and how friends and family members of him hound him about his relationship status and his non-existent wedding plans. He should tell them to mind their own business. Here is his video below. YouTuber AxionPortal Complains That The Only Thing He Is Getting In Life Is OLDER https://youtu.be/S_Qt6IEuICY?si=AIgRNLhhKDe1tGDO Hmmmm. Why is it that all of these men on YouTube who complain about loneliness and getting dealt a bad deck of genetic cards are always into gaming well into their thirties? You have to wonder if those video games are sucking up a load of their time that they could be using to go out and socialize with others. Anyhow, I think that YouTuber AxionPortal has this romantic delusion that a girlfriend or wife would solve all of his problems in life. One has to take into consideration that there are many married men who are miserable because of their wives. The United States doesn't have very much to offer by way of marriage and family. It doesn't take a rocket scientist to see that the younger generations are boycotting romance, marriage, and procreation, especially Generation Z. Therefore, YouTuber AxionPortal is blaming himself for a problem that is way above his head. ## 2.  Arguments Against The Ugly-Duckling Trap Nevertheless, there is another YouTuber that goes by the user name of Dapper Dev, and he appears to disagree with both YouTuber Losermaxxing and YouTuber AxionPortal on their respective schools of thought regarding ugly men. Here is his video below. YouTuber Dapper Dev Questions Why So Many Attractive Women Are With Ugly Men https://youtu.be/U8LILOZA-JY?si=3y41_jJJb-JTG_V7 I wholeheartedly have to agree with YouTuber Dapper Dev out of all three male YouTubers above. Frequently I have seen girls and women with boyfriends that remind me of the lyrics of the song below in terms of these dudes' looks. The Song Titled \

By Joe Jackson https://youtu.be/oDG6MQkzh1o?si=ALhZGYq4BuiIjubQ What makes it even worse is that these butt-ugly men that bag these beautiful chicks, especially the ones I knew back in high school, always think of themselves as Greek gods. It's enough to make you want to scream and throw up on the floor. Now, don't get me wrong. I try not to judge a book by its cover, and I discourage other people from doing so either. Whenever I come across a burn victim whose face is badly disfigured, I am always the first to defend that person from anyone who tries to ridicule them about their appearance. However, whenever a man, young or old, who is revoltingly ugly goes around acting as though he is the next James Dean or John Stamos, I can't help but to become annoyed with him. If a boy or a man who is homely becomes lucky enough to meet the right girl who decides not to judge him by his looks, I somehow feel that he should at least show a certain degree of humility and compassion toward others who want the same things in life that he has and cannot get them easily because they weren't born with the same genetic gifts as the high-school hunk they knew as teenagers. When these men act cocky and smug, I want nothing to do with them. ## 3.  The Decadence Of The American Dating Market The fact of the matter is that men like YouTuber Losermaxxing and YouTuber AxionPortal need to stop beating themselves up over their lack of access to the relationship scene, because the United States simply is not a very promising place to be for a man who is looking for love and to start a family. Even if you're the spitting image of Clark Gable or Sean Connery, you're going to run into problems with women and hit bumps in pursuing romance. YouTuber Dapper Dev explains this same problem in his video below. He shows a panel of gentlemen who attempt to pinpoint what could be causing such setbacks in the dating scene. YouTuber Dapper Dev Describes How The Dating Market Is Drying Up For Men In The United States https://youtu.be/xe2L7Do8Fno?si=Ew439pwBdBeMeef6 The information provided in the video above is valuable. The one point that these gentlemen left out was that the United States has among the highest statutory ages of consent in the world. On top of that, there is a large number of fake I.D.s being circulated through the hands of teenage girls below the statutory age of consent in their respective state jurisdictions here in our nation. You only have to take a look at the teenage girls in the video below, and you'll realize that it would be so easy for any of them to pass off for an 18- or 19-year-old woman with the right type of makeup and get into an adult nightclub with the right type of fake I.D. Adult men usually don't discover how young they really are until after the cops are pounding at their front door with an arrest warrant for \

Teenage Girls Flaunt Off Their Womanlike Figures In Fancy Clothing https://youtu.be/hWAzXdXtvBU?si=vTUGqp10t0HnkkLI Many nations abroad don't have that same problem as the United States does, because their statutory ages of consent are usually 15 or 14 years old or even younger. The foreign nations that have higher statutory ages of consent are probably not as strict about enforcing their statutory-rape laws as the United States is about enforcing theirs. The statutory age of consent in Uzbekistan is 16 years old, but, unlike the United States, that nation probably doesn't force alleged victims to prosecute their older sex partners. In that nation, the so-called crime of \

may not even be a strict-liability offense but rather an intent offense.

## 4.   Dr. Park Dietz - A Freak Show On Display

If you have never heard of Dr. Park Dietz, then consider yourself among the blessed here in the United States.  I often refer to him as Dr. Ditso.

I've never been able to find out whether Dr. Dietz's middle name is spelled \

body.title: My Brain
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW8BbgBS4z89jBfJAnPXTySxu3B1Y9puinsspfc34D4zx/1779553797884.jpg)
My green land breathes like the ocean
low tides of silence, high tides of life.
When the rain season arrives, the earth wakes slowly beneath the clouds, covered in soft green grasses dancing with the wind. The smell of wet soil rises deeply into the air, mixing with the scent of fresh trees standing tall like guardians of nature. 🌲🌳
Animals move peacefully through the fields, their footsteps light against the living ground, while birds sing beneath a sky swallowed by thick silver clouds. Every drop of rain feels like a heartbeat touching the land, feeding every root, every leaf, every hidden dream beneath the soil.
In this season, nature does not rush.
It breathes.
Slow… deep… alive.
And standing there, surrounded by endless green and the calm voice of the rain, it feels like the whole world has returned to peace again.

body.title: [Esp/Eng] ✨Cupcakes de zanahoria. // Carrot Cupcakes.✨
body.body:
>

###### ✨¡Hola amigos amantes de la comida!✨ Espero estén pasando un gran día.

Espero todos estén pasando un lindo día, amigos. En esta ocasión les comparto una deliciosa receta de cupcakes de zanahoria. Amo demasiado el bizcocho de zanahoria, así que obviamente quise preparar unos ricos cupcakes con este sabor. Esta vez no le agregué canela, pero pueden hacerlo; es la combinación perfecta para hacer una delicia total.

**🔸A continuación, los dejo con el paso a paso:**

> ###### ✨¡Hello food loving friends!✨ I hope you are super well on this day. 

> I hope you're all having a wonderful day, friends. This time I'm sharing a delicious carrot cupcake recipe. I absolutely love carrot cake, so of course I wanted to make some tasty cupcakes with this flavor. This time I didn't add cinnamon, but you can; it's the perfect combination for a truly delightful treat.

**🔸Next, I leave you with the step by step:**
 
---

<center>![portada defi.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23u69QkgWKhKbZ4v1EmGFyTdyoaWXnGqvMLVvB27uDfACXFyJH4NhkS36pJLNVTToRhAn.JPG)</center>

---

**♥️Espero les guste. ¡Comencemos!**

**♥️I hope you like it. Let's get started!**

---

<center>![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)</center>

# 🍶 *INGREDIENTES* | 🍶 *INGREDIENTS*

<center>![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)</center>

<div class=\

> - 100 g de harina de trigo. - 70 g de mantequilla. - 100 g de azúcar. - 1 cdta de vainilla. - ½ zanahoria. - 2 huevos.
- 100g all-purpose flour. - 70g butter. - 100g sugar. - 1 tsp vanilla extract. - 1/2 carrot. - 2 eggs.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
![IMG_20260508_092626.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EowG6AUJraCtxuvYXkVjVHFLBYzpSjkDQbQ6qCTc4RVFgvAmqtyYKxRCXtnoSLn4RsR.jpg)
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

> ### ✨PASO 1: Lo primero que debemos hacer es tomar un recipiente hondo y comenzar añadiendo los 70 g de mantequilla, junto con los 100 g de azúcar, y comenzamos a batir, ya sea con batidor eléctrico o de mano, hasta que la mantequilla tome una consistencia cremosa y blanquecina; además de que el azúcar se disuelva.
### ✨1 STEP: The first thing we need to do is take a deep bowl and start by adding the 70g of butter, along with the 100g of sugar, and begin beating, either with an electric mixer or by hand, until the butter becomes creamy and pale, and the sugar is dissolved.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
|![IMG_20260508_095740.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoErW9PDNJP41sJM3e7etJGNHiM6AoYVdPJeosuHdvDWe6MtQ82No9QXb83dMobVvaw.jpg)|![IMG_20260508_100040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EogPL5pNwqALg2KZmXfzucF2bJrS5GLAiM3ipYdNHBqDRNSUAAgWSwHNquNYnqXpkd7.jpg)| |-|-|
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

> ### ✨PASO 2: Seguidamente, añadimos de uno en uno los huevos y seguimos batiendo con velocidad, hasta integrar por completo y que se forme aire. Además, es momento de añadir 1 cucharadita de vainilla; en este caso utilicé vainilla blanca.
### ✨2 STEP: Next, add the eggs one at a time and continue beating at high speed until fully incorporated and airy. Next, add 1 teaspoon of vanilla; in this case, I used white vanilla.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
|![IMG_20260508_100209.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoAcCgLM3xGkbpuFVJDiSxGBjgHT6U7ZymJH1XwtZsSk2kpETz2yceLH7LEYb5feTK1.jpg)|![IMG_20260508_100347.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoeFuGZzJYMTo3JwdVqhMtZte1T2PJamxK6AtNfdnd92as85DED2bdj88kWfQKus5jM.jpg)| |-|-|
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

> ### ✨PASO 3: Seguidamente, vamos con la harina, así que agregamos los 100 g de harina de trigo, previamente tamizada, para que no se formen grumos o caiga alguna partícula extraña. Luego, rallamos ½ zanahoria e incorporamos, haciendo movimientos envolventes.
### ✨3 STEP: Then, let's move on to the flour. Add 100g of sifted all-purpose flour to prevent lumps or any unwanted particles. Grate half a carrot and gently fold it in.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
|![IMG_20260508_100429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoeGqmCRCmu5YYyAf8ogcjBkGiv9eseq4GoQSFzri5GXkvpzkizccA1uYSNs9EWtXnH.jpg)|![IMG_20260508_100627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/Eo8UmmF57y9XWu7cXxuWwAtz6fh86noeqKAc5CD5fYDodHKBL2fLJ1CBqoZynkpsFLG.jpg)|![IMG_20260508_100758.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoGytFVVH1x1c5zGnuk8gFf1x5xXBAaE3iDB6jN63wc7CJKCsG9LVhMjQvSGVHYPoNV.jpg)| |-|-|-|
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

> ### ✨PASO 4: Tomamos nuestros moldes, colocamos los capacillos; con esta cantidad hago solo 8 cupcakes, para no comer tanto, jaja. Vertemos la mezcla un poco más arriba de la mitad de los capacillos y llevamos a horno precalentado a 180°C por 20 min aproximadamente.
### ✨4 STEP: Take your cupcake tins and line them with paper liners. This recipe makes only 8 cupcakes, so I don't eat too many, haha. Pour the batter a little over halfway into the liners and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for approximately 20 minutes.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
|![IMG_20260508_101308.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoCibZLD4prgcNyQQSWS1TkFaBUaCaf11oB3mYyubTYy2hzMasNycNfSCfM2jRhY1Jq.jpg)|![IMG_20260508_104532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/EoeFuAS32LN8VJTCe32ctrhZA44T1cq3XkuuZWCUeHUPNh3YJkkX7CSQBgW9rWff2Rb.jpg)| |-|-|
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)
✨ Así es como pueden preparar unos deliciosos, se los prometo que deliciosos cupcakes de zanahoria; de verdad que si no han probado un pastel con este sabor, se los recomiendo. Además, pueden añadir a la receta canela o un poco de maní. Espero que les haya gustado la receta y se animen a prepararla. ❤️Hasta la próxima publicación. > ✨ That's how you can make some delicious, I promise you, delicious carrot cupcakes. If you haven't tried a cake with this flavor, I highly recommend it. You can also add cinnamon or some peanuts to the recipe. I hope you liked the recipe and are inspired to make it. > ❤️Until the next post.
![Diseño sin título(5).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valenpba/23tw1aNeDiGai59XSApxwN8ZwscawBTVJtqCq8xauiu5y5jSnRzNU5T9KEiYWx93g9Lqy.png)

body.title: My steps to stay safe from online fraud
body.body:
The most problematic thing in the modern world is the security of the account. Because the more our digital technology is developing, the more problems we have. Especially, various scammers are trying to hack our accounts and try to loot all the assets there. If we cannot protect our digital devices from scammers, then it has a very bad effect on our lives. So I try to ensure the security of my account constantly. 

Since I am a conscious person, I have taken several necessary steps so that hackers cannot hack my account. When a person sends an OTP code to my mobile and asks me to share it, I never share those codes with anyone. 

The second thing is that many people send fake messages to my mobile. After sending them, they tell me that some money has been sent to your number by mistake and please return the money to me. To get out of this situation, I look at the transaction and when I see that the matter is wrong, I block that person's account and create a beautiful report in the name of the account. 

 Sometimes I get a message in my account, you have won an iPhone, your account has 1 lakh taka and click here to withdraw this money now. 

That is, the scammer sends me a phishing link and I constantly withdraw that link. I never enter them and I try to keep my account secure. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTJ7LbAoSqtWyBDsMJJuVvjz8dkDhbVEazidi3mYnpG3g/1779552687678.webp)

> Image made with Rafiki 



There are many people among us who are constantly unaware of the above issues. When someone cheats and says that you can win an iPhone by clicking on this link, that person clicks on the link and loses all his money and assets. But in my life, I have not been cheated by any scammer so far. Because I have been aware of the safety and security of devices since I was a child and I know these things well. So I have not been caught by any scammer so far and I have not given a chance to be robbed of my money and assets. 

Currently, in this era of technology, the most dangerous fraud is hacking our Gmail or Google Drive account. Because those of us who work online already save our necessary documents and necessary passwords there.  If a fraudster sends a phishing link to our Gmail account, then it is important for us to be aware of it. Because through phishing links, we can take away all the excels including Gmail access of our account. Due to which it can have a very bad effect on our lives. In this case, I think the most difficult fraud of the current era is to take away the express of our device.

Sometimes many such people email us and send us messages. They tell us that you participated in a lottery some time ago and won an iPhone there. To claim the iPhone, you click on the link below. 

If a fraud or fraudster sends you such a message, you should never click on that message. Many times, different OTP codes can be sent to different options of your online payment. Of course, you should withdraw them and not tell anyone the OTP code of your phone. 

If ever someone sends a phishing link to your e-wallet, then complain against that account and take quick advice and advice from experts. 

Basically, we live in a modern technological world.  In this world of technology, we always have to be careful. Because the more technology improves, the more problems in our lives will increase. Because most of us have a mischievous nature and will decide to use this technology for bad purposes. 

So I think you must be careful to protect your account. Because account security is the most important and first of all. Do not share any OTP with anyone and do not click on any phishing link. Ensure the security of your account.

body.title: Una flor misteriosa y bella - A mysterious and beautiful flower. [Esp-Eng]
body.body: >El asombro fue gigantesco cuando hice mi publicación en redes sociales. Los cuentos que vinieron después me dejaron con la boca abierta del asombro y un poco más tarde, pasado un rato de reflexión, pensé que era algo que sí podía pasar y que yo podía verlo de forma rara esa reacción de las personas porque desde pequeño había tenido el encuentro con este arbusto, su flor y su fruto, con su semilla aromática. Años más tarde ocurrió la incorporación a mi rutina, a mi ritmo de vida cotidiano la observación detallada y constante de aquella magnifica planta.

>Acostumbrado a ver la pequeña plantación de café que crecían en la rivera del río, la misma rivera que fue arrasada por la crecida monumental durante el huracán Melissa, las escasas 10 plantas que se podía ver desde el otro lado de la carretera, comenzó entonces un detenido proceso de observación, de contemplación sin prisa, de una especie de vínculo increíble. Más tarde visitamos los cafetales, esos inmensos cafetales en la falda de las montañas, algunos olvidados en medio del monte, otros vivían su momento de esplendor. Y es que las montañas del oriente cubano siempre se han caracterizado por su grandes volúmenes de producción del café.

> The astonishment was immense when I made my post on social media. The stories that followed left me speechless, and a little later, after some reflection, I realized it was something that could indeed happen. Perhaps I found people’s reactions strange because, since childhood, I had been familiar with this shrub—its flower, its fruit, and its aromatic seed. Years later, it became part of my routine, woven into the rhythm of my daily life through the careful and constant observation of that magnificent plant. > > Accustomed to seeing the small patch of coffee plants growing along the riverbank—the same riverbank that was swept away by the monumental flood during Hurricane Melissa—the handful of ten plants visible from the other side of the road became the beginning of a slow process of observation, of unhurried contemplation, of a kind of incredible bond. Later, we visited the coffee groves, those vast plantations on the mountainsides: some forgotten deep in the woods, others living their moment of splendor. After all, the mountains of eastern Cuba have always been known for their high volumes of coffee production.

>Allí, a diferencia del llano occidental, podías encontrar en cada patio unas cuantas plantas de café que ayudaban en el consumo de la casa, de allí las personas podían completar el proceso completo del café desde su recolección, secado, tostado, molido hasta que las teteras (esas teteras que les vi usar a mis abuelos) colaban la magnífica infusión. Allí aprendí la diferencia entre la preparación del café empinado y el carretero, y se enriqueció mi paladar cuando solo al probarlo sabía de que forma se había preparado. Comprendí, entonces, que si estás dispuesto a que el lugar te enseñe si te abres a las tradiciones que te puede brindar se va ampliando tu mundo y va absorbiendo todo lo que te rodea.

> There, unlike in the western plains, you could find a few coffee plants in almost every backyard, helping supply the household’s daily consumption. From those plants, people could carry out the entire coffee-making process—from harvesting, drying, roasting, and grinding, all the way to the moment when the kettles (the same kettles I once saw my grandparents use) strained the magnificent infusion. > > It was there that I learned the difference between empinado coffee and carretero coffee, and my palate grew sharper: just by tasting it, I could tell how it had been prepared. I understood then that if you are willing to let a place teach you—if you open yourself to the traditions it offers—your world expands, absorbing everything around you.

>¿Pero, quién no había tomado café? ¿Quién no había visto por lo menos una vez sus granos tostado? Y es que el café es una de las infusiones más difundidas por todo el mundo, perooooo...la flor, esa es otra historia y aparentemente un misterio, cuántas personas habían disfrutado su explosión florar, de ese olor dulzón que envuelve el aire, de la nata blanca y de su fugacidad. Allí era donde radicaba el misterio. Había publicado en mis redes sociales estas mismas fotos acompañadas de el siguiente texto: \

> Who hasn’t had a cup of coffee? Who hasn’t at least once seen its roasted beans? Coffee is one of the most widespread infusions in the world, buuuut… the flower, that’s a different story and apparently a mystery. How many people have ever enjoyed its floral explosion, that sweet scent that fills the air, that white creaminess, and its fleeting nature? That was where the mystery lived. > > I had posted these same photos on my social media accompanied by the following text: “_From here something wonderful is born—something that enchants many, that seduces, that fills the mornings of thousands of people with energy, that has become a companion for conversations among good friends around the world, an irreplaceable partner for the nocturnal reader. / It may not be the prettiest flower, but its fruit—the marvel that springs from it—has certainly earned its place in everyday life. How many romances have started there? How many good conversations have deepened in its complicity? How much joy does it inject into us? How many secrets does it hold? / The flowering of coffee is a process that must be lived in full: from the bud to the delicious steaming morning infusion._”

>Y aquí comenzó mi sorpresa: muchos comentaban que nunca habían visto la flor, otros pensaban que el café se daba bajo la tierra (parecido al maní), en otras ocasiones la habían visto pero no tenían ni idea que fuera la flor del café. Allí también llegaron las anécdotas de las personas que habían participado en la cosecha en las montañas, contaban sobre la sensación del rocío en las mañanas, olor a la tierra mojada junto con el aroma dominante y general de la flor o de los frutos maduros que atraían a las abejas y mariposas, también el molesto picor de las bibijoas (o santanillas como se conoce a la pequeña hormiga en occidente).

>Todo fue increíble, desde el asombro en redes sociales hasta la nata blanca que simulaba una nieve encima de las plantas de café que rápidamente va degenerando en marrona mientras la flor se seca y deja una pequeña huella que se convertirá en grano.

> And that’s where my surprise began: many people commented that they had never seen the flower, others thought coffee grew underground (like peanuts), and in other cases they had seen it but had no idea it was the coffee flower. There were also anecdotes from people who had taken part in the harvest in the mountains—they spoke of the feeling of morning dew, the smell of wet earth mixed with the dominant, pervasive aroma of the flower or the ripe fruit that attracted bees and butterflies, and also the annoying itch of the bibijoas (or santanillas, as the tiny ant is known in the west). > > Everything was incredible—from the amazement on social media to the white layer that looked like snow on top of the coffee plants, which quickly turns brown as the flower dries and leaves behind a small trace that will become a bean. * * * ``` Detalles Técnicos Cámara: Canon EOS 80D / Canon EOS 600D Lente: Sigma Art 18-35mm f/1.8 DC , Helio-44-2 58mm f/2, Canon EF 50mm f/1.4 USM Trípode: K&F Concept K254C2 ``` * * * Texto traducido por Copilot / Translated by Copilot.

body.title: Epic Games just made Tomb Raider FREE!! - All the Remasters [ ENG - ESP ]
body.body:
Gracias por pasar, version en español abajo
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u5tHQur2Y8p8C9swRMxHwfWCGqakcn2fzsJBhYM6fEG45wVkj61p7LmdwB3oXWkDTVv.jpg)

---


Every week, Epic Games manages to capture the attention of millions of players by giving away new titles on its digital storefront. But this time, the conversation revolves around a legendary name: *Tomb Raider I–III Remastered*. The remastered collection of Lara Croft’s early adventures has arrived on the Epic Games Store as a free giveaway, quickly becoming one of the year's most eye-catching freebies.

This promotion is part of Epic’s traditional \

campaign—a strategy that has kept the competition among digital platforms alive for years. This week, users can claim both *Tomb Raider I–III Remastered* and *Down in Bermuda* at no cost, keeping them in their libraries forever once claimed.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGwVTbAwjbpipwsnUKteRvG7Tt2ycEJRUjvqgVKBmPjHH6vxnGJGsN2R6eHA1mdeEGZ.jpg)



---

However, the true star of the show is *Tomb Raider*. This isn't just due to the franchise's historical significance, but because this collection represents a perfect blend of nostalgia and modernization. The bundle includes the first three original installments—released between 1996 and 1998—games that defined the third-person adventure genre and transformed Lara Croft into one of the most iconic characters in video game history. ---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xARNrrwHQneZ5wz4JUjJ1VTb6yGREStdHSwnquvg38VNQEY8cuUJj8zyfqQWxuiR9EL.png)



---

The remaster developed by Aspyr keeps the classic essence of the trilogy intact while introducing significant visual improvements. The environments feature revamped textures, updated lighting, and more detailed character models—though players also have the option to instantly switch back to the original graphics to experience the retro look of the late nineties. This feature has become a favorite among veteran fans.

Another interesting point is that the game remains faithful to much of the classic design. Precision platforming, deadly traps, and complex puzzles are all still present. In an era where many modern titles simplify exploration, *Tomb Raider* retains that sense of dangerous, solitary adventure that made the franchise famous. For some new players, it might feel \

but that is precisely where much of its charm lies.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tSU3kx1XL2CG3N2LxyWpGy5bHTXbb6LVrhBi5JLxyJ2AL2CQsxcJb6NfxSKokzYRzYX.png)



---

In addition to the graphical enhancements, the collection includes modernized controls, support for modern gamepads, a photo mode, and new achievements. This helps make the experience more comfortable for those who never played the originals. Even so, the core essence remains intact: exploring ancient tombs, solving puzzles, and surviving against wild enemies as Lara Croft journeys through locations inspired by Peru, Greece, Egypt, and Atlantis. ---



![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2qe4x8xUF6ywsgvy9HFHmGzeh3wiiAGo5E56BNA9QriMxz3dNQRy4uWP4viF6gk28s.png)


---

The return of *Tomb Raider* also arrives at a significant moment for the franchise. Over the past few months, news has emerged regarding new projects related to Lara Croft—including future games and modern reinterpretations of the classic saga. This has sparked renewed interest among many players in the original titles, as they seek to understand how it all began.

On the other hand, the second free game of the week—*Down in Bermuda*—offers a more relaxed and colorful experience. It is a cartoon-style puzzle adventure in which an aviator becomes trapped within a mysterious temporal anomaly inside the Bermuda Triangle. Although it is a much smaller title, it has garnered positive reviews thanks to its visual creativity and puzzle design.

---


![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGbncBHWkoV1Hw5kmrFjWDE9XLsfqf4SQ9u3r4Kyh6MH8DdXJtqWDktQDjTZftquMJ9.png)



---

Even so, it is evident that the true star of the week is Lara Croft. Epic Games is fully aware of the impact that comes with giving away a franchise as iconic as this one. It is not merely a promotion; it is also a way to attract new users and serve as a reminder of why *Tomb Raider* remains one of the most important sagas in the industry.

Players have until May 28, 2026, to claim both titles for free on the Epic Games Store. After that date, they will be replaced by new \

continuing a strategy that has established Epic as a favorite platform for those looking to expand their game libraries without spending a dime.

![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)






### Español
![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23u5tHQur2Y8p8C9swRMxHwfWCGqakcn2fzsJBhYM6fEG45wVkj61p7LmdwB3oXWkDTVv.jpg) --- Cada semana, la Epic Games logra captar la atención de millones de jugadores regalando nuevos títulos en su tienda digital. Pero esta vez, la conversación gira alrededor de un nombre legendario: Tomb Raider I–III Remastered. La colección remasterizada de las primeras aventuras de Lara Croft llegó gratis a la Epic Games Store y rápidamente se convirtió en uno de los regalos más llamativos del año. La promoción forma parte de las tradicionales “Mystery Games” de Epic, una estrategia que desde hace años mantiene viva la competencia entre plataformas digitales. Esta semana, los usuarios pueden reclamar sin costo tanto Tomb Raider I–III Remastered como Down in Bermuda, y conservarlos para siempre en su biblioteca una vez reclamados. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGwVTbAwjbpipwsnUKteRvG7Tt2ycEJRUjvqgVKBmPjHH6vxnGJGsN2R6eHA1mdeEGZ.jpg) --- Sin embargo, el verdadero protagonista es Tomb Raider. No solo por el peso histórico de la franquicia, sino porque esta colección representa una mezcla perfecta entre nostalgia y modernización. El paquete incluye las tres primeras entregas originales lanzadas entre 1996 y 1998, juegos que definieron el género de aventura en tercera persona y transformaron a Lara Croft en uno de los personajes más importantes de la historia de los videojuegos. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23xARNrrwHQneZ5wz4JUjJ1VTb6yGREStdHSwnquvg38VNQEY8cuUJj8zyfqQWxuiR9EL.png) --- La remasterización desarrollada por Aspyr mantiene intacta la esencia clásica de la trilogía, pero introduce mejoras visuales importantes. Los escenarios cuentan con texturas renovadas, iluminación actualizada y modelos más detallados, aunque también existe la posibilidad de cambiar instantáneamente a los gráficos originales para experimentar el aspecto retro de finales de los noventa. Esa función se ha convertido en una de las favoritas de los fanáticos veteranos. Otro punto interesante es que el juego respeta gran parte del diseño clásico. Los saltos milimétricos, las trampas mortales y los rompecabezas complejos siguen presentes. En una época donde muchos títulos modernos simplifican la exploración, Tomb Raider mantiene esa sensación de aventura peligrosa y solitaria que hizo famosa a la saga. Para algunos jugadores nuevos puede sentirse “vieja escuela”, pero justamente ahí reside gran parte de su encanto. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tSU3kx1XL2CG3N2LxyWpGy5bHTXbb6LVrhBi5JLxyJ2AL2CQsxcJb6NfxSKokzYRzYX.png) --- Además de las mejoras gráficas, la colección incluye controles modernizados, soporte para mandos actuales, modo foto y nuevos logros. Esto ayuda a que la experiencia resulte más cómoda para quienes nunca jugaron los originales. Aun así, la esencia permanece intacta: explorar tumbas antiguas, resolver acertijos y sobrevivir a enemigos salvajes mientras Lara Croft viaja por lugares inspirados en Perú, Grecia, Egipto y la Atlántida. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23w2qe4x8xUF6ywsgvy9HFHmGzeh3wiiAGo5E56BNA9QriMxz3dNQRy4uWP4viF6gk28s.png) --- El regreso de Tomb Raider también llega en un momento importante para la franquicia. Durante los últimos meses han surgido noticias sobre nuevos proyectos relacionados con Lara Croft, incluyendo futuros juegos y reinterpretaciones modernas de la saga clásica. Eso ha provocado que muchos jugadores vuelvan a interesarse por los títulos originales para entender cómo comenzó todo. Por otro lado, el segundo juego gratuito de la semana, Down in Bermuda, funciona como una propuesta más relajada y colorida. Se trata de una aventura de puzles con estilo caricaturesco donde un aviador queda atrapado en una misteriosa anomalía temporal dentro del Triángulo de las Bermudas. Aunque es un título mucho más pequeño, ha recibido comentarios positivos gracias a su creatividad visual y diseño de acertijos. --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cocacolaron/23tGbncBHWkoV1Hw5kmrFjWDE9XLsfqf4SQ9u3r4Kyh6MH8DdXJtqWDktQDjTZftquMJ9.png) --- Aun así, es evidente que la gran estrella de la semana es Lara Croft. Epic Games sabe perfectamente el impacto que tiene regalar una franquicia tan icónica. No es solo una promoción; también es una manera de atraer nuevos usuarios y recordar por qué Tomb Raider sigue siendo una de las sagas más importantes de la industria. Los jugadores tienen hasta el 28 de mayo de 2026 para reclamar ambos títulos gratuitamente en la Epic Games Store. Después de esa fecha, serán reemplazados por nuevos “Mystery Games”, continuando una estrategia que ha convertido a Epic en una de las plataformas favoritas para quienes buscan ampliar su colección sin gastar dinero.
![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/u_tgy22DxOsAAAAC/killua-kil.gif)

I have a chance to visit Dansolihon as I am buying some fruits direct from the farmers for my fruit shake business.So I went to my relative for a visit then I  am amazed to see the bunch of fresh harvest Durians.

Also my relative raised some native chickens which just started with a two chicken a hen and a rooster and look at that it already multiples and produced more eggs and chicks.

![701444532_2095582127697353_3449993787086367346_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/antonette/23vhwMy2QDJsmNSj2XbKsdkEyna3wmTdpVXME4BfA23ftuTVem8bf7Xn5hdh8eL7hhE3k.jpg)

Just like when I used to sell durian in my sari sari store before.

Anyway's Bukidnon is also a perfect spot to visit due to its cold weather condition also the greenery sorroundings is good for relaxation and the fresh air and the peaceful ambiance refreshes my mind so I gave some time to visit Bukidnon whenever I have a free time.

body.title: The burning brightest rainbows!
body.body:
The weekend wasn't heading anywhere but I was feeling that I was needing more outside space to clear the mind. May had been long already and even though I enjoyed the first couple of days with rain because nature really needed it, but....Let's say that I was also more than fed up with it fast enough again. The garden was screaming for some attention but as the saying here that 'IJsheiligen' or better said '*the holy ice day*' is the day which they always say that it is safe enough to put your seedlings outside, and that is around 16th of May. I can tell you, the day before that sacred you-can-plant-everything-now day it was still freezing in the night. Better said, no time for planting as yet.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmba3s2jZJ5CcCVRAR33YK38j43ifoZcSSC4H42EvXoTxQ/1779550718783.jpg)
And it seemed like there were rain showers every day, which is fine ofcourse..the plants are loving it. But my mood on my bicycle towards everywhere was kind of getting more calm and calm from it (or should we just call it as it seems and call it irritated) Finally the skies were blue again even though it was super cold, but that is all fine as long as the pooch just wants to walk outside, which means I want to walk outside. I didn't even think something out of it, as the sun was shining and the color of the sky was all normal. As Dutchies do we also check the weather radar to see if anything was coming up, and there was nothing going on. As I was walking further and further into the woods it started to drizzle a bit which is always fine *especially* when you are in the woods where the rain doesn't really get to you. Usually what I do when it is drizzling is that I just tend to hoover around in the woods and wait until the rain is over. I mean, with the dog with you it is always a good idea to have longer time in the woods, as that one is just always happily running around over there.

>
## Breaking hell Until it seemed like all hell just broke loose all of a sudden and rain started pouring down just out of nothing. Again the same tactic was there, just wait under a tree and see what happens. But there all of a sudden the sounds of thunder was super close. What the heck just happened over here that all of a sudden this was there. I decided to wait a bit more, and checked the radar but that one said it would continue to rain for a while longer so I just moved on.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeaUfV9C3TkmmAt8qFbdj1S46rhqBfWms1phGFo8MHoJ1/1779550718843.jpg)
When I stepped out of the woods all, there it was just the most beautiful sight. A rainbow with colors I had hardly ever seen before> I was able to see exactly where the cloud was ending and also a double rainbow even appeared next to the first one giving it even a better and more dramatic sighting of the whole natural spectacle. I stopped and just stared for a while at it. As the sounds of the thunder were slowly rolling away, also the rainbow disappeared in the same speed as that it had arrived. The funny thing to all of this of course was that if the squall (because that is what I would call it, this was serious rain) was on the radar, there would not have been a thought crossing my mind to head outside. But because it there was nothing ...I just went, and got this in return. It was lovely!

>
## Fiyahhhh! As it was still damn cold I it was time to also make a fire. I had spotted some woodworm holes in my wood stash, and that meant it was time to get rid of that before everything would be eaten by the wood worms. Honestly, there is nothing better than just making a fire and staring into it and just letting the thoughts drift away after putting on the sweatpants after this gigantic soak outside.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNMfciuAy7Vh7imUW7jbUwKFm5Y9kAxw1iUttSYtEk25r/1779550718804.jpg)
As you can see the sunlight even came through the clouds again letting the bon feu letters light up on the wood. What a weird day! But I know I love these nature kinds of things going on and it is time to head outside a lot more again! And ow yeah..I really need to plant out the seedlings now, as cold feels long gone now over here

body.title: Prime Directives Spread — May 23, 2026
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY45njDKFwkJ9xUHQeR7NhNy7rYiNJY6UZzFRJB5TWXUc/image_0350449a_1667_45c0_a8b6_4979029f4c8f3355012604102195824.jpg)
### Star Trek Tarot · 7-Card Timeline

---

**Suit translations for context:**
Bat’leths = Swords · Cloaks = Wands · Starships = Cups

---

### Positions 1 & 2 — Past Events
**Page of Bat’leths (Swords) + Queen of Cloaks (Wands)**

Two court cards anchoring the past creates an interesting pairing — a watchful, sharp-minded observer alongside a bold, magnetic, fire-driven presence. The Page of Swords is the one scanning the field, gathering intel, picking up on everything without necessarily acting. The Queen of Wands is the one *being* observed — charismatic, self-possessed, drawing energy into her orbit without trying.

This could reflect a dynamic you witnessed or were part of recently: someone commanding the room while you were reading the situation quietly and carefully. It may also point to a communication or piece of information that passed between two such energies.

---

### Position 3 — Recent Event
**Page of Starships (Cups)**

Just before this weekend began, something quietly emotional surfaced — a soft, unexpected gesture, a tender moment, perhaps a message (literal or energetic) that touched you. The Page of Cups doesn’t announce itself; it arrives gently, almost shyly. It’s the dreamlike impression left by someone or something that opened a small emotional door. Notably, the Shy Guy archetype lives here.

---

### Position 4 — Current State
**9 of Starships (Cups)**

Right now, on this Saturday, you’re sitting in the Wish Card. The 9 of Cups is satisfaction — emotional fullness, a quiet “I have what I need” feeling. You may be feeling pleased with yourself or something in your life, perhaps even a little self-congratulatory in the best way. This is a genuinely good place to be standing as the weekend opens.

---

### Position 5 — Present Course
**Temperance (XIV)**

The path you’re actively walking is one of integration and balance — pouring carefully between vessels, not rushing, not forcing. This is a measured, patient approach. The card as a course suggests you’re blending things well right now — but it also serves as a quiet directive: *keep doing this.*

---

### Positions 6 & 7 — Future Outcomes
**The Devil (XV) + 9 of Bat'leths (Swords)**

Here’s where the spread gets serious, and notably, these two cards follow Temperance *consecutively* in the Major Arcana — XIV, XV, and then that anguished Nine. That’s not a coincidence the deck is offering quietly.

**The Devil** pulls toward what binds you — desire, obsession, a magnetic connection that feels bigger than reason. After the careful balance of Temperance, The Devil represents the moment the leash frays. In your reading context, this is almost certainly pointing toward Knight of Wands energy — that push-pull, Twin Flame magnetism. An encounter, a glance, a moment this weekend could tip the scales from equilibrium into fixation. The Devil doesn’t necessarily mean something *bad* happens — it means something pulls you *hard.*

**The 9 of Swords** landing at the very end of the spread is the aftermath: lying awake, the mind running scenarios, the particular mental suffering of replaying a moment over and over wondering what it meant. The 9 of Bat’leths is the nightmare card — anxiety in the dark, the spiral that starts when the body is still but the mind won’t stop.

---

### Overall Reading

The spread traces a very clean arc: **contentment → balance → seduction → rumination.** You enter this weekend emotionally full and walking a measured path. Something this weekend — likely a charged moment or encounter, possibly at the gym — tips you out of Temperance’s equilibrium and into The Devil’s pull. And by the weekend’s close, you may be sitting with that familiar 3am energy of overthinking what happened (or what *didn’t*).

**The advisory in this spread** is held in Temperance itself: it isn’t just describing where you are — it’s showing you the only position from which The Devil loses its power. The more you can stay in that patient, integrative space rather than feeding the obsession loop, the less the 9 of Swords has to bite.

The Page of Cups in the recent past is worth watching too — that shy, gentle energy may be a factor in this weekend’s events, perhaps as a counterweight or contrast to whatever fires up with the Devil card.
