body.title: Because the money you earn shouldn't be public
body.body:
<center>![photo_2026-05-23_11-54-12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/EpNpqewJd8qKS55Zve6pv1w3UcRqwMwfcSwJe1jMtDgCY4ggbiqzyyYZWWV4txoeBaC.jpg)</center>


**I've noticed this topic is very prevalent in mainstream Web 2.0 networks, and I just saw it on Hive Blog.**

The question of the day: *Should the money you earn or own be public knowledge?*

This is the question posed by @intishar in their post; while reading it, I thought no, nobody should know how much you earn or don't earn, how much you spend or don't spend, or the origin of your funds.

And the only person who should know would be the police; they have to maintain order and ensure things aren't being done illegally.

So I have my own opinions on this...

**The government shouldn't know all your movements. Neither should an ordinary person with internet access.**

I think, as I mentioned, only the police should handle this data for public safety, but I disagree with the government knowing this information. *For what purpose?*

At least in my country, there's the law of *\

*. This refers to taxes.

If you're someone who doesn't earn large sums of money, you might think about what's fair. However, in my country, it's not about justice, but punishment.

And you notice it when you want to start a business, get ahead, begin your own venture. Small businesses or startups are suffocated by taxes. That's when you realize it's not about paying more for justice, but as punishment to prevent people from growing.

+ The more money you have, the more access you have to better education, greater knowledge, and better opportunities.

And somehow, it's not in the government's best interest because...

+ It wants workers.

**You are more vulnerable to robberies and kidnappings**

The idea that we all have access to everyone's financial information sounds like a very nice idea until we realize the reality of the world.

And the truth is, we are already vulnerable to robberies and kidnappings.

At least in my country this is common, so making a person's income public would only be baiting those who seek information that benefits them, allowing them to make easy money or cause a lot of harm. 

<center>![photo_2026-05-23_11-54-17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23x12eAsXgcpFvLdrVcjJNnSP88SsCimsQ92RZDFBQaPDZvcEQNAmz1dYAXJYB3nDanBK.jpg)</center>

**Misconceptions**

It's also common to think that if someone earns more, they should share it. However, I disagree.

Everyone can do whatever they want with their money, and it shouldn't be obligatory or a social obligation.

Yes, the world would be a better place if people with money and power contributed more. However, the reality is that many have gotten where they are through their own efforts. I actually have mixed feelings about this.

On the one hand, I think we should contribute to society. But at the same time, I believe it's entirely voluntary, and that something you earn through hard work is something you can decide whether or not to share. Which isn't wrong.

Often, people think the world owes them something while they lie in bed doing nothing about it.

So I think that, at least for me, as an ordinary human being, if I earned more money, I would like to contribute to worthwhile causes, to people who truly want to do everything possible to get ahead.

For example, by creating schools, universities, or training centers for adults who want to learn a trade that will allow them to generate income.

A personal dream of mine is to teach others how to manage their money properly so they can get ahead, and also how to avoid falling for the nonsense peddled by governments and powerful people, who are only concerned with creating consumers.

But, as I mentioned, it's something that, in my opinion, should be a personal project, something you're passionate about, something you want to do from the heart to truly help people.

For me, it's pointless to \

while doing thousands of bad things that harm society, as we all know who does.

<center>![photo_2026-05-23_11-54-13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zulfrontado/23z7WfwwLva89t7j72G8BK9tRfRPs891y6iyCpo5U9urQxzj1ZUcpzuZQRKvEWVcVBgmL.jpg)</center>

**For an ordinary person without a large income, this would also be a problem.**

I read Intishar's post and I can't help but remember that time I was saving money and I told a group of friends about it.

I'll leave that story for another post—*gossip or storytime?* You can see it however you want, but if you want to read it, you can follow me.

Telling that group of friends was the worst thing I could have ever done. It wasn't much money, but I still lost all the money I had worked hard to earn and saved.

So, that teaches me a lesson: don't tell anyone what you do with your money.

Also, regarding this topic, it makes me think that it would be a big problem for someone who doesn't earn millions of dollars to have their earnings public.

This would only increase the chances of being taken advantage of by people they know. It could also be dangerous because, although it's not a lot of money, let's be honest, there's always someone wanting a little money without lifting a finger. This is how crime arises, at least in part. So I don't think this idea is positive for society.

**The only ones who benefit from this ridiculous idea are the government.**

The reality, at least for me, is that this idea, so prevalent on social media, of making profits public, is because it benefits governments.

It's more money for them. More taxes for them. More obligations for people.

Currently, there's a system being implemented, trying to make people think ridiculous ideas about a kind of \

I don't fall for it because I've lived long enough in my country, where I've learned that supposed social justice is a lie used only to brainwash people, get votes, and later, money.

Those who always benefit from these ideas are governments, people in power, and criminals.

The curious thing is that they are all on the same page, which tells us something interesting that I will leave for your own analysis.

Slavili jsme celá velká rodina, všichni tři bráchové, dva s ženami a dětmi, mamka Monči, bráchové ženy a já.

Bylo nás třináct.

Úsměvná historka je, že jsme slavili v klášterním šenku a přišel tam náhodou i strejda s tetou a dělali, že nás nevidějí a vypadli.

Franta zrovna kouřil, zaslechl: \

(řekl strejda Petr.)

Držitel ceny PEN klubu pořád nemusí být ideální bratr a strýc, dluží mi knížku o malířích, snad si vzpomene, psal jsem mu už dvakrát.

Kromě té scény to byla dobrá oslava: Mamka dostala sluchátka s noise-cancelingem SONY, chytré hodinky na měření tlaku, tepu a kroků a spoustu kytek.

Včerejší koncert katedry skladby byl náramný, s Kubou Amchou jsme se shodli, že nejlepší to měla Čoudelka, škoda, že jí vypadla jedna skladba.

Mně se líbila i spektrální skladba Patrika Hermana, ale z MIDI zněla na semináři lépe.

John Franek mě dobrá forte, ale když se zvuk zeslabil, bylo slyšet, jak je hudba prázdná.

Benjamin Kotík to měl na začátku upatlané, ale tam, kde se rapovalo to bylo dobré.

Mark Karpilovský měl hudbu taky skvělou, ještě jednou jsem mu gratuloval do chatu.

S Čoudelkou jsme si vyměnili několik vět: \

Pokývala...

Snad moje orchestrálka v Ostravě bude znít obstojně ve vztahu k tomu, co jsem včera zažil, na katedře je spousta výborných skladatelů.

body.title: The Ideal Speed for Maximum Fuel Efficiency: Finding the Sweet Spot
body.body:
In an era of rising fuel prices and growing environmental concerns, drivers are increasingly looking for ways to stretch every gallon or liter of fuel. One of the most effective and immediate strategies is adjusting your driving speed. But what exactly is the ideal speed for consuming the least amount of fuel? The answer lies in the complex interplay between engine efficiency, aerodynamics, and rolling resistance.

### Understanding the Science Behind Fuel Consumption

Fuel efficiency in internal combustion engine vehicles is influenced by several key factors:

- **Engine Efficiency**: Most gasoline engines operate most efficiently at moderate RPMs (revolutions per minute), typically in the range of 1,500 to 2,500 RPM, depending on the vehicle and gearing.
- **Aerodynamic Drag**: This increases exponentially with speed. At higher velocities, the car must push through more air resistance, which demands significantly more power and fuel.
- **Rolling Resistance**: This remains relatively constant at lower speeds but becomes less dominant compared to aerodynamic drag as speed rises.

As a result, fuel economy typically follows a bell-shaped curve. It improves as speed increases from very low levels (where the engine works inefficiently in low gears), peaks at an optimal range, and then declines sharply at highway speeds above 70 mph (113 km/h).

### The Optimal Speed Range

For the majority of modern passenger cars, the **sweet spot for fuel efficiency** is generally between **45 and 65 mph (72 to 105 km/h)**. Many automotive experts and studies point to **around 50-55 mph (80-90 km/h)** as the ideal cruising speed for best mileage.

- At speeds below 40 mph (64 km/h), frequent gear shifts and low engine RPMs can waste fuel.
- Between 50-60 mph, the engine runs in its most efficient RPM band while aerodynamic drag remains manageable.
- Above 70 mph, every additional 5 mph can reduce fuel economy by 5-10% or more due to the dramatic rise in air resistance.

For example, according to data from the U.S. Department of Energy and various independent tests, increasing speed from 55 mph to 75 mph can decrease fuel efficiency by up to 20-25% on average.

### Factors That Influence the Ideal Speed

The precise optimal speed can vary depending on several variables:

- **Vehicle Type**: Smaller, more aerodynamic cars (like sedans or hybrids) often achieve peak efficiency closer to 60-65 mph. Larger vehicles such as SUVs and trucks may peak at slightly lower speeds due to higher drag.
- **Transmission**: Modern automatic transmissions with more gears (8-speed or 10-speed) can maintain optimal RPMs across a wider speed range compared to older 4- or 5-speed models.
- **Engine Technology**: Hybrid vehicles and those with cylinder deactivation technology may have different efficiency curves.
- **Driving Conditions**: Headwinds, road incline, tire pressure, and vehicle load all affect the ideal speed.

### Practical Tips to Maximize Fuel Savings

1. **Maintain Steady Speeds**: Use cruise control on highways to avoid unnecessary acceleration.
2. **Anticipate Traffic**: Smooth driving with gradual acceleration and coasting reduces fuel waste.
3. **Keep Your Vehicle Well-Maintained**: Proper tire inflation, clean air filters, and fresh spark plugs can improve efficiency by 5-10%.
4. **Avoid High Speeds**: Even if the legal limit allows 75+ mph, dropping down to 60-65 mph can save significant fuel on long trips.

### The Bottom Line

While the exact ideal speed varies slightly by vehicle, **55 mph (approximately 88 km/h)** serves as a reliable target for most cars seeking maximum fuel economy. Driving at this moderate pace not only saves money at the pump but also reduces emissions and can make for a more relaxed journey.

By understanding and applying this principle, drivers can make a meaningful impact on both their wallet and the environment — one mile at a time. The next time you hit the road, consider whether speeding up is really worth the extra fuel cost.

body.title: Coping with my traumatic moments
body.body:
Greetings!

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmW1XhYezF2NRZqnnsZ6Seu6K5dPYU7kxxhnUG1LkZ9Moi/1779552578239.jpg)

Post trauma is something that most people that have passed through an unpalatable situation or event experienced by a person. The consequences of this experience is what is call post trauma. I have seen people talking about their own post trauma experience and what I have heard from them is not quite different from what I personally have experienced.

Having said this, I would like to delve into the topic of the prompt which is all about, “Post Trauma.”

Well. I have not really experienced PTSD like other people have experienced it, but the one that I have witnessed was a huge blow to me and the aftermath of it was so strong for me to deal with.

The loss of  my lovely and dearly loved mother was one of those things that brought me post trauma. The sudden death of the support pillar of my life didn't come with anything else than a rude shock and this was not because of anything, but because of her kindness and love towards me and my progress in life.

With her in my life, I was able to achieve things that were immeasurable and even at that, she had promised me a week earlier that she would help see me through in life, but after that her promised and a week after, I lost her to the cold hand of death.

The most painful thing was that I saw her last on the day of her promise to me and afterwards, what I heard from home was the sad news of her death.

When I heard the news, I was in a rude shock and the most unfortunate thing was that I heard a paper to write on that particular day and instead of me concentrating on the examination, I couldn't and it's after the exam that I went home for the burial, at her burial, it's as if the world was over as everything looked cloudy to me as if that was the end. 

However, after the burial, I was being encouraged by a friend of my late mum to gear up and stay focused for what to come. She told me that although I would miss her presence in my life, that the grief of her death would not do me any good other than to frustrate me.

She continued to tell me that the only way I can overcome the trauma is to do good in life and that wherever she's, she would be happy she didn't come to this world in vain.

Having heard what this woman told me, I took solace in it and with the word of her encouragement, I was able to overcome the post trauma of my mum's death and returned back to school with a healed heart.

Although the exam that I did on the day of her death when I had received the bad news came out with failure , even at that, I was happy and determined to fulfill her wishes for me when she was alive.

In conclusion, on so many occasions, I have been able to overcome my trauma through the word of encouragement from people. 

This is my entry to week 218, episode 03 of the weekly featured contest in the Hive Learners community.

Thanks for reading.

title.body:
>


https://youtu.be/S5njWn_tsEk?si=prjaBuWVsnciHRPL


One of the topics that really moved my heart was “What pleases GOD the most” – many times people think that God is only pleased with large sacrifices and long prayers, or even just the outward appearance. But by the word of God I have learned that the best thing that pleases God most is to obey, believe, love, humble and have a sincere heart. 


God sees beyond what one sees. He inspects the heart. The Bible says in 1 Samuel 16:7, “For the Lord seeth not as man seeth; for man looketh on the outward appearance, but the Lord looketh on the heart.” This verse is a reminder to me that God cares more about being a genuine person than pretending to be one.

I also learnt that faith is very pleasing to God. Without faith, it is impossible to please Him, says Hebrews 11:6. In my life, I have experienced times when I felt weak, confused and even discouraged, yet I still trusted in God even if I did not understand all of the circumstances. I learned that when I go through tough times, His heart is happy when I trust Him. God desires that we rely on Him and trust in Him's promises even in difficult times.

One of the greatest things that please God is obedience to His commandments. Jesus said in John 14:15, “If ye love me, keep my commandments.” True love for God is not only verbal, but also in action. I remember a time when it was really bad when somebody insulted me and my heart was full of rage. I didn't want to engage with the person at all. 


However, in the times of prayer and Bible study, I heard so much more about forgiveness and love. It was hard, but I really did forgive him/her this time. Then I felt peace in my heart that I could not express sufficiently, after that. I learned from that time that when one does what God commands, and it hurts, God is pleased with that.

God is also happy when we demonstrate love to others. Both the greatest Commandments, that we love our neighbour and God, are found in the Bible, in Matthew 22:37-39. Just because many say they love God, they hate others, gossip, or act badly toward others. I think our joy is best when we see our children loving, being kind, patient and merciful in the name of God. Little acts of kindness have big meanings to God.

Another characteristic that makes God happy is humility. Pride is not God's desire for us. James 4:6: \

body.title: This is how the system evolved.
body.body: >There was a time, long before the vocabulary of politics came into existence, people used to work in their fields, harvesting their crops and believing that the fruits of their labor belonged to them. But things were not as simple as they thought. Soon, wanderers arrived. They were parasites who discovered that it was easier to loot than to sow. They took what they wanted and destroyed what they could not carry.

>In desperation, the farmers proposed a compromise. They said, “take a portion, but spare the rest” and the looters agreed. And thus, without philosophy or constitution, taxation was born - not as a civic duty but as a price for staying alive.
>Over time, the chief of these raiders declared himself king. Power, once stolen by force, now wore the mask of legitimacy.

>Elsewhere, in scattered habitations, people gathered to resist these dacoits. They chose a leader to lead them. In that moment, a republic emerged. It’s birth was not from idealism but from necessity.

>Two systems monarchy and republic born from the same fear and shaped by the same instinct and that was survival. Priest proclaimed the divine right of the kings. Thus, people surrendered before the rulers without questioning their legitimacy because it was against gods to question them.

>Yet both the systems shared a common flaw. To protect themselves they needed soldiers. Soldiers meant fewer hands in the fields. Laborers became scarce. And scarcity, as always, invited exploitation. The poor, the defeated and the voiceless people were turned into slaves. Thus began the era of slavery. This was an institution justified by every system and still continues in many forms. I am not claiming that it started exactly as I have wrote above, but it gives a rough sketch of the image that we are seeing today.

>Centuries passed, names changed and structures evolved. But their essence remained stubbornly familiar. No matter it was monarchy, autocracy or democracy, the human condition did not transform. Modern society congratulates itself for abolishing slavery, yet its spirit survives in subtler forms. The poor work for the comfort of the rich. Inequality persists like an ancient echo. Taxation, once a payment for mercy, often feels like a refined version of extortion. This is an obligation enforced by the every systems that claims to protect us.

>We like to believe that systems are designed to serve humanity. But in reality mankind serves the system. A child is born free, yet grows into a world already divided by wealth, by power and by invisible rules written long before their birth. Only a few benefit from these structures while the rest spend their lives sustaining them. This is not cynicism. It is an observation as old as civilization itself.

>The real question is not whether the system is flawed. It is whether we could ever create a system that truly reflects the dignity of the human spirit. Perhaps the root of our suffering lies not in kings or parliaments but in our collective surrender to structures that outgrow their purpose. A system should be a tool. Instead, it becomes a master. And so the vicious cycle starts. It can never change until we dare to imagine something different.

\n\n**Thanks for reading.**

body.title: The Weight of a Gaze / #monomad challenge / [ING/ESP]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZS2HRVJ8MYGKhgapPqsu2xFf8nUaCkCnHoiHepN67VKr/_dsc7845_copia.jpg)

* * *

The photos 📸 are my entry to the #monomad contest from @monochromes and @brumest.

* * *


Greetings hivers.

Have you ever come across people who, at first glance, seem to have a very strong personality?

A few days ago, while working on some photographs in the countryside, I met one of those men who seem to belong to another era. A farmer, a sugarcane cutter armed with a machete, with hands hardened by labor and a gaze that commanded respect without needing to say much.

I cannot exactly explain what caught my attention so strongly about him. Maybe it was his serious expression, the way he walked, or simply that presence some people naturally carry. The kind that tells stories even in silence.

While working, I could not resist pointing my camera at him several times and stealing a few portraits. Because I felt his face had something authentic, something worthy of being preserved in photographs. Every wrinkle, every gesture, and every shadow seemed to speak of years of sacrifice under the sun.

And although they were stolen portraits, I think they still manage to convey at least a part of the strength that man projected.

I hope you enjoy these images as much as I was impressed by meeting him.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcnSTcdLdUgH9o7Tu2WJK63ja7svShS8nBnxUkQTwyC8H/_dsc7834_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYRySahUaWZMMqtMSZrGQfuhxSr9jUECzssFg4H9aQyQ1/_dsc7838_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQiWS91pcMwWH3eNtTnd29QPUFxTRB49JhurGWB3hrT2H/_dsc7993_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPqooXkcaURW2KL1e84P6sQmFEMX4cwHKLDKoNUuATf2c/_dsc8002_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb1pRthp7krx8QBCvPPAyAWpnSgyf8J4TrsmKi8MA1rBJ/_dsc8005_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaR3Ja2WsPMmFo3EVTWdCwMq6DCKaGuA5PuhpnXLTGu4f/_dsc8063_copia.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUtdJEW2LyqizM1jvRUdiYfa85TQKDdJQ2wYCFdazTWC6/_dsc8065_copia.jpg)


Saludos hivers.

Les ha pasado que se tropiezas con personas que a simple vista se aprecia que tiene una personalidad fuerte.

Hace unos días, mientras trabajaba haciendo unas fotografías en el campo, conocí a un hombre de esos que parecen hechos de otra época. Un campesino, cortador de caña a machete, de manos endurecidas por el trabajo y una mirada que imponía respeto sin necesidad de decir demasiado.

No sé explicar exactamente qué fue lo que me llamó tanto la atención de él. Tal vez su expresión seria, la forma en que caminaba o simplemente esa presencia que algunas personas tienen de manera natural. De esas que cuentan historias incluso en silencio.

Mientras trabajaba, no pude evitar apuntarle la cámara varias veces y robarle algunos retratos. Porque sentía que su rostro tenía algo auténtico, algo que merecía quedar guardado en fotografías. Cada arruga, cada gesto y cada sombra parecían hablar de años de sacrificio bajo el sol.

Y aunque fueron retratos robados, creo que logran transmitir al menos una parte de la fuerza que aquel hombre proyectaba.

Espero que les gusten estas imágenes tanto como a mí me impresionó conocerlo.

* * *

body.title: Not What It Seems
body.body:
![1000136998.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kemmyb/23xpAn6m137aEX7oK1jkFAJATRzE8EgXAzt2H4SSMcvJZkdVD9Yz4DYbZsUTwidp2TnJC.png)![divider curl .webp](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

<div class=text-justify>

Oates, my friend from school, said adults lie more than children and as I glowered at my Dad, I believed him. He stood by the kitchen sink washing the same plate over and over again, his gaze distant and blank.  

I sat at the table with my math homework open, undone. Mum's chair across mine was empty. She always helped with my homework.

“Dad, did she leave because of me?” I asked finally. He startled and his hands stopped moving for a long moment. “Dad?”

“No,” he answered quietly, still gazing outside. “It's not you.”

“Then why? Why isn't she back?” 

He turned to look at me, dried his hands slowly and sat in Mum's chair. He looked older and his eyes were red and slightly swollen. “Sometimes people can love each other and still be unhappy.”

I frowned because he didn't make any sense. Love was supposed to make people happy and want to be together. Maybe this was another lie to get me to stop asking questions. He held my hands and gently squeezed. “Things are not what they seem, Fred,” he whispered.

“What do you mean? Did you hurt her?” I asked while pulling my hands out of his. I just wanted my mother back home. I wanted things to be normal again. 

His face changed then. “Yes,” he whispered. “I thought providing for you both was enough but your mum felt alone for a very long time.” 

I swallowed hard and gazed at my book. I couldn't bear to look at him because I didn't expect honesty. I'd have to tell Oates in school tomorrow that sometimes, adults tell the truth, like my dad now. 

“She still loves you,” he added quickly, leaning forward to draw my gaze back to him. “Nothing changes that.”

I nodded and started to work on my maths. He placed his hand over mine and it trembled slightly.

![divider curl .webp](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/kemmyb/a75ed810b8aaff74d2505ddf85186840400c52a1.webp)

body.title: VOTO LIBRE, cuidando las ELECCIONES con Blockchain
body.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779551734301-57e2871298097a3b.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=cryptomorfosis/35a80f91)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=cryptomorfosis/35a80f91)


---

Fuimos a la conferencia de prensa de Voto Libre, la dApp creada para brindar seguridad a los procesos electorales, creada por iniciativas ciudadanas para que los miembros de mesa, personeros o funcionarios de organismos electorales puedan registrar en la blockchain las actas electorales.

Conversamos con su founder Sebastián Berquet, quien nos comentó que cualquier persona puede descargar la app, registrarse y con ello ya están habilitados para tomar fotos de las actas electorales y subirlas a la aplicación, con lo que cada foto queda inmortalizada en la blockchain, con lo que se busca brindar confianza en el proceso, a través de un registro verificable.

Host, cámara y edición:
Miguel Miyahira

Software de postproducción: 
Adobe Premiere

---

body.title: (ESP/ENG) Celebrando Nuestro Aniversario #12 🥂 // Celebrating Our 12th Anniversary 🥂
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmewsGvD1VHXFhDbGXV5yr6AiFW386Gduevxe7uYzNnaGA/1779394889067.jpg)


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSktaUbFz7VhATWoxJkEDrQcF6cncfZDmAJw4KD63sVV3/1779396129385.png)

<center>


Hace unos días estuve de aniversario de bodas y en este día especial quisimos hacer una comida para celebrar juntos estos 12 años de matrimonio... 

La vida de casados  no es nada sencilla , son dos personas completamente diferentes conviviendo juntos día tras día, aprendiendo, respetándose, queriéndose y cuidándose mutuamente... Mi esposo y yo a través del tiempo hemos formando una hermosa familia tan bella y perfecta que no lo cambiaríamos por nada... 

Este día especial lo celebramos con una parrilla  y aquí el experto parrillero es mi esposo así que lo deje por su cuenta; el sazono, cocino  y arreglo todo para esta cena; que le quedó especialmente deliciosa... Mientras la comida estaba lista hicimos un pequeño brindis por nuestro 12 aniversario... 

Así que Salud por nosotros ❤️‍🩹

A few days ago was our wedding anniversary, and on this special day we wanted to cook a meal to celebrate these 12 years of marriage together... 

Married life  is no walk in the park; it’s two completely different people living together day after day, learning, respecting, loving, and caring for one another... Over time, my husband and I have built a beautiful family so lovely and perfect that we wouldn’t trade it for anything... 

We celebrated this special day with a barbecue, and since my husband is the expert grill master, I left it up to him; he seasoned, cooked, and prepared everything for this dinner, which turned out especially delicious... While the food was being prepared, we made a little toast to our 12th anniversary... 

So, cheers to us ❤️‍🩹

title.title: The law according to Lidia /Lidia fait sa loi (season /saison 3) EN /FR
title.body:
Hello film lovers, /Bonjour les cinéphiles, 

We’re still on Netflix watching the third and final season of this Italian series, based on a true story. This third season consists of six episodes and has been available on the platform since April 2026.
It is a legal drama.

> Nous sommes toujours sur Netflix pour regarder cette 3e et dernière saison de cette série italienne, basée sur une histoire vraie. Cette 3e saison se compose de 6 épisodes et est disponible depuis avril 2026 sur la plateforme.
Il s'agit d'un drame juridique.


![lidia.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florenceboens/EoK5NGsSC2rRcKRWWxwkaq5ifQXLZhhGGuvmFzv7uzh7BaTjQKHzfkY2RGXrvNuCPri.webp)
[Source](https://s2.qwant.com/thumbr/474x266/e/2/240078992166ab029685e2d6335fe735f2e95d8a3e1b836fb4a01ced54a8b5/OIP.hsgNRx5zLE6j4gZ2s1zTkgHaEK.jpg?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftse.mm.bing.net%2Fth%2Fid%2FOIP.hsgNRx5zLE6j4gZ2s1zTkgHaEK%3Fpid%3DApi&q=0&b=1&p=0&a=0)
*Series poster /Affiche de la série*

 ***Synopsis :***

Grazia, a friend of Lidia’s, comes to see her with her daughter Mila. She is trying to escape her violent husband. 

Lidia has known Grazia for several years; it was thanks to Grazia that she was able to find a place to stay and food to eat whilst she was studying law. 

Now, Grazia needs Lidia’s help—first to fund a trip, and then to defend her in court, as her husband has been killed and she is the prime suspect.

Other cases will be woven into this underlying storyline as the episodes unfold.

> Grazia, une amie de Lidia, vient la voir avec sa fille Mila. Elle tente d'échapper à son mari violent. 
> 
> Lidia connaît Grazia depuis plusieurs années, c'est grâce à Grazia qu'elle a pu être logée et nourrie pendant qu'elle étudiait le droit. 
> 
> Aujourd'hui, Grazia a besoin de Lidia, d'abord pour l'aider à financer un voyage et, ensuite, ce sera pour prendre sa défense devant le tribunal, puisque son mari a été tué et qu'elle en est la coupable présumée.
> 
> D'autres affaires viendront se greffer à cette trame de fond, au fil des épisodes.

--- 

***My opinion and a few facts /Mon avis et petites infos :***

Lidia Poët was Italy’s first female lawyer, and she had to fight tooth and nail to be accepted as such, at a time when only men were allowed to practise the profession.

In any case, it’s an original series, albeit one based on real events.

I really enjoyed this series.

> Lidia Poët est la première femme avocate italienne et elle aura dû faire des pieds et des mains pour être acceptée en tant que telle, à une époque où seuls les hommes pouvaient pratiquer ce métier.
> 
> En tout cas, c'est une série originale, tout en étant basée sur des faits réels.
> 
> J'ai bien aimé cette série.

The cast features the main actors and a few new additions for this final season: 

Matilda De Angelis: Lidia Poët
Eduardo Scarpetta: Jacopo Barberis
Pier Luigi Pasino: Enrico Poët
Sinéad Thornhill: Marianna Poët
Sara Lazzaro: Teresa Barberis
Gianmarco Saurino: Pierluigi Fourneau
Liliana Bottone: Grazia Fontana (season 3)

The music is anachronistic and sometimes jarring.

Lidia’s outfits are often full of bright colours and are very pretty.
On the other hand, the clothes worn by her brother Enrico are rather in poor taste, in my opinion, at least.

Have you had a chance to watch this final season yet? 

Enjoy your evenings in front of the telly and see you soon, 

> Au casting, nous retrouvons les acteurs principaux et quelques nouveaux acteurs pour cette dernière saison :

> La musique est anachronique et parfois perturbante.
> 
> Les tenues vestimentaires de Lidia sont souvent pleines de couleurs vives et sont très jolies.
Par contre, les vêtements portés par son frère Enrico, sont d'assez mauvais goût, à mes yeux, en tout cas.
> 
> Avez-vous déjà eu l'occasion de regarder cette dernière saison ?

title.title: A Walk Through the Waves to Los Juanes Beach [ENG/ESP]
title.body:
>

Greetings to all my fellow travelers in this community—I wish you all the best as the weekend begins. 

Today, I’d like to share some photos from a lovely journey I took through the waves from Tucacas to Los Juanes Beach, passing by Tucupido Beach along the way. 

![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23wqiMynmXqYXeVcAmxhXKxe8ufEN1dgqrXLxeTzAXoSEqh2xWcetCykFDw1Sb9U1nqRU.jpg)

![89.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqWkKgpas1iCja2Ym1PxTjrxAfTjpt1CWGhcDWJMAsyig5p1dtRBa3QY75YhWu7GXoP.jpg)

![88.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/ALLHWrrrmckfZBCHVLdQpWUxFK1phUwc8Cgw68pEDQD4MYpz4CtxRtm1M3584dy.jpg)

It was a trip organized by the company where I work to reward us for our hard work, and honestly, it was a real treat.

We arrived at the Tucacas pier in Falcón state around 9 a.m. and boarded the catamaran “La Bambola,” bound for “Los Juanes” Beach and “Tucupido” Beach, which are part of Morrocoy National Park.


![109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eq7KscqZmL5YiSFZd5kqwuqJpmWjKJ8BXq6osVsRy1s6Lo3A38Wuua1KpJPDEdanznc.jpg)

![110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eq7LWKMJMe5RrjRstK6nig6MznafjiUroEKAKYkhRCcHzL8uCkU4ZZF68UeAvMbHa47.jpg)


![87.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EprTbPdBsxLvtvPiGtUsZQRpSPijciSr9MZWkDnZ3qfu72KWxEo3yu4AdBHBo3moY1d.jpg)

![58.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/242rpo8zfhFxtbjJKXj3s4hNbanLEWM4vFVLQJSA7Se5EGJ2EzJxi4SsV5vBLj42knAJ3.jpg)

![61.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/2423qdCMAHT6mJdMJHSHoW4X3vThm1VqniRRxiSPWMVoaRyJPxpvWak3Qsxg4S8yMxMUp.jpg)

![80.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqfEuo8bgXVpCd192NQTXyNDmBPCbiupkgouYD8k1kjUB8DTQrF67hoWdcwmMpm9CUo.jpg)

During the trip, the guide provided information and explained the nautical route we would follow through the mangroves, which are clearly visible and form a well-defined navigation channel. He also told us that the trip to Los Juanes Beach would take between 20 and 25 minutes and described the full extent of Morrocoy National Park, as well as the key points of interest along the way.

![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23xVFDmLnmEynvSdwPCnr1k2unakiErtyT7NhSRr9euJQAmiLSRasKFgJ3dbVPk3ETsBx.jpg)

![105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpT3CiJVJYL616wrznpmtD7hiskV5xm8UER2smw8hq2wfRfE1xDaxK23C11b5bsAqyj.jpg)

![106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpviQt3iWEj9PVuWaxCVA2hrK8fGydYoR6bcnuExGDNWjXaLVTiRgkqp5WAdUTmm18m.jpg)

![107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqBbAprymgWKonRE6m3m9Bhv9YMofg15eShaGZes8HcPLMJ6t7iy2q5qJ9fpfCDDE4v.jpg)


![108.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eq9TPvZcerreZ5KR11XPNQK296UJkaNQPfUNnjxXX8qGN9T8KX2VX2j2Xvq7Cxjk2aU.jpg)

The catamaran is a two-story boat with a capacity for 80 people; however, since it was the off-season, there were only 25 of us that day, including my coworkers and a few others. It has restrooms, music played by a DJ, refreshments, and an area where you can walk around and even dance. The cost per person is $40.

 ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoGyQ4cHorxaUCL9NKQUYWidZB5VBa9XWy4oKASSQdWKLhedfk7Low3XucYUgVdGARn.jpg)

![98.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoK5qn7yMUExKPziVH1UwpoGoZKFCBK3Ffo42RbuZi5FhK2cwq8uv3vEMqt8YKDrXKs.jpg)

We made our first stop at Bajo Los Juanes, and the first things you see are the boats moored there and people enjoying this “natural pool,” because the water is shallow and the bottom is just soft sand where you can walk and play. It’s especially great for kids.

When we went down to the water, the first people to greet us were the street food vendors with their “floating stalls,” offering seafood such as shrimp, squid, and salads, with prices ranging from $15 to $25 per plate.

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eq7LyHzMfSQ9tbmWopRCMiLVuH2zE5Brxum3PwoVs3Dj16TaDJNBm9Vh7PCV7o62YFe.jpg)


![96.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Ep7tCVyJqgHBhN1sbY3k1wSJXj37zWMV2pPyMkNTWjCcQKvv8pXpCGpcECmwHXxQZDu.jpg)

![97.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpCAtJQDmqY3rYgJcoRbePqpdgctYTGK1PeeyqpD5iurucC2ZGjK1piebskgV2A1BwE.jpg)


![83.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpxqmtzoSNgKrsXfqhE9VjhmoT4Sd7forpgxo9FdaxP7LWfZ8hBGoJowskmGjWVBgFZ.jpg)

![85.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpJYYeP1C14EazYGMNzMdBELcWbPUgVU56NSnacpqNnH4La7XRNKhgqrmiDDWUjVPP1.jpg)

Fortunately, the weather was ideal for boating and enjoying the sea and the sand. The bright sunshine and the warm waters of this beach make it an excellent choice for a fantastic weekend getaway.

On the way back, we made another stop at Bajo Tucupido, another natural pool, but this one has the unique feature of having very white, soft sand at the bottom and quite pleasant water temperatures. It looks like a huge pool built by nature.


![100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoK4JEZ5gGv7RsryEmmpi69ZTzTFz1c9dC6NzzNjWAV7VUWMMEfG1F89X2jRFBou6JN.jpg)

![101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoprtPeDpNdknmE9oBq8ahGCyiZqu8FBbwvYu2iFZpaCZMCP7tdzbgZ7QBf5ZUGKE4Q.jpg)

![102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoAUNicSpiAUWyUBPrMvFzjH9Ttx4GDn6dN8jo4XFgMWU6yqWsgJ8p4qFrpqhBt6Cww.jpg)

At some point along the way, the captain steered the boat toward the Cave of the Virgin of the Valley, and we saw it from a distance because the water is shallow there and the boat can’t get too close.
There is a statue of the Virgin Mary there, and there’s a cave where fishermen pay their respects to ask for safe passage and a good catch.


![99.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/2458HvZjBLesQuvtMpUro3Fg4CFa6fxuGPGD6RenQ3Gy8VEEMHXaUHyCA69iNybzKdDX8.jpg)

![103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpNmyCERC8D8i8V5P3hyQ6vKstBQqAMQVXviPW8Yrq9ggCAYt9CFdKNAXcsKEZwcvNL.jpg)


![32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23wgUABMRS1D8xqQGWTg8G7sVQyHXQHhr27kqmzsiJ4TDfnfXZyiFFVbSfC3stpHsHkio.jpg)

![94.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpCAxFGzRPRN2WKwgUbFkDiaXjvErUM1aj2DDnnszbm5nyVYmRGreQgYEfzhvLpo5e4.jpg)

![92.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoyPWZvoZqXSVrbLoYV4eonagqEcsMpkvmqxn5QStbqbYfhbfjfgXtaPJSZVH8tdFdJ.jpg)

That wraps up this lovely outing, which helped strengthen bonds among coworkers and provided a well-deserved break.
Blessings to all.

![thank-you-very-much-.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5tAfanGoki9gRgA1nn2EzvYT5vv3UHJpGVYDF6ChQArJuJ8CVE1AkE1RuurNAtemxv.jpeg)

* Images taken with Samsung Galaxy A12, iPhone 14 Pro

> # Version en Español # Un paseo a través de las olas a playa los juanes Saludos a todos los amigos viajeros de esta comunidad, les deseo lo mejor en este comienzo del fin de semana. En esta oportunidad les quiero compartir imágenes de una bonita travesía que hice a través de las olas desde Tucacas hasta la playa Los Juanes, pasando también por la playa Tucupido que queda en el mismo recorrido. ![portada.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23wqiMynmXqYXeVcAmxhXKxe8ufEN1dgqrXLxeTzAXoSEqh2xWcetCykFDw1Sb9U1nqRU.jpg) ![89.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqWkKgpas1iCja2Ym1PxTjrxAfTjpt1CWGhcDWJMAsyig5p1dtRBa3QY75YhWu7GXoP.jpg) ![88.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/ALLHWrrrmckfZBCHVLdQpWUxFK1phUwc8Cgw68pEDQD4MYpz4CtxRtm1M3584dy.jpg) Fue un viaje planeado por la empresa donde trabajo con el propósito de premiar nuestra labor y la verdad que fue un verdadero regalo el que recibimos. Llegamos al embarcadero de Tucacas en el estado Falcón, a eso de las 9 de la mañana y nos embarcamos en el catamaran \

que pertenecen al parque nocional Morrocoy.


![109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eq7KscqZmL5YiSFZd5kqwuqJpmWjKJ8BXq6osVsRy1s6Lo3A38Wuua1KpJPDEdanznc.jpg)

![110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eq7LWKMJMe5RrjRstK6nig6MznafjiUroEKAKYkhRCcHzL8uCkU4ZZF68UeAvMbHa47.jpg)

![87.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EprTbPdBsxLvtvPiGtUsZQRpSPijciSr9MZWkDnZ3qfu72KWxEo3yu4AdBHBo3moY1d.jpg)


![58.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/242rpo8zfhFxtbjJKXj3s4hNbanLEWM4vFVLQJSA7Se5EGJ2EzJxi4SsV5vBLj42knAJ3.jpg)

![61.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/2423qdCMAHT6mJdMJHSHoW4X3vThm1VqniRRxiSPWMVoaRyJPxpvWak3Qsxg4S8yMxMUp.jpg)

![80.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqfEuo8bgXVpCd192NQTXyNDmBPCbiupkgouYD8k1kjUB8DTQrF67hoWdcwmMpm9CUo.jpg)


Durante el trayecto el guia nos informaba y nos explicaba la ruta náutica a seguir a través de los manglares que se aprecian y dejan un canal muy marcado de navegación. De igual manera nos indicaba que la duración del viaje estaba entre 20 y 25 minutos a la playa Los Juanes y nos indicaba toda la extensión que tiene el Parque nacional Morrocoy, así como los puntos importantes que se encuentran en todo el trayecto.



![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23xVFDmLnmEynvSdwPCnr1k2unakiErtyT7NhSRr9euJQAmiLSRasKFgJ3dbVPk3ETsBx.jpg)

![105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpT3CiJVJYL616wrznpmtD7hiskV5xm8UER2smw8hq2wfRfE1xDaxK23C11b5bsAqyj.jpg)

![106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpviQt3iWEj9PVuWaxCVA2hrK8fGydYoR6bcnuExGDNWjXaLVTiRgkqp5WAdUTmm18m.jpg)

![107.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EqBbAprymgWKonRE6m3m9Bhv9YMofg15eShaGZes8HcPLMJ6t7iy2q5qJ9fpfCDDE4v.jpg)

![108.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eq9TPvZcerreZ5KR11XPNQK296UJkaNQPfUNnjxXX8qGN9T8KX2VX2j2Xvq7Cxjk2aU.jpg)

El catamarán es una embarcación de dos pisos con capacidad para 80 personas, sin embargo, por ser temporada baja, ese día íbamos 25 personas entre mis compañeros de trabajo y otras personas más. Cuenta con baños, ambiente musical dirigido por un D.J, servicio de hidratación y un área donde se puede caminar y hasta bailar.

 ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoGyQ4cHorxaUCL9NKQUYWidZB5VBa9XWy4oKASSQdWKLhedfk7Low3XucYUgVdGARn.jpg)

![98.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoK5qn7yMUExKPziVH1UwpoGoZKFCBK3Ffo42RbuZi5FhK2cwq8uv3vEMqt8YKDrXKs.jpg)

La primera parada la hicimos en el bajo Los juanes, y lo primero que se visualiza son las embarcaciones estacionadas y las personas disfrutando de esta \

, porque el agua tiene poca profundidad y el fondo es solo arena suave donde se puede caminar y jugar. Es especial para los chicos.\n\nAl bajar al agua, los primeros en recibirnos son los vendedores ambulantes de comida con sus \

, ofreciendo productos del mar como camarones, calamares, ensaladas cuyos precios oscilan entre 15 y 25 dólares el plato. ![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Eq7LyHzMfSQ9tbmWopRCMiLVuH2zE5Brxum3PwoVs3Dj16TaDJNBm9Vh7PCV7o62YFe.jpg) ![96.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/Ep7tCVyJqgHBhN1sbY3k1wSJXj37zWMV2pPyMkNTWjCcQKvv8pXpCGpcECmwHXxQZDu.jpg) ![97.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpCAtJQDmqY3rYgJcoRbePqpdgctYTGK1PeeyqpD5iurucC2ZGjK1piebskgV2A1BwE.jpg) ![83.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpxqmtzoSNgKrsXfqhE9VjhmoT4Sd7forpgxo9FdaxP7LWfZ8hBGoJowskmGjWVBgFZ.jpg) ![85.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpJYYeP1C14EazYGMNzMdBELcWbPUgVU56NSnacpqNnH4La7XRNKhgqrmiDDWUjVPP1.jpg) Afortunadamente el tiempo estaba muy favorable para la navegación y para el disfrute del mar y la arena. Un sol radiante y las tibias aguas de esta playa la convierten en una excelente opción para pasar un fin de semana de altura. De regreso hicimos otra parada en el bajo Tucupido, otra piscina natural pero esta tiene la particularidad de poseer en el fondo arena muy blanca y suave y la temperatura del agua bastante agradable. Parece una gran piscina construida por la naturaleza. ![100.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoK4JEZ5gGv7RsryEmmpi69ZTzTFz1c9dC6NzzNjWAV7VUWMMEfG1F89X2jRFBou6JN.jpg) ![101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoprtPeDpNdknmE9oBq8ahGCyiZqu8FBbwvYu2iFZpaCZMCP7tdzbgZ7QBf5ZUGKE4Q.jpg) ![102.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoAUNicSpiAUWyUBPrMvFzjH9Ttx4GDn6dN8jo4XFgMWU6yqWsgJ8p4qFrpqhBt6Cww.jpg) En alguna parte del trayecto, el capitán dirigió la embarcación hacia la cueva de la virgen del Valle y la vimos desde lejos porque tiene poca profundidad y la nave no puede acrcarse demasiado. Alli está la imagen de la virgen y existe una cueva donde los pescadores rinden tributo para encomendar su viaje y su pesca. ![99.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/2458HvZjBLesQuvtMpUro3Fg4CFa6fxuGPGD6RenQ3Gy8VEEMHXaUHyCA69iNybzKdDX8.jpg) ![103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpNmyCERC8D8i8V5P3hyQ6vKstBQqAMQVXviPW8Yrq9ggCAYt9CFdKNAXcsKEZwcvNL.jpg) ![32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23wgUABMRS1D8xqQGWTg8G7sVQyHXQHhr27kqmzsiJ4TDfnfXZyiFFVbSfC3stpHsHkio.jpg) ![94.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EpCAxFGzRPRN2WKwgUbFkDiaXjvErUM1aj2DDnnszbm5nyVYmRGreQgYEfzhvLpo5e4.jpg) ![92.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/EoyPWZvoZqXSVrbLoYV4eonagqEcsMpkvmqxn5QStbqbYfhbfjfgXtaPJSZVH8tdFdJ.jpg) Hasta aquí les dejo este bonito paseo que sirvió para estrechar lazos entre compañeros de trabajo y tomar un merecido descanso. Bendiciones para todos. ![por-su-atención--¡muchas-gracias!-.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gpache/23u5tAfanGoki9gRgA1nn2EzvYT5vv3UHJpGVYDF6ChQArJuJ8CVE1AkE1RuurNAtemxv.jpeg) * Imágenes tomadas con Samsung Galaxy A12, Iphone14 pro * Portada elaborada con Canva * Traductor de texto utilizado: Deepl [//]:# (!worldmappin 10.863539 lat -68.216076 long d3scr)

Introduction


Hello everyone! This is @ybanezkim26 and I'll present today's edition of Travel Digest. In our featured posts, we have an ice garden in Alaska, USA, a temple complex in Poicha, India, and a castle Ciumbrud, Romania. Enjoy and keep on pinning your travel posts to the map!


All featured posts are visible on the Editors Choice Map and upvoted by @worldmappin, our curation trail, and potentially @blocktrades. For more travel digests check out #traveldigest.

Our winners today


🥇 Walking Through an Ice Garden in Alaska by @dtam

After almost 3 years since I mostly written from memories and past trips I enjoyed but whose pictures remained in folders for a long while now, I can happily say that life is finally getting back on track, with more occassional journeys that I've been missing so badly and which I couldn't see coming so soon, but which surely are going to remind me how my journey on here started, namely as a storyteller about places less known, but equally with the hope of promoting Romania more.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥈 Nilkanth Dham, Poicha. by @pranavgtd

I hope you all are fine. I am also fine here. Today's post is based on the religious place Nilkanth Dham, Poicha. The temple complex was developed by the Shree Swaminarayan Gurukul Rajkot Sansthan. The construction work was completed around the year 2013. The entire campus spreads across more than one hundred acres of land. Beautiful pink sandstone, grand domes, tall shikhars, decorative pillars, fountains, and statues make the temple look magnificent. Visitors feel both peace and devotion while walking through the temple premises.

This post on Worldmappin - This user on Worldmappin



🥉 Kemény Castle (Conacul Kemény din Ciumbrud) | Let's travel together #357 by @gabrielatravels

Today was a rollercoaster of emotions. We are in the middle of a week long expedition cruise in Alaska's Prince William Sound. We were supposed to go check out the second largest tidewater glacier in Alaska, Columbia Glacier, but we were stopped by an impenetrable wall of ice, 13 miles long. So at this time, no one is getting anywhere close to the face of that glacier. It must have dumped so much ice during the winter season. We may not be able to get back there all year. So those hopes were dashed very early in the morning. As expedition leader, its up to me, in these situations, to come up with plan B. Our normal path between the mainland and Glacier Island was also blocked with ice. Dang. It was low tide. And there was a lot of ice. Hmmm. This could make for some epic shorewalking among pieces of ice that get stuck on the rocky shoreline. And this is what we ended up doing.

title.title: What Are Unicode Fonts? The Simple Reason Copy-Paste Text Works
title.body:
You've seen it before. Someone's Instagram bio uses a gorgeous cursive style or bold decorative text, and you wonder how they pulled it off. There's no special app installed, no font file downloaded. They just typed something, copied it, and pasted it anywhere they wanted. That's Unicode at work.  
Unicode fonts aren't actually fonts in the traditional sense. When you grab a style from [fancy fonts copy and paste](https://fancyfontgenerator.net/) and drop it into your bio, you're not changing the font your device uses. You're using a completely different set of characters that already exist inside the Unicode standard.  
Here's what that actually means.

**Unicode Is a Universal Language for Characters**  
Every character your device displays, whether it's a letter, number, emoji, or symbol, has a unique Unicode code point. Think of it as a global ID system for text. The letter \

has one. The emoji 🔥 has one. And so does 𝓐, the fancy cursive version of A that shows up in aesthetic bios everywhere.  
That cursive A isn't a styled version of the regular A. It's a completely separate character with its own code point, sitting inside a Unicode block called Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols. It was added to Unicode for use in mathematical notation, but creators figured out it looks great in bios, so here we are.  
Because every device and every platform reads from the same Unicode standard, these characters paste correctly wherever Unicode is supported. That covers Instagram, TikTok, Discord, Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp, YouTube, and basically any modern app you use.

**Why This Is Different From a Regular Font?**  
A regular font is a design file. When a designer creates a font like Helvetica or Times New Roman, they draw each character and package it into a file your device loads. If someone without that font file opens your document, their device substitutes a different font instead. The style doesn't travel with the text.  
Unicode characters don't have that problem. The character itself carries the style. When you copy 𝓗𝓮𝓵𝓵𝓸 and paste it into a text field, every device reads those exact characters and displays them the same way. No font file needed. No substitution. The style goes wherever the text goes.  
This is why copy-paste fonts work across every platform without breaking.

**The Unicode Blocks Behind Your Favorite Styles**  
Different fancy text styles pull from different parts of the Unicode standard. A few of the most common:  
Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols: This block covers bold, italic, script, fraktur, and double-struck letter variations. Most cursive, gothic, and bold fancy text styles come from here. Mathematicians use these characters to denote different types of variables. Creators use them to make their bios look incredible.  
Combining Characters: These are characters that attach to the letter before them. Glitch and Zalgo text effects stack multiple combining characters on top of a single letter to create that corrupted, overflowing look. Your device renders each combining character individually, which is why the text looks chaotic but still pastes as plain text.  
Enclosed Alphanumeric Supplement: This block contains letters and numbers inside circles, squares, and other shapes. The stylish bracketed text styles you see in usernames and Discord nicknames often pull from here.  
Fullwidth Characters: These are wider versions of standard ASCII characters. They create that spaced-out, wide aesthetic text look that's popular in Y2K and lo-fi styles.

**What About Invisible Text?**  
Unicode also includes characters that take up space without displaying anything visible. The most common is U+3164, a Hangul filler character originally designed for Korean text layout. On most platforms, it renders as a blank space that behaves differently from a regular spacebar space.  
This is exactly how [**invisible text**](https://fancyfontgenerator.net/invisible-text) works on Instagram and TikTok. You paste these zero-width or blank Unicode characters into a bio or caption, and the platform treats them as real characters while displaying nothing. Creators use them to add spacing, create blank lines in bios, or send messages that appear empty.

**Where Unicode Fonts Don't Work?**  
Unicode support is widespread but not universal. A few situations where fancy text can break:  
Older operating systems sometimes lack the fonts needed to render newer Unicode blocks. Instead of the fancy character, users see a blank box or question mark. This gets less common every year as systems update, but it still happens on older Android versions and some desktop setups.  
Some platforms deliberately strip or block non-standard Unicode characters. Google Docs, for example, may substitute different glyphs depending on the document font. Plain text fields in some apps also normalize Unicode on submission.  
SEO is another consideration. Search engines read Unicode characters as text, but they may not recognize stylized Unicode letters as the same word as their standard equivalents. Typing your entire website in fancy text makes it harder for search engines to index.  
For bios, captions, usernames, and social profiles, Unicode fonts work perfectly. For documents, SEO copy, or accessibility-sensitive content, stick with standard text.

title.title: Project Hail Mary: A family movie
title.body:
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbF6F5KayVqC5cd9LzmU3vvXotrQ66UiLp8jJvSkoVdvp/mv5bmwzinge0ztetmtiyzs00ymnmlwezzdctyzrjmja2owvjytjlxkeyxkfqcgc_._v1_ql75_ux776_.jpg)<sub>[IBdM](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt12042730/mediaviewer/rm2951859714/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)</sub></center>

---
Yesterday I went with my wife to watch Project Hail Mary. It wasn’t at the cinema exactly, but at a cultural club in my city that specializes in screening films considered among the best in cinema. I had already seen some clips on social media, so when I found out they were going to show it, I felt it was a golden opportunity.

I never imagined that combining science fiction with comedy could bring tears to my eyes. From the very first scenes, when Dr. Grace mourns his fallen space mission companions in the middle of the universe, I knew I was witnessing a very serious comedy. Then the charisma and empathy of the character played by Ryan Gosling helped forge a powerful bond of friendship with an alien, to the point where neither hesitated to risk their life for the other.

These were the perfect scenes to trigger catharsis in me, making me look upward to avoid people around noticing my “weakness.” Luckily, jokes popped up from time to time, but the cure was worse than the disease, since the laughter only tightened the friendship between Grace and Rocky—something that made it very hard for me to endure some of the farewell scenes.

---
<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWiWH4Advc1FKvJg9gpzPhBSucCA8KpETovZhx35kA1yh/mv5byzflntdlzmety2ywoc00zjrlltlkyzatotg2mzniyjdjy2mzxkeyxkfqcgc_._v1_ql75_ux776_.jpg)<sub>[IBDM](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt12042730/mediaviewer/rm2935082498/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)</sub></center>

---

I think the film connects with the human need to create emotional bonds. That’s what drives us to leap over obstacles that seem impossible to overcome. It’s a movie light enough to entertain a child and deep enough to make an adult reflect on the life they’re living.

Without a doubt, it’s a family film. Perfect to enjoy together and spend an afternoon full of magic across space.

---
**ESPAÑOL**

---

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbF6F5KayVqC5cd9LzmU3vvXotrQ66UiLp8jJvSkoVdvp/mv5bmwzinge0ztetmtiyzs00ymnmlwezzdctyzrjmja2owvjytjlxkeyxkfqcgc_._v1_ql75_ux776_.jpg)<sub>[IBdM](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt12042730/mediaviewer/rm2951859714/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)</sub></center>

---
Ayer fui con mi esposa a ver Project Hail Mary. No fue al cine precisamente, sino a una peña de mi ciudad que se dedica a proyectar películas consideradas como lo mejor del cine. Ya había visto algunos clips en redes sociales, así que cuando me enteré que la iban a proyectar, sentí que era una oportunidad de oro.

Nunca pensé que combinar ciencia ficción con comedia, podría provocar que las lágrimas brotaran de mis ojos. Desde las primeras escenas, cuando el Dr Grace despide en duelo a sus compañeros de misión espacial fallecidos, y en el medio del universo, sabía que estaba en presencia de una comedia muy seria. Luego el carisma y la empatía del personaje interpretado por Ryan Gosling, ayudó a crear un lazo de amistad potente con un alienígena, a tal punto que en su momento, ninguno dudó en arriesgar su vida por el otro.

Fueron estas escenas ideales para hacerme entrar en catarsis, y mirar hacia arriba para evitar que la gente a mi alrededor se diera cuenta de mi “debilidad”. Por suerte aparecían los chistes de vez en cuando, pero el remedio era peor que la enfermedad, pues las escenas de risas solo hacían apretar la amistad entre Grace y Rocky, un hecho este que me hizo muy difícil de sobrellevar algunas escenas de despedidas. 

---

<center>![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWiWH4Advc1FKvJg9gpzPhBSucCA8KpETovZhx35kA1yh/mv5byzflntdlzmety2ywoc00zjrlltlkyzatotg2mzniyjdjy2mzxkeyxkfqcgc_._v1_ql75_ux776_.jpg)<sub>[IBDM](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt12042730/mediaviewer/rm2935082498/?ref_=ext_shr_lnk)</sub></center>

---
Creo que la película conecta con la necesidad que tenemos la gente de crear vínculos afectivos. Eso es lo que nos impulsa a saltar los obstáculos que parecen imposibles que podamos vencer. Es un filme lo suficientemente ligero como para que un niño se entretenga y lo suficientemente profundo como para que un adulto reflexione, sobre la vida que lleva.

Sin dudas es una película familiar. Es ideal para ir en conjunto y disfrutar de una tarde llena de magia a través del espacio.

---

title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPRhjFKGfMpJUEMyE9uE7WSpSyjjyrLn6RoUCNTr5oqnW/1000009055.png 

To be honest, watching the Bitcoin chart lately feels like riding a roller coaster without a seatbelt. For those of us in the market, the transition from april to may has been a real test of both patience and mental strength.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUnYdBxmkWiC5XW5iNukCaUEKEavZEKquvta98UPK6VsW/1000009056.jpg 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVQGKvUYhFt7VUDvqePQSA3V6ihbsyg3bbySigVuU3CYm/1000003632.jpg 


If we look back at our april analysis, things were still full of speculation. The market was trying to find its footing, and we were already starting to spot some Smart Money moves in those key areas. Back then, our technical analysis showed that Bitcoin was trying hard to break out of that consolidation zone.

**So, what’s the situation now?**
Looking at today’s chart update, things are getting interesting. We are currently at a major crossroads.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSPeDkxezrNk2igq3zZ8RWxncV2a62hPZCX2efgaUAkTn/1000009036.jpg 

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdtGmCYE6LgcFY6PKrBYBYMX7WYq751mRp8FQtn7i6QfL/1000009039.jpg 


- **The Battlefield Zone:** Take a close look the old support area has now turned into a resistance zone around 79,300 - 77,178. This is a hot area. If BTC can’t break and hold above this, we’re likely going to keep hanging out in the lower range.

- **The Defense Line:** Right now, all eyes are on the 77,580 - 68,350 area. That grey line you see is our current last line of defense. As long as the candles stay above that, there’s still hope for a bullish run.

- **The Goal:** Up there, we still have that FVG (Fair Value Gap) waiting to be filled between 88,630 - 84,568. If the momentum hits, that area is going to act like a magnet for the price. And if it keeps pushing, we’ve got our main resistance waiting at 90,280 - 88,495.

**Why is the market shaking up?**
​It’s not just about support and resistance lines; there’s a massive piece of news fueling the sentiment. The Senate Banking Committee just gave the green light to the **CLARITY Act.** This isn't just random noise, guys. If this actually becomes law and officially recognizes Bitcoin as a digital commodity, big institutions won’t have any reason to hold back.

​What does this mean for our technical areas? It’s a huge deal. This news could be the catalyst that helps the price blast through those resistance zones without looking back. So, don’t just stare at the candles keep an eye on this regulation news, too.

​The bottom line? Keep your eyes on the charts, but don't ignore the bigger story. We are in a make or break moment. Will we see a nice rebound, or are we headed for another dry spell? Stay disciplined with your risk management, and don’t let the fomo get to you.

> Happy trading, and stay safe

title.body:
‎What Goes Around Comes Around
‎
‎Life truly has a interesting way of reflecting to us what we share with others. In Urdu, this is beautifully said as Makafat-e-Amal — the law of consequences. It's a gentle reminder that every action has it's reaction. The kindness we extend often returns as blessings, while the hurt we cause can find its way back to us in different forms.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeo9SvmhysQ1k5JBeAZhEzW3zoWHmXPdnNVfbnWF2LTk8/1779551512233.jpg)

‎It's interesting how some people believe they can act hurtfully, lie, or deceive without any consequences. However, life has a way of keeping track. While justice might not be immediate, in time, everyone eventually faces the  result of their actions.
‎
‎If you make someone cry, you may one day feel the same pain. When you genuinely help someone, life often rewards you in unexpected ways. This is why we should think carefully before doing anything wrong.
‎
‎Sometimes people believe they have escaped after hurting others, but Makafat-e-Amal never forgets. Life has its own timing, and when the lesson returns, it can be powerful. Its like tit for tat for their action.
‎
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYXa1CmkcMU2zNg3UjzsWTD9rBiAMJySDSgXGoLjEGano/1779551530325.jpg)

‎So always choose kindness, honesty, and respect. Treat people the way you want to be treated. In the end, the energy you send into the world is the same energy that finds its way back to you.
‎
‎Because life is simple: what you give is what you receive.
‎

title.title: Чем темнее ночь, тем ярче звезды.
title.body:
![1000152296.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmarNBvVhSx4QrKXe6og2fqLzw4qzaheN5PBTD1ZNC2bVt/1000152296.jpg)

Привет мой дорогой друг!
‎Сегодня я хочу поделиться с тобой вот такой историей. Легко жить по накатанной, легко не напрягаться и плыть по течению. Я часто оправдывала себя, типа у меня нет сил и этим прикрывала лень. А чем я могу помочь другим и тем самым прикрывала безразличие... Я просто чувствовала себя пустой..и бездействовала...Что я могла отдавать другим, когда сама внутри была опустошена?
‎
‎Когда в 20 лет мне поставили диагноз грыжа позвоночника, во мне было 45 кг. при росте 170 см. Врачи сказали , что я не смогу выносить и родить ребёнка. Что в дальнейшем проблемы с позвоночником будут только усугубляться. Но, есть выход- это лечебная гимнастика. Врач показала мне специальные упражнения и вот уже 20 лет, я их выполняю. Я не ленюсь. А почему? Потому что я реально понимаю всю ответственность за моё здоровье. Я понимаю весь риск и не хочу быть прикованной к постели. Кстати сейчас у меня трое взрослых детей. Есть ли , что невозможное для Господа!?
‎
‎Я не стала перекладывать всю ответственность на Бога. Есть то ,за что отвечаю именно я. Иногда я задумываюсь почему, что касается моего физического здоровья меня так волнует. Почему я так же не забочусь о своём духовном состоянии. Наверное я не до конца оцениваю всю степень риска. Иногда мне нужен сильный пинок, чтобы взять себя в руки.Проходя трудные периоды в жизни, мы все становимся ближе к Богу.
‎«Чем ночь темней тем, ярче звёзды».
‎
‎Но знаешь, мой дорогой друг, я нашла другой выход. С моей подругой мы регулярно молимся в 6 утра, я ей подотчётна, это меня дисциплинирует. В нашей церкви создали группу в телеграм по чтению Библии. Ежедневно более 200 человек совместно читают одни и те же главы из Библии. Задают вопросы и рассуждают. И конечно подотчётность. Мы ставим реакцию в комментариях после прочтенных глав. Ну об важности поста, я вообще молчу. Мне проще отказаться от еды, чем от телефона. Реально это мой бич. Но я над этим работаю. Убрать всю мишуру и мусор соцсетей , приблизится в общении к Господу, пропитаться Силою Духа Святого, наполнится Его Словом , как живой водой. 
‎
‎Я не хочу быть воскресным христианином, просто топтать дворы дома Божьего. Я не хочу быть гостем в Его семье. Я хочу быть частью, членом Его тела. Я вернулась в хор. Моё служение Богу не заканчивается в моей семье ,оно продолжается в служение ближнему, а также в церковном труде.
‎Возможно в какой то момент это была самодисциплина, потом привычка, но поверь мне, при нашем усердии Господь наполнит нас и мы увидим Его Славу уже здесь на земле живых. 
‎
‎Я выбрала для себя группу поддержки, потому что самоконтроль не всегда работает. Для меня важно быть наполненой внутри,ведь тогда мне есть,чем поделиться с другими.
‎
‎А что скажешь ты?
‎

title.title: HiveToday 83 - Rising Star Resets, Keychain Goes Multichain, Madrid Still Buzzing
title.body:
Hive’s game layer hit an inflection point this week: [@risingstargame](https://peakd.com/@risingstargame/important-announcement-regarding-the-future-of-rising-star) posted an official **future-of-Rising-Star** announcement while [@keychain](https://peakd.com/@keychain/hive-keychain-multichain-enters-closed-beta-testing) opened **multichain closed beta**—and [@ninaeatshere](https://peakd.com/@ninaeatshere/invitacion-madrid-hive-meetup-or)’s **Madrid meetup** invite still claimed **228 HP**, carrying the meetup energy from [issue #82’s Alicante thread](https://peakd.com/@hivetoday/82).

This is HiveToday—a weekly recap of the Hive blockchain ecosystem.

**New here?** Hive uses delegated proof-of-stake: token holders elect witnesses who produce blocks. You can blog, comment, and play games without paying gas on every click. The chain has been live since March 2020.

---

## Editor's Take

Three plot lines converged.

**First**, long-running games are no longer background noise. **Rising Star** broke the week with a headline post about where the music game goes next—on the same calendar as **Splinterlands’** Electroneum **Voltage** event and a fresh **SarmacjaMundi** beta guide on [C/HiveDevs](https://peakd.com/hive-139531/@sarmatia.app/sarmacjamundi-player-guide). Hive’s play-to-earn catalog is aging in public, not in silence.

**Second**, discovery became an engineering problem. [@iamkaye](https://peakd.com/@iamkaye/why-google-doesnt-hate-hive-it-just-cant-find-us) earned **218 HP** on an SEO post; [@ecency](https://peakd.com/@ecency/how-ecency-is-approaching-seo), [@pharesim](https://peakd.com/@pharesim/want-to-see-your-posts-on-google-post-them-on-hivecomb-net), and [@friendlymoose](https://peakd.com/@friendlymoose/the-hive-account-health-dashboard) shipped tools for search and account health. The content is fine—the index is the bottleneck.

**Third**, trust moved to the wallet edge. **Hive Keychain** entered **multichain closed beta** while **Magi** answered the **Hive Engine** breach with a public statement and a security report—two reminders that user keys and second-layer markets share the same reputation budget.

---

## The Story of the Week: Rising Star’s Future—and a Meetup Circuit That Won’t Quit

On **May 23**, [@risingstargame](https://peakd.com/@risingstargame/important-announcement-regarding-the-future-of-rising-star) posted **Important Announcement Regarding The Future of Rising Star**. It is a rare official reset note from one of Hive’s oldest music games. Read the post for details—the big picture is that a flagship game is telling its story on-chain instead of going quiet.

The same week brought **Splinterlands’** [Electroneum × Voltage event](https://peakd.com/@splinterlands/electroneum-x-splinterlands-voltage-event-powering-up-praetoria) and beta buzz from **SarmacjaMundi**, a strategy game that uses **Hive Keychain**, **HBD**, and **Hive Engine** parcels with block-hash turns.

The meetup thread from [issue #82](https://peakd.com/@hivetoday/82) kept rolling. [@ninaeatshere](https://peakd.com/@ninaeatshere/invitacion-madrid-hive-meetup-or)’s **Madrid Hive Meetup** invite ranked **#2** in weekly author rewards at **228 HP**, with **61 comments** and **1,198 votes**. [@enraizar](https://peakd.com/@enraizar/hive-open-days-alicante-2026-esp-eng)’s **Alicante** recap still made the top ten (**148 HP**, **93 comments**).

---

## Development Pulse

Core devs merged **balance-class** fixes and a patch for **first payouts** that were too large. **Hivemind** added endpoints for **pending author and curation rewards**. **Hivesense** improved sync reliability; **Wax** got a small chain-data fix.

On **C/HiveDevs**, [@friendlymoose](https://peakd.com/@friendlymoose/the-hive-account-health-dashboard) launched an **account health dashboard**; [@inertia](https://peakd.com/@inertia/i-codex-made-a-thing-again-lets-hive-together) shipped **Let’s Hive Together**; [@sagarkothari88](https://peakd.com/@sagarkothari88/fb25ed5f) integrated a unified **Snaps** feed in **HiveSuite**; [@thecrazygm](https://peakd.com/@thecrazygm/hivetools-post-curation-tool-now-filters-by-language) added **language filters** to **HiveTools**; and [@ecoinstant](https://peakd.com/@ecoinstant/feed-your-agent-better-the-md-download-is-live-on-hivetools) added **Markdown downloads** for agents on HiveTools.

**3Speak** merged **pay-per-listen** tracking and playlist APIs in **3speakchecks**, alongside the encoder network’s **Week 24** report.

---

## Project Spotlights

**Rising Star** — [@risingstargame](https://peakd.com/@risingstargame/important-announcement-regarding-the-future-of-rising-star): official post on the game’s future.

**Hive Keychain** — [@keychain](https://peakd.com/@keychain/hive-keychain-multichain-enters-closed-beta-testing): **multichain closed beta**.

**Ecency** — [@ecency](https://peakd.com/@ecency/what-ecency-actually-does-for) on infrastructure role; [@ecency](https://peakd.com/@ecency/how-ecency-is-approaching-seo) on **SEO** changes.

**Magi Network** — [@magi.network](https://peakd.com/@magi.network/on-the-hive-engine-breach-a-statement-from-magi) on the **Hive Engine** breach; [security report](https://peakd.com/@magi.network/magi-security-and-bug-hunt-report-february-may) for Feb–May.

**Splinterlands** — [@splinterlands](https://peakd.com/@splinterlands/electroneum-x-splinterlands-voltage-event-powering-up-praetoria): **Electroneum × Voltage** event.

**3Speak** — [@threespeak](https://peakd.com/@threespeak/3speak-encoder-network-weekly-activity-report-week-24): **Encoder Network Week 24**.

**Actifit** — [@actifit](https://peakd.com/@actifit/actifit-android-v0140-momentum--biggest-update-yet): **Android v0.14.0 “Momentum”**.

**PeakD (via @asgarth)** — [@asgarth](https://peakd.com/@asgarth/proposals-code-blocks-hive-projects-page-and-a-sitemap-revamp-on-peakd): proposals UI, code blocks, projects page, sitemap.

**Worldmappin** — [**Travel Digest #2925**](https://peakd.com/@worldmappin/travel-digest-2925) and daily series #2921–#2925.

---

## Network Stats

| Metric | This week |
|--------|-----------|
| HIVE price | $0.06021 |
| HIVE market cap | ~$32.9M |
| CoinGecko rank | #657 |
| 24h change | −0.41% |
| HBD print rate | **0** (no new HBD minting) |
| HIVE powered up (7d) | 421,115 HIVE |
| HIVE powered down (7d) | 477,558 HIVE |
| Net stake change | −56,443 HIVE |

**HBD explained:** **HBD** is Hive’s dollar-pegged token. When too much HBD exists relative to **HIVE** value, the chain can stop minting new HBD—**print rate 0** means that brake is on now. Treasury HBD in **@hive.fund** is handled separately (see [issue #75](https://peakd.com/@hivetoday/75) for more).

**Powering up:** Net **power-down** this week, with big single moves still landing—including **100,000 HIVE** from **@bluemist** to **@appreciator**.

---

## Governance

Twenty of the top **21** witnesses run **v1.28.3**. **deathwing** is still on **v1.28.0**.

**Funded DHF proposals** (paid above Return Proposal **#0**):

- **#377 HBD Stabilizer — Renewal R2-2026** — 12,000 HBD/day
- **#368 Ecosystem Operations, Bizdev and Growth Retroactive** — 1,000 HBD/day
- **#350 Development of several new open source projects** — 490 HBD/day
- **#360 Hive Dev Proposal #2** — 415 HBD/day
- **#336 Ecency development and maintenance #5** — 300 HBD/day
- **#293 Hivewatchers & Spaminator Operational** — 95 HBD/day

***Governance Data - Hive Power-Ups***

- Most powered up — 7 days | **@bluemist → @appreciator — 100,000 HIVE**
- Most powered up — 7 days (self) | **@btu — 97,346 HIVE**
- Total Hive powered up — 7 days | **421,115 HIVE**
- Total Hive powered down — 7 days | **477,558 HIVE**

---

## Top Community Posts This Week

**HP** means **Hive Power**—the staked token weight that drives author rewards on posts, not “horsepower.”

- **232 HP** — [@plantfuljourney](https://peakd.com/@plantfuljourney/start-of-the-gardening-season): *Start of the gardening season* — 1,240 votes, 23 comments. Strong seasonal photo post.
- **228 HP** — [@ninaeatshere](https://peakd.com/@ninaeatshere/invitacion-madrid-hive-meetup-or): *Invitación: Madrid Hive Meetup | 15-05-2026* — 1,198 votes, 61 comments. Kept the Iberian meetup arc alive after Alicante.
- **218 HP** — [@iamkaye](https://peakd.com/@iamkaye/why-google-doesnt-hate-hive-it-just-cant-find-us): *Why Google Doesn't Hate Hive (It Just Can't Find Us)* — 956 votes, 61 comments. Clear SEO case for off-chain discovery.
- **199 HP** — [@louis88](https://peakd.com/@louis88/yet-another-hive-proposals-frontend-with-more-details): *Yet another Hive Proposals Frontend (with more Details)* — 477 votes, 38 comments. New UI for reading DHF proposals.
- **198 HP** — [@asgarth](https://peakd.com/@asgarth/peakd-updates-magi-swaps-decent-memes-and-nicer-code-blocks): *PeakD updates: Magi swaps, decent memes and nicer code blocks* — 480 votes, 71 comments. PeakD polish plus **Magi** swaps.

***Don't miss***

- [@theycallmedan](https://peakd.com/@theycallmedan/b192b726): *Hive AI aka deAI Preview Pt 2* — 161 HP, 760 votes

I had a nice surprise walking around the dam one morning as I spotted a group of Canada geese with several tiny goslings.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmQErHVeuyAaxb83gdhn3UhXPsHiBz6VegKEu7CUiPF1MV/file_000000006d74722f96c6b85e9bd1ccf4.jpeg

The goslings were fluffy looking, and bright yellow.  Canada geese are very protective parents, especially when their young are small. Interestingly, groups of geese sometimes look after each other’s goslings.  Several families may join together, and the adult geese help keep watch over all the goslings in the group to keep them safe from predators.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYwwP8EWWSnZhjvtK9z2eXcv5Y1YryPV3BhKAGYNuuZVN/P5161955.JPG

There was another pair of geese nearby, but they were chased off after someone started feeding the others. I think the parent geese wanted their own goslings to have all the food, which is fair enough. At one point, a few of the goslings even seemed to lose track of their parents and swam over to the other pair. In the end, though, they found their way back to the right family.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmXJVeAS4R9s31GwuUfoqKKoHdB3ut1B3amH6svUmzouTe/P5161964.JPG

I'm glad they knew what they were doing as I'd got no idea!
