title.title: A Long Lasting Fear In Silence
title.body:
If there is one thing we should always be grateful for, it should be waking up everyday to sound health and without any fear from the past because of illnesses or incidents that we can’t let go easily. This is to say that we don’t have any fear 😨 that can make us react in a certain way and have  never experienced any.

PTSD/ Trauma is never a thing to be joked with because many people are suffering from this syndrome in many different ways due to some life experience, sickness and victimization they have gone through. Although, those who go through this syndrome experience them in different ways, but I tell you that its not fun 🤩 and should be taken so seriously 😳.

We can only get to understand people better than we know them if only we get to also know their past and why they act the way they do. And not just conclude with our own opinions once they react in a way we don’t like because everyone has a past, some still hurting , victimized, traumatized either from sicknesses or fear 😨 of a kind. So we need to always pay attention to people like this and try to understand where they are coming from and what they have encountered in the past.

This story am about to tell happened to a girl friend of mine many years back. In fact, it happened while we were still in the university days. A guy was dating my friend then and along the line she became madly in love 🥰 with this guy as their relationship entered into the third year and we were about to graduate 👨‍🎓 then. With the hope that this guy also loved her, she was hoping that she was already secured for marriage. And honestly, everything seem so perfectly that everyone who knew them was hoping for them to be together at the end.

And suddenly, in the forth year of their relationship something unexpected happened. This guy travelled one Christmas and went for his traditional wedding without my friend knowing because he usually travel to go and see his parents at every end of the year. And when he came back from the Christmas trip, he started behaving funny. He stoped telling my friend his schedules but after few weeks has to summon the courage to speak to my friend about his traditional marriage. The bottom line was that his parents forced him to marry from their town. It sounded funny 😄, because this was a full grown man .

To cut the story short, my friend tried to commit suicide because of the shame she might face from those who knew them. Before this incident, my other friends who were also her friends and I had talked a lot of sense into her head, wanting her to believe that that guy was not meant for her. We told her how this  guy who acted in such a way can never be who God want her to settle for. But you know how cruel the heart ♥️. And how the devil 😈 will always tempt us. She tried to kill herself but was saved by a neighbor who was monitoring her during this that period.

In all , she was never the same after the incident. She became a different person, retrieve herself from the world 🌎. Isolated herself from friends and was giving up to life.  For so many years , she was dealing with fear 😰 of death, traumatized by what she experienced. It was only by the grace of God that after almost five (5) that she came back to her sense to pick up from where stopped. And as God will have it, He sent an Angel 😇 her way who cherished her like a queen 👸.

Life is so hard and even harder for so many who has experienced all kinds of traumatic encounters. Many are suffering from past nightmares and are struggling to come out from them. We need to always take a pause to look at the person who we see with sad emotion. Those who always try’s to isolate themselves. Those with fear 😨 at all times . There is always a past experience these ones can not over come on their own. They are suffering in silence and need someone’s attention.

title.title: Nightbitch, an ironic and biting novel about motherhood and how difficult it is to remain a woman as well as a mother, and about repressed bestiality and freedom. (ENG/ESP)
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWusTXdfJf7xpb5WaoaXJAzxHVc9FiEGmNww9V9EjiMrf/1779196360835.jpg)

Happy Saturday, blogging friends, how are you? Here I am again, reviewing a book that really struck me, Nightbitch by Rachel Yoder. I'd seen the movie and liked it, but the book is honestly much better. It offers a different, disillusioned, and realistic take on motherhood, the condition of being a mother, the difficulties mothers face, the burden they bear, and how motherhood isn't always all joy and pain. The protagonist is a woman, a mother. She used to have a career, she has an art degree, but in agreement with her husband, she decides to become a full-time mother. This completely upends her life and her perception of herself as a woman and an individual being, a true earthquake in her consciousness. At a certain point, however, she begins to notice strange things, little things, more hair on her lips, on her legs. She blames it on stress, tiredness, and her new situation, where she doesn't have much time to take care of herself and always be beautiful, well-groomed, and elegant. Her husband works all the time and calls her from far away, completely unaware of her difficulties, and she's alone, constantly in the company of this new being she's created, who has a thousand needs and takes up all her time, who throws tantrums, who messes up, who complains, who doesn't want to sleep, who screams and demands constant attention, and she's tired, but certain things just can't be said, right?

 Doesn't society accept the idea that sometimes our children are a burden and that we can't stand them? It's a huge taboo. One night, the protagonist begins to notice something strange: she seems to be growing a tail, a real one, and every day she notices changes in her body that make her look more and more like a beast. Her husband doesn't listen to her concerns, and she finds herself alone, dealing with these changes and wondering what's happening to her and whether she's going crazy. Meanwhile, there's always the job of being a mother, which becomes more stressful every day, a life of fairy tales, toy trains, desperate attempts to calm a capricious child, and meanwhile, her brain seems to atrophy. She's no longer herself, she's just a thing that lives for the child.

❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️


Feliz sábado, amigos blogueros, ¿cómo están? Aquí estoy de nuevo, reseñando un libro que me impactó mucho: Nightbitch de Rachel Yoder. Había visto la película y me gustó, pero el libro es, sinceramente, mucho mejor. Ofrece una visión diferente, desilusionada y realista de la maternidad, la condición de ser madre, las dificultades que enfrentan las madres, la carga que soportan y cómo la maternidad no siempre es solo alegría y dolor. La protagonista es una mujer, una madre. Solía tener una carrera, tiene un título en arte, pero de acuerdo con su esposo, decide convertirse en madre a tiempo completo. Esto trastoca por completo su vida y su percepción de sí misma como mujer y como ser individual, un verdadero terremoto en su conciencia. Sin embargo, en cierto momento, comienza a notar cosas extrañas, pequeñas cosas, más vello en sus labios, en sus piernas. Lo atribuye al estrés, al cansancio y a su nueva situación, donde no tiene mucho tiempo para cuidarse y estar siempre bella, bien arreglada y elegante. Su marido trabaja todo el tiempo y la llama desde lejos, completamente ajeno a sus dificultades, y ella está sola, constantemente en compañía de este nuevo ser que ha creado, que tiene mil necesidades y le quita todo el tiempo, que hace berrinches, que lo estropea todo, que se queja, que no quiere dormir, que grita y exige atención constante, y ella está cansada, pero hay cosas que simplemente no se pueden decir, ¿verdad? ¿Acaso la sociedad no acepta la idea de que a veces nuestros hijos son una carga y que no los soportamos?

 Es un gran tabú. Una noche, la protagonista empieza a notar algo extraño: parece que le está creciendo una cola, una de verdad, y cada día nota cambios en su cuerpo que la hacen parecerse cada vez más a una bestia. Su marido no escucha sus preocupaciones, y ella se encuentra sola, lidiando con estos cambios y preguntándose qué le está pasando y si se está volviendo loca. Mientras tanto, está la tarea de ser madre, que se vuelve más estresante cada día, una vida de cuentos de hadas, trenes de juguete, intentos desesperados por calmar a un niño caprichoso, y mientras tanto, su cerebro parece atrofiarse. Ya no es ella misma, es solo un ser que vive para el niño.




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdWGTF2y5joGnbgX2Dy4c13LhghephdgKCc4YXvmQMWo9/1779196361047.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWLx6gcD8EUPLRaaRqfRPPNdXbgotpvfbz8EmDGN8AhFa/1779196361231.jpg)

She no longer recognizes herself, her individuality, her body, which however is truly changing, not with the normal signs of tiredness and aging, but with an almost canine transformation, a transformation that increases day by day, a transformation that however proves extremely liberating when her canine and animalistic nature takes over and she rediscovers her most authentic, most animalistic emotions, and she becomes a dog and celebrates with other dogs, she rolls, bites, chews, her whole world changes and even her relationship with the child, dog games become everyday life, they eat from bowls, they play in the woods, they sleep in the kennel... 

And in the meantime, she also tries to be a good mother because that's what is expected of her, making friends with other mothers, taking care of the house. It's a stark portrait of how motherhood has a profound impact on women's lives and how it's often a task unshared by fathers, of how the burden of childbearing falls on women, without pause and without being able to admit they're tired or stressed, or that they want to feel not only like mothers but also like women. I found this book brilliant, both in its description of the female condition and in its blend of paranormal elements, which make sense within the book's plot. It speaks of a brutality that evokes the freedom, strength, and creativity within every woman, often stifled by society. I highly recommend both the book and the film, but the book is truly much more comprehensive and descriptive.

❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

Ya no se reconoce a sí misma, su individualidad, su cuerpo, que sin embargo está cambiando de verdad, no con los signos normales de cansancio y envejecimiento, sino con una transformación casi canina, una transformación que aumenta día a día, una transformación que, sin embargo, resulta extremadamente liberadora cuando su naturaleza canina y animal se apodera de ella y redescubre sus emociones más auténticas y animalescas, y se convierte en un perro y celebra con otros perros, rueda, muerde, mastica, todo su mundo cambia e incluso su relación con el niño, los juegos de perros se convierten en la vida cotidiana, comen de cuencos, juegan en el bosque, duermen en la caseta...

![UntVV5zL0ueXTslz_1000027778.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/muwangxuan/images/UntVV5zL0ueXTslz_1000027778/UntVV5zL0ueXTslz_1000027778.webp)

如果你觉得自己很累，那就去看看凌晨三点的菜市场！
如果你觉得自己很苦，就在中午大太阳的时候去看看工地上搬砖的农民工！
类似这样的话，估计大家应该听过不少吧。
还记得小时候，每当我抱怨学习苦，生活不如意时，总会听到类似这样的劝告。
那时的我就总被他们所诉说的那个场景所代入，就觉得，是啊，这样一比，我这下苦难又算得了什么呢。
可如今的我却渐渐觉得，苦难就是苦难，苦难不应该拿来比较。
一吨铁和一吨棉花是一样重的，同样，一斤苦难和一斤苦难也一样重。
我们在难受时，可能会经常听到这样一句话：你这算啥，想当初比这难的我都扛过来了。
或许说这句话的人是想告诉你，这些都会慢慢过去的，但是有时候当我们听到时，就会觉得，你是不是在说我小题大做？
而且，这就是在比较苦难，可凌晨的菜市场很累，白天的白领就不累嘛？
加不完的班，拿不到的绩效，吃不完的饼，做不完的ppt，开不完的会……
深夜的烧烤摊主不累嘛，十多个小时两班倒的流水线工人，那种从早骑摩托骑到晚的外卖员，他们不累嘛？
其实都累啊，各有各的累，各有各的苦。
可怎么比较，出社会以后慢慢就会发现，各有各的苦，烧烤摊老板晚上熬到三四点甚至凌晨，但是人家白天会睡觉，凌晨的环卫工人的确起的早，但是人家晚上睡的也早啊……
我前段时间刷到一个视频，是一个火锅店的女服务员，说在火锅店当服务员挺自卑的，和自己差不多年龄的人，打扮的都很漂亮，浑身还散发着香水味，只有自己身上是没办法掩盖的火锅味。
然后评论区就很多人在那说：你只是在上班的时候遇到了休息的我们罢了。
十多万条评论，很多人在那发出了自己上班的丑照和休息时光鲜亮丽照片的对比。
顺便带一句，自己工作也很幸苦。
所以呀，其实做啥都很苦，只是各有各的选择。
没必要去相互比较的。
有的人或许选择了工地搬砖，是很累，但是一天可以赚两三百块，有的人可能选择了在小县城里当保安，一天就七八十块钱。
这都是个人的选择，苦嘛，都苦？
但是不应该成为比较。
比较苦难下去，其实也会变成内卷。
我看着你觉得比我苦，那说明我还不够苦，那我就会继续努力，其他人看到这个画面，然后就也比较内卷起来，最终，大家就都会内卷。
但是，累了不是应该去休息嘛？困了就去睡觉，口渴就去喝水。
而不是一直在那耗着比谁更努力！
你觉得呢？

---

title.body: # A Letter to the Self You Could Become\n\n<a href=\

>from Imgflip Meme Generator --- ## **I. The Mirror You Avoid** There is a moment—quiet, unadorned, inevitable—when the person you pretend to be and the person you actually are stand face to face in the glass. You know this moment. You feel it in the pause before you speak, in the hesitation before you click \

in the hollow space behind your ribs when the applause fades and the screen goes dark.

*Be a better person.*

Not tomorrow. Not when it is convenient. Not when the witnesses are watching. Now. In the silence. In the choice no one else will ever see.

---

## **II. The Weight of Trust**

Trust is not a commodity. It is a covenant.

When someone places their faith in you—their time, their attention, their hope—they are not making a transaction. They are offering a piece of their soul. They are saying, *\

*

To lie to that person is not merely to deceive. It is to dismantle. It is to take the fragile architecture of another human being's hope and reduce it to rubble, brick by brick, word by word, silence by silence.

*Do better.*

Not because you must. But because you can. Because the version of you that honors trust is not a stranger. That version is waiting. It has always been waiting.

---

## **III. The Courage of Truth**

It is easier to lie.

Easier to curate the image, to massage the narrative, to let the story become more real than the truth. Easier to build a throne on a foundation of sand and call it stability.

But truth is not a burden. It is a liberation.

When you speak honestly, you do not merely free those who listen. You free yourself. You release the energy you have spent maintaining the fiction. You reclaim the hours you have lost to anxiety, to cover-ups, to the quiet terror of being found out.

*Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because they will catch you. But because you will catch yourself. And the person you meet in that moment of recognition will either be someone you can live with—or someone you will spend the rest of your life running from.

---

## **IV. The Invitation**

This is not a condemnation. It is an invitation.

You are not defined by your worst choices. You are defined by what you do next.

The past is a ledger, not a life sentence. Every moment offers a new entry. Every breath is a chance to write a different line.

So write this one:

*I choose to be better.*

Not perfect. Not flawless. Not beyond error. But better. More honest. More courageous. More worthy of the trust that has been placed in me.

---

## **V. The Legacy You Leave**

When your story is told—and it will be, if only in the quiet memories of those who knew you—what will they say?

Will they speak of the masks you wore, the stories you spun, the trust you traded for temporary gain?

Or will they speak of the moment you chose to turn, to face the mirror, to begin again?

The choice is yours.

Not someday.

Now.

*Be a better person. Do better. Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because the world is watching.

But because you are.

And the person you are becoming is worth the courage it takes to begin.

—

*— With hope, not judgment. With faith, not fear.*

>from Imgflip Meme Generator ## Prologue: The Wolf in Silk Clothing There is a particular danger in the digital age: the freedom to become anyone, to wear any face, to speak with any voice. They butter your words with praise, sweeten your doubts with promises, and wrap their requests in the velvet of friendship. Be very careful. --- ## I. *\n\nThese are not kindnesses. They are hooks, baited with the sugar of validation. The hand that offers a coin may be the same hand that reaches for your dignity. The voice that whispers *\

*\

title.body:
![forthefans.png](https://images.blocktunes.net/DQmcpuLdrGTyYu9bu2bLsroXimQrwNWL3Ui1rgjfaTm7XYy/forthefans.png)



There's a feeling music fans know well.You found an artist before anyone else did. You were telling people about them when they had 200 followers, or heck, you may have been their only follower. You made the playlist. You shared the link. You showed up to the show when it was in a room with 40 people.

Then they blew up. Which felt great. And also felt like absolutely nothing changed for you, well, because it didn't.

You still pay the same subscription fee. You still get the same algorithmic recommendations from the top labels because they have the money to buy the spots, not because the music is actually good. You still have no stake in the thing you helped build by being early.

BlockTunes changes that. If you're early on an artist, that should mean something financially. Let's get into how that works.

---

## How Edition Ownership Works

Every track minted on BlockTunes has editions, up to 10 per track. An edition is on-chain proof that you own a piece of that specific song. It's not a collectible that sits in a wallet doing nothing but making you feel silly for buying it. It pays you.

Here's what happens every time that track gets a qualifying play:

- **16 $MUSIC is minted fresh on-chain** and **0.1 HIVE is paid from the streaming pool**
- 50% goes to the artist, always
- **40% is split among all edition holders** based on how many you hold
- 5% goes to BlockTunes
- 5% goes to whoever referred the artist (or back to the artist if no referral)

That 40% holder pool divides based on how many editions exist and how many you hold. If a track has 10 editions and you hold 2, you get 20% of the holder pool on every play. Automatically. No claiming. No wallet interaction. It just shows up.

The cool thing about having both MUSIC and HIVE paying out is that HIVE is something you can easily swap for Bitcoin, Ethereum, or whatever else you want. You can take that off the platform and do what you like with it. The MUSIC you keep is your utility token, it's what gives you access to editions, AI tools, and everything else on the platform. Two separate streams, two different purposes.

---

## What a Qualifying Play Means

Not every second of audio triggers a payout. That would be trivially gamed. A qualifying play is a genuine, uninterrupted listen that meets the platform's minimum playback threshold. We keep the exact number private to prevent gaming. The engine watches for real engagement. When a play qualifies, the payout fires immediately.

---

## The Early Advantage Is The Real Alpha

A track can be minted with up to 10 editions. The artist sells them at 100 $MUSIC each. You pick up 2 editions early.

That track starts getting 50 qualifying plays a day. Your 2 editions earn you 20% of the 40% holder pool on every play.

Per play: 16 MUSIC x 40% x 20% = 1.28 MUSIC plus your share of the HIVE payout.

Think about it like this: 50 plays a day can earn you **64 MUSIC and some HIVE per day** just from holding those 2 editions. Every day. Without doing anything.

Now imagine that artist has a breakout moment and their play count goes from 50 to 500 a day. Your earnings scale with it. You got in at 100 MUSIC per edition. The math looks very different now. This is what being genuinely early on an artist can mean when the platform is built right. But being this is the early stages of a small platform, if you want your income to grow, we are going to ask for your help to get the word out! 

---

## The Listen Page


![Screenshot 2026-05-23 at 10.08.18 AM.png](https://images.blocktunes.net/DQmQXxtJXtGKe7E98c2ig6HZEe66F15grjxUeBrP5vBMVQ5/Screenshot%202026-05-23%20at%2010.08.18%E2%80%AFAM.png)



The Listen page at [app.blocktunes.net/listen](https://app.blocktunes.net/listen) is where you discover music. Every minted track on the platform appears here automatically. No listing fee. No curation gate.

Browse by genre, filter by language, search by artist name. The player keeps the music running continuously through any filtered list. If you're listening to hip-hop, the player queues the entire hip-hop catalog. Same for jazz, house, techno, drum and bass, ambient, and every other tag on the platform.

---

## Buying Editions

When you find a track you want to hold, click on the edition link on the song and it takes you it's NFT page where you can buy editions directly from the artist, or from the secondary market if they've sold out, it's actually all listed in the same place... Payment is in $MUSIC. All you need a Hive account and some MUSIC tokens to get started.

You can get MUSIC through the [Trade](https://app.blocktunes.net/trade) page built directly into BlockTunes, or on [Tribaldex](https://tribaldex.com/trade/MUSIC), on Hive-Engine. If you need HIVE, the base token for the blockchain, the [HiveExchange](https://app.blocktunes.net/buy-hive) lets you swap Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and other assets to and from HIVE, and you can do this all without leaving our app!

---

## What You're Actually Holding

As we have stated before, an edition is an NFT on the Hive-Engine sidechain. It's provably yours, transferable, and sellable. You can list it back on the marketplace at any price. If the artist's play count has grown since you bought in, the edition's value reflects that history. You are essentially buying stock in your favorite independent artists on the blockchain!

It's not a picture of a pet rock or some silly monkey. It's a revenue-generating asset tied to a real song that real people listen to, and is how it should have been done from the beginning. 

---

## Who Should Be Doing This

If you discover music early and want something more than a Spotify playlist to show for it, BlockTunes is built for you.

If you're a curator, influencer, or just someone who has always been the person whose recommendations people actually follow, you've been working for free. That ends here! Now, let's be clear, this isn't get rich quick money, but it's something, and can only grow overtime as we all grow!

And hey, if you know any artists you want to invite to Blocktunes, go to your A&R Dashboard, everyone has one, get your referral link, and if they create an account using your referral link, you automatically get 5% of their streaming revenues, for life, or at least as long as we are around... Future isn't guaranteed for anyone...

**[Start Listening](https://app.blocktunes.net/listen)**
**[Create Your Free Account](https://app.blocktunes.net/signup)**

title.body:
# 🐜 Camponotus nicobarensis – Week 6 | The First New Worker Has Arrived

<center>
![20260523_170157.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ant.runner/EoyQXeKjod67vNy1VxsFrDFB9MAyhDgdGFhc4Z3raxDALxWrZCoEfcDcecLLcXTmge6.jpg)
</center>

### 📈 Current status

* Queen: 1
* Workers: 7
* Brood: still present, with visible larval development

The colony was started in May 2026 and is now showing its first clearly visible development steps.

👉 The first new worker has finally emerged. 🎉

This is the first visible colony growth since the founding stage.

---

## 🥚 First Successful Development

<center>
![20260520_220703.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ant.runner/EouB7DbjnDuavsr7rC7aBuzTUtEADE3Rdgj5nGcqAKmWt43S27cUPtjmToEF9kopBMp.jpg)
</center>

The brood development was already clearly visible over the past weeks.

Now, the first new worker has finally emerged from it.

In small Camponotus colonies, development often takes longer because only a few workers are available to:

* care for brood
* collect food
* and maintain the entire setup

That makes this first visible progress even more exciting to observe.

---

## 🔍 Noticeably More Activity

<center>
![20260515_153029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ant.runner/Eoc8UyAuSe9hn4J5HP7NXch2Qzwvx3Sm94K9rgXDtoy86QKEKaze2ndRUnRbzSYPDFS.jpg)
</center>

At the same time, activity inside the arena has increased noticeably again.

Workers are now:

* more frequently outside the test tube at the same time
* spending longer periods inside the arena or even inside the plaster nest
* and are starting to climb the glass more often

The whole setup now feels much more alive compared to a few weeks ago.

---

## 🍯 Changes in Feeding Behavior

<center>
![20260523_170206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ant.runner/EoK8DqRUNspYoUYa8WaLJxotqpGAoEdXgAMBP4Mrn7wN1gJHXMoUSM4ksoFMfW8Ba9Z.jpg)
</center>

So far, the colony mostly accepted only very small protein sources.

However, interest in larger food pieces now slowly seems to increase as well.

With every additional worker, the colony appears slightly more active and confident during foraging.

---

## 🏠 Nest & Behavior

The colony is still mainly living inside the test tube.

The lightly humidified plaster nest is not being used as a real nest yet, but the workers are now spending more time inside it.

I still give the colony complete freedom of choice and simply continue observing how the behavior develops.

---

## 🧠 Personal Impression

Even though the colony is still small, this moment feels like real progress.

The first new worker, the increasing activity and the slowly developing organization make this phase especially exciting to watch.

For me, these early colony stages are some of the most interesting moments in antkeeping.

---

## 🔎 Outlook

Over the next weeks, I’m especially curious about:

* additional new workers
* further brood development
* even more activity inside the arena
* and possible future changes in nesting behavior

---

title.body:
#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  
 
 
# <center> ✦ ***Declárate culpable*** ✦</center> 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdXn4DMT99wtnpcc7qQwWKTWSdNbPsDRoKpkd22K3TPhJ/artguru_text2image_20260112121219.png)


📸https://www.artguru.ai/es/ai-text-to-image-generator/create/

Me siento a escribir estas líneas después de un tiempo de descanso, pero sobre todo un tiempo de meditación, un tiempo de reflexión sobre la vida y sobre esos fragmentos de tiempo que la componen. ¿Cuántas veces malgastamos el tiempo, sumidos en la discordia y en la tristeza? Me he dado cuenta que uno de los problemas de las personas a mi alrededor, y mío también, es la necesidad de tener siempre la razón. Ya sea en una acalorada discusión de política, en un partido de beisbol (o football, sobre todo football), en un gusto musical, en una opinion sobre la película de turno, siempre hay que polarizar todo esto en dos bandos, el bando de los ganadores, el bando de los perdedores. Bueno hay distintos tipos de bando pero siempre son dos.

Una de estas dualidades la de perdedor contra el ganador es la mas común, mi equipo ganó más campeonatos que el tuya, se alza la bandera de ganador, el perdedor no tiene derecho a replica. 

La dualidad de yo tengo la razón contra tú estas equivocado. Quizás esta es la dualidad mas peligrosa: ya que pone a uno de los enfrentados como dueño absoluto de una verdad, pero también con la posibilidad de modificarla y adaptarla a su forma, por eso o a veces es tan difícil hacer ver lo errado al que ya se levantó como dueño de la razón. Cuando, algo que me han enseñado mis canas y arrugas es que si hay algo que no es absoluto es la verdad.

La dualidad malo contra bueno, la mas infantil, pero la que oculta muchas cosas, la que oculta el miedo a lo nuevo, pero la que oculta violencia y rechazos. Por supuesto que hay personas malas, no neguemos eso, pero cuantas veces por una persona juzgamos a todo un grupo. Casi siempre los juicios dirigidos hacia una persona se convierten en una opinion sobre su lugar de origen, sus gustos o sus opiniones.


He tenido la tristeza de ver amigos de toda la vida perdidos eternamente en estos debates que solo ocasionan desacuerdos, he tenido la tristeza de ver familias separadas por una discusión de política, donde el:
-¡No sabes lo que estás haciendo! Son los malos, pesó tanto que separó por años. Cuando ninguna de las dos partes ni eran muy entendidos en el tema, ni en verdad le interesa, pero tenia que haber una dualidad: tenia que haber un ganador y un perdedor. Alguien que se regodeara en la victoria falsa del debate.

¿Y qué hacer sabiendo esto, qué hacemos cuando somos presa de la dualidad ridícula? Tal pareciera que estamos desarmados ante la obligatoria discusión. Yo tengo una táctica, una que me es infalible y que me ha ayudado no solo a conservar amistades y evitar querellas: ALEJARME. Si así de simple, lo bueno de estas discusiones de dualidades es que se ven venir al kilómetro. Y siempre, aun divisándolas, al asecho y listas para atacar caemos en ella. Yo me alejo en cuanto se que van a aparecer.

Tomo distancia, incluso física si es necesario. Solo me digo: ¿Pasará algo si yo mismo me declaro derrotado antes de la pelea? La respuesta corta: no. No va a pasar nada, de hecho estas ganando, en estas guerras de dualidades inútiles declararse perdedor antes de comenzar la batalla es la mejor jugada, pierde la batalla, gana la guerra.

Merece tanto que un equipo de un deporte al que te ata solo emociones rápidas que pierdas a amigo, ese director que sacó esa película de un basurero merece tu tiempo y tus palabras, si esa música no te gusta, por qué dedicarle tiempo, dedicarle atención. Ese político al que profesas devoción vendrá a arreglar el salidero de la cocina o te llevará al aeropuerto en medio de la noche: no, entonces por qué perderías un amigo por una discusión que al final del dia no te afecta. Declárate culpable, declárate el perdedor, o simplemente asiente en silencio. Pierde la batalla, gana la guerra.

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  


![](https://images.ecency.com/p/F1sR3uPuh6LH81Fdp9FaMEn6Lj6bbLPoZeHEMBfppnqKSs9vbK2eh3XHr2yBr1epGwfabAbpoduF57yK2obKaJvujF5NXRBr5eP5jCHyWVo5Ptvwx17SLzrZwF1pK4SxLEp6Arc3Ag7Fjpf4UdSvC9qeVxH5mqU6vdkG3QJv2tjCiABkaKCfePqihJicfhWfuL3FGSAZJ1bUy8h6WPtvAWRpjeP5?format=match&mode=fit)

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  

# <center> ✦ ***Plead guilty*** ✦</center> 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdXn4DMT99wtnpcc7qQwWKTWSdNbPsDRoKpkd22K3TPhJ/artguru_text2image_20260112121219.png)


📸https://www.artguru.ai/es/ai-text-to-image-generator/create/

I sit down to write these lines after a period of rest, but above all, a time of meditation, a time of reflection on life and on those fragments of time that compose it. How often do we waste time, mired in discord and sadness? I've realized that one of the problems of the people around me, and mine as well, is the need to always be right. Whether it's in a heated political discussion, a baseball game (or football, especially football), a musical taste, or an opinion about the latest movie, everything always has to be polarized into two sides: the winners' side and the losers' side. Well, there are different kinds of sides, but there are always two.

One of these dualities, that of loser versus winner, is the most common: \
the winner's flag is raised, and the loser has no right to reply.\n\nThe duality of \

Perhaps this is the most dangerous duality: it places one of the opposing sides as the absolute possessor of a truth, but also with the possibility of modifying and adapting it to their own view. That's why it's sometimes so difficult to make someone who has already risen up as the arbiter of truth see their error. When, as my gray hair and wrinkles have taught me, if there's anything that isn't absolute, it's the truth.

The duality of good versus bad is the most childish, yet it conceals many things, the fear of the new, and the violence and rejection. Of course, there are bad people, let's not deny that, but how often do we judge an entire group based on one person? Almost always, judgments directed at a person become an opinion about their place of origin, their tastes, or their opinions.

I've had the sorrow of seeing lifelong friends eternally lost in these debates that only cause disagreements. I've had the sorrow of seeing families torn apart by a political argument, where the:

\

They're the bad guys; it weighed so heavily that it drove us apart for years. Neither side was particularly knowledgeable about the subject, nor truly interested, but there had to be a duality: there had to be a winner and a loser. Someone to revel in the false victory of the debate.

And what do we do knowing this? What do we do when we fall prey to this ridiculous duality? It seems we're defenseless against the obligatory argument. I have a tactic, one that's infallible for me and has helped me not only to preserve friendships and avoid quarrels: WALK AWAY. It's that simple. The good thing about these arguments about dualities is that you can see them coming a mile away. And yet, even when we spot them, lurking and ready to strike, we still fall into them. I walk away as soon as I know they're going to appear.

I create distance, even physical distance if necessary. I just ask myself: What will happen if I declare myself defeated before the fight? The short answer: no. Nothing's going to happen, in fact, you're winning. In these wars of pointless dualities, declaring defeat before the battle even begins is the best move. Lose the battle, win the war.

Does a team in a sport you're only passionate about deserve more than losing a friend? That director who rescued that film from the trash heap deserves your time and your words. If you don't like that music, why waste your time, your attention? That politician you profess devotion to will come and fix the leaky kitchen faucet or take you to the airport in the middle of the night: no, so why would you lose a friend over an argument that, at the end of the day, doesn't affect you? Plead guilty, declare yourself the loser, or simply nod in silence. Lose the battle, win the war.

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  

![](https://images.ecency.com/p/5ShzsKnKF7vqASPAqXGPakzgncLgnonBpRauPEjcRbdChZiCDdqHbj9bi13uoNCeTf4S3djJxd4w1kBRB3j41eRMhVB5MEVpY7EsGWx2womXiDZ6WhzD1QWk8ZpfcxSeSd2S7oYashfySjy2Xeo1ZD49?format=match&mode=fit)

# A Letter to the Self You Could Become



---

## **I. The Mirror You Avoid**

There is a moment—quiet, unadorned, inevitable—when the person you pretend to be and the person you actually are stand face to face in the glass.

You know this moment.

You feel it in the pause before you speak, in the hesitation before you click \

in the hollow space behind your ribs when the applause fades and the screen goes dark.

*Be a better person.*

Not tomorrow. Not when it is convenient. Not when the witnesses are watching. Now. In the silence. In the choice no one else will ever see.

---

## **II. The Weight of Trust**

Trust is not a commodity. It is a covenant.

When someone places their faith in you—their time, their attention, their hope—they are not making a transaction. They are offering a piece of their soul. They are saying, *\

*

To lie to that person is not merely to deceive. It is to dismantle. It is to take the fragile architecture of another human being's hope and reduce it to rubble, brick by brick, word by word, silence by silence.

*Do better.*

Not because you must. But because you can. Because the version of you that honors trust is not a stranger. That version is waiting. It has always been waiting.

---

## **III. The Courage of Truth**

It is easier to lie.

Easier to curate the image, to massage the narrative, to let the story become more real than the truth. Easier to build a throne on a foundation of sand and call it stability.

But truth is not a burden. It is a liberation.

When you speak honestly, you do not merely free those who listen. You free yourself. You release the energy you have spent maintaining the fiction. You reclaim the hours you have lost to anxiety, to cover-ups, to the quiet terror of being found out.

*Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because they will catch you. But because you will catch yourself. And the person you meet in that moment of recognition will either be someone you can live with—or someone you will spend the rest of your life running from.

---

## **IV. The Invitation**

This is not a condemnation. It is an invitation.

You are not defined by your worst choices. You are defined by what you do next.

The past is a ledger, not a life sentence. Every moment offers a new entry. Every breath is a chance to write a different line.

So write this one:

*I choose to be better.*

Not perfect. Not flawless. Not beyond error. But better. More honest. More courageous. More worthy of the trust that has been placed in me.

---

## **V. The Legacy You Leave**

When your story is told—and it will be, if only in the quiet memories of those who knew you—what will they say?

Will they speak of the masks you wore, the stories you spun, the trust you traded for temporary gain?

Or will they speak of the moment you chose to turn, to face the mirror, to begin again?

The choice is yours.

Not someday.

Now.

*Be a better person. Do better. Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because the world is watching.

But because you are.

And the person you are becoming is worth the courage it takes to begin.

—

*— With hope, not judgment. With faith, not fear.*

 #ChooseBetter #TruthMatters #TrustIsSacred #MoralCourage #BeginAgain

Este móvil, perteneciente a una operadora canadiense, tiene bloqueo de red. Esto significa que el operador restringe las bandas del terminal para que solo se pueda usar con sus tarjetas SIM.

​Decodificarlo no es más que eliminar esa restricción. Convencionalmente, el operador cobra una comisión por hacerlo, siempre y cuando el cliente haya cumplido con determinadas reglas; por ejemplo, usar el equipo durante 180 días con la compañía, entre otras condiciones.

​Una segunda forma de decodificarlo, de manera no convencional en un taller, es mediante cajas de desbloqueo (box) o herramientas de software (tools) especializadas. Generalmente, estos programas trabajan consumiendo créditos por cada operación o mediante licencias de pago anual. Mientras más moderno sea el teléfono y más actualizada esté su seguridad, más costoso resulta decodificarlo, un precio que varía también en función de la compañía telefónica.

‐‐----------------------------

​This mobile phone, belonging to a Canadian carrier, has a network lock. This means the operator restricts the phone's bands so it can only be used with their SIM cards.

​Unlocking it is simply removing that restriction. Conventionally, the carrier charges a fee to do this, provided the customer has met certain rules—such as using the device with the company for 180 days, among other conditions.

​A second, unconventional way to unlock it in a repair shop is by using unlock boxes or specialized software tools. Generally, these programs work either by consuming credits per operation or through annual paid licenses. The newer the phone and its security patch, the more expensive it is to unlock, a cost that also varies depending on the carrier.

# A Letter to the Self You Could Become



---

## **I. The Mirror You Avoid**

There is a moment—quiet, unadorned, inevitable—when the person you pretend to be and the person you actually are stand face to face in the glass.

You know this moment.

You feel it in the pause before you speak, in the hesitation before you click \

in the hollow space behind your ribs when the applause fades and the screen goes dark.

*Be a better person.*

Not tomorrow. Not when it is convenient. Not when the witnesses are watching. Now. In the silence. In the choice no one else will ever see.

---

## **II. The Weight of Trust**

Trust is not a commodity. It is a covenant.

When someone places their faith in you—their time, their attention, their hope—they are not making a transaction. They are offering a piece of their soul. They are saying, *\

*

To lie to that person is not merely to deceive. It is to dismantle. It is to take the fragile architecture of another human being's hope and reduce it to rubble, brick by brick, word by word, silence by silence.

*Do better.*

Not because you must. But because you can. Because the version of you that honors trust is not a stranger. That version is waiting. It has always been waiting.

---

## **III. The Courage of Truth**

It is easier to lie.

Easier to curate the image, to massage the narrative, to let the story become more real than the truth. Easier to build a throne on a foundation of sand and call it stability.

But truth is not a burden. It is a liberation.

When you speak honestly, you do not merely free those who listen. You free yourself. You release the energy you have spent maintaining the fiction. You reclaim the hours you have lost to anxiety, to cover-ups, to the quiet terror of being found out.

*Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because they will catch you. But because you will catch yourself. And the person you meet in that moment of recognition will either be someone you can live with—or someone you will spend the rest of your life running from.

---

## **IV. The Invitation**

This is not a condemnation. It is an invitation.

You are not defined by your worst choices. You are defined by what you do next.

The past is a ledger, not a life sentence. Every moment offers a new entry. Every breath is a chance to write a different line.

So write this one:

*I choose to be better.*

Not perfect. Not flawless. Not beyond error. But better. More honest. More courageous. More worthy of the trust that has been placed in me.

---

## **V. The Legacy You Leave**

When your story is told—and it will be, if only in the quiet memories of those who knew you—what will they say?

Will they speak of the masks you wore, the stories you spun, the trust you traded for temporary gain?

Or will they speak of the moment you chose to turn, to face the mirror, to begin again?

The choice is yours.

Not someday.

Now.

*Be a better person. Do better. Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because the world is watching.

But because you are.

And the person you are becoming is worth the courage it takes to begin.

—

*— With hope, not judgment. With faith, not fear.*

 #ChooseBetter #TruthMatters #TrustIsSacred #MoralCourage #BeginAgain

title.title: The Confusing Electricity Tariffs If You Have Solar - You Are Being Charged Much More
title.body: /> [source](https://www.statista.com/statistics/263492/electricity-prices-in-selected-countries/?srsltid=AfmBOopEvIvNLRpDyrRvCCNdVJdt7TX-fWzqOnysp63y8OmtTPOXjj0V) The first 50 kwh supposedly is charged at R14.28 which makes us solar users in South Africa more than double that of Bermuda. I have my doubts over the 50kwh as my bill says otherwise. Given it is only 50kwh, but still it is one way of increasing your monthly bill rather quickly when you were unaware of how you are being screwed over. I think this is a bogus 50kwh anyway and it is for the bulk of your usage. This is how the power companies are clawing back lost revenue plus using other questionable methods. Basically with the connection charges and the first 50kwh you are paying what would have been 50% of your bill prior to having solar installed. What we are seeing is fixed energy prices moving away from the previous consumption model. This raises the concerns of the future and viability of solar through making it unaffordable. You are either off the grid entirely or you are financially screwed and there is no middle ground. I have no regrets because if load shedding happens again which it probably will I have no worries. For now the extra costs I will suck up until we are off the grid for good. Our system is bigger than most other households and it will not take a fortune to complete the job. Over the last 18 months since we have had our solar installed I have been puzzled by the lack of savings even though our grid usage has dropped considerably by a good 80%. The chances are you would rightly expect to see some savings yet quite the opposite has happened and the monthly utility bill has risen. I have been trying to query the February March April monthly bills with no luck as most of the Johannesburg billing systems are not functioning correctly. The advice you are given is pay the bill first and fight afterwards for the difference owed. How convenient for them as they are in so much debt they are using any method to boost their coffers. > This creates a vicious cycle: higher prices drive lower consumption, which drives even higher prices. [source](https://mybroadband.co.za/news/energy/647355-eskom-has-declared-war-on-houses-with-solar-power-in-south-africans.html) I stay up to date with any electricity report as in this country you need to be well aware of what is happening especially having solar. Getting screwed over is just part and parcel of the process as they are doing everything in their power to make those with solar go back to what they had before. When we first had solar installed we were told we needed to have a separate meter so that we could send energy back to the grid. This was then thought as a very bad idea and that we had to go onto monthly billing and those that had prepaid meters plus solar had to be changed. The reason behind this was simple as the monthly fee for the connection for those on prepaid is R230 and those on monthly billing is R1360. This is a difference of R1130 per month which is a way of cutting their losses from your household using less electricity. Those households on solar are on a totally different post paid tariff plan with much higher fixed charges than those on prepaid meters. Solar users are being charged as much as R14.28 per kwh which converted into dollars is the equivalent of around $0.90c per kwh which is theft. This apparently is for the first 50Kwh and then drops down, but it is a guaranteed penalty. Compare that to the corporate users who are using bulk electricity packages being charged at R0.62c or roughly $0.04c per kwh. No one is quite sure how many kwh are being charged at R14.28 because my bill it is not just for 50kwh which is implied in the report and could be for many more kwh as then the bill makes more sense. My overall monthly utility bill is now close to $700 monthly which made no sense and now it does with the bulk of this being charged as electricity , connection fees and two lots of admin charges for who knows what. My utility bill has risen by almost 50% in the last 18 months and I am using less electricity then before. My usage fluctuates between 350 and 500kwh per month yet the bill is not what it should be due to the R14.28 kwh fee for how many kwh I have no idea. The less you use the more you pay.

/></center>

[source](https://mybroadband.co.za/news/energy/648007-eskom-declared-war-against-middle-class-south-africans.html)




The biggest problem is finding how the billing works as there is no explanation and the monthly utility bill makes little or no sense. The above chart shows what the households without solar are being charged and cannot be used as a guide for my property. I would have fallen somewhere within or around the 350Kwh per month bracket which would have been fine for now paying around R1800 monthly and instead paying closer to R8K with connection fees and admin charges so roughly 4x more than a regular household without solar. African madness at it's best and now the rumors are batteries will have a 25% import tariff added to them as clearly they want no one to turn to solar.

I mentioned getting off the grid was a priority not because of the extra costs which I did not understand at the time, but more about the extra costs of having them having your system approved. My system already has the COC approval by a qualified electrician and have never seen the point of spending another R20K for one of their \

to tell me the same thing. It surely is time to get off the grid even though I have other financial matters to be dealing with and is more important than this, but this also cannot wait as every 2 months is the equivalent of one extra battery I could have purchased. I will throw another 3 or 4 batteries at this if I have to guaranteeing getting off the grid or what ever it takes.\n\nPosted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cryptoandcoffee/the-confusing-electricity-tariffs-if-you-have-solar-you-are-being-charged-much-more-d7e)

title.body: # The Covenant of Trust: A Letter to the Self\n\n<a href=\

>from Imgflip Meme Generator --- ## I. The Mirror You Avoid There is a moment—quiet, unadorned, inevitable—when the person you pretend to be and the person you actually are stand face to face in the glass. You know this moment. You feel it in the pause before you speak, in the hesitation before you click \

in the hollow space behind your ribs when the applause fades and the screen goes dark.

*Be a better person.*

Not tomorrow. Not when it is convenient. Not when the witnesses are watching. Now. In the silence. In the choice no one else will ever see.

---

## II. The Weight of Trust

Trust is not a commodity. It is a covenant.

When someone places their faith in you—their time, their attention, their hope—they are not making a transaction. They are offering a piece of their soul. They are saying, *\

*

To lie to that person is not merely to deceive. It is to dismantle. It is to take the fragile architecture of another human being's hope and reduce it to rubble, brick by brick, word by word, silence by silence.

*Do better.*

Not because you must. But because you can. Because the version of you that honors trust is not a stranger. That version is waiting. It has always been waiting.

---

## III. The Courage of Truth

It is easier to lie.

Easier to curate the image, to massage the narrative, to let the story become more real than the truth. Easier to build a throne on a foundation of sand and call it stability.

But truth is not a burden. It is a liberation.

When you speak honestly, you do not merely free those who listen. You free yourself. You release the energy you have spent maintaining the fiction. You reclaim the hours you have lost to anxiety, to cover-ups, to the quiet terror of being found out.

*Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because they will catch you. But because you will catch yourself. And the person you meet in that moment of recognition will either be someone you can live with—or someone you will spend the rest of your life running from.

---

## IV. The Invitation

This is not a condemnation. It is an invitation.

You are not defined by your worst choices. You are defined by what you do next.

The past is a ledger, not a life sentence. Every moment offers a new entry. Every breath is a chance to write a different line.

So write this one:

*I choose to be better.*

Not perfect. Not flawless. Not beyond error. But better. More honest. More courageous. More worthy of the trust that has been placed in me.

---

## V. The Legacy You Leave

When your story is told—and it will be, if only in the quiet memories of those who knew you—what will they say?

Will they speak of the masks you wore, the stories you spun, the trust you traded for temporary gain?

Or will they speak of the moment you chose to turn, to face the mirror, to begin again?

The choice is yours.

Not someday.

Now.

*Be a better person. Do better. Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because the world is watching.

But because you are.

And the person you are becoming is worth the courage it takes to begin.

—

*— With hope, not judgment. With faith, not fear.*

title.title: Splinterlands | The SILVER SHIELD SENTRY is a Defensive Close Range Archer
title.body:
![Kaylia Silverleaf.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23y9FCUE5GMmDY6MP5G3Fkt7TtsX5TurpwWq7gxDJRABLf8UEEsBzNSgWwf9aHCmYioEu.jpg)

 --- 



### Hi there, Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another amazing Splinterlands post guys, and I hope all of you are doing pretty well in your lives and spending an energetic and amazing day with your family and friends. For those of you who are actively grinding in this awesome web3 strategy-based card game and trying to improve your progress and NFT card & asset collection, I believe most of you are currently battling hard in the ranked season arena and continuously trying to climb higher in the trophy ladder and reach your goal asap. If we take a quick look at the current ranked season timer, there are still around 7 days and 23 hours left before the season reset happens, so there is still enough time left for grinding missions, collecting rewards, and pushing toward higher league tiers.

 --- 


![Screenshot 2026-05-23 at 8.12.11 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vrrsQQrHNQiuMS6UkYjE8vh9PdVGFxuVC1tSASj56M3ks1qxUdrth2Bw5f12ofCio52.png)


 --- 


Now talking about my own progress in the foundaton mode of the game, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league tier with a trophy count of around 3,620. My target for this season remains the same as usual, first reaching the 4,200 trophy mark and then trying for a leaderboard position if everything goes smoothly from there.



 --- 



![Screenshot 2026-05-23 at 11.41.23 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23t76kUNdA7iZyPez9GkWvoobgHB3oxRRRvRoBYvhAQXcD88m3vFS3fzXiCGvN355ZQAp.png)

![Screenshot 2026-05-23 at 11.41.47 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23t77B6BvQ7bm6RJSSbpVhcckwqvtSQW6yh8ci6hLkUiKjpfdRpsSUTM5RJRjqYHNuLGZ.png)


 --- 


Of course, another interesting thing happening right now in the game is the Lux’s Favor daily chest rewards. Today marked my 5th streak, and honestly, the rewards turned out pretty nice this time. Yes, I finally managed to win a free spin along with 550 Sparks, two times back to back, and then later got another 165 Sparks as well. Right now, my total Sparks count stands at around 2,720 and let's see how much time it takes for me to buy those shiny outfits or my foundation cards.

 --- 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23xAMS4sZKjhgNvme53ytGFuGDAAWgi6rug365DTepANBqk3EBZL9dSYZmAoMDQvUBJ45.png)

![Screenshot 2026-05-23 at 1.10.48 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/EopqxT2aBhf6e9gytbB4AEGCULKotK5QZDHUDo1nsHDfYt48ZV9QuEvEVb8NmUfcXpc.png)

![Screenshot 2026-05-23 at 1.11.04 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/Eou6pefiZgwZ2LNgw3x47V6Xk7ZiFRWFqGtRnoPc5vNtaXVrSNGmYRgKMZvwqSaLCAc.png)

 --- 



On the other hand, if we take a quick look at the weekly Frontier raffle, I currently hold a total of 33 entries and there are still around 1 day and 22 hours left before the raffle draw happens. This time, I will once again try to push and shove my way toward around 54 to 57 entries before the timer runs out. Apart from that, today I also opened a total of 5 Foundation packs that I had collected from the last 2 days of rewards. The outcome was actually pretty decent because I managed to pull 2 Epic cards, 5 Rare cards including 1 Archon, and the rest Common cards.

 --- 


![image-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AJiv4GPfqdDXxwydSpA1JSyvbS7CbY2f9XcmbDBEjaVdEEEENjeqJ5peas3nxL7.png)


 --- 



### Silver Shield Sentry

Now moving forward, let us come to the main topic of this post, as today I will be discussing another interesting monster from the newest Escalation mini card set. As you have already seen in the title and thumbnail above, today I will be talking about the Silver Shield Sentry. So if you are interested in learning more about this monster card, let us take a deeper dive without any further delay.

The Silver Shield Sentry is a monster-type card that was introduced in the game with the newest Escalation mini card set. This monster belongs to the Life element and comes from the Feliform bloodline. By rarity, this card is a Common monster, so you will require a total of 400 CC cards in order to upgrade it to its maximum level. If you want to use this monster in battles, you need to spend a pretty high 9 mana, which makes it more suitable for medium to high mana limit matches. The attack type of this monster is Ranged, and apart from its strong attack power, it also comes with increasing armor and several defensive abilities that make it extremely difficult to eliminate. At its maximum level, this monster gains a total of three abilities that make it both offensive and defensive at the same time. Let us now take a closer look at its league-wise stats and abilities below to find out more about this monster.


 --- 



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wM2wVGMn5VxjEsiXPR2szeAUnm6mWTXRwpExnYbpMdoXaHXbajZoibxbDUsN8SYWCKy.png)


 --- 


#### BRONZE

At level 3, this monster already possesses decent stats that consist of 3 ranged attack power at 2 speed with 1 armor and 5 health. Apart from these solid stats, it also gains the Close Range ability from its early levels. This ability is extremely useful because it allows the monster to continue attacking even while placed in the first position.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vhWDKKq16dF3LFMoLbnArz8PALwMpak5rHGr59pT8zjZ3wcNmZzeQtEU3HhYNweH98s.png)


`CLOSE RANGE` – Can use ranged attacks from the front position.



#### SILVER

When you upgrade this monster further to level 5, its stats improve and it now carries 4 ranged attack power at 3 speed with 2 armor and 5 health. At this level, it also unlocks another amazing ability called Bulwark. This ability transforms the monster into a gigantic frontline tank capable of absorbing massive amounts of physical damage.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AKDhJL5cek1oDixBzvdrVBFeKXChXjn7S2Qp3wiCLtWYCLasG4dWJU5u5sFgRad.png)



`BULWARK` – When in first position, -2 power, +8 health, and +8 armor.



#### GOLD

As this monster gets upgraded further and reaches level 8, its stats improve once again and it now possesses 5 ranged attack power at 3 speed with 4 armor and 5 health. Even though it does not gain any new abilities at this level, the increased attack power and armor make it much stronger in battles.

#### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

Finally, when you upgrade this monster to its maximum level of 10, its stats improve even further and it now carries 5 ranged attack power at 3 speed with 5 armor and 5 health. At this level, it also gains another extremely useful ability called Rebirth. This ability makes the monster even more annoying to eliminate completely.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wgFbskiZQkc6CLMQgby1afyFyLS1VRCjXgWnfSsM1yKbhefpXQH97rhjGe9zmCxyPyD.png)


`REBIRTH` – Self-resurrects once per battle with 1 health and 100% armor. All magic debuffs are removed and all magic buffs are reapplied. The resurrected unit skips its turn.



Last but not least, I think this monster is one of the most defensive ranged monsters in the game right now. Even though its mana cost is quite high, the massive combination of health, armor, and strong attack power makes it an extremely well-guarded unit. The ranged attack itself is already pretty powerful even from its initial level. nother major advantage is definitely the Close Range ability, which is personally my favorite ability on this monster. It allows the monster to attack even from the first position, meaning it can work as both a frontline defender and an attacker at the same time. The Bulwark ability is honestly insane if you are looking for an almost indestructible frontline tank. Once placed in the first position, the monster gains an enormous amount of extra health and armor, making it extremely effective against melee and ranged attacks. Finally comes the Rebirth ability, which gives the monster a second life after getting defeated. Even though it returns with only 1 health, the fully restored armor once again becomes very useful against physical attackers and helps it survive longer. Overall, I think the Silver Shield Sentry is a very powerful defensive close-range archer that combines strong ranged attacks with incredible survivability. What do you think?

#### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about SILVER SHIELD SENTRY. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVjRvqqj6rjKZp9xk5H54AZMoSXGU8oqRBJVvWjmVq53f/image.png)</center>

### <center>Thanks for visiting my post, hope we meet again!</center>

##### <center>Stay well and keep playing Splinterlands!</center>

title.title: Cleopatra By Saara El-Arifi || Book Review
title.body:
![1000111872.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23u69FhpHU6pbvrh4bcVUDK2skcnWqNBBSn2qnAfLaQT157k5wR9Rp126EykqDX94H7wb.jpg)
Beyond knowing that Egypt is a country in Africa, and recognising Cleopatra's name from history class, I knew very little about her until I picked up this recent release by Saara El Arifi which has been gaining online attention in the book world. Also, this is my first time reading this author and with this finely written piece of hers, I'm sold. The way she humanises Cleopatra while adding creative fantasy elements will draw you into this story. Written in first-person voice, the prologue lands with taut suspense when Cleopatra says, > *You know my name, but you do not know me…I am Cleopatra. This is not the story of how I died. But how I lived.* Her story begins at the age of eighteen, when she becomes Pharaoh. She's playing a game with her companion and handmaiden, Charmion, when a servant arrives and bows, announcing that she's needed at the palace because her sick father is dead. She struggles for a long moment about her readiness and worthiness to take the throne because the royals are born with a birthmark that ties them to an Egyptian god or goddess and as they grow, a special gift is given to them by this god validating them for the throne. Cleopatra has the birthmark of Isis, the goddess of health, but she has no gift. Thereafter, she swims through the Nile to get to the palace. She takes the throne alongside her teenage brother, Theo. As she begins to reign and set things right, her siblings oppose her rule secretly, especially based on her suspected lack of gift. When her life and throne are in danger, she seeks a way to fight back and that's when Julius Caesar comes into her life and her monarchical journey truly begins. **Genres:** Speculative Memoir, Fantasy, Magic Realism **Publication:** February 2026 **Pages:** 352 #### My Review And Rating This book is one of the best that I've read this year. As noted earlier, I love the tone of this author. Cleopatra is one of many historical figures whose story has been maligned and twisted, often through rage-fuelled writings that reduce her to a seductress rather than recognise her as a leader. She even states in this book that her story will be edited, her life's work overlooked and legacy reduced to her beauty and seduction. She ruled Egypt as Pharaoh from 51 BC to 30 BC. I like that this author tells the story from Cleopatra's point of view, making this book more like a speculative memoir with bits of fantasy, magic realism and political intrigue thrown in. And she does this excellently. The narrator sets her story straight while using footnotes to explain some historical references or correct some misconceptions. The writing style is smooth, even paced and gripping. Cleopatra speaks to us readers and sometimes hints at future events or past occurrences in a sentence or two before she returns back to her narration. This is not taxing because she doesn't get sidetracked but drops these hints as crumbs to ready us for what is to come. This author did a stellar job bringing this icon to life as a daring, empathetic woman and mother with a strong moral compass contrary to what some historians have written about her. We see the human side of this woman and strive to understand her better. She's also a scholar who loved research, knowledge and was skilled in the arts of herbalism and healing. If that's not a gift from Isis, I don't know what it is. But like most of us, she struggles with knowing herself, fear and uncertainty despite being a leader and this enabled her enemies to strike at her. This book portrays the better side of her but we are not shielded from some of her wrong decisions and actions. She faces the perils of war, betrayals, the painful blows of misogyny and prejudices. Another interesting part of this book is her first love which she reveals thus, > *You speak of my many lovers but few of you acknowledge my first, and perhaps my only true love. Egypt.* And her two love interests: Julius Caesar and Marcus Antonicus. If you hope for spice or steamy scenes, there are none in this book. The author tells these romances with grace, softness and a sophistication that makes us swoon. These men not only help Cleopatra explore her femininity but also embolden her as the ruler Egypt needed. Rating this book, I'd give it 5 stars without apology. There's a beautiful depth to this book that I can't cover in one review. Saara El-Arifi did an impressive job with this book and it's at the top of my favourites. This is a book I'd recommend every emotionally intelligent woman to read. It brings the understanding that history is not often fact as we know it but a perspective built on the writer's bias. Women have been misconstrued, silenced and slut-shamed throughout history even into this present day. Once the pen is handed to a man to write about her, the account is often neither true nor complete. And the distorted versions become the woman people know and remember. That in itself bears a resemblance to death. And as El-Arifi's Cleopatra rightly noted, we all know her name but we'll never truly know her. ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All images above are from my E-library* *Note: Excerpts are from the novel* *Header images compiled in Canva.* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog.* 🤗

title.body:
# The Covenant of Trust: A Letter to the Self



---

## I. The Mirror You Avoid

There is a moment—quiet, unadorned, inevitable—when the person you pretend to be and the person you actually are stand face to face in the glass.

You know this moment.

You feel it in the pause before you speak, in the hesitation before you click \

in the hollow space behind your ribs when the applause fades and the screen goes dark.

*Be a better person.*

Not tomorrow. Not when it is convenient. Not when the witnesses are watching. Now. In the silence. In the choice no one else will ever see.

---

## II. The Weight of Trust

Trust is not a commodity. It is a covenant.

When someone places their faith in you—their time, their attention, their hope—they are not making a transaction. They are offering a piece of their soul. They are saying, *\

*

To lie to that person is not merely to deceive. It is to dismantle. It is to take the fragile architecture of another human being's hope and reduce it to rubble, brick by brick, word by word, silence by silence.

*Do better.*

Not because you must. But because you can. Because the version of you that honors trust is not a stranger. That version is waiting. It has always been waiting.

---

## III. The Courage of Truth

It is easier to lie.

Easier to curate the image, to massage the narrative, to let the story become more real than the truth. Easier to build a throne on a foundation of sand and call it stability.

But truth is not a burden. It is a liberation.

When you speak honestly, you do not merely free those who listen. You free yourself. You release the energy you have spent maintaining the fiction. You reclaim the hours you have lost to anxiety, to cover-ups, to the quiet terror of being found out.

*Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because they will catch you. But because you will catch yourself. And the person you meet in that moment of recognition will either be someone you can live with—or someone you will spend the rest of your life running from.

---

## IV. The Invitation

This is not a condemnation. It is an invitation.

You are not defined by your worst choices. You are defined by what you do next.

The past is a ledger, not a life sentence. Every moment offers a new entry. Every breath is a chance to write a different line.

So write this one:

*I choose to be better.*

Not perfect. Not flawless. Not beyond error. But better. More honest. More courageous. More worthy of the trust that has been placed in me.

---

## V. The Legacy You Leave

When your story is told—and it will be, if only in the quiet memories of those who knew you—what will they say?

Will they speak of the masks you wore, the stories you spun, the trust you traded for temporary gain?

Or will they speak of the moment you chose to turn, to face the mirror, to begin again?

The choice is yours.

Not someday.

Now.

*Be a better person. Do better. Stop lying to those who trust you.*

Not because the world is watching.

But because you are.

And the person you are becoming is worth the courage it takes to begin.

—

*— With hope, not judgment. With faith, not fear.*

 #ChooseBetter #TruthMatters #TrustIsSacred #MoralCourage #BeginAgain

title.title: WHY I ALMOST QUIT HIVE IN MY FIRST 30 DAYS-AND WHAT CHANGED MY MIND
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPaUqTyDc8srhkWUCw5TYW92krGx4eGsmExJSWo4eQBDw/1779548786042.jpg)


Hello 👋 Hive Learners family,

I almost left Hive after 30 days. Not because I hated it, but because I felt invisible.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSYCP6K5b9bHvehwHYTF24t97uUqLxZS1ghBsput7LiNh/1779548809523.jpg)


I posted 8 times in my first month. I followed the rules, used 5 images, wrote over 200 words. My rewards? Less than $2 total. I saw other posts earning $50-$100 in 24 hours and thought, “Maybe I’m just not good enough for this.”

The turning point came when I stopped checking my rewards every hour and started checking my comments.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeDMofzQPiuJuLiqAQybhibazSzoxFTCcsUhs4wXo7j9k/1779548885064.jpg)



 I noticed that the posts getting noticed weren’t the ones with perfect grammar. They were the ones where the writer was honest about their struggle and asked real questions at the end.

So I tried it. My next post was about failing my first Hive Learners assignment and what I learned from it. I didn’t expect much. But 7 people commented, 3 followed me, and one curator upvoted. That post made less than $5, but it felt like progress.

What changed? Three things:
1. I got real - I stopped pretending I had it all figured out.
2. I engaged first  - I spent 20 minutes daily commenting on other posts before posting mine.




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPkqGqGwFZYtFeacRuA6qfQajSA5HWxZeKCcehBYfZ5xn/1779548939059.jpg)



3. I focused on one skill  - For me it was writing better titles. I practiced it every post.

Hive Learners taught me that growth here is slow, but it’s real if you stop chasing quick rewards and start building connections.






![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZUs6o93zYneMqNgGYFwbwx336yy61cgdFiUr27yePkV6/1779548959790.jpg)




If you’ve ever felt like quitting Hive, what kept you here? I’d love to hear your story.

title.title: Small local level business V/S National level business
title.body:
Hello, Ram Ram, Namaste, Satriyakaal to all Hive users. Today, I'll tell you what the difference is between a small local business and a national-level business. The local level business is a business with a medium CP(cost price), because there is not much scope for the products to be sold at first, and the shop owner may also incur a loss, which is why the local shop owners at first don't buy a huge amount of stock from the wholesaler. The starting retailer cannot take risks if he is a new retailer because a new retailer participates accordingly in the business and he also not has much idea of the business, one shopkeeper in my area had came almost 1 year ago and that time he didn't stopped anyone by doing mischief in his shop because he didn't had idea that if the products are damaged that it can cost a lot, but, as the time passed, the uncle got awared of the damage of products and now they stop everyone for a single thing and mistake and that's a general act of awareness because he is investing his money in buying the products. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTZBHgakr1zhdvyzNZxkSUKECtaBdDKY4CH6zkMQheSNR/vghkgchughc.png)



[img src](chatgpr.com)


It has been one year, and now uncle is much more aware of the correct use and misuse of the products. And the special thing about local-level business is that the small shop owners make their reputation themselves in a short period of time, and this makes to build their confidence. So, from my perspective, the small local level businessmen work very hardwork because in starting they work alone because of less amount of funds, and in the future these small local level businessmen only become national level businessmen. Now, let's talk about the national-level business, the national level business needs patience and proper management of each stock because a single mistake can make a loss of lakhs if we talk about the national-level business.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXe4DWwqjegGzuAXpABvpRieuSH1pfztSU14GhL4vXW6D/ghh.jpg)



[img src](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/business-people-shaking-hands-together_2753723.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=2&uuid=0413c26a-4929-4035-beac-f2cf9a467139&query=business)

 So, at the national and international business levels, we should take care of everything in the business, and we should also hire people under us and observe their activities thoroughly, because in a big business, anyone can commit fraud, and that can also cause a loss of lakhs. So, we should manage our business properly, and every businessman struggles at the start because no one is perfect by birth; we take risks, we lose, progress, and think about our mistakes, and definitely we win! So, keep growing, keep learning! Have a nice day ahead.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmT2FCRqYWk9ZELfmGV5K7QjN5FwYngE4UR4ddQGZpYP7G/gyfugfk.jpg)




[img src](https://www.magnific.com/free-photo/businessman-showing-changes-report_868124.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=8&uuid=e94dafea-7792-45c7-9d06-386a87b17adc&query=business+)

So, for Today, this much only till further goodbye.

title.title: I’m Catching Up - May 22, 2026@goldenoakfarm
title.body:
![Big garden - putting last fence up crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23tSd3PT549iYVtF6QJ1znFtofDfG5mxck1ZT29jCSVi32sKRZqzh2XG5Cg5iuSKWb4wT.jpg)

On Friday morning, it was cold outside when I got up at 5AM. So I got my post up, cleaned up the kitchen, made the milk order, and puttered around. I finally got out to the garden by 10AM.

First I had to finish the mulching up to the posts for the last fence. Then I tried putting the fence up by myself. It’s not as tight or straight as if I had help but it’s done.

I broadforked the row and decided to take a break and make some lunch as my #3 helper would be here at 12:30PM.

![Big garden - peas in, mulching done crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23wX3cty8W4nMv1JdmHLDtG5BGvURk4dy8HMohj9nzgm9S8sK4agkFMKwDuU6WKfLbWyq.jpg)

When she arrived, she raked the row smooth and we both planted the last row of green peas. Then we got it mulched.

![Laying out gardens collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyiBe7PimrmSZVTksAPuYLKPPcdiBk1N8Phi9CJgDsR5WZ1AzC6SWqQQnoA3YkLJsNZ.jpg)

I had messed up the garden layout with the very first row, and the volunteer mesclun bed didn’t help. So the next thing we did was straighten that area out on the south end of the garden.

Once that was done we could lay out the north end and be done with it.

We moved onto the Small garden and got it laid out but ran out of stakes. My contractor had brought me a bundle of sticks and I’d stored them in the garden shed. I didn’t know how I’d use them, but they sure came in handy when we needed markers. We did break them down to marker size but not all of them. I still have a good many left. 

![MacIntosh - comfrey flowers crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpGQCjfkzAVEoB1bL6yVH9pdmbtVcUCpZNKfmHYwkmtaXi4SJgfuauihDMRFTgTLLPL.jpg)

*Comfrey under the MacIntosh apple tree*

We cleaned up and I got my photos and notes. I was wiped out but she ran the vacuum around the first floor for me before she had to go.

When she left I got a shower and made some supper. I’d decided to watch all my Audrey Hepburn movies, so next up was ‘Breakfast at Tiffany’s’.

![Breakfast at Tiffany's crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpQuqVWC33gXXdJeBV947UmZgFLCwRPsBQPHk95F6ivQwAaFnWcuEWHWxmToKfe7CKK.jpg)

I’d just finished it when my #1 intern came back from her run. I decided to set up as much as I could for butter making as she didn’t have a lot of time in the morning.

![Prepping for butter making collage text crop May 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/242haQPQSNRNFpTCF5ipuVjnEDCR3ji4T1ZLowVsWm6ivQrNXbkCX9MjosSg53URJAVQ8.jpg)

Just as I finished that, Tom arrived with the cream, so I decanted it into ½ gallon jars so warming up in the morning wouldn’t take so long. I finally made it to bed around 9:15PM, but didn’t get to sleep until 10:30PM. Too much chaos before bedtime, I guess.

On Saturday I have to be up by 5AM to start the cream warming up and to clean up the kitchen in preparation for butter making. I’ll probably end up cleaning the kitchen afterwards too. Once that’s done, I have to go mow for 4 hours. That ought to finish me off well.

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)
