title.title: The Most Satisfying Weekend Was Meeting My Former Boss at Another Event After I Quit.
title.body:
This particular weekend keeps coming to my mind and I can but write about it. I do a lot of things, one of which is being a chef/caterer, and I work for various caterers, event planners and all. But then, it's been a while since I went for any of those works, reason being that I lost interest in the whole thing when I had an experience with one of the women I work for.



![1000488052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23uQxipD29P8RZWRqXzKaZdKck5pGnmV986HHxJXJNc8FcrYYQNTrJS37smdacrpLT89D.jpg)


So, I have always seen it happening, the way she talks to her workers and all, including aged people, people who are way older than she is. I have been keeping my cool, and like she always says, I'm gentle. But with calmness, I hate disrespect. One of those weekends we were at work cooking, and making sure things are set before the commencement of the wedding program. That was how she started raining curse words on this older woman, even if the woman has done something bad and all, you don't need to start using curse words on her, one of this woman's daughter was there as well, and I saw how she felt, she just couldn't speak up for her mum.




I would have talked at that instant, but I had a rethink and wouldn't want the matter to drag. So, later when she(our boss) was alone, I walked up to her, greeted her and told her politely how what she did was wrong. Well, she just eyed me and told me to face what I came for. 
![1000066355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23wgPfW6mpzHd5EVHrdQmV3jEmKy6HGGsHfFAioEG4mKVRGnCnP6i1i8kmETqu69JGyHA.jpg)


It was that experience that made me know we won't last, I can't work for long with such a person. So,b what made me actually stopped working for her and for others generally was what happened at another event on a weekend. What happened is just too small to get talked down on that much, she asked me to carry something, and I went to clear the place I'm to put the stuff first, after I was done, I went to call someone that can help, since I alone cannot carry the package. This woman returned to her car, found out I'm just about to carry it with the person I went to call for help and began to shout and talk.






They were not small talks, very hurting ones. Seh talked down on me, cursed me, shouted, yelled and said all sort of things. I was pained. Even though everyone around was trying to calm her down and those that were there were even trying to do the explanations for me that I wasn't playing or wasting time, I was actually doing what she requested, she didn't listen. 


I almost lost my cool, like ... I almost acted up too. I didn't tell her sorry like some asked me to, I haven't done anything, and I don't deserve what she's doing to me, none of us working for her deserves the kind of treatment she gives to us. The fact that we are working for you does not make us less of a human, we have dignity, and we deserve some respect too.



![1000488053.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xVKHT5tKuSpCnoPFe79mg6KFyFt5QgRdgpypmSCm8KJWHTEEBq6MEZYJ8KGEczU72sy.jpg)



I told her its my last time working for her, but I guess she thought it was a joke. Har son reached out to me the following weekend and the next after that, and I keep telling them I'm done. That was how I stopped going for any event work. I stayed away, even in days when I know I'm broke and needed money, I still tell them no.



Not long ago, I resume working. Yea, but not with that woman. I've met her at two different events after I stopped working for her. I remember her son calling me for this last work we did and I told him I mean it when I said I can no longer work for them, know the most funniest part... We met that weekend at an event. She was the chef for the groom side while I was working with the chef for the brides side 😀😀😀.


![1000488051.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23x1AzGauFYvgykLyyene53HJdMH3ZAPAHAfYYdBV4LfyYsu8NMMaWFDubZUV5uhKzuER.jpg)


I'm now carefully choosing who and who I will work with, and I've settled for those that know how to treat others well. And the food we cooked, common... It didn't just look beautiful, it tasted same.




That weekend is one to be remembered. Our eyes kept meeting at the event, and me I didn't even flinch. My boss is treating me well, you on your part can keep treating your workers the way you like, and you will find them leaving/quitting one after the other....just like I did.







🌹

**Images are mine.**

**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

❣️❣️❣️

香辣鸡丁是一道让人一吃就停不下来的美味佳肴。每一口都带有酥脆的口感和浓郁的香辣味，令人感受到那种独特的刺激。鸡肉鲜嫩多汁，与香料和辣椒完美融合，辛辣的味道在舌尖舞动，令人回味无穷。搭配米饭更是绝配，让人忍不住想再来一碗！这道菜真是让我对香辣美食的热爱又上升了一个层次。

昨天晚上熬了个雷霆大夜，因为试着编辑文章在hive上发表，我打字又比较慢还得抠字眼，已经很晚了，但昨天一整天都在上课，然后去看魔术，还没来及好好玩玩，所以这波又贪心玩手机了，又熬到很晚……
 
早上九点自然醒的，这个点吃早饭午饭都不合适，所以我决定搞一下选修课《数字音乐制作》的旋律制作作业，不搞不知道，一搞吓一跳，我这个门外汉旋律、和声、节奏啥的完全不懂，之前上课也没学到些什么，竟然就这么指望我写首歌出来？
 
我真服了，之前啥都不知道，还不自量力地兴冲冲地选了这门课想着大刀阔斧操练一番，这下好了，给自己挖了个无底洞出来……
 
好不容易会操作Cubase的基础工具了，细看作业发现那岂止只要我的几个音符啊，感情啥都想要啊，那我真没招了。

因为24号晚上就截止作业了，我现在以百倍速度都速成不了……

这下真没招了，我只好寄希望于万能的闲鱼，指望从某人手中直接买一个他的成品，即使是儿歌都行啊！只要完成作业的要求即可。
 
这个过程也不容易，要求谈妥了价格说不定，有的连价格都谈不明白，最后可算找到一个好心人，愿意20元给我一个他的工程。我明白他们搞音乐这块非常非常烧钱、耗时费力，所以我不是嫌他们贵，只是我自己不愿意在一门水课上花这么多钱……
 
最后一切落定时已经下午三点多了，大半天就这么过去了。
 
昨天尽写魔术了，我的昨天可比今天精彩多了，还没来得及写下。虽然昨天满课，但我课上都在自主学习，下午的两大节小课也签到后就超了干自己的事（翘课这玩意——想就别怕，怕就别翘——其实翘不翘都无所谓，老师上课我们干什么他也不管，只是他得讲课，我得带着耳机听课，这样声音要放好大还不清晰，所以干脆找个空教室自己外放多舒服）干自己的事就会一心一意干进去啊，也不强人所难，这大学好多好多事都强人所难——把我给整老了……
 
不过无所谓了，我之后都不会比现在的我年轻了，既然没人记录关注我，我就把镜头对准我自己好了，毕竟未来也只有我会回过头来翻看了，那时候的我肯定又会觉得现在的我很年轻快乐吧！

还有还有，这周三我去了本部看他们各种比赛路演，我没有串场成，因为我不是正装出席的，其实我还是有些害怕自己也不愿意上去，我就被安排计时。好无聊啊，学到了些东西但不多，好多感觉很高深莫测我小资历听不懂，而且我晕车了，一直迷迷糊糊的啥都听不进去就只想回来躺着，唉……回来路上晕吐了，多亏司机师傅有个袋子，可算把我弄回来了。那天我好难受啊，吃过饭就一直躺着，难难受受的睡着了，好像也是那天我感慨我老了——晕车真要了我的命了，咋办啊晕成这样，生不如死的晕😵‍💫上次晕车我就感觉自己老了，每次晕车我就感觉自己老了不中了……😭

昨天学姐给我们送来了我们的过去帮忙的奖励，很好喝很高兴看完表演还有奶茶喝，但我不想再晕车了，我实在受不了了……

还有现在翻找图片才想起来的，昨天在下雨啊！很漂亮很畅快的一场雨，悄悄然想小天使一样来了，又悄咪咪的走了，太好了，早上起来发现下雨我都高兴坏了，一天也因为这场雨美妙了起来，拍了好多照片，留下来好多美好的瞬间和回忆！

---

title.title: Damselfly Macro
title.body:
They have a somewhat similar look to dragonflies, but they are typically smaller, and their wings rest very close to their bodies on their sides. I find them sitting still a little more often at different times of day, whereas dragonflies can be very active and require more patience when waiting for one to land. This damselfly had a shiny metallic, almost liquid metal, look to its upper body, which is how I spotted it.

title.title: A Sunset Felucca Boat Ride on the Nile
title.body: There are some experiences that you feel obligated to have, when <a href=\

>visiting Luxor. And one of those is getting out onto the Nile. Shortly before sunset, the river is invaded by an army of Feluccas. But if you’d like to hop onto one of these picturesque boats, bring your nerves, patience, and a willingness to fight. Because you’re either going to be haggling, or getting ripped off.\n\n

/> Before heading out, try to pick a day with a breeze — more on this soon. And don’t arrive to the banks of the river too early, when the operators aren’t yet desperate enough to strike a good bargain. Don’t show up too late, either! You’ll want to see the sun actually set, and you don’t want to be panicked about making it out on time. The felucca boatmen have years of experience in reading tourists, and will sense your weakness instantly. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=swOJDMzpO98 We knew the rules, and marched down to the pier with just the right amount of confidence. That is, we were 100% positive we were about to get ripped off, but confident that it wouldn’t be too much. (One of the biggest mistakes foreigners make when haggling on someone else’s turf, is clinging to the belief that they have to “win”. Let go of that, it won’t happen.) After being approached by a few different guys, we settled on the one who seemed least obnoxious, and talked him down to nearly half his initial offer. He didn’t seem irritated once we got onto the water, which is a sign that we probably still paid way too much. But everyone was satisfied, so it wasn’t a bad outcome.

/> Unfortunately, we had been so concerned with the haggling, that we neglected one of the other rules of Felucca Boat Riding: choosing a day with at least some wind. The weather this evening was so still, that the feluccas’ massive sails were rendered mostly useless. After idling about near the docks for too long, our captain hired some kids with a motorboat to drag us into the middle of the river. We never so much “sailed” as were “slowly pushed by the river”. But it was hard to complain. We were sitting on the Nile with a view of the setting sun, holding cups of strong tea that our captain had prepared. It didn’t take long for the residual stress from haggling to evaporate, and once the calls to prayer began sounding from all the mosques in the city, the atmosphere was positively magical. While we waited for the flow of the Nile to push us back into shore, the captain took full advantage of his captive audience to offer us 1001 other experiences he could arrange for us. And no amount of negative replies would deter him. We were learning that the locals here don’t believe in taking “no” for an answer. Aggravating and an unfortunate, unavoidable finale to what had been a nice evening, but we were feeling too chilled-out to be bothered by it. From our

>

title.title: A satisfying afternoon.
title.body:
> ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRpuTWBZxg1AszHMTX7aqJwgKwYnBFjh8S2SYm9jFD3eR/1779548006379.jpg) Today's afternoon was spent with friends in a different way. A sudden plan was made to go to the famous sweet shop in the area. To be honest, when friends are chatting, intense hunger and craving for sweets come together. Then all the rules of diet were blown away in a flash. As soon as we stepped into the shop, the familiar sweet smell around us made us feel good. We ordered hot rasgolla and langcha, straight from the stove. It was a sight to behold, floating in a thick, sugary syrup in a large aluminum container. When the hot sweets were served in clay pots in front of us, it was hard to resist the temptation. As soon as I took the first bite of the hot sweet, it felt like a heavenly feeling. When the warm, sweet juice spread from the soft, fluffy sweet into my mouth, it felt like all the fatigue of the day disappeared in an instant. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmd9BujvvFhTVxJrSNmSk3YsnM3jY3ohSmVtVhTqrPUuJP/1779548006592.jpg) Even more enjoyable than eating sweets was the quarrel between friends. Whose sweets were softer, who took more syrup, and who stole sweets from whose plate all this led to a lot of laughter. The shopkeeper's smile, along with the trolling of others about the sweetness of one person's mouth, and the urge to take selfies, all added to our joy. The taste of sweets will linger on the tongue for a long time, but these golden moments spent with friends will remain in the corner of the mind for a lifetime. It is such small joys that keep us alive in the busyness of mechanical life. This smoky afternoon at the sweet shop was truly a strangely satisfying experience.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/242N4spuiJwwingR4FEPNmUyDtHkzVdBb1SGF1Yw5zmNKfAJAsUCCShkS2KL7qvdQVUbc.png)</center>

---

Luckily I got two copies of the legendary ulund, Chuma Marandu. I also got 10 rare draws and many common cards. I also got 4 alchemy potions and 1 legendary potion. In addition, I got 1 rare and 1 epic scroll; and a lot of merits. Finally, I got 5 energy and 3 entries for the weekly fortune draw.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23uFKcBB3HyXWB9dJRbKBpFRKsEcNUsfhmzkKkxwr4LYn2a5SEs5Xi1Ek4Z8fm5c19ciE.png)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tvVyQyHhYYXCiAzxnpkkwcqMuAabHvCUYU9oW2bbryNLwxqxXoNYtJShKw7AuXmhYSW.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/league-reward-result/?trx=b8855c2024e7f1bb34df23e9de6565b284b5f9ea&ref=langice)</center>

---

Now, my legendary ulund, Chuma Marandu, only needs one more copy to reach level 3, where he will gain +1 melee attack power and learn the Retaliate ability, so when attacked by an enemy melee unit, he will have a 50% chance to attack the attacker.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tRxaynoG9XTHUi5e9mj86hQginbuqQc6htPx5P9fzSjkfh8mqMPfbmVFvAdJrQuFRwz.png)

---

And my rodentian, Anchor-Hex Adept, needs 13 more copies to reach level 7, where it will learn the Blind ability, so while it is alive, enemy melee and ranged units will have a 15% chance of missing their attacks.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/Eo6CBiXMUNRNCoj4q51RynmS9hhyEFRdtFycpgHawTdRb2Yz7VAwmgmtHPV3p7rPX6D.png)

---

Currently, I have two legendary units from the conclave arcana reward cards at level 2, and the rest are at level 1. This time I was very lucky to get 2 copies of a legendary, and I hope my luck continues the next time I open my next advanced loot chests. I wish you the best of luck finding the cards you need and, as always, have fun playing.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23wMQ3rZkhL4seKDKeANYrzn1UgxoAStYhd4HMhDif9we69ANm79pCTzNzRwdREqnAsgH.png)

---

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield!

title.title: When the Unthinkable Happens...
title.body:
![lmac 251 6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/23w2uwogoWwZYZ6qvq7eQfMbULnjR3oPT2dZa9b5HV6kFnfSTpAE6kuYBUzt6qRJ2J6vj.png)
“That’s Manhattan.”

Ruth nodded toward the orange glow on the horizon.

Hugo held onto the rail because the seas were rough.  And because he needed to hold onto something.

“Does that mean the city is gone?”

“No, I don’t think so.  They would have hit downtown first, the financial district.  Then central city.  No need to destroy the boroughs.  That’ll come later.  Maybe with a ground assault. Maybe with something larger.”

“How about home?”

“They're not there yet.  Probably have cells in place, to start the dirty work from inside. They’ll know where the police and administrative centers are located.  Take them out first.”

“Do you think other people left?” 

“I’m sure they did. There's Farmingdale, with all those private planes. But planes make clear targets, easy to shoot out of the sky. Blow up an airfield.  That'd probably be one of their first hits. Also, a plane needs a landing strip, and the range isn’t too good. Boats, like ours, not too large, that’s the safest bet.”

Hugo glanced at his mother.

“How long have you been planning this?  Why were you so ready?”

The sixteen-year-old had been a big help in getting everyone out of the house and onto the boat. There had been signs of his mother's intentions since at least a year ago. He knew they had a short wave radio.   He’d been playing around with it for months, but had no idea the radio was part of a grand scheme.  His mother had heard from her radio contacts in South Korea and Taiwan that afternoon.  Missiles were on the way.  

Ruth paused for a moment, before responding.

“Remember the first war, with Iran?  That’s when I knew we’d probably be in trouble, someday. I saw we were increasingly isolated.  China was strengthening its alliance with Russia, Iran and North Korea.  We showed no strategic positioning.  We were expending vast amounts of our military hardware.  It seemed risky to me. So I started to plan.  Just in case.”

“The boat?”

“Oh, yeah.  You all thought I was nuts, paying $70,000 for a used trawler.  But I did my research.  That’s a solid boat. Stable in the ocean, suitable for extended voyages.”

“So all those weekend trips, that cruise to Bermuda...training?”

“Training and fun.  We did have fun, didn’t we?  And your grandfather was able to enjoy it all.”

She turned her head toward the cabin.  Her father was resting there.  He’d found the hurried trip to the boat difficult.  He was ready, though, remarkably calm.  He’d asked about provisions and about the ammo on the way to the boat.  Even though he was arthritic, he was prepared to help, to fight for the family if necessary.

“So where are we headed?”

“Remember that island we cruised to last summer, off the Maine coast? Small, rocky, but isolated?  You didn’t like it too much …”

She stopped talking suddenly and looked up.  Jets, streaming high overhead in the direction of the orange-glowing horizon.

“Are they going to shoot us?” 

Hugo turned pale as he asked this question.

“No.  Not now.  They have a mission.  They’re not looking for small boats like ours.  In a week maybe, two weeks, they’ll do clean up. But we’ll be long out of the water by then.”

More jets overhead, loud, lower in the sky.  Ruth was not as confident as she sounded.  She could only guess at the priorities of the invaders.  How visible was the boat?  Was it too small for them to bother with?  She remembered the boats her own government had shot out of the water a few years before. They were no larger than hers.

“Go check on the pets and your sister.   You're taking over when I rest.  The course is plotted.  Follow the charts and you’ll be fine.   We’ve practiced so many times.”

“How long will we be away?  I don’t think we have enough provisions here…”  Hugo stopped himself from saying more.  He didn’t want to be negative, to put more on his mother’s shoulders.

“Those two weeks I went away, last April?  I didn’t go to Chile, to the Atacama Desert.  I wasn’t on a dig, looking for fossils. I went to the island, by myself, with a boatload of provisions.  It’s all set up like a survivalist camp.  Food, shelter, fuel. It’s waiting for us.”

Hugo stared at his mother.

“How certain were you this would happen?”

“Things weren’t good.  For a few years there had been a steady decline in our national security. Increasing unrest at home.  I wasn’t sure if the trouble would come from outside or inside.  And if it didn’t come, then we’d have a great boat.  You learned how to shoot, how to navigate, how to camp.   And that island...someday you and your sister could take your kids there.  Teach them how to camp.  No loss.  A win win all around.”

  Another set of jets overhead. He tried not to look up. If his mother was confident, then he was confident.  He realized this was no time to be scared.  It was a time  to act.  He went down into the cabin. His sister jumped up from her seat.

“Where’s Mom?  Is everything alright?  Is something wrong?”

He smiled and tugged a lock of her bangs.  

“Now, Elgy, you know Mom can handle anything, and she always takes us on these cruises.  Her surprises,  trips to nowhere.  Except this time we're going to our very own island.  What an adventure. You take care of the pets.  They get nervous on the boat.”

Elgy hugged the dog.

“OK.  I love our boat rides. I think it'll be a lot of fun.”

Hugo smiled and chucked the dog under the chin.

“Oh yes.  This is going to be fun.”

He walked into the hold and started counting the rounds of ammunition. He thought of the orange horizon and the jets overhead.

Then he checked himself. No.  Can't think about that. His mother was at the helm.  His sister and grandfather were in the cabin. He knew how to use a gun. They'd be fine.


___________________________________________________________________________
___________________________________________________________________________

**The Story Behind the Collage**

This collage was made in response to the template offered by LMAC's [251st contest](https://peakd.com/hive-174695/@lmac/lets-make-a-collage-a-contest-for-all-creatives-on-hive-round-251-45-hive-in-the-prize-pool).  Current events were on my mind when I looked at the template.  I didn't see a sunset.  I saw a fiery horizon.  I saw war.  Here is the template.

![lmac 251 template.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/agmoore/EppNe9zY751k6wj1Ths6xZh6UuHsXFXMnAv7PuBw7QmaSZ5zLdFTvScaX6ateQBN5MQ.jpg)

I went about finding different elements to share what I saw. There was boat on fire.  And planes.  A cityscape burning. Here are the elements I borrowed, some from Pixabay and some from Unsplash.

[Boat Photo by Jeffrey Zhang on Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-large-boat-on-a-large-body-of-water-2JcxEhFlwDs)

[Skyline loki-su](https://pixabay.com/photos/city-buildings-sunrise-skyline-7510927/)


[Fire TheOtherKev](https://pixabay.com/photos/dancer-fire-breathing-fire-breather-8414383/)


[War DigitalArtist](https://pixabay.com/photos/armageddon-disaster-destruction-war-2721568/)


[WarGuren-The-Third-Eye](ttps://pixabay.com/illustrations/fleet-battles-war-war-begins-8837427/)

Some of the elements I added myself, mostly fire and smoke effects.
I also utilized a filter from Lunapic, to show a burning scene.

I used GIMP and Paint 3D to manipulate the elements.

The story was born even before the picture. They go together.  I imagined myself on that boat.

**LMAC and LIL**

Making this collage and writing the story were a great release for me.  I highly recommend the exercise. We at LMAC are eager, truly eager to view collages created by anyone on Hive.  The collages may be created for the contest, or they may be free form. 

If you use an image from our LIL library you receive extra consideration.  Also, if you use these images in another community and add the tag LIL to you post, you will receive an upvote from LMAC.  The image library at LIL was created entirely by Hive bloggers. Procedures for borrowing from and contributing to LIL may be found [here](https://peakd.com/hive-174695/@shaka/the-lmac-summer-special-lets-build-the-lmac-image-library), on @shaka's blog.

Thank you for reading my blog.   

Peace and health to all. 

Hive on!

title.title: Monomad: A Saturday spent practicing skateboarding [Eng/Esp]
title.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Greetings, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography. How are you all today? I’m doing well, and I hope you are too. Today I’m going on a short trip, but before I go, I’d like to share some photos I took at the skatepark; I hope you enjoy them.

Saludos, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro. ¿Cómo se encuentran el día de hoy? Yo me siento bien y espero que ustedes también lo estén. Hoy haré un pequeño viaje corto, pero antes de irme les comparto algunas fotografías que hice en el skatepark; espero que las disfruten.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tvc1E2VQHPKBhd69z6tenz8sGb3tR6A84Rz57MqCTKyb8nYqdzwTn2WgBbHKBuFYYvZ.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xVCukRcTCy9HucMNpjtLM8FGXJf64X35VbKCQ11xM8RMFQycSc62cZLmJZHfqjf4wa7.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wWpevHPjiDN53DkVq8oF7oNprrVKgxvzfasbBM5QEGXTnEYbNBwUf9uo2EVrC57KvSf.jpg

>

A couple of days ago, I shared some photos here, but they were taken in lower light, the sun had already set, and only the streetlights were on. These, however, were taken when the sun was at its highest point, which is why you can really see those areas of light.

Hace un par de días les compartía algunas fotografías en este mismo lugar, pero con menos luz, ya que había sido cuando el sol ya se había ocultado y solo alumbraban las farolas de luz, pero en estas, las hice cuando el sol se encontraba en su punto más alto, por eso se aprecian mucho esas zonas de luz.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xehjqWQY3bfqka2w85ojtATN8V1QdQGPDrxxukXbquhJc6wqtJq6ws5P7f9zATTvnqQ.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uQnR2jHQU8yKUZZPzJNLUsnHsS9zqTEbinHCiKRCLiXMjTAgpzEcEWfMUV1ZUjdkZpN.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wgKUwKebmyihj2WsLXFhT4uUSTaKUy6zDU5Hu7LSPc3Dd2tUFS7Xd9XkbDjYxVQ9w6G.jpg

>

The great thing about taking photos at this time of day is that you can create a more striking contrast; thanks to the interplay of light and shadow, the photos take on a greater sense of dynamism, framing the subjects in a more natural way and, in my opinion, in a very urban way.

Lo bueno de hacer fotografías a esta hora es justo que se puede generar un contraste más llamativo, porque gracias a las luces y sombras, estas dan más dinamismo a las fotografías, haciendo que los protagonistas queden enmarcados de una forma más natural y, personalmente, de una forma muy urbana.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xozPgKiJ1ScvphrnfFoZYqZ7qERkx7WmU49QcdyXuCYLjftJk7r4ie3PrLE8aAu3b3B.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23ywmB8KHpM7V6Fey3a77vy5ZvYQWcHAq7z924Ud7cxNQUnzcktqziKaEWVBK3Wv7trtB.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23wWw38Q9BPPGoUXhs7e2wVa3DK9mXJdZURqMZ7kmFG4Hn1wFXBrYb6jJpg66DyMHhnru.jpg

>

That's all for today; as always, thank you for taking the time to look at my photos and read a little of what I've written. I hope you all have a wonderful Saturday and enjoy your day. See you next time!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy; como siempre, les agradezco por tomarse el tiempo de ver mis fotografías y leer un poco de lo que escribo. Deseo que todos tengan un excelente sábado y disfruten de su día. ¡Hasta la próxima!

/>

This post is not financial advice

I stumbled upon this new game on Hive. [My d Empire](https://www.mydempire.com/) I was whitelisted to get into the testing phase.  I spent 60 HIVE to get  10 genesis packs. I am fairly confident over time that I will earn that back by posting game updates...eventually :)


I do not have a strategy yet as I am still learning and brand new. But first things first is to build factories on my lands. The construction can take a while.... a  couple  of days on some of them. There isn't anything else to do in the game for me until they complete building and start earning. 

From there I will use EMP (in game token) to build the rest of the factories (blueprints now) with earnings.  I may buy a few more packs at some point but I want to see how things go after the buildings complete and  I start earning EMP. As of now I  don't have enough EMP to build  any more even though I have lands and blueprints.



As many of you know I am a big fan of sustainability and this looks promising on that front.  No inflationary token.  I would like some more info about how they, in the long term,  plan to grow the HIVE holdings they use as rewards without relying on new purchases. That will be the real sustainability test.

Most  games fail when new players don't continuously come in (or purchases stall). I am curious long term what the strategy is to continue to grow HIVE holdings. Even if that strategy is simple- post earnings ,curation, savings. These are things that can add to stability over time and would not require new purchases to fund the reward pools.  Paying out less than 10% of holdings every year as rewards  would make it sustainable (even if no new purchases come in)if they are leveraging curation and posting. There are many strategies for sustainability. These are  just my first thoughts on it.

It's possible this has already been addressed but I didn't  see any posts on this specifically. I have not read every post.

I build the @uni-coin and @pixydust tip bots to be sustainable - no  token purchases required ( though I did hold a small pre sale to get things rolling it was not a necessary thing). 

Enough rambling. Let me start building my empire. I'll update once my buildings complete and I start earning.

title.title: WOO’s Quiet Weekend? Nah… Everyone’s Grinding in the Shadows
title.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

I’ll be real. When I logged in this weekend and didn’t see the usual buzz of events or announcements, my first reaction was the same as everyone else:

“Wait… why is it so quiet?”

No tournaments popping off.
No big weekend hype.
No chaotic chatter about who’s dominating what.

Just… calm.

>*I have gotten some feedback that reminders are pretty useful when it comes to the regular events held in WOO. So here I am again with a quick reminder for any upcoming events.*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23tkk8oXez25WLnWRsipb8x9Mzo5ut4YUPWrfm6V3ptcgiZaycdw2vFH4NVsVEb9VA8qt.png)

---

But, that being said, the more I sat with it, the more I started to think — maybe this isn’t a *quiet* weekend.

Maybe it just **looks quiet on the surface**.

Because with the Battle Pass now live, I don’t think players are *inactive*.

I think they’re just… **locked in**.

* The introduction of daily and weekly quests has shifted focus from public events to personal progression.
  
Before this update, weekends were all about visible activity — tournaments, events, leaderboard pushes. But now? A lot of that energy has moved inward. Players aren’t necessarily gathering in one place — they’re grinding their own objectives. And honestly, that kind of activity doesn’t always show up as “noise,” but it’s definitely happening.

* Players are prioritizing efficiency over spectacle, focusing on completing quests rather than chasing hype moments.
  
Let’s be honest. If you’ve got quests tied to playing matches, opening packs, or progressing steadily, you’re not necessarily waiting for an event to tell you what to do. You’re already busy. That kind of gameplay is quieter, but it’s also more consistent.

* The Battle Pass has turned weekends into strategic catch-up windows instead of peak event periods.
  
This is something I didn’t expect, but it makes sense. Instead of weekends being about *new* activity, they’re becoming about **maximizing progress**. Catching up on missed quests, pushing levels, optimizing your grind. It’s less flashy, but arguably more important.

So yes, maybe WOO isn’t loud this weekend. But that doesn’t mean it’s inactive. If anything, it feels like everyone’s just grinding behind the scenes… and we’re going to see the results of that very soon.

---

**TLDR: This is a reminder to all my readers (and WOO fans) that baring any last minute sudden surprise events, this weekend should be a relatively quiet one. 😜**

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

title.title: Three Ales from Tsitsikamma Brewery for #BeerSaturday
title.body:
>


![_DSC0074.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23xyLQFPS4rAzTch9kHLD8L6zKW3rKiBrnDePsjciwFbovHw2miKVErG98Uk4QZfqbNDg.JPG)

___

[After visiting the Tsitsikamma brewery](https://peakd.com/hive-187719/@fermentedphil/visiting-tsitsikamma-micro-brewery-in-stormsrivier-or-fermented-beermaps), I had to try their other beers. I bought three of their beers, a normal ale, dark ale, and a grapefruit ale. These were three vastly different beers, and I had to say, they were so close to homebrewed style beers that I could not taste the difference. They were good, but they were rugged, hard, and not for the person who prefers a well rounded beer that will challenge you. These beers challenged me, but they were good, because even a bad beer is sometimes what you need! 

So join me on this tasting journey of some interesting beers. 


___

# <center>  Tsitsikamma Woodcutter Ale </center>

___

<center> Pale Ale | 5% ABV | 35 IBUs </center>

___


|![_DSC0070.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23vsBvLtaqKZyFoH3xydjYomKErytXREem6AtQnjFyXa6NERVZkbGqAWz3fWD3ENc3emn.JPG)|![_DSC0071.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23wBdqXjbK5ssMSVbNk1tQYecHqkEerg21Qyr9HEb5wiKx7sW4HitijZvoGR2SbvTUpCe.JPG)|![_DSC0072.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23vhWDLyrHADa49aEN7ezRwJN7SJooGxCnwJoJrB2PLqr7j5QPYrxMFW8AoNnjnUsiK1u.JPG)|
|-|-|-|


The first smell was 100% homebrewed ale; almost exactly like my own. It was hoppy with mild maltiness and some prominent yeast on the nose from the bottle conditioning. The pour was also a bit carbonated, definitely from too much bottle conditioning. 

The first taste was also straight up hops and malt; but then a strong yeast aftertaste. It tastes exactly like my own home brews. It was a strong hoppy one, but the classic problem of adding too much hops, it had some grassy notes. 



![_DSC0076.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23xoap3xLntoC6i6LLGRakzzVr2d1uQ8FRm88tMb7seCjZFNxorsCWC9XQShTVgpePQzs.JPG)


___

# <center>  Tsitsikama Bains Black Ale </center>

___

<center> Dark Ale | 6.5 % ABV | 35 IBUs </center>

___


|![_DSC0086.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23tRtN5GXZ2MLW1jY1xR5nR1vSDJEYrPHggYj13Z6EKGA9hGXdnpBY5Hn4NYzYBPTs486.JPG)|![_DSC0088.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23tGR5GFiKDXTrcVaDpFTFhGxgtxg5GvqhXTLVmZ9VPbpH4iAbX8q2mxcMhzmy6yFSyFc.JPG)|![_DSC0089.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23uQJmno1qq2QEntaoE2Eupgfw355p8Cp4SQyzGUGvXdnY5LNbdKUceTu5rbPY7NLSHkm.JPG)|
|-|-|-|


There was an immediate roasted black malt maltiness overload on my nose; no yeast or hops. It was just the roasted black malt and it was delicious. 

The first sip was full bodied roasted malt overload - again! It was like roasted coffee; black coffee chocolate. It was a lovely beer, incredible really. 

The taste again was like my homebrew; but honestly, one of the best beers I have drunk in many moons. I was sad that I could not go back to buy some more of them. 


![_DSC0090.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23tkhtbDxPbY9QeSmZPUttSyR8AWDSK1b4W7eVPVrKW4fGWkedT8eZGyQFMwkWimdzBoh.JPG)


___

# <center>  Tsitsikamma Grapefruit Ale </center>

___

<center> IPA-style | 7.5 % ABV | 52 IBUs </center>

___


![_DSC0179.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23tGTdpjFfjuSNqonvSo3PmpoHm7vfR3a63WzxuMiwMnYEq5vyVYLB6t7uGqULRtAVFvQ.JPG)

___

<div class=\

> ![_DSC0178.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23u5SrxcYngt2m3nDFYgs3JvYgxhpX4BmAT14o1XtcUeN6Z2VHWnx2mYjDzcZxpiSFuVS.JPG) ___ The first smell was very strong grapefruit and hops, but again hops overload in the homebrewed style. The first taste great balance between hops and malt, very bitter with only a slight sweetness. It was not the classic grapefruit in NEIPAs, instead it was a very big beer with more than 7 abv. It had a nice and full bodied mouthfeel but sadly no real head retention or lacing. It was a good strong and big beer in the end! ___

> ![_DSC0181.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermentedphil/23tGRVKRMrB1YXMR8yZHgBciY4KtGW9UEYxni1HopN3gNf5UGNn9HP7ZsnuLwMbBoJLih.JPG) ___ After the long road, and some adventures, these beers landed very well. I hope that you had some cold and good beers for #beersaturday. For now, happy drinking. *All of the musings are my own, albeit inspired by especially that lovely dark ale. The photographs are my own, taken with my Nikon D300.*

title.title: Sailor Moon using a hybrid technique of collage and drawing//Sailor Moon con la técnica híbrida de collage y dibujo
title.body:
![ccc.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/EoKCXV6sGR4obseSa2BK65MkVQxHSevdN5RBrZWRCUvEu1q2igFoTsAbeiq2sRUWCBh.png)


Hello, my dear otaku friends, I hope you're all doing well.

Some time ago I used this technique and wanted to revisit it with this Sailor Moon drawing. This technique isn't easy to master, but if we put our minds to it and practice, we can achieve great results. It's called a hybrid collage and drawing technique, and it involves drawing the other half of a photograph or image, either digitally or with a pencil.

I used to do it with a graphite pencil, and now I'm using it in my Paint 3D program, which I find very practical because it has the range of colors I need when adding color to my drawings. So, I took this image of Sailor Moon and started drawing the other half with my digital pen and graphics tablet.

When I was finishing the coloring, I noticed some details that I then refined until I achieved the result I'm showing you and sharing so you'll be inspired to try it yourselves.

>Hola, mis queridos amigos otakus, espero se encuentren bien.

>Hace un tiempo apliqué esta técnica y quise retomarla con este dibujo de Sailor Moon. Esta técnica no es fácil de utilizar, pero si nos proponemos y practicamos, podemos obtener un gran resultado. Esta técnica se llama híbrida de collage y dibujos y se trata de dibujar la otra mitad de alguna fotografía o imagen que puede ser digitalmente o con un lápiz.

>Yo lo hacía en ocasiones con un lápiz de grafito y ahora la estoy aplicando en mi programa de Paint 3D, que me resulta muy práctico porque tiene la gama de colores que necesito al momento de ponerle color a mis dibujos. Así que tomé esta imagen de Sailor Moon y comencé a dibujar su otra mitad con mi lápiz digital y mi tableta gráfica. 

>Cuando ya estaba terminando de colorear, me fijé en algunos detalles que luego fui mejorando hasta obtener el resultado que les muestro y comparto para que se animen a realizarlos ustedes también.

Today I am going to share a very good and practical strategy for Hive users on which I myself have been working for a long time and I am continuously earning good profit from it. Especially for those Hive users who have good Hive Power and want to grow their account more through content creation, curating, and power up, this can be a very good opportunity.

Only doing power up and earning income from curating is not enough but if a little smart trading and coin rotation are also included then you can increase your Hive quantity very quickly.

In my opinion, Binance exchange is a very good platform for this purpose where you can trade between Hive and Steem coins with a safe and low risk strategy. First of all you have to set a specific amount through which you will only trade Hive and Steem. 

Most people immediately think that trading is very risky, there can be loss and a person can get stuck. But the special thing about this strategy is that the chances of getting stuck are almost zero because even if you get stuck somewhere you still have many options like hold, power up and coin rotation.

![hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vsmbtbT4XfZ2uQ6V3hnFSgMgAhNM9FueMRvtKTRYHykVJUrwsA9z7T9bcCR6Y19A95s.png)

If I give my own example I have almost $2000 of trading capital which I have divided into five parts. Meaning I use almost $400 in each layer. My base coin is Hive. What I do is buy Hive at its support level and then wait whether it pumps or dumps. 

If it pumps then I simply book profit. But if the price goes down then I do not immediately use stop loss rather I monitor the price of Steem. This is the interesting part started.

For example if Hive dumps 5% but Steem goes down 8% then in such a situation I convert my whole fund (1st layer) into Steem. Because the movement of both coins is quite correlated therefore often such an opportunity comes that later conversion back into Hive can be done at a better rate. During this time if Steem pumps then there is also an opportunity for profit booking there.

After this I wait for Hive to come to the next support level. As soon as the second support level comes I invest my second layer meaning another $400 is invested. If the market reverses from here then again I get profit and if it dumps more then I start the same rotation process again. Meaning I keep taking advantage of the spread by shifting funds between Steem and Hive.

![hive (2).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23viTbYcpzeGiEs4QKLRT6wG4Ey7bV6hqegjsrqH7ghj4fdHXe2bkNoqc6LiUr64h4Fjb.png)

Later when the spread between both coins starts becoming smaller then I start converting Steem back into Hive. The biggest benefit of this whole process is that my Hive quantity keeps increasing continuously. 

Along with this I reach near the break even point where I get the chance to escape or most of the time I book profits. At this point if you want you can take exit or you can hold more for better profits.

This is not just a trading strategy rather it is a “coin rotation strategy” where you use market movement in your favor. The special thing is that if you hold Hive for the long term then through power up you can also earn passive income in the form of 12-16% APR. (This is not the part of this strategy)

![hive (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23viTbYGxnufcA8h3F3EBQMFFmK62NjitdAwLnatYXPCZH8hYxVHHTD1vtphP6vh7Pagh.png)

Even in todays recent pump I made almost 50-60$ profit where I simply did buy low and sell high and the layers that got stuck I converted them into Steem and later shifted them again into Hive or USDT. In this way my Hive quantity also increased. Later you can sell those added quanities or keep on compounding.

I hope you will like this strategy. Especially for those Hive users who want to continuously increase their Hive Power, want to earn extra profit from trading and at the same time also want to keep earning passive income from curating, this can be a very good method.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

title.title: 第一次收到停车罚单
title.body:
前两天去曼城办事的时候，非常意外的收到了一份停车罚单。这也是我这位老司机的第一份停车罚单。要求缴纳70英镑，如果在14天以内缴费的话，还有半价优惠，只需要35英镑。

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd1ZTqWqkExfCtzc5hbm4rgxvjGdbuUibcZSxsrv95iVA/image.png)

其实英国这里对于停车的规定还是很清楚的。比如：如果路边是双黄线的话，就是任何时候都不能停车。如果是单黄线的话，一般是周一到周五之间早8晚6之间不能停。如果是居民区的话，也会有明确提示，比如：如果有停车许可的话才能停。否则只能停30分钟之类的警示牌。

对于这些标志，我还是非常注意的。因此这么多年车开过来，从未收到过罚单。

这次到了办事的地方后，仔细看了看路边，既没有双黄线，也没有单黄线。这种情况下，一般都是可以随便停车的。同时有四处找了找，也没有任何关于停车的警示牌。于是就把车停了下来去办事。

等到办完事，也就是半个小时的时间，出来后发现雨刷器下有个黄色的信封。当时就感觉有些不太妙。打开后发现是一张罚单，罚款原因是在未经许可的居民区停车。

我去，这是什么操作。又在四周仔细看了看，还是没有任何警示。但在把车开出那条街道，驶入大路之前，发现在交叉路口处有一个警示，上面说：只要越过这个路口，里面街道不能停车。还有这样的警示？离我停车的地方有好几百米的距离？？？！！！

感觉这件事不能就这么算了。毕竟这种警示非常不明显。于是选择了进行投诉。主要原因也是警示不够清晰。

等个几天看看结果吧，希望工作人员能够提供一个让我满意的答复。

No pude contenerme y decidí buscar la serie de [Maul - Lord de las sombras](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt36594331/?ref_=ttmi_ov_i), una de las tantas historias de Star Wars de la cual soy muy fan. Esta serie está hecha por los mismos creadores de la serie Guerra de los Clones, la cual es una de mis favoritas de todos los tiempos desde que la vi. Allí explican muchísimas cosas y cada vez que la veo debo echarme el maratón completo de toda la saga de películas de Star Wars.

>  Greetings, fellow Otakus of #TheAnimeRealm. I couldn't resist and decided to look up the series [Maul - Shadow Lord](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt36594331/?ref_=ttmi_ov_i), one of the many Star Wars stories that I'm a huge fan of. This series is made by the same creators of the Clone Wars series, which has been one of my all-time favorites since I first saw it. It explains so many things, and every time I watch it, I have to binge-watch the entire Star Wars saga.


<center>![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)</center>


<center>![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23wgS4FgEGSqPa96vQAo8nSRE9qrDgKU59o1skUxRMdSk3GNq4UhFjiRD8EeXBsiYiv2B.png)</center>


<div class=\

> Y bueno, yo tengo muchos personajes favoritos de Star Wars, entre ellos está Maul, y ver su historia de manera individual, todo lo que tuvo que vivir luego de lo que había sufrido y de haber sido derrotado previamente por Obi-Wan Kenobi, para mí resultó más que interesante esta serie.

> And well, I have many favorite Star Wars characters, among them Maul, and seeing his story individually, everything he had to live through after what he had suffered and after having been previously defeated by Obi-Wan Kenobi, for me, this series was more than interesting.

> La historia comenzó de manera épica mostrando al Maul que todos conocemos, uno despiadado y con sed de venganza. De entrada, la escenografía y los diseños de imagen estaban perfectamente bien hechos, manteniendo el clásico estilo de Star Wars visto en la Guerra de los Clones.

> The story began epically, showcasing the Maul we all know: ruthless and driven by vengeance. From the outset, the set design and visuals were impeccably crafted, maintaining the classic Star Wars style seen in the Clone Wars.

> Me gustó conocer más de la vida de este personaje que resulta ser clave en el momento de la historia general de todo Star Wars. Sencillamente merecía tener su propia serie y qué mejor momento que esta primera temporada que estuvo excelente.

> I enjoyed learning more about the life of this character, who turns out to be key to the overall Star Wars storyline. He simply deserved his own series, and what better time than this excellent first season?

> Con esta serie demostraron que el trabajo estuvo hecho por fans para fans. En todo momento estuvieron mostrando detalles que cualquier persona pasaría por alto, pero para los creadores de Maul no, como por ejemplo el juego entre la luz y la sombra cuando sólo se veía la luz del sable láser.

> With this series, they proved that the work was made by fans for fans. They consistently highlighted details that anyone else might overlook, but not the creators of Maul, such as the interplay of light and shadow when only the lightsaber's beam was visible.

> Todo estuvo hecho a la medida justa y necesaria; además, introdujeron unos nuevos personajes extras que en toda historia de lucha por la luz y la oscuridad deben de haber para mantener el equilibrio en la galaxia. Estos personajes resultaron ser bastante interesantes.

> Everything was perfectly tailored and just right; they also introduced some new supporting characters, which are essential in any story about the struggle between light and darkness to maintain balance in the galaxy. These characters turned out to be quite interesting.

> Lo que más me gusta de este tipo de series, cuando salen nuevas en la secuela de Star Wars, es que siempre aparece un personaje extra conocido, o mejor dicho famoso, así que en cada episodio que veía estaba al pendiente de ver a alguien más conocido como a Obi-Wan o a Yoda.

> What I like most about these kinds of series, when new ones come out in the Star Wars sequel, is that there's always an extra well-known, or rather famous, character, so in every episode I watched, I was on the lookout to see someone else well-known, like Obi-Wan or Yoda.

> Pero nos dieron a alguien completamente inesperado en los últimos episodios. No les diré quién fue, pero lo que sí les diré es que cerraron la serie con broche de oro y quedé con ganas de ver la segunda temporada de ya para ya.

> But they threw in someone completely unexpected in the final episodes. I won't tell you who it was, but I will say that they ended the series with a bang, and I'm dying to see the second season right now.

> Así que otra cosa que debo agregar es que esta serie te demuestra muchas cosas del lado oscuro de la fuerza, que al igual que el lado de la luz que estaba hiperdesarrollado antes de que ocurriera lo que ocurrió con Anakin, la balanza fue justa y tuvo que equilibrarse al lado de la oscuridad.

> So, another thing I must add is that this series shows you many things about the dark side of the Force, which, like the light side that was hyper-developed before what happened with Anakin, the balance was fair and had to tip towards the dark side.

> Es ahora que lo entiendo y Maul fue considerado un desertor porque no estaba de acuerdo con el imperio, sólo estaba segado por su venganza. Lo peor de esto es que irse por el lado oscuro es recorrer un camino de dolor y sufrimiento que nunca sana.

> It's only now that I understand. Maul was considered a deserter because he disagreed with the Empire; he was simply blinded by his thirst for revenge. The worst part is that choosing the dark side is a path of pain and suffering that never heals.

> Una serie que definitivamente vale la pena ver en un maratón que disfrutarás en menos de medio día. Esta serie está cargada de sorpresas y momentos tan emocionantes que te harán levantarte de la cama para ponerte al filo del asiento a ver qué sucederá. Así de buena es; yo le otorgo por eso sus 5 estrellas completas. Veredicto final: ¡Excelente!

> A series that's definitely worth binge-watching in under half a day. This show is packed with surprises and such exciting moments that you'll be jumping out of bed and on the edge of your seat to see what happens next. It's that good; that's why I give it a full 5 stars. Final verdict: Excellent!

title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSXMEzfyURpczyXs8AqvQmtmKiHt8jgpLpe7rxqbHzGrj/dfuns_2026_05_23_1613460d5a49070fbf.jpg)

Już to kiedyś pisałem, ale się powtórzę: zdrowie jest jak Litwa - ile je trzeba cenić ten tylko się dowie, kto je straci. Od wtorku coś mnie próbuje rozłożyć. Co ciekawe nie mam nawet stanu podgorączkowego. Tylko zapchany nos, kaszel i ogólne osłabienie (czasem ból głowy). Dziś jest najgorzej, bo spałem strasznie kiepsko. Ciągle się budziłem. W sumie nie wiem czy to przeziębienie (dość nietypowe w maju) czy jakaś alergia.

Efekt jest taki, że moja produktywność zmalała o połowę i nie robię nic ponad to co muszę. Choć i tego jest całkiem sporo, bo ostatnie dni były w KBK intensywne. Sporo ludzi. Nawet zrobiło to wrażenie na Oldze, która wpadła na Biskupią w ramach IV Małopolskiego Forum Animatorek i Animatorów. Nasz system bardzo ją zaciekawił.

Mimo choroby dzieje się. Pobicie rekordu frekwencyjnego jest niemal pewne, bo brakuje już tylko 63 wizyt. Do rekordu darowizn jest trochę dalej - brakuje 1760 zł. Został jednak ponad tydzień i aż dwie noce planszówkowe (+ jedna niedzielna) po drodze.

---

1) przelewając dowolną kwotę na konto bankowe: Fundacja Tradycji Miast i Wsi, 16 1090 1740 0000 0001 2088 2593 (Santander), tytuł: \

2) wpłacając darowiznę poprzez [zrzutkę](https://zrzutka.pl/zhnzyt)  
 
3) przesyłając tokeny HBD na konto @fundacja (zasilają one Fundusz Rozwojowy KBK)

title.body:
[![](https://images.3speak.tv/images/1779546023986-4bc9e4a3f28116b3.webp)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/2f929558)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=davidnollearth/2f929558)


---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

---

title.body: > En la vida, encontramos muchas situaciones que nos generan diferentes sentimientos; es nuestra decisión en qué nos enfocamos. Por eso, hoy decido despertar y dar gracias, tanto por lo bueno como por lo no tan bueno. Aunque no nos guste atravesar la adversidad, pero en su momento brindan grandes experiencias y aprendizajes. ![El crecimiento 13 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcUqGYEP7dTQvXb7sCTNjWFM2smqvwCrLMAAsDNBt4CTC/El%20crecimiento%20%2013%20(1).jpg) [Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/ma%C3%B1ana-amanecer-mujer-silueta-2243465/) Como dice el dicho popular, cada día trae su propio mal, pero cuando nos enfocamos en las cosas positivas, nos da la motivación para salir adelante y así superar las diferentes adversidades de la mejor manera. Últimamente, la situación económica del país ha empeorado, impactando directamente nuestras emociones. Como resultado, lo que más escuchamos en las conversaciones son palabras de tristeza y desesperación. Esto es comprensible cuando hay esperanza de que todo mejore. Pero siempre me pregunto: ¿es esta realmente la mejor solución para mejorar la situación? En realidad, solo causa más estrés, fatiga mental y nos hace olvidar la bendición de tener vida y salud para seguir adelante. Sé que no es fácil, pero centrarnos en las situaciones adversas solo nos mantendrá estancados, viviendo en la incertidumbre de no saber cómo ni cuándo mejorarán las cosas. ![lavnatalia-woman-6824203.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmakmTM13KotYgfXWvyjEdDykqj3TZca56ZPgQWzCGgiqm/lavnatalia-woman-6824203.jpg) [Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/mujer-agradecido-arte-linda-6824203/) Por otro lado, cuando enfocamos nuestra energía en agradecer todo lo que tenemos, nos damos cuenta de la fortuna que poseemos, de que contamos con muchas herramientas para encontrar maneras de mejorar y avanzar. No es una tarea fácil, pero marca la diferencia. La gratitud es el impulso positivo que nos permite ver todo con claridad, sabiendo que aún hay mucho por aprender y lograr, pero también que somos afortunados por todo lo que hemos recibido. La gratitud me da la fuerza para ver de lo que soy capaz, que aunque las cosas no hayan salido exactamente como quería, lo que ha sucedido me ha brindado buenas experiencias y resultados. No todo ha sido un camino de rosas, pero he tenido la fortuna de disfrutar de grandes bendiciones. Actualmente, una de mis mayores preocupaciones está relacionada con las finanzas, pero he intentado enfocar mi energía en encontrar soluciones beneficiosas, emprender negocios y buscar herramientas para aprender nuevas habilidades que me ayuden en el proceso. No se trata de que todo mejore de la noche a la mañana, pero cuando somos agradecidos, nos damos cuenta de que cada paso adelante es valioso. Esto nos ayuda a seguir adelante, y cuando lo comprendemos, todo por lo que hemos trabajado llega a su debido tiempo. ![roonznl-sunset-5033708 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYH5nTGFVjYvGfNUWszf7a7ivkBFSrV2y5nXJVN3gGRCv/roonznl-sunset-5033708%20(1).jpg) [Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/puesta-del-sol-silueta-crep%C3%BAsculo-5033708/) Hoy elijo dar gracias por mi familia; su amor y apoyo incondicional son mi principal motivación. Por mis amigos leales y por aquellos que estuvieron en mi vida por poco tiempo pero dejaron un vínculo de cariño sincero; por las pequeñas y grandes metas que he alcanzado con mi esfuerzo y dedicación; y también por aquellas experiencias que, aunque desagradables en su momento, luego me enseñaron valiosas lecciones. ![petig-sunset-5238044.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeRJqDT3vKAfdQbt5cu5jrM8wyHvdbFGtRi4HpusEo2bP/petig-sunset-5238044.jpg) [Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/atardecer-mujer-libertad-silueta-5238044/) Hay tantas cosas por las que estar agradecido, empezando por la oportunidad de un nuevo día de vida, de seguir soñando y esforzándonos por alcanzar todas nuestras metas. > Gracias por leer mi publicación ❤️ --- |English version . | | -------- --- In life, we encounter many situations that evoke different feelings; it's our choice what we focus on. That's why today I choose to wake up and give thanks, both for the good and the not-so-good. Although we don't like going through adversity, it ultimately provides valuable experiences and lessons. ![El crecimiento .jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcY1Z6Zuwk6Df3CyDwztKf3SP6yS2PSah2GPZGKn1QA1D/El%20crecimiento%20.jpg) [Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/trepador-escalada-silueta-9491285/) As the saying goes, each day brings its own troubles, but when we focus on the positive, it gives us the motivation to move forward and overcome different adversities in the best way possible. Lately, the country's economic situation has worsened, directly impacting our emotions. As a result, what we hear most in conversations are words of sadness and despair. This is understandable when there's hope that everything will improve. But I always wonder: is this really the best solution to improve the situation? In reality, it only causes more stress, mental fatigue, and makes us forget the blessing of having life and health to keep going. I know it's not easy, but focusing on adverse situations will only keep us stuck, living in the uncertainty of not knowing how or when things will improve. ![lavnatalia-woman-6824203.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmakmTM13KotYgfXWvyjEdDykqj3TZca56ZPgQWzCGgiqm/lavnatalia-woman-6824203.jpg) [Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/mujer-agradecido-arte-linda-6824203/) On the other hand, when we focus our energy on being grateful for all that we have, we realize how fortunate we are, that we have many tools at our disposal to find ways to improve and move forward. It's not an easy task, but it makes all the difference. Gratitude is the positive force that allows us to see everything clearly, knowing that there is still much to learn and achieve, but also that we are fortunate for all that we have received. Gratitude gives me the strength to see what I am capable of, that even though things haven't turned out exactly as I wanted, what has happened has given me good experiences and results. It hasn't all been a bed of roses, but I have been fortunate to enjoy great blessings. Currently, one of my biggest concerns is related to finances, but I have tried to focus my energy on finding beneficial solutions, starting businesses, and seeking out tools to learn new skills that will help me in the process. It's not about everything getting better overnight, but when we are grateful, we realize that every step forward is valuable. This helps us move forward, and when we understand this, everything we've worked for comes to fruition in due time. ![roonznl-sunset-5033708 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYH5nTGFVjYvGfNUWszf7a7ivkBFSrV2y5nXJVN3gGRCv/roonznl-sunset-5033708%20(1).jpg) [Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/puesta-del-sol-silueta-crep%C3%BAsculo-5033708/) Today I choose to give thanks for my family; their unconditional love and support are my main motivation. For my loyal friends and for those who were in my life for a short time but left a bond of sincere affection; for the small and large goals I've achieved through my effort and dedication; and also for those experiences that, although unpleasant at the time, later taught me valuable lessons. ![petig-sunset-5238044.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeRJqDT3vKAfdQbt5cu5jrM8wyHvdbFGtRi4HpusEo2bP/petig-sunset-5238044.jpg) [Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/atardecer-mujer-libertad-silueta-5238044/) There are so many things to be grateful for, starting with the opportunity for a new day of life, to continue dreaming and striving to achieve all our goals. > Thank you for reading my post. ❤️ Imágenes creadas en [canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/) Texto traducido al inglés en [Traductor de Google](https://translate.google.com/?hl=es&sl=auto&tl=en&text=Para%20finalizar%20me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20resaltar%20que%20existe%20un%20fidelidad%20que%20es%20para%20toda%20la%20vida%2C%20sin%20dudar%20por%20un%20momento%2C%20digo%20que%20es%20la%20fidelidad%20de%20Dios%20en%20nuestras%20vidas.&op=translate) ![IMG_20231128_162542.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQFtBdh3FXgNmKcYfeJMmjCJNgMiUoHyAoXxNqM4v6a2g/IMG_20231128_162542.png)

Me sorprende que a pesar de tener casi 4 años, Alejandro me siga sorprendiendo, alguna vez les conté que el es muy dependiente de mi y me sigue a todos lados y siempre duerme conmigo pero últimamente hace dos cosas nuevas que antes no. Se acerca a mi y se me tira encima con su parte de atrás, ósea se recuesta en mi cara o mi cuerpo pero se tira con su parte de atrás y se recuesta así, es super raro jajaja antes no hacia, lo malo de esto es que a veces lo hace cuando estoy dormido y me levanta. La otra cosa que hace es que me lame la mano para que lo acaricie, antes hacia lo que todos los gatos y restregaba su cara contra mi mano para que lo acaricie pero ahora son lamidos. En serio me sorprende como cambia y ahora es diferente.

> It's Saturday, and that means it's cat time! Although at the beginning of the year I posted photos of my cats almost every Saturday, these last few weeks have been difficult due to personal matters, but here I am to show you how adorable my boys still are. It surprises me that even though he's almost four years old, Alejandro still surprises me. I once told you that he's very dependent on me and follows me everywhere and always sleeps with me, but lately he's been doing two new things he didn't do before. He comes up to me and throws himself on top of me with his backside—I mean, he rests his back on my face or body, but he throws himself on my backside and lies down like that. It's super weird, haha, he never used to do that. The bad thing about it is that sometimes he does it when I'm asleep and wakes me up. The other thing he does is lick my hand so I'll pet him. Before, he would do what all cats do and rub his face against my hand so I'd pet him, but now he licks me. I'm really surprised at how he's changed, and now he's different. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMuvNtLgk8f9CNWpA4SKg2JNrsciDCrVKJWgchZio8yS/img_8928.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeRfmBi3hUyzy8qBPFqX88duKboU7QEyJZ1kEzbbT2X1f/img_8930.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeLmuGvSkEDQKKDZBPaYifEEQZDNYrdP7tWmFMM9DNFXH/img_8942.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSDG9oGMYaMm5JxyJdp2Xi2oQXQot9EPtfeSjLHeXF35T/img_8943.jpg)

Maxinne tiene la costumbre de cuando estoy en los muebles viendo TV, es trepa encima mío y duerme sobre mi pecho, es lindo que haga eso pues fue mi primer gato y siempre lo amare. title.title: Hunter Assassin is so cool game
title.body:
[![](https://hotipfs-3speak-1.b-cdn.net/ipfs/QmdU1V8Eefmv5E77Ct6hNG8A3f9b75dZmVS6ZVvw5ynnrn/)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/35718c5d)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/35718c5d)


---

Hello friends, how are you all? I hope you are all well. I am also well by the grace of God.Today I will present a new game to you all.Hunter Assassin a fast-paced mobile game for stealthy and strategic players that takes you on a wild adventure as a hunter with a deadly knife. With multiple enemies to kill, challenging missions to complete, and rewards to collect, this game will test your skills and keep you on the edge of your seat.

 If you love a classic stealth challenge, this game is made for you.You can discover the Unique Characters of Hunter Assassin.You'll have the chance to unlock several unique characters. It's up to you to choose the one that best fits your play style and strategy. Whether you prefer a fast and agile hunter, or one with more health and endurance, there's a character for everyone in this ultimate hunter game. With so many options to choose from, the possibilities for gameplay are endless. 

You can unlock the strongest hunter, be the stealth master, and dominate the diamond game.Beware the traps and define your own strategy.Whether it's running, hiding, or striking with precision, you have to play your cards right. Use your knife skills and powerful weapons to kill enemies and collect diamonds. Activate laser traps to lure enemies into your trap, then strike with precision and take them all down.

 With freeze mines and rockets flying toward you, you will need to be quick and cunning to succeed.In Hunter Assassin, the themes change as you progress in the game, providing a constantly evolving and exciting experience every time you play. You might start off in the cyber cityscape, dodging traps and taking down enemies with your knife like a true ninja. 

But as you progress, you might find yourself in a laboratory filled with hazards, forcing you to think strategically and use your abilities to your advantage. Face every action-packed battle with your hunter and rise as the ultimate stealth assassin.With each successful kill and completed mission, you'll earn chests filled with gems to unlock new characters. Dominate the challenge as you level up.

👉Thumbnail source: Captured by me during the gameplay.

Thanks for watching my video

@likhon420

---

title.title: Manic Swoons: Abundance Year Episode 1975 (audio: noxsoma.substack.com)
title.body:
Full Metal Ox Day 1910
Saturday 23, May 2026
Abundance Year Episode 1975
Noxsoma Life Camp:  
Manic Swoons
Tranquility 
7D Traffic
Revisiting the 7 D Puzzle & The Next Cult.      

Sabado Grande mi gente. 

Welcome to one more day above ground in the kingdom of chaos. It’s Abundance year and we have no fear because we are protected, and connected to Source. 

After years of sussing out what we mean by the 7 Dimensional Puzzle, we realized that “dimension” is not an accurate way to describe what we’re talking about.  

Bummer.  

It sounds cool to us though. So we’ll keep using it until something cooler-sounding emerges. 

This is the water that seeps into the rock. Like Julia Ormond, in “Legends of the Fall.” Compromise is the foundation of corruption. Here’s the reference. Rainwater settles into the rock during the spring. As the weather cools, the water turns to ice, eventually splitting the rock. It doesn’t usually happen in a single season, but eventually. The way were were told that Grand Canyon was formed. The rock is “core-rupted”, broken at the center. And there’s no coming back. 

So I compromise by using a word I know is inaccurate, because it sounds cool. What else are we compromising on? 

Seven Elements? Or maybe I’ll just make up a word. I’ve been minting words to describe the Simulatrix, time, the 17 days between self-health checks, and so forth. There are a lot of roots and sounds available with which to craft these words. The next trick is to propagate them and inculcate them into to lexicon, so that my fellow carbon units will apprehend what I’m talking about. 

Here are the 7 Elements of this mystical puzzle that Mind is perpetually assembling and altering as we make our way through the realm. 

1 thru 3 are the actual dimensions of matter. 

4, is space-time. Motion. 

5, is shape, & change and everything associated with it.

6 & 7, that’s on Us. It’s an ever expanding bag, so to speak. It’s knowledge & gnosis, perspective & perception, quadrastanding, interpretation, & dare I say, “common senses.” 

For example, you look at a Pizza Parlor, just to use a conspiratorial example. It’s just a restaurant, until someone points out the symbolism. The elements, (6 & 7), are activated. What else do you start noticing about this pizza place because you were “awakened” to the, (using the word loosely here), “truth?” The art on the walls starts to look a little bit more creepy. You maybe start to imagine that the kids don’t necessarily “belong,” with the adults who are with them. And suddenly, the pepperoni tastes a little off.  

This is just a thought provoking example. But it works with enlightenment as well. Some fairy tale that you learned as a kid that sticks with you. Because of instant access to information, you decide to “decode” the words. They meant something different in 1600, than they mean today. Humpty Dumpty is a good example. You do a little digging and learn where the term comes from, and that the poem you recited as a kid, is not the way it was originally composed. 

The apocalypse doesn’t change your life, and it doesn’t complete your puzzle. Instead it completes a piece of the greater puzzle. What else was changed? What were the names of the seven dwarfs before Disney changed them to something more family friendly? Why are witches trying to murder pretty girls in fairy tales. What’s the symbolism of the deep sleep? A shoe that only fits a single foot? Why are there no other words like “shoe” in English?   

We could make our puzzle out of nine elements, or twelve, or 360, or even 360 to the power of 360, (that’s a little more abstract). FYI, the answer has 921 digits in the string and returns to digital 9.  

Anyway, We apply this “Septonomial” puzzle philosophy to just about everything. In today’s episode we apply it to traffic. 

In the audio companion, 7 shows up again. You will never guess where it showed up this time. 

Stay safe, stay strong, stay sane, stay savvy, stay serene, stay sovereign, stay subscribed.  

PEACE.     



![1975.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaCSCuhZcDUduQtnBpcB2CK5rLWHMpCgZWUCh1bqL98By/1975.png)
 

Today's Episode:   https://odysee.com/@Noxsoma:2/1910_full_5-23-26_1975_swoons:5?r=47k2ScJsm9Uex9eETqgCCA8q1fukdST9  
Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe.

The Break I was supposed to Take Yesterday.
One of the best circumstances about blissful ignorance, is the option to eschew critical thinking. If you want to believe that a Chicken Heart was kept alive in a vat in a University laboratory and was let loose by a careless janitor and eventually ate New York City. That’s cool. Don’t ask any questions. Just roll with it. 
If you want to believe that viruses exist and can be spread only after 9 PM, up to a distance of 5 feet & eleven inches. That’s cool. Don’t ask any questions.

Your humble vagabond wants to believe that space-aliens came to Earth to mine gold, created a slave species that multiplied in its multiplicity, made so much noise that it kept the head alien up at night, and were eventually wiped out by a devastating flood. Because they were noisy.   
Or at least I wanted to. I think the novelty is wearing thin. However, it might be revised. 
Why?
Because I broke the rules. I asked questions. I looked in the closet and under the bed, in the attic and in the basement, but I didn’t find the boogieman. I didn’t find any trace of a boogieman. I asked the difficult questions and although the boogieman had become a par of my identity, I had to let the fantasy go. 
This same release may have to happen with Alien Intervention theory. Maybe it actually happened. But the story, with which I was fascinated, the first thousand times I heard it, is losing its charm. Maybe because I asked questions. 
That’s what they call it the scientific method. Science means to split. So I started splitting this story apart. And what I found is more code and maybe 6,000 years of spin. Oh yeah, and symbolism too. Of course I didn’t catch the symbolism right away, because I didn’t know where to look. And I wasn’t asking questions. 

So yesterday, for some reason, I searched the etymology of the word Igigi. These were the “younger” or “lesser” maybe working class Annunaki aliens. I can almost guarantee you that the “Annunaki” did not call their laborers, Igigi. 
First of all, Igigi is a palindrome. Spelled the same way forward as backwards. 
Secondly, and I’m actually getting a bit tired of this, the name traces back to number 7. But not just seven. Check this out, the connection between the word \

and the number 7 is not a coincidence.  While the true origin of the name is unknown, evidence suggests its later, written form was deliberately crafted as a sophisticated numerical pun referencing the number of great gods, those luminaries for which our days of the week are named. \nHere’s the cuneiform break down, numerically speaking. \nThe Cuneiform Signs: The name was later written in Sumerian as \
.\nThe Numerical Values. In the Sumerian language, these signs also functioned as numbers, where \
= 1. \nThe Mathematical Puns. \nAddition (5+1+1): This equals 7, which was the traditional number of the \

in the Mesopotamian pantheon. 
You guys should know by now that 7 is my magic number. Just an aside, I got a massage over the last weekend, and the therapist took me to room 7. If this is real life, the magic is working. If it’s a simulation, my self-programming is working. 
This exploration of the etymology of Igigi, not only led me back to 7, but also led Mind to the determination that the Sumerian tablets and the Annunaki saga recorded therein, is encoded numerically. There’s also gematria at play. And if I wanted to believe in the boogieman, I might suggest that there are some secret formulae in there. However, and this is a big however. I think what’s encoded in the Sumerian tablets has already been exposed. We suspect that the information is aimed that those who are robust, clever and imaginative enough to rebuild and manage a post-deluge society.   
This has been a major detour and a blow to my humans-are-marked-for-death-by-repentant-aliens cosmogony. It may yet be revived. However, right now Mind is more fascinated by the math hidden in the stories.

title.title: La constance ne fait pas toujours de bruit ✨
title.body:
/>

Not everything that matters is visible.

Over the past few days, I’ve been quieter on social media…  
but that doesn’t mean I stopped building.

Some of the most important growth happens behind the scenes:  
the discipline,  
the consistency,  
the repeated actions nobody sees.

In business, wellness, and life, progress is rarely built overnight.  
It’s built through small decisions made consistently over time.

Showing up.  
Staying focused.  
Continuing even when no one is watching.

Quiet seasons are still productive seasons ✨

—

Ce n’est pas parce qu’on est moins visible qu’on a arrêté d’avancer.

Ces derniers jours, j’ai été plus discrète ici…  
mais les habitudes, les efforts et la constance étaient toujours là.

Parce que souvent, les plus grandes progressions se construisent dans l’ombre.  
Dans les petites actions répétées.  
Dans la discipline quotidienne.  
Dans le choix de continuer, même sans reconnaissance immédiate.

En affaires comme dans la vie, les résultats se bâtissent une étape à la fois.

Une marche à la fois.  
Une habitude à la fois.  
Un pas de plus chaque jour 🤍

title.title: The best way to live a teenage life
title.body:
https://youtu.be/z_jPv6Klof4?si=e3Whnce4yVVfVjXw
Teenage life a the best time when you build your life in the way of God. The Bible teaches that the best way for teenagers to live a good life is by fearing God, respecting parents, choosing good friends, and avoiding sinful habits. A teenager who follows God’s ways will grow in wisdom and make better decisions in life. The life of Joseph is a good example of a young person who remained faithful to God even when faced with temptation and challenges.

 >1 Timothy 4:12, “Let no one despise your youth, but be an example to the believers in word, in conduct, in love, in spirit, in faith, in purity.”

The scripture teaches us we should use our youthful time to build a good relationship with God. Instead of following bad influences, young people should fill their minds with things that are pure, honest, and helpful. Living a good teenage life means showing love, humility, discipline, and obedience to God daily.
