title.title: Phase Out Voucher Distribution and Switch Exclusive Card Sales Exclusively to DEC
title.body:
**Objective to completely remove the Voucher system and replace it with the sale of exclusive cards for DEC, while simultaneously supporting the Legendary Archon archetype.**

Current situation approximately 40,000 Vouchers are distributed daily (20k for SPS stakers + 20k for Node License owners). This results in 14.6 million Vouchers per year, with a total value of 420–450 million DEC (at ~29 DEC per Voucher). I propose to change complete cessation of Voucher distribution. **Switching to exclusive card sales for DEC with 100% burn**, while strengthening Legendary Archon, will burn significant DEC, support the peg, positively impact SPS price long-term, and create a healthier economy. The current Voucher system is outdated. It’s time for a sustainable, pro-economic model.



## Sell Vouchers card for DEC ##
Launch of a new Exclusive Card Shop – all new limited cards will be sold exclusively for DEC.
Card prices should reflect current Voucher values (e.g. a legendary card costing 20k DEC per BCX).

## Support for Legendary Archon ##
New cards from the upcoming sets should include dedicated synergies and abilities that significantly increase the usefulness of Archon cards (especially Legendary). These supporting cards should work similarly to how Coastal Sentry supports Possibilus the Wise — providing strong buffs, mana efficiency, or powerful effects that make Archon decks much more competitive and desirable in the current meta.

1. Strong DEC Burning and PEG Support 
Current liquid DEC supply is approximately 6.39 billion, with ~4.33 billion frozen in major pools (@sps.dao, @sps.dao.reserves, @credits.for.dec, and Land). With 100% burn of all DEC spent in the Exclusive Card Shop, we create powerful deflationary pressure and one of the strongest mechanisms to maintain the DEC peg at 1:1000, which is important for DAO to pay their bills in stablecoins by converting DEC for USDC.
2. Real Demand Instead of Inflationary Rewards
Players will need to buy DEC on the open market.
3. Better Gameplay and Card Value
New cards gain real meta relevance through Archon synergies.
4. Team Effort vs Current Lack of Return
The Splinterlands team currently spends a lot of time and resources designing these exclusive cards, carefully testing their abilities, and ensuring they positively influence the game meta. However, under the existing Voucher system, these efforts bring almost no direct economic benefit to the project or the ecosystem.  Changing this mechanic to direct sales for DEC with full burn would create a positive and sustainable ecosystem: the team’s hard work would directly translate into token burns, stronger peg stability, increased player engagement, and real value creation for all participants.
6. Realistic Sales Projections
Assuming an average of 200 max exclusive cards sold per month: 
a. Monthly revenue: 200 × 220,000 DEC = 44,000,000 DEC
b. Annual revenue: 22,000,000 DEC x 12 = 528,000,000 DEC
 (with 100% burn)
5. Positive Impact on SPS Token Price
Current staking returns (SPS and Nodes) are only around couple % APR thanks to Vouchers. However, this small yield comes with heavy selling pressure that drives SPS price down over time. It is much better to have 0% APR from Vouchers but reverse the downward trend of SPS and achieve real price appreciation. In the long term, token price growth brings far more value than low inflationary rewards. Examples:
- Current system: ~2-4% in Vouchers, but SPS price drops 50% in a year → large net loss.
- Proposed system: 0% Voucher rewards, but SPS price rises 20% per year → positive return.
- Optimistic case: SPS price grows 40–60% annually → stakers benefit significantly more.

## Direct Benefits for SPS Stakers and Node License Holders

 ##
This change is designed to bring long-term, sustainable value to stakers and Node owners, not just short-term rewards:
- Significant SPS Price Appreciation: Removing constant Voucher selling pressure will reduce downward pressure on SPS. A 20–60% annual increase in SPS price (very realistic with better tokenomics) would generate far greater returns than the current ~2-4% APR from Vouchers.
- Higher Real Yield in USD Terms: Even with 0% Voucher rewards, if SPS price rises 20% in a year, a staker’s portfolio performs much better than earning 4% while SPS drops 40–50% (as seen in recent years).
- Increased Value of Node Licenses: Stronger DEC peg and healthier game economy will drive higher player activity and demand for Nodes. 
- Better Staking Rewards Compensation: I propose implementing alternative compensation mechanisms, such as: GLINT staking rewards,
exclusive airdrops such as skins, bonus multipliers for long-term stakers.
- Stronger Ecosystem = Higher Asset Value: A stable DEC and growing player base directly benefits everyone holding SPS or Nodes. Healthy tokenomics attract new players and investors, increasing overall demand for governance and infrastructure assets.

### In short: It is better to own a stake in a rising, healthy ecosystem than to receive small inflationary rewards in a declining one. ###

## Call to the Community ##

I strongly encourage @Claboyn (DAO Managers) to create a poll covering this change. As one of the most respected voices in the Splinterlands community, he could clearly explain the current problems with the Voucher system, the benefits of switching to exclusive DEC sales, and the long-term advantages for stakers, Node owners, and the entire ecosystem. It would be ideal if he could gather community feedback, refine the key points, and then present the proposal to @davemccoy so they can formally submit and champion it through official DAO channels.



## Time to End the Voucher Shop Experiment ##
The testing phase of the Voucher Shop has now run its course and, while the core idea of regularly releasing new exclusive cards was good, the Voucher distribution model itself has proven to be problematic. The constant inflation caused by giving away millions of Vouchers every month created significant selling pressure and did not deliver the expected long-term benefits to the ecosystem.  It is time to stop the bleeding, learn from this experiment, and implement a better system that benefits everyone — players, stakers, Node owners, the team, and the token economy as a whole.



## Conclusion ##
Switching to exclusive card sales exclusively for DEC (with 100% burn) combined with strengthening the Modern Archon is a comprehensive solution that will significantly burn DEC, support the peg, positively influence SPS price in the long term, and strengthen the overall game economy.The current Voucher system is outdated and creates inflation. It’s time for a sustainable, pro-economic model.

title.title: [Eng./Esp.]   Owner of what?   ||   ¿Dueño de qué?
title.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***

# ***
***

> *‘I am the owner’*, say the deeds and contracts. What a curious phrase of the day, and yet, at the same time, so presumptuous. At seventy years of age, I read it and can’t help but smile wryly—the kind of smile that only comes with maturity, when you stop believing in the fairy tales of ownership. They call me the *‘owner’* of a house with leaks, of a car that is ageing with me, and of books gathering dust because nobody reads them anymore. But ***what do I really own?***
# ***
Owner of what?
*** I was born naked, landing in this world without a single coin, possessing barely the air that filled my lungs for the first time. Now, at this stage where time simply flows by like a silent river, I understand the punchline: when I die, if they don’t decide to cremate me and turn me into particles, others will dress me in a suit I didn’t buy for a journey where suitcases aren’t allowed.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23xyP3TihzpQmYL4wXhWei3BMP4CJZkTwBDbLwY1LH7DdyPwE6LQGLT8efVcU87FdAo6t.jpeg)
I have spent decades accumulating objects, foolishly believing that the verb ‘to possess’ granted me a solid identity. What a human mistake. I am not even the master of this body that creaks as I wake today, nor of my own memories, which sometimes decide to desert me without warning. Time does not belong to me; I am the one who belongs to it, and it devours me with a subtle and terrifying patience. Perhaps I am master only of my own doubt, and even that I suspect. We are precarious tenants in an existence that asks no permission to come to an end. My only possession is this present sigh, this second that has already slipped away. The rest is a mirage, a short-term loan that is settled with death. *** ***

> Come and participate, there's still time. You can find all the information daily in the [#Freewritehouse](https://peakd.com/c/hive-161155/created) Community. Specifically, today's prompt post:
# **
[PROMPT: «I am the owner»](https://peakd.com/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/23-may-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3112-i-am-the-owner)
**
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/AJmudPPCWGA6FfcXPrAmdLk2CY4mxGWYvbsFs8KPohCx9wnhBrpjcwmEyvYmxqn.jpg Cover of the initiative.
*** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23swkfAXGs5WxHg49jyEWGAanWReDpMUQbxUB4FYX98iMaztGejMtj5HJUN6abwpCZhUN.png)

*** *** ### **
Dedicated to all those writers who contribute, day by day, to making our planet a better world.
** *** ***
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23vhudAgmrPvXnYXzmsiD5366jktCLxdeWqxFQg2nCeezVK4yv7CJ9dQpSevYb8nEeqTR.png) https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif
*** *** ***

*, dicen las escrituras y los contratos. Qué frase tan curiosa del día, y, a la vez, tan insolente. A mis setenta años, la leo y no puedo evitar una sonrisa ladeada, esa que solo te regala la madurez cuando dejas de creer en los cuentos de hadas de la posesión. Me llaman *\

* de una casa con goteras, de un coche que envejece conmigo y de unos libros que acumulan polvo porque ya nadie los lee. Pero, ***¿de qué soy dueño realmente?***
# ***
¿Dueño de qué?
*** Nací desnudo, aterrizando en este mundo sin una sola moneda, poseyendo apenas el aire que estrenaba mis pulmones. Ahora, en esta etapa donde el tiempo simplemente pasa como un río silencioso, entiendo el chiste final: cuando muera, si no deciden incinerarme para volverme partículas, otros me vestirán con un traje que no compré para un viaje donde no se permiten maletas.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23xyT4NyWoXJTVkYpy8T5mDcjczNJ55qtg3V6tx5vj6XjJQMwMpdoL1GezrDEgDjxt5xw.png)
He pasado décadas acumulando objetos, creyendo estúpidamente que el verbo \

me otorgaba una identidad sólida. Qué error tan humano. Ni siquiera soy el amo de este cuerpo que hoy me cruje al despertar, ni de mis propios recuerdos, que a veces deciden desertar sin previo aviso. El tiempo no me pertenece; yo soy el que le pertenece a él, y me devora con una paciencia fina y aterradora. Quizá solo soy dueño de mi duda, y hasta de ella sospecho. Somos inquilinos precarios en una existencia que no pide permiso para terminarse. Mi única propiedad es este suspiro presente, este segundo que ya se fue. Lo demás es un espejismo, un préstamo a corto plazo que se liquida con la muerte.
*** ***

>## Hive World Cup 2026 - join us

>After several Bundesliga tipping seasons on Kicktipp, I am thinking about organizing a traditional FIFA World Cup 2026 prediction game for the Hive community.

>This would run in parallel to other awesome football projects already existing on Hive and is NOT meant as competition to them. Ideally people simply enjoy both 🙂

>## ⚽ What is this?

>A classic football prediction game hosted on Kicktipp:
👉 predict World Cup match results
👉 climb the leaderboard
👉 answer a few bonus questions
👉 compete with the Hive football community

[https://www.kicktipp.com/hive-world-cup-2026/](https://www.kicktipp.com/hive-world-cup-2026/)

>## 🏆 How does scoring work?

>Points are awarded automatically by Kicktipp for:

>* exact scores
>* correct goal difference
>* correct tendency (win/draw/loss)

>* Who becomes World Champion?
>* Which team produces the tournament top scorer?
>* Which teams reach the semi-finals?

>These bonus points are automatically added to the overall leaderboard.

>## 🌟 Matchday Winners

>Each tournament phase / matchday also has its own ranking and winner automatically handled via Kicktipp.

>This keeps the competition interesting throughout the entire World Cup and not only at the end.

>* random community prizes

>* HIVE
>* HBD

>Simple:

title.title: When Dreams Become 'DUET'.🥰❤️
title.body: > Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. ***

> Hello my dear friends. I am @rasel72. From #Bangladesh. *** ![6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzrpzePdY2sCyemUjpRGRjxTKzzUd5z8nR85ezm2bXTz5zSEqv1vxoasCtDtjCNtoxGtE28PSkmJWj2XY2.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfNvmADspkNgf2zWjy3PmQB31pRRA8T78Ff8CdhE6TwAS/6VvuHGsoU2QBt9MXeXNdDuyd4Bmd63j7zJymDTWgdcJjnzrpzePdY2sCyemUjpRGRjxTKzzUd5z8nR85ezm2bXTz5zSEqv1vxoasCtDtjCNtoxGtE28PSkmJWj2XY2.jpeg)
Thumbnail

>


Since we came to know about our arrival on earth, various kinds of speculations and plans about our life's goals and future have been going on. First, as per Allah's plan, our parents take various kinds of plans and precautionary measures to show us the face of the world. Then, since we came to earth, they have been arranging their dreams around us. How can we be raised as ideal people, how can we be educated in higher education, and how can we be well-off, parents forget to fulfill their dreams and hobbies. When we learn to understand and grow up, our own liking also comes into play. We start following our own choices and desires. Especially those who want to educate themselves and stand tall in the society, they always dream. And try accordingly. Especially many of us dream of becoming a doctor, engineer, or something else. But it cannot be done just by wanting to be. For that, luck is also needed in addition to hard work.

 One of the early dreams of a student is to get a chance in a good public university after completing college. Because, to fulfill your dream, you must be highly educated. Even if you want to go far with a general education, you cannot go far. Therefore, the first step to fulfill your dream is to make yourself a graduate. Currently, to get a chance in public universities in Bangladesh, you have to work hard and get a place in the merit list through the admission test. Which is not an easy task at all. Especially for those who complete their diploma engineering and take the university admission test, it is more difficult, because there is only one public university for diploma students in Bangladesh, which is Duet, which is located in Gazipur district. This is the dream place of thousands of diploma students in the country. After a long year of coaching or trying and winning the admission battle, you get a chance to study here. Those who do not get a chance the first time, they have a second chance, which is even harder. That means you have to study for another year and then take the exam to get a chance. I myself got a chance the second time, after trying for two years. 

![1000053747.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmfA77XJ4CBX62AXLhJmKRtwR9Lm7m76HSoA3BAHY4WFu7/1000053747.jpg)

![1000053772.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUbWeM5M9zEBGnZgEnKHQVru3MNBJ8cAsVvWc8V7UDHzF/1000053772.jpg)

![1000053823.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmQGPtD71WWFF9XLVxLtp5wUMM5yuyvv32V3bAx4Cmimtj/1000053823.jpg)

![1000053834.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmcRyAkf3YXHFjqfXAnSEEBMgTrgNXwWzS5JxoTY8E2hXz/1000053834.jpg)

Here, proper guidelines and studies are required to give admission exams. As a result, one has to enroll in coaching to study every subject well. There are many Duet Admission Admission Coachings in Ghazipur, where students get admitted and prepare for the Duet Admission Exam. The biggest and best coaching in Ghazipur in terms of success is \

. Where I have also coached myself. Currently, after getting a chance, I am associated with this coaching. Along with the responsibility of a resident of coaching, I do the work of taking coaching exams and checking the records. Not only me, but almost a hundred Duetians are involved in this work. Every week, students have exams on Friday. Duet Admission Exam is coming up after a few months. For this, series exams are going on in the coachings, today there was a series exam of each department's department subject. I went there to give guard and check the records. The coaching informed us in advance about the exam. Then we went to the examination center on time. ![1000053804.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQma3rvB7QkxLtjpLGwiJRrLkgwYSDXaTz6qtf3vfgBRULF/1000053804.jpg) ![1000053812.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmbqWEoRwDrVUhvoKLM8jFb1yatDLD7NUAb9uUUp9vL1iM/1000053812.jpg) ![1000053761.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmd8NACQf3k1YWCqZncJXZLUcKgucTKmJNFJMruQmkESqf/1000053761.jpg) Today the examination started at 7 am. I went before 7 am. Then they gave examination duty till 9 am. Then the coaching provided breakfast for everyone, we ate it. After finishing our meal, we all started checking the records together. We checked the records till 11 am. Then the coaching gave us a specific amount of money as remuneration. I went to my room with that. Every year thousands of students come to Ghazipur with dreams, some succeed and return smiling, while some fail and return crying. In fact, everything is the work of creation, we just try our best. But we should all always trust in the Creator. Anyway, today I will discuss the life stories of duet warriors. Earlier, although I also shared my admission journey with you, those who read my posts already know. It ends here like today, everyone stay well and healthy. I will see you again with a new post of mine.   #
>Thank you very much everyone for reading today's post.

title.title: Alpaca Drag, Cabinet Door + More, Irrigation Install Finished, Scapes, Trailer, Sore - Friday
title.body:
The alpaca had turtled overnight so I went up on the hill and dragged her down, under the fence, and to the bottom of the hill. She just gave in to it without any fight and as soon as I rolled her on her stomach her head popped up and she was acting more normal. ![IMG_20260522_063611.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tSYQLqNFcBca8qSGjSWbrNRrst8B7QqjJUFTCLpnZkuPHtqTVauhbF1AksTcAaQyjJJ.jpg) She was up there on the hill. ![IMG_20260522_063614.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vhunsXuYV6LzV64aowETB1EK8tfqFGGt96wPFdfVmag1CoqohcBYou1HqQ9eFYHya7M.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_071541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tbtyNFZhNr85EvGErAz7zUmsYz7yFnJsPuDB7jBeAWfiyYavRa2vqG4J4QsAReKcVPD.jpg) I was at my one client's house by 8am. I got the soil into the planter, set the irrigation rotor zone, Installed her Ring cameras, put together the weed eater and cut grass along the fence, then I had to make the old lazy susan cabinet door work with hinges. I had to run and grab my planers from home so I could shave down one side a quarter inch. ![IMG_20260522_095206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wMYNidBbLWCLoABrWKxeZfo9S6tQwACEeDER4fjNTkcsSGYAgqeACB8Kz15ENCvTNB1.jpg) I had to chamfer the edge pretty extreme to allow the door to open as the edge caught on the cabinet. Now it opens fully and there is just enough resistance to hold itself closed for now. I will put a magnet setup on it to keep it closed. ![IMG_20260522_103035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWuF3GoW1EuroxWhvQrZoMoCeuaAQe9HgbiCzRBiST8HgQGaHiEtgy9Mf7nER9wepPe.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_103030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23xAY38EHHye79kS34WcqmUqbgcv13tqwqSZnBxhMj8dxFuUgwDcsDu1tq2naW6sFiwQY.jpg) I got home and ate in the 20-ish minutes I had before I had to leave for the irrigation install. The first thing I did was pull up the bricks and dig the trench. I had to install the pop-up heads and nozzles, run the wire, then bury everything in the trench. ![IMG_20260522_120411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23y8t1F3sXirPj9WEbEeUqN4UE8aYax1WkWSbvc1nYurSs9Wr6yphtGMrNXG7auXjBFkG.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_133020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wMU58B5SoozKxnZt7xPxoaAMEV7DT7sjj1yUPLmH3bmEdGvKAH6LNHQHsqU8p8ZwMwT.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_133030.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tva9sdkabuYtdG6VJGfzZBgpjjhkTbRgC5ndq2LPzELX3mDmQh6vGxXsb7aTY24KadA.jpg) It took me 2 hours to finish the install then I had to test all the zones and set the spray patterns right. I was VERY pleased with the positioning of the rotors in the front yard as they are head to head and all hit the middle. No mapping or measuring, just used my judgement and visual placement. ![IMG_20260522_140930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmBLMcJXawXtemS2bsRxtGvX4v4YNBFwMpXm3PqHtvGBS73gk1g8uzHLHihtX57wMQC.jpg) ![IMG_20260522_141536.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWpsU9tBWDh5oyv9UFfnZVPuRuUZAvvZnGvKkGuanrFF56yJdj63TTPZUyN9x6Y4CLQ.jpg) I was really stoked on the side of the garage as the fence is pretty close. The heads barely hit the fence so all the water falls in the narrow strip. ![IMG_20260522_145732.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tH3nNQt6eXMvDLmgdbx7GPygcEzRuFVxySA4bsy7tsEzfuB1pzdjAvjZsKqURHnq7ek.jpg) The back yard has total coverage as well as the side by the valve box. Tested on the controller and all valves work, set the controller and I was done. Zelle is killer as I get the notification of payment as I am standing with the client. ![IMG_20260522_145735.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23u62xGKocBrbtRGqR2vEv3qNKHPx1ytDPD7wJ9UThMuLVh8zuMmsPobLDry2RWv9VqdH.jpg) I was beat once I got home but found myself out in the garden cutting scapes from the rows of garlic. Thankfully about half the 3100 heads produce scapes. ![IMG_20260522_174851.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmBLEPuB1UYqfXQdcWxqZSuTpoZN1zAL7GnbmJs3wtLH8FxjyFpAmdeBANdx5xocdEg.jpg) After dinner I got the trailer hooked up for the grain run I have done already. Shower then much needed bed. ![IMG_20260522_201129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23vsEFLV2qS7e6k9e373kGx2tFGKjsqRummtWwhxjct9xBjrnsAjRS8VSjzhbmuY1ym51.jpg) I have been to town for the grain and will unload it in a bit. I then go up and haul back the branches from the tree I cut down. I would like to get a ride in today, maybe grill this evening. ---

title.title: Cold and Raining - Let's Cook Instead of Gardening - by Sunscape
title.body:
![foodiesbeehive-bok-choi-egg-rolls-7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPug4CMRv6qS4JQCJzygRXGd7qGKVA3wUuDyakwj2GksA/foodiesbeehive-bok-choi-egg-rolls-7.jpg)

I planned on gardening, but the weather changed those plans.  I had been wanting to make egg rolls again, so that's what I did.


![foodiesbeehive-silverbloggers-egg-rolls-.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTomU1R11A5bW3XqaezUd1Ak7emACiaJDEuom4qa9drki/foodiesbeehive-silverbloggers-egg-rolls-.jpg)

I browned some ground beef with onions, peppers, and shredded carrots first.  Then I finely chopped the bok choi that I harvested from the hydroponics.  While that was wilting down, I quickly boiled rice noodles until al dente.  Once they were cooled off, I cut them into small pieces and added everything together for the filling.


![foodiesbeehive-bok-choi-egg-rolls-4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQRESzj7t59btKZGvex6RTdk8GhXWH5mCVRs7GvEueZt9/foodiesbeehive-bok-choi-egg-rolls-4.jpg)

I used two wrappers per egg roll to make them stronger.  It didn't take too long before I had finished filling them all.


![foodiesbeehive-bok-choi-egg-rolls-6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbWjH5gTQx5JR9mLRNL9X3K4tWCB6UZaVKEe18hGDRc7r/foodiesbeehive-bok-choi-egg-rolls-6.jpg)

I only cooked them in oil until lightly browned, as I was prepping these for the freezer, and they would be reheated.  


![foodiesbeehive-bok-choi-egg-rolls-9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRKLnWRBEkrsx6sn4NjBDZdHk3stoBS7vE5YXMrU9kTiK/foodiesbeehive-bok-choi-egg-rolls-9.jpg)

The darkest ones became part of that night's dinner, and the others were packaged for the freezer.  I had made enough for three meals, not a bad accomplishment for a rainy morning.  


![stir fry.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZrNW3xFN129nQwV8mpB1B9h2vmSTX6swH1BUWKzPHXyC/stir%20fry.jpg)

Making a quick stir-fry three days earlier must have put me in the mood for Asian-style meals.  Now, I'm feeling Thai Curry coming in the near future.  lol

It's still rainy, windy, and cold outside.  I will have to find something else to make this morning.  Oh my!  


![banner-sunscape-2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYr3stqM7yx8cpipf8v6F4YgkM2aD282NSQrGYzJZqCxE/banner-sunscape-2.jpg)

<center>*The human being's quest to find plenitude, peace and purpose seems to have no end;  The same letter describes it precisely: \

We live in a peaceful world, where glories, applause and poses are temporal.  We try to fill the soul with things that fade with time, forgetting that an infinite void can only be filled by an eternal God.\n ​That's where this song takes on a glorious meaning and connects with our theme of the week: \

.
 ​This tower on the ground tells us of a moment of rescue, a bell of an absolute truth that remains unalterable through ages.* </center>


<center>*La búsqueda del ser humano por encontrar plenitud, paz y propósito parece no tener fin; la misma letra lo describe con precisión: \

. Vivimos en un mundo pasajero, donde las glorias, los aplausos y las posesiones son temporales. .

.  This grace that broke the fear did not end in expiry. title.title: Friendship: A Priceless and Selfless Gift of the Heart
title.body:
> How are you, friend? I hope that in this busy life, you are doing very well with your loved ones. Today I want to talk to you about a topic that is an integral part of each of our lives—'Friendship'. Humans are social creatures, and while living in this society, we get entangled in the web of many relationships. Some relationships are of blood, some are of need. But the relationship that survives above all these without any conditions is friendship. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9035f369-88f3-4d2d-a5a2-12cfde236158.jpg) What you said is absolutely true—friendship is a precious gift, which is impossible to judge by any price or money. When we come to this world, our identity with family or relatives is established by birth. But a friend is a person whom we find with our own conscience and love. This relationship does not accept any formality, does not accept any social status. To a true friend, your identity is only through the clarity of your heart. In this modern mechanical world, we can buy and sell almost everything. Money can buy luxury, comfort, and even artificial respect. But have you ever heard of someone buying a kilo of 'trust' or two liters of 'sympathy' from the market? Friendship is just like that. It is a treasure that can only be earned, not bought. When you are lost in a danger in the middle of the night, can the presence of a person who stands by your side without any interest be repaid even with diamonds and jewels worth crores of taka? The answer is, no. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/30834814-8d2a-485b-87af-d86bcd4a8870.jpg) Friendship cannot be limited to any definition. It is a ray of sunshine on a rainy day, or a little cool shade on a hot afternoon. A true friend can understand your silence, which the rest of the world fails to understand even after shouting a lot. There are times in our lives when we feel very alone, when we really want to tell someone the words stored in our hearts - then a friend becomes that safe haven. There is no judgment, no urge to find fault; There is only a tendency to accept a certain amount. You may have many friends, but at the end of the day, only a handful of them are very close to your soul. These people are the real wealth of your life. Their love or sacrifice is priceless. Because love and selflessness have no price tag. Friendship means complementing each other. Just as there is no jealousy in a friend's success, there is no question of leaving him/her in a friend's failure. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fcc4f762-5275-4b2c-91c0-c4e62a28490b.jpg) Finally, I would like to say that if you have even one friend in your life who understands you unconditionally, then you will know that you are one of the richest people in the world. It is your responsibility to protect this wealth. Once money runs out, it can be acquired again, but once a true friend is lost, it is not possible to fill that void even if you pour all the wealth in the world. So, let us take care of these precious relationships of ours and wrap each other in the blanket of love. Because at the end of the day, the memories we have left will be the biggest savings of our lives.

title.title: The tunes of “Scary Movie”.
title.body: <center>[Bloody Disgusting](https://bloody-disgusting.com/movie/3942774/new-poster-for-scary-movie-spoofs-terrifier-and-other-recent-horror-movies/)</center>\nLess than two weeks before its theatrical release with its original cast, ***Scary Movie*** is arriving with an even more robust marketing campaign. In addition to trailers, posters, interviews, and direct contact with the public (through social media), one of the best (and most profitable) *nonsense* comedy franchises in cinema is betting on a soundtrack that gets straight to the point: to entertain, but with personality in each new attempt.\nTwo songs were recently released, and it is precisely because of them that I am writing this text. The limits of personality in this new chapter of the franchise are truly above expectations. **Chris Patrick** reached the public's ears with the song ***\

***, which is a musical product full of attitude. The well-orchestrated touches of rap (with cause and effect) bring a very energetic atmosphere and fit like a glove in this chapter.\nAnother name that adds a very interesting product here is **Lizzo**, who, alongside rapper **Sexyy Red**, released the song ***\

***. Without any pretension of being a song that will be remembered for years to come, the idea is simply to entertain listeners with generic themes. However, it's worth mentioning the great interaction between the singers, which makes the song sound very natural and characteristic of this comedic franchise. Here's another cool and confident rap.
In general, it's very satisfying to see a franchise as popular as this being so well produced again and with the original cast (almost the entire cast) back. The effort being made to allow the public to see all these characters on the big screen again is worthy of applause (because it really isn't such an easy task to bring them all together in the same project after so many years). I'm very much looking forward to seeing what they've come up with here.
---
<center>**Las canciones de “Scary Movie 6”.**</center>
A menos de dos semanas de su estreno en cines con su reparto original, ***Scary Movie 6*** llega con una campaña de marketing aún más ambiciosa. Además de tráileres, pósteres, entrevistas y contacto directo con el público (a través de las redes sociales), una de las franquicias de comedia *nonsense* más exitosas (y rentables) del cine apuesta por una banda sonora que va directo al grano: entretener, pero con personalidad en cada nueva entrega.
Recientemente se lanzaron dos canciones, y es precisamente por ellas que escribo este texto. La personalidad que se respira en este nuevo capítulo de la franquicia supera con creces las expectativas. **Chris Patrick** llegó a los oídos del público con la canción ***\

***, un tema lleno de actitud. Los toques de rap, bien orquestados (con causa y efecto), crean una atmósfera muy enérgica y encajan a la perfección en esta entrega.\nOtro nombre que aporta un producto muy interesante es **Lizzo**, quien, junto al rapero **Sexyy Red**, lanzó la canción ***\

***. Sin pretender ser una canción que se recuerde por años, la idea es simplemente entretener al público con temas genéricos. Sin embargo, cabe destacar la excelente interacción entre las cantantes, que hace que la canción suene muy natural y característica de esta franquicia cómica. Aquí tenemos otro rap genial y seguro. En general, es muy satisfactorio ver una franquicia tan popular como esta tan bien producida de nuevo y con el elenco original (casi todo el elenco) de vuelta. El esfuerzo que se está haciendo para que el público vuelva a ver a todos estos personajes en la gran pantalla es digno de aplauso (porque realmente no es tarea fácil reunirlos a todos en un mismo proyecto después de tantos años). Tengo muchas ganas de ver qué han creado. ---
**Os sons de “Todo Mundo Em Pânico”.**
Há menos de duas semanas de estrear nos cinemas com o seu elenco original, ***Todo Mundo Em Pânico*** está chegando com uma campanha de marketing ainda mais robusta. Além dos trailers, posters, entrevistas e um contato direto com o público (através das mídias sociais), uma das melhores (e mais rentáveis) franquias de comédia *nonsense* do cinema está apostando em uma trilha sonora que vai direto ao ponto: entreter, mas com personalidade em cada nova tentativa. Duas músicas foram recentemente lançadas, e é precisamente por causa delas que eu estou escrevendo este texto. Os limites de personalidade desse novo capítulo da franquia estão realmente acima do esperado. **Chris Patrick** chegou aos ouvidos do público com a música ***“Bigger Than Ever (We Back)”***, que é um produto musical cheio de atitude. Os toques bem orquestrados do rap (com causa e efeito) trazem uma atmosfera bem enérgica e cai como uma luva nesse capítulo. Outro nome que adiciona um produto bem interessante aqui é **Lizzo**, que ao lado da rapper **Sexyy Red**, lançou a música **“HOES”**. Sem qualquer pretensão de ser uma música que será lembrada ao longo dos próximos anos, a ideia é apenas divertir os ouvintes com temas genéricos. No entanto, vale à pena mencionar a ótima interação entre as cantoras, que fazem a música soar como algo bem natural e característico dessa franquia cômica. Eis aqui outro rap legal e confiante. De um modo geral, é muito satisfatório ver uma franquia tão popular quanto essa sendo tão bem produzida novamente e com o elenco original (quase inteiro) de volta. O esforço que está sendo feito para que o público consiga rever todos esses personagens na tela grande novamente é digno de aplausos (porque realmente não é uma tarefa tão fácil reunir todos eles em um mesmo projeto depois de tantos anos). Eu estou muito ansioso para ver o que eles aprontaram aqui. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/the-tunes-of-scary-movie-gph)

title.title: The Hamburger Helper Saga (40 boxes and counting)
title.body: ### The Hamburger Helper Saga\nI was surfing the internet the other-day for the purpose of getting bulk supplies ordered directly to my door. Not the easiest of things to do as I live outside main routes in a rural community. I found a spot that would deliver but I had to reach a certain dollar amount spent before the delivery made sense. This prompted me to purchase a bunch of comfort foods. Another of the things ordered was a few boxes of various dry pasta. Some other supplies ordered included gourmet spreads, some healthy snacks along with a range of other supplies. Three or four days go by and I get an email stating some of the items I ordered had their stock run out. This included 15 bags of organic chips I ordered.  \

--- Are we sure about that. Sounded reasonable enough so now I have to find substitutes for the items that are not available. I go view their list of items and look what I see --> _The items on my original list still available for sale_. I email them back with a list of substitutes. Included in that email a list of items that are clearly for sale on their website that was said to be out of stock. One of my substitutes - _40 Boxes of Hamburger Helper_. I was offered flat rate delivery for spending $XXX amount of dollars. So regardless of how big or small my order is my delivery cost is the same. I highly suspect they didn't want to ship me certain items because the volume of those items would make the shipping costly. A fair complaint if they were to say such but they didn't. After-all 15 large bags of organic chips does take up allot of volume and would be a costly delivery expense. Probably about the same amount of space those 40 boxes of Hamburger helpers are going to take up. It's been over a week since I ordered, a few days since the amendment to the order (at their request) but nothing has been shipped yet. If they get delivered I have no clue what I will do with such an amount of Hamburger Helper. I'd likely give them away to those in my local area. I suspect the business I ordered from are running the numbers of the total sale vs. the cost of shipping to me and are conflicted. I am interested to see what transpires next.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSbvnFMQqV2P6hz1GHhr4C7nBoAADwiVEBafySWT4ufsS/image.png) [Images are AI assisted] That's it for now. Thanks for stopping by. title.title: but what a beautiful cycle path in the mountains!!
title.body:
![_202605220945.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/242Y5QcSfJpYkpw2ZfuU1T2s7MD4cezfGPRHVcyvjieQseXhmHanFod7exnYx4rz2m8yv.jpeg)

Hello friends,
I have to say that whenever I travel to South Tyrol, I'm always amazed by the beauty of the area and by how beautiful and well-maintained the bike paths are. I don't find them like this anywhere else in Italy. You can tell we're almost on the border with Austria.
I think the beauty of cycling is admiring nature, because the bike gives you the opportunity to admire everything slowly, it would be impossible to notice the same things by car, only by going slowly you enjoy them more.



![705859874_10242340471437683_6493921370660554192_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/EpC8R1W9M282vFFpFXvjmVzX1QRE8DyDFWoccKkifhM2iLnWWJhiDFRNwUjw9TAbTex.jpg)

This network of cycle paths—I started from Merano—winds for about 20 km with breathtaking views. I recommend it if you're in the area. What I like most is how well-marked and maintained they are, with plenty of dedicated services, such as numerous fountains where you can fill your water bottle and even bike repair services, which unfortunately I had to use because I had a flat tire.
I'm already planning to do other trails later if I find the time, because there are some very beautiful places to see.So I hope to bring you more photos here.

![703136089_10242340466557561_2864754258401848619_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/EptZ6GrooQe531aDodq8rd3PmUeUaj871EV5pa8K1rPaMvpdKBANjR51U5Swyr9k1LL.jpg)

I am always speechless when I admire these beautiful mountains. The route is very easy because it is a moderate but constant climb. I can assure you that it is not even tiring to do.
But what I also like about cycling is that it's very environmentally friendly. I often arrive from Milan by bike, and many trains are now equipped to transport bikes. Once you get here, you're spoiled for choice when it comes to these routes.



![705440086_10242340456637313_5779872328212292809_n.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ilmaffeiano78/EpLeWrJFKbCmjY6BaadzBn5D9bqbsjKBozJULG4PiHWD7sdt6HxQHgUUd23vaxrmzUs.jpg)

I hope you can also take these routes and admire these natural landscapes. I hope the photos have conveyed some of the emotions they conveyed to me. Thank you for reading. See you next time! Bye!

title.title: Caribbean Panorama: Indictments, Blackouts, and more (May 17–23, 2026)
title.body:
![InShot_20260422_154840996.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yecier/23uQph8nVQCdurXCWQ4zxMahzgRbpyfF6D4UEjwPXvDdyVo8ZWqCGWu7tpMRLam45o8jP.jpg)

The region is grappling with a perfect storm of geopolitical escalation, crippling energy crises, democratic uncertainty, and economic fragility, all while attempting to chart a path toward longer-term resilience.

## Cuba: The Flashpoint of a Geopolitical Storm

Cuba remains the epicenter of a rapidly intensifying confrontation with the United States. On May 20, the Trump administration indicted former President (and actual power in the shadows) Raúl Castro on charges related to the 1996 downing of two civilian \

planes. The timing of this move, coupled with the simultaneous announcement that the USS Nimitz Carrier Strike Group had entered the Caribbean Sea, has been condemned by Havana as a “political maneuver” and a potential precursor to military aggression.

This political drama is unfolding against a backdrop of profound humanitarian suffering. With blackouts, lasting up to 22 hours a day in some areas, have sparked social protests against Cuban government and are decimating the vital tourism sector, with international arrivals plummeting.

## Jamaica: Economic Contraction and a Tourism Shift

The ripple effects of the Cuba crisis, combined with the lingering aftermath of Hurricane Melissa, are battering the Jamaican economy. The Planning Institute of Jamaica (PIOJ) reported a sharp 5.9% contraction in GDP for the first quarter of 2026. The tourism sector, a critical engine, saw a 20.4% downturn as total visitor expenditure fell by over 21%.

Despite the downturn, Jamaica and the Dominican Republic are inadvertently benefiting from a shift in regional travel demand. As Cuba's tourism infrastructure falters, both nations are emerging as alternative destinations, attracting redirected flights and cruise traffic. The Dominican Republic also scored a major counternarcotics victory this week, with U.S. and French agents seizing nearly a tonne of cocaine off its coast.

## Haiti: Democracy Deferred Amid Gang Warfare

Hope for a near-term political solution in Haiti is fading. Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé has openly doubted whether presidential elections can be held as scheduled in August, citing the inability to guarantee security. His assessment is tragically validated by events on the ground: renewed clashes between rival gangs in Cité Soleil have killed at least 78 people since May 9, forcing hospitals to evacuate and displacing over 5,300 residents.

## CARICOM and Infrastructure: A Region Rethinking Its Future

In a significant multilateral development, CARICOM, the UN, and the UNDP launched a landmark framework in St. Kitts this week to treat crime and violence as a public health emergency. The initiative calls for a prevention-oriented strategy that addresses the social, economic, and institutional drivers of insecurity, moving beyond traditional policing.

## Others highlights 

Meanwhile, the region’s creaking infrastructure remains a central challenge. In Puerto Rico, Governor Jenniffer González pledged to add 3,000 megawatts of new power generation capacity to combat chronic blackouts, a crisis rooted in a grid that has been crumbling since Hurricane Maria in 2017. The push for recovery was boosted by a U.S. House committee approving $1.22 billion in funding for the island’s roads and bridges. Further south, as Guyana and Suriname ride an energy-driven economic boom, Caribbean Airlines announced it will cut several intra-regional routes, including links to Dominica and St. Kitts, highlighting the persistent difficulty of maintaining connectivity in a fragmented and costly aviation market.

This week has laid bare the Caribbean's interconnected vulnerabilities and its deepening fault lines. As geopolitical tensions and climate impacts intensify, the region is forced to fight for stability on multiple fronts, all while trying to build a more unified and self-reliant future.

title.title: Saturday Run
title.body:
>A sunny weekend.

A weekend with no plans to go anywhere and no appointments with friends. This afternoon I relaxed and ran as usual. Since it was Saturday, the jogging track was naturally busy. Groups of children strolling leisurely, teenagers and their partners, and families joking and laughing. It was a joy to see the warm scenery along the jogging track.

Me? Of course, I ran alone. I hadn't seen my other running buddies, like Vivi, in a while. Besides the fact that we live quite far apart, our work schedules have also made it increasingly difficult to meet up. We've also been missing running together.

Earlier, I ran five kilometers with a total time of 37:33 minutes and an average pace of 7:22 per kilometer. It's so me, isn't it? Always five kilometers and the same pace.

---

![1000664788.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23tRximUwtaQiYjyLHqbdr6XZjqFysA2vXbZcqeUXFZyTNeGn91JbeDRL1dZu8QqM1LYr.jpg)



---

Sometimes, I even rethink my desire to run a Half Marathon, for example. But somehow, there seem to be so many excuses that allow me to be lazy about upgrading my running. I should be planning on going back, right?

Besides running, of course I brought my own running gear. A black hoodie, a brightly colored dry-fit jersey with HIVE RUN written on it, boosting my enthusiasm. It was as if I wanted to show off to everyone, \

LoL.

---

![1000664787.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/242DSygrfbwm1BCPPzu4fue6tqBZDzWRVPz7hNFwGnRWnagjukdi8TDtUqEKXhvbu7xSW.jpg)

![1000664792.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23wCBeDywNSNt1ejLAmTszrxVoNKWrsz4UMURx1SBx1mqGLM7kmh3KWcJAPujXQacvabA.jpg)

---

While walking home after cooling down, I took a photo of a large tree whose leaves had all but disappeared. I don't know why. We don't have autumn, though. Haha. Maybe it was the strong winds or the rainstorm. The winds can be really strong here.

---


![1000664791.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23x1BFBApPnJXFMhyVoPaz4qiTDGYCTFGDt2wKkCX27C81PvqFiUZPmbDGUjMKKh8JsHb.jpg)

![1000664794.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23sUGWHb2niYicGBnPxP7chDrXAffrFfLDk58ESDm9QjeTrHVgz5wJCSN83p3VJpfdhPj.jpg)

![1000664793.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23xVF4aPxgDwpNCaFXYcVoD3ihC1FUzfMgCABZioA4rXCvepJ7DUGzhbe1ijYbApsuJqD.jpg)


---

Okay, that's it for today. See you next time.

---

title.title: Nausea | Horror in the bus
title.body: _Until today, anytime I want to embark on a road trip using a bus, I get sick imagining what is waiting for me..._ * * * The leaders of each Local government were called for a compulsory meeting, where no invited members were allowed to miss, except for a genuine reason. An absence meant that the defaulter would pay a fine. The event was to start by 7pm and my town to the event city was just about two hours drive, so I decided to get on the journey by 4pm. The transport system was a drop-by-drop pattern. The first bus I entered became my trauma. I sat at the back, close to the window side and just 30 minutes into the journey, motion sickness held me so badly like a 6-month pregnant woman. It was so bad that I couldn't hold my system, and I puked while the bus was moving. Yeah, I puked through the window and the people who sat close to me saw everything and began to console me with all manner of stuff such as sprinkling water on my head and asking if I was sick before I entered the bus. Before I knew it, the bus which I considered to be long, had everyone concerned about my health status and I was treated like a sick person.

/>

Did the nausea stop?

Nope, the stomach rotation was still there and the urge to puke the second round was there but I summoned the courage to hold it back because I didn't want the driver to drive me to the hospital as all the passengers were suggesting. We got to the first junction, and I came out and quickly rushed to the nearest gutter to puke again. I couldn't continue the journey, I had to rest in that spot for about an hour before I boarded a motorcycle and returned home. Yeah, using a motorcycle to travel back was very expensive but that was the alternative for me because I couldn't dare to use a bus or any type of vehicle.

The post drama happened...

Since then, I found it very hard to travel knowing that motion sickness was after my life. But then, it was during the NYSC year and we had to travel a lot. I was dodging all of the journeys and the ones I couldn't dodge, I had to pay high cost to use motorcycles.  
Then, time got to where we had to travel to the state headquarters to rectify an issue in a particular bank that's not in my city. There was no way to use a motorcycle because it was very far.  
Two days before the fixed day, the fear of what I was going to experience came knocking very hard. I didn't know whether I was going to experience the same thing again or not, but I was just scared and the thought of the scene of me in the bus again got my stomach feeling the same way. I tried so hard to shun the thought but by then, my stomach had adopted the effect already and guess what, I puked that same day. Jeeeez! I hated myself, I hated my body system that day!  
Guess what? The day came, we boarded a bus, the effect came, very heavily but I was able to fight it and I didn't puke.

Image: Chatgpt

I'll agree and disagree.

First:  I love nature.  

There is something about being in nature and green areas that is beautiful.  Then again, right now I'm in Southern Spain and there is an awful lot of arid desert type climate which is also nice to walk through.

However, I own acreage that is untamed forest and it is absolutely not calming.  Walking through there I'm always looking out for bears, wolves, coyote, moose, cougars and of course the bugs like mosquito's, hornets and whatever else might be around.  Untamed nature always has the potential to harm and the possibility of getting lost plus even walking through it is a challenge.

In that way there is nature and there is ***nature***.  They aren't the same :)

The difference for me?  Quiet parklike settings or even tamed nature walks are beautiful.  They allow someone to get away from the stress of civilization and focus on themself and give a person time to quiet themselves.  So much of life is go go go go and there is always something that needs to be done, a distraction coming up, or an argument brewing.  In a quiet parklike setting with trees, birds, and quiet nature around you its much easier to be at peace.

In the true wild?  Not so much.  Just a different type of stress :)

Anyways, my quick thoughts for the day and I've called the helios.voter for this post.  Let's see how that goes :)  Have a great day.

title.title: Fun day out visiting a beautiful garden (Eng - Esp)
title.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** A simple picnic or a casual outing can become an excellent opportunity and a wonderful experience to enjoy and discover the wonders of nature. I've mentioned before that I love visiting the countryside to breathe fresh air, enjoy being in contact with nature, and most importantly, escape the hectic pace of city life. Personally, visiting the countryside is a kind of therapy for me, as it allows me to relax, walk in natural surroundings, and observe the wonders they offer. Last week, I had the opportunity, without any prior planning, to visit the countryside. It's located just a few minutes from the city, and while driving along the road, I took the opportunity to snap several photographs. This area is characterized by its numerous streams and a beautiful mountain in the background. The houses are situated very close to the mountain, and most of them boast beautiful and colorful gardens. Our visit was to the home of a friend's mother, whose garden is one of the largest and most beautiful due to its variety of plants and their striking colors. Since it's the dry season, the rivers have very little water, and in some cases, the riverbeds are completely dry. However, the surrounding vegetation remains lush and green, adorned with flowers. According to this kind lady, the rains have been slow to arrive, and she has had to travel to higher elevations to find water and keep her plants safe and well-hydrated.

> **
ESPAÑOL
** Un sencillo día de campo o una salida ocasional, pueden convertirse en una excelente oportunidad y una gran experiencia para disfrutar y conocer las maravillas de la naturaleza, he comentado que me encanta visitar el campo para respirar aire, puro disfrutar el contacto con la naturaleza y lo más importante salir un poco de la vida agitada que implica la ciudad, en lo personal visitar el campo es una especie de terapia pues me permite relajarme, caminar en los entornos naturales y observar las maravillas que estos nos ofrecen. La semana pasada, tuve la oportunidad sin planificación alguna, de hacer una visita al campo, este se ubica a pocos minutos de la ciudad y mientras iba por la carretera aproveché para tomar varias fotografías, esta zona se caracteriza por poseer varios riachuelos y una hermosa montaña al fondo, las casas se ubican muy cerca de la montaña y la mayoría de ellas tienen hermosos y coloridos jardines, nuestra visita era a la casa de la mamá de una amiga cuyo jardin es uno de los más grandes y bonitos por la variedad de plantas y sus llamativos colores, como estamos en la estación de sequía los ríos tienen muy poca agua y en algunos casos los cauces están totalmente secos, sin embargo la vegetación alrededor se mantiene verde y con sus respectivas flores, según esta amable señora, las lluvias han demorado en llegar y ella se ha tenido que movilizar buscando agua en las zonas más altas para poder mantener sus plantas a salvo y bien hidratadas. ![campo 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/243M5AFXzbkmYYfsnVCcJtwfTeVivZsGCJ6T4Gk1QVAmv5RbzA4m6dFAAkesA4JtG9pJW.png) ![campo 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/242Nd2K6qpCegRvBLgN8Mi2CgP8Ua5YcmV1tHpvBJXsQGV15PhfqcXJJE6jCxXG8WkuAv.png) ![campo 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/243WHDTpSFZYfUuHyPgX5kZeXsVJ8HUd4ycmAEhW1Zdn1BvCBQq4XEZN88uPkCNwrtVgP.png) ![campo 3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23x12iXgeoBxqmyZbtRhbBFHR94brprPG21zZcWv7AWSDEA8xNxVgvNqHGknA3qxmdEkL.png)

> After greeting each other and a brief conversation, we headed to the garden, which boasts several ornamental and fruit-bearing plants. One that caught my eye is the one known as the Four O'Clock Flower (Mirabilis jalapa), because its flowers open at dusk, have a pleasant fragrance, and remain open throughout the night. The flowers can be various colors, including yellow, pink, and white, often with veins of other colors on the same flower or plant. It prefers full sun and well-drained soil. It is important to note that all parts of the plant are toxic if ingested, especially the seeds and roots.

> Luego de saludar y una pequeña conversación, nos dirigimos hasta el jardín, el cual tiene varias plantas ornamentales y frutales, una de las que llamó mi atención es la que le conoce como **Don Diego de noche**, [Mirabilis jalapa](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mirabilis_jalapa), porque sus flores se abren a la atardecer, además tienen un agradable aroma y permanecen abiertas durante la noche. Las flores pueden presentar diversos colores, incluyendo amarillo, rosado y blanco, a menudo con vetas de otros colores en una misma flor o planta. Prefiere pleno sol y suelos bien drenados. Es importante resaltar que todas las partes de la planta son tóxicas si se ingieren, especialmente las semillas y raíces. ![flores amarillas con rojo (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoGvvspTqNhTWPxVmeVum1uFy1nY1wYvnArvkyTpCLPHAj1YRcJj2o3z3vCD4dTGAyw.jpeg) ![flores amarillas con rojo (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23tm96eLnQaXq94AiZmMGjNceNMZBtEn6wDWeuiUDfpt8pUJiZsge81T8AeysthfYE4tt.jpeg) ![flores amarillas con rojo (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoEobXPgDAHwka2mJgJprZSwZJ6mB1qVDRYQpxrZA8Rjn7XkjbCWti8cfPKMAeKpbk8.jpeg) ![flor 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23tSMrdenBg9mDkt4CZubhvyLux9WtgaSyNFEbWixMLMZrKtKrUBDPXgo7nECqD94ad9n.png)

> Another plant I liked is the one known as the **May Flower** [Plumeria rubra](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plumeria_rubra). I love its beautiful pink color, with a white spot on the petals and a yellow or white circle in the center of the flower. It's an ideal shrub for decorating gardens. Its most remarkable characteristic is its ability to withstand periods of drought once it has established deep roots and some branches. The ideal places for growing it are sunny spots with well-drained soil. The flowers are fragrant, and in addition to pink, there's also a white variety with a yellow center. I've seen this flower several times; Mrs. Lucy's plants are large and have many flowers. Some branches were even leafless, but the lovely, fragrant flowers were found at the top.

> Otra de las plantas que me gustó es la conocida como **Flor de mayo** [Plumeria rubra ](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plumeria_rubra), me encanta su hermoso color rosado, con una mancha blanca en los pétalos y un círculo en el centro de la flor de color amarillo o blanco, es un arbusto ideal para decorar los jardines, además su característica resaltante es que resiste los períodos de sequía una vez que ha echado raíces profundas y algunas ramas, los espacios ideales para su cultivo son zonas donde reciba el sol, pero con un suelo bien drenado, son fragantes y además del color rosa hay de color blanco con el centro amarillo, he visto esta flor varias veces, las plantas de la señora Lucy, son grandes y con muchas flores, incluso algunas ramas est+abn sin hojas pero en la parte superior se encuentra las lindas y aromáticas flores. ![flor de mayo (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23u695QsoST22stbxy27BqwjAUbXEMty7R4scHo6a6ksyz8CgotkdQBQYNE7pr5hwkeME.jpeg) ![flor de mayo (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23tm9dV7axExZNdnwceLsrCKZAa8u2W7EcvWTKcCuY7bE5Q2pgSp9bPYzqssLeGcjHkTw.jpeg) ![flor de mayo (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/EoeGqXtWnYp3pnF1Hp8dDoKQyjGVFYor5FdcgcRpqY72wLediHfaFxCM7RNHfuEZkdo.jpeg) ![flor de mayo (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23y8jVCur3qAdcjxrdLmawSxbAaqoWTRkRnwVjTwSi5638UVDATwzPyxwk8GtKF7U9sm8.jpeg) ![flor de mayo (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xKsysHGXCVy9DkcexUgwPc8XvMZWG25xb6t8Q4NoAnS8WH2VjYMt3bxoLXYyL7dY7c8.jpeg)

> ![dese.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/23xpa97s1nEmxvZDqAMx4ZzmjvkUmxhHxiCA1BRqEKxTZWwMi7qP93b8ZBqN27bMBVLD2.png) ¡Bendiciones! ![298840ed-dc99-44dd-88ae-e5dd98c6a2fd-e077c470-b3b4-41b7-8298-8b73f49e1a25-v1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/belkyscabrera/AKCBArsVymhAtxSEXuQEXVtGFqs179BAJqxscwbiHjeUjfHW4BXK94BrzTQoN88.png)

title.title: Voices, Mainly Within...                 ...Finale
title.body:
*Tell your heart that the fear of suffering is worse than the suffering itself. — Paulo Coelho*


![Confession.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRJrEpkHzF3iE2GLLkuLDcDX56sQbbQFZ8YEDttJB9CW6/Confession.png)
*Baring My Heart*


I took a walk in the rain and am now soaked to the skin and shivering on the verandah of a Victorian house. I could have taken an Uber but I needed to clear my head and sort my feelings—yeah, Evelyn does that to me whenever I see her. I love the girl but she turned down my marriage proposal once and although I often end up nursing hurt feelings, once in a lifetime is bad enough and to ask her again would just be pitiful.

But the whole situation is playing with my mind. I mean, here I am, wet and chilled, sheltering from the rain when I could be getting on with my life. Instead, I’m sheltering on a verandah in the night listening to voices and I’m not sure if they’re from within my head or this old house is haunted. One thing I do know is that I seem to be overhearing an intimate conversation between parents who have lost a son in the second world war. Yeah, sounds insane…and maybe I am, but I hear the voices start up again.

“He’s not coming back, Walt.” “We’ll make it through, Bess—somehow we’ll make it through” I scarcely breathe. The voices are faint, indistinct, like the dry rustle of leaves. I should be terrified, but I’m not. My ears strain to hear more. “The house too, Walter—what are we going to do?” “What we have to do, Love. What we always do.” I listen, transfixed, holding my breath, but the voices are gone. I’m alone in a vast forest of sounds.

Later that night, I’m back in my apartment and out of my wet clothes. I boil the kettle for instant coffee and open my laptop. I Google the house. There’s a *Globe and Mail* newspaper article written by Evelyn. She compares the Dooley Estate to the abandoned farmhouse in Joyce Kilmer’s poem, *The House With Nobody in it.* I feel a chill run up my spine. *What the hell is going on here?* She writes about her fondness for the house—how she always wanted to live in it. Then she says, a part of her is stuck there: *It hurts me to look at the crumbling roof and the shutters fallen apart, For I can't help thinking the poor old house is a house with a broken heart.*

Now, this is more than a coincidence—it feels like Fate is calling out to me. I look at the clock—past eleven—too late to phone. I pick up anyway and punch in Ev’s number. She answers right away. “Hey Ev, it’s Richard—hope I didn’t wake you.” “Richard—what a coincidence! I was watching the rain and wondering if you made it home without getting too wet.” “Yeah, I’m fine Ev. You know that article you wrote about the Dooley house—what’s the back story on the people?”

“It’s a tragic tale. Walter and Elizabeth Dooley lost the house during the Depression. Then, they were just getting back on their feet when their only son, Peter, was killed in the War. He piloted a Lancaster bomber over Germany.” “That’s brutal,” I say huskily, trying to hide my sadness thinking of these poor parents. “Well, some good came out of it, I suppose. The couple stayed together and used their money to buy back the Rosedale mansion and used it as a center for rehabilitating returning soldiers.”

“So, why is it vacant?” I ask. “After their deaths, the property reverted to the city. It was going to be used as a center for the handicapped, but those plans fell through. Last I heard, it was going to be put up for sale.” “That’s good—isn’t it?” “Not really—the Dooleys specified the property be maintained for charitable or residential use only, unless a buyer for it couldn’t be found. The city wants to sell it to a developer. I’d buy it myself if I could afford it.” “Look Ev—it’s late, but can we meet tomorrow and talk? I’ve got something to share with you.” “Sure. We’ll meet at the bar.”

I told Ev about the voices—strangely, she wasn’t surprised. “Something happened out there on the porch, Ev—feelings awakened in me I never knew I had.” “What kind of feelings?” I sigh deeply, but have to tell her. “Hearing Bess and Walter talk about their dreams for the future—the house they built—It did something to me. And then, hearing those dreams come crashing down, and still they carried on—I don’t know—it was life-changing.” “I didn’t think you cared much about feelings, Richard.” “I don’t—I didn’t… until that moment.Something broke inside me.”

I tried to refocus—to gather my thoughts. “It was as if someone pushed a pause button, Ev, and my life stopped. I listened to Walter and Bess—their struggles and pain—and suddenly, wasn’t afraid any more. I wanted to feel like they felt—to live fully through joy and through pain.” She stared at me, saying nothing. “I know it sounds stupid—but I figured if I didn’t feel too much, I wouldn’t get hurt too much. The trouble was, I wasn’t living life at all—just watching emotions pass by and not getting involved.” “Was that what happened to us?” “I think so.” She nodded, as if what I said tallied with her thoughts. “I don’t want to be that way anymore,” I said. “I’m glad, Richard.” Her eyes were shining.

One conversation rarely changes a life—although, in my case, what I overheard was the catalyst for a series of thought adjustments that eventually changed mine. Ev and I finally clicked—and this time, she didn’t refuse. We bought the Dooley Estate. It seemed appropriate—Walter and Bess, and me and EV—we’re joined somehow. Now the rainstorms we watch are from our front porch, with the city lights milky and blurred by rain, and the sounds of rustling leaves, faint and indistinct. We’re sentimental people, Ev and I. We’ve grown attached to the place

title.title: Hermosas princesas tejidas.//Beautiful knitted princesses.
title.body:
![Polish_20260521_143354283.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/48QucmsYgzPgakB9qbwzZ76exYAjvdSX9UZkytLhrRZtzKYJt8ogdrfVT86tEHaVkn.jpg)

Hola amigos, feliz día para todos. Por aquí bien dentro de lo que cabe. Todos los días debo agradecer por las bendiciones que nos llegan al hogar y porque tenemos mucha esperanza de que pronto estaremos mejor. El día de hoy quiero mostrarles un proyecto hermoso que al fin pude terminar. No soy de las que deja trabajos a medias, sin embargo este es uno de los pocos que no he podido concretar a tiempo. 

>Hello, friends, and happy day to everyone. Things are going pretty well around here, all things considered. Every day, I feel grateful for the blessings that come into our home and because we have so much hope that things will soon get better. Today, I want to show you a beautiful project that I was finally able to finish. I’m not the type to leave things half-done, but this is one of the few projects I haven’t been able to complete on time.

![Polish_20260521_143212147.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/AK56stBBt4KEneoLmh6MqmfcNXeiczMF9rLkg17s1uuzyzHBQ7cyBcePXGWW4aS.jpg)

Hace como un año más o menos empecé a tejer cuerpos base de las princesas de Disney, unas muy bonitas y sencillas que encontré en internet. Tenía la ilusión de tejerlas todas, aunque luego por un motivo o por otro no pude continuar. Debo decir que estos patrones están disponibles de manera gratuita en la web y en canales de Youtube. Si te gustan solo coloca princesas de Disney a crochet y te aparecerán una cantidad de videos de los cuales puedes escoger. Me gustaron estos por el tamaño de las muñecas, 19 cm cada una aproximadamente. 

>About a year ago, I started crocheting basic bodies for Disney princesses—some really cute and simple ones I found online. I was excited to crochet them all, but for one reason or another, I wasn’t able to continue. I should mention that these patterns are available for free online and on YouTube channels. If you’re interested, just search for “Disney princesses crochet” and you’ll find a bunch of videos to choose from. I liked these because of the dolls’ size—about 19 cm each. 


![IMG_20260421_174902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/EoErU4jeSasyLPap465PnCZ9Rk2dhidFE4C4q83Nid9tAJCedXTZm4mc4cQttBmCdYc.jpg)

Empecé retomando los dos cuerpos base que ya había tejido, estos cuerpos viajaron conmigo a Argentina y conmigo se regresaron intactos. Fue ahora en 2026 cuando me dediqué con empeño a completar el trabajo. Así se ven de lindas estas dos princesas. Confieso que por la situación actual que estoy viviendo tardé en terminar cada muñeca como en una semana, tejiendo muy poco por día. Lo mejor es que él trabajo se logró y quedó precioso. 

>I started by picking up the two base bodies I had already knitted; these bodies traveled with me to Argentina and came back with me intact. It wasn’t until 2026 that I dedicated myself wholeheartedly to finishing the project. These two princesses look so cute. I have to admit that, given my current situation, it took me about a week to finish each doll, since I was only knitting a little bit each day. The best part is that the project was completed and turned out beautifully. 

![IMG_20260420_203430.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/EoeCyefLLW2psnviKTzBGWnLyYgJeBsjTK95GXT1D7mZr2jXQDDK72aRNetMS3T5Skq.jpg)

La Cenicienta y la Bella fueron las primeras que tejí. La Bella tenía muchos más detalles y tardé más tejiendo su cabello. Disfruto muchísimo tejiendo muñecas, si las vendiera estaría mucho más feliz 😀. Por aquí las ventas de estos productos son pesadas. Todos quieren, pero cuando digo el precio me dejan en visto ✅

>Cinderella and Belle were the first ones I crocheted. Belle had a lot more details, and it took me longer to crochet her hair. I really enjoy crocheting dolls; if I sold them, I’d be so much happier 😀. Sales of these products are slow around here. Everyone wants one, but when I tell them the price, they just ignore me ✅

![IMG_20260420_175455.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/23wC9nnoTWUrKNDnaf7q1FamuuGJaBTsxSL9JCeyFANayq6VrEskDus4wpaxD69cR6R69.jpg)

---------

![IMG_20260420_175434.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/23wMYHyEHynZDvLx5EQFuPPhFEJNwXK29X772hE1gsCX3mhVmbhbUnx4QLLewWTyJM3T9.jpg)

---------

![IMG_20260420_160700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/23xAaBtA9UYbiq6c4ypzS7eGVcDDG1FK8YwAaMkJegFPjhXHqxeD3Q9kkkCBCmNrDvmBB.jpg)

Estoy muy contenta con el resultado. Luego de ver cómo quedaron la Bella y Cenicienta me decidí por tejer a Blanca Nieves. Tejí el cuerpo base que como las demás ya viene con el color de la ropita y los zapatos. Luego se tejen por parte cada pieza del vestido y el cabello. 

>I'm really happy with how it turned out. After seeing how Belle and Cinderella turned out, I decided to crochet Snow White. I crocheted the base body, which, like the others, already comes in the color of the outfit and shoes. Then you crochet each part of the dress and the hair separately. 

![IMG_20260418_081001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/creacioneslelys/EoiWiKrXnF6vnCCrSG8FNBBBUYLtZ7S2ur56RdnXv97DwsQpQdkJneEiHxAgyscDznp.jpg)

Les he ido mostrando el proceso desde el acabado hasta como fue que las empecé. No he tomado muchas fotografías porque por muchas horas he tejido cuando no hay luz, aquí en Venezuela tenemos de nuevo un programa de racionamiento diario, estamos igualitos al 2018 cuando muchos venezolanos entramos a #hive buscando hacer algo desde casa y poder monetizar el tiempo y la dedicación. En aquel tiempo hubo un apagón nacional y después vino la época de la pandemia. Los venezolanos estamos pasando prueba tras prueba. No nos han dado tregua.

>I’ve been showing you the process, from the finished product all the way back to how I started them. I haven’t taken many photos because I’ve spent many hours knitting in the dark; here in Venezuela, we’re back to daily power rationing. It’s just like 2018, when many of us Venezuelans joined #hive looking for a way to work from home and monetize our time and effort. Back then, there was a nationwide blackout, and then the pandemic hit. We Venezuelans are facing one trial after another. They haven’t given us a break.

title.title: La indústria de la fusta guanya competitivitat davant l'encariment de l'energia
title.body:
En un escenari marcat per la volatilitat i l'augment sostingut dels preus de l'energia, moltes indústries manufactureres tradicionals es veuen pressionades per un increment dels costos de producció. Tanmateix, la indústria de la fusta emergeix com una de les grans beneficiades d'aquesta situació, guanyant terreny competitiu respecte a materials alternatius més dependents de l'energia.

### Un avantatge estructural en costos energètics

La transformació de la fusta és, per naturalesa, un procés relativament poc intensiu en energia comparat amb la producció d'acer, alumini, ciment o plàstics derivats del petroli. Mentre que fabricar una tona d'acer pot requerir centenars de quilowatts per hora, la serrada, assecat i processament de fusta demanen quantitats molt més modestes. Amb l'encariment de l'electricitat i dels combustibles fòssils, aquesta diferència es tradueix directament en un avantatge de cost.

Aquest efecte és especialment visible en el sector de la construcció. L'ús de fusta laminada encreuada (CLT) o bigues de fusta massissa està guanyant quota de mercat davant del formigó i l'acer, ja que redueix significativament la petjada energètica de l'edifici tant en fase de fabricació com en el transport (la fusta és molt més lleugera).

### Biomassa i economia circular: un cercle virtuós

Un altre factor clau és la capacitat de la indústria de la fusta de generar la seva pròpia energia. Els residus de serrada, encenalls, escorça i serradures es poden valoritzar com a biomassa per produir calor, electricitat o biogàs. En moltes serradores i fàbriques europees, especialment a països amb forta tradició forestal com Suècia, Finlàndia, Àustria o Catalunya, una part important del consum energètic es cobreix amb aquests subproductes.

Així, quan pugen els preus del gas natural o de l'electricitat del mercat, les empreses que utilitzen biomassa forestal veuen com els seus costos energètics es mantenen més estables o fins i tot baixen relativament, millorant la seva posició competitiva.

### Sostenibilitat i demanda de mercats verds

L'augment dels preus de l'energia ha accelerat també la transició ecològica de les economies. La fusta, com a material renovable i amb capacitat d'emmagatzemar carboni durant dècades (en construccions, mobles o envasos), es beneficia d'aquesta tendència. 

Normatives europees com el Green Deal i els objectius de reducció d'emissions fan que promotors immobiliaris i arquitectes busquin alternatives amb baixa empremta de carboni. La fusta respon perfectament a aquesta demanda, cosa que es tradueix en nous contractes i projectes que abans haurien optat per materials convencionals.

### Reptes i oportunitats per al sector català

A Catalunya, on el sector forestal i de la fusta té una llarga tradició però ha patit anys de dificultats, l'encariment energètic pot representar una oportunitat de renaixement. Les empreses que inverteixin en modernització, eficiència energètica i valorització de residus poden guanyar posicions davant de competidors internacionals més dependents de l'energia importada.

Tanmateix, per aprofitar plenament aquest avantatge caldrà:

- Millorar la gestió forestal per garantir un subministrament sostenible.
- Invertir en tecnologia per augmentar el rendiment i reduir encara més el consum energètic.
- Desenvolupar productes d'alt valor afegit (fusta tècnica, construcció modular, biocomposites).

### Conclusió

L'augment dels preus de l'energia no és només una amenaça per a l'economia; també actua com a filtre que premia els sectors més eficients i menys dependents dels combustibles fòssils. La indústria de la fusta, per la seva naturalesa renovable, el seu baix consum energètic i la seva capacitat d'autogeneració, es troba en una posició privilegiada per sortir reforçada d'aquesta crisi energètica.

Aquelles regions i empreses que sàpiguen aprofitar aquest moment tindran l'oportunitat de consolidar un model més sostenible i competitiu a llarg termini. La fusta no només és el material del passat, sinó també, cada cop més, el del futur.

\n\n

>Jajaja fuera e beta realmente ando cansado de esta mmgvda en hive, una miseria de curación como siempre, sigo desempleado y ahora ando con un dedo malo, es una forma poco peculiar de iniciar un post pero hoy, será así.

>Ni se de que ponerme a hablar, hay muchos nichos pa niches y pa tu kitchen el pinche chicken, un poco de rimas feas pa q el ego se espiche. No en serio, rimas feas palabras cortantes y entre otras cosas han pasado por mente el dia de hoy, amaneció lloviendo de forma leve sin embargo mi dificultad para caminar no me permite salir de forma cómoda y hoy debo caminar demasiado desde mi casa hasta el centro,. estoy realizando esta publicación antes de salir.

\n\n

>Quisiera tener algún tipo de información mas relevante, algo interesante, pero en este momento me encuentro en un gran dilema personal entre ocupaciones obligaciones y necesidades.

* * *

>Me quiero lanzar del tanque, son como 200 metros de caída. Pero cada dia lo intento de nuevo, intento seguir adelante.

\n\n

>Si algun día no regreso no crean que fué un accidente o una caida tonta, simplemente me cansé.

* * *

>Si alguien está leyendo ésto le agradezco por tomarse el tiempo y pido disculpas por ño que está leyendo, ain embargo aon solamente estados mentales que en ocasiones duran a penas unos minutos o unas horas, en otros casos dias y semanas, en mi caso meses y años lo que es bastante agotador.

\n\n>
>Saludos a todos, tengan un feliz fin de semana.
