title.title: HOW ONE SMALL ACT OF KINDNESS ON SOCIAL MEDIA CHANGED MY VIEW ON CHARITY FOREVER
title.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX6DUvk35G1XDbUcpySgfdhUKeZBirQ2hHWHB8Jf9VPAG/1779538587082.jpg)


Greetings Hive Reachout family,👋🤗

When I joined Hive, I thought charity was only about money. Big donations, big projects, big names. I scrolled past posts about small acts of kindness because I assumed they didn’t count. I was wrong, and one moment on social media changed that for me.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYHuZwufHXYNHGCasTcsp4EivkwmZN9RhAb1GsakpmE8n/1779538616145.jpg)



Three months ago, I saw a post from a Hive user sharing how they used 2 HIVE to buy food for a neighbor who had been sick for weeks. No camera crew, no long speech. Just a photo of the food and a short note: “I couldn’t give much, but I gave what I had.” That post got 15 comments and 8 people said they would do the same in their own community.

That was the first time I realized charity doesn’t need to be loud to be real. Social media made that small act visible, and visibility inspired action. In the past, that neighbor might have suffered in silence. But because of one post, others stepped up.



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbHvURKuW13wKKcSGJsW13uYmkxBNaLJGaWaiutrV6wfZ/1779538674737.jpg)


Since then, I’ve started looking for ways to use my own small platform for good. Last week, I used part of my Hive rewards to buy notebooks for 3 kids in my street who couldn’t afford school supplies. I didn’t post it for clout. I posted it because Hive Reachout taught me that sharing our actions can encourage others to act too.

Here’s what I’ve learned about charity in the social media age:

1. Small acts matter more than perfect acts. You don’t need $100 to make a difference. $2, a phone call, or sharing someone’s fundraiser can change a life.
2. Visibility creates momentum. When people see real examples, they stop thinking “someone else will do it” and start asking “what can I do?”
3. Authenticity beats performance. People can tell when you’re posting to help vs posting to impress. Share the story, not just the result.

Hive Reachout is special because it reminds us that compassion isn’t a competition. It’s a chain reaction. My $2 act was inspired by someone else’s $2 act. Maybe your post will inspire someone reading this right now.

I know some people worry that posting about charity looks like showing off. I felt that too. But silence helps no one. If your intention is pure, your story can be the reason someone else decides to help today.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbvpyYK5s4eUuMcqZbYZD99WLjyART9jo5nWU6uHgpbu2/1779538870821.jpg)



So I want to ask you, Hive Reachout family: What’s one small act of kindness you’ve seen or done recently, even if it felt too small to mention? Share it in the comments. Let’s fill this post with real examples and remind each other that we don’t need to wait for big moments to be kind.

Let’s keep building a community where love and compassion are not just words, but actions we can see and repeat.
❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹❤️‍🩹

Images are AI generated.

title.title: Una segunda batalla en el estudio | Historia [ESP-ENG]
title.body:
> ![llll.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeBDGQ2WRAqxdupRPMDZVGguq3MrmLUrpVUYPuAfD6eQe/llll.jpg) [Source](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/hombre-de-camisa-blanca-tocando-la-guitarra-acustica-3789030/) La primera batalla entre NOXIC y WUZING quedó incompleta, las pantallas se detuvieron y aquella tercera sombra apareciendo entre la tormenta dejando un misterio, donde nadie sabía qué había entrado al escenario y nadie decía nada sobre lo que ocurrió. El empresario golpeó la mesa principal y comentó —No fue suficiente, necesitamos algo más grande y más real— Los músicos aún tenían sus guitarras en sus manos, pero seguían temblando. Sin embargo, tenían que continuar, por eso comenzaron creando un escenario nuevo y desconocido. Minutos después ya estaba listo y el nuevo campo de batalla era una ciudad suspendida sobre el vacío, con estructuras metálicas que flotaban, además edificios inclinados, puentes rotos, cadenas y un río que atravesaba toda la ciudad. Lo que daba miedo es que no tenía suelo, solo oscuridad infinita y no podía faltar la música que combinaba guitarra, violines y tambores. NOXIC fue liberada primero donde la criatura apareció sobre una plataforma flotante mientras que las marcas venenosas de su cuerpo ahora brillaban más fuerte. Después apareció WUZING, pero su entrada fue de gran impacto, ya que cayó desde lo alto destruyendo parte de la estructura metálica, además sus marcas rojas parecían lava viva y cada respiración expulsaba vapor caliente. >The first battle between NOXIC and WUZING remained unfinished; the screens went dark, and that third shadow appeared amid the storm, leaving a mystery in its wake—no one knew what had entered the stage, and no one said a word about what had happened. The promoter slammed his fist on the main table and said, “That wasn’t enough; we need something bigger and more real.” # >The musicians still held their guitars in their hands, but they were still trembling. However, they had to continue, so they began creating a new and unknown stage. Minutes later, it was ready, and the new battlefield was a city suspended over the void, with floating metal structures, tilted buildings, broken bridges, chains, and a river running through the entire city. What was scary was that there was no ground—only infinite darkness—and the music, combining guitars, violins, and drums, was a must. # >NOXIC was released first, where the creature appeared on a floating platform while the poisonous markings on its body now glowed brighter. Then WUZING appeared, but his entrance made a huge impact, as he fell from above, destroying part of the metal structure; moreover, his red markings looked like living lava, and every breath expelled hot steam. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNg51KVQrFMfrJXYbaKxBV7uJ2bviAUPUYBsEjVYMpJ6K/image.png) [Source](https://peakd.com/hive-131131/@holozing/december-2025-advent-calender-and-new-beta-starter-creature-reveal) WUZING siguió y rugió muy fuerte, pero NOXIC no se asustó, simplemente desapareció y solo quedó un polvo verde venenoso en el aire. Pero WUZING se volteó y golpeó todo a su alrededor, lanzando una gran cantidad de ondas de impacto. Con esos dos movimientos de ambas criaturas la batalla comenzó mucho más agresiva. NOXIC seguía atacan desde todos los ángulos y WUZING destruía todo intentando alcanzarla. Claudio seguía tocando la guitarra con mucha más rapidez y entonces los movimientos de NOXIC ahora se movían como una sombra imposible de seguir y soltaba más veneno alrededor de WUZING. Sin embargo, ocurrió algo que todos quedaron sorprendidos y NOXIC y WUZING también lo notaron, como si algo los observara. De repente en el cielo apareció una figura gigantesca descendiendo lentamente entre las estructuras, donde no caminaba, no volaba simplemente flotaba. Además, era una criatura enorme cubierta por fragmentos metálicos y su cuerpo cambiaba de forma, como si estuviera incompleto. En el estudio, simplemente estaban viendo y uno de los diseñadores comentó — ese es el monstruo más peligroso que existe en este juego— >WUZING followed and roared loudly, but NOXIC wasn't fazed; she simply vanished, leaving only a cloud of poisonous green dust in the air. But WUZING turned and struck everything around him, sending out a barrage of shockwaves. With those two moves from both creatures, the battle became much more aggressive. NOXIC kept attacking from every angle, and WUZING destroyed everything in an attempt to reach her. # >Claudio kept playing the guitar much faster, and now NOXIC moved like a shadow impossible to follow, releasing more poison around WUZING. However, something happened that surprised everyone, and NOXIC and WUZING noticed it too—as if something were watching them. # >Suddenly, a gigantic figure appeared in the sky, slowly descending between the structures; it wasn’t walking, it wasn’t flying—it was simply floating. Moreover, it was a massive creature covered in metal fragments, and its body was shifting shape, as if it were incomplete. In the studio, they were just watching, and one of the designers remarked, “That’s the most dangerous monster in this game.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZnjJ4y1c8GT8yVXrPrqt4dywyHjKtPhkCjqrGALX4w9C/image.png) [Source](https://peakd.com/hive-131131/@holozing/first-bug-and-poison-type-creature-reveal-and-some-updates) Ambas criaturas dejaron de pelear, ya que tenían miedo y allí la figura comenzó a moverse rápido. Donde el empresario comentó —Ahora si la batalla se pondrá buena— NOXIC y WUZING rugían juntos por primera vez, ya que uno mano gigantesca los perseguía. >Both creatures stopped fighting, overcome by fear, and then the figure began to move quickly. The businessman remarked, “Now the battle is really going to heat up.” NOXIC and WUZING roared together for the first time, as a gigantic hand chased after them.

title.title: Beyond Five Stars: The New Era of Luxury Travel
title.body:
Luxury travel has evolved far beyond private suites and first-class flights. Today, it is defined by exclusivity, personalization, meaningful experiences, and the ability to disconnect from routine while embracing comfort at the highest level. Modern travelers are no longer satisfied with simply visiting famous destinations; they want immersive journeys that combine elegance, authenticity, and unforgettable memories.

From secluded island retreats to tailor-made cultural experiences, luxury travel is reshaping the way people explore the world.



![pexels-anastasia-shuraeva-4210037.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/70b7f73370bf1c53191daef9930c560dcd6b2b5c4d5bd5c38817baf0c5868f83)



## The Shift from Traditional Luxury to Experiential Travel

In the past, luxury travel was often associated with lavish hotels, expensive shopping districts, and premium transportation. While those elements still matter, today’s high-end travelers increasingly value experiences over possessions.

Private culinary tours in Tuscany, yacht expeditions through the Greek Islands, wellness retreats in Bali, and Arctic adventures under the Northern Lights are examples of how luxury now centers on exclusivity and emotional connection.

Travelers are seeking moments that feel rare and deeply personal. A private dinner prepared by a Michelin-starred chef, a guided safari with conservation experts, or a custom itinerary designed around personal interests can transform a trip into something unforgettable.

## Personalized Travel Experiences

One of the defining features of[ luxury travel](https://davidsguide.com/) is personalization. Travelers expect services tailored specifically to their preferences, lifestyles, and schedules.

Luxury hotels and travel planners now use advanced technology and detailed guest profiles to create customized experiences. Some guests may prioritize wellness and relaxation, while others seek adventure, fine dining, or cultural exploration.

Personalized luxury may include:

*   Private airport transfers and VIP check-ins

*   Curated city tours with local experts

*   Custom spa and wellness programs

*   Exclusive access to events and attractions

*   Personalized dining experiences

*   Private villas, yachts, or island stays

This level of customization creates a seamless journey where every detail feels intentional.

## Luxury Travel and Wellness

Wellness tourism has become one of the fastest-growing segments within luxury travel. Many travelers are now prioritizing mental well-being, mindfulness, and physical health during their vacations.

Luxury wellness retreats often combine stunning natural surroundings with premium health-focused experiences such as:

*   Yoga and meditation programs

*   Holistic spa treatments

*   Detox and nutrition plans

*   Digital detox experiences

*   Fitness and recovery programs

*   Nature-based therapies

Destinations like the Maldives, Switzerland, Thailand, and Costa Rica have become global hubs for luxury wellness travel. These experiences allow travelers to recharge both physically and emotionally while enjoying world-class hospitality.

## Sustainable Luxury Tourism

Modern luxury travelers are also becoming more conscious of sustainability and environmental impact. Eco-friendly resorts, conservation-driven tourism, and responsible travel practices are now highly valued.

Luxury no longer means excess without responsibility. Many high-end travel brands are investing in:

*   Sustainable architecture and eco-resorts

*   Renewable energy initiatives

*   Plastic-free operations

*   Local community support programs

*   Wildlife conservation projects

*   Farm-to-table dining concepts

Travelers increasingly prefer brands that combine comfort with ethical responsibility. Sustainable luxury creates a balance between indulgence and environmental awareness.

## The Rise of Private and Remote Destinations

Privacy has become one of the most valuable aspects of luxury travel. Remote destinations and private accommodations are now in greater demand than crowded tourist hotspots.

Exclusive island resorts, private mountain lodges, desert retreats, and luxury safari camps offer travelers peace, security, and personalized service away from busy urban environments.

Remote luxury destinations often provide:

*   Uninterrupted natural beauty

*   Highly personalized hospitality

*   Enhanced privacy and security

*   Authentic cultural immersion

*   Unique outdoor experiences

For many travelers, true luxury is now defined by space, tranquility, and freedom from constant digital distractions.

## Culinary Excellence as a Travel Experience

Food has become a central part of luxury travel. High-end travelers increasingly explore destinations through local cuisine, fine dining, and immersive culinary experiences.

Luxury culinary tourism may include:

*   Private wine tastings in vineyards

*   Chef-led cooking classes

*   Gourmet food tours

*   Michelin-starred restaurant experiences

*   Farm-to-table dining experiences

*   Exclusive regional tasting menus

Culinary experiences help travelers connect more deeply with local culture while enjoying exceptional quality and creativity.

## Technology Enhancing Luxury Travel

Technology continues to redefine the luxury travel industry. Artificial intelligence, smart hotel systems, and digital concierge services are improving convenience and personalization.

Travelers can now enjoy:

*   AI-powered travel recommendations

*   Smart hotel rooms with automated controls

*   Digital concierge assistance

*   Contactless luxury services

*   Virtual itinerary management

*   Personalized travel apps

Despite the increased role of technology, the human touch remains essential. The best luxury experiences combine innovation with genuine hospitality.

## The Future of Luxury Travel

The future of luxury travel will likely focus even more on exclusivity, sustainability, wellness, and personalization. Travelers are looking for meaningful experiences that enrich their lives rather than simply offering visual luxury.

Space tourism, ultra-personalized itineraries powered by AI, immersive cultural journeys, and eco-conscious luxury accommodations may shape the next generation of travel.

As the industry evolves, one thing remains constant: luxury travel is ultimately about creating unforgettable experiences that combine comfort, discovery, and emotional connection.

## Conclusion

Luxury travel is no longer limited to expensive accommodations or premium transportation. It has become a highly personalized form of exploration centered around comfort, authenticity, privacy, and meaningful experiences.

Whether it involves wellness retreats, private adventures, sustainable resorts, or world-class dining, modern luxury travel reflects a deeper desire for quality, connection, and unforgettable memories. In a fast-moving world, luxury travel offers something increasingly valuable — the opportunity to slow down, experience the extraordinary, and travel with intention.




---

title.title: Modelos Pequenos e Fine-Tuning em 2026: A Vantagem Dos Especializados
title.body:
Há uma narrativa dominante em LLMs: maior é melhor. Os headlines são sobre modelos de trilhões de parâmetros, janelas de contexto de 10 milhões de tokens, benchmarks de fronteira. Mas em 2026, uma mudança silenciosa está acontecendo em produção: as empresas que estão extraindo mais valor de IA não estão usando os modelos maiores. Estão usando modelos menores, treinados especificamente para o que precisam fazer.

A Inversão de 2026
------------------

A premissa parece contraintuitiva, mas os dados de deployment em produção são consistentes: um modelo de 7 bilhões de parâmetros, fine-tunado em dados do domínio específico de uma empresa, frequentemente supera um modelo de 70 bilhões de propósito geral na tarefa para a qual foi treinado — com custo de inferência 10 vezes menor e latência significativamente menor.

Um analista de mercado descreveu a dinâmica com precisão: \

Isso já está acontecendo. A previsão do setor é que até 2027, organizações vão usar modelos pequenos e especializados três vezes mais do que LLMs de propósito geral.

O Que É Fine-Tuning em 2026
---------------------------

O fine-tuning evoluiu além do ajuste de parâmetros em datasets específicos. As técnicas dominantes em 2026 são:

**LoRA e QLoRA** continuam sendo o padrão para a maioria dos casos empresariais. LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adiciona matrizes de baixo rank ao modelo base, permitindo adaptação a domínios específicos com uma fração do compute necessário para treinar do zero. O modelo original fica intacto; apenas os adaptadores são modificados. Isso significa que um mesmo modelo base pode ter múltiplos adaptadores LoRA para diferentes tarefas, trocados dinamicamente.

**GRPO e RULER** são a evolução mais recente. Diferente do fine-tuning supervisionado tradicional, essas técnicas permitem treinar modelos agênticos que melhoram através de experiência, sem escrever funções de recompensa explícitas ou coletar exemplos rotulados. É aprendizado por reforço aplicado a LLMs de forma prática.

**Destilação** é o processo de usar um modelo grande como \

para treinar um modelo menor mais eficiente. O Llama 4 Behemoth, ainda não público, já está sendo usado pela Meta como modelo professor para melhorar Scout e Maverick. O Google usa o Gemini 3.1 Pro como professor para os modelos Gemma 4.

Por Que Modelos Pequenos São Viáveis Agora
------------------------------------------

Dois fatores tornaram modelos pequenos genuinamente competitivos em 2026.

O primeiro é a qualidade dos dados sintéticos. Modelos de fronteira são usados para gerar datasets de treinamento de alta qualidade para tarefas específicas. Um modelo de 9B treinado em 100 mil exemplos gerados pelo GPT-5.5 sobre um domínio específico — análise jurídica, diagnóstico médico, engenharia de materiais — pode superar o próprio GPT-5.5 na tarefa específica porque aprendeu padrões de domínio que o modelo geral não tem incentivo de aprender em pré-treinamento.

O segundo é a otimização de inferência. Quantização para 4 bits (INT4) reduz não apenas o armazenamento, mas a largura de banda de memória em 4x — e em inferência de LLMs, a memória é o gargalo principal. Um modelo INT4 de 7B em uma única GPU moderna tem throughput de tokens similar a um modelo FP16 de 3B, mas com qualidade muito superior. A lacuna entre qualidade e custo de inferência está fechando rapidamente.

O Hardware de Edge Como Plataforma
----------------------------------

A convergência de modelos pequenos com hardware moderno de edge criou um novo segmento: LLMs rodando diretamente em dispositivos sem conectividade de rede.

Smartphones atuais (2025-2026) têm NPUs com 20-40 TOPS de capacidade, suficientes para modelos de 1-4B parâmetros em INT4. Onde 7B parâmetros pareciam o mínimo para geração coerente há dois anos, modelos sub-bilhão hoje lidam com muitas tarefas práticas.

As quatro razões para preferir on-device são: latência (sem round-trip de rede, resposta em milissegundos), privacidade (dados que nunca saem do dispositivo não podem ser interceptados), custo (inferência no hardware do usuário não tem custo de serving), e disponibilidade (modelos locais funcionam sem conexão).

Para aplicações industriais — análise de imagens em linha de produção, processamento de documentos em campo, assistência técnica offline — essa combinação resolve problemas que APIs de cloud não conseguem resolver.

Casos de Uso Que Não Cabem no General-Purpose
---------------------------------------------

A limitação fundamental dos modelos grandes de propósito geral é que eles precisam ser bons em tudo. Isso cria trade-offs: um modelo otimizado para raciocínio matemático usa capacidade que poderia estar otimizando extração de entidades médicas. Fine-tuning elimina esse trade-off para quem tem um caso de uso específico.

Exemplos reais de 2026 onde modelos especializados superam os gerais: extração de entidades em contratos jurídicos (modelos de 7-13B fine-tunados em corpora jurídicos superam GPT-5.5 em precisão e recall de cláusulas específicas), triagem de documentos financeiros (modelos de 3-7B treinados em relatórios contábeis identificam anomalias com menor taxa de falsos positivos), e code completion em linguagens de nicho (modelos de 1-3B treinados em código proprietário superam modelos gerais que nunca viram aquele estilo de código).

A Equação de Custo
------------------

O argumento final é econômico. Inferência com Claude Opus 4.7 via API custa US$ 25 por milhão de tokens de saída. Um modelo de 7B INT4 rodando em GPU própria tem custo de inferência de US$ 0,02 a 0,10 por milhão de tokens dependendo do hardware.

Para um pipeline que processa 10 milhões de tokens por dia — não uma escala incomum em automação empresarial — a diferença entre API de fronteira e modelo especializado próprio é de US$ 250 versus US$ 1 a 10 por dia. A diferença de custo financia o fine-tuning inteiro em semanas.

Em 2026, \
é cada vez mais uma questão de contexto — não de benchmark.

title.title: Why Discipline Beats Motivation Every Time
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmURW5VoVpqwU6yKFZPbdyFVg8d1weHfxYmqWx6qg2QgPv/1000699840.png

Motivation feels powerful.

But motivation is unreliable.

Some days you feel unstoppable.

Other days you feel tired, distracted, or completely unmotivated.

That is why people who rely only on motivation usually struggle with consistency.

Discipline is different.

Discipline keeps moving even when emotions change.

And in the long run, discipline almost always wins.

The market does not reward temporary excitement.

It rewards consistency.

The same applies to life.

People admire successful outcomes but rarely appreciate the routines behind them.

The early mornings.

The sacrifices.

The silent work.

The repeated effort nobody notices.

That hidden repetition is where transformation happens.

Most people want massive results without building stable systems.

But systems shape outcomes.

Your habits eventually become your future.

That’s why disciplined people often appear “lucky.”

From the outside, people only see results.

They do not see the years of consistency creating those opportunities.

Especially in crypto and investing, emotional discipline matters enormously.

Fear destroys portfolios.

Greed destroys portfolios.

Impatience destroys portfolios.

The strongest investors are usually not the smartest.

Often they are simply the most emotionally stable.

The people who stay rational while others panic.

And perhaps that is the biggest competitive advantage in modern life:

Remaining focused while the world becomes increasingly distracted.
  


#EYS | Turning Patience Into Power 🌱💎

title.title: Complete Guide to Reliable MD Auto Repair Services
title.body:
Keeping your vehicle in excellent condition is one of the most important responsibilities of every car owner. Whether you drive daily for work, travel frequently, or simply use your car for family needs, regular maintenance and timely repairs help ensure safety, performance, and long-term reliability. Finding dependable [MD auto repair services](http://mdautorepairny.com/) can save you from expensive breakdowns, unexpected repairs, and unnecessary stress.

This complete guide explains everything you need to know about reliable auto repair services in Maryland, including common repairs, maintenance tips, choosing the right repair shop, and why professional service matters for your vehicle.

Why Reliable Auto Repair Services Matter

Your vehicle is made up of hundreds of parts working together. Even a small issue can affect overall performance and safety if ignored. Reliable auto repair services help identify problems early and keep your car operating smoothly.

Professional repair shops use experienced technicians, modern diagnostic tools, and quality replacement parts to ensure accurate repairs. Regular servicing also improves fuel efficiency, increases vehicle lifespan, and helps maintain resale value.

Ignoring warning signs such as unusual noises, dashboard warning lights, vibrations, or fluid leaks can lead to more severe damage over time. A trusted repair service helps prevent these issues before they become costly problems.

Common MD Auto Repair Services

Reliable Maryland auto repair shops typically offer a wide range of services for different vehicle makes and models. Some of the most common services include:

Brake Repair Services

Your braking system is essential for safety. Worn brake pads, damaged rotors, or brake fluid leaks can reduce stopping power and increase accident risks. Professional technicians inspect and repair brake systems to ensure maximum performance.

Signs you may need brake repair include:

Squeaking or grinding noises

Vibrations while braking

Soft brake pedal

Increased stopping distance

Brake warning light

Engine Diagnostics and Repair

Modern vehicles use advanced computer systems to monitor engine performance. When the check engine light appears, diagnostic equipment helps identify the exact issue.

Common engine repairs may include:

Spark plug replacement

Fuel injector repair

Ignition system repairs

Sensor replacement

Timing belt replacement

Quick diagnostics prevent small engine issues from turning into major mechanical failures.

Oil Changes and Preventive Maintenance

Routine oil changes are among the most important maintenance services for any vehicle. Clean engine oil reduces friction, prevents overheating, and improves engine lifespan.

Preventive maintenance services often include:

Oil and filter changes

Fluid inspections

Tire rotation

Battery testing

Air filter replacement

Belt and hose inspections

Following the manufacturer’s maintenance schedule helps avoid unexpected breakdowns.

Transmission Repair

Transmission problems can severely affect your vehicle’s performance. Reliable repair shops diagnose automatic and manual transmission issues before they worsen.

Common signs of transmission problems include:

Delayed gear shifting

Slipping gears

Burning smell

Transmission fluid leaks

Strange noises while driving

Early transmission service can prevent expensive replacements.

Suspension and Steering Repairs

A properly functioning suspension system improves comfort, handling, and stability. Damaged shocks, struts, or steering components can make driving unsafe.

Technicians inspect:

Shock absorbers

Struts

Ball joints

Control arms

Power steering systems

If your vehicle pulls to one side or feels unstable, suspension service may be necessary.

Heating and AC Repair

Maryland experiences both hot summers and cold winters, making climate control systems extremely important. Auto repair shops provide heating and air conditioning services to maintain comfort year-round.

Common AC issues include:

Weak airflow

Warm air from vents

Refrigerant leaks

Compressor failure

Professional repairs help restore efficient heating and cooling performance.

How to Choose a Reliable MD Auto Repair Shop

Selecting the right repair shop is essential for quality service and peace of mind. Here are several important factors to consider:

Check Certifications and Experience

Look for certified technicians with experience working on your vehicle type. ASE-certified mechanics are trained to meet industry standards and handle various repair tasks professionally.

Read Customer Reviews

Online reviews and testimonials can provide insight into a shop’s reputation. Reliable repair centers often receive positive feedback for honesty, customer service, and quality workmanship.

Ask About Warranties

Trusted auto repair shops usually offer warranties on parts and labor. This shows confidence in their work and provides added protection for customers.

Compare Pricing Transparently

While low prices may seem attractive, extremely cheap repairs can indicate poor-quality parts or inexperienced technicians. Reliable shops provide clear estimates and explain repair costs before beginning work.

Evaluate Customer Service

Professional communication is important. A good repair shop answers questions clearly, explains issues honestly, and keeps customers informed throughout the repair process.

Benefits of Regular Vehicle Maintenance

Preventive maintenance offers many advantages beyond avoiding repairs. Consistent servicing helps:

Improve fuel efficiency

Extend engine life

Increase road safety

Reduce repair costs

Maintain resale value

Improve driving comfort

Routine inspections also allow mechanics to detect hidden problems before they become major expenses.

Signs Your Vehicle Needs Immediate Attention

Some vehicle problems should never be ignored. Seek professional auto repair services immediately if you notice:

Check engine light staying on

Smoke from the engine

Burning smells

Loud knocking noises

Fluid leaks under the vehicle

Sudden loss of power

Overheating engine

Delaying repairs may cause additional damage and increase repair costs significantly.

Importance of Using Quality Parts

Reliable MD auto repair services use high-quality OEM or premium aftermarket parts designed for durability and performance. Cheap replacement parts may fail quickly and create additional problems.

Quality components improve reliability, ensure compatibility, and often come with warranties for added protection.

Final Thoughts

Reliable MD auto repair services play a crucial role in keeping your vehicle safe, efficient, and dependable. From routine maintenance and brake repairs to engine diagnostics and transmission service, professional technicians help protect your investment and reduce long-term costs.

Choosing a trusted repair shop with experienced mechanics, transparent pricing, and strong customer reviews ensures you receive quality service every time. Regular maintenance, quick repairs, and attention to warning signs can help your vehicle perform at its best for years to come.

By staying proactive about vehicle care and working with dependable auto repair professionals, Maryland drivers can enjoy smoother rides, improved safety, and greater peace of mind on the road.

title.title: El poder de una decisión: Cómo cuatro semanas de amor propio me cambiaron la vida
title.body:
>Tengo aproximadamente tres semanas llevando a cabo todo lo que por meses, o quizás años, no había podido realizar. Y es que, si nos detenemos a pensarlo un segundo, la vida es una sola. Más allá de los objetivos profesionales, de las metas financieras o de los compromisos diarios, hay una realidad interna que no podemos evadir: yo no quiero que termine la semana, el mes o el año y sentirme la persona más inútil del condado. ¿Cuántas veces nos ponemos metas con toda la ilusión del mundo, pero qué difícil es cosecharlas, verdad? Es exactamente como querer que una planta crezca, florezca y adorne de forma espectacular algún espacio de nuestro hogar, pero nos olvidamos por completo de ponerle abono, de echarle agua o de sacarla al sol para que reciba la luz del día. El resultado de ese descuido es obvio. Bueno, les confieso que esa mata seca, marchita y achicharrada fui yo durante mucho tiempo. Hoy, afortunadamente, decido hablar en pasado. En pocos pero muy bien organizados días, he tratado de cambiar varias cosas en mí. Al escuchar esto, quizás te preguntarás: “¿Tan mal estabas?”. No, chico o chica, no estaba tan mal. No era el fin del mundo. Pero uno ve la vida correr a una velocidad increíble y, a estas edades, uno ya no quiere arrepentirse de nada. Y cuando digo de nada, es de nada, nada.
![H.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmagabriela/23wgQ8UZ9nmJrXZvgteNKYVRieeB7fqbQ79uuYbAULDyyECkGD5bvXiy8TYEQDnppHzi8.png)
***
> Para ponerlos en contexto: yo siempre fui una persona bastante delgada. Sin embargo, la combinación de la ansiedad, la maternidad y la acumulación de malos hábitos me han llevado, poco a poco, a habitar un cuerpo que hoy desconozco. Ojo, bendigo y agradezco cada parte de él por todo lo que me ha permitido vivir, pero no me siento cómoda en él y he estado tratando de mejorar. Cuando hablo de mejorar, no me refiero únicamente a un cambio físico o estético; hablo de mí como persona, de una transformación integral. Antes vivía en una ansiedad absurda. Y cuando digo ansiedad, no me refiero a una simple preocupación cotidiana por las deudas o el tiempo. Me refiero a ese sentimiento desbordante y asfixiante dentro del cuerpo, en el cual uno siente hasta un sofocón en el pecho, ganas de llorar de la nada y el cuerpo completamente paralizado, seguido inmediatamente por unas ganas inigualables de comerte el mundo entero. O bueno, al menos así es como me da a mí. Levo aproximadamente cuatro semanas haciendo una dieta. Y no, bebé, no es una dieta de esas locas, absurdas y súper restrictivas que te estás imaginando ahora mismo. Yo hablo de una dieta verdaderamente sana, que consiste en comer mejor, cocinar sin grasa y medir las porciones con todo pesadito, pero con la gran ventaja de no pasar hambre. No me crean si no quieren, pero sí, créanme: funciona. Cuando comencé con este régimen alimenticio, muchas cosas cambiaron radicalmente en mi rutina. La primera gran victoria fue que comencé a creer en mí misma. El simple hecho de poder controlar mi cerebro y dominar mis propias decisiones me da una alegría inmensa. Siento que todo lo bueno puede nacer de allí, de la necesidad de poder ver las cosas con absoluta claridad para tomar las mejores decisiones en el día a día. Pero seamos completamente honestos, mis santos: esto no fue nada fácil. La primera semana fue un reto titánico; sentía un desespero tal que me quería comer a mí misma o tomarme el agua de los floreros si era necesario.
![J.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmagabriela/23wX1RDkF4bGm8SPHcXmt3JDQ8wSyt7nFzHG65ec8VfSVDCyK8z5HthAPh5pB8a3yxbix.png)
***
>Sin embargo, para la segunda semana, mis hermanos, la historia fue otra: yo andaba volando. Me desperté con la creatividad a flor de piel, con unas ganas inmensas de trabajar y con una energía desbordante que ni yo misma reconocía. Y es que, pensándolo bien, ¿cómo puede el cerebro funcionar correctamente con un cuerpo que todo el tiempo está cansado y maltratado? No, simplemente no puede. Por eso, si estás allí sentado, tratando de tomar alguna decisión importante en tu vida pero te sientes completamente estancado, haz primero cosas que te ayuden a desbloquearte. Ojo, en mi caso particular la necesidad me llevó a iniciar una dieta, pero en tu caso la solución puede ser otra muy distinta: dejar el celular por algunas horas, leer un buen libro, sentarte a tomar un café con un amigo o hacer el delicioso... ¡Qué sé yo! Jaja. Cada quien encuentra su válvula de escape en lo que mejor le funcione.
***
>Hoy en día, esta claridad mental me ha llevado a ser mucho más feliz de lo que ya soy. Me ha permitido enfrentar situaciones difíciles y recientes con valentía y total tranquilidad. Me ha dado la vitalidad para estar más activa que nunca, pero, sobre todas las cosas, me ha hecho sentir muchísimo más segura de mí misma. Tener la casa en orden —es decir, mi propio cuerpo sano— me ha devuelto una felicidad incalculable. Evidentemente, no voy a negar el tema estético. Claro que me importa la apariencia y claro que he mejorado notablemente frente al espejo. Pero hoy por hoy, más que el cambio físico, lo que realmente admiro es la decisión que tomé, la fuerza que tuve para aguantar la primera semana y mi determinación actual por continuar en este camino. Solo así seguiré sintiéndome bien y productiva. Vamos a estar claros: como uno se siente en el interior, se termina exteriorizando tarde o temprano. >Hace poco tiempo vi un reel en las redes sociales que me dejó pensando profundamente. Decía algo como: “Si ocurriera una situación de emergencia extrema, ¿tendrías las cualidades y las capacidades físicas para poder salvar a tu hijo?”. Honestamente, esa pregunta me caló hondo y me dejó reflexionando por días. No se trata solo de lucir bien. Estar bien físicamente es también pensar en la vejez. Yo no quiero que mi hijo me vea en el futuro como una carga pesada; al contrario, yo quiero que él me vea como un apoyo sólido, como alguien fuerte que siempre estará para él cuando necesite ser auxiliado. Y a que no saben qué pasó. Justo a las pobres pero bendecidas cuatro semanas de haber iniciado este cambio, mi hijo tuvo que ser intervenido quirúrgicamente. Aunque se trató de una operación sencilla, requirió que yo estuviera al cien por ciento para cargarlo, apoyarlo físicamente y mantenerlo fuerte en su recuperación. Hoy doy infinitas gracias por estas nuevas decisiones basadas en el amor propio, porque al final del día, todo ese amor que me doy a mí misma se deriva también en bienestar y amor protector para mi pequeño.
![U.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmagabriela/23vsQDAmVAzxKvdYdy8jgKkDWiXjEKaQBiACv1h7eeMY86FHn61GQnSWJib9gyZ5SVb1j.png)

title.title: PLAYER OF THE SEASON,  NOT DECLAN?
title.body:
It is no longer news that Bruno Fernandes have been named this season's Player of the Season.


![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/703hZPkmXS4AAAAC/bruno-fernandes-why-always-me.gif)

Following this award has been a noteable uproar as to why Declan Rice wasn't the preferred candidate. 

For me,actually this award is for standout performers ALL THROUGH THE SEASON.

That is who Rice is! That is not who Saka is for example. That is not who Bruno is.
That is who Gibbs-White is– you can argue same for Doku and maybe Enzo Fernandez.

Bruno came alive only when Carrick came in. People like Mainoo also came alive too at same time(that's why he goes to the World Cup). But before Carrick, Rice has been exceptional for Arsenal and has continued, even improved till today.

And the winner **CLEARLY IS**?  DECLAN RICE.

Oh come on.
But let's not pretend that these awards are usually not perfect. Let's not pretend that goals, skills and goal's creation, are not a great temptation for award decisions.

These awards are often sentimental and emotional. Therefore if a team wins something or a team is a big club, it gives an advantage to their players for these kind of awards.

Rice won something, but you had another guy in an equally big club creating and scoring more goals.

You may be the midfield destroyer, the back bone of the team in a season where the two most important players in Saka and Odegaard were not consistent. You have covered more distance than Bruno.

But football emotions often goes with the guy very close to the shout of \

. They go with the player who has more flair, the guy with more dribbles. That guy is Bruno!

Even the MOTM awards reveal these sentiments. Rice plays the Mainoo role and even deeper than Mainoo bcos Zubi was a problem. 
Football emotions will usually consider the guy closer to goal like Bruno, that's also why Bruno has more MOTM awards.

If I pick a sprinkling here there of the past you would observe this same theme behind winners:

Virgil van Dijk (2018/19, Liverpool)
- Kevin De Bruyne (2019/20, Man City)
- Mohamed Salah (2017/18, Liverpool)
- Luis Suárez (2013/14, Liverpool)
- Gareth Bale (2012/13, Tottenham)
- Thierry Henry (2005/06, Arsenal)

My conclusion:

Going without sentiments, **THE WINNER IS DECLAN RICE.**

However, the reality of football is sentiments, so the winner becomes **BRUNO.**

![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/acQ8fk3Q_xcAAAAC/bruno-hat-tip-bruno-fernandes.gif)

title.title: No pain, no gain? [EN/PT]
title.body:
> No pain, no gain. When I hear that phrase, the first thing that comes to mind is... something related to bodybuilding—ah! Those bodybuilders love those catchphrases. But is pain really necessary to gain something in Splinterlands? Not physical pain, of course; this is something more symbolic, and even though I find this phrase so cliché, it makes a lot of sense. Of course, the title of this post relates to the battle rule—the battle I’m featuring today—something I’ll discuss in a moment. But the question here is whether pain is actually necessary to achieve goals, and yes, it is. Not specifically in this battle, but I’ve put in the effort—it’s been almost five years playing Splinterlands—and the pain here came from losing, learning, dedicating myself, and planning strategies, understanding the best defense and attack mechanisms, and so on. This commitment can be symbolically compared to pain: how far must one go to reach the final destination? But anyway, today’s battle reflects this pain very well—even better than any other amateur analogy I’ve tried so far. The rule is indeed “No Pain, No Gain,” and every time we inflict some kind of damage on our monsters (or indirect damage caused by the opponent), they become stronger. So, if pain is necessary to get stronger, I treated myself to this moment of masochism. I chose a monster with the Burn ability—it deals damage to all allied monsters. And why on earth would anyone create this kind of ability? To balance things out, perhaps, because this is a very strong monster with a low cost—there should be some negative trade-off... But then, to take advantage of this power outside of battles with the Back to Basics rule (where everyone loses their abilities), the No Pain No Gain rule is an interesting way to use this type of monster with this ability and further boost your own monsters offensively. But with this kamikaze strategy, there’s a catch: the sadomasochistic monster that inflicts pain on your little friends needs to be defeated somehow; if it stays on the field too long, well, it’ll be more pain than gain, if you know what I mean… but anyway, keep reading because below I’ll tell you more about this battle, and you’ll understand that, in fact, a little pain helps achieve your goals. https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1070730152037847110/111.gif ## [To watch this battle, click here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_a051103e58f02cce54d425d4673a032d)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeJtycjirK4YGVBwGupkhWfwtqH25e3z2WL2G9fWi3h6j/image.png)
### A few points about this battle: Well, we don’t even need to say anything about the battle rule, so let’s just mention that 51 mana is a very interesting amount for choosing slightly more expensive monsters, and we still have all 6 elements available to choose from.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaTxUAEaupJRnm9zcR3KUTJ1w4yvJfaTHWDPwYxw77pCH/image.png)
In the tank position, two sturdy monsters that I particularly like a lot. My opponent’s choice brings even more protection to the entire team with the addition of shields, a monster with high health and generous attack. My choice is a tank that is almost perfect: it has a good amount of health, great speed and shield, and also has abilities that can throw the opponent off balance.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUaSS5jxGKYt73UXhoTVFDPpJh4WdZfqYDWwMxAkaFUak/image.png)
For my backline, I choose monsters with strong attack power. My main focus was on offensive monsters that could really make my opponent bleed heavily with every attack, enhanced by a strategy to gain more power when they take damage from their own team. The goal here is to build a high-impact team capable of ending the match in just a few rounds.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRCKcjMrJmiGw7ALPugHMRXcVWeeCAJCeX9zVKfCbK8GG/image.png)
Well, it was a very interesting battle, and I believe this was the first time I’ve used a similar strategy—and it’s a success. I always like to look for some alternatives, and this time, a very risky one but with great destructive potential.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP4MJtfMUEKTEs6yFurNPbQqXdpJ7tw4TdxDfNsAqXuCd/image.png)
Well, that wraps up this battle. Thanks for reading this far and spending a little of your time with my words and thoughts. See you next time! Translated with DeepL.com https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1026615110300602368/rdgf2gh.gif ## Olá Splinters, bem vindos de volta!! ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVB3vayqiK5kRoH6MTbvCmtjhGapbF2M2yr5jaS4VqsC3/convenience_19_.gif) Sem dor, sem ganho. Quando escuto essa frase, a primeira coisa que vem na minha cabeça é... coisa relacionada à musculação, ah! esses marombas adoram essas frases de efeito. Mas será que, para ganhar algo em Splinterlands, é necessário de fato a dor? Não dor física, claro, isso é algo mais simbólico e, apesar de eu achar essa frase algo tão clichê, ela faz muito sentido. É claro que o título desse post está relacionado à regra de batalha, da batalha que eu trouxe hoje, algo que falarei daqui a pouco. Mas a questão aqui é se de fato é necessário dor para alcançar os objetivos, e sim, é necessário. Não especificamente nessa batalha, mas eu depositei esforço, já são quase cinco anos jogando Splinterlands e a dor aqui veio em perder, aprender, dedicar e planejar estratégias, entender os melhores mecanismos de defesa, ataque e etc. Esse empenho pode ser comparado de forma simbólica com a dor, quanto caminho é necessário percorrer até chegar no destino final? Mas bem, a batalha de hoje reflete sobre essa dor muito bem, até melhor do que qualquer outra analogia amadora que tentei até então. A regra de fato é No Pain No Gain e toda vez que causarmos algum tipo de dano em nossos monstros, eles ficarão mais fortes (ou danos indiretos causados pelo adversário). Então, se é necessário dor para ficar mais forte, eu me proporcionei esse momento de masoquismo. Escolhi um monstro que possui a habilidade Burn, ele causa dano em todos os monstros aliados e por que diabos alguém criaria esse tipo de habilidade? Pra equilibrar talvez, porque esse é um monstro muito forte e possui um custo baixo, alguma compensação negativa deveria ter... Mas então, para usufruir desse poder sem ser em batalhas que contenham a regra Back to Basics (onde todos perdem suas habilidades), a regra No Pain No Gain é uma maneira interessante de utilizar esse tipo de monstro com essa habilidade e ainda potencializar de forma ofensiva seus próprios monstros. Mas diante dessa estratégia kamikaze, tem um porém: o monstro sadomasoquista causador de dor nos amiguinhos precisa ser derrotado de alguma maneira, se ele permanecer muito tempo em campo, bem, vai ser mais pain do que gain, se é que você me entende... mas enfim, continue acompanhando que abaixo contarei mais sobre essa batalha e você entenderá que de fato, um pouco de dor ajuda a alcançar os objetivos. https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1070730152037847110/111.gif ## [Para assistir essa batalha, clique aqui](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_a051103e58f02cce54d425d4673a032d)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeJtycjirK4YGVBwGupkhWfwtqH25e3z2WL2G9fWi3h6j/image.png)
### Alguns pontos sobre essa batalha: Bem, nem precisamos dizer nada sobre a regra de batalha, então vamos mencionar que 51 de mana é uma quantidade muito interessante para escolher monstro um pouco mais caros e ainda temos todos os 6 elementos disponíveis para escolha.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaTxUAEaupJRnm9zcR3KUTJ1w4yvJfaTHWDPwYxw77pCH/image.png)
Na posição de tank, dois monstros robustos e que eu particularmente gosto muito. A escolha do meu adversário traz ainda mais proteção para todo o time com a adição de escudos, um monstro de muita vida e ataque generoso. Minha escolha é um tank que é quase perfeito: possui boa quantidade de vida, ótima velocidade e escudo e ainda possui habilidades que podem desiquilibrar.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUaSS5jxGKYt73UXhoTVFDPpJh4WdZfqYDWwMxAkaFUak/image.png)
Na minha linha de trás, eu escolho monstros de bom ataque, a minha principal escolha era por monstros ofensivos que pudessem realmente fazer meu adversário sangrar muito em cada ataque e potencializados pelo planejamento de ganhar mais poder quando são tocados por danos da própria equipe, a intenção aqui é realmente ser um time de alto impacto e que pudesse resolver a partida em poucos rounds.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRCKcjMrJmiGw7ALPugHMRXcVWeeCAJCeX9zVKfCbK8GG/image.png)
Bem, foi uma batalha bem interessante e acredito que essa tenha sido a primeira vez que eu tenha feito uma estratégia parecida, e está aprovada. Gosto sempre de buscar algumas alternativas e desta vez, uma alternativa bem arriscada mas com grande potencial de destruição.
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmP4MJtfMUEKTEs6yFurNPbQqXdpJ7tw4TdxDfNsAqXuCd/image.png)
Bem, e por aqui eu encerro esta batalha, obrigado por ler até aqui e passar um pouco do seu tempo com minhas palavras e pensamentos. Até a próxima! https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/864886270764122122/1026615110300602368/rdgf2gh.gif

title.title: When Rain Clouds Gathered, Coffee Became My Comfort: A Simple Afternoon Story of Cancelled Errands and Quiet Reflection
title.body:
![collage.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoChgqEkkXRSrPRyWNAUenu6r57RdNNL31vQDnGrGeuVwyPNY25ohRdfgn6e2UuGPq2.jpg)

**Hello Hive Family, and most especially my ever-supportive Hive Friends all over the world!** I’m happy to share another little piece of my daily life with you. Sometimes, it’s the ordinary moments that remind us of life’s quiet comforts, and yesterday was one of those times.

![2nd.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/Eo8M1p3j44XJJE1ZcmCPNCxJx1NoXctgepFPSsC382MMuJyY1oLrY4X93uHTNPTdgaq.jpeg)

![3rd.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EpT3HR9BYfJNe8EuUuydTXaNLk3Qr2FjFGNCXcmj7Y5Ddmhutg9dBPvt9oGwJXUxpFc.jpeg)

Yesterday afternoon, just a few hours after lunch, I was supposed to head out for an errand. But as I looked outside, the sky seemed heavy, hinting that rain would fall anytime. I decided to cancel my activity outside and stay home instead.

![4th.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/EoyNxoDvXai4qYTQuprQJ73d7fTxQvbJx47P7JJtKxP7q9uECWq29kY7fQcqt24Cgww.jpeg)

While waiting for the rain to pour, I wandered into the kitchen and prepared my favorite quick fix: one sachet of **American black coffee**. That was enough to keep me company.

![5th.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23ynQaor2QzkJBJvBHz3AK1gh7Vo32NMVN7Fki8fkERhEz4DJfATzztpipBN6XKWhTecL.jpeg)

I sat quietly, sipping each warm mouthful. Honestly, I’ve been feeling down lately due to several personal problems, but coffee has always been my little comfort. As a true coffee lover, I found joy in every sip, even in the middle of my worries. Sometimes, it’s not about solving everything at once; it’s about finding small moments that remind us we can still enjoy life.

![6th.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leighdalisay/23wMRrQFkKHdgd5GBRJHLSc3pbpbdjdTmcEGHwNXz5tibEuFo5jp5FKtVqrRPLd3wcG8U.jpeg)

**Thank you, dear Hive readers, for spending time with me through this short story.** Your support means more than you know. Until my next post, may we all continue to find comfort in the little things, whether it’s coffee, rain, or simply sharing stories with friends across the world.

title.title: XRP is Testing Everyone’s Patience | What’s Actually Going On?
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVYog3Q8KtqWEFKNNcQ1UFaQNPPxyyQ2ZJZhcpk9DvQcV/1000008984.png 


The last two weeks have been a real emotional rollercoaster for XRP. If you’ve been glued to the charts like I have, you’ve probably noticed that the market has been messing with us. We’ve been stuck hovering around the $1.30 mark, and every time we think we’re breaking out, the price just pulls back. It’s enough to make any trader want to step away from the screen for a bit.

The current market situation is honestly pretty tricky. A ton of long positions have been wiped out basically, the market is cleaning house. It’s a classic move smart money is sweeping liquidity before deciding which way to move next.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUQMByPzRBzciEdctUPXzX82NBtx21EZ2zrCARhuEUTje/1000008976.jpg 


*Visual: Take a look at the price action hovering right at that critical support zone.*

Looking at the derivatives data, the Long/Short ratio on Binance and OKX is still pretty high. It means a lot of people are still super optimistic that XRP is about to moon. But, the market has its own way of keeping us humble. The liquidation chart shows a lot of long traders getting forced out because the price just wouldn't play ball.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSgvrRcZ6jzEwEfyaMDru7TbWGftbQh6tYKVnW7XQvDUD/1000008972.png 

*Visual: Check out those red and green bars showing where traders got rekt.*

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc4FvUgBeZCxjnm1bVgYVG5VW1KAwtDZnGn1hqKZHRGiB/1000008973.jpg 

*Visual: This data gives you a good look at how heated the market is on the major exchanges.*

The interesting part? Even with all this volatility, a lot of whales are quietly moving their bags to cold wallets. If you connect the dots, it’s a sign they aren't looking to dump at these levels. They’re playing the long game while waiting for some concrete news on the CLARITY Act in the US. Until that regulation gets the green light, don't be surprised if XRP keeps playing cat and mouse around $1.30.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSkYbzEii5t9rSfAbVZSgpjZLHaJs9rd9cHREi8YWDe1Y/1000008971.png 

*Visual: This volume heatmap shows just how much interest (and hesitation) is floating around.*

**So, what’s the play?**
If you’re a swing trader, that $1.30 support is the make or break line. If it breaks, well, we know what that usually means. But if it holds, it could be a sweet accumulation zone. Bottom line don't fomo. The market is super volatile right now, so keep your risk management in check.

What do you guys think? Are you still holding your XRP tight, or are you looking for greener pastures?

position and orientation. Three.js handles all the panning and volume math through the Web Audio API's `PannerNode` under the hood.

For creative audio-visual installations, imagine placing multiple sound sources around a 3D scene -- each one playing a different instrument or stem from a track. Walking through the space mixes the music spatially. Close to the drums, you hear the beat louder. Move toward the synth pad, it dominates. The visual representation of each source can react to its own audio level, creating zones of activity scattered through the 3D world.

You'd create a separate `AudioAnalyser` for each `PositionalAudio` to get per-source frequency data. Then each visual element reacts only to its own audio source. title.title: Crash Bang Wallop
title.body:
<center>    
![20260523_095654 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdCQfXnmnmJ1J45yPq5uiFAeXbcRhadGrUr9QG97oZh64/20260523_095654%20(1).jpg)  </center>


From a very young age, I knew there was something wrong with everyone else, but even so,  I was still shocked by people’s behaviour during the whole Covid madness, and I haven’t had much faith in humanity since.

Until yesterday.

There we were, my brother and I, tootling into town in our battered old jalopy when suddenly —bang — a jolt, and straight into the back of the car in front we crashed, somehow managing to wedge the fella’s towbar underneath the front of our car... a manoeuvre only a truly experienced driver could pull off.

Out hops the other driver to inspect the damage. I’m braced for wailing, recriminations and maybe some gnashing of teeth but instead he’s all sweetness and light, calmly calling a mechanic friend rather than the police.

Within moments, a crowd gathers, not to gawp, but to help. Two buildery-looking lads (real men) appear and immediately try lifting one car off the other with their bare hands. A kind lady takes my brother aside and comforts him while he indulges in his usual crisis-time bawling. Everyone else stands around offering suggestions and encouragement.

“We’re gonna need a jack,” announces the driver of the wounded car.

“Did someone say jack?” asks a woman pulling up in a posh-looking jeep. “I’ve a top-of-the-range one in the boot.”

The buildery lads get to work, the car is lifted free, and all the while the other driver keeps reassuring my brother that it could happen to a bishop and nobody’s hurt.

And that was that. No screaming. No blame. No threats. Just handshakes and smiles.

Both parties drive away in good humour.

Sometimes I just love people.

==============================================================

Cancer clusters are terrifying. Definitely something to look into. They say asbestos disease will be around for at least another 100 years as there is still asbestos around in the form of housing materials. Dad's was occupational - he was a draftsman and he liked to be the one getting outdoors on building sites and measuring up. Often, buildings in states of demolition or with asbestos being cut etc. Awful way to go. And that was after suffering a cancer from.chemicals from his tour in Vietnam. War and industry. Couldn't make you sadder and madder, right? The little people cop the horror. It was lucky that both don't show up til later in life so he had a full, good life til around 69 years old. Immunotherapy cured him off the war cancer and a year later mesothelioma swept in. 

There's been absolutely no inkling of clusters near us, we would have known, so we didn't even factor that in. I think Australia might be a little better off in that regard, largely anyway. 

I hear you on the ring tone PTSD. It's so anxiety inducing. I could never play poker or be a financial trader, I'd fair have a heart attack. 

Still, don't you think that if you didn't have the stress, you wouldn't feel as content/happy in the end? Like we need the hardship to appreciate the end result. Phew. 

Life is indeed strange. He would have been very happy for us, I know. I'm eternally grateful to both him and Mum.

[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRJK3XEbam4tiyWX66k8DcJPAH7LcQF6CAFU58SRfifU/hivegarden.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdRJK3XEbam4tiyWX66k8DcJPAH7LcQF6CAFU58SRfifU/hivegarden.jpg) *Greetings, friends.* In a week, the last spring month will end, which at the moment, due to the abnormal heat, looks more like the middle of summer. We have already been using products from our garden for almost the entire month of May. And what have we already grown? Of course, it's just fresh spinach, watercress, basil, lettuce, onion, and radish, and other herbs. But if we calculate the price of all this in the store in winter and even at the moment, then we have significantly saved our family budget.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX3T7maPk27yGmv6JBUDXkkxLJwEzFfVPFmGYkoBsMk8K/20260511_091637380_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX3T7maPk27yGmv6JBUDXkkxLJwEzFfVPFmGYkoBsMk8K/20260511_091637380_ios.jpg) The first week I visited my daughter, a hurricane was in our village at that time. My wife called me and said that a cubic container had fallen, into which water was collected through the drain from the roof of the house. Why did this happen? She stood in this place for 6 years. Of course, I wanted to fix it to the concrete base, but the structure seemed quite heavy and stable. The plastic container was damaged, but it is quite usable.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZkgVFSbvTVHycDbiaWQLRTFHxuU6qM1iHEmihs9m52WD/20260514_073138993_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZkgVFSbvTVHycDbiaWQLRTFHxuU6qM1iHEmihs9m52WD/20260514_073138993_ios.jpg) ***Spinach***. For some reason, we couldn't grow it. The soil structure in our garden may be to blame. I don't know what happened, but for the third year in spring we have had a wonderful harvest of this juicy, healthy herb. In the middle of April, we start growing early grass in the greenhouse. By the time the tomatoes are planted, all the delicious grass grows and is eaten, or we put it in containers in the refrigerator.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYCDXKwe7HmNHTCrJfSW3d9bq6tocA1mR7p6Ezqqs5N8z/20260514_073144943_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYCDXKwe7HmNHTCrJfSW3d9bq6tocA1mR7p6Ezqqs5N8z/20260514_073144943_ios.jpg) This is the second spinach harvest. It has already grown to the size of my palm, it was assembled yesterday and put in the refrigerator.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVvZ8pugLvY6ToqevtNCFRfcf8abP7cACdCAAUVYWENqy/20260514_073437497_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVvZ8pugLvY6ToqevtNCFRfcf8abP7cACdCAAUVYWENqy/20260514_073437497_ios.jpg) We harvest the first radish harvest in the first half of May. During the summer, we constantly plant radishes. We get the last radish harvest at the end of September. Radishes are called long night vegetables because they love moisture, like all similar root vegetables.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVnDKAnFrssoPAxaQEeyspBQQeA5ihmsaGNLsjV2wXtsy/20260514_073414544_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVnDKAnFrssoPAxaQEeyspBQQeA5ihmsaGNLsjV2wXtsy/20260514_073414544_ios.jpg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVrvKn39GCgZt6jFG189js3T4dnAwoWHvXz14sb61WALK/20260514_085733436_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVrvKn39GCgZt6jFG189js3T4dnAwoWHvXz14sb61WALK/20260514_085733436_ios.jpg) And what do I do with spinach? Often we just eat the leaves as an addition to the dishes, and, of course, we make salads.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZC5sXDMC9YCk5XwvwnVfwvhPWzKf79v9nWa481UCmJky/20260514_090144245_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZC5sXDMC9YCk5XwvwnVfwvhPWzKf79v9nWa481UCmJky/20260514_090144245_ios.jpg) How to make a salad? Take all the delicious food from the garden, cut it up, put it in one plate, add salt. I usually make a salad with sour cream, my wife likes it with olive oil.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcAw1zGSErSMFsBWUZzHDyuGQ6yRNsXyaRg9d5dKR56SB/20260514_090354267_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcAw1zGSErSMFsBWUZzHDyuGQ6yRNsXyaRg9d5dKR56SB/20260514_090354267_ios.jpg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXp2fNzd4N7WC9moAUe4PxmsbbB2PoeJ6d5itpbr89ovJ/20260514_090604286_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXp2fNzd4N7WC9moAUe4PxmsbbB2PoeJ6d5itpbr89ovJ/20260514_090604286_ios.jpg) This cucumber is not from my garden yet, but from the store. I think that in 2 weeks we will have our first lettuce cucumbers.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaqQNp83zj7UDMDJ5k7j5Zgzi2skMFiVRCpPSUgqQRwey/20260514_092315429_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmaqQNp83zj7UDMDJ5k7j5Zgzi2skMFiVRCpPSUgqQRwey/20260514_092315429_ios.jpg) An egg in this salad never hurts. And I'll add 3 eggs.
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXBuTwY1EcL9Efzo7FqYjiRHM3qhstDhLxvs7Trfn9P75/20260514_092509449_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXBuTwY1EcL9Efzo7FqYjiRHM3qhstDhLxvs7Trfn9P75/20260514_092509449_ios.jpg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWPMeZDY5XQPkkWCgRVCt9xzwqo6xPnoe66N8PnziHLC4/20260514_092646986_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWPMeZDY5XQPkkWCgRVCt9xzwqo6xPnoe66N8PnziHLC4/20260514_092646986_ios.jpg)
[![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNNSH1cb1ExYHuqPBp7gKhwKxgQdvqUJHbg2Nt1GQuKiU/20260514_093242299_ios.jpg)](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNNSH1cb1ExYHuqPBp7gKhwKxgQdvqUJHbg2Nt1GQuKiU/20260514_093242299_ios.jpg) The salad is ready. I decided to add some more grainy mustard for piquancy. The main thing is that my wife gave my creation a positive assessment. Although, of course, she always likes to eat the food I cook.
The wind started blowing this morning, and clouds appeared in the sky. On Monday, we are expecting rain, which has not been seen for 3 weeks. Yesterday, while walking with the dog, I fell unsuccessfully, or rather, the dog dropped me. I fell on my back and hit the back of my head on the ground. It hurt, but nothing bad happened. That's what I thought. But in the afternoon, when I bent down, I felt pain in my lower back. It will pass quickly - that was my thought, but yesterday I couldn't do anything in the garden. In the evening, I gave myself an injection of Diclofenac and a second injection an hour ago. Now I can walk normally, and now I'm going to the garden to mow the grass with my lawnmower.
![imagehive1.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbD5H7vX4jU6TiFbUKDRt1VvurE3tmJNBgpmF4jxEYkW/imagehive1.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdnr6CyN4mtmwyYLY8pARGkVVgkXFcvLZv62JTVLhKesF/image.png)
**Thanks for reading...** ***Don’t Worry, Be Happy*** (C) Bobby McFerrin Text & Photography by @apnigrich With love @apnigrich Good luck and have fun ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTaptAjVsgabYkFsYE2HhYkehE8Xyx6T7Ud2En1ELgm4g/image.png)

title.title: A Middle Class Boy | How He Survived? Final Part.
title.body: ### Hello Hivers! Last Day I share a story of Ali who completed his education but didn't get job opportunity, he was the only son in his family, this lead him into deep depression. [Read the Full Story Here](https://hive.blog/hive-125125/@nabbas0786/story-of-a-middle-class) ***NOW, let's go for Part 2, did he get Job? How he survived?*** It started when Ali finished his studies. Like any young guy stepping out of university he was full of ambition high energy and ready to take on the world (every second person felt this), he had big dreams (as many of us had after completing our education). But the reality of the job market hit him like a cold wave ([as mentioned in previous Part](https://hive.blog/hive-125125/@nabbas0786/story-of-a-middle-class)). Weeks turned into months and that initial excitement of getting the things fixed, ending up the poverty for his family and for himself as well, slowly faded into a depressing routine of checking emails facing closed doors and dealing with unanswered applications. It felt like he was screaming into a void and all of his struggles went in vein. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfBm1S423hJdCeaUkdAuQ7y6jzguh9ru4djqcYN7zCUcS/1779536389702.png) Image Created With Google Gemini The father, watching his son's spirit bend under the heavy weight of constant rejection, can't stay quiet. One evening as they sat down for tea his dad pulled him aside. He didn't offer toxic positivity instead of that he gave him a reminder grounded in something deeper. \
his father said gently after putting his hand on Ali's shoulder, **\

**\n\nThat conversation with his father changed something deep inside Ali. He realized that sitting around waiting for the perfect door to be opened for him isn't good not even working for so long. Now, he needed to shift his mindset but **\
**. \n\nHe started telling himself a line that became his daily mantra \

It wasn't about lake of confidence or not about pretending to be someone else, it was about having absolute unshakable faith that his daily hard work would eventually connect with the right opportunity. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSLKqcX7ArKynf3JkhAiPZd3W89EVN8Hob4GLoSkyDKYo/1779536434822.png) Image Created With Google Gemini So, instead of wasting his time, he went to work on himself (finally, he is going to change himself instead of looking for a perfect match, we all should do this if you're getting fail again and again). He started picking up small freelance gigs and keep learning new tools to upgrade his skills. Even when the pay was nothing he kept showing up every single day just to get experience and to make his name in market. He held onto another profound reminder from the Holy Quran: *: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ* \
If you were to rely upon Allah with the reliance due to Him - He would provide for you just as He provides for the birds.\
Who can handle this? I need someone who won't buckle under pressure.\
There is this young guy Ali. He is sharp incredibly hardworking and handles tough situations with total honesty. He is exactly who you need right now.\

body.title: Nucleus Turns Onchain History Into Reputation Score
body.body:
[Nucleus](https://nucleus.codes/invited?code=pvK44O4V) is part of a new generation oeb3 infrastructure projects trying to solve the industry’s biggest unsolved problem! The vision is to turn activity into measurable usability.

For years crypto focused obsessively on decentralization, token mechanics, and protocol engineering while ordinary users were left navigating wallet setups gas fees and endless signatures.

Most interfaces felt like tax software designed by anarchists. Projects like Nucleus are reacting to the realization that the technology itself is no longer the primary bottleneck. 

What makes Nucleus interesting is that it positions itself less like a traditional crypto app and more like an operating layer for digital identity, reputation, and access across Web3 ecosystems.

The platform revolves around the idea that your onchain behavior and social presence together form a kind of portable credibility score... a reputation engine for the Web3 economy.

Instead of filling out applications, joining whitelist raffles, or farming referral links, your activity becomes the application itself. The distribution layer for Web3 was created! 

​
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVn8RhKzcToJiXPTXWJPpMqFfVnU9SmiWxP4AEuYN63LR/image.png)


Early crypto culture was built around anonymity and pseudonyms. The newer wave is increasingly building systems around reputation portability as a way to build trust.

The idea that wallets, social graphs, contribution history, NFT ownership, governance participation, and behavioral patterns can collectively function as a decentralized identity layer.

Your wallet becomes more than storage.... it becomes a résumé. What’s especially smart is how[ Nucleus](https://nucleus.codes/invited?code=pvK44O4V) blends this reputation system with ecosystem participation mechanics.

Right now they’ve tied engagement into things like the native Nucleus campaign, a Quip Network NFT whitelist opportunity, and the 60-days Sleepagochi epoch system.

This creates the feeling of an interconnected onchain social environment rather than isolated apps competing for attention. I joined all three narratives and started to hustle! 


DeFi died because speculation alone cannot sustain ecosystems forever. The industry spent years optimizing token launches before solving for identity, trust, and meaningful participation.

Reputation systems are an attempt to create continuity between communities, allowing users to carry social and economic credibility across platforms without constantly restarting from zero.

[Nucleus](https://nucleus.codes/invited?code=pvK44O4V) treats your digital footprint as infrastructure. Your tweets, transactions, participation history, and wallet activity become signals feeding an algorithmic understanding of who you are.

The algo then see what opportunities you deserve access to. It’s Web3 rebuilding credit scoring with a decentralized ecosystems that evaluate cultural and behavioral legitimacy.

We are done with endless chains competing on TPS metrics nobody cares about, but systems focused on identity abstraction, social coordination, and seamless participation.

If projects like [Nucleus](https://nucleus.codes/invited?code=pvK44O4V) succeed.... Web3 may finally move away from feeling like fragmented financial software and toward something closer to a persistent internet-native reputation layer! 

Now trust and opportunity follow users across ecosystems automatically. Must flex my Top 7% rank... because being and OG and a chad leaves many blockchain footprints!

title.body:
![3207.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fherdz/23ynS7XWbgVxX21Zyp2eYoQRJtFTCMwE4EzJEX7NyBq6EdFS69vtLnSDZwJLAFnZnzQgp.jpg)


**Sa kulay ng politika, tayo’y magkakaiba,
Ngunit respeto’t dangal, huwag sanang mawala.
Hindi dahil salungat ang ating paniniwala,
Ay salita ng galit ang agad na isusuka.**


**Sa mundo ng social media, tila apoy ang sigla,
Konting di-pagkakasundo, insulto ang bunga.
“Bobo” ang bansag, masasakit na salita,
Na tila ba katotohanan ang sila’y may hawak na watawat nila.**



**Ngunit ang tunay na talino’y may galang na dala,
Nakikinig, umuunawa, di basta nanlalait sa iba.
Sapagkat ang politika’y usapin ng bansa,
Hindi dahilan para kapwa’y yurakan at saktan pa.**


**Pagkat sa bawat kulay, iisa ang adhika,
Ang bayan ay umunlad, at pagkakaisa’y madama.
Kung respeto ang paiiralin sa bawat pagtatalo’t sigla,
Mas magiging makabuluhan ang ating demokrasya.**

I have been outside in the garden so much the last few days and have taken photos of the various flowers, but I have used them in the last two articles, so I thought I would give it a rest and *let sleeping dogs lie.* That idiomatic expression has nothing to do with anything related, but since there is a picture of our dog having a nap between my legs, it is close enough. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/242NoQr6s3MW6nRsvRj8g1adDjb1bXzFGE7PgC7ZjUwYH7BzNsM7usn96cBVxcJF8h8vw.png) --- Since the weather is mostly sunny and warm today, we invited a friend couple around to grill some burgers with us, and eat on the terrace. It should be nice, as I am trying a slightly different burger recipe and will also try to make sangria for the first time. And yesterday, since we had a lot of cherry tomatoes that were softening, I made a tomato relish for the first time also, and at least I am going to spread that sucker onto my burger. Smallsteps and I went to the shops earlier to get supplies and she was surprised at how expensive it all was for one meal. And yes, it is expensive, but considering there will be five of us eating, if we did it at even an average burger restaurant, it would cost fifty percent more, and there would be no leftovers. Doing it like this means that we will have various bits and pieces (not the meat) leftover to add to other meals in the future. She has the habit of taking the receipt and reading it in the car, so this time I had her work out what was the most expensive things and what kinds of food they were. Other than the minced meat, she correctly identified that all of the packaged things were expensive and then we had a discussion about what kinds of foods they actually are in terms of health benefits. For instance, she has flavoured yoghurt for snacks, which have a fair bit of sugar in it - but for the same price as one tiny tub, she could eat half a kilo of apples. Or for the price of a couple tubs, she could have unflavoured yoghurt, some berries and some honey several times - which she also does and likes. I have heard that in the US it is much cheaper to eat unhealthily, but I think in most of Europe, eating healthier is the cheaper option, but not the convenient option. So much of the food is pre-cooked and packaged now which saves time, but how much? Even going to a takeaway drive-thru takes time, so what would the difference actually be between getting takeaway or making a salad? Price-wise, the salad is much cheaper (here at least), and will actually take less time to prepare - but it *has to be prepared.* > People are lazy. Anyway, I quite like eating home-made food and I am one of those sad people who think a home grilled burger is far better than one from a burger joint. Even homemade steaks are now better than many of the restaurant ones I have had the last couple years. So why go out? Yes, there is the company aspect and for special occasions so no one has to prep or clean up, but overall, I am becoming less and less of a fan of eating food out, that I can make better at home. When it comes to ethnic food though with various Asian or Indian foods - I am happy for a decent takeaway place, because I can never get it even close. >Now though, it is time to prep the patties and get the sangria flowing! Have a great Saturday. ## Why Massage Therapy Is Important

Massage therapy is widely recognized for its ability to help people relax and recover from physical strain. Modern routines often involve sitting for long hours, using digital devices continuously, and dealing with demanding schedules. These habits can contribute to stiffness, discomfort, and reduced flexibility. Professional massage techniques are designed to help the body feel more comfortable by encouraging relaxation and improving circulation.

Many individuals choose massage therapy as part of their wellness routine because it provides a peaceful environment where they can focus on rest and self-care. Even a single session can help create a feeling of refreshment and renewed energy.

## Benefits of Professional Massage Services

A professionally performed massage can provide numerous benefits that support both physical and mental wellness.

### Key Benefits Include:

*   Reduced muscle tension

*   Relief from daily stress

## Different Types of Massage Therapies

Massage centers typically offer a variety of treatments designed to meet different relaxation preferences and wellness goals.

### Swedish Massage

Swedish massage is one of the most commonly requested therapies. It uses gentle and flowing movements that help relax muscles and promote a calming experience. This option is often selected by individuals seeking overall relaxation.

### Deep Tissue Massage

Deep tissue massage focuses on deeper layers of muscle tissue. It is commonly chosen by people experiencing muscle tightness caused by physical activity, long working hours, or repetitive movements.

### Aromatherapy Massage

This treatment combines massage techniques with aromatic essential oils. The pleasant scents can contribute to a calming atmosphere while supporting relaxation.

### Thai Massage

Thai massage incorporates stretching techniques along with controlled pressure. It is often preferred by individuals looking to improve flexibility and enjoy a more active style of therapy.

### Hot Stone Massage

Heated stones are used during the session to create a soothing sensation and encourage muscle relaxation. Many people find this treatment especially comforting.

### Foot Reflexology

Foot reflexology focuses on specific pressure points located on the feet. This therapy is frequently selected by individuals seeking a relaxing and refreshing experience.

夜色迷人啊，虽然近几日总有雨水来打扰，所幸也都是一阵一阵的，到了夜晚，似乎地板也都被夏日热度烘干了，灯光亮起，又是一个五颜六色璀璨靓丽的夜。

东街一带，不论是白天，还是晚上，依旧是热闹的，尤其是现在的福州已经成为旅游热门城市之一，热闹程度更甚于前，尤其是几大热门景点，除非你是一大早出发游玩，莫不然就会看到好些拖着行李箱的外地游客，喜气洋洋地站在热门打卡点拍照呢。

当然，从大家知道福州地铁空余处可以放置行李箱后，似乎都很默契的把行李箱放在摄像头底下，一点也不担心会丢失，不过大多数人也不会把贵重物品放行李箱吧，至少我不会，稍微贵重一点的都放在随身携带的包包内，(⊙o⊙)…，其实最贵重的应该还是自己吧，别把自己弄丢了就行，哈哈哈哈。。不论男生女生出门在外，务必保护好自身安全哈。

平时我就很少喝红牛，更别说不知名的东鹏特饮了，但，从张雪机车连续获冠军之后，东鹏特饮身影也闯入了我眼，那么今天我也来尝一下这冠军饮品的口感，哈哈，买了无糖口味的，开盖扫码也可以参与赢立减金活动，这不，又扫码中了立减金2.5元，下一次购买东鹏的时候，可以直接立减使用。。好家伙，我发现这饮料刷码中奖率这么高吗？？这连续中奖好几次了，这一次换了品牌，还中奖啊，哈哈哈，那咋就不客气了。。

话说这东鹏的口感还OK，至少我个人还有点喜欢这味，无糖的也很合适，喝了之后，也确实起到了提神醒脑的效果，好嘞，今后有喝功能性饮料，就喝东鹏家的啦。。红牛再见。。

一边喝着东鹏特饮，心里还美着呢，无意中发现地板上一个小可爱，不知道是谁家的小挂件掉地上了。。。！！！咱还是别动它了吧，看这样子还挺新的，好似刚掉的，说不定它的主人很快能回来找到它。。祝你好运，小家伙。

OK，今天先分享到这儿哈，祝福大家周六愉快，喜乐平安。

**感谢大家的阅读和喜欢，您的点赞给予我莫大的鼓励，感恩❀**
