body.title: The travel chaos
body.body:
Yesterday,  I started my journey for Japan. It was a long travel day with alnost total 26 hours of travel time. My first flight was from Muscat to Mumbai and then Mumbai to Tokyo. There was almost 4 hours wait time between the 2 flights, so I had decided, I will make a quick visit at home in Mumbai, had some extra luggage which I was supposed to drop off. Everything was arranged. 

But then on reaching airport got to know that our Muscat to Mumbai flight was delayed by 2.5 hrs. In that moment I was scared and nervous, thinking what if it gets more delayed. And then I had the extra luggage also, which I had to leave in Mumbai. With this delay it was impossible for me to go home and return back. Luckily my niece was in town and I requested her if she could come to the airport to take the luggage and she agreed.  

The flight did not get delayed further, we reached Mumbai just in time for our Tokyo flight. My son met us at the airport and after that it was all smooth. On reaching Tokyo, again it was all smooth. I had completed the immigration online so we came out very quick. I had booked a cab in advance so he was also waiting for us. We reached our Hotel by 10 a.m. The hotel check-in was at 3, we requested early check-in but then the previous guest had not left so we had to wait in the lobby.

I was feeling exhausted and wanted to sleep, so we tried looking for hourly bed arrangements in the nearby area, which is very common in Japan. It was hard luck there, as everything was full. At 12 finally we got the room, and we all crashed. 

The day 1 itinerary got little disturbed, our first point we missed, because we over slept but then later on we did other places. 

So that's the update so far on my journey of reaching Tokyo.

Every week, we're going to post a challenge early in the week just to give you some writing inspiration. 

As the weeks go by, we'll also list *previous* weeks topics, so that if you missed one that you *wanted* to write on, or you don't feel inspired by this weeks, you can write on any.

The idea is to always have some salty content to write about. 

Whilst as yet we can't offer rewards, @riverflows may give the best ones a tip each week, if she has the time and isn't swimming with sharks. 

If you love what @oceanlovers is about, please delegate to us so that we can continue to grow and support others. Community maintenance is hard work - any support is really welcome! 

### This Week's Challenge

*Wk1* 🌊 What are your first memories of the ocean? These can also be in the form of a movie or a book if you've never been to the seaside, or you can write a fictional piece if you like. 


##### The Rules

- Post in the community and use #oceanlovers as your first tag
- Title/preview title (up to you) OCEAN LOVERS CHALLENGE (WEEK #...) - YOUR TITLE
- No AI content please
- Be kind

body.title: How I protect myself from online scammers
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPDuAoTubQ57dhkLsi5QDN7rgFw2DCHnq3q4JCinWyBMW/1779536229510.jpg)

In today’s digital age, online scammers are everywhere, constantly looking for unsuspecting people to deceive through fake messages, websites, phone calls, and attractive offers. Because of this, I always try to stay careful whenever I use the internet. One of the major ways I protect myself from online scammers is by avoiding trusting strangers online too quickly. I never share my personal information such as passwords, ATM details, bank information, or OTP codes with anyone, no matter how convincing they may sound.

I also make it a habit to carefully check links before clicking on them. Many scammers send fake links through emails, WhatsApp messages, text messages, and social media platforms in order to steal people’s personal information or hack their accounts. In addition, I avoid offers that seem too good to be true because most scammers use fake giveaways, unbelievable discounts, or promises of quick money to attract victims.

Another important step I take is using strong passwords and enabling two-factor authentication on my accounts. This adds extra security and makes it harder for hackers to gain access. I also regularly update my phone, computer, and applications to protect them from viruses and cyberattacks.

Before buying anything online, I make sure to confirm that the seller or website is genuine by reading reviews, checking ratings, and verifying their reputation. I also stay informed about common online scams by reading online safety tips and news updates.

Most importantly, I advise my friends and family members to be cautious online as well. I believe that being smart, patient, and alert while using the internet is one of the best ways to stay safe and protected from online scammers.

**Thanks for reading.**

body.title: Блиск, що не тьмяніє: як наука нарешті перехитрила час
body.body: >Знаєте, є в золоті щось таке, що змушує серце битися трохи швидше. Це не просто метал, це символ стабільності, багатства та, якщо хочете, певної вічності. Я завжди любив дивитися на старі монети чи прикраси, намагаючись уявити, через скільки рук вони пройшли. Але давайте будемо чесними: золото, яке ми носимо щодня, не таке вже й безсмертне. Воно дряпається, втрачає той самий \

блиск, тьмяніє, якщо носити його занадто активно, або ж реагує на хімію. Я сам колись віддавав улюблену обручку на полірування, бо вона виглядала так, ніби прожила життя важче за мене. І от, натрапивши на останні дослідження, я зрозумів — ми нарешті знайшли спосіб обманути цей природний процес старіння металу.

\n\n
>Це не просто чергова лабораторна знахідка, про яку забудуть через тиждень. Вчені нарешті зрозуміли, як саме відбувається процес \

на нанорівні. Виявляється, справа не стільки в самому металі, скільки в тому, як він взаємодіє з мікрочастинками на своїй поверхні. Довгий час ми вважали золото інертним, таким, що ні з чим не вступає в реакцію, але фізика виявилася куди підступнішою. Коли я читав про це, то відразу згадав свій старий велосипед, який іржавів у гаражі — тільки тут замість іржі ми маємо справу з непомітними для ока змінами структури поверхні золота.

>Суть нового відкриття вражає своєю елегантністю. Дослідники з’ясували, що ми можемо маніпулювати тим, як золото контактує з навколишнім середовищем, фактично створюючи захисний бар'єр на молекулярному рівні. Це не фарба і не дешеве напилення, яке зітреться через місяць носіння. Це зміна самої поведінки атомів на поверхні. Уявіть собі метал, який не просто відбиває світло, а робить це постійно, ніби ви щойно вийшли з бутіка. Для когось це може здатися дрібницею, мовляв, ну, блищить і блищить, але для промисловості, де золото використовують у надточних датчиках, смартфонах чи медичних імплантатах, це справжня революція.
>Коли я думаю про це, мені стає цікаво, куди нас це заведе. Ми завжди прагнули досконалості, і ось ми її отримали — вічний блиск. Але чи не втратимо ми ту саму \

історію предметів? Стара річ має свій характер, свої шрами. Якщо каблучка не втрачає блиск десятиліттями, чи стає вона від цього менш цінною як пам'ять? Можливо, це занадто філософські роздуми для статті про фізику металів, але я часто ловлю себе на думці, що ми намагаємося зробити світ занадто ідеальним. Хоча, давайте будемо реалістами: хто з нас відмовиться від смартфона з роз’ємами, які не окислюються, чи від прикраси, яку не потрібно чистити кожного року?

>Ця технологія відкриває двері, про які ми навіть не здогадувалися. Ми говоримо про енергоефективність, про довговічність електроніки, яка тепер зможе працювати в екстремальних умовах без втрати якості сигналу. І все це завдяки тому, що ми нарешті розгадали секрет того, як зробити золото по-справжньому вічним. Я дивлюся на свої руки, на свій годинник і розумію, що межа між \
стає все тоншою. Ми не просто копіюємо природу, ми її покращуємо, підганяючи під наші потреби.

>Це той випадок, коли наука стає не просто сухою викладкою фактів, а чимось, що торкається нашого повсякденного життя. Ми звикли думати, що все навколо нас тимчасове, що час нещадний до всього, що ми створюємо. Але іноді стається прорив, який змушує нас усміхнутися і сказати: \
. Мені дуже хочеться побачити, як ці розробки впровадять у масове виробництво. Як швидко ми побачимо на ринку предмети, які гордо заявлятимуть: \

>Можливо, через десяток років ми будемо сміятися, згадуючи, як колись витрачали час на чистку золотих прикрас чи перепайку окислених контактів у техніці. Це майбутнє, яке приходить тихо, без гучних фанфар, але воно вже тут. А ви готові до того, що навколо вас все буде залишатися таким же новим, як у день покупки? Чи все ж таки в потерті, яку залишає час, є своя магія, яку не варто замінювати на вічний блиск? Мені цікаво дізнатися вашу думку — чи варто людству намагатися зробити абсолютно все навколо себе \

, чи ми повинні залишати місце для природного ходу часу?

Для ознайомлення із першоджерелом надаю певне

body.body: />Hello Everyone! Hope you all are doing amazing and welcome to another #Splinterlands post. Today was honestly one of the best grinding days I had in #Splinterlands for quite some time. I finally ranked up from Modern Diamond 3 to Modern Diamond 2 again and it actually felt really satisfying because Diamond league is getting harder and harder every single day.

> The climb today was not easy at all. Some players in Diamond 3 are actually insanely strong now. I fought multiple teams with maxed cards and annoying combinations. But somehow I kept winning. At first I was just trying to complete daily focus normally, but then I realized I already had a small win streak going. After 3 wins I started becoming extra careful with my lineups because I really wanted to push rank today. Then suddenly it became 4 wins. Then 5 wins. And finally 6 wins in a row. That final match before promotion felt so important. When the victory screen appeared and I saw the promotion to Modern Diamond 2, it honestly felt amazing.
> After ranking up, it was finally reward opening time. I had 21 chests waiting and seeing those 2 Ultimate Chests sitting there looked so satisfying.
> Before opening anything, I immediately consumed Legendary Potion and Alchemy Potion.

> I know rewards are random, but using potions just makes the openings feel way more exciting. It feels like increasing your luck even if just a little bit. Then I started opening everything one by one. Some rewards were normal stuff like merits, potions and energy, but I also got some pretty decent cards from the rewards. I didn’t get some crazy jackpot legendary, but honestly the rewards still felt solid overall. Ultimate Chests always make the opening experience feel more hype.

> The main highlight of today honestly was the 6 win-streak. In lower leagues, win streaks happen pretty often, but in Diamond league it feels much harder because almost every opponent has strong cards and experience. One mistake and the whole streak ends. That’s why I was actually surprised I managed to keep winning continuously. I think patience helped a lot today. Instead of rushing lineups, I actually took time checking mana caps and possible enemy elements before selecting cards. That definitely improved my results.

></center>

𝐂𝐎𝐍𝐂𝐋𝐔𝐒𝐈𝐎𝐍
====================

Overall today was a really good #Splinterlands day for me.

*   Ranked up from Modern Diamond 3 → Diamond 2
    
*   Went on a 6 win-streak
    
*   Opened 21 reward chests
    
*   Got 2 Ultimate Chests
    

Even though Diamond league is stressful sometimes, moments like these make the grind worth it.

Now the goal is to hold Diamond 2 and maybe push even higher if possible.

Anyway thats it for today’s #splinterlands grind. More battles tomorrow and hopefully more crazy moments too. Please do give your reviews in the comments section below. I would really appreciate it :)

I'll be back with another one soon. So do follow me if you want to stay updated. Till then, Stay Happy and Stay Hydrated.

body.title: 17% населення ЄС живе в переповненому житлі, кожна десята сім'я мерзне вдома
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUFn8HGQCSCAh8yneWAi3MggaLr8GRDKY1F3ggyE9GsyM/image)

![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcMPfo8zaQc3uFvCZMEjQDcougQb2CHAvVDGQWorDWmKG/image)

Згідно з даними Eurostat, у ЄС 17% населення мешкає в переповненому житлі, що менше, ніж було 2010 року (19%).
Нині найвищі показники переповненості - у Румунії (41%), Латвії (39%) і Болгарії (34%), найнижчі - на Кіпрі (2%), Мальті (4%) і в Нідерландах (5%).

Проте 33% европейців живуть у малозаселених помешканнях. Типовою причиною є літні батьки, які лишаються у великих помешканнях після того, як їхні діти виросли і роз'їхалися.
Найбільше малозаселеного житла - на Кіпрі (70%), Ірландії (67%) і Мальті (64%), найнижчі - в Румунії (7%), Латвії (10%) і Греції (13%). 

Ще один важливий показник якості житла в ЄС: 9% домогосподарств не в змозі утримати оселю належним чином теплою.
Найвища частка населення, що не в змозі підтримувати вдома належне тепло - у Болгарії та Греції (по 19%), Литві та Іспанії (18%). А ось у Фінляндії, Словенії та Польщі ситуація протилежна (нижче 3%).

body.title: A Quiet Evening in the Village
body.body: Photography has a beautiful way of capturing simple moments that often go unnoticed. This photo reflects the peaceful side of village life where nature, open roads, and daily routines create a calm atmosphere.

/>

The wide dusty road, green fields, and the large tree standing beside the path make the scene feel natural and relaxing. The soft evening sky adds warmth and gives the image a peaceful mood. What I like most about village photography is its simplicity. There are no bright city lights or crowded streets, only pure moments and natural beauty.  
Sometimes the most beautiful photographs are not planned. They come from ordinary places and simple views that tell their own story. A village scene like this reminds us that beauty can be found in quiet places too.

body.title: How Can You Master Business Resilience Concepts for the IAPP CIPP-E Exam?
body.body:
You've been reading through the iapp certified information privacy professional exam material and most of it makes sense GDPR principles and lawful bases and data subject rights all feel doable after a while. Then you hit business resilience and something changes. Suddenly you're looking at ideas that mix legal duties with day-to-day planning and incident response and it doesn't feel like a privacy topic anymore. It feels like a whole different subject dropped into the middle of your prep.

That confusion is completely normal. Business resilience sits right where privacy law meets real-world practice and that's exactly why it catches people off guard.

## What Business Resilience Actually Means Here

In the context of the cipp e certification business resilience isn't about general disaster recovery. It's about how organisations keep up with their data protection duties even when things go wrong a breach and a system failure and a third-party vendor going dark. The exam wants you to understand how GDPR accountability rules stretch into crisis situations and not just normal day-to-day work.

Focus on three things: what your organisation must still do during a disruption and who is in charge and how that gets written down. Those three angles cover most of what the exam tests in this area.

## Connecting Resilience to Articles You Already Know

Here's something that helps a lot: business resilience doesn't stand alone. It connects directly to Article 32 (security of processing) and Article 33 (breach notification timelines) and Article 28 (processor duties). 

Once you link resilience back to specific GDPR articles it stops feeling vague and starts feeling like something you can actually answer questions about. Go back to those articles with resilience in mind and you'll spot the connections quickly.

## Practice Questions Close the Gap Faster Than Notes

Reading about resilience is one thing. Answering exam-style questions about it is where real understanding builds. The [cipp e practice exam from Pass4success](https://www.pass4success.com/iapp) gives you situation-based questions that show how these ideas actually come up on test day not just meanings but real applied situations that push your thinking. 

## You've Already Done the Hardest Part

Getting through the bulk of CIPP-E material while still taking on the tricky parts like business resilience takes real effort. You now have a clearer way to approach this topic tie it to specific GDPR articles and think in terms of duties during disruption. When you're ready to test that understanding with true-to-life practice questions Pass4success has the study material and practice tools built for exactly this stage of your preparation.      

---

body.body:
> Hello, dear friends at @MoviesTvShows Greetings and blessings. Today I’m here to talk to you about the miniseries *WandaVision*, which I found entertaining and a great way to pass the time. I love everything related to the Marvel universe, and I couldn’t miss this one—especially since it features a heroine-turned-villain who, sadly, chooses the dark path, perhaps because of the nature of her powers or simply because she can’t bear to lose what she once loved. ---
![MV5BZTMxMmM1ODItMTZiMS00NjI1LWEwODctMjQ4ZjY4ODliNDI0XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23vhud7wELV6L38rE26ZE77vajhiE4QaYNQpUrrnCr8Np6AcxcQtPhkgufShApv3cARLX.jpg)
[Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt9140560/mediaviewer/rm1634915585/?ref_=tt_ov_i) ---

> This is Wanda, also known as the Scarlet Witch. While you may know her for her work with the Avengers, after losing Vision, Wanda isn’t doing too well and retreats to a remote place where she begins living in a house, seemingly alone, but that’s not the case—she lives what could be considered a normal life with Vision, which seems impossible. Yet, because of her powers, we know it’s possible—or at least to create an alternate reality where she can fulfill her dreams, which are to have a normal life with Vision and start a family with him. Given her childhood—after losing her only brother—the mental instability she experiences is far from normal. --- ![MV5BNWNmZWJkMjMtZDAxYi00ZGIxLTlmNWEtYWFhZmJlOTEyNWEzXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23zbMpFt3uSUSXx2rRag1DJXRcLpyVvdWHt7oDHWudovvVMNkA1DxVBd358e5wQwANVzp.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt9140560/mediaviewer/rm132371969/) ---

> Wanda certainly did her best to help the Avengers, but her emotions are all over the place, and her powers as a witch don’t exactly help matters. That’s why she starts to lose her grip and create more problems than meets the eye. While creating an alternate reality might not be entirely bad, disrupting the environment and resorting to forbidden magic to bring her beloved back is total chaos, so the lives of many will be caught up in it. The Scarlet Witch is undoubtedly strong and capable of many things, but at the same time, she is a woman who simply seeks to be loved and appreciated, who doesn’t want to be alone, who wants a family, a husband, children—the normal things any woman would want—but for her, none of that is fulfilled with the person she longed for. --- ![MV5BZDE0MWNhYzMtZjhkNi00ODExLWEzMDItNjZkMjRlODE3YmM2XkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23ywoLwBc8s5Yq6eWezMgcCia7Vu8i48WLgJJLzZdRWdgtFNAk6YgNG2TyECkgJsen81H.jpg) [Source](https://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt9140560/mediaviewer/rm3744583937/) ---

> So Wanda's life becomes even more complicated, to the point where her powers spiral out of control, severely affecting her mental and emotional stability. She finds herself at a crossroads where she must decide whether to remain deluded in a world that—in another parallel universe—might or might not be real, or perhaps she must choose to embrace reality, even if it is cruel and not what she wanted—a difficult but necessary decision for her to take a step toward something different, even if that means shattering her illusions or continuing to be deceived by something she no longer has. --- ![MV5BZTZjNTM2ZjAtZDQ0Ny00OGM4LTg3ZjctM2VhMGExZDIxNzliXkEyXkFqcGc@._V1_.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/EoAYrpgbpPonU6mdHyMRnT3oMwKYwrax5w1KJCDWPPrABA2pNiSeRafXHxwUhysjMvo.jpg) [Source](htps://www.imdb.com/es/title/tt9140560/mediaviewer/rm2875511553/) ---

body.title: A Day in My Life Blog: We have a Visitor a Representative from Philippine Coconut Authority for the Distribution of Dwarf Coconut Seedlings for our Cooperative Members Beneficiaries! 😊🤗😇
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>

**Have a Blessed Day to all ASEAN Hivers and all my Fellow Hivers all over the World!**

This blog post of mine today is something special as now that I can already do some of the usual activity that I've attended. I am very thank to God for I can now do much more things after the accident which happened to me. 

Just today, we have a special visitor from Philippine Coconut Authority which they sent a representative to document the distribution of Dwarf Coconut Seedlings for our Cooperative Members. 

This is what I am about to share today on my newest ***\

*** post. But before I proceed with my sharing, this is what I always do. To give thanks to all my supporters, most especially the Admins, all Curators and even to all who keeps on dropping by to comment on my blog post, thank you to all of you. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS5ThN5ZYKFhLZm3wd2ubxYvqPAQJv4Pt7M5QvdqRDTeD/1779531561954.png) A day before this activity happened, our Cooperative Chairperson contacted me about the said distribution of Dwarf Coconut Seedlings, and even though I am not on the list who will receive a seedlings, I need to attend too since I am the Secretary of the Cooperative. It was said first that it will happen by the afternoon but suddenly, the representative from the Philippine Coconut Authority changed it and said she will arrive by 10:00 in the morning. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZhMmBnHAy8f6pU1TRiDfjddDpF2QvNf4kDygw6oSv7sF/1779532389869.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfTmobrVZSm4XrsasZ4eedVfcwsPPgFpkVG5peDsEXdGi/1779532390108.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWdS6vkKmXG5Sx1ZAaTpKPFSNQJ4Q17EMLoQx6NafSzs5/1779532390291.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcTXdpg6pb4HWKVDkpZezTVEHRhYPvEpL5yVbxx11Z57n/1779532390484.jpg) Since the time has changed, I have now then contacted those members of our Cooperative wo will receive the Dwarf Coconut Seedlings, and told them that the schedule is change and need to go to the house of our Chairperson where the seedlings located and be distributed. I arrived around 9:30 in the morning and when I arrived, the representative from the Philippine Coconut Authority had already arriveda and some of the beneficiaries too, that is why we immediately started the process. The representative now started the process she needed to do and since she is the one who knows what is the process, we let her do it and were just here to assist and help here. She first did a evaluation and do some interview for documentation purposes. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSCopKf4iPG8ZZkrDjEZHGBVwp8JTRFz1ZZ2UKpDm27Ht/1779532807310.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPESXohN2mwSyp8cQMqRVdxBcxjk647mPkd4YVEq8pn5J/1779532807519.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPd6bFQ4Q2UcVjcqqByaupH2sm2gxozAotqYZUfVPp5mP/1779532807724.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQNusJz4rLiFnmSCnXMwT9oyeUts15oHhE58sNKsK7AEZ/1779532807914.jpg) After the evaluation and do some interviews to the beneficiaries, it is now time for them to get their allocated Dwarf Coconut Seedlings. It is said that the allocated seedlings will be 143 Seedlings per 1 hectare. Some of our beneficiaries declared 2 hectares that is why they will receive a total of 286 seedlings in total. They have now started to separate snd and count carefully the number of seedlings to be fair. After a while, some other members who are beneficiaries had finally arrived and the process has now been started to them too before they can get their allocated seedlings. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbrCjpwgNUebiUAiCuPKTgp3wFoZ3bAocsokr4EEk8Xb5/1779533119296.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYvTmjG1hzUqcmfcZUa1SrZbwfkcUFqYWhJq2HYkUTWaV/1779533119435.jpg) Some of our Members where not arrived yet but since it is started to rain, we decided to go inside the house of our Chairperson while waiting for the rain to stop. While were here inside, we took this time to have a short meeting since we have one of our Board of Directors, and me too who is also a member of the board with our Chairperson, so we are quorum to have a meeting. We took this time to have a official turn-over of our Certificate of Re-Accreditation which we needed so that we will continue to received any program the Philippine Coconut Authority offers. The other agenda which the representative shared to us is the Scholarship Grant they have for all the members of the Philippine Coconut Authority. She shared to us the requirements and other things we needed to know about this program, so we can share it during our Monthly meeting. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZzwVkaxTfbG24ouVEXtXZ9rQwErCkm62L2kPrCSUXUn3/1779534812183.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWMGnChD3g5of42ha8FGXDxXwc16iMsMAkCCG4ALPXWUE/1779534812321.jpg) ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbMSq2ahEUf2PV4PbqjVQDyE3BQrPeGTNbUyecimBuMqB/1779534812418.jpg) It took us many minutes talking about the program and other important matters and when we looked outside it is still raining, so we can't go back home yet. Since it is already around 12:00 noon and it is time for lunch, our Chairperson offered us to have a lunch here in their house. We didn't hesitate since, it is already time to have lunch and it is still raining outside. After a while, the lunch is already ready and it is now time for lunch. She prepared a lot of foods for us which are very delicious and we thank God for what our Chairperson prepared for us. God will definitely bless her more for what she did today and for providing our lunch with the representative from the Philippine Coconut Authority. After then, it is now time for us to go home. This would be all for today's post, and until next time again, I just want to thank everyone in advance who will drop by on my blog post. **To God be all the Glory!** 😇🙌☝️ **Your Friend** **_@godlovermel25_**

body.title: Social media: A tool in Charity
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTxJ3UYg5A2AbDEWfVF19RQhbaBab3sbwvjzymvDGeGQ2/1779533883542.jpg)

The influence of social media on charity is vast and widespread. Traditionally, people needed to walk about begging for alms that could barely suffice or meet their needs. They were limited to their immediate community, and most times the help they got was small and inconsistent.

Social media has bridged that gap with wider visibility and ease of donation from  a larger audience. A short video clip of a person seeking charity has the potential of gathering hundreds to thousands of people within a few hours who voluntarily donate money to save a cause or aid recovery of the sick. What once took weeks of moving from street to street can now happen online before the day ends with tangible aid. 

**Social media: the middleman between the donor and donee**

Especially in crowdfunding, it gives voice and strength to average humans. You don’t need an NGO or a big platform to be heard anymore. Anybody with a phone and internet can tell their story directly, and it makes giving feel personal. Donors see the face, hear the voice, and know exactly where their money is going and what it’s intended for.

Previously charity involved NGOs who oftentimes split the funds into half to support the person and also the organization for logistics and verification. It meant the beneficiary could get less. Social media eliminates the middleman cost, though it introduces a new challenge: trust and integrity.

Even the marking of cards to raise money for events is on the decline now. When I was little, I used to do that for my interhouse sports day. People would sign on to the card and give money. It usually had numbering from 0-20 or up to 50. That was a form of charity, and oftentimes some people split the money in two — keeping some for themselves and giving some to the game master. It was local, limited, and based on trust within the school even with that it was compromised by some people. 

Now social media amplifies the reach of charity by breaking geographical boundaries. It makes it possible to raise funds within a few hours to a few weeks, depending on the cause, without the need for a physical meeting. The role of Social media on charity makes it speedy, helpful and more efficient. 

Although social media is a harmless tool, people who operate social media often abuse its power. Some people defraud others of their money by lying about needing charity. Some serve lies or disguise themselves to seek help from non-suspecting people to extort money.  

I read about a social media influencer who charged money from a needy person in order to crowdfund financial support for them. This was inhumane. If they had the money in the first place, they would not be seeking crowdfunding support. So why charge them again?  

Albeit, there are also honest influencers who use social media for genuine charity. The same tool that helps can also be abused.
Some people set cameras now while doing charity. 
It could be to show that the people truly receive the charity or to gain public recognition and applause. Whether it's right or wrong depends on individuals preferences and intention . As long as the cause of charity was being done and someone truly received help.

That is why social media in itself is a tool but not an end to means. It encourages voluntary donations which people find easy to do out of their goodwill and freewill. The influence of social media on charity is providing wider interactions between different people to offer help.

As such it is necessary to verify any requests for charity on social media before funding to ensure authenticity and reduce fraud and blackmail while getting help to the people who truly needs it. 

Image is mine.

body.title: Deaths Game K - Contest #47 Culture #15 / 죽음의 게임 K - 대회 #47 문화 #15
body.body:
>This is my latest Korean drama obsession, and the latest k series that i have watched, and this point id say im fully immersed in Korean series and also I think at this point, I am fully down the K drama rabbit hole! I absolutely binge watched it yesterday night and honestly, it was amazing. At one point, I was literally on the verge of tears because it hits so incredibly hard. It hit like another Korean series i watched called “tomorrow”. I cried my eyes out watching it, i cried almost every episode but that will be another topic for discussion some other week. This is about Deaths game and I really loved watching it, and I had to come on here to rant about it because I just can’t keep quiet. If you haven’t seen it yet, you are seriously missing out on a masterpiece.
So the whole concept of this show is wild, but in a very unique and emotional way. The story follows a guy called Choi Yee jae, a guy who is completely down on his life after struggling to find a job for years, losing his savings, and experiencing a massive heartbreak. In a moment of absolute despair, he decides to end his life, but instead of everything just fading to black, he wakes up in a mysterious dark realm and encounters an entity known simply as Death. Death is insulted by his casual attitude toward dying, so as a punishment, she forces him to play a game, the game is he has to experience death 12 more times through 12 different bodies. Hence the name of the show “Deaths game”
The show kicks off from the very first episode and i love series that kick off from the first episode, no need for 5 episodes building up what the series is all about. Without giving up much spoilers the protagonist is thrown into the bodies of people who are just minutes away from dying, some are in a crashing private jet, some are secret agents, high schoolers facing severe bullying and all that. The catch is, if he can figure out a way to survive the imminent death waiting for that specific body, he gets to live out the rest of that person's life. He goes from being someone who threw his life away to someone desperately fighting for every single second of survival and that is the plot of the series, without me giving away too much.
With this series you get this brilliant puzzle where pieces of information are handed to you bit by bit. There are hidden truths and unexpected twists that keep you guessing. Just when you think you understand the pattern, same as the protagonist , the show throws a curveball that changes everything.
I also have to talk about the acting and the cast in this series, because choi keeps switching bodies, different top tier actors step in to play him in almost every episode, and they all do an incredible job mirroring his original personality while dealing with their own unique struggles. This is definitely a must watch show.

[https://ecency.com/hive-123450/@veryhappyday/korean-hive-village-contest-47?referral=zubygeee](https://ecency.com/hive-123450/@veryhappyday/korean-hive-village-contest-47?referral=zubygeee)

/>\n\n이것은 제가 최근에 빠져든 한국 드라마이고, 제가 본 최신 K 시리즈입니다. 지금 이 시점에서 저는 한국 시리즈에 완전히 몰입했다고 말할 수 있고, 이 시점에서 저는 K 드라마의 깊은 구렁텅이에 완전히 빠져들었다고 생각합니다! 어젯밤에 정말 몰아서 봤는데, 솔직히 말해서 정말 대단했어요. 어느 순간, 정말 눈물이 날 뻔했어요. 너무 강하게 와닿아서요. 또 다른 한국 시리즈인 \

처럼 강하게 다가왔어요. 눈물을 흘리며 봤어요, 거의 매 에피소드마다 울었는데 그건 다른 주제로 나중에 이야기할 거예요. 이건 'Death's Game'에 관한 이야기인데, 정말로 재미있게 봤어요. 그래서 여기 와서 불평을 해야겠다고 생각했어요, 왜냐하면 그냥 가만히 있을 수가 없거든요. 아직 보지 않았다면, 정말 걸작을 놓치고 있는 거예요.  \n그래서 이 쇼의 전체 개념은 정말 독특하고 감정적으로 매우 특별한 방식으로 미쳤어요. 이 이야기는 최이재라는 남자를 따라갑니다. 그는 몇 년 동안 직장을 찾기 위해 고군분투하고, 저축을 잃고, 큰 상처를 경험한 후 인생에 완전히 낙담한 남자입니다. 절망의 순간에 그는 자신의 목숨을 끊기로 결심하지만, 모든 것이 검은색으로 사라지는 대신, 그는 신비로운 어두운 영역에서 깨어나 단순히 죽음으로 알려진 존재를 만난다. 죽음은 그가 죽음을 가볍게 여기는 태도에 모욕을 느끼고, 벌로서 그에게 게임을 강요합니다. 그 게임은 그가 12개의 다른 몸을 통해 12번 더 죽음을 경험해야 한다는 것입니다. 그래서 이 쇼의 이름이 \

입니다.  
쇼는 첫 번째 에피소드부터 시작하고, 저는 첫 번째 에피소드부터 시작하는 시리즈를 좋아해요. 시리즈가 무엇인지 5개의 에피소드를 통해 쌓아올릴 필요가 없거든요. 많은 스포일러를 주지 않고 말하자면, 주인공은 죽기 직전의 사람들의 몸에 들어가게 됩니다. 어떤 사람들은 추락하는 개인 비행기에 타고 있고, 어떤 사람들은 비밀 요원이며, 어떤 사람들은 심한 괴롭힘을 당하는 고등학생 등입니다. 문제는, 만약 그가 그 특정한 몸이 기다리고 있는 임박한 죽음을 피할 방법을 찾아낸다면, 그 사람의 남은 생을 살 수 있다는 것입니다. 그는 자신의 삶을 포기한 사람에서 생존을 위해 필사적으로 싸우는 사람으로 변모하며, 그것이 이 시리즈의 줄거리입니다. 너무 많은 것을 말하지 않고도요.  
이 시리즈에서는 정보를 조금씩 제공받으며 이 훌륭한 퍼즐을 맞추게 됩니다. 숨겨진 진실과 예상치 못한 반전이 있어 계속 추측하게 만듭니다. 주인공처럼 패턴을 이해했다고 생각할 때쯤, 쇼는 모든 것을 바꾸는 예기치 않은 반전을 던집니다.  
이 시리즈의 연기와 캐스트에 대해서도 이야기해야 합니다. 최가 계속 몸을 바꾸기 때문에, 거의 매 에피소드마다 다른 최고 배우들이 그를 연기하게 되는데, 그들은 각자 고유한 고난을 겪으면서도 그의 원래 성격을 훌륭하게 재현해냅니다. 이건 정말 꼭 봐야 할 쇼입니다.

Just looking at the NFS Heat PS4 screen gives you a whole different racing feel. The glowing streets at night neon lights and high speed cars make the game absolutely incredible. Every race feels like you've stepped into the real world of street racing.

The most special thing about this game is its open world city which has a different vibe for both day and night. Legal races during the day and dangerous street racing at night make the game even more exciting. And the scene where the cops start chasing you just cranks the adrenaline up even more.

The graphics of NFS Heat on PS4 look really beautiful. The car lights reflections on wet streets after rain and the city atmosphere make the screen feel cinematic. Each car adds even more fun with its own unique style and power.

If you like high speed racing drifting, and customized sports cars, then NFS Heat is a great game. It doesn’t just feel like a racing game it feels like a complete street racing experience.

body.title: ¿Cómo superar la frustración y el bloqueo mental?
body.body:
![](https://entrenalavida1.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/img_20251018_181647.jpg?w=970)

Todos, absolutamente todos, hemos enfrentado esos momentos de frustración y bloqueo mental que nos hacen querer dejar el entrenamiento una vez y por todas.

Pero, ¡ojo!, rendirse no es una opción. **Hoy te comparto mis estrategias personales para superar esos baches y seguir avanzando hacia tus metas .**

**La Cruda Realidad:** El Bloqueo Mental es parte del juego. Seamos sinceros, el camino del fitness no es un lecho de rosas. Hay días en que te sientes invencible y otros en que levantar una mancuerna de 5 libras se convierte en una tarea titánica. 😫 Esos momentos de frustración son como pequeños duendes que intentan sabotear tus esfuerzos. Te susurran al oído: ‘No puedes’, ‘No lo lograrás’, ‘Es demasiado difícil’. ¡Pero no les hagas caso!

**Mis Estrategias Anti-Bloqueo (Probadas y Comprobadas)**

Después de años de tropezones y levantadas, he desarrollado un arsenal de trucos para combatir la frustración y el bloqueo mental. ¡Aquí te los revelo!

_**1\. Reconoce y Acepta tus Sentimientos:**_ El primer paso es admitir que te sientes frustrado. No te castigues por ello. Permítete sentir esa emoción, analízala y luego déjala ir. ¡Como si fuera un globo que se eleva hacia el cielo! 🎈

_**2\. Cambia el Chip:**_ Si estás atascado en un ejercicio, prueba algo diferente. Cambia de rutina, prueba una nueva clase, sal a correr al aire libre. ¡Sacude tu cuerpo y tu mente para romper el patrón! 🔄

**_3\. Divide y Conquista:_** Si te sientes abrumado por un objetivo grande, divídelo en pequeñas metas alcanzables. ¡Celebrar cada pequeño logro te dará la motivación para seguir adelante! 🎉

**_4\. Visualiza el Éxito:_** Cierra los ojos e imagínate logrando tu objetivo. Siente la emoción, la satisfacción, el orgullo. ¡Esta técnica te ayudará a reprogramar tu mente y a recuperar la confianza! ✨

**_5\. Busca Inspiración:_** Lee un libro motivador, escucha un podcast inspirador, mira un video de alguien que admire. ¡Rodéate de energía positiva y recarga tus baterías! 🔋

**_6\. Habla con Alguien:_** Comparte tus sentimientos con un amigo, un familiar, tu entrenador o un terapeuta. ¡A veces, solo necesitas desahogarte para ver las cosas con claridad! 🗣️

**_7\. Date un Respiro:_** Si todo lo demás falla, tómate un día libre. ¡Descansa, relájate, haz algo que te guste! A veces, lo mejor que puedes hacer es alejarte del problema para volver con una nueva perspectiva. 🧘‍♀️

**_8\. Aprende de tus Fracasos:_** No veas los errores como algo negativo, sino como oportunidades para aprender y crecer. ¡Analiza qué salió mal, ajusta tu estrategia y vuelve a intentarlo con más fuerza! 💪

**_9\. El Humor como Aliado:_** Reírse de uno mismo y de las situaciones difíciles es una excelente forma de liberar tensión y cambiar la perspectiva. ¡No te tomes la vida demasiado en serio! 😂

Resiliencia: La Clave para Triunfar a Largo Plazo.

La resiliencia es la capacidad de superar la adversidad y salir fortalecido. Es como tener un resorte interno que te impulsa a levantarte cada vez que te caes. ¡Y tú, mi querido lector, tienes ese resorte! Solo necesitas activarlo.

La frustración y el bloqueo mental son inevitables en el camino del fitness, pero no tienen por qué detenerte. ¡Utiliza estas estrategias para superarlos, cultiva tu resiliencia y sigue avanzando hacia tus metas con determinación y alegría! Recuerda que el muro solo está en tu mente. ¡Tú tienes el poder de derribarlo! 💥

Con ustedes hoy, Emy ☺️

---
*Originally published on [entrenalavida1.wordpress.com](https://entrenalavida1.wordpress.com/2025/10/27/como-superar-la-frustracion-y-el-bloqueo-mental/) on October 27, 2025*

body.title: Was it a \
ending?
body.body:
This post may contain spoilers. If you haven't seen the series, skip this post. https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/1mQcvviF1HLkoEZwCJfA9tdsD2S.jpg
[Source ](https://www.themoviedb.org/tv/76479-the-boys/images/backdrops)
Edited in Photoshop & Canva App
https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jcrodriguez/245cUBXzvWF8QVukk8UvqTFX6FutvCzv1TyGDA8ybnR5QKA1v6nMvGS4j6y81Qg9M2HLn.jpg
Well, The Boys series has ended, but not its universe; they'll keep releasing spin-offs, of that we can be sure. The series was a success, although its finale seems to have received a barrage of criticism. As is often the case with many productions, endings and definitive conclusions of a story generate debate, and many didn't like it. I think the ending adapted well to the comic's conclusion. That is, important things happened, like the death of the main villain and, of course, the death of the protagonist who, in the comic, loses his mind and wants to destroy everyone. Perhaps that madness is more readily perceived in the comic, and in the series it didn't quite move me. I don't think the problem is the ending itself. It's that the series felt somewhat exhausted since the previous season. In my case, I no longer watched it with as much enthusiasm, and what once seemed innovative didn't seem the same to me now. The jokes and the sexual or scatological humor no longer amused me as much. Perhaps that's one of the problems with the series in general, but there's another issue that, for me, is what ultimately became tedious. I think it was around the third season when the show's creators, infected by their anti-Trump obsession, turned the program into a form of anti-Trump propaganda. The similarities between Homelander and their view of Trump were already too obvious. And this isn't unique to this series; for example, the new Daredevil series also uses current political events in the United States to create an anti-Trump pamphlet. Okay, as a series creator, you can have your left-leaning political ideologies, but if you completely distort a character like Homelander, turning him into a reflection of how you want your country's citizens to perceive their president, you completely affect the story and you're going to make mistakes, which, in my opinion, is what happened and why so many people are bothered by the ending. I mean, it's not a bad ending, it's how they deceived us and what they changed for their propaganda. Anyway, this won't stop them from continuing to exploit The Boys universe. I don't know if the Generation V spin-off will get a third season. I watched the second season out of inertia; it's another series that started well, but its impactful scenes lost their impact. By the way, these guys appear in this season of The Boys, but they don't contribute anything. Why on earth do they include these spin-off characters if what they do isn't important? Sage's ending also seemed incredibly pathetic to me. She goes from being the smartest person in the world—though I found it hard to believe, I couldn't stand that character—to the dumbest one. Is she in her bunker picking her nose? I don't know, and I don't care. A character who shouldn't have existed in the series. I finished the series and felt nothing. It left me quite indifferent. It wasn't like with other series that leave me with a hangover or even a bad taste in my mouth when they end. Anyway, as I said, the universe will continue; they've already released a trailer for a spin-off set in the past, like a prequel, when Soldier Boy was the toughest. I'll watch it to pass the time, but if they also turn it into anti-Trump propaganda, they're going to completely ruin it. I didn't think it was a bad ending; I just question some decisions, but those were already a consequence of problems from previous seasons. What did you think? Good or bad? ---- > Bueno, la serie The Boys ha terminado, pero no su universo; seguirán lanzando spin-offs, de eso podemos estar seguros. La serie fue un éxito, aunque su final parece haber recibido una avalancha de críticas. Como suele ocurrir con muchas producciones, los finales y las conclusiones definitivas de una historia generan debate, y a muchos no les gustó. > Creo que el final se adaptó bien al final del cómic. Es decir, ocurrieron cosas importantes, como la muerte del principal villano y, por supuesto, la muerte del protagonista que, en el cómic, pierde la cabeza y quiere destruir a todos. Quizás esa locura se percibe mejor en el cómic, y en la serie no me conmovió del todo. > No creo que el problema sea el final en sí. Es que la serie se sentía algo agotada desde la temporada anterior. En mi caso, ya no la veía con tanto entusiasmo, ni lo que antes me parecía innovador me parecía igual ahora. Los chistes y las cosas sexuales o escatológicas ya no me divertían tanto. Quizás ahí radica uno de los problemas de la serie en general, pero hay otro que, para mí, es lo que finalmente se volvió tedioso. > Creo que fue más o menos después de la tercera temporada cuando los creadores de la serie, contagiados por su obsesión anti-Trump, convirtieron el programa en una forma de propaganda anti-Trump. Las similitudes entre Homelander y su visión de Trump ya eran demasiado obvias. Y esto no es algo exclusivo de esta serie; por ejemplo, la nueva serie de Daredevil también utiliza eventos políticos actuales en Estados Unidos para crear un panfleto anti-Trump. > Está bien, como creador de una serie puedes tener tus ideologías políticas de izquierda, pero si distorsionas por completo a un personaje como Homelander, convirtiéndolo en un reflejo de cómo quieres que los ciudadanos de tu país perciban a tu presidente, afectas totalmente la historia y vas a cometer errores, que, en mi opinión, es lo que sucedió y por lo que a tanta gente le molesta el final. O sea, no es un mal final, es cómo nos engañaron y qué cambiaron por su propaganda. > En fin, esto no les impedirá seguir explotando el universo de The Boys. El spin-off de la Generación V, no sé si tendrá una tercera temporada. Vi la segunda temporada por inercia; es otra serie que empezó bien, pero sus escenas impactantes dejaron de serlo. Por cierto, estos tipos aparecen en esta temporada de The Boys, pero no aportan nada. ¿Por qué demonios incluyen a estos personajes del spin-off si lo que hacen no es importante? > El final de Sage también me pareció increíblemente patético. Deja de ser la persona más inteligente del mundo, aunque me costó creerlo, no soportaba a ese personaje, y terminan convirtiéndola en la más tonta. ¿Está en su búnker hurgándose la nariz? No lo sé y me da igual. Un personaje que no debería haber existido en la serie. > Terminé la serie y no sentí nada. Me dejó bastante indiferente. No me pasó como con otras series, que me dejan con resaca e incluso con un mal sabor de boca cuando terminan. En fin, como ya dije, el universo continuará; ya lanzaron un tráiler de un spin-off ambientado en el pasado, como una precuela, cuando Soldier Boy era el más rudo. Lo veré para pasar el rato, pero si además lo convierten en propaganda anti-Trump, lo van a arruinar por completo. > No me pareció un mal final; simplemente cuestiono algunas decisiones, pero esas ya eran consecuencia de problemas de temporadas anteriores. ¿Qué te pareció? ¿Bueno o malo?

body.body:
Hello guys....

How are you all? I hope you are all well because I am too. Meet me again, I will tell you about my journey that I have done. Exciting and interesting activities and trips are waiting for me to tell you.

This time, I'm going to tell you about learning to draw at a drawing course. It's called Ichi Art Tuition. This is the most famous drawing course in Medan because they teach various drawing techniques, such as digital drawing and drawing using pencil and paper. They also offer classes for all ages, which is why I was able to learn there.

Studying here is very comfortable, comfortable atmosphere, comfortable study room, good and expert teachers. They are able to teach clearly and easily understood.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-21 at 05.51.33.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/23xKxKNGrZrV7bH2rcyrmQrGdbFsu1x46Uz1qNUY6rbszyuWCGtGo4FSrvTsuBBWvcbY2.jpeg)


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-21 at 05.51.34.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/23wqw2ZpdAVRXGb3Q2KkjMAKE4Rh3DPphVXuaBJ7VRXkGeg1fc7PCxP4Qh6tStFLwgbEY.jpeg)

Here I'm taking a class to learn how to draw anime. Drawing anime isn't something new to me. I've drawn quite often, but this is the first time I've learned from a teacher like this. I really enjoy drawing, and my dream is to become an artist who can draw many things. So, from now on, I'll learn slowly to make that dream come true.

Here, I was taught the basics of drawing people, starting with how to draw the head, face, and body parts. The learning time was actually very short, only one hour per session, and it was taught in stages.

Not only drawing the front face but also the face from the side, the face from below. All are taught so that the face does not look odd. Also taught how to make the eyes look even between the right and left, draw the nose so that it fits in the middle, also draw the lips.

After being able to draw the head and face, next you will be taught how to draw hair, long hair and short hair. How to make the neck.

Then I was also taught how to make hands and fingers. And I think drawing fingers is the most difficult thing, but my teacher made it very easy to draw, he also taught it in a way that was easy and easy to follow.


![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-21 at 20.02.41.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/Eokexz2a7KKKGScgV5GgCR3YUarkRX3fFg81uEChSaEDUcDQ77GjM4xQD7MtLhQGzd4.jpeg)

![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-21 at 20.02.42.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sweetest/EogQHgwCa7bsXHFisRCXvygwDNZ4M9XXXa4J2Kjz1FNrJEa8wYBC2VpnpFH7rN4zuQz.jpeg)

After learning how to draw, I was asked to draw a face of a person, and I chose to draw one of the characters from the anime Jujutsu Kaisen. It's not really similar, but I tried my best haha.

From my time studying here, there is one word that I really remember from my teacher, that is, he said that I am good at drawing by imitating, haha ​​and I answered yes usually I can only imitate, my imagination in drawing is very lacking and bad. that's why I asked for some tips on how to find imagination and inspiration. he suggested to look at a lot of pictures drawn by other people, and practice often. thank you to my teacher who has taught me, I will study harder.

Thank you for reading my story this time, see you in my other stories, bye~

body.title: Above all shocks
body.body:
Post trauma is the condition of mental health which is usually caused by traumatic events. Maybe accident, death of loved ones, kidnapping or any related incident. 


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVriyeENxhdV4t11xUyS2dh8WEJ4WFvaRe5L3Qi9QpCgo/1779535392207.jpg)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/sorrow-grief-mourn-sad-funeral-4900424/)

I believe that in one way or the other people face this situation often because life is full of ups and downs. Most times there is little or nothing that one can do about it. It is also noted that we as humans react to problems differently. What may cause shock for Mr. A, may be a normal thing for Mr. B. And that is the very reason why we react differently to things. 

I have noticed that things that frighten others don't really make me afraid. I have lived with it for years even when we lost someone very close to us it doesn't really get to me  so that it will make me begin to react negatively when I remember it. But I was shocked to know that it is hidden somewhere in me when I lost someone recently and I never believed what happened after. I had this friend and brother too in my church, I was too close to this fellow that I relate to him as my own brother. He also related to me that way and that made us bound very well.

THE UNEXPECTED HAPPENED LAST YEAR.

We usually hold a meeting at the beginning of every year to pray for the whole year. So, last year we came for the meeting which took place for four days. After that we all went back to our parishes because it was a diocesan program. Because I was too busy I never had enough time for our usual pleasantries with this brother and we all left with no good bye too because I had to attend to something in my place so I left before him. Just two days after the program I had that this brother was knocked down by a hit and run driver and he died at a spot. When I heard of it, I refused to believe it and went on to call his number and it was switched off already. I tried it all through the day and it was still switched off. The following day I traveled to his place only to discover that his burial has been fixed already because of the way he died. He was burial the following day and that was how I lost a dear brother and friend without a good bye.

POST TRAUMA FOR ME

From that day that I visited his house I started dreaming of him everyday. I started getting afraid of seeing him even in the physical. Sometimes when I am walking on the road, I feel as if I am hearing his voice and when I turn I won't see anyone. This continued for months before it stopped and that was when I know what post trauma is. Is not easy to come out of one especially if is something you experienced first hand. The shock will keep coming and most times it comes with fear that tries to overcome us.

 But that God because when I noticed what was beginning to happen to me, I started praying for myself. I also related the issue to some of my friends who also prayed for me and gave me words of advice on how to overcome it. Today is gone because I followed their advice

body.title: A visit to the lake...
body.body:
...as we wanted to see if the lake has filled up after recent storms.
![003.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23uQto8Bzbw6fAzxYf8EiLYEHGGkVabEkCQx4RJ3dgGP69iGfGbrWsuS9Dw9nMfKZi1Yx.jpg)

This is what it looked like during our last visit that I posted. But by now all of the flamingos were gone, as they migrate every winter here to the warmer countries up north on the African Continent. They will return during the late spring season next year, as they breed here. Then their youngsters grow up during our summer season to be strong enough for the migration trip the next winter.

We were happy to see that the lake is full again, and even more water will be added to sustain it now during our winter, as we are in a winter rainfall area. So, today you will see no flamingos, and none of the other migratory birds, as we had to search for any local birds that we may find. There was no water to be seen here during our last visit, as we could walk in the area where the water is now. 
Fortunally we found a few local birds that I will show you in here. 

![003.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqquufEA6JDnEj4KPBsu2LsbEZTrEa12Vj64XNDGwWecZ1APF29byXRZAUGf2BiHfdZ.JPG)

![006.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eqqtpdf6ud86L9Jg9ihB6BB8bCawWzevXLYsjet7u7CDuKUnC6htf3H1uUBwnkGxySu.JPG)

No birds, not even one could be seen, and during summer there are thousands of birds all over here.
![008.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqquSSsc6MGRiXRVveYSLYtfm7JREuQKSKfLrwdbJmZUAp24jdCH51X8AWoRcy7xKmk.JPG)

**But what was this?**

I saw the dive and knew that I was too close, so I stepped back to wait for the bird to emerge.
![009.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23uFYCuDUw3mUQD7hw7psfuz6GpL9aR8fXGdZB3jUZUgdKuJ1saCNZVxEKt9S1Ls12ubC.JPG)

Ah! It was a Red-knobbed Coot (Fulica cristata).
![010.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoChDc29LBmX1rZ2F5TXHQaEYYp9BJQCwMeoER22ZpnzwJ3h9k8yKjVWS3Rire4maf3.JPG)

And now for a scoop, as look what I got below.
![021.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23z7DdDq5fpx1FKbve3odbQDChev1bPXgQGxS3rGcrLuQVwEEVDTHtUV9GB6yH9BVgtKE.JPG)

A lovely Swan couple, and it might be Black Swans (Cygnus atratus), but with the sun in my eyes I could not be certain as to the species.
![027.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqL7GkvMWNUtv8NUNXamroYb4UeV1z8Sdk5BLL2dDbbQRAD5hkXyMJR11ifFWF3UWNu.JPG)

I know that they can be found in Australia, and someone might have brought them in, or they escaped from somewhere.
![025.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eos2DdA3m2DNrUjvyRDJJFtdi5ja5zvdqWnLfapRqMqNyfkbVGru9dH8fQoQKdtTifR.JPG)

Finally, I close with some attacking coots on a run in the lake.
![034.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eo4DyU55ZxAHfRFL3UW299yAxuKHhx1EuYU7u2xNmaBcfGwu39Ea9X8i9ii1ZpTcmCC.JPG)

We love our visits to this lake, as it has taught us so much about nature and the seasons. As much as the birds are dependent on the water, so we as human beings are also dependent on water. Only difference is that we cannot run on the water like the coots do :) Only joking, but yes, it is said that water is life, and here is evidence of it. The coots are tough little birds, and they fiercely protect their territories. If a strange coot appears, then they chase it by running after it on the water.

As far as the swans are concerned, we don't know them, but they are here, and so we will have to do some research to see what we can find. I should have done the research first before I did this post, but my excuse is that I am old and have a foggy brain, so don't ask me quickly what my name is :) In any case, I am sure that we will visit the lake again, and then when I do the post, I will have the information if I don't forget. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera. 

Thank you kindly for supporting this post.

body.title: Kemény Castle (Conacul Kemény din Ciumbrud) | Let's travel together #357
body.body:
![357.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/243g79HmA1fMwHd6rrgTszfh6w6xZc2N93ZtVHvGT8CVUq15CxneE2zKoQGWwa4qk8KuA.png)

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23uQr4a36zPSdFCTVYhj3EGsYzS8ry4WRST4m7QgsmJ7AXN1Vw64ScGEpEZSk9f6wz3v3.png)

After almost 3 years since I mostly written from memories and past trips I enjoyed but whose pictures remained in folders for a long while now, I can happily say that life is finally getting back on track, with more occassional journeys that I've been missing so badly and which I couldn't see coming so soon, but which surely are going to remind me how my journey on here started, namely as a storyteller about places less known, but equally with the hope of promoting Romania more.

Hence, along with crazy weather conditions and a bit of confusion created by Google Maps when following my GPS, I managed to have the last Saturday conclude with no less than 4 discoveries during a long drive in the Alba County, each of these stops deserving a full blog article written with this purpose.

![Photo_1779022955886.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xKp7iu4wCr4DWLmSc6CQrjwaGVJ5WziH7FUb97MGk9Yw8ycJdeyJzb2WTCwwR2WZ3Md.jpg)

The first stop of the day was determined by the **Kemény Castle** in Ciumbrud, where the same name is more popular for another castle in Romania, but located in a whole different region, which, with a bit of attention when setting up the destination on GPS, you will reach it.

This is actually more like a mansion than a castle, but which most likely gained its new label based on the passage of years and how it slowly turns into ruins being claimed by nature, so a more appropriate name for it would be **Conacul Kemény** rather than **Castelul Kemény** in Romanian, or **Kemény Mansion** rather than **Kemény Castle** in English.

![Photo_1779022953064.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23yTak2AEMFQTqmoetzrE9Rq2MJMCkof1fJ4AX5cc6B6uSF4KsbpaL2GFRHrkjssxmv8T.jpg)

Reaching it seemed at first more like a trap, since the GPS announced our arrival in front of a school rather than a castle/mansion. So what we did was to drive a few meters further until we managed to park the car next to a stadium, then start walking on foot with the desire to explore more of the area where our GPS route ended.

Obviously, we ended up in the same place, which was in front of a school, but whose gates were widely open, so we could made our way in. And now looking back, I am really happy we entered the area because right on the left of the school, there was another gate that we followed, and that's how we ended up in front of our so chased destination.

Sadly, the view wasn't the most welcoming, with most of the buildings looking in a bad shape, the single exception being made by 2 or 3 houses of the locals placed on the right. I remember seeing some sort of a bar on the left of the mansion with a lot of curious people, but definitely not the friendliest faces one can meet.

We even greeted one of them since he was looking quite insistently, but didn't really receive a response back, which was fine since neither my boyfriend nor I didn't necessarily looked to make new friends but rather discover a genuine part of history represented by the **Kemény Castle.**

![Photo_1779022961245.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xAW4m26tuFesX97DcXGV1vDYrKez2rLvxftVaVT3EgWaRAkq4a9BAAR3aH9LRBZz2CR.jpg)

![Photo_1779023029025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23tGyGj7LHnQT4BNEU2VwRuSU9McxDAzDvp4C4NhX7GGRo8cPRw6w1qofR23C3R5DJ7eK.jpg)

![Photo_1779022958298.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23yJ9m2hjV28GiGCvEEatjCd3i6HyZ7Qj7FjwxCnFg3sqbv7SgZhpnmhPfimsgDFmVeGw.jpg)

As we approached, we were welcomed by a lot of dust, broken windows, but most importantly, a padlock attached to the front door. 

When I did my research before starting the small trip, I've seen a few pictures shared from the inside of the building in some articles written for the local news, but based on the surroundings and definitely not being a popular destination people decide to visit while in Romania, it made sense to keep everything locked with the hope to protect the building from even more damaging that could be caused by thieves or homeless people.

|<center>[![Photo_1779023026278.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23uFMUa4kN4sayR1Mezwo5T3ZTgqdC73chSz2eyZHzCqPgEwkJQFgGXvL6wE3UqHXyajX.jpg)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23uFMUa4kN4sayR1Mezwo5T3ZTgqdC73chSz2eyZHzCqPgEwkJQFgGXvL6wE3UqHXyajX.jpg)</center>|<center>[![Photo_1779022963600.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23vhWHhZiLfktNPRULQwcmp5TrsNH6xb8EwccdDawSMvUQp79kUyTg98qovMLeTpoj4d3.jpg)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23vhWHhZiLfktNPRULQwcmp5TrsNH6xb8EwccdDawSMvUQp79kUyTg98qovMLeTpoj4d3.jpg)</center></center>
| ------------- |------------- |

Though, for the sake of calming my curiosity to see what it looks like on the inside, I managed to snap a picture through one of the broken windows, which I'd lie by saying that it didn't give some shivers going down the spine as for some reason I always expect to see a face looking at me or a random guy doing a 'peek-a-boo' action. I guess I watched too many movies, lol.

But joke aside, I think there are lots of interesting furniture objects that could represent something and tell a better story than one can create only by checking the place from the outside.

![Photo_1779023080707.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/2432NMCq7cVHwbo2wZxkGHsAeL3BVg9Fk7LXmEPwWHKPYVX8fEVSRvVbckjfShrRT78ev.jpg)

![Photo_1779023078664.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xKvAanuaF3tKuDer4M2owKvUWd8kuK5VaoPUoLyL1Fk4hD2N76mUZyims9TBZcotTqe.jpg)

![Photo_1779023076420.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/244eCHevJnDRkbKC9Y6HbmiBfbBVEq6DraKEPYGL5DNsGnb5usKpaW5L2pcX4YwrRqEbJ.jpg)

The story of the castle begins more than two centuries ago, dating since 1805 when it was raised by the Árpád Kemény Baron, whose name was also used for his mansion. 

The baron used to live here until the World War I, where as soon as the war ended he sold both his mansion and the park located nearby to a collegium that promised to have big plans in this region, which was to form the Hungarian farmers from Transylvania. As plans don't always go as intended, forming the Hungarier farmers happened but with the help of a different school that also offers the access to the castle these days, there being rumours that some of their equipment is still placed inside the building, and that's why it is currently closed.

Sadly, despite seeming like life had plans with this mansion, recently it turned out to be left unused for many years in a row which also caused it to be more and more damaged from one year to another. I did find an article written for some local news stating that both the building and the park will be renovated so they will be more welcoming with the tourists that are fewer with each passing year, but since a couple of years had already passed from that article, I am assuming that the plan was abandoned along the way and there are rare chances to see it anytime renovated soon.

![Photo_1779022993287.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xKrQAf3pwJtpCys5nnRJBsAnYL3x56or4Jt5Vb6bQtNC4ZU6cwTucDxHrzxPUC9c5zX.jpg)

|<center>[![Photo_1779023038357.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/245T1Wptv8YBwyguLg5aDGBjVPJ1meJKoNWHe2FLpwfUYXq1Zz6LtEDenUeVFQeWQfNcM.jpg)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/245T1Wptv8YBwyguLg5aDGBjVPJ1meJKoNWHe2FLpwfUYXq1Zz6LtEDenUeVFQeWQfNcM.jpg)</center>|<center>[![Photo_1779023032172.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xAKJ3cSEB7Ynu1BWQq9V3YzpeGU5bXicmnyF7Umkp1cGuhBFoQGYzKmR5CSf1GsVFVt.jpg)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xAKJ3cSEB7Ynu1BWQq9V3YzpeGU5bXicmnyF7Umkp1cGuhBFoQGYzKmR5CSf1GsVFVt.jpg)</center></center>|<center>[![Photo_1779023035323.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/244e5n9iGwmS4z4gbmdHu7ZufXg1EbDoqiipZoUnwtDB5VaWs4W3Z1MCmQRGhL2kgJWZd.jpg)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/244e5n9iGwmS4z4gbmdHu7ZufXg1EbDoqiipZoUnwtDB5VaWs4W3Z1MCmQRGhL2kgJWZd.jpg)</center></center>
| ------------- |------------- |------------- |

|<center>[![Photo_1779022998145.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xp2258z1r4CLf5cBuF9dibKq8ok8oERBEAvVnWgnvuXgkd2Vs68DgeDaqzjcNf5si4x.jpg)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23xp2258z1r4CLf5cBuF9dibKq8ok8oERBEAvVnWgnvuXgkd2Vs68DgeDaqzjcNf5si4x.jpg)</center>|<center>[![Photo_1779023000780.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23vhrzLREJufFHdzzZ9kNUYQ98j8QRuuqdQHHZSWjwzCtEeTrTSmZAzrgqA52cyh19v6C.jpg)](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23vhrzLREJufFHdzzZ9kNUYQ98j8QRuuqdQHHZSWjwzCtEeTrTSmZAzrgqA52cyh19v6C.jpg)</center></center>
| ------------- |------------- |

The park, however, seemed to be in a better shape, with fresh cut grass and two curious cats that looked very happy to see people passing by. 

We did not venture too much in exploring it since we wanted to see some other places for the rest of the day, but after checking the map more closely, we came to the conclusion that this is somehow linked to the Botanical Garden from Ciumbrud, which can be accessed from a different direction.

Either way, a thing that I think is worth to be mentioned, is that neither in this case did the people stay away from disappointing by polluting the surroundings by throwing away a lot of garbage even in the courtyard of the castle, which was really hard to see. After my [latest post](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@gabrielatravels/the-famous-living-stones-of-romania-or-lets-travel-together-356), I thought that I would stop sharing only the good parts of exploring a place but share the reality frankly, even if it's about my country, and it always hurts twice to run into places like this.

But along with the situation caused by the local people, who obviously are guilty, I think the town hall shares the same level of guilt for both not taking measures against the people who are causing all this pollution, as well as not organising activities to keep the place at least clean, if not being renovated as well.

---

The easiest way to reach **Kemény Castle** is by simply typing on GPS \

which will make the difference between reaching this mansion and the other castle with the same name but located in a whole different part of Romania, but for some even clearer indications, we reached it by driving on the **A1** highway for most of the part, then head on the European roads **E68/E81** for a few more minutes, passing through Aiud before entering Ciumbrud.

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23uQr4a36zPSdFCTVYhj3EGsYzS8ry4WRST4m7QgsmJ7AXN1Vw64ScGEpEZSk9f6wz3v3.png)

who started this community from the passion of attending various festivals and with the purpose of encouraging more people to explore festivals all around the world and share their experiences. 
At the same time, **Gabriela** is an independent Graphic Design Freelancer since 2019 completing over 600+ orders in this time and collaborating with various businesses and people from all over the globe. 
Additionally, **Gabriela** has her own corner on the internet since 2017 where she writes various articles for her blog, the most popular being the travel ones (350+ articles written on this field), but also approaching other topics as well, like game and book reviews, lets plays, movie and series reviews, photography posts, cooking recipes and more, boosting the total number of articles written to 850+ blog posts.
**Gabriela** is also a gamer since she was 11 years old and gaming remains one of her biggest passions along with traveling, owning a YouTube channel for each of the two.</sup>

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: May 23 2026
body.body: <center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g00c93ede4630ccfc4d7c5394fa5de29ea6845e64200817b2b10819225916884ba8adc5586a4ac5f7167b3eb9fa78ae302248e1dc9a39eaac4466d0b74fff8c55_640.jpg)</center>Hoy, mi caminata fue realmente refrescante. Comencé mi recorrido en un parque cercano, donde la brisa de la mañana me dio la energía que necesitaba. En el parque, conocí a una mujer mayor que estaba alimentando a las palomas. Me contó que había estado viniendo al mismo lugar durante más de 20 años, y cada día traía un poco de pan para sus \

las aves. Su sonrisa y amor por esos pequeños momentos me recordaron la importancia de disfrutar las pequeñas cosas de la vida. A medida que seguía mi camino, pasé por una colorida feria de artesanías. Había un puñado de artistas locales mostrando sus obras. Me detuve a charlar con un pintor que capturaba paisajes urbanos en acuarela. Sus pinturas eran vibrantes y llenas de vida. Me explicó que se inspira en las escenas cotidianas que observa durante sus paseos, justo como yo. Esa conexión con el arte y la cultura de la ciudad me dejó una sensación cálida mientras continuaba mi caminata. Fue un día lleno de pequeños encuentros que enriquecieron mi experiencia. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). # 10 Советов по Оптимизации Производительности Linux-сервера

Привет, коллеги по цеху! Если ваш сервер начал вести себя, как старый кот, который не хочет вставать с дивана, то это пост для вас. Давайте разберемся, как вернуть ему былую энергию и производительность!

## 1. Убедитесь, что у вас достаточно ресурсов
Проверьте, не забился ли ваш сервер под завязку. Если у вас 1 ГБ ОЗУ и 1000 пользователей, то не удивляйтесь, что он медленно реагирует. Это не сервер, а каша из-за переполненной кастрюли!

## 2. Настройте swap
Если ваш сервер начинает \

при высоких нагрузках, добавьте немного swap. Но помните: swap — это не замена ОЗУ, а лишь временная соломинка для вашего сервера. Он не должен жить в swap, как кот на диване!

## 3. Оптимизируйте конфигурацию сервера
Не бойтесь копаться в конфигурационных файлах. Это не так страшно, как кажется! Настройте параметры, такие как `max_connections`, чтобы ваш сервер не задыхался от наплыва запросов.

## 4. Используйте кэширование
Кэширование — это как дать вашему серверу немного кофе. Он станет быстрее и бодрее! Используйте такие инструменты, как Varnish или Redis, чтобы ускорить доступ к данным.

## 5. Отключите ненужные службы
Посмотрите, какие службы работают на вашем сервере. Если вы видите что-то, что не использовали с прошлого лета, смело отключайте! Это как убрать лишние вещи из холодильника — освободите место для важного!

## 6. Следите за нагрузкой
Используйте инструменты мониторинга, такие как `htop` или `nload`, чтобы следить за нагрузкой. Это поможет вам понять, когда ваш сервер начинает \

и требует помощи.

## 7. Регулярно обновляйте систему
Не забывайте про обновления! Это не только безопасность, но и улучшение производительности. Как говорится, \

.

## 8. Оптимизируйте базы данных
Если ваш сервер работает с базами данных, убедитесь, что они оптимизированы. Используйте индексы и избегайте ненужных запросов. Не позволяйте базе данных делать \

, когда она должна работать!

## 9. Настройте файловую систему
Выбор правильной файловой системы может значительно повлиять на производительность. Например, `ext4` или `XFS` могут стать вашими лучшими друзьями. Но не забывайте, что это не \

, а лишь один из инструментов в вашем арсенале.

## 10. Не забывайте про резервное копирование
И напоследок, всегда делайте резервные копии! Как бы вы не оптимизировали сервер, иногда он все равно может \
. Лучше быть готовым, чем потом искать, где вы потеряли важные данные. Это как иметь запасной план на случай, если кот решит устроить \

в ваш серверный шкаф!

---

Соблюдайте эти советы, и ваш Linux-сервер будет работать как швейцарские часы! А если нет — всегда можно попробовать \

его с помощью хорошей чашки кофе. Удачи!

**If you want to sponsor the contest prizes with Hive, Leo or Ecency points, you can send the tokens to @afri-tunes or @afritunes, or you can reach out to us via [Afri-tunes Discord Server](https://discord.gg/hZf37g5r9y)!!!**

in your title. ☆ Say your username, Week title and the title of the song you wish to present before you begin. ☆ Let your Word Count be 250+ - Include your reason or inspiration for choosing or sing the song, - Adding lyrics is optional, but if you do, ensure you cite adequately. - Include all of the lyrics if the music is original. #### We recommend that you don't use the #Leo or #leofinace tag in your music post ☆ PROPERLY cite all external materials (images and text) - ENSURE TO PUT THE LINK TO THE SOURCE ``` Cite this way: [Lyrics or text Source](then put the web link here) ``` - You can also join the Afri-tunes Discord Server and other music servers to promote your song. - Afri-tunes Weekly Event will run from 00:00 on **FRIDAYS** to 23:59 (11:59pm) on **THURSDAYS**, using GMT +1 as our time standard (Nigerian Time). ____ ![Backup_of_hive hive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ksam/23wBxmf4mFvKEwA1sdxTsvmTiKRFWD3BUVRW9zFVVhEzaMeGDzJod53cbjgpX4NdNoMxt.png)

____

### <center>**IMPORTANT UPDATE AND ANNOUNCEMENT 📢**</center>
____

We appreciate everyone who continuously participate in our Afri-tunes weekly contest to share their African Music and tunes with the Community. We are happy that the community is growing day by day, week by week, month by month and year by year.

In order to maintain quality content while sharing our lovely African musical tunes, we wish to remind everyone about the following:

- The minimum word count remains 250: however, if you use dual languages then it'll be 500.
- Let your writeup contain more of your inspiration behind the song, the choice of the song, what the song means to you or any topic/write-up you wish to share with us. 

____

#### **Important ⚠️**

We wish to revisit the use of adding lyrics in posts so that it doesn't take  50 - 80% of the post content. On this note, we wish to restate the following: 

- Adding lyrics is Optional 
- If you are the original composer of the song, you can add the whole lyrics 
- If it is a song cover and you copied the lyrics from the Internet, only include the 1st VERSE AND CHORUS in your post. Then cite properly by providing the link to the web page you got the lyrics from.

- Kindly note that spamming is a great offence on the hive blockchain and highly frowned at.⚠️

The Three Tunes Tuesday is an initiative founded by ablaze. Participants are encouraged to choose three songs from the same artist or from a particular genre to share; you can write about how meaningful the songs are to you or what you love about them. Also, ensure to tag ablaze, use the #ttt or #threestunestuesday tag or read [his post](https://peakd.com/hive-193816/@ablaze/rory-gallagher-for-three-tune-tuesday-week-104-10-hbi-shares-to-be-won) for more information. 

The Afri-tunes Community is a home for African Music on Hive, and we welcome participants to feel free to post their #ttt compilations ON AFRICAN SONGS in the Afri-tunes Community every Tuesdays and don't forget to make your words count 500 and above for #ttt.

body.title: How Do I Protect Myself From Online Scammers?
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ2Ctj3QW1Wc7bEjHvCFSM3iCDUFX5qMbz5W3fK5bywQp/1779530073861.jpg)

In today’s digital world, online scams have become very common, and anyone can become a victim if they are not careful. Personally, I believe protecting myself from online scammers starts with being alert and cautious at all times. I have learned that not everything I see online is trustworthy, so I try not to believe every message, email, or link that comes my way.

One major way I protect myself is by avoiding suspicious links and messages. If I receive a message asking for personal details, money, or passwords, I make sure to verify the source before responding. I understand that genuine organizations do not usually ask for sensitive information through random messages or calls.

Another important step I take is using strong passwords and enabling two-factor authentication on my accounts. This gives my accounts extra security and makes it harder for scammers or hackers to gain access. I also avoid sharing too much personal information online because scammers can use small details against me.

In addition, I regularly update my phone and apps because updates often include security improvements that protect against cyber threats. I also try to educate myself about common scam tactics so I can easily identify warning signs.

Most importantly, I have learned that patience is key. Scammers often create urgency to make people act quickly without thinking. Instead of rushing, I take time to think, verify, and ask questions.

Protecting myself from online scammers is not just about technology—it is about awareness, wisdom, and making careful decisions every day. By staying informed and vigilant, I can greatly reduce my chances of being deceived online.

**Thanks for reading.**
