body.title: REASONS TO BELIEVE IN GOD// THE OLD PATH
body.body:
Having trust in God gives our life more meaning and direction in life. The Bible teaches that the beauty and order of creation are signs that God exists. When we look at the world, nature, and even human life itself, we can see evidence of a wise Creator. Many people also believe in God because they experience His love, peace, protection, and answers to prayers in their daily lives. Faith in God gives hope during difficult times and strength to keep moving forward.
https://youtu.be/Bq_G5BLqk00?si=Y_B2q02KAo2Gz784
Another reason to believe in God is the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. Jesus showed us the love of God his good duds and the promise of God while he was on earth. God also changes the hearts and lives of those who trust Him, helping them live with love, forgiveness, and purpose. Believing in God is not only about religion, but also about having a personal relationship with Him.

>“And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.” Hebrews 11:6

body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWfdrfntTyAxBKmvizkhaLYtYYC2WBe92whj78ZrRT7r9/1779534041922.png)


Hello everyone! 👋
     I’m new here and excited to be part of the Freewriters community.

I’m nc6 [shugarito] and I’ve always used writing as a way to sort my thoughts and tell the stories that won’t leave me alone. For me, writing isn’t about being perfect - it’s about being honest on the page and seeing where the words take me when I just start typing.

What I love most about freewriting is that it gives me permission to be messy first. No overthinking, no waiting for the “right” idea. Just me, my mind, and whatever shows up. I’m here to get better at that, and to read the messy, brilliant pieces you all put out too.

I promise to read, leave positive comments, and keep everything I post 100% my own work. Looking forward to learning from this community and growing with you all.

Thanks for having me here!

He was not only a dedicated teacher but also a guiding light for countless students. His sincerity, discipline, kindness, and wisdom made him one of the most respected personalities in the school and community.
Teachers like him do not simply teach lessons from books — they shape lives, inspire generations, and leave behind unforgettable memories. His hard work and devotion will always be remembered with respect and gratitude.
Retirement is not the end of a journey; it is the beginning of a new chapter filled with peace, happiness, and countless blessings.
We pray that Allah grants him good health, happiness, and a long peaceful life ahead.

summary.title: Las Juanas (Review y Análisis personal) ESP/ENG
summary.body:
![Blue and White Simple Beach Presentation.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23uQjuwKfkG68JLhpF58ZcuixJV3T9RustebqhfnZwWEofGgKJsY8JjVbRHuo8RXa98WR.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/45669383694305845/)

If you're Latin American, you probably saw this Colombian telenovela. It came out in the late 90s and became a trend; everyone was talking about it, they were selling clothes and all kinds of merchandise. But beyond all that, we can't overlook the fact that Las Juanas highlighted the identity of Colombian women and their culture to the world. >Probablemente si eres latinoaméricano llegaste a ver esta telenovela cololmbiana, apareció por allá a finales de los años 90 y se convirtió en tendencia, todo el mundo hablaba de eso, vendían ropa y todo tipo de merchandise, pero más allá de todo eso no podemos pasar por alto que Las Juanas resaltó la idenidad de la muejer colombiana y su cultura ante el mundo.

Summary/Resumen

A woman named Juana Valentina Echenique arrives in a coastal town called Corozal in search of a man named Calixto Salguero. She wants to ask him two questions: if he was in Barranquilla the year she was born, and if he has a very particular birthmark—a mustard-colored, fish-shaped mark at the base of his spine. Through these questions, she discovers he is her father. However, feeling cornered and encouraged by the divine miracle of surviving a lightning strike, he confesses to having been with four other women. Juana Valentina then sets out to find her sisters, but what's most surprising is that they all share the name Jana (Juana Bautista, Juana Mani, Juana Caridad, and Juana Matilde), each with a distinct and very different personality. From the moment they arrive in town, a series of extraordinary events unfold.

>Una mujer llamada Juana Valentina Echenique llega a un pueblo costeño llamado Corozal en busca de un hombre que se llama Calixto Salguero, para hacerle dos preguntas, si ha estado en Barranquilla en el año del nacimiento de ella y si tiene una marca de nacimiento muy particular, una mancha color mostaza en forma de pez justo donde termina la espalda, siendo asi ella descunre que él es su padre, sin embargo, al sentirse acorralado y alentado por el milagro divino de haberse salvado luego de que le cayera un rayo encima sin matarlo, él confieza que estuvo con otras cuatro mujeres, así que poco a poco Juana Valentina se encarga de ir buscando a sus hermanas, pero lo más sorprendente es que todas se llaman Jana como ella (Juana Bautista, Juana Mani, Juana Caridad y Juana Matilde) todas ellas con personalidades muy marcadas y diferentes enre si. Desde que ellas llegan a pueblo se desatan una serie de eventos, extraordinarios

My Opinion/Mi Opinión

One of the most appealing things about this telenovela is that it broke the mold of its time, something Brazilians and Colombians were always experts at. Back then, they created irreverent, unconventional characters. The Juanas were truly empowered women. Growing up without a father figure, they learned to be independent and stand up for themselves. They didn't wait for others to solve their problems; they provided the solutions themselves. And another thing I really liked, and still like now that I'm watching it again, is that the protagonists are very different from each other, yet they maintain a perfect dynamic of protection and camaraderie—it's truly impressive.

>Una de las cosas más atractivas de esta telenovela es que rompió paradigmas de su época, y en esto siempre eran expertos los brasiñelos y los colombianos, en esa época ellos hacían personajes irreverentes, distintos. Las Juanas eran mujeres verdaderamente empoderadas, al crcer sin una figura paterna aprendieron a ser independientes y a defenderse a si mismas, no esperaban a que resolvieran sus problemas, sino que llas mismas aportaban soluciones. Y otra cosa que me gustaba mucho, y me sigue gustando, ya que estoy viéndola nuevamente, es que las protagonistas son muy diferentes entre sí, pero aún así mantienen una dinámica perfecta de protección y camaradería entre ellas impresionante.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23ynWbK2TAzfm1quaL6ej7HUGhayzBBgjYKpM59SgpEwAaujWh4yBCLhQyaCTTkhBNGjV.png)
[Fuente](https://www.semana.com/gente/articulo/las-juanas-asi-lucen-las-protagonistas-25-anos-despues-del-estreno-de-la-telenovela/202219/)

Another point worth mentioning is that any discerning reader of Gabriel García Márquez will recognize the telenovela's deep roots in magical realism. In fact, the narrative strongly resembles García Márquez's style, as he is known as one of the greatest Latin American exponents of this genre. This is evident in the characters' dialogue, the mention of superstitions, and the fantastical events that emerge within everyday life. And it is precisely this magic that makes this gem even more captivating, transforming it into something fantastical at times, while maintaining the reality of a Colombian coastal town: its daily struggles, its customs, its experiences, and so on.

>Otra cosa digna de mencionar es que todo aquel buen lector de Gabriel Garcia M'arquez reconocerá el profundo arraigo que tiene la telenovela en el realismo mágico, de hecho la narrativa recuerda muchísimo el estilo de García Márquez, coonocido como uno de los más grandes exponentes latinoamericanos de este género. Se nota en los diálogos de los personajes, la mención de las supersticiones, los hechos fantásticos que aparecen dentro de la cotidianidad, y esa es precisamente la magia que hace aún mas atractiva esta joya, la vuelve fantástica a ratos, pero manteniendo la realidad de un pueblo costero colombiano; sus luchas diarias, sus costumbres, sus vivencias, en fin.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23zSBUJ3G9kbnMNqcLuURHrdVSkZ38W6PJ8gtJxQVqQNZpnE93WQ4hmBnvGKxPxdGsHmk.png)
[Fuente](https://peru21.pe/cheka/que-paso-con-las-actrices-de-la-telenovela-colombiana-las-juanas-la-venganza-de-las-juanas-series-de-netflix-nnda-nnlt-noticia/)

It has everything: a touch of drama, romance, intrigue, and comedy. In fact, the two main villains don't take themselves seriously and sometimes even provide comic relief, but it doesn't feel cartoonish; instead, it adds a touch or seasoning that sparks the audience's interest.

>Y es que tiene de todo, un toque de drama, de romance, de intriga y también de comedia, de hecho los dos villanos principales no se toman en serio a sí mismos y a veces hasta sirven de alivio cómico, pero aún así no se siente caricaturizada, sino que le da como el toque o la sazón que aviva el inetrés del úblico.
https://www.nuevamujer.com/espectaculos/2022/05/31/asi-se-ve-juan-ruben-de-las-juanas-a-25-anos-de-la-telenovela/
[Fuente](https://www.nuevamujer.com/espectaculos/2022/05/31/asi-se-ve-juan-ruben-de-las-juanas-a-25-anos-de-la-telenovela/)

Well, I hope I've left you with a good memory, or at least given you a good recommendation in case you've never seen this gem.

>Bueno, espero haberles dejado un buen recuerdo, o al menos haberlesdado una buena recomendación en caso de que jamás hayan vistor esta joya.
![Presentación Propuesta de Proyecto Portfolio Scrapbook Marrón y Negro.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wqwC8G3pmfAmUg1E61Zg3gUWbUypQbajqdteMGTFid9mWcYbLuHqe1kY7FxJ8zAiMM5.jpg)
(Image designed by me in canva editor)

summary.title: The Yellow Wallpaper
summary.body:
### The Yellow wallpaper by Charlotte Perkins Gilman

![1000018414.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leaky20/23wMcxqRRb6k62gcrpwTccPQdjhzqss8F4bNvJSufpN4kDRWbSJQiFURbUbXbU5sY5v3j.jpg)

Its a short book but there's a certain impact that comes from reading it. When I say short I mean that its only around 30 pages and it can easily be read in just an hour or two. It was originally published in 1892. 

This review post is a brief interpretation and it contains spoilers. So be warned!

### <center>Synopsis</center>

<hr>

The book is about a woman's slow decent into madness brought on by her physician husband.

The woman suffers from postpartum depression and she and her husband, rent an upstate cottage to spend the summer with a plan to return home after next three months. The idea is to give her rest and peace. She is confined to the house and mostly to one particular room, a nursery with yellow wallpaper. She is encouraged by her husband to not see anyone else or to write or engage in anything that might excite her or create anxiety. But without having any simulation she becomes focused on the intricate yellow wallpaper in the room and eventually begins to see its intricate floral design as bars to a prison. Overtime she starts to see a woman creeping behind the pattern, trapped by the design, shaking the bars of her prison, trying to escape. 

The book reaches its climax on the day that the couple is meant to leave the cottage and return home. The woman locking herself in the room and tears down the wallpaper. She then begins creeping along the walls. 

The husband ends up breaking down the door with an axe and is so shocked by his wife's maddness that he passes out in the threshold. The woman doesn't even notice her husband lying on the ground and simply steps over his body again and again and she continues to circle about in the room, creeping along the walls. 

### <center>Interpretation</center>

<hr>

The hallucination of the woman trapped behind the wallpaper seems to me to symbolize the woman herself who is trapped in the room. This is pretty obvious I think. 

When I first read the description of the book before reading it myself, I got the impression that the husband had intentionally locked his wife up in the room and or intentionally manipulated her in a way that would make her go insane. In reading the story myself though, I didn't actually get that impression. I think that the husband actually loves his wife and genuinely wants her to get better, which is portrayed throughout the story and which is also why he is so shocked in the end by her madness. Where the husband goes wrong is that he repeatedly fails to listen to his wife, who clearly knows herself and her body better than he or anyone else. For instance, the wife wants to be social and see others, but he encourages her to remain alone as seeing others would be too taxing and stressful for her. He encourages her to just rest and to not tire herself by entertaining others. The woman wants to write and be creative as well but the husband again  discourages her for those things for similar reasons. He ultimately believes that he knows best and believes that she needs peace and rest. He is very wrong though and she repeadely tells him that she needs to be social and needs intellectual and creative stimulation. In the end her isolation worsens her condition and she eventually decends into madness. 

To me I think that this is a commentary about how male physicians often do not listen to their female patients and think that they know what is best for their female patients. The book was written in the late 1800's when the standard cure for woman was bed rest, isolation and for wealthier woman these retreat like isolated spas. 

Though I think that things have likely improved (somewhat) since the time that this book was written I still think that this idea is probably very relevant today. I'm sure that a lot of women do not feel heard, or recognized by their male physicians or their husbands and there are still many known biases in the medical field that favor male patients over female ones.  

#### What do you think? Have you read this book? Do you think that there are biases in the medical field that disfavor women or that male physicians at times to not listen to what female patients are telling them? Do you disagree with any of this? Let me know your thoughts in the comments.

summary.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt # 47 Telephone booth memories [ESP/ENG]
summary.body:
![Miniatura de Youtube Tradiciones México Moderna (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23wMjLcCJ9NJcMm1nUBcDnzT6TCpLy3fpJPdLF3CDiK6zwRL5qK3gegbJ9juj7WGzLv3e.jpg)
Made with Canva Editor >Imagen editada en Canva

What wonderful memories of my youth this week's #SilverBlogger topic brings back! Phone booths were everywhere in my day, both in the city and the country. Just like the original post says, back then there was no more effective way to communicate. They were there, readily available 24/7, so they were incredibly useful. However, I remember there were many urban legends surrounding them that, whether true or not, scared people. For example, it was said that you had to be careful when using the receiver because sometimes they left syringes or razor blades infected with the dreaded HIV virus. No cases were ever reported, but people were still cautious. >¡Que bellos recuerdos de juventud me trae el tema de esta semana de #SilverBlogger, las cabinas telefónicas abundaban por toda la ciudad y el país en mis tiempos de juventud, tal como dice la publicación original, antes no había una forma más efectiva de comunicarse que esa, estaban allí, a la orden del día, disponibles las 24 horas, así que eran muy útiles. Sin embargo en mis tiempos yo me acuerdo que había muchas leyendas urbanas entorno a ellas que, fuesen verdad o no, asustaban a la población, por ejemplo se decía que había que tener cuidado al tomar el auricular porque algunas veces dejaban jeringas o hojillas infectadas con el temido virus VIH. Nunca se supo de algún caso, pero de todos modos la gente tenía cuidado.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23wqtt9Xp1pVJ8LRJvYkUNNJgD664gX5sVSpkxWMefLSriVa5TGvzKjLVyp1yUi7cSrtn.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/tel%C3%A9fono-cabina-telef%C3%B3nica-1839160/)

There were some communal phone booths where, despite the phones being spaced apart, you could still hear someone arguing (when they were arguing 😄). I used the public phones for specific things, but as far as I remember, they were only for local calls. When I wanted to make a call out of state or even internationally, I went to the CANTV (the national telephone company) office. There was a room there where you could request international calls, and many times my friends and I made calls to contact our friend who was now living in London with her husband. I remember feeling nostalgic when I heard her voice, imagining her so far away from us and her own culture.

>Había algunas cabinas de teléfonos colectivas donde, a pesar de estar a cierta distancia algunos teléfonos de otros, igualmente se podía escuchar a alguien discutir (cuando lo hacían 😄) Yo utilizaba los teléfonos públicos para cosas puntuales, pero según lo que recuerdo solo eran para llamadas locales, porque cuando yo quería hacer alguna llamada fuera del estado o incluso internacional, recurría a la sede de la C.A.N.T.V (la empresa de telefonía nacional) allí había una sala donde uno solicitaba llamadas internacionales, y muchas veces mis amigos y yo hicimos llamadas para contactarnos con nuestra amiga que ahora vivía en Londres con su esposo. Recuerdo la nostalgia al oír su voz, imaginándola tan lejos de nosotros y su propia cultura.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carmen1659/23tmQWknYiWeyDMWRXLVGcT2XJtSdpLBMkhQ4maFRgp2Ra8gJbxQaxTsDRaRZhrMz8RBj.png)
[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/tel%C3%A9fon)

These public phones could save your life and shorten distances, so they were an indispensable tool back then. Some people even knew how to rig them to make free calls 😄, although I was never interested in doing that. Anyway, it was truly a pleasure for me to join this initiative and share my experience. Here's the link to the original post, in case you'd like to join in.

>Estos teléfonos públicos podían salvarte la vida y acortar distancias, así que eran un elemento indispensable en ese entonces, incluso había personas que sabían amañarlos para hacer llamadas gratis 😄, aunque nunca me interesó hacer eso. Bueno, de verdad que para mi fue un placer unirme a esta iniciativa y contar mi experiencia, por aquí les dejo el enlace a la publicación original, por si quieren unirse.
[The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt # 47 Telephone booth memories](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-chronicles-prompt-47-telephone-booth-memories)

And because I used chicken breast, it is not too oily. I actually added more oil in it to make it juicier, but it taste really really good. Thanks to @leannwithdoublen [Chicken Adobo](https://peakd.com/hive-100067/@leannwithdoublen/cooking-blog-adobong-manok-one-of-my-favorite-food) I suddenly crave for it. Ahh, but mine has no carrot and potato, coz they're like gold in here with its current price. Lol

summary.title: Chronicle of a Street Photographer, Day 2./ Monomad Challenge [Eng/Esp]
summary.body:
![1000474987.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23tvVrAwDUvQS3Zahi28b8CNFe2oUB4vFWiFLfHwUHkgP3QWoBwUM7eqpfVrNomjRkSvs.jpg)
Official entry for the #monomad challenge hosted by @monochromes and @brumest

> Greetings, friends of the #blackandwhite community. Classic cars have always been a fundamental part of the documentary photo project I’m working on around the city. I love seeing them at their best—meticulously maintained—and admiring the creativity their owners bring to keeping them running. But at the same time, it fills me with immense sadness to see them abandoned and forgotten.

> Saludos, amigos de la comunidad #blackandwhite. Los autos clásicos siempre han sido parte fundamental del registro fotográfico documental que voy haciendo por la ciudad. Me encanta verlos en su mayor expresión de cuidado y la creatividad de sus dueños para mantenerlos funcionando. Pero a la vez me da una tristeza enorme verlos en estado de abandono, en el olvido.  ![1000476793.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23wC5V1YdNjAu8rGppMMcwqRWeuaggewueRHRFxkpNyAvGsE2v18iNWUQ2BDCWP8SEppj.jpg)
> Something like that happened to me while I was walking through the Nuevo Vedado neighborhood in the capital: I came across this classic 1950 Ford Perfect in a terrible state of disrepair.

> Algo así me pasó mientras caminaba por la zona de Nuevo Vedado en la capital: encuentro este clásico Ford Perfect de 1950 en un estado de deterioro terrible.  ![1000474984.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000474984.jpg)

> I got the feeling that it had been brought there and left to die, literally. So I sat down nearby and began to imagine how much history it must have; I played out a whole mental movie about this poor car that had reached the end of its days.

> Me dio la sensación de que llegó hasta allí y lo dejaron morir, literalmente. Entonces me senté cerca y comencé a imaginar cuánta historia tendría; toda una película mental me hice sobre este pobre auto que llegó al fin de sus días.  ![1000474983.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23x1313T6PA8zENsWXyX7t2Rh6hWjwue3XA8LF72k1aaagQuh3d4nde1TrCKj6WHFFVxo.jpg)

> I stayed there for quite a while, took several photos, and, strangely enough, it didn’t say a word to me; sometimes the car’s owner shows up when I take these kinds of photos, but it seemed as if no one cared

> Allí estuve un buen rato, varias fotos le hice y, lo más curioso, nada me dijo nada; a veces aparece el dueño del carro cuando hago este tipo de fotos, pero pareciera como si a nadie le interesara. ![1000474985.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000474985.jpg) ______________ ![1000474986.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/1000474986.jpg)
> Such a shame 😢—at least I was able to take these pictures of it; I hope some kind soul restores it and doesn’t let it disappear to rust.

> Una pena 😢, al menos le pude hacer estas imágenes; espero que algún alma piadosa lo restaure y no lo deje desaparecer por el óxido. ![1000474982.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/muhammadhalim/23u5b6a5vdQXsowzx3mKTRjuXW7wbwFhVyC86fEWQYCCuDWwAywf8VPSqDepqMvRqDDiU.jpg)
> And that’s my story for today; I hope 🙏 you enjoyed it. Thank you so much as always for your company and time; I look forward to your comments. See you soon!!!

> Y hasta aquí mi historia de hoy; espero 🙏 les haya gustado. Mil gracias siempre por su compañía y tiempo; espero sus comentarios. ¡¡¡Nos vemos pronto!!!

summary.title: Quick & Cheesy Omelette – Ready in Just 5 Minutes
summary.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZELsHswhx6UNbA8PGbKBRxS8DqrjwiFQrQeDGi73LKca/1779465754468.jpg)
___
# Hi foodie's!
___
Hello friends, how are you all? I hope you all are fine. I am also fine. So today I have come again with a new blog. Today I brought a very yummy recipe for you all which is the recipe of cheesy omelette. It becomes very delicious and it is very easy to make and gets ready within 5 minutes. So friends now without wasting much time let’s start making this delicious omelette.
___
# Ingredients needed
___
Eggs
Tomato
Onion
Mozzarella cheese
Oil
Salt
Red chili powder
Turmeric
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmULtGwDvcChkBDzwsYJsXKk9q7F4awTVnZLt1C772fy5U/1779465754517.jpg)
___
# Let’s start
___
So guys to make this cheesy omelette, first I washed 2 tomatoes and 1 onion nicely and then cut them into round shapes. After cutting them, I took mozzarella cheese and grated it nicely. 
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNdWnaJd64aFzxKkKUgFreE9eDkDdYGXY2vMNeEA1jNvm/1779465754619.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf88URSSEtYarMqQW1yfgUdn884B7b1uHixXXRrFxhTXh/1779465754689.jpg)



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVWq3PDEL1AyJqp8tAathmYS2ULaNkMoPzTY35JMvCnsr/1779465781860.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRrUEmBLJt7Mn2bBa37wZ7U6Kh3Pt37VJG8vVPTwKokYQ/1779465781961.jpg)
___
Now I took a pan and added oil in it and heated the oil a little. Now first I added onions in the pan and fried them a little, then I also added tomatoes in it but some tomatoes were left so I did not add them.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTmzPB5oVwydWu7ag5QHZebv9KNsozKkaV7UfiZ11iLzc/1779465782071.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYk1LZj95THpLLPAFMwxQMFWquTZA1286ZzNAWoKFFjHD/1779465782190.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcugtRywsHCB6tQLQVJe4aoEb1HGPp7h8hYZrBkL8SFGf/1779465782295.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVqSamoH6PUPedpcM4ZRtSD2xWijF1XMnvsyiUUeo1yE5/1779465811745.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYkwnSUebbaSyfDharwSUEun4DnmxWX8dQUudEFjytdst/1779465811864.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUZW6cWTBPCUMGWGvntBexexhcHhRba9Ai1rUS9MenSiz/1779465811967.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTF1eyzE2JrYLwrreSeuEQJNUWk3jfJQQKqGGwB4fxMSf/1779465812094.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWy5tYpnM6VpmHVjVwAbmZjRw8aNLqHoVGPuq1qq5T6TG/1779465812207.jpg)
___
# Adding the eggs and spices
___
Now after adding tomatoes, I added spices in it like 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon red chili powder and half teaspoon turmeric. After adding the spices, fry the tomatoes and onions a little so their raw taste goes away. After frying for some time, I added 3 eggs in it.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQ3GJXvuG1fScHKsaHj1LiemEXte7wLpbPgL7mZfrzSKi/1779520973475.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTaC3X2rzs3j7o36Ndvi4ht1ty948hPBZ56ssF75mJFSf/1779465852492.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZrfhRz1Jb1STRPCRNPuDzEqeSYefB2kgpgBWaHh4CQMi/1779465852596.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNeAG4WwaoVLSTPMWCn1p62hAV7r6yvvoxEPveWAEbidu/1779465852719.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSwjJXUKoSoH7G28ge975NXJCMyhzqbcmufasiQo32jCw/1779466082604.jpg)
___
# Adding the mozzarella cheese
___
Now after adding the eggs, add the cheese that we grated on top of the eggs. At the end lower the flame and place a lid on the pan and then cook it for 1 or 2 minutes on low flame. After 2 minutes our yummy and cheesy omelette will be ready.
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPKFX6zLjnYsCMikLcreU7gZbCxfsfukHoKBnKxj8mVx7/1779466082730.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdjFABn8362exmPuS9AnFWzYoUvHN4h2kqbxMTXVki5Zd/1779466082853.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSCZWjCnNi2AenHNtjH7ZJmfbrGU1wBYgs4Drgq6pLwb7/1779466082972.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXWjpeEFD2wWm3a8qWETvscMrQTqEvgWi4APsqLwLagVs/1779466083073.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNZ59FVwV8YxLGfAtgENzLP5SPsqcXkdVejxyN1k6syAF/1779466115254.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXuxpp539YKgZzpHqe3f7bxxH3w7uKNbVBnZYMdaRSrDm/1779466115366.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTnTjdY4MY35yoRvQCwmZyYuD13amPZgmVYD1nSTtf1o8/1779466115475.jpg)
___
# Final result 😋
___
So guys this is the final result of my cheesy omelette. It became very yummy. I ate it with naan (bread). It can be eaten in breakfast and lunch too. So friends if you liked this recipe then please tell me in the comments section and support me like always thank you so much and bye bye. 💛
___
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTKskgen9r11dNxYw2BdNekYsmftQTJhxjyxRKy3xA9gp/1779466115604.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUPutHxnMWo7D5P8BXc37otzDQPVu8nTXkNpEdgU41L8Z/1779466115715.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTfaJzKmYcF9W3YMDLSHNYbNt5e18kWgc9uhEJazkaH86/1779466140487.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYoaR8NcH57mKE2zKrRXz6kAZywmA8bkCaiX82kH4nVJm/1779466140595.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYAP3fH4pJF3KbCfQxdu5HnoXqrrbsukkivcJ6miJWsH4/1779466140720.jpg)
___
***That’s all for today. I will be back soon with something new to share. Until then, stay happy and keep supporting*.**
___
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ1vti72jskVair5xqGJQzXLvVJv3AkyGzhRspyS9X9Ta/1760280731982.jpg)
___

summary.body:

花朵是大自然的馈赠，它们以绚丽的色彩和芬芳的香气，带给人们无尽的美好感受。当我看到一朵盛开的花，心中自然生出一种宁静与喜悦。它们象征着生命的脆弱与坚韧，让我在忙碌的生活中停下脚步，享受片刻的宁静与美丽。花儿们悄然绽放，仿佛在诉说着春天的故事，提醒我们珍惜当下，感受生活中的每一个细微瞬间。

summary.title: A visit to the Chess Museum inside Pan De Amerikana
summary.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcmy3DEAPBRiGNkfRmiSvxVWNvdWU4ior31rLXxAK3zBa/img_6054.jpg)

Today, I am going to take you to a virtual tour at the Pan De Amerikana. Pan De Amerikana is actually a restaurant located in Marikina City, Metro Manila, Philippines. But...This is not your typical restaurant at the heart of the city. Why? Because this houses the Philippine's first ever **Chess Museum**.

*Yes! Museum inside the restaurant! Sounds amazing right?*

As soon as you get inside, you'll feel like travelling back in time. Because unlike the modern and polished reataurants, this shows a vintage atmosphere.

Here's what you'll see:


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdBVERig6wSJFu7wTa3B3VAHzZJoHmDaQ9n7FWuMzqJVj/img_6069.jpg)
**Antique decor and rustic furnitures** such us this old TV from the 80s or 90s. To be honest, I'm not really sure from what year this is from, all I know is that this is a vintage television as well as the speaker-like thing. I alao love those mini chairs. On the right photo, it's like a movie or drama set from the early days. You'll see a *kalesa*, *taho and palamig containers*.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNifTZFgKu3wvxT1Eahm7uFuoEiPAieTctN1GWqbzQJYu/img_6043.jpg)
On another corner is an old piano and across that is a set like in the province. An old earthenware jar to store water and some claypots used for cooking. It felt like I was back at my grandmother's house in the province.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbmxcHdUUCBg6vGYWea2AYwpcWUe5PzjfeDkKhNfYxiLW/img_6068.jpg)
There are also lots of photos hung on the wall. Those are old **photos of Filipino actors and actresses from classic Philippine cinema**. I dont recognize most of the faces, but the black and whote photos made the place feel like you're visiting you're great grandparents ancestral house.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmSwCEDiLBh5g4y3NrFqsW5UbRVtMpWcrX5WvRRuQfKdEH/img_6073.jpg)
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmduMjJNC5WnMTsgt6pjTmKtEvX1Eop8xe6wRWXaXYpgJw/img_6072.jpg)
Small hanging bridges connect different parts of the restaurant, which felt like a tiny adventure park. And below those bridges is a mini pond with Koi fishes and something like a big nest and a well on the right side.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPDQSjC1LkzunDqzA7fzEzdTcAfsgsu2Ms2426cQoR3Wz/img_6067.jpg)
I also noticed an upside-down set of tables and chairs.
It feels playful and confusing at the same time, like gravity stopped working for a moment. 



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmRhiz91RVD1sELt5N7WMKTqUQSJ4UrSDWWXaSJhK9srCJ/img_6053.jpg)
*Mini Windmill.*


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUGsCA4b9xnkLovPCd8zP4nEEhTWkiWUtAhhzZQWgfc8y/img_6057.jpg)
*An old telephone which I only saw in movies.*


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVz16NFRpKXfR2m2R3wXPEThQCnnZQbnChDzbw75eYoTi/img_6058.jpg)
*This one is like a mini tunnel with cute lanterns and lights and at the end is a vintage Land Rover.*


***Finally! We see the Chess Museum.***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcmy3DEAPBRiGNkfRmiSvxVWNvdWU4ior31rLXxAK3zBa/img_6054.jpg)

At the entrance it says **\

**. Just a little back story, the museum is dedicated to Eugene Torre, he is a Filipino chess legend and Asia’s first chess grandmaster. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWcRgziMaq5svQkcw8KLosqCQbQBYeTzmzRsfP1XjoNwy/img_6051.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTRjWqRB7MyaSjFXa7GmtgihWn8zJ3cKxwZspZHudCnAc/img_6050.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPkZWNfGd785U5bMuLn2BNfTw29mGUjvcciSb6x3Vx6mA/img_6055.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNqcKSNkPts871wfnaB8yyBVcVPFkFSia8CVajV4DH3Kj/img_6056.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmS9NgktaDMA4Jw67JB6QSxgMG2KYEee2A8uEg8BoXnRDB/img_6049.jpg)

Inside are giant chess pieces and chessboard tables. There are giant life-sized statues of knights made of steel.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmcMusPKnWJKJcYaDca1jB2Wyg9c68EBubn3DJWe5akZzn/img_6052.jpg)

We playfully moved the pieces around for photos while some other visitors played with it. Outside the museum area, the chess theme continues everywhere. There are different sets of chessboards that looks aesthetic and vintage.

The museum feels like the *“heart”* of Pan de Amerikana, quietly reminding visitors that chess is not only about winning games, but also about patience, discipline, and finding beauty in thinking ahead.

Before I end this virtual tour, let me also add that this is called Pan De Amerikana because this is originally a bakery that sells *Pan Amerikano*, I heard it is a popular bread in the 1950s that is baked using a traditional oven made of brick. And eventually, to attract more customers they made it into a restaurant. But until today, they still sell that bread. I was just unable to took photos because I was too focused and in awe of the museum.

That's it for our virtual tour today. I hope you enjoyed it! 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

All photos are mine and are from my gallery.

summary.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g66f0e42d90eef7d9415635fab2aeb1d2407c50ed0e04f0d080a9d629cd88b8b7c63735fb1805c765b38c1d588d8e3e762617932ff524bfb6e2b2e8affd4c1c61_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 사랑 이야기의 주제: 다양성

사랑 이야기는 다양한 주제를 다룰 수 있으며, 각기 다른 배경과 상황 속에서 펼쳐지는 감정과 갈등을 통해 독자에게 깊은 감동을 줍니다. 여기 몇 가지 사랑 이야기의 주제를 제안합니다.

## 1. 금지된 사랑
- **배경**: 두 사람의 사랑이 사회적, 문화적 장벽에 의해 방해받는 이야기.
- **예시**: 서로 다른 신분이나 종교를 가진 연인들이 외부의 압력과 편견에 맞서 싸우는 이야기.

## 2. 첫사랑
- **배경**: 어린 시절의 순수한 사랑이 성인이 되어 다시 만나는 이야기.
- **예시**: 오랜 시간이 지나 다시 만난 두 사람의 감정이 어떻게 변했는지를 탐구하는 이야기.

## 3. 재회
- **배경**: 과거에 사랑했던 사람과의 재회로 시작되는 이야기.
- **예시**: 이별 후 각자의 삶을 살아가던 두 사람이 우연히 다시 만나 서로의 마음을 확인하는 과정.

## 4. 우정에서 사랑으로
- **배경**: 오랜 친구 사이에서 사랑의 감정이 싹트는 이야기.
- **예시**: 서로를 이해하고 지지해온 친구들이 어느 날 서로에 대한 감정을 깨닫는 과정.

## 5. 연애의 어려움
- **배경**: 현대 사회의 다양한 문제들 속에서 사랑을 지키기 위한 노력.
- **예시**: 직장 생활, 가족의 반대, 경제적 어려움 등 여러 가지 장애물을 극복하는 이야기.

## 6. 다문화 사랑
- **배경**: 서로 다른 문화적 배경을 가진 두 사람의 사랑 이야기.
- **예시**: 언어와 관습의 차이를 극복하며 서로의 문화를 이해하고 존중하는 과정.

## 7. 시간 여행
- **배경**: 과거와 현재를 오가며 사랑의 의미를 탐구하는 이야기.
- **예시**: 시간 여행을 통해 과거의 사랑을 회상하거나 미래의 사랑을 예견하는 이야기.

## 8. 상실과 치유
- **배경**: 사랑하는 사람을 잃은 후의 슬픔과 그로 인한 치유의 과정.
- **예시**: 사랑의 상실을 통해 성장하고, 새로운 사랑을 찾는 이야기.

## 9. 비밀의 사랑
- **배경**: 숨겨진 사랑의 이야기로, 비밀이 밝혀질 때의 긴장감.
- **예시**: 가족이나 친구들에게 숨겨진 사랑이 드러나는 순간의 갈등과 감정.

## 10. 사랑의 재발견
- **배경**: 오랜 결혼 생활 속에서 잃어버린 사랑을 다시 찾는 이야기.
- **예시**: 부부가 서로의 소중함을 다시 깨닫고 관계를 회복하는 과정.

이러한 다양한 주제를 통해 사랑 이야기는 독자에게 깊은 감동과 공감을 불러일으킬 수 있습니다. 각 주제는 독창적인 요소와 캐릭터를 통해 더욱 풍부하게 발전될 수 있습니다.

summary.title: The Paper Trail
summary.body:
The receipt was still in his pocket when Emeka buried his father. He had forgotten it was there, tucked in alongside a folded tissue and a parking stub from Tuesday. It was only later, much later, when his sister Adaeze was gathering clothes to donate that she held up the shirt and felt something in the pocket. “What’s this?” she said. Emeka looked up from the floor where he had been sitting for no particular reason.  “Nothing. Just throw it.” https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWUY4NwpDrrHLDdKZpuKmA7MuL6d7gSRspHnnMU1b4CxR/ChatGPT%20Image%20May%2023,%202026%20at%2011_01_55%20AM.png But Adaeze never threw anything away without looking at it first. It was a habit that had irritated him for thirty years and would apparently not stop now, not even in grief. She folded it. Her eyes moved across the paper. Then she went very still. “Emeka.” “What?” She crossed the room and held it out to him. It was a receipt from a pharmacy in Gwagwalada. The date in it was the fifteenth of March — eleven days before their father died. The items were listed in that thermal-print font that always faded too fast: two bottles of Ensure, a jar of groundnut butter, and a packet of Digestive biscuits. Emeka stared at it. “That’s the stuff he used to bring you,” Adaeze said quietly. “When you were sick last year. Remember? You said you didn’t know where he was getting it from.” Emeka remembered. He has been in bed for three weeks with typhoid and something the doctor called “exhaustion,” which was really just the name doctors gave a man who has been working sixteen-hour for days without stopping. His father had shown up at his flat every three days with a small bag of things. Emeka had assumed his wife was sending them. He hasn’t asked. He had been too tired to ask.  “He never said a word,” Emeka said. “You know how he was.” Yes. He knew how his father was. Chief Okeke has been the kind of man who showed love the way some people paid tax — quietly, consistently, and with a deep personal conviction that acknowledgment would ruin the whole thing. He did not hug. He did not say _I am proud of you._ He showed up. He fixed things. He bought Ensure and groundnut butter and Digestive biscuits and left them at the door without knocking as he thought you might already be asleep. “There’s something written on the back,” Adaeze said. Emeka turned it over. It was their father’s handwriting. Shaky now, the way it has gotten in the last two years, but still unmistakably his. He had written a list — the kind of list a man makes when he is trying to keep track of something without admitting to himself why. _Emeka — biscuits, Ensure (chocolate). Adaeze — amoxicillin, Ribena, plasters (small). Chima — zinc supplements, glucose._ Their younger brother Chima lived in Enugu. Emeka had no idea his father had been sending him things too. “He kept a list,” Emeka said. His voice came out strange. “Like a… he kept a whole list.”  Adaeze sat down on the bed. “We never asked him,” she said. “Any of us. We just took what he brought and said thank you and moved on.” “He didn’t want to be asked.” “No.” She paused. “But maybe he wanted to be noticed. ”Emeka thought about the last real conversation he had with his father. It had been about the land in the village, some boundary dispute that needed resolving before the rain came. Practical. Concrete. The kind of conversation his father was comfortable in. At the end of it, his father had said something odd. He had said, _You know, I am not always sure you children know how much I think about you. And Emeka, distracted, already reaching for his phone, had said, _Of course we know, Dad._ He has not asked what prompted it. He has not looked up from his screen. That was for months ago. Now he was sitting on his father’s bedroom floor holding a pharmacy receipt with a shopping list on the back, and the weight of what he had failed to say pressed on his chest like a stone. “I should have told him,” Emeka said. “We all should have,” Adaeze said. They sat in silence for a while. Not the uncomfortable kind. This was another kind. The kind that comes after something has been understood that can’t be undone. It was the silence of people who have arrived too late and knew it and are choosing, for once, to sit with that fact instead of running from it. Eventually Adaeze refolded the receipt carefully, like it was a document of some importance. “I am keeping this,” she said. Emeka nodded. “Keep it.” She smoothed it against her knee. “He went to the pharmacy sick, you know. The pharmacist told me when I went to collect his prescriptions after. Said Dad came in every few weeks, sometimes looking really tired, but he always bought things for other people before he bought anything for himself.” Emeka shot his eyes. “Always,” she repeated, softly. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbLoShaJawo1LFWnYnuNkwxAsWvSaetaM5QX6z7bUX2kJ/ChatGPT%20Image%20May%2023,%202026%20at%2011_04_39%20AM.png In the days that followed, Emeka found himself doing something he hasn’t done in years — calling his siblings. Not for logistics, not to discuss the estate or the funeral costs or who was taking which piece of furniture. Just calling. Asking how Chima’s knees were. Asking if Adaeze had eaten. Staying on the line a little longer than necessary. He could not explain it to his wife when she remarked on it. He didn’t try. Some things, he was beginning to learn, did not need explaining. They just needed doing.  He had the receipt laminated, in the end. It sat on his desk now, between a photograph and a smash potted plant that he was — against all his previous instincts — making a real effort to keep alive. It was, he supposed, the least he could do. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmW2KVjJmvCpcViWeKdep8enVmsBhPxvQ4y5Ysx2K6PSrP/ChatGPT%20Image%20May%2023,%202026%20at%2011_07_16%20AM.png _The things we carry without looking at them. The things we throw away. And the things we find, too late, that tell us everything the person never said aloud._

summary.body:
# a few recent sunrise shots from a couple of walks I have bene able to get out for a couple of early morning walks recently, in fact I could have got out for another one this morning, as I tend to do when I wake up I first check the weather apps, well thats second, first I check the time to make sure its not the middle of the night, then if its close to 4Am when I normally wake up I check the weather. This morning 3 of the 4 weather apps I said all indicated about a 60% chance of rain this morning, so I stayed in, and did my steps inthe sun room, when it got light enough for me to check there had been no rain, but oh well tomorrow is another day. I do love getting out for morning walks, its my favorite way to start the day, so I am a happy camper there will be more days when I can get out for early morning walks again for the next few months. MOrning walks are what I do most, for a few reasons, as I said I love waking up and getting moving, so getting out for a photo walk is a good way to do that, another reason being my wife doesnt fele up to getting out much, so I do not like leavingher alone and heading out for a photo walk during hte day when she is up to often, and thirdly and somewhat related she sleeps inb a lot later than I do so I can get out for a good walk, get home and do editing and preparing posts while she is still sleeping. OK lets get to the photos Starting off from a shot from yesterday morning ( as I prepare this draft) I headed to popes Island initially, I had not bene there for a photo walk yet this year, and I was lucky enough to catch a fairly nice sunrise. This one taken on one of the piers at Fleet Marina
![recent sunrise sots-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/244UG8Fzq5pgHY4Vgbtak6xtTpGmGL752Z9cFw7qBcoRnJo2qGrKREahhU6QnGUVmbozs.jpg) **Sony A7iv 27mm F10 5 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/244UG8Fzq5pgHY4Vgbtak6xtTpGmGL752Z9cFw7qBcoRnJo2qGrKREahhU6QnGUVmbozs.jpg)**

Another walk I took was at Neds Point in Mattapoisett, I often share shots of the light house there, but this time focusing on the other views, this one actually looking away from the rising sun, towards the moon adding a nice glow on the water
![recent sunrise sots.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/2431ZatA6m4VmPYhMB6PMXeP5dC2uPyecJcMY3Y3BV2AajcnL6VFyCdGaYxHuNz4Fa4mg.jpg) **Sony A7iv 23mm F11 10 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/2431ZatA6m4VmPYhMB6PMXeP5dC2uPyecJcMY3Y3BV2AajcnL6VFyCdGaYxHuNz4Fa4mg.jpg)**

and at the other end of Neds Point, looking along the coast with some nice sunrise glow over the horizon
![recent sunrise sots-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/242NTxNxvKk4sxeLot4R5kw2z2TaBXB7HWZ38S5oEdZgN21YUwzv1yxoR4GH3wwQpB1fw.jpg) **Sony A7iv 26mm F11 1.3 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/242NTxNxvKk4sxeLot4R5kw2z2TaBXB7HWZ38S5oEdZgN21YUwzv1yxoR4GH3wwQpB1fw.jpg)**

and another shot from yesterday morning, I do love getting shots of this old swing truss bridge, and a bonus with nice sunrise colors behind it
![recent sunrise sots-3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23w2BAHPJCvVfFgEAucPBsjfkMotebETJb3ZWShRxsWcGXTcmZT3zN7HAXobGfsN7yJmP.jpg) **Sony A7iv 17mm F8 13 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23w2BAHPJCvVfFgEAucPBsjfkMotebETJb3ZWShRxsWcGXTcmZT3zN7HAXobGfsN7yJmP.jpg)**

summary.title: Star Trek: Discovery, Season 1, Episode 12, Movie review
summary.body: > Hello everyone. I hope you are all well. Today I am going to share my feelings and experiences about the twelfth episode of the first season of the Star Trek: Discovery series, “Vaulting Ambition”. I was really surprised while watching this episode, because the whole story progressed in a way where one mystery after another was revealed and at the last moment a truth came to light that made us think about the events of the entire season in a new way. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmabS2c7nvP4cC2oAcDFtJds5EdhhgdfP91FispSbvUMhJ/IMG_20260523_184557.png At the beginning of this episode, we see Michael Burnham and Captain Lorca sailing towards Empress Georgiou’s huge warship. Burnham still had a kind of hesitation on his face. Because he knows that the Georgiou he is going to stand in front of is not the Starfleet Captain Georgiou he knows, but a completely different cruel ruler. This mental stress seemed very real to me. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZstM8wEeGTTpWpaAMLhNpPqLtMRw9E7zX4Jt7NxZYnUM/Screenshot_20260523_184218.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmemvV7ZHhhikfxspGrER2ZVBm8mP9Ni2z3eAyb9tEqpfU/Screenshot_20260523_184228.jpg Michael Burnham’s character was extraordinary in this episode. Throughout the episode, he tried to control his emotions and manage the situation. On the one hand, he had to manage both sides, his own safety on the one hand, and the responsibility of getting the Discovery crew home on the other. Burnham's performance and her dialogues seemed to me to be one of the strongest parts of the episode. The atmosphere of the episode became even heavier after seeing Empress Philippa Georgiou. Seeing Giorgio from the Mirror Universe made me think how much power can change a person's character. Although he is cruel, his weakness towards Burnham was sometimes visible. Michelle Yeoh's performance was truly extraordinary. The scenes became more vivid when his presence was on screen. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZdRVi12bzJ99esguGkAAF2oHuafHrU5eC1Hvgh33XcLj/Screenshot_20260523_184245.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSSqxhKX4bTv7PMuNgRxtySWG8HcagDWCSyrMPifqBXbr/Screenshot_20260523_184237.jpg Captain Gabriel Lorca is the most mysterious character in this episode. From the beginning to the end, there was a kind of unease surrounding him. He always seemed to know more than the others. In many scenes, it seemed that he was hiding some big plan. When Burnham began to understand the truth towards the end, I was also surprised. The character we had been seeing one way for so long had another truth hidden within it. On the other hand, there was another important story going on on the USS Discovery. Paul Stamets was still trapped inside the Mycelial Network. I found these parts very emotional. Especially when Stamets is confronted with the memories of Dr. Hugh Culber, the scenes are heart-wrenching. The depth of their relationship and Stamets' mental anguish are shown very beautifully. At the same time, the mystery of the Mycelial Network also begins to become clearer. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbMbb7ndhgGzCDEAp8oqd95gKLvbWQXa2mcN9sJxriVD4/Screenshot_20260523_184316.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVTNGfg5vXXjDYprMkJYSHNbdSzQV6rpznRMLcfTC3ice/Screenshot_20260523_184333.jpg The character of Saru was also very important in this episode. This officer who always follows the rules seems much stronger here. He understands that Ash Tyler has big problems inside. That's why he seeks L'Rel's help. Saru's patience, leadership, and sense of responsibility impressed me in this episode. The parts of Ash Tyler and L'Rel were also very important to the story. The mystery that has been building about Tyler's identity for so long begins to become clearer here. His inner conflict and mental breakdown were worth watching. L'Rel is also a character who cannot be easily called good or bad. She is loyal to her people, but she also has human feelings. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmemvV7ZHhhikfxspGrER2ZVBm8mP9Ni2z3eAyb9tEqpfU/Screenshot_20260523_184228.jpg Although Tilly was not seen for much time in this episode, she was still present with the same positive energy as before. I liked her concern for Stamets and her sense of responsibility as a friend. Even in small moments, Tilly's character can make a place in the audience's mind. The biggest strength of this episode was its storytelling. On the one hand, political intrigue, on the other hand, personal relationships, and at the same time, scientific mysteries—everything was beautifully blended together. No scene felt redundant. Every moment seemed to lay the foundation for the next big event. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmctDuC6M71j16JjeTFAKowgHTWc46TB2DAGuJeu9uKPPK/Screenshot_20260523_184351.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmetx2LJhBpLdik5XdyHGkm9BDbdicssrKAbTtUEhHd8rv/Screenshot_20260523_184414.jpg The visual effects and set design also have to be said separately. The splendor of the Mirror Universe, the palace-like environment of Empress Georgio, and the spaceship scenes were truly extraordinary. While watching each scene, it seemed that the creators had worked with a lot of care. Overall, Vaulting Ambition is one of the best episodes of the entire first season for me. As the characters develop, so do the mysteries that are revealed that make the audience's interest in the next episodes increase several times. Especially the surprise at the end made me even more excited to watch the next episode. IMDb Rating: 7.9/10 My Rating: 9/10 After watching this episode, I felt that Star Trek: Discovery is not just a story of space exploration; it is also a story of faith, identity, power, and sacrifice. And that is why “Vaulting Ambition” will be a memorable episode for me. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@mirzaiqi/star-trek-discovery-season-1-episode-12-movie-review--95e)

summary.title: Dos en uno, restauración y disfrute // Two in one: dining and enjoyment.
summary.body:
<div class=text-justify>





![1000253199.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/AKVWqSEu57uGXkPZXRyETt17YKPg5x7DaT14Eh2tdsFyZ3rZeiFcCcA4nvU5DL6.jpg)











Hola amigos de #hive y en especial a la comunidad de @homesolutions , como siempre espero que se encuentren bien al igual que sus familiares y amigos. En el día de hoy paso por acá para mostrarles como restauré un juego de sala viejo y le di un nuevo uso. Resulta que hace algún tiempo me compré un juego de sala nuevo, pues ya el que tenía estaba bastante malito y decidí cambiarlo, pero cuando uno le toma cariño a las cosas no hay corazón para deshacerse de ellas, así que decidí restaurarlos y darles un nuevo uso. 



![1000253200.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/241tjattUfTYD4dBTKvMpqDR51QoBxo5rGpbt62SFYhUCezGmV6DPMTghGpt4cnvhbbtm.jpg)



Bueno les cuento, resulta que mi casa es muy calurosa y el único lugar bien fresco es el balcón del mi casa, y justo ahí no tenía muebles aún, así que lo primero que hice fue que los puse en este lugar y después me dispuse a repararlos, pues la verdad les tengo mucho cariño, ya que fueron los primeros que tuve y no quería deshacerme de ellos. Sin pensar mucho en ello y sin perder el impulso, busque las cositas que necesitaba para ello y puse manos a la obra, pues como dicen por ahí para luego es tarde. 




![1000253201.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23xpH5ZnrF6pxFGc1cf8p94ScCdFLoHSFn4cSsSY23oLuc1pc7qhqohLHDC611D4qFtrC.jpg)



Lo primero que hice fue quitarle a los muebles la pajilla que tenía, que la misma ya estaba bastante rota y viejita, así que decidí quitarla por completo, sin pensar, tomé un cuchillo que era la herramienta que tenía para eso, y poco a poco lo fui quitando todo con cuidado para no dañarme, pues estaban agarradas con clavitos. Luego de terminar todo, los sacudí muy bien y quedó justo en la madera, listo para dar pintura. 



![1000253202.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23zm32SSBByg6tQZVJzRbi1tk11fAhJfZsyhFqk35TUbzYT8p2dR39LyctgUHS57gQkA8.jpg)




Casi todos en mi casa está pintado de blanco y esta no sería la excepción, pues me gusta mucho este color y a la vista todo luce con más limpieza, así que lo prefiero siempre. Así que sin pensar tomé la pintura y comencé a pintar todo el mueble y también las butaquitas, cosa de que quedara todo parejo y bonito. Esto me tomo varios días, pues solo con una mano de pintura no quedaba bien, así que tuve que esperar y después le di otra mano más de pintura para que quedara parejita. Cuando ya estuvo listo de pintura, pues tome varias esponjas que tenía en casa y les hice unos cojines para que estuvieran más cómodos. Tomé unos forros y se los coloqué para que quedaran más bonitos y se los puse también. Así que quedaron restaurados y cómodos.




![1000253203.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23wqyUGYUE5BCMHnRqHFUFpFRHY5EhMab8a1Bc6MDUv9XjQ9SkHfQWNzJzJxxqN6Y2NHf.jpg)





Bueno la verdad resolví dos problemas, otro espacio más en casa del cual disfrutar y tomar fresco y restauré los muebles de los cuales no me quería deshacer. La verdad disfruto mucho de este nuevo espacio y cada tarde tomo mi cafecito cómoda y fresca en estas tardes tan calurosas de apagón, todavía me falta por embellecedor un poco más este pequeño rincón de mi casa, pero la verdad que ya como esta lo voy disfrutando muchísimo. Yo sin más me despido de ustedes y espero que esta pequeña restauración les haya servido de algo en cuanto a ideas para el hogar, un saludo especial tengan todos y feliz día.



![1000253204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariolisrnaranjo/23yx3ingGiPkwqLvLwz8y71rmezZ2cwc2jDDaG9wcb1dvoKPai6iX4dSgLYJA8HyvpqoG.jpg)

‎ Hello, #hive friends, and especially the @homesolutions community. As always, I hope you and your family and friends are doing well. Today I’m stopping by to show you how I restored an old living room set and gave it a new purpose. It turns out that a while back I bought a new living room set, since the one I had was in pretty bad shape and I decided to replace it. But when you grow attached to things, you just can’t bring yourself to get rid of them, so I decided to restore them and give them a new purpose. Well, here’s the story: it turns out my house gets really hot, and the only cool spot is the balcony, and I didn’t have any furniture there yet. So the first thing I did was put the old set out there, and then I set about fixing them up—I’m really attached to them, since they were the first ones I ever had, and I didn’t want to get rid of them. Without thinking too much about it and without losing momentum, I gathered the supplies I needed and got to work, because as they say, it’s too late to do it later. The first thing I did was remove the straw from the furniture, since it was already pretty worn out and old, so I decided to take it all off. Without thinking, I grabbed a knife—the only tool I had for the job—and carefully scraped it all off bit by bit, being careful not to hurt myself, since it was secured with small nails. After finishing everything, I shook it out really well, and it was left just the bare wood, ready for a coat of paint. Almost everything in my house is painted white, and this wouldn’t be an exception, since I really like this color and it makes everything look cleaner, so I always prefer it. So without thinking twice, I grabbed the paint and started painting the entire piece of furniture and the little chairs too, so everything would look even and nice. This took me several days, since one coat of paint wasn’t enough, so I had to wait and then apply another coat to make it even. Once the painting was done, I took some sponges I had at home and made cushions for them so they’d be more comfortable. I took some fabric and put them on so they’d look nicer, and I put those on too. So they ended up restored and comfortable. Well, to be honest, I solved two problems: I gained another space at home to enjoy and stay cool, and I restored the furniture I didn’t want to get rid of. I really enjoy this new space, and every afternoon I have my coffee comfortably and coolly during these hot afternoons with power outages. I still need to spruce up this little corner of my house a bit more, but honestly, I’m already enjoying it so much just the way it is. Without further ado, I’ll say goodbye to you all, and I hope this little restoration project has given you some ideas for your own homes. Special greetings to everyone, and have a great day.

summary.title: Important Announcement Regarding The Future of Rising Star
summary.body:
![risingstar_logo.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/risingstargame/AK6XSQk5wcx52Eu84ujZa4t4ssjp9xfQKWQ24GrmYUFfxFRKqUDrtEvfDX5Gzqf.png)

# Good News and Bad News

- First the bad news - Rising Star will be shutting down in it's current form.
- The good news - Blockchain Gaming, run by @wagginston, will take over the management of the game and will be working with the Rising Star community to relaunch it taking everyone's feedback into account. I (Jux) will also be part of this new team as an advisor and some of the developers in the community have agreed to be involved in various ways.

# Weren't You Going To Make The Game Self-Sustainable?

Yes it is true that I have been working towards this goal since this long bear market started however a few things have happened that have meant this is not happening fast enough and the costs are now too prohibitive for this to work anytime soon.

- Firstly the HBD interest rate dropped from 20% to 12%, that's quite a difference and had an immediate hit on our plan.
- Secondly our hosting company increased their prices
- Thirdly HIVE has not started to recover and I really had hoped that it would have done so by now but the entire crypto market is struggling at the moment. Things do seem to be indicating that we are likely to be at a bottom and recovery should happen in the future but we could still be many months from that recovery starting.


# The Straws That Broke The Camel's Back

A couple of things happened in the last week that were the last straw - some of the Hive Engine bridges were hacked and some HIVE & Hive Engine nodes shut down.
I have tried to get the game running again on different nodes but none of them have worked. Even if I could get them working I have had issues in the past where the game was blocked from using them after a while as we put a lot of calls in.
I had also started accumulated some SWAP.ETH & SWAP.SOL and those funds were stolen during the hack. They weren't large amounts but were part of the plan.

# The Next Steps
I will be cancelling the current hosting contract soon and if possible will leave the game running until they shut down the server so you can at least play and have a think about what features you would like to see in the relaunched game.

I will hand over management of STARPRO & STARBITS to Blockchain Gaming and will stop selling those tokens. 

The Rising Star discord will probably be the place that Waggi wants to discuss things so I will keep that going.

# Conclusion
It has been a lot of fun running Rising Star for over 6 years. I have learned a lot and met some amazing people, many of whom I now consider friends.
I want to thank everyone who has supported the game through the good times and the hard times and hope that you will continue to support Waggi and his new team as they work towards relaunching in the future. Please keep in touch with him in [Discord](https://discord.gg/dbB6Jc7) so that you end up with the game you really want and can enjoy for years to come.

Lastly a massive thank you to the two people that have been with me since the beginning and have worked for almost nothing, @theturtleproject and @nupulse. Rising Star would not have been possible without you!

Cheers and rock on \m/
Jux.

summary.body:
>I explored this ability only a short while ago and have since tested it multiple times under various battle conditions; based on that very big experience, I can confidently say that it is truly an exceptional ability. Typically, abilities designed to buff cards tend to have a specific bias—for instance, the Inspire ability increases the attack power of melee cards by +1, yet the inherent chance of those attacks missing still remains. Similarly, while other cards might boost the attack power of magic attackers, Shadow Focus stands out as a unique ability of its kind, encapsulating a multitude of powers within itself. However, activating it requires that the card possessing this ability be positioned at the very end of your lineup; consequently, the card remains unable to attack until it reaches the frontline. Yet, during this interim period, the enemy is also unable to target it, as it becomes Camouflaged. These constitute the powers that Shadow Focus bestows upon the card—but the magic of the Shadow Focus does not end there.

\n\n

>In addition to allowing the user to camouflage themselves, this ability boosts the attack power of all allied cards in the team by +1. Furthermore—and it is worth noting—the Shadow Focus ability makes absolutely no distinction when it comes to increasing attack powers; that is to say, it makes no difference how many melee attackers, ranged attackers, or magic attackers are present in your team. Moreover, it does not even matter how many cards in your team possess more than one type of attack power. Every single type of attack power possessed by the team's cards is increased by +1. Consequently, if you happen to have cards with multiple types of attack power—as was the case in <a target=\
>this specific battle of mine, where I included \

—their stats receive a simultaneous boost. Azr the Relentless originally possessed 2 Melee and 2 Magic attack power; however, upon the activation of Shadow Focus, these stats increased to 3 Melee and 3 Magic attack power. Similarly, the attack power of every other card in the team was also increased by +1, a benefit that extended to both the melee attackers and the magic attackers alike.

\n\n
>But this is not the end of the magic of the Shadow Focus ability. Furthermore, all allied cards gain the \

ability; this ensures that every card becomes resolute regarding its attacks—meaning that if, for any reason, one of your cards misses an attack, it immediately performs a second, identical attack. Consequently, the likelihood of your cards' attacks missing is significantly reduced. Moreover, if you demonstrate strategic acumen in your choice of Archon, you can inflict an even more devastating impact upon your opponent. For instance, in the context of this specific battle, I selected Akane—an Archon of the Dragon Element—thereby granting her \

ability to two of my heavy magic cards. As a result, even before the battle had officially begun, the Ambush attacks executed by those two cards had already dealt substantial damage to my opponent. And you, too, would agree that building pressure on the opponent right from the start gives you an edge in the game—something that has a significant impact on the final outcome.

\n\n

>Splinterlands isn't an easy place, but that's what makes it even more fun. A perfect strategy takes into account many factors, including stats, abilities, rulesets, mana caps, and more. That's why it's even more important to consider all these factors when developing a strategy. Add good cards to your deck, but also work on improving your strategies, and strive to win as many battles as possible!🔥\n\n

summary.body:
I have probably missed the topic for your community, but it was the video that I wanted to share... so it was perfect to do it here... 😃

> I’ve always connected better with people older than me, and so I taught for over 12 years to older adults up to the age of 85. But life leads us to connect with many people, and I’ve also worked with teenagers and young adults, and adapting is important. 

That was one of the clearest things that I noticed in the video! I remember when I was in elementary school, and it was so much easier for me to talk and socialize with my teachers than with my school buddies! And then, when I opened my PC gaming club, in my mid-twenties, it was so easy to connect with teenagers and kids who would visit the club... And there was a huge gap between those older than me and those youngsters... There was no way for them to communicate with each other, and my generation was like a \

between those two worlds... 

It's interesting how it was easy to LIVE that, but I never thought about it, or searched for a reason... Finding this short video was revealing, and I would say, useful to understand myself better...

PS. Thanks for creating this community, I will try to share more interesting videos in the future... When I stumble upon some... 😃

summary.title: A Quiet Story Inside Four Walls
summary.body: There is something special about black and white photography. When colors disappear, emotions become louder. This photo captures an ordinary room, but ordinary moments often carry extraordinary feelings.

/>

Sunlight quietly enters through the window, spreading soft light across the room while shadows rest in every corner. The hanging clothes, the simple furniture, and the calm atmosphere together tell a story of everyday life. It reminds us that beauty does not always live in grand places; sometimes it lives in the spaces where we spend our normal days.  
Black and white images have a way of slowing time. They allow us to notice details we usually ignore and appreciate the peaceful moments hidden in our daily routine.

summary.title: Playoffs Week 10 Saturday Previews
summary.body:
https://images.hive.blog/DQmXYYCGnjdxomTS2xELQRZAiUktKarEGVzZ8JgeNga1h73/Degradatie.jpg
These are previews from matches involving Belgian Teams with all the latest on team news, player form, and injuries along with my personal betting angles, ...

/> Only one weekend to go in the regular season and similar to many teams with questionable motivation, I'm also kind of already in a mental mode where I'm done with this season looking forward to the next one. So it's just some basic notes and likely limited betting action starting with the match for the final place in 1st league next season followed by 3 Playoff 2 matches played at the same time.

Dender vs Lommel

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmTXg2fakZbc9qyr51zEBq1mtiieCptbpBuLF4uVyjjREh/image.pngThis likely will be the most interesting match of the day as there is everything to play for. Lommel went into the first match at home opening as the clear -0.2 favorite but by closing time the line was moved to a DNB line. They started out taking the initiative while Lommel lured at the counters which didnt' last that long. Around minute 20 it was an even mlatch but Dender made the 0-1. Both teams had quite high efficiency and Dender was 1-2 in the lead at minute 82' when they still gave it away somehow. Overall it was a pretty close affair where you felt that Dender has a bit more quality if it was not for them giving it away once again. Nerves will be high today on both sides and a 1-goal home win for Dender will take it to extra time which I see as a not so unlikely scenario which made me tale 0.1 unit on Dender To Win By 1 Goal @ 4.140. Overall it remains a match between a 1st and 2nd division team where there is a home advantage and a clear goal ahead to win for Dender which I think they are capable of enough times to take a tiny 0.1 bet also on Dender -0.5 @ 2.224. The most likely scenario is for Dender to take the initiative without overly taking risks and Lommel to lure on the counters.

OH Leuven vs Genk

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmbFcX3ZoSPvaPjajGhUTKCRgsuQhVgk47Gbnibsrv2NCk/image.pngGenk once again failed last match at home against Antwerp not getting further than a 0-0 draw as it was not good enough with many key missings (Heymans, Karetsas, Bangoura, Sternberg, Medina). They are still without Karetsas and Sternberg while Smets who is important in the defense also is injured and don't have matters into their own hands anymore. They are obligated to take the win away against OHL and hope Standard doens't win at home to still take the 1st place. So at least at some point in this match, risk will need to be taken. OHL plays their last match of the season now at home and have been in a bit better flow while at the same time it's hard to trust them. Genk failing today would be typical of their season but OHL losing also would be typical of their season. My main angle in this match is that sooner or later, risk will have to be taken but that doesn't buy me much as the total line is set at 3 goals. No Pre-Game Bets

Antwerp vs Westerlo

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmVbK4tAp1tm9bhV1tPNVC6kjgmnwLR6p3HJjavDjfcUgn/image.pngThis is a match with nothing to play for aside ending the season in a good way. I would argue that Antwerp has the motivational edge because of the home advantage but Westerlo has the slight quality edge. Antwerp has been giving more youghsters a chance but I kind of expect them to at least start with their best squad now. Westerlo is expected to play with 2nd Goalkeeper Van Langendonck who will be leaving while otherwise is also expected to play with their best 11. This one should be set up for an entertaining match where more importance is put on offense compared to the defense which also refelcts in the odds as the line is set at 3.25. I at least need to see more and get some confirmation before possibly taking a small bet on that. No Pre-Game Bets

Standard vs Charleroi

>https://images.hive.blog/DQmdFmUEry73MNnpAJpG1ADyGBE8DdydrehPgVCdU2JDiNY/image.pngStandard kind of got them in a good spot somehow as with limited quality and defensive fundamentals, they managed to get multiple hold-ups without really dominating or showing willingness to go forward even of they kind of had to since they always needed to take wins. Today in that sense is no different as they also are forced to take the win but I can't see them all of a sudden go forward like crazy aside mabe for the 1st 10 minutes without being able to keep that up. Charleroi has nothing to play for but this match stays the shocl wallon and there is no pressure for them so I would not be surprised if they play more freely. Standard also tends to have better results on the road where they are not abligated to play offense. I expect a match where Standard shows a lot of energy and willingness to go forward at the start which will die down after which it might become another match where patience is key but when there is no goal should result in an open end again. My 2 leans are Standard to create the 1st corner and for Charleroi to score at least 1 goal. I also expect Standard to push and Charleroi to crawl back in case the score becomes 0-1. for now I'm just keeping all these options in mind for potential in-game bets. No Pre-Game Bets

summary.title: Some experiences are never a thing of the past.
summary.body:
> 
 

## Hello, everyone.
I welcome you to my blog and another wonderful edition of the Hive Learner's featured post. One thing in life I have come to realise is that so many people don't believe in the existence of a particular thing until it has happened to them or they have experienced or must have seen it happen. There are many people out there who, when someone shares their experience, will tend to doubt or argue that such a thing is not possible, but they only doubt because they have not seen it happen or experienced it, and for that reason will find it hard to believe. 

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUJXou6JEdU1bsHu5x5nk2G95NKReGWhAFttxR7fUWT7p/1779531717667.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-in-black-and-brown-camouflage-uniform-holding-red-smoke-Sa04XETPPx0)

I was one of those who did not believe that an experience from the past would come back to haunt you; back then I'd say unless it was spiritual, but that perspective changed, and I saw things for myself. Living in a military base really did expose me to seeing things I was not even supposed to see, and at quite a young age, I found it difficult to believe that a past experience can come back to haunt you unless spirituality was now involved, but after seeing a few things play out, that belief disappeared because I have now seen for myself that past experience can keep coming back, and there was nothing spiritual about it. 

When the insurgency in the northern part of Nigeria got really bad, at least 80% of the soldiers from the base were deployed there, leaving the base almost empty and just filled with women and children. The truth is that many of the soldiers that left for that deployment did not come back the same; some were able to handle the situation calmly, while that of others was very loud, and the entire neighbourhood knew about it. A friend's dad, after the deployment, came back, and things were never the same again for the family.

At least twice a week the entire neighbourhood gathers at their house to try and calm his father down and remind him that he was back home because if allowed, he would zoom off and be ready to keep shouting and screaming \

in the Hausa language; both family and neighbours will have to hold him down and keep reminding him he was home and no longer at the forefront. It was embarrassing for my friend, but there was nothing he could do about it. We just tell him to stay strong and not try to maybe cut the dad off because of recent developments, as it is not even the dad's fault either. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNi64YiQezDzTGjrKcz92QrTg7RKSVb3f7YYUpFGD9Sze/1779531717621.jpg) [Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/soldier-gives-water-to-wounded-comrade-on-stretcher-Ua5BTQAohoQ) That is just one experience; there are many more, some of which, after the experience, you dare not sneak up on them because they will react with an action that will leave you injured. PTSD and post-trauma are real; people are dealing with it, and one of the best ways I saw them handle it and settle theirs back then was reassurance and support from loved ones. Whenever it happens, loved ones are there to calm them down, and over time, the number of times it happens reduced drastically. Reassurance from loved ones and being surrounded by loved ones I think is one of the best of ways one can deal with any trauma.

summary.title: Butter cookies 🧈 with peanuts 🥜
summary.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hoy preparé para la merienda familiar unas galletas de mantequilla con maní, una receta sencilla, fácil de preparar y con un resultado muy delicioso; ideal para compartir en familia, te muestro la preparación

> **
ENGLISH
** Today I made some peanut butter cookies for our family snack—a simple recipe that’s easy to make and turns out delicious; perfect for sharing with the family. Here’s how I made them ![1000903974.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23xKtGdG2MM5H87KCXAwjKdaaJ3zVKyF32qTX68BfvEiUyD8zSe1rYQBse4AdWGjXRHg4.jpg)

> **
INGREDIENTES
** harina de trigo, azúcar, huevo, mantequilla, lluvia de maní

> **
INGREDIENTS
** wheat flour, sugar, eggs, butter, chopped peanuts ![1000903895.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/EoChb2XsYdMXgUVqcKVzesbrVbtPpz5brw5kf8j5MEt85UXw1Ga8CLxsVPfSRSUTXEn.jpg)

> **
PROCEDIMIENTO
** En una taza agregó la mantequilla y el azúcar, mezclo muy bien hasta que esta se disuelva; luego incorporo el huevo, el harina de trigo y continúo mezclando hasta que esté homogénea; agregue un poco de vainilla y finalmente incorporo la lluvia de maní mezclando muy bien. Luego tomo pequeñas porciones, coloco en una bandeja y decoro por encima con maní ; llevo al horno a 180 grados por 20 minutos

> **
PROCEDURE
** In a bowl, add the butter and sugar, and mix thoroughly until the sugar dissolves; then add the egg and flour, and continue mixing until the mixture is smooth; add a little vanilla, and finally stir in the chopped peanuts, mixing well. Then take small portions, place them on a baking sheet, and top with peanuts; bake at 180 degrees for 20 minutes ![1000903896.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23wMUMYbwTKnWbVHmUrMt5Bh4S1osRcQaNmG4erowzc13YsFFiAwyqx2LvN47MdS7y4Tg.jpg) ![1000903897.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/Eoc6Xwe6ZYYoDPkt1APXVaCPP47qzJoW6cMGMQyaTPoftKYT9txsMCdZAmwmCMTrfUz.jpg) ![1000903898.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tvgMrkqKdecMRA4ZkiCanT82Lr7miG1VNKifgr1Hc2GdbpMQx4NcT3utNBwgmLBMF1T.jpg) ![1000903934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23tvefc5E94EinnS68ja1x6jHcTzGc113ZSgcLwmHHE6YfCyJAJF59HcfB9dQdggYM8An.jpg) ![1000903969.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yessi08/23vhywLfqey2dRU4RCV8uaf3jbaNGircfELrKAgmvnrg7hGi6h86iJCzRvCiVsNAEhPQe.jpg)

summary.title: Moonlit Silence – A Walk Through the Night
summary.body: There’s something deeply calming about empty streets at night. The soft glow of the lamps, the quiet pathway, and the peaceful moonlight create a moment where everything feels still and reflective.

/>

This scene reminded me how beautiful silence can be. The warm lights against the dark night sky gave the alley a cinematic feeling, while the shadows added depth and mystery to the composition.

Night photography has a unique charm. It allows ordinary places to look magical through lighting, contrast, and atmosphere. In this shot, I wanted to preserve the natural mood of the environment without over-editing, keeping the image realistic and emotional.

The moon above the pathway became the perfect finishing touch, guiding the viewer’s eyes through the frame and adding balance to the composition.

Photography like this reminds me that beauty often exists in the quietest moments around us.

**What emotions does this photo give you?**

summary.body: The EV vs. combustion cost debate is shifting fast — electricity prices have diverged significantly by region. In Europe, where industrial electricity rates are up 60%+ since 2021, the operating cost advantage of EVs has shrunk dramatically. But in regions with cheap renewables (solar-heavy areas), EVs are still dramatically cheaper per mile. The same dynamic is playing out in Bitcoin mining — geography is becoming the primary cost differentiator. It's not that the technology is failing, it's that the input costs are regionalizing in ways the models didn't predict.
