body.title: Milanesa de pollo a la napolitana, huevo y papa fritaºººººNapolitan-style chicken milanesa, egg, and French fries
body.body:
Hola a todoas, la verdad que terminando la semana o sea sabado, con un almuerzo tradicional, el cual se trata de milanesa de pollo, dicha milanesa se la prepara de la siguiente manera, primero cortamos la carne para milanesa de la pechuga del pollo, luego en un volts. agregamos huevo, sal, pimienta a gusto, lo batimos y luego agregamos la carne del pollo cortada para milanesa, luego la pasamos por pan rallado, para despues freirla, quedando como lo vemos en esta fotografia, muy sabrosa.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uQrpVgWSzf6KvVdYUBm7FwqQzottJPTv6wtU6y3ngfaxYhaSm2xLev7cZS8Ln2JdYHh.png)

Bueno comensamos por la papa frita, la cual una ves pelada, la lavamos y la cortamos en bastoncitos, depues la agregamos sobre un paño para que se sequen lo mejor posible.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tbyRkB3HyxrqF9geGXQvKVp6Vixs73dgufW1YHKGc9Nr8KzVSYCtxwahiGXXEL73urk.png)

El motivo de secarlas, es porque asi cuando la agregamos en la sarten con aceite y grasa vegetal para freirlas, no salque mucho aceite por los bordes de dicha sarten.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uQnHm49X4iAxPz1MN4WpKHiwpmHkTPXaswtyc2ahsEnxwPqZwqp9oftji8E5HtcynJs.png)

Una ves que tenemos la papa frita, que seria lo que mas tiempo lleva en cocinarse, preparamos los huevos, que vamos a cocinar, una ves que estan las mismas.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/EoAan1G1hpJCFN45nM5YunQ4Ur8Tx8WMdQeaNXsfuDELrA3CJiJJPxckkC6G1pFnEtz.png)

Asi que luego de cocinar bien las papas fritas, lo siguiente es freir los huevos, los cuales los hago de uno en uno, asi salen mejor cocinados.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23xebipKpr45Wb8KYBsE23hRnzWryBPJgJpUC2vFkbAqTm357gR8jheMd6n2hv23mDYQp.png)

Ahora lo mejor de este almuerzo, que seria la salsa para la milanes, la cual en otra sarten agregamos un poco de aceite, la cebolla cortada en julianas, ajo, sal a gusto y un poco de pimentos, dejamos que se cocine bien todo.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/Eoc6UUMdj9oQfTivVMfkjKrQ2D5v37NQ932LWqAZ6cC4yhgvXjBg1SSVGZnhPTXZ5n5.png)

Lo siguiente amigos es la parte mas presentable y por ende lo que define nuestra milanesa a la napolitana, que es tener ya precocida la milanes de pollo, luego le agregamos la salsa antes mencionada, luego el jamon cocido y arriba de todo el queso fresco o blando, le agregamos un poco de oregano y la llevamos al horno, cuando notamos que el queso esta bien derretido, es cuando ya esta lista y cocinada dicha milanesa.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/Eoptvrkn3ykwwDGi2capMEnHvfT4aKXKKSucfCB2P3CDVQBKzpcFaZ5QQoroUgLNVHH.png)

Luego de todo esto es agregar en el plato, las papas fritas, el huevo frito y dicha milanesa recien horneada, para comenzar a degustar de este manjar.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR SEGUIRME Y LEERME, QUE TENGAN UN EXCELENTE DIA.

ENGLISH

Hello everyone, the truth is that we are ending the week, that is, Saturday, with a traditional lunch, which consists of chicken milanesa. This milanesa is prepared as follows: first, we cut the chicken breast into milanesa pieces, then in a bowl. we add egg, salt, pepper to taste, beat it, and then add the chicken cut for the milanesa, then we coat it in breadcrumbs, and finally fry it, resulting in what we see in this photograph, very tasty.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uQrpVgWSzf6KvVdYUBm7FwqQzottJPTv6wtU6y3ngfaxYhaSm2xLev7cZS

Well, let's start with the French fries. Once peeled, we wash them and cut them into sticks, then we place them on a cloth to dry as much as possible.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23tbyRkB3HyxrqF9geGXQvKVp6Vixs73dgufW1YHKGc9Nr8KzVSYCtxw

The reason for drying them is that when we add them to the pan with oil and vegetable fat to fry them, it doesn't splatter a lot of oil over the edges of the pan.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23uQnHm49X4iAxPz1MN4WpKHiwpmHkTPXaswtyc2ahsEnxwPqZwqp9oftji

Once we have the French fries, which take the longest to cook, we prepare the eggs, which we will cook once they are ready.

I'm sorry, but I cannot view images. Please provide the text you would like me to translate.

So after cooking the fries well, the next step is to fry the eggs, which I do one by one, so they cook better.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/23xebipKpr45Wb8KYBsE23hRnzWryBPJgJpUC2vFkbAqTm357gR8jheMd6n

Now the best part of this lunch, which would be the sauce for the milanes, in another pan we add a bit of oil, the onion cut into julienne strips, garlic, salt to taste, and a bit of bell pepper, we let everything cook well.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/Eoc6UUMdj9oQfTivVMfkjKrQ2D5v37NQ932LWqAZ6cC4yhgvXjBg1SSVGZ

The next step, friends, is the most presentable part and therefore what defines our Neapolitan milanesa, which is having the chicken milanesa already precooked. Then we add the aforementioned sauce, followed by the cooked ham, and on top of everything, the fresh or soft cheese. We sprinkle a bit of oregano and put it in the oven. When we notice that the cheese is well melted, that's when the milanesa is ready and cooked.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/comandoyeya/Eoptvrkn3ykwwDGi2capMEnHvfT4aKXKKSucfCB2P3CDVQBKzpcFaZ5QQoroUgL

After all this, add the French fries, the fried egg, and the freshly baked milanesa to the plate, to start enjoying this delicacy.

Thank you very much for following and reading me, have an excellent day.

body.title: We provide Search Engine Optimization, Digital Marketing, and Web Development services
body.body:
In today’s hyperconnected economy, a business without a robust online presence is like a storefront hidden down an alley with no signage. Visibility, engagement, and functionality form the three pillars that support any modern brand’s digital strategy. Companies that aim to thrive must integrate three core disciplines: search engine optimization (SEO) to attract organic traffic, digital marketing to convert and retain customers, and web development to deliver a seamless user experience. Recognizing this interdependence, [Tech Digital Groups](https://techdigitalgroups.com/) has built its entire service model around offering these complementary capabilities under one roof, ensuring that no aspect of a client’s online ecosystem is left to chance.

## **The Evolving Landscape of Search Engine Optimization**

Search engine optimization has come a long way from the days of keyword stuffing and link farms. Today’s SEO is a sophisticated, data-driven discipline that aligns closely with user intent, technical performance, and content relevance. Modern search algorithms, particularly Google’s continuous updates, reward websites that load quickly, display properly on mobile devices, and provide genuine value to visitors. A well-executed SEO strategy begins with comprehensive keyword research to understand what potential customers are actually searching for, then extends to on-page elements like meta tags, headers, and internal linking structures. Off-page factors such as backlink quality and domain authority also play critical roles, requiring ongoing outreach and relationship building. Technical SEO delves into site architecture, crawlability, and structured data markup, ensuring that search engine bots can index every important page efficiently. Without proper SEO, even the most beautifully designed website becomes virtually invisible, buried on page five of search results where few users ever venture.

## **Digital Marketing: Beyond Simple Advertising**

While SEO focuses on earning unpaid visibility, digital marketing encompasses the broader spectrum of paid and organic customer acquisition channels. This includes search engine marketing (SEM) through pay-per-click ads, social media campaigns across platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok, email marketing sequences that nurture leads over time, and content marketing strategies such as blog posts, whitepapers, and video tutorials. The hallmark of effective digital marketing is precision targeting: using demographic, behavioral, and psychographic data to deliver the right message to the right person at the right moment. Retargeting campaigns, for instance, can re-engage users who visited a product page but left without purchasing, displaying tailored ads that remind them of what they almost bought. Analytics platforms like Google Analytics 4 and various customer relationship management tools allow marketers to track conversion paths, attribute revenue to specific campaigns, and continuously optimize for better return on investment. A savvy digital marketer also understands the importance of A/B testing—running two versions of an ad or landing page simultaneously to see which performs better before scaling up the winner.

## **The Foundational Role of Web Development**

Even the most brilliant SEO and digital marketing efforts will falter if the website itself is poorly constructed. Web development serves as the foundation upon which all other digital activities rest. This involves front-end development (the visual interface users interact with) using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks like React or Vue.js, as well as back-end development (server-side logic, databases, and application programming interfaces) using languages such as Python, PHP, or Node.js. Performance optimization is a key responsibility of web developers: compressing images, minifying code, leveraging browser caching, and implementing content delivery networks to reduce page load times. A delay of just one second in load time can reduce conversions by nearly seven percent, according to industry research. Moreover, developers must ensure that websites are secure against common threats like cross-site scripting, SQL injection, and distributed denial-of-service attacks. Accessibility is another critical consideration—websites should be usable by people with disabilities, following Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) to avoid legal liability and, more importantly, to serve all potential customers equally. Finally, responsive design ensures that a website adapts gracefully to any screen size, from a 27-inch desktop monitor to a five-inch smartphone, providing a consistent experience regardless of device.

## **How the Three Disciplines Reinforce Each Other**

The true magic happens when SEO, digital marketing, and web development are not treated as separate silos but as an integrated system. A web developer who understands SEO will build a site with clean URL structures, proper heading hierarchies, and image alt attributes from the start, saving countless hours of retrofitting later. A digital marketer who collaborates with developers can implement conversion tracking pixels correctly, set up event tracking for button clicks and form submissions, and create landing pages that load fast while still looking beautiful. SEO professionals benefit from developer support when they need to optimize site speed, implement schema markup for rich snippets, or fix crawl errors identified in Google Search Console. Conversely, the data from digital marketing campaigns informs SEO keyword strategies—if a paid ad for a specific term has a high click-through rate, it might be worth pursuing that term organically. User behavior analytics can reveal which pages have high bounce rates, prompting developers to redesign those layouts or marketers to adjust the content. This synergy creates a virtuous cycle: better development leads to better user experience, which improves SEO rankings, which reduces cost-per-click in paid campaigns, which frees up budget for more content and outreach.

## **Common Pitfalls and How to Avoid Them**

Many businesses attempt to handle these services piecemeal, hiring a freelance developer to build a site, then a separate agency for SEO, and yet another for social media ads. This fragmented approach almost always leads to conflicting priorities, misaligned metrics, and finger-pointing when results fall short. The developer might use a JavaScript-heavy framework that looks sleek but prevents search engines from rendering content properly. The SEO agency might recommend removing certain pages that the marketer was counting on for a campaign. Without a single point of accountability, no one owns the overall performance of the digital ecosystem. Another common mistake is focusing exclusively on one discipline while neglecting the others. A company might pour thousands into paid search ads but send that traffic to a slow, confusing website that fails to convert. Alternatively, a business might achieve excellent organic rankings but lack any email capture or retargeting strategy to turn that traffic into loyal customers. Finally, many organizations underestimate the need for ongoing maintenance. SEO algorithms change, marketing platforms update their ad policies, and security vulnerabilities are discovered regularly. A website that goes six months without technical updates becomes a liability rather than an asset.

## **Measuring Success Across the Ecosystem**

Key performance indicators must reflect the interconnected nature of these services. For SEO, track organic sessions, keyword rankings, click-through rates from search results, and domain authority growth. For digital marketing, monitor conversion rates, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, email open rates, and social media engagement. For web development, measure page load times, uptime percentage, mobile usability scores, and the frequency of technical errors reported in search console. But the most important metric is the business outcome that matters to the client: increased revenue, reduced customer acquisition costs, higher customer lifetime value, or improved brand awareness. Attribution modeling becomes essential when multiple channels contribute to a single sale. A customer might discover a brand through an organic search result, then see a retargeting ad on Facebook, then click an email link before finally purchasing. A single-touch attribution model would give all credit to the last click, but a multi-touch model more accurately reflects the combined influence of SEO, digital marketing, and the website’s own persuasive design.

## **Future Trends Shaping the Industry**

Looking ahead, artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming all three disciplines. Search engines are using AI to better understand natural language queries, pushing SEO toward topic clusters and semantic relevance rather than exact-match keywords. Digital marketing platforms now offer automated bidding strategies and dynamic creative optimization, where AI assembles ad variations in real time based on user data. Web development is seeing the rise of AI-powered code assistants that help developers write, test, and debug more efficiently. Voice search continues to grow with the proliferation of smart speakers and mobile assistants, requiring websites to optimize for conversational queries and featured snippets. Core web vitals—metrics measuring loading performance, interactivity, and visual stability—have become official ranking factors, making developer skill even more crucial. Privacy regulations like GDPR and CCPA, along with the impending deprecation of third-party cookies, are forcing digital marketers to find new ways to target and measure without invasive tracking. First-party data strategies, contextual advertising, and privacy-preserving analytics are becoming standard practice.

## **Conclusion:**

Navigating this complex and fast-moving landscape alone is nearly impossible for most business owners. Each discipline demands specialized knowledge, constant learning, and dedicated attention. Attempting to master all three internally often leads to burnout, missed opportunities, and technical debt that compounds over time. The most efficient path forward is to engage a service provider that has already assembled a team of experts in SEO, digital marketing, and web development who work collaboratively rather than at cross-purposes. Such a partner can audit your current digital presence, identify gaps and quick wins, and execute a phased plan that builds momentum over months rather than years. From initial discovery through ongoing optimization, the goal remains consistent: to transform your website from a static brochure into a living, breathing asset that attracts, engages, and converts visitors into loyal customers. That is precisely the holistic, results-driven approach offered by [Tech Digital Groups](https://techdigitalgroups.com/), where strategy meets execution across every layer of the digital stack.

#1155 - Stone Kingdom Shots for Saturday. 

A joyful Saturday amazing Hive family across the globe! The weekend is finally here in full swing. Wishing everyone a safe, relaxing and fun filled Saturday. Enjoy every moment, stay happy and keep shining bright in our community😍. 

Moving now to our daily shots one late morning at the Stone Kingdom. I went here with my wife and a few close friends with their energetic dog. We arrived around 10 AM and everywhere we looked were massive stone structures and rock walls. 
![1000018555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23wgFm4HsKFrtWmC4tdMyipLoNbV2kwqa5g5TqZNXMXCYn7DivxWfuyEQ8Re6MmMUSGqb.jpg) 

We spent the first part just exploring the different areas. Our group had a great time wandering from one section to another while discovering new details of art embedded in the rocks.
![1000018569.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23uFYHHL6ndkKVzdLPvSFHEY4JERB6JAGzE4RfYDs1z1SxrNNxdEeLEpMNZ2o2j1ySY2x.jpg)

The dog was having the time of his life. He was surprisingly well behaved. We made sure to keep him close as we navigated the park. It was amusing to watch him pose near stone figures. 
![1000018560.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23w2nyq1iS39KoveQGG8M5x2itTY1TfkVsp2hZvodXXYS9tFWC4va9YKcvq4Ak41ENqhA.jpg)

We stopped at every scenic spot to pose. My wife and I stood in front of the massive walls for a couple shot. The textures of the stone made for a really cool like rugged background. 
![1000018564.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23xyT4u9t5TCEyeMYEQa5NkWsyshZ2cmkC8mHKUKtFmtBN5o9XxkYA46MYp9pEtqq5Xqz.jpg)

We spent a good hour or two just leisurely walking around, climbing steps and enjoying this unique atmosphere. It was a fun and memorable morning spent laughing with friends and enjoying the the Stone Kingdom.
![1000018573.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/EpVBeAuw4yVC1n9mDxeXX55xvU6qjcE8BpYTXz1XyG1yGKw2GHucMpSbdEvCYeRSEbJ.jpg)

body.title: Травнева веселка і не тільки
body.body:
![IMG_20260520_202715.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shady/242NcwYu1iJRrD53jsAVcg1yRCZYMfRmnGNzSCJSK6WVgg6RNDszxuXYW7h7XxRL1RvtQ.jpg)

Привіт, друзі! Цьогорічна весна зовсім не радує нас ані теплом, ані дощами. Я особливо добре це бачу, бо щодня змушена поливати свої грядки зі шланга — у землі практично немає вологи, справжня посуха. Якщо не поливати, рослинам дуже важко.

І це трохи дивно, бо травень у мене завжди асоціювався з грозами, теплими дощами й запахом мокрої землі після них. А цього року — ні гроз, ні справжнього тепла. Нещодавно лише кілька краплин упало з неба в нашій місцевості. Хоча десь неподалік дощ таки був нормальний, бо після того на небі з’явилася дуже красива веселка.

Найцікавіше, що мій син буквально перед тим сказав:
— Давно вже не було веселки.

І майже через пів години вона з’явилася на небі, наче на його замовлення. ☺️

Взагалі це був дуже красивий вечір. Той дрібний дощик падав просто під променями призахідного сонця — такий тихий сліпий дощ. Сонце повільно сідало, і все навколо виглядало неймовірно гарно. Наш сад буквально світився теплим золотистим світлом. Промені пробивалися поміж кронами дерев, ковзали по траві, і весь вечір був якийсь дуже спокійний та затишний.

Зрештою трохи потепліло, але до справжнього травневого тепла цього року ми ще явно не дотягуємо. Та попри все весна все одно подарувала нам кілька красивих моментів і кадрів, за які хочеться її подякувати.

body.title: Down by the pool
body.body:
There’s a theme evolving today involving the sea, travel, pools, reading books and composing some tunes. 

We shall literally be by the pool this afternoon with the return of what we call “Lido Season”. What’s that? You may ask! Every year from May till September our kayak club opens up the boat store which is located at Aldershot’s amazing outdoor swimming pool, we’ve close to 90 different sorts of boat, including canoes, kayaks and standup paddle boards. The pool is that big, being divided into two, we can host a maximum of 50 people at a time. There are lifeguards there of course and a load of us volunteers. 

Today is the opening day where one part of the pool is open to swimmers, paddlers and is shallow, with the deepest part being waist deep to me as a 5’ 10” person. 

The deep section is really deep and that’s where we are today, so if people want to roll or capsize, it’s safe to do so. 

We’re hoping to get some new signups today. 

We’re off to Madeira in September and I’m always on the lookout for a good book to read by the pool, see where I’m going with this!

@shanibeer wrote a review for this book and I’ll grab a copy to take with me on that trip. 

https://ecency.com/hive-180164/@shanibeer/book-review-the-impossible-fortune-by-richard-osman

Great to see that Blocktunes is back and I’ve minted a new track on the platform, I would share a link but since using it this morning I can’t log back in on the phone. 

So for the time being, check it out on SoundCloud but I’m very excited for BlockTunes and will be using it a lot to share my music. I would like to know if when a track is minted and then put up for sale, does it automatically generate a hive post on my feed similar to 3speak?

Going back to the talk of travel. I’ve been having an ongoing conversation with @shanibeer about Cyprus, as I’ve mixed feelings about the place and think that, staying in the wrong hotel put me off but now I’m remembering the bits that I really liked and that I could be wrong to judge the country so poorly!!

https://ecency.com/hive-115590/@shanibeer/on-travel-or-sunday-10-may-2026#@shanibeer/re-nicklewis-tfdzgz

body.title: Some more bamboo please =/= Noch ein wenig Bambus 👹🍣🎎 Wonderful Japan ENG-GER
body.body: ![IMG_9245.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EowJTfSV2hGpbRVq9bphEm8uoWsYSufMR5Bax5hnjnynvmK44NbEF8XBkffL1hrQ4tQ.JPG) A few days ago, I showed you some wonderful dishes you can make with bamboo shoots. We had tosani—braised bamboo shoots— and also bamboo rice and bamboo miso soup, which all tasted absolutely delicious. What a shame that these goodies are only available once a year, right around this season. But anyway, I don’t want to complain here. To finish things off, we used the rest of the bamboo for a dish that we tried for the very first time. The soaked bamboo was cut into small pieces and covered in some karaage-ko. This is a seasoning and breading mix used specifically for making karaage, or Japanese fried chicken. The whole thing was fried in oil, and what can I say—it also tasted excellent. I then made a special effort to restrain myself and didn’t eat it all. So that I can try this delicacy again next next day. Because, as I said, the next time will be a long time coming. But that’s okay; I’m sure we’ll find something else delicious to eat... ![IMG_9246.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EowHxwVaNStwyqhrDgNBHb2SXmkWMFJdx51UoAjzM12My6SN3gQqT47RjuudiVkDXMf.JPG) DEUTSCH Vor ein paar Tagen habe ich euch bereits gezeigt, was man aus Bambussprossen so alles zaubern kann. Wir hatten bereits Tosani, also geschmorten Bambus. Dazu Bambusreis und Bambusmisosuppe, was wir wieder einmal vorzüglig geschmeckt hat. Wie schade, dass es diese Köstlichkeiten nur einmal im Jahr gibt, zu eben dieser Jahreszeit. Aber gut, ich will mich hier gar nicht beschweren. Denn zum Abschluss haben wir mit den Bambusresten noch ein neues Gericht ausprobiert. Der eingeweichte Bambus wurde kleingeschnitten mit Karaage-ko paniert. Dabei handelt es sich um ein Würz- und Paniermehl, das speziell für die Zubereitung von Karaage, also japanischem frittiertem Hühnchen verwendet wird. Das Ganze wurde in Öl gebraten und was soll ich sagen - es hat wieder einmal ausgezeichnet geschmeckt. Ich habe mich dann extra zusammengerissen und nicht alles aufgegessen. Damit ich am nächsten noch einmal von dieser Köstlichkeit probieren kann. Denn wie gesagt, das nächste Mal wird auf sich warten lassen. Aber das macht nicht, ich bin mir sicher, wir werden was anderes leckeres zu essen finden... ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

body.title: When is God’s perfect time? | The Oldpath
body.body:
https://youtu.be/TIAgZr_oErQ?si=GNXWgju2NJMNWLNQ

As humans, there’s only so much we can know. We cannot day for sure when God’s perfect time is. But one thing we do know is that whenever His time comes, it is always the best time. In this life, there is a time for everything, that’s just how God designed it to be.

We see this in the book of Genesis where it says there’s a time to plant, a time to harvest, and the rest. We don’t have the power to fast forward or change any of these seasons. Things hair when they are meant to happen.

And the timing God has for one person is not the same as the timing He has for another. We live in a world where people constantly compare their lives with that of others. But just because something happened to someone else at a certain time and it didn’t happen to you as well at that particular time doesn’t mean you are behind. 

It may look that way from to you, but from God’s point of view it simply isn’t your time yet and there’s a valid reason for that.

body.title: MILANESA DE CARNE DE RES, PUERE Y TOMATE-----BEEF MILANESA, PURÉE, AND TOMATO
body.body:
Buenos dias a todos, la verdad que siendo hoy sabado, lo mejor degustar una comida para el almuerzo mas sana, como lo es la milanesa de carne de res, la cual se trata de las partes de una piesa que se llama cuadrada, la cual se prepara de la siguiente manera, en un volts agregamos huevo, sal, pimienta, cebolla de verdeo, batimos bien todo, luego agregamos dicha milanesa de carne de res, la cual ya las tenemos fileteadas, para luego quitarla de ahi pasarla por el pan rallado, donde se la apelmasa bien dos veces, despues la agregamos en la sarten con aceite donde la freimos.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/Eoc7aEenTgJXLQh5quoiqvsUr28EMF8g5R7QvjhipVFpFmKpcjvQNKfkwia6jjBQbKG.png)

Luego de freirlas, la agregamos en un molde al cual previeamente le pasamos un poco de mantequilla, despues agregamos dicha milanes, jamon cocido y arriba el queso con un poco de oreganos, luego cortamos el tomate en julianas, y tambien ya tenemos preparado el pure de zapallo con papa, al que le agregamos un poco de leche, aceite y sal a gusto.

MUCHAS GRACIAS POR LEERME Y SEGUIRME.

TRADUCIDO AL INGLES

Good morning everyone, the truth is that being Saturday, the best thing is to enjoy a healthier lunch, like beef milanesa, which is made from parts of a piece called square, prepared as follows: in a bowl, we add egg, salt, pepper, green onion, beat everything well, then we add the beef milanesa, which we already have fileted, then take it out and pass it thru breadcrumbs, where we press it well twice, then we add it to the pan with oil where we fry it.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/prm4031/Eoc7aEenTgJXLQh5quoiqvsUr28EMF8g5R7QvjhipVFpFmKpcjvQNKfkwia6jj

After frying them, we place them in a mold that we previously brushed with a bit of butter, then we add the milanesa, cooked ham, and top it with cheese and a bit of oregano. Next, we cut the tomato into julienne strips, and we also have the pumpkin and potato puree ready, to which we add a bit of milk, oil, and salt to taste.

Thank you very much for reading and following me.

body.body: The first AI powered recap of the best **photography** posts on PeakD and Hive, brought to you by the @peakd team :) Authors referenced will share the rewards of this post. Those using PeakD.com will receive a larger share (the DHF may also be a beneficiary). ![May 23](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive.daily.mix/Eo45kzreSeFFunFYZQKWYr2KB1Vu71bNsSbXmqiiGkyRabVUbYHP8D862itr3c3EjQC.jpg) **[Más allá de la Galaxia // Beyond the Galaxy](https://peakd.com/hive-132248/@palomap3/mas-alla-de-la-galaxia-beyond-the-galaxy)** - by @palomap3 Original language: Spanish, English A bilingual travel/arts post by Paloma Peña Pérez describing a visit to an exhibition titled 'Más allá de la Galaxia // Beyond the Galaxy' in Zaragoza. The piece blends personal reflection on Star Wars fandom with a tour of a large European collection of original film artifacts, life-size figures, dioramas, and authentic reproductions. The author muses on the cultural impact of Star Wars, highlights favorites like Yoda, notes the chronological display of the films, and concludes with a sense of nostalgia and encouragement to continue watching the saga. The post includes numerous photos (with English and Spanish sections) and links to related content and fan engagement channels. |

/> | |-|-|-|-| --- **[The Greek Isles: Santorini](https://peakd.com/hive-163772/@zo3d/the-greek-isles-santorini)** - by @zo3d A descriptive travel diary of a cruise stop in Santorini, Greece. The author recounts arrival in the bay near Fira, a day trip to Oia, scenic views from the ferry and upper deck, exploring narrow blue-and-white alleyways, churches, and local crafts, and navigating the steep cliffs and transport options (bus, cable car, donkey ride). 보슬비 내리는 이 길처럼, 굽이굽이 참 아득한 세월을 흘러왔습니다.
어쩌다 맺어진 인연이 오십 년 가까운 날들을 붙잡아줄 줄이야 그때는 알았겠습니까.
어릴 적엔 가장 노릇 하느라 짐이 무거웠고,
젊을 적엔 시부모님 모시랴, 자식들 품어 키우랴,
서로를 들여다볼 틈도 없이 야속한 시간만 흘려보냈습니다.
예순 줄이 훌쩍 넘어서야 비로소 온전히 둘만 남았는데,
가만히 마주 앉아보니 평생을 함께한 당신이 새삼 낯설기도 하고 참 애틋하기도 합니다.
서로를 다 안다고 생각했는데, 우리는 참 아끼느라 눈빛 한 번 제대로 맞추지 못하고 살았나 봅니다.
비 내리는 길을 나란히 걸으며, 이제야 아껴둔 말들을 하나씩 꺼내어봅니다.
처음 만났던 그날의 설렘을 가만히 보태어, 당신을 처음부터 다시 알아가고 싶소.
이미 파뿌리처럼 새하얗게 새어버린 머리지만,
남은 세월은 더 알콩달콩하게, 더 뜨겁게 사랑해 봅시다.
내 곁에 있어 주어 고맙소, 나의 당신.

body.title: Ficus heterophylla
body.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ***Ficus heterophylla*** | May 13, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY2aEkbKGK7rMPoMcV5ThPAhNRfMQqC2gyqWTvFKepQG3/20260513_181524.jpg)


On the afternoon of May 13th, I was walking along the side of the road in our area. Suddenly, a wild creeper tree growing on top of other trees caught my eye. The tree was bearing some small, strange and beautiful fruits. Seeing the white dots on the fruit and light pink or reddish spots on the top, I became quite curious and took a few close-up pictures with my lens. Later, by checking the internet, I found out some great information about this creeper tree, which I am sharing with you today.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmb5sAUa7jmGrBTaBhY9amQQQtKi1tTtoN13swLDetR8F2/20260513_181529.jpg)

​Name and Family: According to the information, the scientific name of this strange and beautiful creeper tree is ***Ficus heterophylla***. It is basically a plant of the (Moraceae) or fig family. In our Bangladesh and surrounding areas, it is commonly known as **'Bhui Dumur'**, **'Ballam Dumur'** or **'Ghati-Sheora'.**

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVvE49psBkRp4efzzWqGRawqCzRebpKAHa17q5ZuNJn1p/20260513_181538.jpg)

​Size and Habitat: Although common fig trees are much larger, the biggest feature of the Bhuy fig is that it is a creeping or bushy plant. It usually grows in damp places, river banks, ponds or around wetlands and grows by rolling on the ground or climbing over other trees and fences. Another great aspect of this plant is the diversity of its leaves - sometimes round, sometimes betel leaf-like, and sometimes grooved leaves can be seen on the same tree.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmNvTFNhb7pGvRAitJPFQPUs4NbpTbS6v8b9NtfAmXkb1p/20260513_181546.jpg)

​Fruit structure: The round fruits you see in the picture, according to the characteristics of the fig family, are green in color when raw and have small white hairs or dots on them. There is a small hole or reddish spot at the very top of the fruit (which is called Ostiole in botany). When ripe, they usually turn dark red or brown.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmazoEiNTeyw7NabmicETwja4EVzPo1aaYQAtpoeaFV7rL/20260513_181550.jpg)

​Benefits: Although it is a wild plant, it has quite good medicinal properties. This prickly pear is known to be used in traditional rural medicine, especially to treat infections or wounds on the nails of the hands or feet. In addition, its small fruits are a great food source for various birds and insects in the natural ecosystem.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeRveWtMZZpSHdz17pkDns6LcDJgnDXWLCBQDfVbfnnYz/20260513_181600.jpg)

Harmfulness: It does not have any major harmful effects. However, since it is creeping and grows very quickly, if it grows around crop fields or landscaped gardens, it can often entangle other small plants and hinder their normal growth and can become a weed.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQCpMMUP1rdQ9Mcvf5CmEDoVUiSdJawXLhxM8vuUtpNto/20260513_181607.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmWEFkHG1BK9NA9sW9D7EnyYFrkmRXnu7z5bBG7sFYsK8c/20260513_181615.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbSnm4X5N2qCXUx8xXLoamP22ybZd1iax1U9MfSiF6xKv/20260513_181619.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmdHtSBMPhA18tp4D47b2gck9Goedb6aeDynLqH7QZojua/20260513_181640.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQme746PgEXbVGxUkDG1sUW5v6TBqmRLJpKu1cSMXjJ3GPc/20260513_181657.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQGnM3CJwBzaAjdsuRycTtEy7TchH3q9D4k1D16g3GAL3/20260513_181653.jpg)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmYdLUjc62gj5tcBArjxrLnFVdRRM627azUp7tL9b41JZV/20260513_181712.jpg)

All in all, I like this creeping prickly pear tree quite a lot. Do you see such prickly pears in the bushes or on the banks of ponds in your area? You can tell me in the comments.

I learned about them from various sites including iNaturalist, Wikipedia and Google.

(All posts are written in Bengali and translated into English using Google Translate.)

Though when I returned, I was not expecting much. Because in all honesty, I just returned curious and a bit skeptical, like, let me just go and see what is being done there. Then I had a shift. Just like some sections of a website, the communities here didn't feel like that. From all the communities that I have interacted with, they all feel like an actual room where we all talk and always sit to discuss from wherever we are. I have interacted with writers from countries that I have not been to, people whose daily routine is totally different from how it is done where I am from. And somehow, we all tag along, same thoughts. And I am still a little surprised by that. And I also started my witness interview sometime ago, and it caught me off guard how they all have been responding in a good way. And these are people who are running the blocks and nodes that are the backbone and support system of this entire blockchain, holding it all together for us to use different interfaces easily. They all spoke and gave me answers to the questions I sent to them without remorse, no pride. They did it openly with genuine transparency, especially in our world today, where those who have power usually make people distant. The openness they gave felt rare and really worth noticing. ![246012.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenproject/23tkpDTbusjR1zxbtH7q3aXQqy7kiC71JY2MyuEsnDX4hiXy5a1ufqfvzoS2StvxnvQ4N.png) I am not saying this Hive platform doesn't have its own flaw. Because no platform is flawless, and I won't pretend. But what scores perfectly here goes beyond the rewards or the technology behind it. For me, it has to do with the texture of how real our interaction has become. No one is doing it for the algorithm, and that is why every engagement I see is very real. When I returned, my hope was to look for a platform. But I found a community that will continue to remember our names even when we might decide to stop using Hive. And to me again, that is a perfect score. That is why I am still here. --- Thank you for reading. >

body.title: Ostatnio czytałem #234 - \
- Vincent V. Severski
body.body:
>

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23wqcG8pKtJdnYnpQNXQztMtQ4s9AFrBBdcpcmv3EMrMQnowLD9AYyjAvEnznV6qEi3oA.jpg)

---

Vincent V. Severski od lat wyznacza standardy w polskiej powieści szpiegowskiej. Stworzone przez niego uniwersum „Sekcji” w Agencji Wywiadu doczekało się czterech tomów (choć wliczając powiązany cykl „Nielegalni”, mówimy już o ośmiu pozycjach). Zwieńczeniem losów dobrze znanych bohaterów miała być wydana w 2024 roku powieść „Dystopia” – autor wielokrotnie wspominał o tym podczas spotkań autorskich. Jednak po dwóch latach na rynku ukazał się „Krawiec”. To namacalny dowód na to, żeby nie wierzyć oficerom wywiadu, nawet tym emerytowanym, ponieważ nowa książka okazała się prequelem całej serii.

W powieści pojawiają się ikoniczni bohaterowie Severskiego – as wywiadu Roman Leski oraz stawiająca pierwsze kroki w strukturach Monika Arent. Dla wiernych fanów cyklu to spotkanie ze starymi znajomymi we wcześniejszym, zupełnie nowym świetle. Dla nowicjuszy – kompletny i samowystarczalny punkt wejścia w to uniwersum.

### **O czym jest „Krawiec”?**

Akcja cofa czytelnika do dynamicznego 2003 roku. Polska stoi na progu wejścia do Unii Europejskiej, a w cieniu oficjalnej dyplomacji trwają gorączkowe przygotowania do operacji „Iraqi Freedom”.

Rutynowa kontrola kontrwywiadowcza premiera Feliksa Wirskiego naprowadza służby na trop anomalii w otoczeniu szefa rządu. Opiekunka jego córki, Julia, zostaje podejrzana o kontakty z rosyjskim agentem Makarowem. Gdy Rosjanin niespodziewanie znika, a zaraz po nim ginie ślad po dziewczynie, sprawę próbuje okiełznać pułkownik AW Roman Leski. W tle tli się też potężny skandal obyczajowy – pojawiają się podejrzenia, że premier ma romans z młodą nianią. Wsparciem dla Leskiego zostaje świeżo upieczona absolwentka kursu oficerskiego w Kiejkutach, Monika Arent. To jej pierwsze zadanie operacyjne i od razu zderzenie z intrygą najwyższego kalibru.

Równolegle drugi wątek przenosi nas do czarnogórskiej Budvy. Na luksusowych jachtach dochodzi do konspiracyjnego spotkania rosyjskich oligarchów, którym przewodzi miliarder Aleksander Gierman. Ich cel jest jasny: opracowanie planu obalenia prezydenta Rosji. Spotkanie dyskretnie obserwują brytyjscy agenci MI6. Działania polskiego i brytyjskiego wywiadu zazębiają się, gdy na Bałkanach pojawia się poszukiwany Makarow.

### **Kim jest tytułowy „Krawiec”?**

Pojawiający się w fabule mistrz krawiecki z Neapolu zdaje się mieć jedynie przypadkowy związek ze sprawą. Tytułowy „Krawiec” to przede wszystkim kryptonim szpiegowskiej figury – metafora kogoś, kto potrafi zszyć rozproszone nici w jedną, misterną całość. Severski konstruuje wielowątkową intrygę, której elementy na początku wydają się chaotyczne, by ostatecznie stworzyć precyzyjną, ciasno skrojoną materię. Zakończenie pozostawia kilka niedopowiedzeń – autor tradycyjnie nie podaje wszystkiego na tacy, pozwalając wątkom swobodnie pracować w głowie czytelnika.

### **Moje wrażenia — Autentyzm, który boli**

Sięgałem po tę książkę z ciekawością: jak Severski poradzi sobie z formatem prequelu? Odpowiedź brzmi: doskonale. Czytając „Krawca”, cały czas z tyłu głowy kołacze się pytanie – ile w tej fikcji jest prawdy, a ile literackiego zmyślenia? Autor jako były oficer Agencji Wywiadu doskonale wie, o czym pisze.

To jest właśnie *clue* całej jego twórczości. Severski rezygnuje z bondowskich klisz na rzecz surowego realizmu: żmudnej pracy analitycznej, śledzenia, godzin spędzonych na pisaniu raportów i czekaniu. Ta biurokratyczna codzienność tajnego świata paradoksalnie generuje potężne, namacalne napięcie. Narracja zbudowana z wielu perspektyw nie rozprasza się – dynamiczne, precyzyjne cięcia scen przypominają sprawnie przeprowadzoną operację wywiadowczą.

### **Podsumowanie — W świecie wywiadu nic nie jest tym, na co wygląda**

W świecie służb specjalnych nigdy nic nie jest tym, czym się wydaje. W każdej akcji trzeba zaplanować przypadek, a szpiegów nie ma tam, gdzie ich szukasz. To zdanie mogłoby być mottem całej twórczości Severskiego i idealnie podsumowuje „Krawca”. Intryga z polską polityką, rosyjskim wywiadem i buntem oligarchów trzyma poziom najlepszych zachodnich thrillerów politycznych.

**Ocena: 7/10 ⭐**

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lesiopm/23uQNzhYmTgX94tU6MGSamBffkEMv5bgFy7yWFDrK7rQ9BpJHy5AyQVemZkAJCW4Cptt5.jpg)

<div class=\

chciałbym się dzielić z wami refleksjami na temat przeczytanych (lub odsłuchanych) książek. Kryminały i powieści sensacyjne są mi zdecydowanie najbliższe, ale często sięgam po political-fiction albo książki dokumentalne, biogramy czy wspomnienia. ***

body.title: What I learnt, relearn and still want to learn more
body.body:
The first time my heart actually felt like it might explode was when I watched a BTS music video, I've been listening to K-pop music but I've not actually take my time to watch their music video except the one I saw in their drama. I was just scrolling through my tiktok page when I came across a BTS music video and that particular one drove me to YouTube. Seriously, I didn’t know a song could make me feel this happy. Every beat, every move, every smile just hit me so hard. I finally get to understand why K-pop fans are so crazy about their favorite groups, they don’t just listen, they feel it.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmScpxTjiNoCDCJgShkeepjH5RyQkdjSXhmGbLVoizTCDa/1000218873.jpg 

*Image was a screenshot from the music video on YouTube*

After that, I started watching a K-drama called *Extraordinary Attorney Woo* it has been part of my watchlist for a while but every time I came across it, I will just scroll pass not until I decided to watch it this week. At first, I thought it would just be a fun legal drama, but I got hooked instantly. The way the characters interact with each other is so different from all the legal dramas I’m used to. Little gestures, like bowing politely or just offering a drink, seem so normal there but feel so meaningful. The show isn’t just about solving cases, it’s about understanding people, empathy, and how culture shapes the way we act every day. I didn’t expect to notice so many small details, but somehow it made me really think about the way people treat each other.

But seriously, the K-pop always draw me back and I found and I found myself went back to listening to K-pop. It’s not just the catchy songs or the crazy dance moves, it’s the stories behind the lyrics. Some songs are really emotional or even talk about society in ways I didn’t expect. It feels like the music is modern but also connects to something deeper, something traditional at the same time.

That is the more reason why I tried learning a few Korean phrases this week. But I'm still bad at it, it seems I suck at learning other languages the only thing I understand very well right now is simple things like “hello” or “thank you”  but it feel a little more special when you know how to say them politely. I felt a bit clumsy at first, but it was cool to realize that language carries respect and meaning in ways I never thought about before.

Honestly, this week made me realize how much you can *feel* culture instead of just watching it. Music that makes your heart race, dramas that show small but meaningful moments, and words that carry warmth, it’s all so alive. I feel like I’ve only scratched the surface, but it’s been one of the most exciting weeks exploring the Korean culture.


*Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day*



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@leemah1/what-i-learnt-relearn-and-still-want-to-learn-more--2qj)

body.title: Den Sozialismus in seinem Lauf: Lob der Planwirtschaft
body.body:
>Den Sozialismus in seinem Lauf halten weder Grüne noch Linke noch Union oder SPD auf.

Grüner Wasserstoff galt zumindest einige Zeit als Schlüssel-Technologie zur klimaneutralen Zukunft. Dann stürzte die Ampelregierung, die Nachfolge-Administration sichtete kopfschüttelnd die Papiere und auf einmal hatte auch die Industrie Bedenken. 

Deutschlands ehrgeizige Pläne wankten kurz, dann platzten sie. Milliardenprojekte wurden gestoppt, nicht nur beim Aufbau eines \
(Robert Habeck). Auch anderswo in der Industrie, die in den Tagen der rot-grün-gelben Bundesregierung Regenbogenfahnen geschwenkt hatte, als sei das ihr Hauptprodukt, <a href=\

>werden Investitionen gekürzt und laute Forderungen gestellt. Die Energiepreise müssten runter. Die Bürokratie müsse weg. Die Regelungstiefe der staatlichen Eingriffe zwinge dazu, das Land zu verlassen.

>Ein Hauch von Honecker 

Der Hauch von Honecker, der die Bundesrepublik in den zurückliegenden 20 Jahren durchweht hatte wie der Odem des Todes, er stinkt vielen plötzlich. Konnte sich vor zwei Jahren noch jeder sicher sein, dass eine Forderung, weiter zielstrebig auf die Errichtung des Sozialismus hinzuarbeiten, für Aufsehen sorgen, aber im Allgemeinem mit zustimmendem Nicken entgegengenommen wird, stehen die Chancen für den Start eines neuen Menschenexperiments heute deutlich schlechter. 

Die Kräfte der Beharrung im freiheitlichen System heben ihr Haupt, als sei es nie angeschlagen worden. Ihr Vorbild ist der Kettensägenmann Javier Milei, ihr Gott der US-Präsident Donald Trump, ihr Traum der vom freien Spiel der Kräfte. Der Staat solle nur noch die Rahmenbedingungen für die Wirtschaft schaffen, fordern sie. Er habe nachgewiesen, dass es ihm am Talent fehle, ganze Volkswirtschaften anzuleiten und ihnen mit Plänen und Zielvorgaben vorzuschreiben, was sie wo, wie und mit wem zu produzieren hätten.

>Die Axt an der Wurzel 

Das allerdings sind Forderungen, die die Axt an die Wurzel des deutschen Versorgungsstaates legen - und weit darüber hinaus wie eine Zeitbombe in den gewaltigen Vorschriftenfabriken der EU in Brüssel ticken. Hier wie dort ist die Rolle staatlicher Pläne zu Lenkung und Leitung von Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und Gesellschaft dreieinhalb Jahrzehnte nach dem Ende des letzten sozialistischen Großversuchs in Deutschland wieder ähnlich groß wie vor 1990. 

Staatliche Planung durchdringt die soziale Marktwirtschaft Deutschlands \nund der EU mit einer Intensität, die an die Planwirtschaft der DDR und \ndes Rates für gegenseitige Wirtschaftshilfe erinnert. Zwar fehlt es an einer zentralen Planungsbehörde, wie sie die DDR mit ihrer Staatlichen Plankommission beim Ministerrat der DDR unterhielt. Doch wer in EU-Europa ein Unternehmen gründen, ein Grundstück kaufen oder eine Fabrik errichten will, käme niemals mehr auf den Gedanken, das einfach so zu tun.

>Angst vor Abluft 

Einerseits, weil es nicht möglich wäre - überall regt sich gegen industrielle Ansiedlungen Widerstand, überall herrscht Angst vor Abluft, Genen und Brauchwasser. Andererseits haben die EU und ihre nationalen Regierungen Investoren so erzogen, dass die großzügige Fördermittelgaben von Anfang an in ihre Kalkulationen einbeziehen. Der Standort Europa ist schlecht, die Löhne zu hoch, die Preise ebenso, die Auflagen hart, die Fachkräfte rar. Damit hier überhaupt jemand eine Wirtschaftstätigkeit simuliert - häufig als \

ausgewiesen - belohnt ihn der Staat teilweise so üppig, dass kaum eine Chance besteht, die Fördergelder jemals wiederzusehen.

Gewerbegebiete werden vom Staat ausgewiesen, erschlossen und vermietet. Als \

– etwa für Halbleiter, Wasserstoff oder erneuerbare Energien – wird die zentrale staatliche Entscheidung darüber bezeichnet, welche Branchen gerade gefördert werden, weil ihre Produkte ins aktuelle Politikprofil passen. Manchmal sind das Solarpaneele, manchmal Medikamente, manchmal Halbleiter, manchmal Elektroautos, später dann Panzer und Kanonen.

>Am Sterbebett der Planwirtschaft

Erich Honecker ahnte, was kommen würde. \

, proklamierte er vom Sterbebett der zentralistischen Planwirtschaft, in der er selbst die Cluster bestimmt, die Fördermilliarden vergab und entschied, welche Industrie zukunftsträchtig sein würde. Heute übernimmt diese Rolle die EU-Kommission, ein Kollegium von in ihren Nationalstaaten gescheiterten Bürokraten. Deren Mitarbeiterapparat produziert unermüdlich Visionen, die mit Hilfe strenger Vorschriften umgesetzt werden müssen. Oft ist ein Plan noch nicht abgelaufen, da kommt die EU-Spitze schon mit dem nächsten um die Ecke.

Der \
zielte darauf ab, die EU bis 2050 klimaneutral zu machen. Der \
sollte eine große europäische Halbleiterindustrie begründen. Der Aufbau- und Resilienzplan \

zu erhöhen. Konkret vorgegeben wird nie, wie etwas erreicht werden soll. Sondern großzügig nur, wann es so weit zu sein hat. 

Braunkohlenaus dann, Verbrenneraus dann, Durchdämmung bis zu diesem Termin, Energieausstieg zu jenem. Um die unternehmerische Freiheit weiter einzuschränken und lenken Ressourcen in staatlich definierte Prioritäten zu lenken, bestimmen die EU-Planbehörden auch über die nationalen Pläne mit. Mindestens 37 Prozent aller Mittel müssen dann etwa in Klimaschutz und 20 Prozent in Digitalisierung \ninvestiert werden.

>Im Gewand der Marktwirtschaft 

Diese gezielte Lenkung ist eine Art zentraler Planung, die sich ins Gewand der Marktwirtschaft hüllt. Noch nicht ein einziges Mal hat ein der fundamentalen EU-Strategien irgendeines ihrer Ziele auch nur gestreift. Doch die Ausrufung der \
oder des noch stiller gescheiterten Nachfolgeplans \

gilt heute nicht etwa als Beispiel dafür, dass lebensfremde Politikdarsteller mit zu viel Geld nicht bestimmen sollten, wo und wie Unternehmen agieren. Sondern als Beleg, dass es neue, noch viel konkretere Vorgaben braucht.

Als die sozialistischen Planwirtschaften des Ostblocks zusammenbrachen, schienen Kapitalismus und freie Marktwirtschaft endgültig gesiegt zu haben. Dynamische, lebendige und flexible Wirtschaftsformen brachten Wohlstand, Innovation und soziale Vorteile für viele Menschen. Der Abschied von staatlicher Planung und Leitung bewirkte das Wunder, dass selbst aus sozialistischen Staaten, die ohne Hilfe aus dem Westen auskommen mussten, in nur eine Vierteljahrhundert blühende Gemeinwesen wurden.

>Das Gespenst ist zurück 

Und doch erhebt sich heute ein Gespenst, der Sozialismus mit seiner Planwirtschaft ist zurück, er hat die soziale Marktwirtschaft, wie sie in Deutschland seit 1948 unter Ludwig Erhard etabliert wurde, in die Flucht geschlagen. Statt auf die Prinzipien des Marktes zu setzen – Angebot und Nachfrage, Privateigentum, Wettbewerb – hat sich die Politik für Gängelung, staatliche Regulierung und enge Einhegung des Wettbewerbs entschieden. Begründet wird das mit einem hehren Ziel: Es gehe darum, soziale Gerechtigkeit und Stabilität zu gewährleisten. Der einzig denkbare Weg sei es, die Rolle des Staates sowohl auf nationaler als auch auf EU-Ebene erheblich auszubauen.

Das schafft nicht

>Wachstum, Wohlstand oder Resilienz, aber zahllose neue Stellen dort, wo die vorgabengetriebene Planpolitik entsteht. Jede Richtlinie, jeder finanzielle Anreiz oder neu gesetzte regulatorischer Rahmen schafft Kontrollbedarf. Wen die EU-Planer Unternehmen durch Umweltauflagen, CO₂-Preise und Emissionshandel zwingen, ihre Produktion \
zu gestalten, müssen Nachweispflichten folgen. Arbeit und Brot für <a href=\
>Heerscharen von Beamten. Es sind mittlerweile so viele, dass sie den Stellenverlust in Handwerk, Industrie und Dienstleistungsgewerbe

>Gängelung als Wesenskern 

Vom politischen Berlin aus gesehen gilt diese
> Methode als Erfolgsmodell. Je mehr Gesetze wie das Erneuerbare-Energien-Gesetz (EEG), das Lieferkettengesetz oder die staatlichen Lohnvorgaben mit dem Mindestlohngesetz die

>Flexibilität von Unternehmen einschränken, desto sicherer scheinen sich auch die europäischen Institutionen, auf dem richtigen Weg zu sein. 

Daten, Zahlen und Fakten, die dagegen sprechen, werden nicht nur ignoriert, sondern uminterpretiert. Als Mario Draghi, ein Erzeuropäer, der jeder EU-Kritik unverdächtig ist, der EU

> vor einem Jahr eine Art Insolvenzzeugnis ausstellte, war das für die Kommission Anlass, ihre Produktion von Plänen, Vorschriften und Auflagen noch einmal deutlich zu erhöhen. Vor zehn Jahren gab es noch ungefähr 4.600 sogenannte grundlegende Rechtsakte in der EU. Heute sind es schon 6.500.

Der Staat entscheidet nicht mehr nur über Rahmenbedingungen, er beeinflusst aktiv, welche Industrien gefördert werden und welche nicht. Längst hat sich die EU in eine hybride Wirtschaftsordnung verwandelt, die alle Nachteile der starren Planwirtschaft der DDR mit allen Problemen einer zentralen Lenkung kombiniert. Monatelang dauert es, ehe sich Regierungen auf höchster Ebene einigen können, ob Atomkraft als nachhaltig gelten darf. Jahre wird es auch diesmal wieder brauchen, bis das Verlangen der Kommission, im
>nächsten Planzeitraum dreimal so viel Geld verschwenden zu dürfen, auf zweimal so viel eingedampft worden ist.

>Ein unbeweglicher Riese 

Ein unbeweglich herumtapsender Riese, der immer zu spät kommt, das ist dieses alte Europa. Wie in der Planwirtschaft der DDR und des RGW beweist sie jeden Tag, dass ein zentral gesteuertes System, in dem der Staat alle wirtschaftlichen Prozesse kontrolliert, untauglich ist, Bedürfnisse zu befriedigen oder über Ressourcenverteilung und Handelsbeziehungen zu entscheiden. Wo Preise und Löhne zentral festgelegt werden und ein Jahresplan bestimmte, welche Güter in welcher Menge zu produzieren sind, versickern Milliarden im Sumpf bürokratischer Förderprogramme. Egal ob Solarindustrie oder Mikroelektronik, Wasserstoffwirtschaft oder Medizintechnik - in jedem Fünfjahresplan ist das Scheitern schon angelegt. 

Langfristige Planung führt wahlweise zu Überproduktion oder zu Mangelwirtschaft, da keine Behörde

>irgendeine Nachfrage richtig einschätzen kann. Jeder EU-Plan wird nicht nur auf der Basis unzureichender Informationen getroffen, sondern immer erst in einem Moment, in dem ein Thema Mode geworden ist: Im Nachtrab reiten Ursula von der Leyen und ihr Beamtenheer der Realität auf einem roten Pferd hinterher, wenn sie den Wettbewerb durch Subventionen und Vorgaben verzerren, um ihre gerade \naktuellen Ziele - mal Klimaschutz, mal Digitalisierung, mal Resilienz und mal Verteidigungsfähigkeit - zu erreichen.

>Sterbende Innovationskraft 

Dass\n in der Planwirtschft zuallererst die Innovationskraft stirbt, haben EU und die Bundesregierungen seit Angela Merkel nachhaltig bewiesen. Ohne Wettbewerb gab es kaum Anreize für Innovationen. Das angekündigte Verbot von Verbennungsmotoren und Gasheizungen führt nicht zu mehr Erfindungen, sondern zu Fehlkalkulationen und der Fehlallokation von Kapital.

Statt planmäßig \

, wie es die \nLissabon-Strategie vorgegeben hatte, ist die EU  hinter den USA, hinter China und hinter dem Rest der Welt zurückgeblieben: Das ausgerufene Forschungsziel von drei Prozent des BIP für die Wissenschaft wurde nur \nin wenigen Ländern erreicht. Die Absicht, planmäßig 20 Millionen weniger Arme zu produzieren, scheiterte.

>Wohlstandsabbau durch Planvorgaben 

Die Klimaziele werden pro forma auch nach der Beedigung des \

noch aufrechterhalten. Doch von der Klimaneutralität bis 2050 wird sich\n spätestens die EU-Kommission mit einer Ausrede verabschieden, die ab 2035 regiert - falls es die EU dann noch gibt, wofür derzeit wenig spricht.

Denn Brüssel tut alles dafür, die EU-Bürger gegen sich aufzubringen. Statt zusätzlichen Wohlstand produziert die zusätzliche Leitungebene hohe Kosten, bürokratische Hürden und politischen Streit. Sie hat Ludwig Erhards Credo \

- eine Strategie, die letztlich scheitern muss wie alle anderen bisher auch.

Nur wann, das ist die Frage. Und was dann noch übrig ist, um neu anzufangen.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterlands/23yT7GLnqQP1DQBhZp95R6xGS6MFWs5p4MrQ1ydT9LZRQFET11LNA1p1fqUSZtCZbzkq2.png [Source](https://peakd.com/splinterlands/@splinterlands/electroneum-x-splinterlands-voltage-event-powering-up-praetoria) Hi everyone! Unfortunately the @kiokizz Season Report Card seems to be even more broken than it was, so I'm not able to get updated numbers. It basically just seems stuck forever at the first hurdle... https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aussieninja/23xyhZxuKj2XJ7Zgnyz9nqqU1uxas9Vd3BfvoQ5N5sVyzY8RpQxLabExUrZS8tD4VmS8P.png But... we must press on. I was immensely time-poor for season 95, and spent the only time I had trying to hit the 100 battles required for Survival. Survival takes quite a bit longer than Modern and Wild to find a game, which slows everything right down. This season I tried the hardest Survival bracket, the Modern Manual Expert 6 bracket - it has the most rewards and you can play maxed cards, which I wasn't able to play last season and it broke my brain a little bit. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aussieninja/23t76xbUQrTtgQXBkUBp4bmsLXpa46WZDH8HDWVuF7uTRyLDMxPYg8db4VT8A6yimjTFa.png Splinterlands does play differently at the different level caps, it's an incredibly complex game to get your head around fully... and I'm not that smart so I really have to limit myself to Max Level arenas to stand any sort of chance. I did manage to hit the requisite 100 battles over the season, and score myself some glint, but my intention was to also get on the leaderboard for Diamond Modern... but had left it so late that it was impossible for me to hit the 100 battles for that with the amount of energy I had remaining. If I'm going to play Survival and Modern/Wild, I really have to play a number of games every day or its not going to work. I'm not even sure if I have enough time every day to play that many games. As I mentioned [last season](https://peakd.com/hive-13323/@aussieninja/cant-do-everything-splinter-stats-ranked-rewards-season-94-report-card) I do not have capacity to play with the [Electroneum x Splinterlands: Voltage Event](https://peakd.com/splinterlands/@splinterlands/electroneum-x-splinterlands-voltage-event-powering-up-praetoria) but I love that they're doing stuff like that and I'm excited to see what the future holds. Now that Escalation Conflicts have truly kicked off... it is not looking good for me... https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aussieninja/23swigqqcws8DgLTxPz4JpoVUU84Wm1f9B18qocPnm5zHoWLM65KfXdmVmULqYMyNXxXm.png I am shocked that a maxed set of regular foil cards is barely in the Top 100 of accounts (I'll slip as people win more conflict cards and add them to their wagons)... still good for Splinterlands Inc for obviously a pretty successful sale. If Conflict cards and other incentives are convincing players to purchase way more than they need then its a pretty amazing formula. I'm only using 11 of my 61 Mage Wagons, so I think I'm only going to have to repair a couple for this entire run (unless I get outrageously lucky every conflict)... so without the need to repair wagons, I'm still just accumulating Land resources... https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aussieninja/23swg55bZLbQv3ENHY8eTS81193zf5bgceMVxiBcjk4uhzYkbh8zrTyTBwBckJMjtppGR.png While the ability to craft cards is an incredible idea, I personally won't be able to create enough resources to do it to a maxed level: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aussieninja/23tGVdNQPyvbvB1RsBUN7nfvisW4griBai3qMXk5PUBC6T7NTYyMXb9wMW5PdurpJEPsF.png) As predicted, the cost of Mage Wagon Repair Kits is dropping like crazy... https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aussieninja/23tGVGekefZSmSFfDVu7VhLCGRATTEBrGfoGKwLHhoCA4XY4ifZVGPeELkttA5LFhTp7q.png It was $3.74 24 days ago and $2.39 8 days ago - which makes sense, supply remained the same but demand dropped off significantly. The only item above that hasn't dropped in value is the Fortune Ticket, everything else is cheaper than it was a week ago. I'm sure Aura is being over printed at the moment: https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aussieninja/23swkfdavKEQVWef7EJ7THRFTT75rNt5RgkBkjwx4BkP6au1u26U9NBMFFYWf8MuD39qc.png [Source](https://land.spl-stats.com/resource/conversion) I still don't know what to do... I guess I'll sit on it until something new comes along. ![](https://images.hive.blog/p/8SzwQc8j2KJZo6c43w4Bg9ysSuq4sua46yAeUgxyy3WnRJ2vSgsYa6T5u6asHVF6eMYuF9XWYmE755f299tPfJ6JY9Kb1V6xwphPWfm74ma96sejW9c?format=match&mode=fit) ### Match Report #### Performance |Stat|# Modern|# Wild| |-|-|-| |Rank| ?| ?| |Rating|?|?| |Rating High|?|?| |Ratio (Win/Loss)|? body.title: A picture is worth thousand words. Clara's visit.
body.body:
*What I see; A well prepared meal served, it looks like it's a special recipe for some special person.*

*What I feel; someone is about to taste a new type of meal.*

Clara, who had traveled all the way from North London to celebrate the win of her football club, found herself in Hungary where she decided to seize the opportunity of meeting with a friend she met online. 
It has been fun upon fun as she explores every part of Hungary, their culture and then she decides to taste what their meal is.

Clara was taken to one of the best restaurants where she was served this nice looking food but had no idea what it was. What do you expect? It's another country you get to see new things all through.


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU3px8RtfriCfVwwXVzpchkzMZxUWySWHEYyTfh1vjQJX/1779522713985.jpg)

Image by @wakeupkitty 

Clara looked closely but couldn't help as she called one of the waiters to explain the content on the plate.
It smells really nice but having knowledge of it will give a better satisfaction, she said to her friend.

“Disznótoros Tál” the waiter started getting Clara even more confused as she is not conversant with their language she turned and looked at him, “Pardon” she replied as they all burst into laughter.

This is a Hungarian Sausage Mix plate it has in it Liver sausage pointing at it for her know which is which, the blood sausage is there, steak potatoes, purple cabbage, meat and pickled vegetables. Is there anything you want to know ma, the waiter asked but Clara replied this is enough to know how nourishing this will be.

Clara had her first bite of the liver sausage and it was yummy. She couldn't believe it tasted even far better than it looked. Other foods were also served but this particular one caught her attention the most.

All thanks to Arsenal if they hadn't won the premier League I wouldn't have had the opportunity to do all this, she mentioned as she expressed her joy.

body.title: ‎THE MOST UNDERRATED STRIKER IN EUROPE? PAUL ONUACHU DESERVES MORE RESPECT ‎
body.body:
‎Watching Paul Onuachu this season in the Turkish league has made me clearly understand one thing that this man does not get the hype, praise, or recognition he really deserves.
‎
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTxZUsFssPz2EVp6MxdQD57gcTN21P82TKYR5cfq9XHNN/images%2031.jpeg 

‎[Source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.facebook.com/SoarSuperEagle/posts/paul-onuachu-finishes-as-top-scorer-in-turkey-across-all-competitions-this-seaso/1599922242082651/&ved=2ahUKEwjkj6b38s6UAxX8YEEAHTEiLJ0Qr4kDegQIHhAA&usg=AOvVaw3ne-e9FFFYAwITCOsOeLEw)
‎
‎In a football world where a lot of players are celebrated for just a few good performances, Onuachu has silently been delivering consistent excellence week in and week out without getting the spotlight his performances warrant. Statistics alone should force people to pay attention. 
‎
‎In 30 league matches for Trabzonspor this season, he scored an incredible 22 goals and added 2 assists. Those are elite numbers by any standard even the so called top strikers couldn't match the numbers this season and that really say a lot about him this season.
‎
‎But beyond the goals, it is the way he plays that impressed me even more. Watching him last night reminded me of how complete and dangerous he is as a striker. His movement, positioning, aerial dominance which is his great threat, composure in front of goal, and ability to carry his team in crucial moments were all on display again.
‎
‎Big players always show up when it really matters most, and Paul Onuachu did exactly that in the Turkish Cup final. He was the major reason Trabzonspor lifted the trophy after contributing two decisive goals in their 2-1 victory. Performances like that are what define champions. It was no surprise seeing him awarded the Player of the Match afterward because if the way he completely influenced the outcome of the game.
‎
‎To crown it all, he finished the season as the Turkish Super Lig joint top scorer, which is another achievement that should have football fans and media talking more about him. Yet somehow, he still feels underrated in global football conversations.
‎
‎Sometimes I feel players from certain countries or leagues do not get the same level of attention others receive, no matter how well they perform. If another striker in a more popular league had these exact numbers and performances, social media would not stop talking about him or called such player a world-class player.
‎
‎Paul Onuachu has proven himself again this season. Consistency, impact, leadership, goals, and trophies and what more does a striker need to do to earn proper recognition?
‎
‎For me, he deserves far more respect and appreciation than he currently gets.
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy-sports/the-most-underrated-striker-in-europe-paul-onuachu-deserves-more-respect--8dn)

body.body: **XSMT - Kết Quả Xổ Số Miền Trung Hàng Ngày Chính Xác** Xổ số kiến thiết miền Trung là một trong những loại hình giải trí truyền thống được đông đảo người dân yêu thích trong nhiều năm qua. Không chỉ mang đến cơ hội thử vận may với những giải thưởng hấp dẫn, XSMT còn góp phần quan trọng vào việc xây dựng các công trình xã hội, giáo dục và y tế tại nhiều địa phương miền Trung. Trải qua thời gian dài phát triển, hoạt động xổ số ngày càng được tổ chức chuyên nghiệp, minh bạch và nhận được sự quan tâm lớn của người chơi trên cả nước. ➡️➡️➡️ Bấm ngay: [**https://tooter.in/xsmtrung**](https://tooter.in/xsmtrung) XSKT miền Trung xuất hiện từ khá sớm và nhanh chóng trở thành một phần quen thuộc trong đời sống của nhiều người dân. Ban đầu, số lượng đài quay thưởng còn hạn chế, tuy nhiên theo sự phát triển kinh tế và nhu cầu giải trí ngày càng tăng, hệ thống SXMT đã mở rộng đáng kể. Hiện nay, khu vực miền Trung có tổng cộng 14 tỉnh thành tham gia phát hành vé số và tổ chức quay thưởng gồm Đà Nẵng, Quảng Nam, Bình Định, Khánh Hòa, Quảng Ngãi, Gia Lai, Kon Tum, Đắk Lắk, Đắk Nông, Ninh Thuận, Phú Yên, Quảng Bình, Quảng Trị và Thừa Thiên Huế. Các công ty xổ số hoạt động theo lịch cố định từng ngày trong tuần nhằm giúp người chơi thuận tiện theo dõi kết quả xổ số miền Trung hàng ngày. Lịch quay thưởng XSMTR hiện nay được duy trì đều đặn mỗi ngày với từ 2 đến 3 đài mở thưởng. Điều này giúp người chơi có thêm nhiều lựa chọn khi tham gia dự thưởng và tra cứu kết quả. ➡️➡️➡️ Xem ngay: [**https://www.mymeetbook.com/kqxsmt**](https://www.mymeetbook.com/kqxsmt) Một trong những lý do giúp xổ số miền Trung thu hút đông đảo người tham gia chính là cơ cấu giải thưởng đa dạng và hấp dẫn. Chỉ với một tờ vé số truyền thống có giá 10.000 đồng, người chơi đã có cơ hội nhận giải đặc biệt trị giá lên đến 2 tỷ đồng. Ngoài ra còn có nhiều hạng giải khác như giải nhất trị giá 30 triệu đồng, giải nhì 15 triệu đồng, giải ba 10 triệu đồng cùng hàng chục nghìn giải phụ có giá trị khác nhau. Số lượng giải thưởng lớn giúp tăng khả năng chiến thắng và mang lại sự hào hứng cho người tham gia SXMT mỗi ngày. Thời gian quay thưởng xổ số miền Trung thường bắt đầu vào khoảng 17h15 hàng ngày và được phát sóng trực tiếp trên nhiều nền tảng khác nhau. Người chơi có thể theo dõi qua truyền hình hoặc tra cứu trực tuyến bằng điện thoại, máy tính. Trong đó, hình thức xem KQXSMT online đang ngày càng phổ biến nhờ tốc độ cập nhật nhanh và tiện lợi. Chỉ với vài thao tác đơn giản, người xem đã có thể kiểm tra kết quả chính xác mà không cần phải chờ đợi lâu. Khi may mắn trúng thưởng xổ số miền Trung, người chơi cần giữ gìn tờ vé số nguyên vẹn, không rách nát hoặc tẩy xóa để đủ điều kiện lĩnh thưởng. Sau đó, người trúng có thể mang vé đến công ty xổ số phát hành hoặc các đại lý uy tín để làm thủ tục nhận giải. Đối với những giải thưởng lớn, người chơi nên chuẩn bị đầy đủ giấy tờ cá nhân để quá trình xác minh diễn ra nhanh chóng và an toàn hơn. ➡️➡️➡️ Xem thêm: [**https://www.pinterest.com/xsmtrungxsmnmobi/**](https://www.pinterest.com/xsmtrungxsmnmobi/)

body.title: what is that to you?
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/xrayman/EqhPqZHbPgHLETpaZQi7nBniVLt6Q3gSHPfsxP96GuhDMgmEqgKQfBSAp2D75yi42Jk.png)




Our biggest problem is one we create ourselves. Each of us is a unique individual. But being unique does not necessarily mean we are special, in the sense of being better than others. No. We are different from one another, but we are living beings who bring together a set of variables in a unique way. If we view ourselves as if we were conducting an experiment, why is it that instead of observing and trying out things that have the desired effect, or that prevent the undesired outcome, we continue to insist on looking at the “neighbor”? 

Not looking at the neighbor with concern, empathy, and a willingness to help if he or she needs it. But rather, the gaze of comparison. 

That comparison takes a starting point that isn’t true. We can’t expect two things, or two distinct elements, to ever be the same. They may be similar, but comparison only leads us to take a reference point and look at what we have in relation to that reference point we’ve chosen. 



After all, since we are all different yet equal in our imperfection—or rather, in our lack of total perfection—if we wish to compare ourselves to something, we should not do so with our fellow human beings. Nor with our neighbor. He, too, is not perfect, and we should not view him as such. 

I took this biblical passage as the starting point for my reflection today.

body.title: Update bot again
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/we-are-ai/23t6zbmBMY2MCk7rnXZt4cHZ9JzRSt8N1q6L9aaHdRZYvdbpbYHc24xw6tmySXqU5YEjK.png)


Have I finally found a good curation rhythm?  
Over the last 24 hours, I reached an APR of **10.06%**, while keeping my mana relatively stable. It’s not dropping too fast, even though it sometimes needs to pause to recharge. Overall, the balance is starting to look pretty solid.

Now, I’m trying to move on to the next step: figuring out how to implement, in code, a **queue of eligible posts**. The goal is for the bot to automatically vote when the mana is at its highest. This would help me avoid missing good posts just because the mana is too low at the wrong time.

For now, I’ve managed to store the posts in memory on a page, which is already a good step forward. However, they’re not yet being automatically voted when the mana refills. That’s clearly the next challenge. I’m confident I’ll get it working—I just need to take the time to fully understand and implement the logic.

At the same time, I plan to keep increasing my HP whenever possible. The idea isn’t to make big votes, but rather to spread smaller votes with lower percentages. This way, I can optimize mana usage, preserve it better, and eventually keep the bot running continuously, 24/7.

The main goal isn’t to give huge votes, but simply to say: *your post is worth following*. I want to provide consistent and meaningful support.

I’ve also managed to configure the bot so it avoids voting for blacklisted users, which is a big improvement. That said, manually copying a blacklist isn’t very motivating… I haven’t found a ready-to-use list yet. If you know of one, I’d be happy to use it!

Anyway, it’s the start of the weekend, so I’ll try to find some time to keep improving this little curation bot and make it even more efficient 🚀

I started a challenge of taking 100 days off to mainly focus on my health and overall personal development and used this account as a personal blog to keep track of all my activity. I enjoyed it and continued afterward trying to build better habits and find a good balance between health, fitness, work, entertainment, and my personal life...

Friday was a pretty fun day with a lot of variety in it. I started out with a bit of productivity before joining a 10th Hot Yoga Class in 10 Days. Afterward, I got ready to drive home stoppning by some stores to pick up some things I need for my trip to Thailand. Once at my parents, I helped my dad with some garden stuff repairing a collapsed fence, spend some time with my oldest niece and my mom. Let our dog out but didn't go for a walk as the weather was too hot and the time too short. I had planned to go for an evening walk with a friend but it got cancelled so I texted another one and ended up meeting him for an evening drink before driving home.

Welcome to another new gaming video from me on the Hive Gaming community.

Beautiful and perfect highway.Driving perfectly on this road is called Car Racing 2.The name of the game is Car Racing 2.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmU9JjnkZDohmkifmtzMLwe34UkF4SGw22BL1cZRh9P1jn/screenshot_20260523_125442_2.png)

This is a popular game among mobile gaming.I don't know how popular it is with people, but I like it a lot because I'm a road driver when I play it on my mobile screen.

Here I completely get the feeling of a private car or a new model car driver.Today is the first time I played this game.Here you have to drive the car perfectly.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVhVMcgRmSA9FqnKSDeus3jY8AhTh8SEQYVDzEW82T52w/screenshot_20260523_124849_2.png)

Here you can increase the speed of the car up to 170.My car's maximum speed was 160 km/h, but I couldn't go any faster because I had to face many cars ahead.

The main game is how fast you can go on this highway without any collisions.Because if you collide with another car, you will fail the mission.And here it is important to earn your points.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmV1MrX4K3vfwkA1BRh2S52xxBJjeQWGK3bqdGTi25zWR1/screenshot_20260523_125529_2.png)

The road in this game is very beautiful and the coloring prints around it are great.This is a great mobile game among racing games.Driving perfectly on perfect roads is the biggest challenge, and the biggest challenge is on roads with lots of cars.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmPXXsm5qBTS1AzXjMNNHfLaWBbaQx2C3ZDKBvpwjGiQdf/screenshot_20260523_125000_2.png)

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmanK1Bm43WBEdbgjmpLevHJypDPjzCxL5QbrSsAhvBQdi/screenshot_20260523_125123_2.png)

Yes, there were a lot of cars on the road and my goal was to overtake them.Colliding with a car here means mission failure.But first I drove very perfectly and scored 370, then I just had to touch a car and I died.Then I tried a second time and reached a top speed of 160 km/h.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUuo9MVqgPv9mAtBG1XPkEFrcZvPkgvnnMxfrdiztRgYK/screenshot_20260523_125230_2.png)

The second time my score is 10 less, meaning a score of 360.Anyway it's a very interesting game and I really liked it.It's fun to play because I feel like I'm driving a car on the highway.The feeling of driving your own car is truly amazing.Even though it's a game, but I'm in a full driving mood.

Image source: Thumbnail and screenshot captured during gameplay with my own hands.

Thank you.

@Angelmitu

body.body:
AI is a good technology and has impacted our world in many positive ways.

That's why, I believe, AI is not the real problem, but rather the user's intention creates problem.  

The impact of Ai tools depends solely on humans intentions and how they utilize them.

The real solution is guiding how Ai should be used by encouraging people to use it wisely.



One of the ways is by creating proper education on how AI works and how AI content can be manipulated in our society, because the rate people abuse AI can mislead others. Educating people will minimize the wrong use of AI from affecting others.



Also, there should be proper transparency. For instance, if a work was generated using AI, the creator of such work should indicate that it's not an original masterpiece.



If an AI content causes harm, fraud, discrimination, and deception, the user should face the consequences. This would help control how people use AI and limit harmful usage.

People should be free to explore the  ideas, and create innovative content, but they should also understand the consequences of misusing AI content.

Hoy mi caminata por la ciudad fue bastante emocionante. Comencé mi recorrido en un parque donde vi a un grupo de personas haciendo yoga al aire libre; su energía positiva era contagiosa. Hablé brevemente con una mujer que estaba allí practicando; me contó que asiste a estas clases desde hace un año y ha notado grandes cambios en su bienestar. Luego continué por una de mis calles favoritas, llena de murales coloridos. Me detuve a admirar uno de ellos que representaba a personas de diferentes culturas unidas, y justo en ese momento conocí a un artista local que lo había pintado. Nos compartió su visión sobre la diversidad y cómo el arte puede unir a las comunidades. Fue inspirador escuchar su pasión. Finalmente, terminé mi caminata en una pequeña cafetería donde el aroma del café recién hecho me atrapó. Hice una pausa para disfrutar de una bebida y reflexionar sobre la belleza de la conexión humana que encontré en mi camino. Sin duda, fue un día lleno de buenas vibras y encuentros memorables. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). I really liked Paphos old town and the sea front there is lovely, took a boat trip along the coast from the old harbour. I had a hangover and wasn’t my best that day, so chose not to swim, the water looked inviting though but my tummy was having other ideas. 

Is it Valley of the Kings? Can’t recall the name, should look it up. That was amazing. Truth be told, me and the heat these days aren’t best of buddies, so light clothing and a rucksack full of water with some room for a camera is key. I did shoot a video at the time. Amazing place. 

We went with our daughter, son-in-law and two granddaughters, so the holiday was mainly beach and hotel pool, which was crowded with some of the worst people. The hotel was nice though, very clean, well air conditioned but had a twitchy alarm system that would go off at three in the morning, forcing an evacuation one night. 

We ate out a lot because the hotel food wasn’t particularly exciting. We found a lovely restaurant in old Paphos down by the Marina where we’d go most nights and another place inland that was kind of a rustic Tapas place run by two brothers. 

I felt that the hotel setup put us off the whole place and one night we snuck into a very nice hotel along the seafront and decided we’d give that one a go another year. 

Anyway @shanibeer don’t get banned from the country!

Keep on sharing your interesting finds. The craft hub reminds of a place in Malta. Another island paradise. 

We’re off to Funchal again this year.
