body.title: Splinterlands: Overpowering my opponent with quantity in Back to the Basics
body.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I saw a battle where I took advantage of the ruleset.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>
![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23vrrbZdV1b8h3g6rqAJm4y9vwTRR6D9EjSNrqLE7ZydsgqyxmZ33WWAZ4auFvdAXE2v3.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are Back to the Basics and Lost Magic. This means that all monsters have no abilities and no magic monsters can be used. There is also 28 mana available, and I can use any [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except for fire or dragon.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Wizard of Eastwood|3|Summoner|-2 Armor|
|Nectar Queen|9|1st||
|Failed Summoner|2|2nd||
|Gobson Sniper|5|3rd||
|Vampiric Blossom|5|4th||
|Goblin Chariot|5|5th||
|Total Mana:|29|||

My summoner is Wizard of Eastwood for the -2 armor. I have Nectar Queen as my tank and Failed Summoner as my backup tank. The rest of my monsters are all ranged monsters so they can deal damage while my tanks take the damage.

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. The first few monsters can tank most of the damage, and the rest of my lineup is all focused on dealing ranged damage. There are no abilities, so the extra damage from range will help. Also, my archon reduces armor and that can give me an advantage.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/Eo1wpEdNs7VQdvfoFxXmivDPfts1mNpDzBuPN9YHTdahuGNjpehpeuvbh8xuCzAGx6D.png)
At first glance, I think that I have the advantage. My opponent doesn't have as much damage as I do, but he does have tankier monsters. My tanks will be alive for a few turns so I can deal damage during that time period.

### Round 4

![round 4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tGXZn98mDwPQNxZwQVNyHCoePPX8VkZ1QXygyixdP89SVAm3adGhRGF8iGAeDqGzDd8.png)
A few rounds later, my opponent is down to 2 monsters, while I still have 4. This is my win because the first monster will die from my magic monsters, and that means my opponent can't attack anymore.


![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tRvEB3benVnXSX2YQuuxGqNZ4QUZMWWpmJhUMP67j8TJgsiDxY6WoyMLbMPiJZcJk3R.png)

I won later that round.

## Conclusion
The battle did go exactly as planned. I took advantage of the ruleset to put some tankier monsters up front because they will always get targeted. With this, the rest of my ranged monsters could focus on damage and gave me a win.

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_lD0bEYrSWJcXZO6b9yLa?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

body.title: Kinegar Big Bunny at Dockers bar for Beer Saturday
body.body:
# <center> Working in Dublin </center>
#

The nature of my job means regular spins up and down to Dublin. I often drive up and down on the day, but there are also times when I've to work up their for two consecutive days in order to attend team meetings, meet vendors or attend to senior management matters.

Last week I had two days in a row, so I stayed in a city centre hotel. We get to choose the hotel, so I tend to opt for one with a pool and leisure centre, so that I can start day two with a swim, jacuzzi and sauna which is a marvellous way to start any day!

That evening I went to a pub called The Dockers for a few pints.


![Screenshot_20260523_065508_WhatsApp.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmafMYL2mCZERAkpCYq2MF5Asn4fDr45iJC27qZ3ebGb21/Screenshot_20260523_065508_WhatsApp.jpg)

It's a pretty funky bar in Dublin and it sells some good IPAs including Kinegar's Big Bunny, a firm favourite of mine and a local beer from Donegal. 

It's always nice to support local! 
Níl aon tinteán mar do thinteán féin!
![Screenshot_20260523_065501_WhatsApp.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdBdgT4Di4QkUJTp6B7bR2ac9CaHXrhoZX6yxFvQjWV3W/Screenshot_20260523_065501_WhatsApp.jpg)

I wasn't the only one drinking a few IPAs either. I got these photos from one of my good friends who lives in California.


![Screenshot_20260523_065631_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZxpRE6WehxTUtoMrdksvFKLdEf9hhjU4nTXRHHbujuzZ/Screenshot_20260523_065631_Gallery.jpg)

He was missing in action in Miami on a trip woth his wife, enjoying a few nice hoppy local IPAs of his own.

It's a worldwide thing now and everyone enjoys a nice cool, refreshing IPA, well everyone with a semblance of taste anyways!

![Screenshot_20260523_065626_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW7TFLpMhoVcY2Ws7bMahaEWGpcMQ6DzudzZsDKoBcG9H/Screenshot_20260523_065626_Gallery.jpg)

What IPA is the go to where you are? Or is there another staple drink like the Guinness we have here in Ireland? 


![Screenshot_20260523_071511_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYvCMhoe5zoWc5a8Tsm44CN98JuZupZvFZnJ7js8dsESL/Screenshot_20260523_071511_Gallery.jpg)

![Screenshot_20260523_071525_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWPHipncmEBHTXaii2nQM4Sw8GhCZZrac9wBfbTMk2RFF/Screenshot_20260523_071525_Gallery.jpg)

![Screenshot_20260523_071723_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvWvThDk4Qd3Btsgduj3tVt9WVmUQrozugiQqBjCZHyL/Screenshot_20260523_071723_Gallery.jpg)

![Screenshot_20260523_071730_Gallery.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSLtTuSMw8tNeWdyQfepx8DmL5oDi3uC8rxWKSzX9T1he/Screenshot_20260523_071730_Gallery.jpg)



I'd love to hear all about it in the comments below.

Well, that's it.

Until next time Beer Saturdayorians...

Oh by the way...

How was your Beer Saturday?

Where were you?

What was the drink of choice?

Who was with you?

Are those your feet?

How's your auld one?

Any other craic?

body.title: 老同学离职
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![A1ocNICBG76aiZjk_IMG_20260519_110016.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/A1ocNICBG76aiZjk_IMG_20260519_110016/A1ocNICBG76aiZjk_IMG_20260519_110016.webp)
![I5GBWNOP2HQ9ENfN_IMG_20260519_110023.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/I5GBWNOP2HQ9ENfN_IMG_20260519_110023/I5GBWNOP2HQ9ENfN_IMG_20260519_110023.webp)
![il46KytfwwgcTCiA_IMG_20260519_110019.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/trina77/images/il46KytfwwgcTCiA_IMG_20260519_110019/il46KytfwwgcTCiA_IMG_20260519_110019.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

我的同事也是我的老同学，昨天正式告别职场。她经我的介绍来到了公司与我在同一部门同一大区工作，我们共同为了自己的生活而努力着。起初，大家都怀揣着一份努力拼搏的心态干到退休，终究，还是没能坚持下去。
 
她只有两份工作经验，第一份工作稳稳坚守了十一年，那是南昌开往北京直达列车的乘务员，由于常年累月奔波与熬夜她在成家后就选择了离职。

接下来就是我们这份工作也咬牙坚持了六年。其实这次离职她心里早就酝酿许久，两年前患上焦虑症开始，离开的念头就一直在心底盘旋，其中种种心酸缘由，也不便细细言说。
 
我们这份工作常年顶着高强度压力，频繁出差奔波，家庭与工作的平衡也总令她困扰。这六年里，从备孕二胎到离婚加上投资失利，身心慢慢被耗得郁郁寡欢。

平常的她与同事们相处和睦融洽，面对业务却始终有心无力。销售行业向来以业绩说话，没有业绩就没有话务员。常年业绩靠后，面对领导严苛的要求始终难以达标，加班、追责更是家常便饭，这么多年她一路小心翼翼熬了过来。
 
当初她和前夫经相亲结缘，没有感情基础，只因彼此条件相当才组建家庭，婚后丈夫性格怯懦，处事情商不足，婆媳矛盾也无从调和，最终她果断选择放手，孩子跟着她生活。
 
昨天下班之际，她发来消息道别：“老同学，再见了，以后常联系哟！”
我回复她：“恭喜你终于解脱，往后日子一定闪闪发光。”
 
能真切感受到，卸下重担的她满心轻松畅快，还早早订好了27号飞往新疆的机票，打算奔赴远方散心释怀。好像大多告别职场的人，都会用一场旅行放空自己，以此来宽慰多年牛马生活的短暂结束。
 
相识近二十年的情谊不会因离职变淡，真心祝愿她往后好好调养身心，褪去所有烦恼，放下生活与工作的重重压力，再去开启一段新的旅程，不论是婚姻也好工作也罢愿以后的她都能闪闪发光。

---

Earth element monsters that are effective and powerful have always been considered the best especially those cards whose cost is low but powers and abilities are very amazing. I always try to present such best and budget friendly cards to you people that can prove to be game changers in battle. 

Today I am going to talk about “Forlorn Geomant” which is a very dangerous and powerful monster belonging to the Earth element. If it is used correctly in high mana battles then it can become a very big threat for the enemy. 

Today I will discuss in detail its visual display, stats, abilities, best placement and price. There are monster cards which have the best stats and ability available at low prices and this will be  my effort to bring forward such cards for you guys.

![Screenshot 2026-05-23 104719.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tGbvsW5LxBPgpWxu7z7E6nnwDXM9eisTpN35XUHYfsQPA5ftuJkhWNrvocChwxMU6Qc.png)

First of all lets talk about the visual display of this monster, it is an amazing Earth theme based monster. Its whole body looks made of strong stones while the energy present around its hair and body looks made of green grass, leaves and stone particles. 

He is looking at its enemies in a very dangerous way and it feels as if it is ready to throw all its energy at them. Its visual design is really very beautiful and impressive which impressed me a lot and based on this idea I also created an image of it with the help of ChatGPT.

Its stats is amazing, it is a 13 mana cost monster card that means it can be used in the best way in mid to high mana battles. In low mana battles it does not prove very effective because its mana cost is quite high. 

Its biggest strength is being a strong tank. It has 5 armor which keeps absorbing enemy attacks for a long time and gives protection to its allied units. Along with this its health is also excellent and if we talk at level 10 then its health reaches 10  which makes it able to survive in battle for a long time.

![Screenshot 2026-05-23 104731.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23uQGLY57xww5syi9wmvEz1LVjMu62WEsgHupgfpkko5phmaKBzC6Nsv8fsW2YF196Q8S.png)

Its speed is 3 which is considered a decent attack speed but the most dangerous thing is its magic attack. In every round it does magic damage to the enemy and the special thing is that magic attack bypasses armor and directly hits health. 

This thing makes it a versatile monster because on one side it is a strong tank and on the other side it is also a powerful attacker. He attacks with +5 every round.

Now lets talk about its abilities, at level ten it has two very dangerous abilities. The first ability is “Impede” through which after every successful attack it keeps reducing the enemy’s speed with minus one. 

The second ability is “Wing Break” which proves especially very dangerous against flying units. It always targets flying enemy units and also does extra damage to them. These two abilities make this monster even more dangerous and unique.

![Screenshot 2026-05-23 104754.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EnynZMKFmyHSk9z33Wa9MmeUdJ5GhJ8Ge7Xe4S2Cewcky2naU2btzJfENfzKPqGwf11.png)

Now if we talk about its price then at starting levels it is available for only $0.02 which is a very reasonable price according to its powers and stats. While if you want to upgrade it to max level meaning level ten then it is available for around $9 which is still considered a very reasonable price for a powerful and versatile card. 

Players who cannot afford to buy cards, for them renting is also a very good option because at a very low price you can get any monster card on rent.

So this was the detailed discussion about Forlorn Geomant. I hope you got good information about this powerful Earth monster. If you play high mana battles then this card is definitely worthy of being included in your deck.

[My new video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ECEy6lDoJYU) about my second ride while on holiday in Germany just got online if you like to see some nice cycling content accompanied with some good music, because of so many closed trails in the forest I couldn't go where I had planned with my Garmin computer, so I ended up just cycling in a general direction but that obviously didn't work! 🤣

body.title: Why You Need To Learn Before You Lead
body.body:
> There was this young guy that I met some years back where I did my internship. He was a staff of the organisation. Due to his performance, skills, talent, and hard work, he was promoted to the supervisory role of his department. However, instead of acting like he was omniscient or that he knows everything, he had to still spend some time, learning from his managers listening to his team members, and even improving on his communication skills. He was willing to humble himself to learn before exercising his authority. This made him to be respected as a leader, and his leadership was so effective. Others did not have any problem following him because they saw value in him. This is why it is always good to learn before you lead.
![pexels-mikhail-nilov-8730124.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcLNGvBHd5BgUFF6Jnb8Qqy5P3TQvqPGB2pWWaj3FY1bm/pexels-mikhail-nilov-8730124.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/men-shaking-hands-over-a-conference-table-8730124)
Leadership is something that everyone would desire at some point in their life. For example, in the family, at home, in one group or the other, in the neighborhood, within the community, or even at the higher levels. However, there is something about the concept of leadership that not everyone have really understood, which is; your willingness to learn should precede your quest for leadership. Obviously, you do not know everything, so learning is not an option, but a mandate if you will lead well. If you see a leader who does not learn, they will be prone to taking wrong decisions, misusing their authority, or even abusing power. This is why I have always believed that the best of the leaders are those who are also the best of the learners. Before leading effectively, you have to develop wisdom, knowledge, discipline, and understanding before you take responsibilities for others. Trust me, leadership is not just about the position you occupy, or the portfolio you are given, but it is also about the impact you create, your influence, and your problem-solving skills. It is not about staying in one corner and giving instructions, but it is more about guiding others in wisdom, setting good examples for them, and being involved in their growth. If you want to know the success of any leader, look at the people they are leading. One of the vital reasons why learning is important is because leadership directly or indirectly affects people's lives in ways you may never expect. One single decision can alter the course of someone's life permanently. A leader's decision can influence the team, affect the organisation, and many other aspects. Now imagine if the decision is taken without proper understanding, it may cause a lot of damages, confusion, or even setbacks. This is the reason why preparation is absolutely very important. Before a leader will lead, they must first developed themself. After all, you can only develop others when you have developed yourself.
![pexels-mikhail-nilov-9159068.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW138PRfoFpBxTFBavqVVdkYrbT4o2n7UuVYwPNx2CxfA/pexels-mikhail-nilov-9159068.jpg)
Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-teacher-observing-his-student-9159068)
Another reason to learn is that it also builds humility. The people who are always willing to learn will understand that they do not possess infinite knowledge, nor do they know everything in the world. This will make them to remain open to correction, advice, and growth. Pride often comes with poor judgement, which can affect someone's leadership negatively. But humility makes it worthwhile. In addition to building humility, learning also builds experience, which can teach valuable lessons in life. The truth is that leadership skills are not born with people, rather they are developed through observation, listening, paying attention, and taking responsibilities. Someone who has not learnt patience, for example, will struggle to lead people with understanding. Small things will get them angry, and they may not be able to manage stress. It is worthy to note that good leaders are also good listeners. This is not just about hearing what others are saying, but listening to understand, not just to respond. Listening is also part of the learning processes that are required to produce a good leader. Understand that your perception about life may not be the best, there are still different perceptions and perspectives that you need to welcome to be able to make better decisions. If a leader does not listen to their teammates, they may begin to feel undervalued and ignored, and they may lose their willingness to follow the leader. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

HiveSuite integrates unified Snaps feed UI with improved navigation, reply UX, and cleaner sidebar structure.

# HiveSuite 

## Sidebar & Inbox Navigation Improvements

### Inbox Navigation Update

- Updated sidebar Inbox navigation icon:
  - Replaced Ring Bell icon  
  - Added Mail icon for Inbox navigation  


- Improved navigation clarity and consistency across the application sidebar.  

- Better reflects messaging and inbox-related functionality for users.  


- Outcome:
  - Cleaner sidebar navigation experience  
  - Improved UX consistency for Inbox interactions  


Inbox Navigation Icon Update
![Inbox Navigation Icon Update](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sagarkothari88/23uEwyNnqjm55EeUq5ZryzpRZhxbTjfUk3pSKgQeeFoUBf3omEmanaQgv8PYrjdjoBDkK.png)

---

## Unified Snaps Feed Integration

### Snaps Feed System Integration

- feat(snaps): integrate unified feed UI in hivesuite.
- Integrated unified Snaps feed UI using HiveReactKit components.  

- Mapped feeds using:
  - `useFeedByType` stores  
  - HiveReactKit feed keys  


- Added `SnapsUnifiedPage` integration into the application.  

- Unified hSnaps feeds with the shared kit feed system.  


- Removed mobile feed-selector dropdown to simplify feed navigation.  

- Cleaned up `AppDrawer` navigation structure.  


- Outcome:
  - Improved feed consistency across HiveSuite applications  
  - Cleaner navigation flow for Snaps feeds  
  - Reduced UI complexity on mobile devices

body.title: Weekend is here
body.body:
Hi, guys!

Today I'm supposed to rest, and yesterday I finally sat down and rewrote my daily plan, factoring in all the things I'd like to do regularly. It's a very strict plan, and I have no idea how I'm going to live with such a rigid schedule, so now I need to test it out and see if it's even viable. It looks good on paper, but it looks like it'll be pretty daunting in real life. But if I want to finally start doing all the things I've been wanting to do for so long, I'll have to start tightening up my daily plan.

So far, I've only been able to do my blog and reading on a regular basis, but my list should also include sports, dog walks, writing, drawing, and music. And that's every day. I understand that's a lot for one day, but it just so happens that I need everything at once, and I don't see any other options. So I'll have to find a way to squeeze everything into my schedule without sacrificing my blogging and reading. I'll try to live a more relaxed life on weekends, and take days off during the week when I feel the need.

Plus, I have to maintain my and my husband's diet, cook, and take care of myself. Basically, my hands are full, and I have to keep up with everything. But I hope I'll learn to cope. I'll get used to managing everything.

Have a great day, everyone!

# <center> Welcome to the #DailyPrompt by the @daily.prompt, your daily writing prompt from the @Freewritehouse, and the Freewriters Community!</center>

<center><sub><sub>The @Freewritehouse, and members of the Freewriters Community, will be forever grateful to @mariannewest for creating the daily freewriting prompt and for posting it for 2023 days!!! Thank you Marianne!</sub></sub></center>




Freewriting is a great way to start or maintain a writing habit. And we've been making it easy for you with a daily prompt for over 3000 days!

And, as an added bonus, we are continuing to award **three freewriters a Hive SBI share every single day**!
<center>![giveaway.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/AJoLtsVsugdVrTuJ5x7bFSQywMHn9X8XiTcDB748kRJdDaiJHvbSAZ6bAHMVj3j.gif)</center>
All you have to do, for a chance of winning one is 
- write a freewrite based on the @Daily.Prompt
- post it in the Freewriters Community, 
- and drop a link in the comments section of this post! 

Every day **three** of the best daily freewrites will be awarded **one** HiveSBI share. 
<sub>Not sure what Hive SBI is? [Find out more here](https://docs.hivesbi.com/)</sub>

What are you waiting for?



# <center>Today's #DailyPrompt is</center>

# <center>I am the owner</center>

...

How to freewrite...

- Set your timer for 5 minutes
- Start writing
- Use the hashtag #freewrite #dailyprompt
- Publish your piece (include a link to this post if you wish)
- Copy and paste your URL into the comment section of **this post**.
<sup>Or, if you don't want to publish your freewrite, just copy and paste as a comment under the prompt post.</sup>
- What if you want to write for longer than five minutes? No problem! There are no rules... 

except...
# 
### <center>**NO plagiarism, NO AI-generated stories**</center> 
<center><sup>(write your own story; that is kinda the whole point!)</sup></center>

<center>![ezgif.com-crop (1).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/daily.prompt/23tGTgenLx7nZuH24w8svkxMgichtFRkx4TPk4Ycqw4gV2EF1XNXCmJHkuoes3Lki5fPH.gif)</center>

# Check the @freewritehouse for fun contests

Other contests are available at the FreewriteHouse. Thank you to everyone who contributes!

<sub>If you have an idea for a contest (and the time and motivation to run it) please contact @felt.buzz</sub>


...
# Contests by Friends of the Freewriters

@improv runs a weekly Punday contest. Check it out!

<sub>If you are running a contest you want to be listed here, let @felt.buzz know.</sub>

# Writing help

- A free app: Grammarly. A lot of us are not native English speakers and I am finding it a helpful app. It will underline spelling and grammar mistakes. Remember that it is not always right -especially if you use complex sentence structures. [Here is the link](https://app.grammarly.com/)
- Remember [The Most Dangerous Writing App](https://www.squibler.io/dangerous-writing-prompt-app). You set the time - 5 min - and start typing. Don’t stop!!! It will destroy what you wrote if you stop for more than 3 seconds - and backspace does not count as writing on the app. If you are prone to stop and think - this app forces you to keep going. You can make corrections after the 5 minutes are over.
- A timer. Egg timer is a free tool you can use on your desktop to set a time. This is useful for our freewrites or if you want to work in blocks of time and then take a break. [Here is the link](https://e.ggtimer.com/)

body.title: [ENG/ESP] Daily 5-Minute Message / Hope. Mensaje diario de 5 minutos/Esperanza
body.body:
Hope is that delicate yet resilient thread that the world has not managed to break, even when wars, hatred, and violence seem to take up far too much space. In the midst of a wounded planet, where news sometimes weighs heavier than sunrises, hope remains an act of courage. It is not naivety: it is a form of resistance. It is believing that humanity can rediscover its light even when the shadow insists on imposing itself.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbtLMgPYVSxEnFBn5wxDmEE9QgVG7RVJhQzyMieVhFtxy/100_2235.jpg)


Hope is born when we recognize that, despite everything, we still long for peace, love, and noble feelings. That longing does not arise from emptiness: it arises from what we have lived, what we have lost, what still hurts. Those who have seen darkness know how to value clarity. That is why hope is not a luxury, but a spiritual necessity. It is the engine that allows us to get up, reach out, forgive, rebuild, imagine a different tomorrow.

In a fractured world, hope is also a commitment. It is not enough to wish for peace: we must cultivate it in the everyday, in the way we speak, in how we look at others, in how we respond to conflict. Hope becomes real when it turns into gesture, into word, into action. When we stop repeating the violence we criticize and begin to sow the tenderness we long for.

Sometimes hope seems small, almost fragile. But it is precisely in its fragility that its strength lies. Because a single spark is enough to ignite a fire, a single hug can stop a fall, a single kind gesture can remind us that not all is lost. Hope is contagious: when someone holds onto it, others find the courage to hold onto it as well.

I believe in a world where peace is not the exception, but the norm. Where love is not a refuge, but a path. Where noble feelings are not seen as weakness, but as the true measure of human greatness. And even if that world does not yet fully exist, hope is the compass that guides us toward it.

To conclude, as I like to do, I give you two décimas espinelas on the value of hope.

The Value of Hope

Amid so much war and strife
hope rises, steady and bright,
a light that never brings fright
and makes the barren earth fertile.
Though hatred is cast aside — with patience and with love's own art —
always a radiance will start
that dares all sorrow to defy,
for the peace of each day, you and I
build with courage within the heart.

Hope is the seed that remains
resilient through the storm's roar,
the voice that stays at the core
when the soul kneels down in its pains.
It's the strength that in us reigns,
the embrace that calls us near,
the truth that ignites no fear,
and the dream that holds us fast,
because in the end, at last,
the light comes to claim what is dear.



Note: I used the translator DeepL Translate as a reference and adjusted for poetic flow.






ESPAÑOL 

La esperanza es ese hilo tenue pero resistente que el mundo no ha logrado romper, aun cuando las guerras, el odio y la violencia parecen ocupar demasiado espacio. En medio de un planeta herido, donde las noticias a veces pesan más que los amaneceres, la esperanza sigue siendo un acto de valentía. No es ingenuidad: es una forma de resistencia. Es creer que la humanidad puede reencontrarse con su luz incluso cuando la sombra insiste en imponerse.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbtLMgPYVSxEnFBn5wxDmEE9QgVG7RVJhQzyMieVhFtxy/100_2235.jpg)

La esperanza nace cuando reconocemos que, pese a todo, seguimos anhelando paz, amor y sentimientos nobles. Ese anhelo no surge del vacío: surge de lo vivido, de lo perdido, de lo que aún duele. Quien ha visto la oscuridad sabe valorar la claridad. Por eso la esperanza no es un lujo, sino una necesidad espiritual. Es el motor que nos permite levantarnos, tender la mano, perdonar, reconstruir, imaginar un mañana distinto.

En un mundo fracturado, la esperanza es también un compromiso. No basta con desear la paz: hay que cultivarla en lo cotidiano, en la forma en que hablamos, en cómo miramos al otro, en cómo respondemos al conflicto. La esperanza se vuelve real cuando se convierte en gesto, en palabra, en acto. Cuando dejamos de repetir la violencia que criticamos y empezamos a sembrar la ternura que añoramos.

A veces la esperanza parece pequeña, casi frágil. Pero es precisamente en su fragilidad donde reside su fuerza. Porque basta una chispa para encender un fuego, basta un abrazo para detener una caída, basta un gesto de bondad para recordarnos que no todo está perdido. La esperanza es contagiosa: cuando alguien la sostiene, otros encuentran el valor para sostenerla también.

Yo creo en un mundo donde la paz no sea excepción, sino costumbre. Donde el amor no sea refugio, sino camino. Donde los sentimientos nobles no sean vistos como debilidad, sino como la verdadera medida de la grandeza humana. Y aunque ese mundo aún no exista del todo, la esperanza es la brújula que nos guía hacia él.



Para concluir lo hago como me gusta hacerlo y les regalo dos décimas espinelas sobre el valor de la esperanza.

El valor de la esperanza 

En medio de tanta guerra  
la esperanza se levanta,  
como luz que nunca espanta  
y vuelve fértil la tierra.  
Aunque el odio se destierra  
con paciencia y con amor,  
siempre nace un resplandor  
que al dolor desafía,  
pues la paz de cada día  
se construye con valor.

La esperanza es la semilla  
que resiste en la tormenta,  
la voz que nunca se ausenta  
cuando el alma se arrodilla.  
Es la fuerza que nos brilla,  
el abrazo que nos llama,  
la verdad que nunca inflama  
y el sueño que nos sostiene,  
porque al final siempre viene  
la luz que al mundo reclama.

Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate.

body.title: SpaceX Successfully Launches Biggest and Strongest Starship V3 Ever...Explosion after launch of Indian Ocean
body.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWFiEtpaocYY1FHn6P8XUap6S69v6M8pTTsyhikQVEDjj/image.png)

>SpaceX has successfully completed a test flight of its largest and most powerful new Starship model ever developed. It is an upgraded spacecraft that NASA is counting on as a key tool for future moon landing missions.

>The newly designed super rocket went on its first public flight two days after SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced plans to go public. The rocket was launched from the new Starbase launch site at the southern tip of Texas, and was originally scheduled to launch Thursday evening, but it was postponed by a day due to last-minute technical issues with the launch site.
The flight marks the 12th test flight of Starship, which Musk is developing to eventually send humans to Mars. The last flight of the previous generation Starship was in October last year, and the new third-generation version, the so-called \

measures 407 feet (about 124 meters) long, more than a meter larger than the previous model. The thrust of the engine has also been greatly strengthened, and the first-stage booster has grown in size and strength instead of reducing the number of grid pins used for direction control on return. The transfer pipe, which fuels the 33 main engines, has also been redesigned to a level equivalent to SpaceX's Falcon 9 first-stage booster. The main body of the spacecraft has been newly added to the docking condo for increased number of cameras, improved navigation and computer performance, and future docking and lunar exploration.

>The flight went on a trajectory that circled half the earth for about an hour, and 20 test Starlink satellites were successfully separated and discharged in the middle. The spacecraft succeeded in reaching its final destination, the Indian Ocean, despite some engine problems. Afterwards, it charged into the Indian Ocean in a vertical position while maintaining almost complete control, and immediately exploded by falling sideways. According to SpaceX, this last explosion was an expected scenario.

>SpaceX feared a repeat of a situation in which an aerial explosion dumped debris into the Atlantic Ocean on a series of test flights last year, but this time it continued its flight without a major explosion until the last minute. Meanwhile, no equipment was recovered from the flight, and the first-stage booster crashed into the Gulf of Mexico. Starship is basically being developed with the goal of full reuse, and it envisions catching a return rocket in the air with a giant mechanical arm installed on the launch pad.

>The immediate task of Starship is the moon, not Mars. NASA has paid billions of dollars to two companies, SpaceX and Blue Origin, to develop a lunar lander that will land Artemis astronauts on the moon. While Starship has already reached its space boundary for about an hour through several test flights, Blue Origin's Blue Moon lander, founded by Jeff Bezos, has yet to be launched. However, preparations for a prototype for a test flight to the moon are underway within the year.
Following a close-to-the-moon flight involving four astronauts in April, NASA plans to conduct a real docking test in Earth's orbit next year. The Artemis III mission will allow astronauts to practice docking procedures with the Orion capsule and Starship or Blue Moon. It will then be possible for the Artemis IV mission, in which two astronauts will land on the moon in 2028, and the actual model will be the safer and first-prepared landing craft among Starship and Blue Moon. If the mission is successful, it will be the first time since Apollo 17 in 1972.

>NASA's idea is not just a landing. We are steadily moving toward our long-term goal of building a permanent lunar base run by astronauts and robots near the moon's south pole.
Jaehyung Kim (jhkim03@ytn.co.kr )

The explosion was an expected part of the process.

Therefore, despite the issues with the launch vehicle, the focus should be on the fact that all planned objectives were carried out during this launch.

It appears that, at least in terms of launch vehicle technology, they are still more than one step ahead of other companies.

The construction of a lunar base also seems to be just a few years away.

body.title: El peluche rosado y único para mi amor
body.body: >\nMe llego un dinero es el momento y lo primero que pienso es en mi amor, es sábado y es tarde, pero intentare buscar ese regalo especial, el regalo, el que ella se merece; siempre que hablábamos ella me dice que querías la figura de un monstruo rosa tierno, así bien cute, recordé una tienda en el centro que tenia ese tipo de peluches y figuras, corrí para evitar que me cerraran la tienda en la cara, como suele pasar habitualmente, honestamente no quiero llegar con las manos vacías, con suerte logre estar en la tienda a tiempo, pero siempre hay algún inconveniente, la tienda esta llena de peluche de todo tipo, muchos rosas, y la cantidad de monstruos y animalitos peludos es impresionante, abismal, de momento toca respirar, tener paciencia que últimamente no la tengo, pero no me falta la fe y ganas de conseguir ese objeto para mi amor.

>Tome valor, respire y le pregunte al vendedor si sabia de ese peluche, yo no me se el nombre el nombre, así que lo describí: -es redondo y no es Pokemon, tiene un cabello azul rizado, los ojos grises, su expresión es de sorprendido...-, después de explicar cada detalle, el vendedor me dijo: - ahhhh ya se, creo me queda uno, debe estar por aquí -. yo de momento confió que lo consiga, tengo fe, a los dos minutos de espera me comenta que no esta, que quizás se vendió mas temprano, así que pensé que falle en la misión del regalo especial, me resigne y baje la cabeza, sentí tristeza por no cumplir, me acerque a la puerta y resulta que estaba allí al lado de la entrada, el peluche estaba como viéndome, este tenia los brazos abiertos, casi que dice, ¡estoy aquí nos vamos!, lo agarre con alegría y pague, pedí que lo envolvieran que era un regalo especial, salí de allí, había anochecido, pensé que aun quedaba ir a casa a darme una ducha y salir a donde mi amor, pero decidí que la entrega no podía esperar, la llame para que estuviera pendiente que tenia que hablar algo urgente con ella, un vil engaño para darle la gran sorpresa, llegue en 30 minutos a su edificio, ella bajo extrañada, la salude y le dije muy serio: - Te pedí para hablar contigo, porque debes saber que... Conseguí el peluche, el que querías y que siempre me comentabas...- . Ella no aguanto la sorpresa y se le pusieron aguados los ojos, sonrió, salto y luego me dio un beso mágico. Ese momento termino siendo el mas feliz de nuestra relación.

\n--------\nEl texto anterior corresponde a el [Concurso. Observa Piensa Escribe](https://ecency.com/@lanzjoseg/concurso-observa-piensa-escribe-b8a6d3fe6dda6), en que entrando al post, puedes enterarte de las normas para tu también participes en este reto creativo de escritura,

body.title: What would our life be like without smartphones?
body.body:
After waking up in the morning, we first wake up with our phone's alarm. We wake up to the sound of our smartphone and then we see what time it is through our smartphone. Then our day's activities start and we start breakfast in the morning. When we start breakfast in the morning and while having breakfast, we watch various cartoons or funny videos from our social media. There are many people who have breakfast after waking up in the morning and visit various news and surrounding news media while having breakfast. Then a person starts his day's activities. When we get into a car during office hours and leave for the office, we can find out various news entertainment or news on our smartphone inside the car. We have a smartphone in our hands. After entering the office, we start our office activities. Sometimes we go to the office and when we go to the office, we constantly see what time it is on our mobile and with the help of our smartphone, we complete our day's activities. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVnWcYWktX4aZBHBDSR89dv8YyYUQKomAyaQyZ3GHb5Vd/1000097154.webp There are many people among us who finish their work and return home. On the way back home, many people go to the market because they need to buy vegetables for their family. When we go to the market to buy vegetables, we also use our smart phones when we go to the market. We can find out the price of a vegetable by using the internet service of our smartphone. While returning home from the market, we use our smartphones again in the vehicle. Moreover, the students around us use their smartphones constantly. In this modern world, we can complete our educational activities through smartphones. We can send news from far and wide to this end of the world in an instant. However, in the crowd of so many things, we have lost our beautiful life. Basically, the creator has given us a very beautiful life. And we are ending that life with just one device. Because the ability to use smartphones has increased a lot within us. Every person is using a smart phone and their friendship time has decreased. Even a few years ago, during school holidays, we used to play games with our friends and sit and chat in the evenings. But now when we sit together as friends, everyone has a smartphone in their hands. And these smartphones are wasting our time and reducing our ability to enjoy nature. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQmw5kSdcngn2tZH7quZbEtkHZErq2CS5mBf7eUXGBVV2/1000097155.webp But what would our situation be like if we did not have a smart phone inside us? I think it would be a great moment. When we do not have a smart phone in our hands, we will be much freer and the stress on our heads will be reduced. When the stress is reduced, we will get the opportunity to play sports with friends and we will be able to enjoy a beautiful life. Now in the evening when we sit together with friends, everyone uses smartphones. Some do not have time to talk to each other. Everyone uses smartphones and some play games on their phones and watch reels videos. But if we do not have a smart phone, then the time will be really happy. Because we will be able to enjoy enough time and the ability to enjoy this world will be created. So I think without a smartphone, our stress will be reduced, our time will increase and we will be able to succeed in any work and enjoy a beautiful life.

body.title: Challenge #04892-M143: False Fate
body.body:
![smithsonian-xjMTjKODKFw-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/23wCLbumyjzh3hw3ZvLtxcX67pnve5MD47mr3psFQoP3RSw7dSHdzXP2fgj5A1w5gQ8UN.jpg)

> Some hold that the fates of all men are carved into stone. What happens when a miner breaks into a cave and discovers tablets seeming to record all events of the miner’s life up until that point and then details what is to come thereafter? -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

Some legends say that the Great Silver Dragon curled up and became the moon. Some say that she became the very world upon which all other life depends. Some legends say that all the destinies of all the lives are written upon the Great Silver Dragon's scales, and woe betide any who find so much as one...

Some legends will say anything.

But most legends have a mote of truth inside them, as the unfortunate Sapper Jaymes found out to his peril. He _had_ been minding his own business, mining his claim and following a seam of interesting rock. At least until that very rock split open and he found a small chamber containing a stone like no other. It was covered with writing.

Well. What he recognised as writing. It had all the shapes and patterns of writing. As he ventured closer, the shapes _moved_ and twisted. Became something he could understand.

Pictures. Pictures of his life. He recognised his family and the farm he grew up on. The time he broke his arm because Cousin Daryn dared him to goad the bull. The one fishing trip that had caught a true bounty. His decision to go mining, and the building of his mine. The best finds. Including this one.

As to what happened _next_... it showed him hauling the stone towards the surface, bringing it out into the daylight. Showing it off to the wandering merchant who came by to sell him supplies. It showed crowds coming to see it. It showed him getting rich from their money. It showed his mine becoming a destination.

That was a lot of people who suddenly wanted to know him. He'd come out this far to _avoid_ too many people. Jaymes backed away from the thing. Readied his pick to smash it.

The pictures changed. It showed him smashing the stone, the mine collapsing around him. It showed bones under the ground.

Well, if he didn't want to drag it up and he'd die if he smashed it, then he could just bury it again. He had plenty of spoil from his excavations.

The images changed again. Showing him chipping some of the stones surrounding the chamber. Selling them to the traveling merchant. It showed him doing well. It showed him talking to a Wizard, who did the taking the stone away. It showed Jaymes living the life as suited him best.

\

He chipped the stones from the chamber walls, sold them off in exchange for supplies. The merchant came back in a hurry. A day sooner than the week it took her to make her stops. This time with an excited Wizard in tow.

\
Jaymes figured the Wizard was foreign and didn't know the right way to say some words. \

Wizards never needed lanterns, but Jaymes told them not to make any flames on account of the gasses that could sometimes cause troubles. He led them down to see it, and busied himself with the walls while the Wizard stared at the changing writing.

He met Ereshkygal with his pick in his hand and a knife in his back. That was only the start of a chain of murder and thievery attached to the Rock of Dissension.

>Unsplash] If you like my stories, please [Check out my blog and Follow me](https://peakd.com/@internutter). body.title: Historical Trends in U.S. Housing Affordability (1985-2025)
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQMMqo8nvcHWniyc7fXhGhpXThyWwsbmqvXPHqZLk3nJQ/image.png)


>OC/Excel
Note: This chart is based on FRED data (MSPUS and MEHOINUSA646N). It compares median sales prices of homes sold with median household income and does not adjust for mortgage rates or regional differences. Price-to-Income Ratio calculated by the author.

| Year | Median Household Income | Median House Price | Price-to-Income Ratio |
|------|--------------------------|--------------------|------------------------|
| 1985 | $23,620                  | $82,800            | 3.5                    |
| 1990 | $29,940                  | $123,900           | 4.1                    |
| 1995 | $34,080                  | $130,000           | 3.8                    |
| 2000 | $41,990                  | $165,300           | 3.9                    |
| 2005 | $46,330                  | $232,500           | 5.0                    |
| 2010 | $49,280                  | $222,900           | 4.5                    |
| 2015 | $56,520                  | $289,200           | 5.1                    |
| 2020 | $68,010                  | $329,000           | 4.8                    |
| 2025 | $83,730                  | $423,100           | 4.8                    |


Over the past 40 years, housing prices in the USA have outpaced wages, causing today's aspiring home buyers to feel that home buying is out of reach. In the early 1980s the price for a house was approximately 3.5 times the average yearly income. Today, houses in the USA cost five times or more than the average yearly income, with many larger metropolitan areas costing ten times or more than the average yearly income.

This issue hasn't developed evenly. At one point, housing prices were improving in the year 2000 and then sharply increased in the mid-2000s. In many areas where housing is in significant demand due to job density, housing stock is extremely lacking, combined with rapidly increasing land and construction costs, which drives prices even higher. Additionally, housing has increasingly become a vehicle for investment rather than simply a place to live, which has placed upward pressure on prices.

Due to all of these reasons, owning a home today has become increasingly difficult when compared to past generations, especially relative to current mortgage interest rates, and many people end up renting longer prior to being able to purchase a home.

Data Sources:

Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED). (n.d.). Median sales price of houses sold for the United States [Data set]. [Link](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/MSPUS)

Federal Reserve Bank of St Louis (FRED). (n.d.). Median household income in the United States [Data set]. [Link](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/MEHOINUSA646N)

body.title: WHAT THE NUMBERS FEEL
body.body:
# WHAT THE NUMBERS FEEL

*A dispatch from the bottom of the Michigan survey*

---

44.8.

Sit with that for a moment. The University of Michigan's final consumer sentiment reading for May came in at 44.8 — weaker than every single economist projection in the Bloomberg survey, and lower than the preliminary read of 48.2 published two weeks ago. It fell through the floor that April had just set as the previous all-time low. It is now below the June 2022 nadir, when CPI was running at 9.1%, Russia had just invaded Ukraine, and the global supply chain was still a crime scene.

Americans feel worse about the economy right now than they did then. Absorb that.

The sentiment series goes back to 1952. We have never been here. Not during the oil shocks of the 1970s that economists still use as their bogeyman. Not during the dot-com wreckage. Not when Lehman failed and the whole apparatus shuddered. Not during a pandemic that closed the world for two years. The University of Michigan has been asking Americans how they feel about their economic lives for 74 years, and the answer, in May 2026, is: worse than ever.

You can dismiss sentiment data if you want. Plenty of strategists do. They'll show you the jobs numbers, point at S&P profit margins — which hit a record 13.4% in Q1, a number that would have seemed delusional five years ago — and argue that vibes are not fundamentals. They're not wrong that the divergence is real. They are wrong that it doesn't matter.

---

Inflation expectations over the next year jumped to 4.8%. In February, before the US-Israeli war with Iran started and before oil crossed $100 a barrel, that number was 3.4%. One and a half percentage points of inflation expectation added in three months, entirely on the back of a geopolitical event that most Americans couldn't have located on a map before it started. The national average for a gallon of gasoline crossed $4 — the level at which AAA, in a 2022 survey, found a majority of Americans begin actually changing their behavior. Not grumbling. Changing.

GasBuddy's daily active user base nearly doubled in March. People are driving to find cheaper gas. McDonald's is warning analysts about pressure on customer spending. Whirlpool used the phrase \
to describe the drop in appliance demand. These are not vibes. These are companies watching transactions in real time and reading the data.\n\n\

a PNC economist said recently. There's something almost plaintive about that observation. The Fed spent a decade worrying about deflationary spirals. It spent 2021 calling the price surge transitory. Now inflation is so culturally embedded that Google searches for the term hit all-time highs earlier this year. The economy didn't change people's minds. It burned a new category into them.

---

Here is what makes this moment structurally different from previous sentiment troughs, and why the strategist dismissal misses the point.

In 2022, when sentiment last hit bottom, the Federal Reserve was behind the curve but it could act. Rates were at zero. The hiking cycle had barely started. There was runway. You could tell a story about central bank credibility being restored. Painful, but coherent.

In 2026, that runway is gone. The Fed funds rate is sitting where it is, the new chair was sworn in yesterday morning, the 30-year Treasury closed last week at 5.064%, and one-year inflation expectations are at 4.8%. The policy response space has contracted dramatically. You can't hike into a war-driven oil shock without crushing the consumer who is already, by their own account, more miserable than at any point in recorded survey history. You can't cut without the long end of the curve treating it as an inflation signal and repricing upward again. Warsh is in a box that Powell didn't build and can't be blamed for, but that doesn't make the box less real.

The S&P 500 closed at record highs this week. The Dow is at 50,579. Consumer sentiment is at 44.8. That gap — between what financial assets are pricing and what the people who actually make up the economy are experiencing — is one of the more unsettling disconnects in recent memory. It's not new; the divergence has widened steadily since 2020. But it keeps getting wider, and at some point the question stops being whether a convergence happens and starts being which direction it converges from.

---

Bitcoin, for what it's worth, is trading around $77,500. Down from $80,000 a week ago, and roughly $34,000 below where it was a year ago. The strategic reserve thesis — Trump's government as perpetual bid — has so far not materialized into a floor. The crypto-friendly Warsh narrative that juiced the space during his confirmation hearing has been thoroughly overtaken by the reality that nobody, not even the most ideologically malleable central banker, can conjure easy money when year-ahead inflation expectations are approaching 5%.

There's an almost classical irony in BTC sitting $34,000 below its year-ago price while inflation fears drive the Michigan survey to its worst reading in history. The asset that was supposed to protect against currency debasement is doing nothing of the sort while the people who most need a hedge are paying $4.50 for gas and choosing between groceries.

---

The long-term inflation expectations data is the one thing in this report that isn't flashing red. Five-year expectations rose only modestly, suggesting that most Americans still believe, on some level, that the current pain is temporary. That's the last structural support for the idea that the Fed doesn't need to slam rates higher. If that reading breaks — if the five-year starts migrating toward 4% — the calculus changes entirely and the conversation shifts from \

Watch that number. It's doing a lot of load-bearing right now.

The rest of the Michigan data is telling a story about a country that is three months into a war it didn't choose, with gas above $4, a new central bank chair who was sworn in at the White House with the president watching, record equity valuations overhead, and a feeling — diffuse, stubborn, historically unprecedented — that something is wrong in a way that the headline numbers have not yet fully priced.

The headline numbers, as they usually do, will catch up eventually.

They always do.

body.body:
<center>

Preparé una taza de café 
y la serví para merendar a las tres,
con empanada sabría bien,
pero, eso no quería la bebida que preparé. 

Apenas puse el café en la taza,
este saltó de ella con ansias,
cayó sobre la empanada
que amortiguó la caída de forma grata. 

>I made a cup of coffee
and poured it for my three o'clock snack,
it would have gone well with an empanada,
but that wasn't what the drink I made wanted.

>As soon as I poured the coffee into the cup,
it eagerly spilled out,
landing on the empanada,
which cushioned the fall nicely.

por el piso caminó

Cuando encontró la puerta,
la abrió sin reserva,
salió por ella
y dejo la casa, como si prisa tuviera. 

>However, the coffee didn't stay put
and left the kitchen,
walking across the floor,
it even passed by the broom.

went out through it,

oscuro quedó el firmamento

he climbed onto a roof without fear.

and dyed it black,
the heavens grew dark,
and the coffee finally found its place.

body.body: I can't believe the process it takes now to evict someone compared to twenty years ago.  All those \
safety nets put into place to protect people from being evicted during the \

.  People start adding it up now, look at the overall big picture, a large part of what took place, the lock downs, was to force closure of businesses, which ultimately, was the starting process of eliminating them to create capacity on the grid for data centers.  Same with retailers who never went back to 24 hour operations, it was never meant to.  Setting new rules and restrictions on evictions was to ensure many landlords sold out to investors because no one can take a four month loss evicting someone.  Once they are evicted, the house sold to investors, they rehab it and price people out.  That whole concept of \

came from Trump who revitalized blocks at a time into playgrounds in the middle of hoods for the ultra rich.  They never had to step foot outside for something they needed, it was all contained within the buildings.  Now they are using that gentrification process on entire cities.  I am not really complaining complaining, when I moved here I had this saying we were the dividing line, fifty thousand and up, going uphill behind me, to fifty thousand and down, going toward downtown, now it's basically reversed but it's all rentals, condos' and very high priced going toward downtown.  Housing is still pricey behind me going up hill but that was the objective, price all low income people out.  Our downtown is coming back that twenty years ago seemed unimaginable, it's beautiful.  Use to be row after row of abandoned buildings and low income rental area, a playground for the poor essentially.  That's all changed now, though there is still a segregated somewhat area where low income people reside still in apartment buildings a former mayor worked with an investor to rehabilitate for them before gentrification kicked in. Despite the lack of affordable housing for a lot of them, they live in shelters down there, get plenty to eat at a kitchen that serves them free everyday, medical care, and a park designated for them to hang out at.  They have a coffee house with washer and dryers available to use also.  Recently though they did something I think they will come to regret down the road.  They slapped down an open air arena, and soon to be finished soccer stadium that is also open air.  Our downtown is restrictive in space due to a river on one side, and a historic district on the other, and people buying into these condos and paying high rent on rentals, are going to wear out over time having to deal with music genres they don't appreciate, loud screaming, and large amounts of traffic to contend with, especially when all three venues are hosting events on the same nights.  I live at least a mile from the new outdoor arena, and I could not only hear the first concert though closed windows, but sitting on the back porch reverberate off the highway wall back at me.  They really think people are going to pay boatloads of money to live right on top of it just so they can fill up restaurants, bars and parking garages, I just don't see that happening on a continuous basis, and I'd say, probably just about the time, 10, 15 years down the road when maximization of investment starts to kick in, it's going to be a hard sell to convince someone to pay for a 2,3, 4, 5 thousand condo just to be drove crazy in the summertime.  For all the \
, and we are going to do it the right way, in the end, I think they'll find they were no better at it than those who came before them.

body.title: Водонапірна вежа
body.body:
Колись давно на нашій вулиці було дві або навіть три криниці. Всі жителі набирали воду з них, іншого просто не існувало. Легко здогадатись, як багато треба було носити тієї води для потреб сім'ї та великого господарства. Люди ж тримали багато сільськогосподарської птиці та худоби. В кожному майже дворі були як мінімум кури, свині і корова. В часи мого дитинства кози у нас не вважалися серйозними помічниками для годування сім'ї, - корова дає більше молока, то його і їсти вистачає, і здати за якісь гроші заготівельникам можна, щоб мати копійку крім зарплати.
Але згодом по вулиці почали будувати водопровід. Його заповнювачем стала водонапірна вежа, яка постала неподалік від нашого дому. А ми саме вивчали цю тему у школі, тому мені було надзвичайно цікаво, як це все працює.І коли ми їздили у відпустку по Україні, то помічала всі такі вежі, в кожному містечку, селі чи на фермі.
Проживши майже все своє доросле життя у місті, якось про вежі, що дають нам воду, забулося. Ну існує якийсь там водопровід, якісь там насоси качають воду, от вона і є в кранах квартир та міських будинків. Десь ніби з річки Десна її перекачують, попередньо фільтруючи. От і вся фізика.
А коли ми повернулися жити в батьківський дім, то прийшлося згадати про мою улюблену в дитинстві водонапірну вежу. Бо воду ми отримуємо саме з неї. І коли її ремонтують, чи стається якась аварія, то ми лишаємось без води. Тому за рік проживання вже звикли тримати запаси у бутлях та відрах. Бо, на жаль, жодної із криниць вже немає, і взяти відро та піти принести воду в хату вже неможливо...

body.title: The little forest that guards the sea [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVBeXnS7a2thz19HhLj7Z8BZhmdeMp2w7gTSv4YgunU1P/1779512546471.jpg)



***
***
I will talk about a path that is not meant to get you there fast, but to remind you to slow down. I discovered this a few days ago when I crossed that artificial walkway that separates the noise of the world from the first breath of the ocean.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZjeYgCBmZwkgvhTLtuM96DTySxNVAFyprUQQ7bhszk3q/1779512651050.jpg)

***
I was walking with music playing, with haste as well, looking for the vastness of the beach, but before my feet touched the coarse sand, the trail played a beautiful trick on me: I plunged into a forest of sea grapes.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUGLBZcsLhkJBVKKzFrwnQqVRNE5JsTqj966i5PjYF9up/1779512651263.jpg)

***
It was not a large or imposing forest. There were no towering cedars or deep shadows. It was more like a hidden gift, a green lung attached to the sea. There they were, the sea grapes hanging in greenish clusters, some already turning a shy purple, ripening with the salt that the wind gives them every afternoon.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeqoNcCCmh3HSMNMr6qQEgsgzQGf14QLNxPcFWqDhoETP/1779512973105.jpg)

***
I had always seen them from afar, in summer photos, or as that fruit someone mentions in passing, like beach grapes. And I know some people eat them, but I had never stopped to truly observe them. I took off my headphones to look at them in silence.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4GusUDTMZe26MWDQJK9i8xd7fCYu5xXmLT3GHJNDACo/1779512973431.jpg)

***
Their leaves fascinated me immediately. They are round, perfect, like little green coins sewn onto the branches, forming a low canopy that barely touches the sky but hugs the ground. Beneath them, the world becomes kinder because the sun filters through in thin rays, the breeze turns warm, and for a moment, stress stays behind.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZS4QrT7e4MXpijbVVaxuoJV5GsE9mjBJ7Zhx6X9KkCug/1779512972910.jpg)


***
I walked slowly, touching some leaves with my fingertips, wondering if these plants know they live in the most privileged place on earth, with their feet on solid ground and their gaze set on the infinite sea. To me, they are the bridge between the safe and the wild.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTiL5AsaBcH3CiRzX63bcmDCvcwtDuzxFczjbyc3Kfysp/1779512973214.jpg)


***
I picked up a grape from the ground, but I did not dare to taste it. I sat on a rock at the edge of the little grove, right where the branches give way to the white foam, and I understood that one does not come to this beach only for the sea, but also for this forest that guards the entrance. Because here, among round leaves and small clusters, there is no rush, only calm and the certainty that before you throw yourself into the waves, the earth gives you a green hug.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQNkWjs2VMvRXjuyLrrjbPYsvcEmEZPC2fUemdyyzGUm/1779512973301.jpg)


***
Now, every time I see a sea grape, I will remember that path and I will smile, because in the midst of chaos, I found a tiny forest that taught me to arrive slowly.

<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTeTdEXkKDvQsv1MkcAEMthgQ3dA9hMceEye4t8ViLUQc/1779067886188.jpg)

<sub>🍃 **𝑻𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈!** 🍃
𝑰𝒇 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒎𝒆 𝒚𝒆𝒕, 𝑰’𝒎 𝒂 **𝑪𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏 𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒆𝒓**, 𝒂 𝒎𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓, 𝒂 𝒘𝒐𝒎𝒂𝒏, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒅𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒎𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒉𝒐’𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒖𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒂 𝒃𝒆𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒐𝒂𝒓.  
𝑨𝒍𝒍 **𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒎𝒂𝒈𝒆𝒔 𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝒎𝒚 𝒐𝒓𝒊𝒈𝒊𝒏𝒂𝒍 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏𝒔**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏-𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒆 (𝒏𝒐 𝑨𝑰).  
𝑩𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒊𝒈𝒏𝒆𝒅 𝒃𝒚 𝑳𝒖𝒎𝒊𝒊.
𝑳𝒐𝒗𝒆𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒔𝒕? **𝑼𝒑𝒗𝒐𝒕𝒆, 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕, 𝒐𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒃𝒍𝒐𝒈** 𝒕𝒐 𝒔𝒑𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒊𝒏𝒈𝒔 𝒐𝒇 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒗𝒊𝒕𝒚! 💚</sub>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 
### <center>VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL</center>

![cinti 800x20 - copia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWKGeMBmj14VqKn8xBrmpFM3RYVcgmAXX6bGnGwuNWEnc/cinti%20800x20%20-%20copia.jpg) 

## <center>El pequeño bosque que custodia el mar</center>




![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbiuJcitXNjyEDRy5zNabFRy4qxX6zC9G7RMscHZDY6wp/1779512546607.jpg)


***
***







Hablaré de un camino que no está hecho para llegar rápido, sino para recordarte que bajes la velocidad. Eso lo descubrí hace unos días al cruzar esa vereda artificial que separa el ruido del mundo del primer suspiro del océano.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZjeYgCBmZwkgvhTLtuM96DTySxNVAFyprUQQ7bhszk3q/1779512651050.jpg)


***
Iba con la música puesta, con la prisa puesta también, buscando la inmensidad de la playa, pero antes de que mis pies tocaran la arena gruesa, el sendero me jugó una trampa hermosa: me metí de lleno en un bosque de uvas caletas.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmUGLBZcsLhkJBVKKzFrwnQqVRNE5JsTqj966i5PjYF9up/1779512651263.jpg)


***
No era un bosque grande ni imponente. No había altísimos cedros ni sombras profundas. Solo era más bien un regalo escondido, un pulmón verde pegado al mar. Ahí estaban ellas, las uvas caletas colgando en racimos verdosos, algunas ya pintándose de un morado tímido, madurando con la sal que el viento les regala cada tarde.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeqoNcCCmh3HSMNMr6qQEgsgzQGf14QLNxPcFWqDhoETP/1779512973105.jpg)

***
Siempre las había visto de lejos, en fotos de verano, o como ese fruto que alguien menciona al pasar, como las uvas de playa. Y sé que algunas personas las comen, pero nunca me había detenido a observarlas de verdad. Me quité los audífonos para observarlas en silencio.
***



![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmY4GusUDTMZe26MWDQJK9i8xd7fCYu5xXmLT3GHJNDACo/1779512973431.jpg)

***
Sus hojas me fascinaron de inmediato. Son redondas, perfectas, como pequeñas monedas verdes que alguien cosió a las ramas y forman una copa baja que apenas roza el cielo pero que abraza el suelo. Debajo de ellas, el mundo se vuelve más amable porque el sol se filtra en rayos finos, la brisa se vuelve tibia y, por un momento, el estrés se queda atrás.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmZS4QrT7e4MXpijbVVaxuoJV5GsE9mjBJ7Zhx6X9KkCug/1779512972910.jpg)


***
Caminé despacio, tocando algunas hojas con la punta de los dedos mientras me preguntaba si esas plantas saben que viven en el lugar más privilegiado de la tierra, con los pies en la tierra firme y la mirada puesta en el infinito del mar. Para mí son el puente entre lo seguro y lo salvaje.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTiL5AsaBcH3CiRzX63bcmDCvcwtDuzxFczjbyc3Kfysp/1779512973214.jpg)


***
Recogí una uva del suelo, pero no me atreví a probarla. Me senté en una roca al final del bosquecillo, justo donde las ramas dejan paso a la espuma blanca, y entendí que uno no viene a esta playa solo por el mar, también viene por este bosque que custodia la entrada, porque aquí, entre hojas redondas y racimos pequeños, no hay apuro, solo hay calma y la certeza de que antes de lanzarte al oleaje, la tierra te da un abrazo verde.
***


![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmbQNkWjs2VMvRXjuyLrrjbPYsvcEmEZPC2fUemdyyzGUm/1779512973301.jpg)


***
Ahora, cada vez que vea una uva caleta, voy a recordar ese sendero y voy a sonreír, porque en medio del caos, encontré un bosque diminuto que me enseñó a llegar despacio.


<center>🌱</center>
<center>🌱</center>

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRSmczRZ7mh457ozsGyfJF93vxnsidtnD9LmCYpF1XK9K/1778037185350.jpg)

<sub>🍃 **¡𝑮𝒓𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒂𝒔 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝒍𝒆𝒆𝒓!** 🍃
𝑺𝒊 𝒂ú𝒏 𝒏𝒐 𝒎𝒆 𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒐𝒄𝒆𝒔: 𝒔𝒐𝒚 **𝒏𝒆𝒖𝒓ó𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒂 𝒚 𝒆𝒔𝒄𝒓𝒊𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒄𝒖𝒃𝒂𝒏𝒂**, 𝒎𝒂𝒅𝒓𝒆, 𝒎𝒖𝒋𝒆𝒓 𝒚 𝒔𝒐ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐𝒓𝒂 𝒒𝒖𝒆 𝒆𝒏𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒕𝒓ó 𝒆𝒏 𝑯𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒖𝒏 𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒎𝒐𝒔𝒐 𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒂𝒄𝒊𝒐 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒗𝒐𝒍𝒂𝒓.  
**𝑬𝒍 𝒕𝒆𝒙𝒕𝒐 𝒚 𝒍𝒂𝒔 𝒊𝒎á𝒈𝒆𝒏𝒆𝒔 𝒔𝒐𝒏 𝒅𝒆 𝒎𝒊 𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒐𝒓í𝒂**, 100% 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒐𝒔 (𝒔𝒊𝒏 𝑰𝑨).  
𝑩𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒊𝒔𝒆ñ𝒂𝒅𝒐 𝒑𝒐𝒓 𝑳𝒖𝒎𝒊𝒊.
¿𝑻𝒆 𝒈𝒖𝒔𝒕ó 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂 𝒑𝒖𝒃𝒍𝒊𝒄𝒂𝒄𝒊ó𝒏? **𝑽𝒐𝒕𝒂, 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒂 𝒐 𝒓𝒆𝒃𝒍𝒐𝒈𝒖𝒆𝒂** 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒂 𝒂𝒚𝒖𝒅𝒂𝒓 𝒂 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒍𝒆𝒈𝒂𝒓 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒔 𝒂𝒍𝒂𝒔. 💚</sub>

body.title: [ENG/ESP] A day on the road through the hills, filled with work and smiles
body.body: > **As I mentioned in my previous post, this Friday was my last day of work for the week, and even though I was already mentally looking forward to the weekend, that didn’t mean it was any less productive than the others. On the contrary, I experienced it with a mix of enthusiasm, relief, and that sense of satisfaction you feel when you know you’re wrapping up a cycle the right way. I hope you, too, are nearing that long-awaited moment when your body and mind prepare to let go of the routine and surrender to rest. From the bottom of my heart, I wish you a beautiful day and a restorative weekend. My day began with a particularly high spirit. The weather was lovely, with a clear sky that seemed to mirror my desire to end the week on the best possible note. I knew it was my last day of work, and that filled me with a different kind of energy, as if every step I took brought me a little closer to that much-anticipated break. My husband and I set out to complete our only scheduled task: heading to the Unik Hotel to check that the water levels were appropriate and to chlorinate the main tank. During the drive, the scenery looked more beautiful than on other days. I don’t know if it was because of the excitement I was feeling, but everything seemed brighter, more vibrant, and more welcoming. Sometimes our mood changes the way we see the world, and I think that’s exactly what happened to me. Every tree, every building, every stretch of road seemed to have a special glow.**

> *Como les conté en mi publicación anterior, este viernes fue mi último día de trabajo de la semana, y aunque ya estaba mentalmente a las puertas del descanso, eso no significó que fuera un día menos productivo que los demás. Al contrario, lo viví con una mezcla de entusiasmo, alivio y esa satisfacción que se siente cuando uno sabe que está cerrando un ciclo de manera correcta. Espero que ustedes también estén ya rozando ese momento tan esperado en el que el cuerpo y la mente se preparan para soltar la rutina y entregarse al descanso. De corazón, les deseo un día hermoso y un fin de semana reparador. Mi jornada comenzó con un ánimo particularmente elevado. El clima estaba precioso, con un cielo despejado que parecía acompañar mi deseo de terminar la semana de la mejor manera. Sabía que era mi último día laboral y eso me llenaba de una energía distinta, como si cada paso que daba me acercara un poco más a ese respiro que tanto esperaba. Salimos mi esposo y yo a cumplir la única tarea programada; dirigirnos al hotel Unik para verificar que el agua tuviera los niveles apropiados y realizar la cloración del tanque principal. Durante el trayecto, el paisaje se veía más hermoso que otros días. No sé si sería por el entusiasmo que llevaba encima, pero todo parecía más radiante, más vivo, más amable. A veces el estado de ánimo nos cambia los colores del mundo, y creo que eso fue exactamente lo que me pasó. Cada árbol, cada edificio, cada tramo de carretera parecía tener un brillo especial.*
![photo_2026-05-22_23-13-16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23w2mLu5JZm1xPukuwswLLxyvAmsdmvxs9QxczPoVQfMTuHzSMNQvKLaq8ZZjbeg6XWfK.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-13-14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EowFBRuPQAojmwC56nynux1seGKhkQ8MzJffmpqH5kGiXxxaEp6yTjov8AFXAiyfcPn.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-13-12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Epta5pRocq4ZJXBP2p6jsX1f3uzBQfRw4r8WpidvdAhybe8UcyVYzeyZQcxNSQ7mRLf.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-13-10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqFrXKXJ48d7whzRaA4VU5kQJSi3F4BRBtN8oWQbKBf8a21rfsLiYKZ4YhSKMAkxyVR.jpg)

> **When we arrived at the hotel, they were already waiting for us to begin our routine. Everything went smoothly, which I deeply appreciated. When things go well from the start, you feel a tremendous sense of calm, like a silent confirmation that you’re doing things right. We completed the inspection and chlorination without a hitch, and that sense of a job well done stayed with us as we left the premises.**

> *Al llegar al hotel ya nos estaban esperando para comenzar nuestra rutina. Todo fluyó con una armonía que agradecí profundamente. Cuando el trabajo sale bien desde el principio, uno siente una tranquilidad enorme, como una confirmación silenciosa de que se están haciendo las cosas correctamente. Culminamos la inspección y la cloración sin contratiempos, y esa sensación de deber cumplido nos acompañó mientras nos retirábamos del lugar.*
![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-39.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq7LRGfWRp9K4jnXxgqTq5qk5qbQtBMYqt85ndoctRSNn4VK7s6Lq4nwFdwicoX98ro.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpzykGMoAsdBZyf1AagTYx5ebgSDM7HiuRpnw69pSfgoYed8DAe4YqRYgsSYRnBmu5F.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpJaVTN5AjtHJ52gJoSmZ8nP5Nbt4fCn7cRyV2u4T4RgR5YRQYJj4iuFfA9tRW6kJ69.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-35.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqFsWYp8ynKCxumr9nchcG3YRwUhfkumqQJDsvousj5m5yttzSs9RQjxcaXBoWn8ykH.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-35 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpnDoEKn4BHTvDLgBJ5Pnb2JniepM9VeXu5HkwpaxqH3W4SeTkUW9aQ75omT171zmLB.jpg)

> **After finishing up at the hotel, we headed into town to buy another bottle of bleach, because the one we had was almost gone. I don’t like to store large quantities of this product in our storage room, since its smell is quite strong if inhaled, and I’m very careful about that. In fact, whenever we have to move or handle larger quantities, I always wear a mask to protect my respiratory system. Safety is something that should never be neglected.**

> *Después de terminar en el hotel, nos dirigimos a la ciudad para comprar otro frasco de hipoclorito, porque el que teníamos ya estaba por acabarse. No me gusta almacenar grandes cantidades de este producto en nuestro depósito, ya que su olor es bastante agresivo si se inhala, y soy muy cuidadosa con eso. De hecho, cuando debemos trasladar o manipular cantidades mayores, siempre me coloco una mascarilla para proteger mis vías respiratorias. La seguridad es algo que nunca se debe descuidar.*
![photo_2026-05-22_23-13-08.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5Dza34JTW8Wu7SUUPkxtDQWDanUPSzSVNaLNJHtPRTXb6vQLKsWjHfaMgE9uCqqZ6.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-13-07.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqSVyWBjZ76XNwabCEDJwCZzQdncrAmKhTMRGoTG9gySyFog8qz9mh7CsARduLryNk4.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-56.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqHytSt7JtQncVwMrTug55zMKxXPtRte396ZdFyb9gxKWWMP7BKnkLyeLCEZYSGSpt3.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-48.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EnYTMLmEbweSRuSwFa37RxqH7ebVvRYzdbAZKsoL1sMDiLP4wmCXXdpX9bLCwqWS1HC.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-48 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqHySFHrYRUD65iFWt5s7gbi4MbZfc6aa9e2sywmqBZvvyqqayWUMLHMA4nb2CBTKXK.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-47.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT48SwfCarH7Goqi3DEqtmdmdQ9k3QHuSFPuCZKyCKpYF8gsx3dd9K6u167Hbf4yQv.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EqWkJaGHAynnknwie9HAQwLWsTMFhSHizUoVPsNePbtWChFAPfKSHTVAV8aXrffoThU.jpg)
> **The cityscape was beautiful, too. The contrast between the buildings, the hustle and bustle of the city, and the deep blue sky created a very pleasant scene.**

> *El paisaje urbano también estaba hermoso. El contraste entre los edificios, el movimiento de la ciudad y el azul intenso del cielo creaba una escena muy agradable.*
![z.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eokcc2srpN7jZ8XTZFXx33dTwXNWGjyWehqYXwuLvZTaUCTczW23jfm87RBAhH7145o.jpg) ![y.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq34dSbDhTAtMptGpZqEb3tJ1s5YNmHYV1sfB955EWdfo7Hugg3sDzfKqS6pn5Sdwvi.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-13-09.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoeFsAxVVKzPzsM5J2fL7HDYcpucimeNDLJdpmguDSN5jvrBwQmGtZaKV27ZDmGuDJS.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-13-07 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq5EUrU4ZWJbJScuxkPoZzzYEvYBPdz55VLfF1zuTHsEW2WQoYtTje4qexudQP4kkDy.jpg)

> **We arrived at Tecno Química, our trusted supplier for many years, and finally bought the product. As we left, I felt a tremendous sense of relief, as if that purchase had officially crossed the last item off my to-do list for the day. Everything I had planned for this Friday had been accomplished, and that sense of satisfaction completely enveloped me.**

> *Llegamos al local de Tecno Química, nuestros proveedores de confianza desde hace muchos años, y finalmente compramos el producto. Al salir, sentí una ligereza enorme, como si con esa compra se cerrara oficialmente la lista de pendientes del día. Todo lo planificado para este viernes estaba cumplido, y esa satisfacción me envolvió por completo.*
![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-41.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EowGbYji2S3m5JmirjPAdVj1XTwhcQcmVhmLQJJFnaAjDPYdACSdKB6hAQGgPo9JLSd.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-40.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpJXffJZ4tKRY2t7t4Vf1ehxBFc9wQ1U55J1AU9jACwdwzTHpCtzgjuPFX9AjMkh6cc.jpg) ![photo_2026-05-22_23-12-39 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EopryHRUeG6dgsNob5pb5cN3UaSF6CJqPFkc45dedMNZpiAMwY8LmkeR57BHqgohMki.jpg) ![a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23x17ENMFSaCd7qXzQWb2aVAFZowoVjRfUX6PWj5tw2LhannkWEY1YCKQnNhz5XbWSs49.jpg)

> **At that moment, I was already officially in weekend mode. It was as if my body knew it before my mind did. So, with that wonderful feeling, I said goodbye to the day and the week. In another post, I’ll share another little glimpse into my daily life, which always has something to offer. See you soon. Bye.**

> *En ese instante, ya me sentía oficialmente de fin de semana. Era como si el cuerpo lo supiera antes que la mente. Así que, con esa sensación tan bonita, me despedí de la jornada y de la semana. En otra de mis publicaciones les contaré otro pedacito de mi día a día, que siempre tiene algo que compartir. Hasta pronto.   Chao.*

body.title: 🐜 Insects are our favourite Jungle snack! Red ants salad!
body.body:
></center>

**Hello, everyone!**

Living right out in the sticks, literally across from the jungle, you naturally become increasingly immersed in the authentic, everyday Thai way of life. Around here, you don’t just observe nature—you end up putting it on your dinner plate!

And today, I want to talk about one of our absolute favourite local treats: <span class=\
>Red Ant Queen Salad, known locally as
>Miang Mod Daeng (เมี่ยงมดแดง).\n\nWhen we head out into the bush to go ant egg collecting (

>which is a whole different adventure that deserves its own post later!), we don't just harvest the eggs. We also collect worker ants and queen ants. While the eggs are saved for a completely different dish, the actual ants and queens are used to whip up a highly popular salad that you can find all across Laos and the northeastern Isaan region of Thailand. * * * ### 🥗 The Ingredients of the Wild If you want to make a traditional _Miang Mod Daeng_, you don't need a complicated grocery list. You just need what you can forage and a few village kitchen staples. **Here is the traditional lineup:** *
>The Stars: Crunchy red ants and the large ant queens.\n \n*
>The Greens: Finely sliced shallots, chopped lemongrass, and plenty of fiery bird's eye chillies.\n \n*

>The Seasoning: A splash of fish sauce (NamPla), salt, and a healthy dose of MSG (_Ajinomoto_) to bring it all together. What makes this salad so incredible is the natural flavour of the ants themselves. They actually have a sharp, citrusy sourness (thanks to the formic acid they contain), which acts like natural lime juice in the dish!
> * * * ### 🍃 How to Eat It: The Careya Sphaerica Leaf We don't eat this salad with a spoon. Instead, it’s eaten as a _Miang_, which means everything is wrapped up into a neat little leaf bundle.
></center>\n\nFor this salad, we use fresh leaves from the <span class=\
>Careya Sphaerica tree, known in Thai as
>Bai Gradon (ใบกระโดน). These leaves have a very distinct, slightly astringent and tart flavour.\n\n

> When you take a bite, the dry, tart crunch of the leaf cuts perfectly through the sharp sourness of the ants, the citrus notes of the lemongrass, and the explosive heat of the chillies. It is a massive blast of complex flavours in just one single bite!

></center>

* * *

### 💰 A Luxury Snack (If You Buy It!)

You might think that eating bugs is a \

but in reality, this is far from a cheap treat. Whether you are buying ant eggs, worker ants, or the highly prized queens, they fetch a serious premium in the local markets. Prices usually start from **350 Baht per kilogram** and can go way higher depending on the season and location. Luckily for us, we don't buy them. If we ever get a craving for a wild, we just grab our gear, go right into the jungle, and harvest them ourselves. It is definitely not an easy job—those little red bastards bite hard and protect their nests fiercely—but the reward is absolutely worth the struggle!
>Thanks for reading, and see you in the next chronicle of our real Thai village life!

>This beautiful place is located along the Dobra River not far from Ozalj, and has become known throughout the region as the village of strudel. It is located in Karlovac County, and is a combination of tradition, local gastronomy and beautiful nature. In addition to gastronomy, Jaškovo delights with greenery, the Dobra River and the proximity of the old town of Ozalj, which makes it a perfect place for a weekend trip and an escape from the city crowds. The greatest fame has brought this place the famous Štrudlafest, a festival dedicated to the favorite local dessert, strudel. It was here that the Guinness record for the longest line of strudels was broken – more than 3 kilometers and almost 9,000 strudels! So small and yet so big in many ways.\n\n
