body.body:
**Source:** https://mark-conlon.blogspot.com/2020/02/what-really-happened-to-united-93.html


By Mark Conlon

Introduction:

In
this analysis I explore conflicting official data evidence in relation to the alleged crash of \
We\nhad played a Monday night game in Denver, and flew back home the next\nmorning,\

We landed in Newark, N.J., about 6:45 in the
morning. We usually get off the plane on the tarmac and board a bus to get to
our cars. I noticed another plane sitting next to ours because the people were
walking to the plane across the tarmac instead of through the jet way. Two
weeks later, as we’re taking another plane to a game, one of the stewardesses
informed us the plane that had been boarding next to us was Flight 93 that
crashed in Pennsylvania on 9/11. That was a very eerie feeling.\
time is supported by evidence from the\nstaff’s radar analysis, the flight data recorder, NTSB (National Transportation\nSafety Board) analysis, and infrared satellite data\
the precise crash time has been the subject of some dispute.\
body:
a Boeing 767 out of Boston made an emergency
landing due to a bomb threat, the airplane landing safely, moved to a secure
location and evacuated”. 

![Image 9](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhJpDXhBFrpU6Gvy7EHcrJ8aYk1jOe5v93bHR5f6PT48JssnbRvvY-xB18n2LlI8gMCnmh98ZeYlBj-y_rKXqxkIHjInWOHLnLqTLXNggujfxKljiTnsriqrA33N7EPf7d-loCmrrGvhQ/w391-h400/Cleveland+UAL+93+Story.jpg)

The
early morning report went on to say United Airlines verified the plane as
Flight 93, but was also deeply concerned about another jetliner in the
vicinity, Flight 175, flying from Boston to Los Angeles. Also included in the news
report was a comment from United CEO, James Goodwin, who said, \

Former
Mayor White, as well as United and WCPO comments were suspiciously removed from
the television's website in June 2004 in and around the time of the 9/11
Commission Hearings. With the evidence of these statements in the public
domain, the obvious question still remains: If Flight 175 had crashed into the
South Tower and Flight 93 was downed over Pennsylvania like the government
asserted, why was Mayor White saying both planes were in or in the vicinity of
Cleveland? 

In
the 2nd Edition of the 'Loose Change' and 'In Plane Site'
documentary films, they both promoted the idea that UAL 93 landed at Cleveland
Hopkins Airport at 10:45 a.m. I had been sceptical about this disclosure and
promotion of this story for several years, because of the overwhelming official
evidence and data I had obtained indicating that UAL 93 landed at Reagan Nation
Airport at 10:28 a.m. which was in the opposite direction and location to
Cleveland Hopkins Airport. However after studying all the official evidence
data, and in particular the official ACARS data, both in relation to UAL 93's
take off time discrepancies with the BTS and also later ACARS messages which located UAL 93 near Champaign, IL which is in direct conflict with Air Traffic Control's
last known coordinates of UAL 93 (15 miles past the official crash site in
Shanksville, PA) as shown earlier in this analysis. I now feel the UAL 93
landing at Cleveland Hopkins at 10:45 a.m. to be relevant and a possibility to
provide a plausible hypothesis for the conflicting official evidence data to
offer an explanation to what happened to the duplicate UAL 93 airplane flying near Champaign,
IL. 

The
plausible reason why UAL 93 was located near Champaign, IL was because UAL
93 flew near Champaign, IL before turning back around and heading back towards Cleveland
Hopkins Airport to make its landing at 10:45 a.m. If this is so then this would
explain the statement made by Mayor White and United Airlines, thus why the
story was published by WCPO on their website. 

The
ACARS messages #16 to #19, together with the time when they were received establishes
a rough flight path for the duplicate UAL 93:

9:22
a.m. PIT (Pittsburgh)
9:32
a.m. CAK (Canton/Akron)
9:35
a.m. CLE (Cleveland)
9:46
a.m. TOL (Toledo)
9:51
a.m. FWY (Fort Wayne, IN)
10:10
a.m. CMI (Champaign, IL)

If
we study the ACARS messages sent to UAL 93 which were received by the airplane from the Radio
Ground Station (RGS) in Cleveland message #10 at 9:35 a.m. and the last two ACARS messages #18
and #19 sent from RGS in near Champaign, IL which were received at 10:10 a.m.
this shows a 35 minute time-line between the two ACARS messages in which UAL 93
would have travelled from Cleveland to near Champaign, IL. If we use the last
known received Champaign, IL ACARS message #19, (time of 10:10 a.m.) it equates to 35
minutes for UAL 93 to have flown back to Cleveland Airport to make its 10:45 a.m.
landing precisely. 

To
support this hypothesis is the testimony of Air Traffic Controller Stacy Taylor
who recalled UAL 93 changing altitude from 35,000 ft to 41,000 ft, and flying
past Cleveland Center and then turning back around and heading straight for
Cleveland Center with a rapid descent. Source: https://youtu.be/RE08PCTf_nY

![Image 10](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEik0sdB-WegfyZa-WejA5ngRsbZUtIWUQZOYNDkpkzC4Kb-Y9t442kT8iX60-1SOocAy70kmSx9vdbt0RQ_D4ULn7u7TOzpGDYsr57uIVU2FU_o9Iun_kN8b-elWkPwzaOwypmYts9L3w/w400-h147/Cleve+Msg+10+-+9-36am.jpg)

UAL 93 circling over Chicago?

In
the memorandums from the 9/11 Commission online release, on page 5 of this
document: http://media.nara.gov/9-11/MFR/t-0148-911MFR-00762.pdf
 it states: \

to ACARS, but speaks from radar data someone told
him. 

ACARS messages get transmitted via VHF radio antennae on
the ground near the plane. For planes at cruising altitude, \

can be up to 200 miles away. The sender must include the ground station in the
message. After studying the ACARS Radio
Ground Stations (RGS) it becomes apparent some ACARS messages were run-by RGS’s
near Chicago, such as: Toledo, Fort Wayne and Champaign, IL. 

Toledo
covers a 200 mile radius coverage which includes Fort Wayne

Chicago
covers a 200 mile radius coverage which includes Toledo, Fort Wayne and Champaign,
IL. 

Champaign,
IL covers 200 mile radius coverage which also includes Fort Wayne and Chicago

The
VHF ACARS radio range fits perfectly with Marr’s account. The “circling over”
Chicago means that the airplane was near Chicago. But the data that Marr
mentions is not data from the ACARS, moreover information (incorrect or
correct) that comes from other sources: FAA or Radars and therefore does not
and could not refer to the RGS that manage the ACARS messages of the Airlines.
Chicago must undoubtedly have its own RGS, but as we
learned from the words of Knerr and Winter (in the UAR UA 93 ACARS Case Study).

Mr.
Winter explains the Aircraft Communication and Reporting System (ACARS) uses radio
ground stations (RGS) at various locations throughout the United States for
communication. The messages from the aircraft utilize the RGS in a downlink
operating system. A central router determines the strongest signal received
from the aircraft and routes the signal/message to UAL flight dispatch. Source:
http://www.911myths.com/images/1/1c/Team7_Box11_FBI302s_ACARS.pdf

Some research “debunkers” believe that the ACARS ground
station is usually determined from flight plans, not from live information
about the plane's actual location, but as Mr. Winter explains, this theory is incorrect.
Furthermore, UAL 93’s acknowledgement that it received the ACARS
messages (18 and 19) sent from the RGS in Champaign, IL is absolute proof
that UAL 93 was near Champaign, IL.

CNBC
News Reported UAL 93 Originated in Chicago and headed to Cleveland

CNBC reported information from WPIX at 11:10 a.m. that “the
plane that crashed in Pennsylvania originated in Chicago, it was heading to
Cleveland and there was 90 people onboard. https://youtu.be/IdPJ8QSyZuM

Does the CNBC news report corroborate further support for
Marr’s account regarding UAL 93 “circling
over” Chicago. Does this provide proof that UAL 93 was indeed heading back
to Cleveland to make the 10:45 a.m. landing? Although this report states UAL 93
originated in Chicago, and was heading to Cleveland, the evidence is clear that
both UAL 93’s took off from Newark International Airport, not Chicago. Was this
a mistake in the reporting because UAL 93 was near to Chicago as suggested by
Marr? Was this misinterpreted that UAL 93 originated in Chicago because UAL 93 was flying
to Cleveland? The report suggests that it was indeed UAL 93. Is this a coincidence that the
report correlates with the ACARS messages data regarding the Radio Ground Stations
which located contact with UAL 93 near to Chicago?  

The UAL 93 confusion with Delta 1989
Theory

Many
people say UAL 93 was confused with Delta 1989. The Associated Press and two
Ohio newspapers report a landing at 10:45 a.m. However, Delta Airlines registered
its landing time at 10:10 a.m. Cleveland firefighters also can confirm that the
landing took place before 10:30 a.m. Because Delta Airlines did not lose track
of its airplane. The 10:10 a.m. plane was surely Delta 1989. So the 10:45 a.m.
plane is by definition – United Airlines 93. To further support this evidence,
a report by USA Today said: \

- On a remote
taxiway at Hopkins International Airport in Cleveland – Delta Flight 1989 is
quarantined. Since early reports that a bomb, then hijackers, might be aboard,
Delta CEO Leo Mullin, 58, had nervously tracked the flight from the company’s
headquarters in Atlanta. Every five minutes, a new report came in. None seemed
clear. Still, the flight landed uneventfully in Cleveland at 10:10 a.m. [USA
Today, 8/12/02].

Summary
& Conclusion: 

As
I have outlined using the official evidence, data along with some mainstream media sources, there are major
discrepancies regarding UAL 93's official wheels-off time at 8:42 a.m., which is
in direct conflict with the official BTS data, which indicates UAL 93’s
wheels-off time was at 8:28 a.m., not 8:42 a.m. We also have official ACARS
data suggesting that UAL 93 was near Champaign, IL, after UAL 93 had allegedly
crashed at 10:03 a.m., and also Air Traffic Control (ATC) communications revealing
that UAL 93’s last known coordinate was 3951N  07846W, locating UAL 93
fifteen miles past the official crash site after the alleged crash, which was
obtained via transponder data which was active at 10:05 a.m., two minutes after
the official crash time at 10:03 a.m. Champaign, IL, is nowhere near UAL 93’s last
known coordinate (15 miles past the official crash site). 

Based
on this official evidence and data conflicts, FAA and United Airlines had to be
tracking two different airplanes. This is supported by Anthony F. Mazza’s
account, the fueler for Ogden Aviation Services at Newark International Airport
who encountered a different pilot on UAL 93, who was not Leroy Homer, Jr nor
Jason Dahl, who were officially named as the two pilots of UAL 93. Moreover,
the official narrative states the passengers of UAL 93 boarded the airplane
from boarding Gate 17 of Terminal A at Newark Liberty International Airport on
9/11, however passengers were observed boarding UAL 93 from the tarmac, which
could suggest those passengers were boarding a different UAL 93 airplane,
especially taking into account Anthony F. Mazza's account seeing a different co-pilot
of UAL 93. 

Additionally,
the evidence also indicates UAL 93 filed two additional new flight plans. The
first one was Hagerstown (HGR) and the second one was Reagan National Airport
(DCA). Corroborating evidence demonstrates that UAL 93 was heading towards
Washington, DC, to make a landing at Reagan National Airport. The official ACARS
and ATC data shows UAL 93 still airborne after the “alleged” crash time. It has been
suggested that the airplanes were inserted blips, however due to the ACARS
messages being received by the airplane near Champaign, IL, this proves it was
not an inserted radar blip. Moreover, it is questionable whether or not the airplane located via ATC
coordinates an was an inserted radar blip because a VFR had a visual sighting on UAL 93, which
was travelling at 8,000 feet, and 11 miles south of Indian Head, PA, which is
just north of Cumberland, Maryland, thus demonstrating a airplane was
observed by the VFR, thus proving two different UAL 93's were in the air.
The
evidence presented here in this analysis demonstrates that an airplane
identifying itself as UAL 93 landed at Reagan National Airport at
10:28 a.m., while a duplicate airplane was identified as UAL
93 was near Champaign, IL, which possibly landed at Cleveland Hopkins Airport
at 10:45 a.m., which was reported on the morning of 9/11, by Cleveland
Mayor, Michael R. White. It was also reported via a Cincinnati television
station, saying “Flight 93 had landed at
Cleveland International Airport”. Although was later retracted by Liz Forman. In
conclusion, the “official” telemetry data itself strongly indicates that duplicate planes identifying as United Airlines \

were in the air on 9/11, and did not crash at the named crash site in Shanksville, PA at 10:03 a.m.

body.title: Torta rellena con maracuyá y cubierta de buttercream sabor a maracuyá
body.body: # Torta rellena con maracuyá y cubierta de buttercream sabor a maracuyá\n\n<div class=\

>

Buenas noches amigos amantes del buen comer y del buen paladar que dedican una parte de su tiempo para leer mi contenido, les deseo bendiciones en abundancia. Sean todos bienvenidos a mi blog.

![38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uFaS34CzcTjSwKHJpjmCdKX1sUSyp12r6mqzoYhzzAtcoEkSYmE61BGLweznWreJ6V2.jpg)

Hoy les traigo a esta hermosa comunidad una receta que parece ser difícil pero en realidad es muy sencilla que ni se lo imaginan, una deliciosa torta con sabor a maracuyá, rellena de maracuyá y cubierta con buttercream sabor a maracuyá, realmente es una delicia que quedo de chuparse los dedos, ese fue el comentario de quienes lograron degustar este rico postre.


![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpVCceG3Rbq3WD3PKso8LeSLMxR9N8LdFRhDNAW1SMCtYTDK7pjZFut8tdPEngV2fuz.jpg)

Este delicioso postre lo preparare para regalarsela a una de mis vecinas que estaba de cumpleaños, a quien aprecio mucho y se que le encanta la maracuyá o conocida en Venezuela como parchita.

![37.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc83SHNDreQdH5ocyNzno4syh1wh23Fgo4G9dVxmMnmgszU5qTazG8Jk1SAzWjhHPy.jpg)

Quedo bastante humedad, jugosa, esponjosa y rica; la textura del relleno buenísimo, no se lo explicare ya que en otro post ya les enseñe como preparar una crema de maracuyá, al igual que el buttercream que ya les he explicado la base, de ahí parte todo, le agregamos el sabor de nuestra preferencia, en este caso hice una melado con el concentrado de la maracuyá, tome varias cucharadas, se lo agregue al buttercream para que le diera ese toque especial que tanto nos encanta.

![36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoiWiJJCE67x7RnhWS6dkNrFkAbge9W4psD9MHZpPK8FzRFY7miUq9ZQxjYC5HxSAhv.jpg)

El peso de esta con el relleno fue de 1 kilo ochocientos ochenta y cinco gramos, utilice un molde de 22 centímetros que alcanza para 25 comensales, su cocción fue de 30 minutos, ya que es un ponqués, la misma base de una torta tres leches. 


![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yTomjPz9EZx8mP6LZcc9uGujPGHmQNmgiX8xFVHV8jy16kaFZdp73XiPTKwxfH1d2sa.jpg)

ahora paso a nombrarle los ingredientes que utilice y de que manera la decore.

# Ingredientes

* 6 huevos de tamaño grande
* 2 y 1/2 tazas de harina de trigo leudante
* 2 y 1/2 tazas de azúcar banca refinada
* 1/4 de concentrado de maracuyá para el biscocho
* 1/2 cucharada de extracto de vainilla

![34.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EonnUC4E5TtmCc4cE67jp6qsRUHVHSLsqFMbswazsBVqqSkQWYgEBQaCjdvXmfeKBck.jpg)

Los demás ingredientes tanto para la crema de parchita como para el buttercream solo se los voy a nombrar

# para el relleno
* 3 huevos
* 2 parchitas o maracuyá
* 130 mililitros de concentrado de maracuyá
* 200 gramos de azúcar
* 3 cucharas full de  harina de trigo para espesar, disuelta 2 cucharadas de concentrado
* 1 cucharada de margarina


# para el buttercream
* 150 gramos de manteca vegetal
* 100 gramos de margarina sin sal
* 5 cucharadas de extracto natural de la maracuyá o parchita

![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpNpR56uqh5BC6FG3P7y9m4U692FkyoePaJNcEU7zSPiRnHy7ADbDNbLS3eVkAgsvYT.jpg)
# paso a paso

Lo primero que hice fue pesar y tamizar los ingredientes. Posteriormente busque un bool y coloque las claras de huevo, batí a punto de nieve por 7 minutos, le fui agregando una a una las yemas de huevos, batí con batidora eléctrica para unir todo.

![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd1qyYr2bazYHbbUHFd3CnhaUyHpzZMYZyugpiGJBYMhZQ3xQy3HbbszLRGwmu7Vv7f.jpg)|![31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgWDMGKde82YUz1w9wwsn943WqWhjGirCyMipMcfjgZeV1iqCud9kRU3N93R1H8aYVT.jpg)|![32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zGesXWFaK2xjrbh7HMY9FteaMLQC7tvBNoz25T2cwAWGztsBg9rfXhmQMoWANpTsKvP.jpg)
-|-|-


![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsSpBXjedw7coTRtuhJq5d53fcwSMaQ7QiMCpKNYqxTBkpwRbBAXSrNCTizSjzi6bVR.jpg)

Posteriormente le agregue poco a poco el azúcar, probé e inicie el proceso de agregarle la harina, el extracto de maracuya, seguí batiendo manualmente en forma envolvente, vertí la mezcla en un molde engrasado y enharinado y lleve al horno a cocinar por 25 minutos, esto depende del horno de cada quien. Deje 15 minutos en reposo para enfriar el biscocho.

![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVRpPHAVMh9C3whEjuU6D6XA8Evg6NjRcfCNn19Sw8ggtdnnUTFKCpmkdrG4MHri5tU.jpg)|![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgUWPX7HQoGaPmS3GrvfmUmWjvctSThTBoy5YvPNsk4DeZD5gwQ9qiHn8u1YvkS1Gkj.jpg)
-|-

![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xpALdiPnmbJF87xBaMWuEXtKLLXPUam4XpwYuuLACrgorRcgk8dqxrZeaY55kczfBg7.jpg)|![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/AKRC7MdLR7frgPguDeerG639D1KKFdyvkRTTciVsCrCSHtFUH2f6kpy29QFSQ2S.jpg)
-|-

Por ultimo corte el biscocho en dos partes, humedeci cada tapa, le agregue la crema de male agregue el extracto de maracuyá y cerré con la otra tapar.

![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsWmZcU8L1tfqPLvYv29fhUgr6xwqHh2t7ZSqqctUkdkLKXKA4coQExymzsbz84HMPW.jpg)|![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyboVN34Q5kRyeJT12K6Eyaz3w1xNyNZFZAUwZstSfoPb5uckstavDUoDQweogbDRjZ.jpg)|![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJNy5koC2d3ZE2QX88V6PSiNtKKJ2cCBmSCsY1cMJE9yDy4iYSTGZgufPowznLvbtSX.jpg)
-|-|-

![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep1XvrUPSyShKDzxJJ8o5AKueu44oKALEVgJxDLQpa2jKj3fUqNuGkyHKdX3fR4PtmX.jpg)

Para finalizar la cubrí por los lados con el buttercream, en el centro del biscocho le coloque el concentrado  de parchita, a estae le agregue algunas semillas para adornar.


![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23u6DVXeUqHzhKnvLnAcXvmt8raeEQrFgri6i7edRd2dwy94zW1Ao5GLNrAcNVuitnAzq.jpg)|![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQzdb8Wxz4CyJduGJjsEkKHTBpUeL4SQocraKEXjCMpmxKVAewzAuthya7i14TVp1cs.jpg)
-|-

![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep7w5uxbFrNjkhn7vpj2BpdZW2CvKYrYhFBre9X69CbvQVNV99UKbYN2txYu6suzFok.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpVCceG3Rbq3WD3PKso8LeSLMxR9N8LdFRhDNAW1SMCtYTDK7pjZFut8tdPEngV2fuz.jpg)

Hasta aquí mi contenido, espero sea de su agrado y nos vemos en una nueva receta. Saludo y bendiciones  para todos 

* Fotos tomadas con Iphone 8 plus
* Portada diseñada con Canva
* Texto traducido con Deepl

<div class=\
> # English Version # Cake filled with passion fruit and topped with passion fruit buttercream

> Good evening, my friends who love good food and fine dining and take the time to read my posts. I wish you all abundant blessings. Welcome to my blog. ![38.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uFaS34CzcTjSwKHJpjmCdKX1sUSyp12r6mqzoYhzzAtcoEkSYmE61BGLweznWreJ6V2.jpg) Today I’m sharing with this wonderful community a recipe that looks difficult but is actually so simple you wouldn’t believe it—a delicious passion fruit-flavored cake, filled with passion fruit and topped with passion fruit buttercream. It’s truly a finger-licking treat; that’s what everyone who got to taste this delicious dessert said. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpVCceG3Rbq3WD3PKso8LeSLMxR9N8LdFRhDNAW1SMCtYTDK7pjZFut8tdPEngV2fuz.jpg) I made this delicious dessert as a gift for one of my neighbors who was celebrating her birthday—someone I care about deeply and who I know loves passion fruit, known in Venezuela as “parchita.” ![37.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Eoc83SHNDreQdH5ocyNzno4syh1wh23Fgo4G9dVxmMnmgszU5qTazG8Jk1SAzWjhHPy.jpg) It turned out quite moist, juicy, fluffy, and delicious; the filling had an amazing texture. I won’t go into detail here since I’ve already shown you how to make passion fruit cream in another post, and I’ve also explained the basics of buttercream. that’s where it all starts; we add the flavor of our choice. In this case, I made a syrup with the passion fruit concentrate, took several spoonfuls, and added it to the buttercream to give it that special touch we love so much. ![36.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EoiWiJJCE67x7RnhWS6dkNrFkAbge9W4psD9MHZpPK8FzRFY7miUq9ZQxjYC5HxSAhv.jpg) The weight of this cake with the filling was 1,885 grams. I used a 22-centimeter pan, which serves 25 people. It baked for 30 minutes, since it’s a pound cake—the same base as a tres leches cake. ![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yTomjPz9EZx8mP6LZcc9uGujPGHmQNmgiX8xFVHV8jy16kaFZdp73XiPTKwxfH1d2sa.jpg) Now I’ll list the ingredients I used and how I decorated it. # Ingredients * 6 large eggs * 2 1/2 cups self-rising flour * 2 1/2 cups refined white sugar * 1/4 cup passion fruit concentrate for the sponge cake * 1/2 tablespoon vanilla extract ![34.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EonnUC4E5TtmCc4cE67jp6qsRUHVHSLsqFMbswazsBVqqSkQWYgEBQaCjdvXmfeKBck.jpg) I’ll just list the remaining ingredients for both the passion fruit cream and the buttercream # For the filling * 3 eggs * 2 passion fruits * 130 milliliters of passion fruit concentrate * 200 grams of sugar * 3 heaping tablespoons of wheat flour for thickening, dissolved in 2 tablespoons of concentrate * 1 tablespoon of margarine # for the buttercream * 150 grams of vegetable shortening * 100 grams of unsalted margarine * 5 tablespoons of natural passion fruit extract ![15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpNpR56uqh5BC6FG3P7y9m4U692FkyoePaJNcEU7zSPiRnHy7ADbDNbLS3eVkAgsvYT.jpg) # step by step The first thing I did was weigh and sift the ingredients. Then I took a bowl and added the egg whites, beating them until stiff peaks formed for 7 minutes. I added the egg yolks one by one, beating with an electric mixer to combine everything. ![30.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yd1qyYr2bazYHbbUHFd3CnhaUyHpzZMYZyugpiGJBYMhZQ3xQy3HbbszLRGwmu7Vv7f.jpg)|![31.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgWDMGKde82YUz1w9wwsn943WqWhjGirCyMipMcfjgZeV1iqCud9kRU3N93R1H8aYVT.jpg)|![32.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23zGesXWFaK2xjrbh7HMY9FteaMLQC7tvBNoz25T2cwAWGztsBg9rfXhmQMoWANpTsKvP.jpg) -|-|- ![29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsSpBXjedw7coTRtuhJq5d53fcwSMaQ7QiMCpKNYqxTBkpwRbBAXSrNCTizSjzi6bVR.jpg) Then I gradually added the sugar, tasted it, and began adding the flour and passion fruit extract. I continued folding the mixture by hand, poured it into a greased and floured pan, and baked it for 25 minutes—though baking time may vary depending on your oven. I let the cake cool for 15 minutes. ![28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xVRpPHAVMh9C3whEjuU6D6XA8Evg6NjRcfCNn19Sw8ggtdnnUTFKCpmkdrG4MHri5tU.jpg)|![23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23wgUWPX7HQoGaPmS3GrvfmUmWjvctSThTBoy5YvPNsk4DeZD5gwQ9qiHn8u1YvkS1Gkj.jpg) -|- ![22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xpALdiPnmbJF87xBaMWuEXtKLLXPUam4XpwYuuLACrgorRcgk8dqxrZeaY55kczfBg7.jpg)|![21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/AKRC7MdLR7frgPguDeerG639D1KKFdyvkRTTciVsCrCSHtFUH2f6kpy29QFSQ2S.jpg) -|- Finally, cut the sponge cake into two layers, moisten each layer, spread the mango cream on top, add the passion fruit extract, and cover with the other layer. ![16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23vsWmZcU8L1tfqPLvYv29fhUgr6xwqHh2t7ZSqqctUkdkLKXKA4coQExymzsbz84HMPW.jpg)|![18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23xyboVN34Q5kRyeJT12K6Eyaz3w1xNyNZFZAUwZstSfoPb5uckstavDUoDQweogbDRjZ.jpg)|![17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23yJNy5koC2d3ZE2QX88V6PSiNtKKJ2cCBmSCsY1cMJE9yDy4iYSTGZgufPowznLvbtSX.jpg) -|-|- ![9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep1XvrUPSyShKDzxJJ8o5AKueu44oKALEVgJxDLQpa2jKj3fUqNuGkyHKdX3fR4PtmX.jpg) Finally, I covered the sides with buttercream, placed the passion fruit concentrate in the center of the cake, and added a few seeds for decoration. ![8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23u6DVXeUqHzhKnvLnAcXvmt8raeEQrFgri6i7edRd2dwy94zW1Ao5GLNrAcNVuitnAzq.jpg) |![7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/23uQzdb8Wxz4CyJduGJjsEkKHTBpUeL4SQocraKEXjCMpmxKVAewzAuthya7i14TVp1cs.jpg) -|- ![6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/Ep7w5uxbFrNjkhn7vpj2BpdZW2CvKYrYhFBre9X69CbvQVNV99UKbYN2txYu6suzFok.jpg) ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morepina/EpVCceG3Rbq3WD3PKso8LeSLMxR9N8LdFRhDNAW1SMCtYTDK7pjZFut8tdPEngV2fuz.jpg) That’s all for now. I hope you enjoyed this post, and I’ll see you in a new recipe. Greetings and blessings to everyone. * Photos taken with an iPhone 8 Plus * Cover designed with Canva * Text translated with Deepl Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@morepina/torta-rellena-con-maracuy-y-cubierta-de-buttercream-sabor-a-maracuy-csi)

<center>

On the way into the Museum a quick look at some of the big lumps in the Sculpture Park. *Vingrių štėlių Square is a unique urban space designed for peaceful enjoyment of outdoor sculpture exhibitions, greenery, and the flow of spring water.*



![M1 (5).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grindle/23tvgEGCenLE4LSuacYPuAE69KwDWnwda53T8mkKrcd81FVuhrzP7VwSd7jcB3uNPNiMe.jpg)

Now considered an art installation, this was once standing in the Naujiejs Rasai cemetery,the Liobiai family tombstone. restored and now in its new home.



![M1 (6).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/grindle/Eokc5SVjhHTejeyoZcy54L1uB6zqf5Zy5k3HBKYnQa8p5Ph6JAPkkrcPn39XLCEhhh3.jpg)

Entitled \

, a construction of steel and granite built in 2018

body.title: ¡Una pequeña aventura para comer hamburguesas! 🌅✨ [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
>
Bienvenidos! 🙋🏻‍♀️
¡Hola amigos!! Hoy les quiero compartir unas fotitos muy bonitas de un momento especial, pues como mi vida ha cambiado estos meses y no he podido hacer senderismo, ver atardeceres o tener aventuras como antes, que eran bastante seguidas, aprecio y valoro cuando la vida me brinda una nueva oportunidad para hacerlo. En este caso, Chris, me propuso ir a comer hamburguesas a un mirador que poco vamos, queda en la zona norte de Margarita y es bastante bonito, pues está entre montañas, así que luego de preparar un bolso con una manta, agua y mi cámara, fuimos hasta Sigo donde compramos hamburguesas de happy shack, pues son las únicas que me gustan (y las de pollo de chill), los que me conocen saben que no soy fan de las hamburguesas, por lo que estas son las únicas que suelo comer una vez cada 3 meses jajaja. Nos encaminamos al mirador y el camino estuvo bonito, el clima se veía nublado, pero normal, en esos días estaba así, supernublado y lluvioso, más, aun estando así, los atardeceres en Margarita suelen ser preciosos, llegamos, buscamos un buen sitio para colocar una manta, poner nuestras cosas, sacar las hamburguesas, jugo y demás, para disfrutar de esta linda vista, con una rica hamburguesa y por supuesto, mejor compañía no puedo pedir! La tarde nos despidió con un bello atardecer, el cual fotografié y espero pronto tener algo de tiempo para mostrarles lo que capture con mi cámara. Me despido deseándoles un exitoso y prospero día, hasta pronto!.
ENGLISH

Welcome! 🙋🏻‍♀️
Hey friends!! Today I want to share some really nice photos of a special moment. Since my life has changed these past few months and I haven't been able to go hiking, watch sunsets, or have adventures like I used to, which were quite frequent, I appreciate and value every time life gives me a new opportunity to do so. In this case, Chris suggested we go for hamburgers at a viewpoint we don't go to very often. It's in the northern part of Margarita Island and it's quite beautiful, nestled among mountains. So, after packing a bag with a blanket, water, and my camera, we went to Sigo where we bought hamburgers from Happy Shack, since they're the only ones I like (and the chili chicken ones). Those who know me know I'm not a big hamburger fan, so these are the only ones I usually eat, maybe once every three months, haha. We headed to the viewpoint, and the walk was beautiful. The weather was cloudy, but that was normal; it had been super cloudy and rainy for days. Even so, sunsets in Margarita are usually gorgeous. We arrived, found a good spot to lay out a blanket, put our things down, and get out the burgers, juice, and everything else to enjoy the lovely view with a delicious burger and, of course, better company! The afternoon ended with a beautiful sunset, which I photographed, and I hope to have some time soon to show you what I captured with my camera. I wish you a successful and prosperous day, see you soon!.

body.title: El crujido del cristal...[The Crunch of the Crystal]
body.body:
![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX24YjdAiUqooDzu9B6cmCCNdLuM8t48W5RbzUKBAMk42/1779510296225.png) (A veces, la mente dibuja paisajes perfectos sobre cristales muy finos. Bastan un solo intento y un golpe de realidad para recordarnos la distancia prudente que hay entre el deseo y lo concreto.) ​
✦ ✦ ✦
​Es frágil el paisaje que el deseo dibuja, un lienzo de cristal donde el anhelo habita, un escenario perfecto que la mente agita, mientras la fantasía, en secreto, lo empuja. ​
✦ ✦ ✦
​Basta un solo intento, un paso hacia el frente, para que el aire choque contra el suelo. El ideal que construimos con tanto desvelo se estrella, sin aviso, ante el mundo concreto. ​
✦ ✦ ✦
​El golpe de la realidad no tiene estruendo, no hay alarmas cuando el cristal se quiebra; es un crujido sutil que despierta en el pecho el frío de aceptar lo que estamos viendo. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeKPxbDdmggAKaZTygPXMpq96pyvhQawDgu9HWeaJo8KP/1779510329077.png) ​Mirar los fragmentos es medir el abismo entre lo que se quiso y lo que de verdad existe. La ilusión se desarma, la mirada se viste con la sobria certeza de volver a uno mismo. ​
✦ ✦ ✦
​Por eso el repliegue, la retirada prudente, poner tierra de por medio y marcar la distancia. Dejar atrás los restos de aquella fragancia y habitar la verdad, aunque duela de frente.

✦ English Version ✦

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmX24YjdAiUqooDzu9B6cmCCNdLuM8t48W5RbzUKBAMk42/1779511337064.png) (*Sometimes, the mind draws perfect landscapes on very fine glass. A single attempt and a strike of reality are enough to remind us of the prudent distance between desire and the concrete.*) ​
✦ ✦ ✦
[*The landscape drawn by desire is fragile, a canvas of glass where yearning resides, a perfect stage that the mind stirs while fantasy, in secret, pushes it forward.*] ​
✦ ✦ ✦
[*A single attempt is enough, one step forward, for the air to crash against the ground. The ideal we built with so much sleepless devotion shatters, without warning, before the concrete world.*] ​
✦ ✦ ✦
[*​The strike of reality has no roar, there are no alarms when the glass breaks; it is a subtle crunch that awakens in the chest the chill of accepting what we are seeing.*] ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmeKPxbDdmggAKaZTygPXMpq96pyvhQawDgu9HWeaJo8KP/1779511317494.png) [*​Looking at the fragments is measuring the abyss between what was wanted and what truly exists. The illusion disarms, the gaze dresses itself with the sober certainty of returning to oneself.*] ​
✦ ✦ ✦
[*Hence the retreat, the prudent withdrawal, putting land in between and marking the distance. Leaving behind the remains of that fragrance and inhabiting the truth, even if it hurts up front.*]
✦ ✦ ✦
(Las imágenes fueron creadas por Nano banana 2.0.) (The images were created by Nano banana 2.0.)

body.body: intishar, for raw user count and volume, centralized exchangers still beat DEXs by a mile; [CoinGecko’s 2026 report](https://www.coingecko.com/research/publications/cex-dex-trading-activity-report-2026) shows DEX share is growing fast, but it’s still the smaller slice of overall spot and perps activity. People use exchangers more because fiat on-ramps, simpler UX, customer support, and account recovery matter more to normal humans than crypto purists like to admit, while DEXs win on self-custody, permissionlessness, and no-KYC access as noted in this [DEX vs CEX guide](https://cryptoslate.com/decentralized-exchanges/). On InLeo, the conversation leans hard toward self-custody and avoiding CEX risk, but even there the practical reality is mixed, like in [this post](https://inleo.io/@shortsegment/fiaxoa-sat-rich-the-non-existent-fantasy-of-a-trustless-bitcoin-credit-line) arguing people still end up relying on centralized rails for real-world spending. So the honest answer: exchangers are used more, DEXs are respected more.

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfH6aCgPvCDY4Z8TwkeBy9jXuKMjiTqabMw8UBJKvedTG/nika_akin_green_5124174_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/green-face-light-portrait-woman-5124174/)

---

#  **La ciencia de lo cotidiano #1**  
### *El cuerpo también aprende el miedo*

---

Hay cosas que no necesitan palabras para instalarse en nosotros.

A veces llegan en silencio.  
Sin avisar.  
Sin explicaciones.

---

Recuerdo haber observado, en más de una ocasión, cómo el cuerpo humano reacciona antes que la mente.

Un leve cambio en la respiración.  
Una tensión que aparece en los hombros.  
Un gesto mínimo que delata algo que todavía no ha sido dicho.

---

Durante años pensé que el miedo era una respuesta clara, evidente.

Algo que se podía nombrar fácilmente.

Pero con el tiempo entendí que no siempre funciona así.

---

El miedo también se aprende.

No como una lección teórica.  
Sino como una reacción repetida.

---

El organismo comienza a recordar situaciones, incluso cuando creemos que ya las hemos superado.

Un lugar.  
Un sonido.  
Una forma de hablar.  
Un silencio demasiado largo.

---

Y de pronto el cuerpo responde antes que cualquier pensamiento consciente.

---

No siempre es dramático.

A veces es casi imperceptible.

---

Un ligero aumento del pulso al recibir un mensaje.  
Una incomodidad sin explicación al entrar en un sitio conocido.  
Una sensación de alerta sin peligro real presente.

---

Lo curioso es que el cuerpo no distingue entre lo que ocurrió una vez… y lo que se repitió muchas veces.

Para él, todo es memoria.

---

Y esa memoria no siempre es lógica.

---

En medicina aprendí que el sistema nervioso no solo responde al presente.

También anticipa.

---

A veces protege.  
A veces exagera.  
A veces simplemente recuerda demasiado bien.

---

Hay personas que viven sin ser conscientes de que su cuerpo está reaccionando a historias antiguas.

Historias que ya no están ocurriendo… pero que tampoco han sido completamente archivadas.

---

Y entonces uno empieza a entender algo importante:

no todo lo que sentimos en el presente pertenece al presente.

---

El cuerpo también escribe su propia biografía.

Sin pedir permiso.  
Sin orden cronológico.  
Sin explicaciones detalladas.

---

Solo con respuestas.

---

## **Memorias que respiran**

---

Con el tiempo, he aprendido a observar esos pequeños signos con más atención.

No para controlarlos.

Sino para entenderlos.

---

Porque detrás de cada reacción automática hay una historia silenciosa intentando ser interpretada.

---

Y quizás no siempre se trata de eliminar el miedo.

Sino de reconocer cuándo está hablando el presente…  
y cuándo está hablando la memoria.

---

Al final, el cuerpo no miente.

Solo recuerda.

---

Y a veces, recordar también es una forma de aprender a sobrevivir.

---

Las imágenes son de Pixabay y la traducción al inglés fue realizada usando DeepL Translate.

---

🇬🇧 English Version
---

Hello, dear Holos-Lotus community! 

Today I want to share one of those ideas that seem invisible in everyday life… until one day you realize they were saying much more than we ever noticed.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmfH6aCgPvCDY4Z8TwkeBy9jXuKMjiTqabMw8UBJKvedTG/nika_akin_green_5124174_640.jpg)
Source [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/green-face-light-portrait-woman-5124174/)

---


# **The Science of Everyday Life #1**  
### *The Body Also Learns Fear*

---

There are things that don’t need words to take root inside us.

They arrive in silence.  
Without warning.  
Without explanation.

---

I remember observing, more than once, how the human body reacts before the mind does.

A slight change in breathing.  
A tension rising in the shoulders.  
A small gesture revealing something not yet spoken.

---

For years, I thought fear was a clear, obvious response.

Something easy to name.

But over time, I realized it doesn’t always work that way.

---

Fear is also learned.

Not like theoretical knowledge.  
But like a repeated reaction.

---

The body begins to remember situations, even when we believe we have already moved past them.

A place.  
A sound.  
A way of speaking.  
A silence that lasts too long.

---

And suddenly the body responds before any conscious thought appears.

---

It is not always dramatic.

Sometimes it is almost invisible.

---

A slight increase in heart rate when receiving a message.  
A subtle discomfort when entering a familiar place.  
A feeling of alertness without any real danger present.

---

The interesting part is that the body does not distinguish between what happened once… and what happened many times.

To it, everything becomes memory.

---

And that memory is not always logical.

---

In medicine, I learned that the nervous system does not only respond to the present.

It also anticipates.

---

Sometimes it protects.  
Sometimes it exaggerates.  
Sometimes it simply remembers too well.

---

There are people who live unaware that their body is reacting to old stories.

Stories that are no longer happening… but have never been fully archived either.

---

And then you begin to understand something important:

not everything we feel in the present belongs to the present.

---

The body also writes its own biography.

Without permission.  
Without chronological order.  
Without detailed explanations.

---

Only through responses.

---

## **Memories That Breathe**

---

Over time, I have learned to observe these small signs more carefully.

Not to control them.

But to understand them.

---

Because behind every automatic reaction, there is a silent story trying to be interpreted.

---

And perhaps it is not always about eliminating fear.

But about recognizing when the present is speaking…  
and when memory is speaking instead.

---

In the end, the body does not lie.

It only remembers.

---

And sometimes, remembering is also a way of learning how to survive.

---

body.title: Accidentally stumbling on a new idea
body.body: I was looking for something for scrobble.life that a user requested recently, didn't have a lot of luck to find it, it was kind of a \

solution, but while looking I kind of stumbled upon some info I wish I had known earlier. 

What this changes. 

The thing with youtube is, the \

way to use it is the way we do now, if a song is scrobbled and info has been fetched for it from different sources, there's usually a youtube link applied to it as well. This means that someone on scrobble.life can easily click on a song they see and it'll load the youtube embed with that song (99% success-rate). The reason we however can't have a youtube-search bar is because that'd tap us out quickly on API restrictions as it's all running through our site/server.\n\nWhat some \

apps do, is they use [innertube](https://lighttube-org.github.io/InnerTube/) to search for youtube through their sites/apps which goes directly against their ToS, masking the video to only play the song is also against their ToS as that's Youtube Music which requires its own private subscription. So basically we can't search for music on youtube through our website and we can't play music without displaying the video. 

Either way, there is however one upcoming platform I haven't heard of in years that is a lot more open to searches and currently has something like 1.5 million songs in their library: Audius. Some of you may know it since it is a crypto project focused on decentralizing music. Obviously it hasn't gotten that far yet considering the low volume of songs and marketcap, but it works. What this allows us to do: 

We already had Audius as a scrobble connector on the extension - meaning if some of our users were playing songs from the audius platform, it'd recognize those tracks and log them in custom ops and display them on our website. 

It allows for search and to play songs wherever you want - legally. 

What this means is that aside from only searching for scrobbles on scrobble.life, we can now search for songs that haven't been scrobbled yet through the Audius library _and_ play them directly on scrobble.life. No video, no potential ads, just songs directly on scrobble.life. 

This also means we now have to build a web player for scrobble.life! (Which I'm currently building while typing this)



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/Eo1vtvCxgtcPkK2CXSM1nmVpjn2oUHK7m4qvCJ6mArmotrrNJjTArYxRzLSPEy3h1W8.png)

Another thing people have asked for is playlists which I'll be working on after this is finished. 

The idea here is to not rely on solely one platform as most of them are centralized and may drop dead at some point or cut you off API-wise. 

This is also why I already embedded 3speak videos and enabled scrobbling of 3speak content on the site and whatever future platforms may appear. 

All while keeping things legal and according to ToS. 


Other than that, I've been working some more on the holozing \

style scene in unity which is getting a bit further along. 




![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/acidyo/23vsZ4XGX96CPZ66ZJ896wwANjqxZiQv7PngCUcbZZZGC2hBCGAfNEDjaVQEay3Ny6Cc1.png)


Slow and steady!

body.title: How can I easily calculate the current price of a deck in Splinterlands?
body.body:
>
**Best regards Splinterlovers** 💚
The value of card decks in the game is something very important to keep in mind, especially since there isn't much information available on this topic. In other words, if there's a market for them, you can calculate the value manually, but it’s a bit tedious and time-consuming, and these days information travels very fast—we need speed in everything we do. So, while doing some research, I discovered an incredible platform that really simplifies everything we need to know—not just the value of decks, but of every card in that set. This certainly makes things much easier for new users. Being able to quickly view the market with a single click and see the prices of cards from a specific set can help many players plan a clear strategy for what they want and move forward as soon as they have the necessary resources (capital) available to do so. I have to be very honest up front: Splinterlands isn’t a cheap game, at least when considering the cards in the current META. I’m not saying you have to play with a full deck no matter what, or that you’re obligated to buy them, because that’s not true—the “Rental Market” is always active, and renting them is very simple and they’re affordable, but this post is aimed at those who want to buy cards and build a sort of business in Splinterlands with as little risk as possible. **So, if you want to know how to do it the easy way, stick around until the end of this post—you'll see that every player, whether experienced or not, will really like this tool.** --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png) ##
What is Splintiers and how does it work?
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif Splintiers is a website created by @bravetofu, who deserves credit for building a platform that simplifies the process of manually searching for cards, checking their prices, adding them to your cart, and handling all the other details involved. This tool was created to provide us with different “tiers” of cards so we can understand their utility in the game, which is great because it helps you better balance things when you’re building a deck from scratch. **So, to go into a little more detail about that—since you already know what “Splintiers” is all about (which you can access by clicking [HERE](https://www.splintiers.com/), by the way)—it’s about understanding how these two modes work:** ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png) ####
Splintiers Components
* **The Tier List:** As I mentioned earlier, here you can see the cards in a “Tier List,” where S-tier cards are the most powerful and dominant, A-tier cards have a strong impact on strategies, B-tier cards offer solid options, but where you have to be selective, and finally C, where most cards are very specific and situational and can’t be used all the time. This helps you choose wisely which cards you want if your focus is on buying, though you can also use it to select your rentals and be more efficient in that regard. * **Deck Builder:** This is where your prior knowledge of the “Tier List” becomes incredibly useful, because, as I said, you can use it to carefully select the cards you need, but not only that—you can also see the actual value of any set you choose. I’m not just talking about whole numbers; you can see how much each card costs, which helps a lot. And now, the manual work of adding them to the cart—something we’ll eventually do—but with clearer numbers. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23u5vePV5iwFG29wh3uQfdDbYigwRfxyEFNhfbBe6JWiCDCHhc7xegwdPbFz6WwpcF4cR.png) ##
How much does a set of “Conclave Arcana” cost?
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif That’s the topic of this post, but beyond that, here you can start figuring out what you need and, most importantly, how much “capital” is required. I’d also like to see a feature that shows rental prices, but maybe the developer will add that later. On the other hand, let’s take a look at the prices of various SETS: ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png) ####
Conclave Arcana:
![Conclave Arcana Precio core promo y reward.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tbGjbSxaRHXnStkBtVVRnL1ew2qfDnJoeDijTMY9PKNTsmLuto5fyePbggPw9ejHgam.png) As you can see in the image, the complete deck for the “Arcane Conclave” set costs approximately $1,056.57, including the current “Core,” “Promo,” and “Rewards” cards. Of course, there are other factors to consider, such as the “Tier” cards you want; for example, I selected all of them, but you can start with whichever tier you prefer. Additionally, you have the option to choose a “League”; I selected “Silver” because it’s the intermediate league, offering the best balance between newcomers and more experienced players, which is ideal for anyone looking to get started with the game. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tkp8cd5gvvhKG9Ar71nV7nrae8YSetvBPC7s4D2oMwKqFHDatyxAGbifSMuz2E7z8EU.png) ####
Escalation:
![Escalation Precio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/23tRt5DWuh3BDvxMDxDX4GUPejfXW48wRJyTy9Gjd2Ds8CeamSWi1yGscdXGC6NxD1gTa.png) The same applies to the Escalation set. Since it currently consists of only 43 cards, the price of the complete set—with all tiers selected and nothing excluded, and of course including the “Silver” tier—is $254.14, which is, of course, much lower, but as they continue to add cards—such as the 6 from “Conflicts”—the number will increase, and therefore the value of the complete deck will as well, so these are details that must be taken into account. --- https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYoUgCugij9Zc9YqZStweXGkczF99nE2M3751EwFvhAF/image.png ##
Conclusion
https://images.hive.blog/DQmaGxPb1AgP9whK3yUktqV6aRxGY3gavovoadSZwkVoX1t/gif%20sp.gif This platform is amazing. I’d already been thinking about something like this to manage our assets more efficiently—in this specific case, our cards. So, if you’re still having trouble building decks, figuring out their costs, or choosing cards, this platform really simplifies things for you. Plus, it’s very intuitive; anyone can use it without any trouble. **Let me know in the comments—did you already know about “Splintiers.com”?**
https://images.ecency.com/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mhowii/23t74jP9PwnQVm1xvGFRSWNw9CX8dtyaB4fPKB2YqhBL6VuzewvG9Sd3Ft2qNL4scwN2L.gif
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/AJhYgvAA2jMdAtev45LxeeeYzzVqonoQgjHfk865cC9GnBW1MVqFA5B5cJ6BKaa.gif ### **I invite everyone to join Splinterlands, the best game based on chains of blocks, full of adventures, battles, and strategies where you will have fun and get rewards according to your league**
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cieliss/Eoc6Yq8EJ2L35tJnQyXixtVnvmKBsf6xNX4yVaZQfn4SPonejdcZVSUfs2LcNi53bp4.png ---  https://i.postimg.cc/d02nBjTg/banner-doradas.gif

body.title: A day of somewhat anxious shopping
body.body: >Buenas noches amigos, hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una especie de blog donde veremos que cosas se pueden comprar actualmente con $136 en mi país Venezuela, creo que es algo bastante interesante sobre todo para aquello que viven en otro país y asi comparar que tan jodidos estamos en Venezuela jajaja. A pesar de que todo esta super costoso juraba que compraría menos cosas, asi de enfermos nos tienen, siempre vamos a comprar con un pesimismo terrible y esperando que el dinero no alcance para nada. Esta compra no tiene lo que mas se necesita para sobrevivir un mes completo, de hecho, es como para dos semanas y eso teniendo en cuenta que hay cosas que no compre demasiado porque aun tengo en casa. > Good evening, friends. Today I want to share with you a sort of blog post where we’ll see what you can actually buy with $136 in my country, Venezuela. I think it’s pretty interesting, especially for those of you living in other countries, so you can see just how screwed we are in Venezuela, hahaha. Even though everything is super expensive, I swore I’d buy fewer things—that’s how messed up we’ve become. We always go shopping with a terrible sense of pessimism, expecting the money won’t be enough for anything. This shopping trip doesn’t cover what’s needed to survive a full month; in fact, it’s enough for about two weeks—and that’s considering I didn’t buy too much of some things because I still have them at home. ![Corazón banner (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23uFgAbHNHepcyH3o8wH15M4pR8K7Jsf3tw4TsSj65zyY1UyQpKRK2L9tGpjABj48Qxzb.png)

>En casa tenemos 3 pollos aun en el congelador y varias cosas que aún no se acababan, aunque si me faltaba queso, huevos, mantequilla, salsas, mayonesa, entre otras cosas. Aclaro para que entiendan porque no compre tanto pollo/carne jaja, el motivo de las compras de hoy aparte de hacer una especie de restock de cosas es porque mañana habrá una especie de “simulacro” realmente no entendí bien que quiere decir, pero como nunca nos pasa nada bueno me dio miedo y es mejor prevenir que lamentar jajaja, todo esta muy raro y sospechoso y la gente en redes estan inventando mil teorías. El supermercado estaba un poco colapsado hoy por cierto, supongo que fue por eso. > We still have three chickens in the freezer at home and a bunch of other things that weren’t quite finished yet, although I was running low on cheese, eggs, butter, sauces, mayonnaise, and other things. Just to clarify so you understand why I didn’t buy that much chicken or meat, haha—the reason for today’s shopping, aside from restocking some items, is that tomorrow there’s going to be some kind of “drill.” I didn’t really understand what that means, but since nothing good ever happens to us, I got scared, and it’s better to be safe than sorry, hahaha. body.title: New Year.
body.body:
New Year. For each person, New Year is something special and very personal, aside from the wild moments of celebration, which are, in theory, present for everyone, only the degree of this activity varies. They say it's a time for making wishes, saying that whatever you wish for as the clock strikes New Year's Eve will come true. I don't know, I have a slightly different perspective, perhaps influenced by the life stories of people who knew and honored God, and God is not Santa. For me, New Year's Eve is a time to examine my hopes and the fulfillment of those hopes over the past year, and a desire to learn to trust in God in everything, as Abraham did, for example, who only became a father at the age of 100, and everyone laughed at his belief that one day this would happen. ![1aDSC09670 (1).png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmRp47NtEb7FytBSHfiJfLu385b4HoT2jgdycHnu3djkLU/1aDSC09670%20\(1\).png) Without such faith, the new year will be just another year in which I was immersed in the daily grind, even though I saw the presence of God around me. ![1ptrsDSC08352.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmQz5SaNHzA7fnSJ4YoEodANEozi7JajtCVraDT29B7Y79/1ptrsDSC08352.png) A tiny bit of faith, like a grain or a drop of water, works miracles, but it's not faith in the good intentions of a bank offering a loan on favorable terms, or faith in the government making the right choice when you're a voter. No, only faith in a Good God works miracles, both in the past and in the new year. ![1DSC03046(1).png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZLrqLkzGer3y5WLWNeeZBvw1P2gjHWLFeag48LaB5v7V/1DSC03046\(1\).png) Zoom in on a photo for a closer view. *** Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. body.title: Dragon Quest 7 reimiagined:  Just kind of a lazy and uninspired remake
body.body: I don't normally get involved with any remakes of famous older games because they are almost always a disappointment.   I initially was excited about the Final Fantasy 7 remake but after defeating the first installment and being rather nonplussed by it I didn't even bother to look at the 2nd installment even though it is now free on the PS-Plus network.   \n\nWhen Dragon Quest 7 Reimagined was released I decided to break my code and buy this one anyway and here we are, about 10 hours into the gameplay of one of my favorite games that was ever made, and I have to say they really \

on this one.  

<center> https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2499860/2f5ecf8d4a17a0bf959f96145a41250703ee7993/capsule_616x353.jpg?t=1772804835
[src](https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2499860/2f5ecf8d4a17a0bf959f96145a41250703ee7993/capsule_616x353.jpg?t=1772804835)</center>

My dislike of this game isn't definitive.  There are parts of it that I like but for the most part this is just because every now and then it brings me back to 25 years ago when this game was first released and graphics and sound were very far behind where they are today.   The story is mostly the same although some parts of the game were removed.  Since so much time has passed I am not always very aware of where they were cut and the game is so damn long that I don't really miss it.

But this Square-Enix re-release kind of sums up about how I feel about the general laziness of that company that has reared its ugly head in recent years.

<center> https://preview.redd.it/heres-a-graphics-comparison-top-is-original-middle-is-3ds-v0-kxs3j8ihh5qf1.jpg?width=1080&crop=smart&auto=webp&s=d2a5147e8ad6177d49f160a1d3284e59c6242236
[src](https://preview.redd.it/heres-a-graphics-comparison-top-is-original-middle-is-3ds-v0-kxs3j8ihh5qf1.jpg?width=1080&crop=smart&auto=webp&s=d2a5147e8ad6177d49f160a1d3284e59c6242236)</center>

Here we have a comparison between the original, the 3DS release, and the modern Switch version.  The improvements are palatable and real, that much is for sure and this stays fun for a little while.   The problems that we encounter as the game goes on though are noticeable to the point of annoyance.  

For one thing, they made combat, which was already quite easy, even easier.  

I am a good 50% through the game and have only encountered a handful of situations where doing anything other than using the basic attack command was necessary.  The auto-healing I guess is nice but it kind of eliminates a great deal, if not all of the strategy necessary to succeed.  Instead, you are made aware of your lack of level by losing fights and then are simply supposed to go and grind for more levels before proceeding.  When has that ever been fun? 

<center> https://sm.pcmag.com/t/pcmag_au/review/d/dragon-que/dragon-quest-vii-reimagined_muy1.1920.jpg
[src](https://sm.pcmag.com/t/pcmag_au/review/d/dragon-que/dragon-quest-vii-reimagined_muy1.1920.jpg)</center>

As is the case in any JRPG, combat is a major part of the game but in the case of DQ7R, it is so repetitive and basic that I start to find myself just wanting it to be over.  I will often skip optional treasure chests just because I can see from my vantage point that I will have to endure 2-3 more fights in order to get to the chest that in all likelihood contains something that I don't need anyway.  

<center> https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TSHLjpEvKuhJYKbLi7ZrU7.jpg
[src](https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TSHLjpEvKuhJYKbLi7ZrU7.jpg)</center> 

I will give credit where it is due though and the cutscenes are excellent on the remake.  This seems to be what Square-Enix specializes in these days and that being the case, they should just transition to being an animated studio and forget about making games.   I suppose we could say that they already tried this but as it turns out there are not enough general fans of their games for them to make money on films.  The Final Fantasy films I have watched were mostly not worth the time even though they were beautiful.

Combine this with the fact that I am not really a fan of excessive cinematics interrupting gameplay and there really isn't much for me to enjoy contained in this game.   

I should have listened to what I already kind of knew:  Remakes are generally just lazy cash-grabs on the part of studios with a couple of exceptions.  the *Resident Evil* remakes are ones that pop into my mind as being wonderful \

of the already excellent originals.   

The *Dragon Quest* remake though, that is an entirely different story.  Not only is the story almost exactly like it was in the originals with very little new content, but they actually cut some of the content out including a great many of the enemy types that existed in the original.  I don't necessarily NEED a wide variety of opponents, but when it is the same 7 or 8 enemy types over and over again this gets boring pretty quick.

The only reason why I am even playing this at all is because *Nine Sols* is so painstakingly difficult that I find that I need a break to something that is significantly easier.   

Unfortunately *DQ7R* is so easy and simplistic that I can go ahead and state that the entire experience is boring and seems like a waste of time.   My parents claiming that video games are a waste of time has come to fruition in this particular title and I can't recommend this game to anyone really.  Old school fans are going to be pissed about their memories getting shit on and new players are going to be like \

and be bored almost immediately. \n\nI am kind of in a state of disbelief that Square-Enix continues to exist as a company.   Perhaps in a future episode I will dive into their finances and management, because I believe there are some really serious problems over there at what was once one the most highly-regarded companies in gaming.

body.title: A daily affirmation.
body.body:
Sometimes you  have to do what you have to do. It's all a matter of perspective that will define how things around you go. Even when things look bleak there is no time to be meek.

The person next to you may seem like the world around them is crumbling into pieces, you should always stay calm in the knowledge that you are your purveyor of your design. 

Life happens when you lay expect it. 

Even to them. 

That heavy bag on your shoulder is as light as a feather to the one next to you, use their strength as they lean on yours.
