body.title: TIB - An Investors Journal #810 - Rare Earths, Uranium, US Industrials, Europe Banks, Oil Services, Alternate Energy, Solar Power, ASX stocks + lots more
body.body:
A busy options expiry at the end of a choppy week sees lots of adds especially in uranium and nuclear and a few sales in alternate energy. A bit of a step back week for uranium explorers otherwise ![May15Trades.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23yJXfEJZC2VsQm1DDqVa8tujVdh4sgku9EGDoKoXoceRKu5KJhZ6HUDq8hw7TPTZPBMS.png)

Portfolio News

In a week where S&P 500 rose 0.2% and Europe dropped 2.64%, my pension portfolio dropped 2.35%. The drop driven largely by the pullback in commodities especially gold, silver and uranium. Big movers of the week were Miramar Resources (M2R.AX) (50%), Genmin (GEN.AX) (33.3%), Pursuit Minerals (PUR.AX) (30.9%), Tokai Carbon (5301.T) (28.6%), Lifeist Wellness (LFST.V) (25%), Fermi (FRMI) (24.5%), Strike Energy (STX.AX) (22.7%), Sumitomo Chemical Company, (4005.T) (22.7%), Mitsubishi Steel Mfg (5632.T) (18.2%), Orezone Gold Corporation (ORE.AX) (16.4%), Inghams Group (ING.AX) (15.3%), Fortuna Metals (FUN.AX) (13.6%), OD6 Metals (OD6.AX) (12.9%), Honda Motor (7267.T) (12.7%), Lithium Universe (LU7.AX) (12.5%), American Rare Earths (ARR.AX) (12.3%), VHM Limited (VHM.AX) (11.3%), RocketBoots (ROC.AX) (10.7%), Solis Minerals (SLM.AX) (10.5%), Broken Hill Mines (BHM.AX) (10.2%), Evolution Energy Minerals (EV1.AX) (10%) A shorter 21 stocks making the big movers lists. The big sell off on Friday (May 15) took a big toll. Big themes are here - from the top: gold/silver mining (3 stocks), alternate energy (5 stocks), marijuana (1 stock), nuclear (1 stock), rare earths (3 stocks). Good to see a couple Japanese stocks in the list - been a long slow road to recovery ![May15News.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EocDFc4cjzJ2EjiBt7KK4pbA1ts9aM8vybQSXYqXb9vR5sTXxai6o3J15PPvSFz5CNw.png) The headlines are a bit all over the place as the markets bounce around one day ignoring the war, the next worried about oil and the war. What was moving things lower was prospect of a UK PM leadership challenge and sagging gold and silver prices in Friday trade **Crypto Drifts** Bitcoin price pushed lower all week finishing the week 4.8% lower than the open with a peak to trough range of 6.7%. ![May17BTC.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23w3EnXc91dJbTjk8pM2jmuBw7grTSowfKq6QPnmApBZVnVNK2BVUFqLNpbmtb61fdGDa.jpg) Ethereum price did much the same finishing the week 9% lower than the open with a peak to trough range of 10.7% abd testing support from a weekly chart way back ![May17ETH.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wXQhLhKeZ8pCy6RZM4wqhLbYDpTQX3shgUG8nL7tGcPicXRQFmvGN9SLunWb8zS9s9i.jpg) Showing signs of life was Chiliz (CHZBTC) with a 19% pop - looks like the top of the consolidation range but there is new markets news - USA entry in Football World Cup year ![May17CHZ.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23viTJdMr5zXNKwKtPBm32NMPXYpsGPmTfqn3JVTdeficiVuE6yd5qdtYbM9D5XfGmZba.jpg) Also showing life is Injective Protocol (INJBTC) with a 49% pop ![May17INJ.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wXQUpZcxJxtf2gEmR3sRxhNpsbpz2koV57fGnxqciVEQHVDYwnArU74fW94TsaHttE2.jpg) **Nuclear Energy Holdings** An active options expiry adds quite a few holdings and takes overall total back of $1million. Portfolio value drops a whopping 9.2% ![May15NuclearChange.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EoKCXamb5QQUcTf1WUXPHD5dybQLCZa3xgmajKoZewd8HGLFzJYdYRDZ7LZ6egigx4s.jpg) A few changes in rankings of the Top 10 with the additions. Denison Mines Corp (DNN) rises 2 places to slot 2. Cameco Corporation (CCJ) comes into Top 10 in slot 5 and EU comes into slot 8. Dropping out the Top 10 are Silex Systems (SLX.AX) and NuScale Power Corporation (SMR). Share of top holding Uranium Royalty Corp (UROY) drops below 10%. Share of portfolios rises 2.5 points to 31.4% ![May15Nuclear.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/245TQxCuKWkzUfoY22EnsQTCvAfKegvCttyPKH4yCW36yRe9ekwUXKMS1cb2NNXSbu7a4.jpg) Holdings by Stage sees key changes with the additions. Physical drops 2.4 points, Producing goes up 0.7 points, Near Producing drops 1.3 points, 2027 goes up 2.8 points, Explorers goes down 1.1 points, ETFs go up 4 points, Enrichment is down 0.7 points and Technology goes down 1.9 points ![May15NuclearbyStage.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EocDNhDRc2kURHjefei1UTNwBtPpSy6Y1tiQXauSm1gb6kTSJkYs1ruasAUAFn54eKN.jpg) **Alternate Energy Holdings** A few key sales and a few small additions through options assignment and a 4% drop in valuations ![May15LithiumChange.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23viTJdMikNzo5mSmx3MhCxe99wahiRsTw42MtAABr5ZdoP9VarW2mrGA78YUAcNydjfp.jpg) Two key changes with sales of two Top 10 stocks, Invesco Solar ETF (TAN) and iShares Global Clean Energy ETF (ICLN). Westwater Resources (WWR) and Largo Inc (LGO) change places in slots 4 and 5. PLS Group (PLS.AX) rises one place to slot 5. QuantumScape Corporation (QS) drops three places to slot 6. Gevo, Inc (GEVO) and Frontier Nuclear and Minerals (FNUC) and Lithium Americas Corp (LAC) come into Top 10 in slots 7, 9 and 10. Share of Others drops 1.8 points to 16.9%. Dropping out of the Top 10 but still held is Pilbara Gold (PGL.AX). Share of portfolios drops half a point to 5.2% ![May15Lithium.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/245J3rSXJ9SBg65TLFQUu1mfmazEVj5NMPjXqMmYkaTpJKS7wAfhhZWstvuoB1ybNj4NR.jpg) **Precious Metals Holdings** A few modest additions which balance out the 3.5% drop in valuations ![May15PreciousChange.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EoeLeoX8RQBLve56wQgvaoGRCmuF4qbfhKi19Tc8hoby3CK2uxFvowyAcvvDiw66Lo4.jpg) A few small changes in the mix of holdings with Barrick Mining (B) swapping places with Alamos Gold (AGI) in slot 7. GoGold Resources (GGD.TO) rises one place into slot 9 and Newmont Corporation (NEM) comes into the Top with the addition there. Dropping out the Top 10 is Pilbara Gold (PGL.AX). Share of Others rises 2.6 points to 31.4%. Share of holdings rises 0.4 points to 11.2% ![May15Precious.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/244or1vDjN8wHpSuRk919CjPzqiZWoLi4rqXsPtcazwE5HRSsFFyY3ogvPsEK8odKw4yw.jpg)

Bought

**ACDC Metals** (ADC.AX): Rare Earths/Gold. Pending order to add a 2nd parcel at a lower entry than the first tranche. Trade rationale set out in [TIB807](https://mclnks.com/tib807) was relative valuations of two businesses developing mineral sands projects in Goschen, Victoria - then find the company acquired gold tenements in Nevada and have started work soon after acquisition was complete. >Immediate start to exploration at ACDC Metals new gold and silver project in Nevada, USA. Airborne Geophysical survey (magnetics and radiometrics) now completed. Processing and interpretation of geophysical data in progress, with aim of defining priority drilling targets Deployed some of proceeds of Atha Energy Corp (SASK.V) sale below in a few other uranium explorers based on AI suggestions. **CanAlaska Uranium** (CVV.V): Uranium. >CanAlaska is a “project generator” with extensive land holdings, success identifying uranium exploration targets and making new high-grade uranium discoveries in the Athabasca Basin. There are 6 projects in the Athabasca Basin located in proximity to Cameco (CCJ) and Denison (DNN) mill assets. ![May11SASK.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/48TpDjvycZSBQTj3uusr2sg2WWCoHMbevfLDXWqgjS2LqMiS2a6Y4cjYLzm9yppDe8.jpg) This chart from Atha Energy Corp (SASK.V) was part of the idea - next stock down the table **Myriad Uranium Corp** (M.CN): Uranium. Watched interview with Thomas Lamb, CEO where he discussed the new drill program in Wyoming, the sale of New Mexico assets and the prospect of technology companies moving hard in the junior mining space. Got to say the discussion on the Copper Mountain, Wyoming project was confusing - was not really clear if they were trying to confirm the historical data or to widen the resource. The good news is the sale of Red basin, New Mexico did generate cash to fund the drilling. **Denison Mines Corp** (DNN): Uranium. Followed an AI suggestion to add a small holding In pension portfolio. Wrote covered call for 1.3% premium with 6.9% price coverage - 4 days. Was assigned on sold put in personal portfolio - Breakeven $3.47 vs $3.28 close (May 15) - two cycles. In managed portfolio - breakeven $3.27 vs $3.28 close (May 15) - two cycles. **Noble Plains Uranium** (NOBL.V): Uranium. Scaled into holding In pension portfolio. See [TIB807](https://mclnks.com/tib807) for rationale. **Power Solutions International** (PSIX): US Industrials. Company announced earnings which disappointed the markets - sales in oil and gas sectors sagging with high oil prices. Market punished the stock at one stage down 50%. This exposes the pension portfolio to a sold put at an ugly strike. Sense is the market over-reacted. Bought a parcel of stock in extended hours to average down the sold put which will get assigned at expiry. Wrote covered call for 1.4% premium with 25.8% price coverage - 3 days to expiry. Why buy more? Average down entry price and my idea source likes the promise of the business > The pattern is clear, and strikingly similar. The market is not disagreeing with the demand story. It is laser-focused on margin compression and earnings quality, and it keeps finding reasons to worry. A few words from Swiss Transparent Portfolio after the last earnings (not this one) from \

(their words). In regular hours with price opening at $41.10, put in place an August expiry 45/55/35 call spread risk reversal. This offers maximum profit potential of 251% for a 33.8% move in price. The sold put fully funds the call spread with 14.8% price coverage. Breakeven on sold put should it be assigned is $32.11. ![May13PSIX.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EoEwo1WBAVkaipUyq6cTx7sLvrkTWeDjPyS539NzLe42MLLJSzxSTUgWQGWnDicMuRt.jpg) Let's look at the chart which shows the bought call (45) as a blue ray and the sold call (55) as a red ray and the sold put (35) as a dotted red ray with the expiry date the dotted green line on the right margin. At trade time (May 13), price was just below the bought call strike (45). Trade idea is simple - recover half of the gap down and hold above the bottom support level (lower red line) - one green arrow price move will do it. Those are little green arrows. A bunch of assignments on sold puts - aided and abetted by a down day in on options expiry day. **enCore Energy Corp** (EU): Uranium. Assigned In personal portfolio on sold put - one tranche assigned early, the other at expiry. Breakeven $1.50 vs $1.57 close (May 15) - 4 cycles. In managed portfolio - breakeven $1.56 vs $1.57 close (May 15) - 6 cycles. In pension portfolio - breakeven $1.10 vs $1.57 close (May 15) - 6 cycles **IsoEnergy** (ISO.TO): Uranium. In personal portfolio. Breakeven $14.41 vs $15.47 close (May 15) - one cycle **Deutsche Bank AG** (DBK.DE): German Bank. In personal portfolio. Breakeven €25.72 vs €26.70 close (May 15) - three cycles. In managed portfolio - breakeven €26.24 vs €26.70 close (May 15) - one cycle. In pension portfolio - breakeven €26.54 vs €26.70 close (May 15) - two cycles. **Barclays Group** (BARC.L): UK Bank. In personal portfolio. Breakeven £4.13 vs £4.23 close (May 15) - two cycles **Lloyds Banking Group** (LLOY.L): UK Bank. In personal portfolio. Breakeven £0.95 vs £0.94 close (May 15) - one cycle. In managed portfolio - breakeven £0.97 vs £0.94 close (May 15) - two cycles. **NatWest Group plc** (NWG.L): UK Bank. In personal portfolio. Breakeven £5.71 vs £5.61 close (May 15) - two cycles. In managed portfolio - breakeven €5.79 vs £5.61 close (May 15) - one cycle. **Baker Hughes Company** (BKR): Oil Services. In personal portfolio. Breakeven $64.01 vs $64.12 close (May 15) - one cycle **Cameco Corporation** (CCJ): Uranium. In personal portfolio. Breakeven $113.18 vs $107.51 close (May 15) - one cycle. Never a problem owning Cameco. **iShares U.S. Regional Banks ETF** (IAT): U.S. Regional Banks. In personal portfolio. Breakeven $55.42 vs $55.41 close (May 15) **The Mosaic Company** (MOS): US Fertilizer. In personal portfolio. Breakeven $21.19 vs $21.76 close (May 15) - two cycles. In managed portfolio - breakeven $22.00 vs $21.76 close (May 15) - one cycle. **NexGen Energy** (NXE): Uranium. In personal portfolio. Breakeven $11.45 vs $11.24 close (May 15) - one cycle. Covered call will close that gap in one go. **Westwater Resources** (WWR): Graphite. In personal portfolio. Breakeven $0.52 vs $0.60 close (May 15) - 4 cycles of sold puts. **iShares MSCI Brazil Capped ETF** (EWZ): Brazil Index. In managed portfolio. Breakeven $38.55 vs $36.23 close (May 15) - one cycle. **VanEck Uranium and Nuclear ETF** (NLR): Nuclear Power. In managed portfolio. Breakeven $122.61 vs $129.68 close (May 15) - one cycle - a good start to a new holding **Sprott Uranium Miners ETF** (URNM): Uranium. In managed portfolio. Breakeven $62.64 vs $60.15 close (May 15) - 4 cycles. Going to need a long hold **L'Air Liquide S.A.** (AI.PA): Specialty Chemicals. In pension portfolio - breakeven €175 vs €174.50 close (May 15) - three cycles of credit spreads/ Timing works with stock dividend ex date June 8 - adding another 2.1%. Was the sold put leg of a 180/170 credit spread **Gevo, Inc** (GEVO): Specialty Chemicals. In pension portfolio. Breakeven $1.71 vs $1.68 close (May 15) - on cycle **Newmont Corporation** (NEM): Gold Mining. In pension portfolio. Breakeven $109.11 vs $109.06 close (May 15) - one cycle - a new position **U.S. Gold Corp** (USAU): Gold Mining. In pension portfolio. Breakeven $17.06 vs $15.89 close (May 15) - one cycle. A hard start

Sold

**Atha Energy Corp** (SASK.V): Uranium. Watched interview with CEO, Troy Boisjoli. Another confusing interview - what is clear is the project is standing on a substantial resource. What is not clear is the chances of getting to development - no PFS yet. >ATHA holds the largest prospective land package in the highest-grade uranium districts in the world – 3.8 million acres in the Athabasca Basin, 3.1 million acres in Nunavut, and 399k acres in Newfoundland and Labrador’s Central Mineral Belt. Decided to lock in 38.5% blended profits on FIFO basis since March/June/July 2024 in pension portfolio and deploy elsewhere. Will retain a holding with a lower average cost. Interesting chart from their latest corporate presentation - stage of development and relative enterprise value. It does show the step up in value with the transition into development ![May11SASK.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/48TpDjvycZSBQTj3uusr2sg2WWCoHMbevfLDXWqgjS2LqMiS2a6Y4cjYLzm9yppDe8.jpg) **Halliburton Co** (HAL): Oil Services. Assigned on covered call in pension portfolio for 23% profit since February 2026 - drill, baby drill worked here **iShares Global Clean Energy ETF** (ICLN): Alternate Energy. Assigned on covered call in pension portfolio for 5.2% profit since February 2026 **Invesco Solar ETF** (TAN): Solar Power. Assigned on covered call in pension portfolio for 30.4% profit since November 2025. Maybe time to pick a stock or two from the Top 15. Income trades have added another 77% profit in the same time.

ASX Portfolio

The segment reports trading in ASX fractional share portfolio. Trade entries are made based on stock screens looking for undervalued stocks (price to book, price earnings, price to sales) that are showing technical signs of breaking a downtrend. Exits are made at 35% profit or 25% if 52 week high is lower than 35% advance. New buys are in $500 lots. Scale ins and top ups in $250 lots **New Buys** **Metro Mining Limited** (MMI.AX): Bauxite. ![May12MMI.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tmmT4FWwHpjXBfPohrJAr2fQU9vSVDhiDfJVqJjk2LxnzgtGkiTEiy5195QhQRmGTy4.jpg) Chart shows price in a consolidation range. If price follows a similar trajectory to the last breakout (the blue arrow) this will reach a 52 week profit target. Risk in the trade is largest customer base is China and United Arab Emirates - risk in China-US relations and the Iran war. **Scale Ins** **Austral Resources Australia Ltd** (AR1.AX): Base Metals. Chose to scale in holding as stock was on the big movers list last week. Averages down entry price and copper price is moving. **Top Ups** **Worley Ltd** (WOR.AX): Mining Services. Dividend yield 4.01%. ![May14WOR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/Eo6SF4v7M5dzMpMbSvYEAR7U15uCyf4yxqXmwFXBm4uU1RGZVdm6vPGxFb4Vqvha2wJ.jpg) Chart shows price dropping below support and making higher low. there is enough headroom to make a 52 week high profit target though that would be at lower than the normal 25% average profit needed. ![May14WORvsMAH.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tSzLNbitQp5FtRkqKs5Hk7zJvbEThfGVcaHLHhR6in7Rvdb5uT7r6rwxyVQWTsdcfDm.jpg) Big gaps to the major competitors **Sold** **APA Group** (APA.AX): Utility. Closed out at 52 week high target for 25% blended profit since April/May 2024. **Dyno Nobel was Incitec Pivot Ltd** (DNL.AX): Fertilizer. Closed out at 52 week high target for 25.6% blended profit since August/September 2023/March/April/May 2024/June 2025. All tranches profitable. Transferred out some of the capital from this portfolio to personal portfolio - been a good run.

Shorts

**Pfizer** (PFE): US Pharmaceuticals. Exercised In personal portfolio on bought put leg of 26/24 ratio put spread. With close at $25.33 (May 15), trade is in-the-money and better than the $25.70 breakeven. ![May15PFE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23twAKVLETaj93iqApvaV1rQFo6eqi2Y3R5QjFZeZMALXUC7Zp6FMUZHPR1FTEvbocbAC.jpg) Chart shows price chose to follow red price arrow scenario to go just below the bought put level. Exercise was after ex dividend date - so not needing to pay away the dividend amount.

Hedging Trades

**Vanguard FTSE Europe ETF** (VGK): Europe Index. With price closing at $85.79, bought put leg of 84/82 credit spread expired worthless in pension portfolio expired. Trade started life as a 87/84 ratio put spread to hedge Europe exposure. Closed out the bought put (87) when price plumbed below the sold put (84) and replaced it with a bought put lower (82) to protect the potential of an assignment on he sold put (84). Somehow managed to get the expiries mismatched. ![May15VGK.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tHbkihuAr4RKCBUZyy6GvkgPPybrKdSs8V8nuHsYnMY5tEnThE8mFmsZmys2P8T8ekk.jpg) Chart tells the story. Price did drop and dropped more than a red arrow price scenario which made selling the bought put (87) a profitable exit. What is left over is the sold put (84) - price is holding fine above that level and should be safe if there is another red price arrow move (the pink arrow is same size and is new on the chart). It is time to review the hedge needs - must be true as here was a CNBC article suggesting now is a good time to hedge (because implied volatility is moderate). ![May22Hedge.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23wgmayZLNsUY7z5zmDtqzPqWrkreN9Z91C7UiftmXqTREVdwJ3HyAGWkNjwX4yrSqz9p.jpg) https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/22/stocks-continue-surging-to-record-highs-heres-how-to-hedge.html

Expiring Options

**Lightbridge Corporation** (LTBR): Nuclear Technology. 17.5/25/15 call spread risk reversal expired with price below the sold put strike in managed portfolio. Trade goes back to December 2025. As the sold put fully funded the call spread, can apply the series of sold puts from the last assignment - breakeven $7.67 vs $11.43 close (May 15) - 6 cycles - been doing this a while. ![May15LTBR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tcNs5P31k8c4v5pQ6txN1ppj6GXzUcDfnJttFtLxxXCDWos4TY7y5EWVdpYkXbHx3qt.jpg) Chart shows price never got moving on any of the price scenarios - just tracked sideways for two months and then drifted lower. Maybe a trade ahead of its time. **Westwater Resources** (WWR): Graphite. With price closing at $0.58, sold put on 5/2 risk reversal went to assignment in personal portfolio. While the risk reversal was not fully funded, the cycle of rolling sold puts bought breakeven down to $0.49 - been a specific strategy on these low ticker stocks to use sold puts to find discounted entry levels. This is a hold for the long haul In pension portfolio a 2/5 call spread went to expiry - over time the call spread was fully funded by sold puts. ![May15WWR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tSzLNbh8KeaKd2S2UkVE6v5EmBGNS6JswoLPPUkwFWfX7ZeyRoQFP55d3YFvACyvhLC.jpg) Chart shows the bought call as a blue ray and the sold call as a red ray and the series of sold puts as dotted red rays with the expiry the vertical green line on the right margin. Trade was set up after the big peak was dismissed. Trade idea was for a recovery - maybe 3 cycles of similar strenght (the blue arrows) each pulling back to the 0.768 Fibonacci level. The sold puts outweighed the cost of the call spread by 8.6 times **NOV Inc** (NOV): Oil Services. With price closing at $20.37, sold put leg (18) of 20/30/18 call spread risk reversal expired. ![May15NOV.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/EoAgzeXT6K2vnyp175qEwdT3ZiV6EzPbCCWVGr4f6oq35XMCDuLwKEteW1xtEKvyUFh.jpg) Chart shows the trade set up with expiry of the sold put (18) shorter than the call spread expiry. The sold put was set up as a ratio to fully fund the call spread with the shorter duration. Price has stayed comfortably above that level implying that it is possible to continue selling at that level to lever the trade up further. **Gevo, Inc** (GEVO): Specialty Chemicals. With price closing at $1.68 (May 15), 3/5/2 call spread risk reversal in pension portfolio from October 2025 went to expiry worthless. As the 3/5 call spread was fully funded by the sold put (2) not a losing trade. In fact a series of sold puts along the way has made this a good trade avenue ![May15GEVO.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/carrinm/23tmmf7kkQU4EPoqv2UouJC9tsR51ijS3nVn57Q6GipsUKsx6a4RPAaB1tt6NBYxjkvFY.jpg) Chart shows trade entry was not the best - at the top of a long run up. Better idea is to wait for the pullback. The trade idea though was for a series of runs up (the blue arrows). As it happens that looks like it was wishful thinking (but a free trade is a free trade). They key take away from the chart is the way price has cycled around the sold put (2) level. Hence the approach evolved to keep selling puts at that level and take delivery every now and then. Did that 6 times with 3 assignments including this month.

Income Trades

**Covered Calls** 84 covered calls went to expiry with only 4 assigned (in brackets) (UK 4 Europe 4 US 71 (4) Canada 5) **Goldman Sachs Nasdaq-100 Premium Income ETF** (GPIQ): US Technology. Assigned early and at expiry on covered call In personal portfolio for 6.6% profit since April 2026 - was not expecting that after passing the dividend ex date. Maybe the buyer was getting nervous about Nasdaq levels. **UBS ETRACS Crude Oil Shares Covered Call ETN** (USOI): US Oil. Scaled into holding In personal portfolio. Might be a somewhat counter-intuitive move with China and US sort of agreeing to keep Straits of Hormuz but it seems the trade-off was China buying more US oil - has to underpin WTI Texas Crude price. Yield 32.57% **Naked Puts** 89 sold puts went to expiry with 29 assigned (UK 7 (5) Europe 15 (3) US 61 (20) Canada 6 (1)). Next month will need to be a bit quieter as the markets feels a bit toppy to be that exposed. Sold puts happy to own at lower prices - Glencore plc (GLEN.L): Base Metals. Return 1.35% Coverage 5.8% - June expiry Sold puts on stocks that might get assigned on covered calls - U.S. Gold Corp. (USAU): Gold Mining. Return 2.6% Coverage -0.3% - OTM at close - Rio Tinto Group (RIO): Mining. Return 2.1% Coverage 5.4% - June expiry - Uranium Royalty Corp. (UROY): Uranium. body.title: Jam on! My Actifit diary: May 22 2026
body.body:
Today I wrote quite a bit. And read quite a bit. Reason was something going on in Splinterlands that I was interested in, as a stakeholder. In short, it seems like the developers had been negligent with code, leaving a big security worth $4.5 million open. A white hat hacker found it, reported it, and it was patched right away. Now the DAO will pay the white hatter (with good reason), but I ask myself if the coder will be held responsible for not doing their job right like they’re paid handsomely to do. Probably not. [Which lead me to thinking about my own policy on negligent employees doing damage to the company.](https://peakd.com/hive-180505/@beelzael/fairness-and-wages) Feel free to read and comment! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/223f5af1-f336-47a5-9b15-76c7e8231a3e.jpg) I started the day with a good work out at the gym. I’m building a routine on the walker now, trying to improve my way of walking, too. And as a side benefit, it helps a lot to improve my step count. The rest was back and shoulder training, and it seems like the Tang Soo Do training is beneficial to that part as I did not feel any hardening or similar, which usually comes up that day (which is why I train that part on Fridays). ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/56519dcf-d289-4438-b37c-7619d07f95cc.jpg) I also went to the courthouse to gently push them to not forget about my case. No news from Lily yet, but I reminded her today that Sunday is my mom’s birthday. I hope she’ll be allowed to send a message for that. Though it wouldn’t surprise me if she won’t be. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ab293294-d798-42c9-94f7-94fc72149d12.jpg) I didn’t really do much the rest of the day. Time just trickled by. But that’s okay, I’ve been very productive this week and am quite happy with that. Still going to go to the jamsession today. It seems like quite a few musicians will be coming, which is great as we will be at a venue that has a stage. So, an early good night – though I won’t publish before I’m back home. Gotta count all the steps… ;-)
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@beelshops/actifit-beelshops-20260523t044251211z)_

China has begun developing a new technology, namely gestational robots, a type of robot designed to undergo the pregnancy process like a normal human. title.title: What Keeps You Delegating to Projects?
title.body: There are a lot of good reasons to delegate to projects. This can be for Hive-Engine tokens, liquid HIVE as a share of curation rewards, helping others, etc. The question that matters most is, \

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmTHpj7Ub7zidRgUzcAw9SE7qEhNTSEf213kuxvxGE9bck/1779510209420.jpg) (Created with Bing) I'm still working on my token idea. The issue with delegations is once the main draw of delegating is gone, what is keeping people around? A great example of this is the HELIOS project. The token supply has pretty much hit its limit, so nobody is earning more tokens, yet people continued to delegate. As soon as there was talk of eliminating HIVE payouts from curation rewards, suddenly those delegations disappeared in a hurry. So it would seem that when the tokens dry up, the delegations stay if liquid HIVE is paid out from curation rewards. The next question would be what would is an ideal percentage payout range? Certainly 100% would be best, but in order for a project to grow it would have to be less than that in order to continue growing the HP over time. So what is an ideal percentage range you'd want to see paid in liquid HIVE for delegating? Or am I wrong and there are other motivating factors I haven't considered? . In fact, it is very true, we can earn money in any way but to save it, we need to have a lot of patience and a mindset not to spend unnecessarily. There are many people who earn money but do not have any money in their hands, they keep spending everything they earn. In fact, there are some people who spend even a little money in various ways. Even if they do not need it, they easily buy unnecessary things when they see it and feel like it. WExtra spending. e should not spend extra money on anything. We should always remember that we cannot spend money on anything unnecessarily except spending money on necessary things. If we spend money on unnecessary things without need, we will not be able to save our money for the future and for spending it at an inappropriate time, as a result of which when a bad time comes in our life, we will be financially devastated. If we keep spending unnecessary money, then the people around us will not want to stand by us and help us. Because they will also get annoyed by our behavior and will not want to help us financially in any way after seeing our wasteful spending. Half of the money we earn in life must be saved for our future and for sudden accidents or medical support. Human illnesses and dangers are never predictable, so we should always think about our physical illnesses and dangers and save some money for our future. Then we will not have to go to anyone to ask for financial help in times of trouble and we will be able to be financially independent. But if we do not do that and keep spending money as we earn it, whether we need it or not, we will keep buying various things, then at some point money will run away from us. It is not only unnecessary things that are wasted, but people who get addicted to various things in different ways and spend money on getting their addicted friends addicted also fall into the category of wasting money. Spending money unnecessarily on the streets, betting money with friends and gambling, building and breaking things without a plan, buying the same thing again even though it is there, destroying things and then using the same thing again, money is wasted in various ways. If we do not spend money in life by calculating, we will not be able to achieve financial success and progress in life. If we have to progress in life, we should definitely spend money by planning. We should definitely save one third of the money we earn and the money from that savings should not be wasted or spent in any way. One third of the remaining two parts should be used to buy various necessary things and the rest should be spent on the needs of our family. Only then can we spend our money properly. We should always consider which is a bad expense and which is a necessary expense. If we can stay away from bad expenses and always spend money wisely, then we will never lack money and we will be able to save money for the future. So we should always try to earn more money in an honest way and try to save more, only then we will be able to secure our future life and also protect our family members. title.title: FIAT BROKE, SAT RICH: The Non-Existent Fantasy of a Trustless Bitcoin Credit Facility
title.body:
Let’s face it, fellow Plebs: being a Bitcoin maximalist is hard, exhausting work. Every single day, we wake up, look at our beautifully curated UTXOs sitting safely in cold storage, and then look at our empty fiat bank accounts. It’s a tragic, Shakespearean dilemma.
#
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdmSkNf8Z2hZYCkivjRHy7V9Zjyjs6VNMbn79GBWWTTaB/Screenshot%202026-05-22%20at%202.15.00%E2%80%AFPM.png 


You need to buy groceries. You want to pay your rent. You really, *really* want to buy that shiny new server rack for your routing node. But how? The only option available to us in this cruel, inflationary world is to do the unthinkable: KYC onto a centralized exchange and sell our satoshis. The mere thought of it sends shivers down my spine. Selling Bitcoin? Generating a taxable capital gains event? In this economy? It feels like selling a piece of your own soul. If only—oh, if only—there was some sort of magical, hypothetical \

where we could just lock up our BTC as collateral in a secure, multi-sig setup and borrow spending money against it. Imagine a world where you could inject capital into your life without forcing yourself to part with your generational wealth! Alas, we can only dream of such a sophisticated, nonexistent utopia.

But let’s dare to dream even bigger. If such a fantasy protocol ever existed, it would be even better if we could borrow a stable, decentralized layer-2 asset natively backed by the network itself against our Bitcoin.

Why a native cryptographic dollar? Because the real world is finally waking up to the Bitcoin Standard! We are on the precipice of a global point-of-sale revolution. Imagine walking into a store and paying instantly over the Lightning Network or via decentralized payment infrastructure. Imagine seamlessly integrating your funds into cross-chain layer-2 DeFi or cruising through a trustless, decentralized landscape utilizing state chains or Threshold Signature Schemes (TSS).

Just picture it: You walk into your local coffee shop. You pull out your phone. You scan a QR code, and boom—you pay for your oat milk latte using liquidity that you borrowed against your bitcoin over a lightning fast payment rail. Your BTC stays safely locked away, appreciating in value and securing the network, while you enjoy your caffeine fix. It’s a flawless, closed-loop fantasy.

If only some brilliant minds in the Bitcoin ecosystem would come together to build a true, trustless \

to make this happen. We could call it something crazy... like a decentralized community lending pool. It could allow long-term HODLers to access instant liquidity worth, say, 50% of their collateral value. And maybe, just maybe, it could even remove millions of satoshis from liquid exchange circulation, creating a beautiful supply shock and a deflationary effect on the market.\n\nAnd then, what if someone else built the \

to connect that borrowing infrastructure to the rest of the world? A non-custodial, cross-chain layer-2 protocol that could route global swaps directly into native Bitcoin without wrapping it, making centralized exchanges completely irrelevant.

Wow. What a wild, sci-fi concept. A synergistic flywheel where you lock up BTC in a secure vault, draw an instant loan, spend it at a merchant point-of-sale, or throw it into automated liquidity pools to earn yield. It sounds completely made up.

But until that imaginary day comes when decentralized Bitcoin-backed lines of credit and non-custodial cross-chain rails are real, everyday realities working together to build a sovereign financial fortress... I guess I'll just sit here, staring at my hardware wallet, wishing there was a way to buy a pizza without cutting into my permanent stacking schedule.

title.title: Colors fade, outlines become blurry.
title.body:
As night falls, the city plunges into darkness. Colors fade, outlines become blurry. This continues until the sun suddenly decides to emerge from its warm crib and wake up, taking care of some important matters. title.title: Black beans with bacon and cheese (Eng-Esp)
title.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wqvtoDP749XhaWDvzxLwHbfwHVScmy7TT5KJNwriBaex3CdMNue4KXrfkUmMQsCW8EF.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening, Hivers! I wish you a happy weekend... Today, I'm sharing with you the delicious dish I'll be preparing for my family. Below, I'll explain how to make some \

Although this dish is very complete and balanced, whenever I make it, I love to serve it with: steamed rice and fried plantains... A true delight!

>* Buenas noches hivers, les deseo un feliz fin de semana... Hoy, comparto con ustedes el delicioso platillo que prepararé para compartir con mi familia, a continuación les explico como realizar unos \

. 
Aunque este plato es muy completo y balanceado, siempre que lo preparo me encanta acompañar con: arroz al vapor y plátanos fritos... Un manjar al paladar!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23zktiQr3bbTpsB5qfuZmzjSXDudMVAFzeZPDoSjj88zK5JkF4ht6fA8xqD7QJT1LGNbw.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: bacon slices, red bell pepper, onion, garlic cloves (crushed), sweet peppers, cumin, pepper, sunflower oil, black beans, white cheese and salt to taste.

>* INGREDIENTES: lonchas de tocineta, pimiento rojo, cebolla, dientes de ajo (triturados), ajies dulces, comino, pimienta, aceite de girasol, frijoles negros, queso blanco y sal al gusto.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wgYNCuSFmact5LNMe668WabyQDz4vQfrYBwFgiiSACUxVVZPk5pG25zZxjZDbRyp7P9.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* To make this recipe, I usually soak the black beans in water with 1 heaped teaspoon of baking soda for 8 hours. After this time, I discard the water; this helps them soften faster.
I then put the beans in a deep pot, add enough water to cover them, and cook over high heat until tender. I don't usually add salt at this stage, but rather when I add the vegetables.

>* Para realizar esta receta suelo dejar los frijoles negros reposando en agua con 1 cucharadita colmada de bicarbonato de sodio durante 8 horas, transcurrido este tiempo se desecha el agua, de esta forma conseguiremos que se ablanden más rápido.
Incorporamos los frijoles en una olla honda, agregamos suficiente agua, cocinamos a fuego \

hasta que se ablanden. En este paso no suelo integrar sal, sino al momento de agregar las verduras.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/242Nd6fMSx1LBrKWsNcRfyUkGY9T8ruLRn8EBWzt2U517CpxyWqyDCxxddMpvMJ4DzgqE.png)</center>

* We add sunflower oil to the pan... We sauté the onion, along with the (crushed) garlic cloves.

>* Agregamos aceite de girasol al sartén... Sofreímos la cebolla, junto con los dientes de ajo (triturados). 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wCE25UGQq11PunjmRqBjdte98ztxvD9zL5WGyAu8wv2PC69hgpH2siV3K7E4Ur6jozP.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tmPoLaXNbihX7vD4MDhk1boQ1D2t2CGM49jqWLaQVetoGHUspSFcE3b4xf3e9t5csh7.png)</center>

* Next, add the thinly sliced ​​bacon... This ingredient will give it a spectacular smoky flavor!
I suggest not cooking it over high heat to avoid it getting crispy.

>* A continuación, incorporamos las lonchas de tocineta, finamente cortadas... Este ingrediente aportará un sabor ahumado espectacular!
Les sugiero no cocinar a fuego \

de esta forma evitarán que su textura quede crujiente.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wMckqmGzydB1nWk7Br6RJbRTjj1bqmba3Bxcz27iGQ55GqtvuFYomMxkiZQB6uRsQ4w.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/Eoc8uRusNBMr71Tx9T3ujpqdTFJm2Qut67T7GCyEJaFnaKdW15scpEJaR46PGKu432i.png)</center>

* We place the bell pepper (preferably red) along with the sweet peppers. We add 1/2 cup of water, and season with pepper, cumin, and salt to taste.

>* Colocamos el pimiento (preferiblemente rojo) junto con los ajies dulces. Integramos 1/2 taza de agua, aliñamos con: pimienta, comino y sal al gusto.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23vi8FK4W6VT6B6ZXxtj8vx1YhLkr1onykBagRV5KvRv8xjiFxA7Ynk9FEynj9Gs3L7hs.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23u6Fn1Mk4Je5cUHLeG6hBFeEq9GcdWSYSX1BSeBtoSdzLxFV12p41coNHqQxJ1hJsrc2.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23u6E1NQfvftfKNz22EN54SLuR5tWs8sgr5HHCq18mxTfb7Ep6gKLA9JSRU94pDWWFSw2.png)</center>

* When the beans are \
, we proceed to add the reserved sofrito. We cook until its texture is very soft and smooth.\n\n>* Cuando los frijoles estén \

procedemos a integrar el sofrito que teníamos reservado. Cocinamos hasta que su textura quede muy blanda y suave.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/241tZ3FWZq7ni4q9YLZ9sKjHFD7mVkN9szWPBeNAkCCqyQVby3GsNj5jQ98ALAapMijpD.png)</center>


* Our dish is ready to enjoy!

>* Nuestro platillo está listo para disfrutar! 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23y8t67tU5HoHDd4sYCYGAqQGVujRSNfocacQm8zjjwk8SLPM6MU6iLGTnY4Qimd1fsw2.png)</center>

* We plate it... We add white cheese, I love using Palmizulia or Santa Bárbara type cheese, as they have the right salt content, in addition to having a VERY succulent flavor!

>* Emplatamos... Incorporamos queso blanco, me encanta utilizar queso tipo Palmizulia o Santa Bárbara, ya que poseen el contenido adecuado de sal, además de tener un sabor MUY suculento!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wMjGDciDqfqbj5DoMGwunakvzpSFE2FZKA2ZhVJ85uL65m8t84eWCzwhELr5Up4P9Vi.png)</center>

* Friends, here's our delicious dish! I hope you enjoyed the step-by-step instructions... I'm sure you'll love it!
Thank you so much for visiting my blog. See you in the next post. Happy weekend!

>* Amigos, a continuación les presento nuestro delicioso platillo, espero que hayan disfrutado el \

... Estoy segura que les encantará!
Muchas gracias por visitar mi blog, nos vemos en una próxima publicación... Feliz fin de semana!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23zktiQr3bbTpsB5qfuZmzjSXDudMVAFzeZPDoSjj88zK5JkF4ht6fA8xqD7QJT1LGNbw.png)</center>

* All photos are my own work
* Todas las fotos son de mi autoría

title.title: FDIC Study Links Digital Assets to the Fastest Bank Runs in U.S. History: The Speed of Crypto Fear
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUCtGy3TEFtnvJLYwSseFr1cKk4abVeJS7Kcof3E8Saib/bankrun.png 


The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) has released a definitive staff study analyzing the unprecedented mechanics behind the spring 2023 banking turmoil. The empirical evidence provides a critical look at how structural vulnerabilities within the traditional banking sector were exponentially amplified by their exposure to digital assets and modern financial technologies. According to the FDIC's data-driven insights, the failures of institutions like Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) and Signature Bank marked the largest and fastest bank runs in United States history, driven by an entirely new paradigm of depositor flight.

A systems-level examination of the data reveals that these runs were characterized by both unprecedented scale and velocity. The root cause lies in the high concentration of uninsured, institutional deposits closely tied to the cryptocurrency and venture capital ecosystems. Unlike historical bank runs that were physically constrained by branch operating hours and manual processing speed, the digital-asset-adjacent runs of 2023 operated on real-time, 24/7 financial rails. The study underscores that the primary mechanism for the flight was immediate electronic wire transfers, enabled by modern digital banking infrastructure and catalyzed by coordinated panic across digital communication platforms.

Furthermore, the FDIC’s intraday payment data confirms that the outflows were highly concentrated among a small number of massive corporate and digital-asset depositors, rather than a broad base of retail accounts. This high-value deposit velocity fundamentally challenges traditional liquidity management models. The study explicitly concludes that standard deposit insurance mechanisms act as a stabilizing anchor, but when a niche sector heavily integrated with high-velocity digital assets begins to lose confidence, the speed of capital flight can outrun regulatory intervention frameworks. For institutional investors and financial architects, the data serves as an absolute guardrail: treating digital-era deposit liabilities with legacy risk parameters is a recipe for systemic failure.

title.title: The patience of a fisherman
title.body:
by Narocky71 on Narocky's Blog 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/narockysblog [![The patience of a fisherman](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/81ffcaae-5b5a-4860-ae10-fbc1e31ff589.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/nyUPQPfdxU1bvdZYWH8QPX) 
 
 

Today I am back with a new video, I hope you all like today's video. Actually, I was sitting by a river and saw a fisherman catching fish, but despite trying many times, no fish came into his net, but he kept trying, which made me unhappy. Actually, a fisherman tries many times but cannot catch a fish. Finally, he caught a very big fish, which made the fisherman very happy and I myself was very happy. Actually, after so much hard work, when he got such a big fish, it is a matter of joy. A lesson from this is that if you keep trying, one day you will definitely succeed. I hope everyone likes today's video.

Hay momentos sencillos que nos recuerdan lo verdaderamente importante. Hoy tocó una salida diferente, una cena en Arturos con las mujeres de mi familia; una pausa necesaria llena de risas, complicidad y, por supuesto, comida rica.

Ver al grupo reunido me hizo pensar profundamente en el valor único que tiene cada ser humano. A veces la rutina nos lleva a prisa, pero cuando te detienes a escuchar al otro, te das cuenta de que cada mente es un universo entero. Cada una de las mujeres que me acompañaba hoy brilla con luz propia: tiene sus propias batallas, sus sueños, sus formas de amar y una sabiduría que aporta algo irreemplazable a mi vida.

Ninguna vida es igual a otra, y ahí radica la magia. Recordar nuestro valor personal —y reconocérselo a quienes amamos— no requiere de grandes eventos; se cultiva en el presente, en un abrazo sincero o compartiendo la mesa en una tarde cualquiera aquí en Valencia.

Agradezco infinitamente estos espacios que me permiten desacelerar, conectar desde el corazón y celebrar la valiosa presencia de las mujeres que me inspiran a ser mejor cada día. 

💛

There are simple moments that remind us of what really matters. Today was a change of pace—dinner at Arturos with the women in my family; a much-needed break filled with laughter, camaraderie, and, of course, delicious food.

Seeing the group together made me reflect deeply on the unique value of every human being. Sometimes routine rushes us along, but when you stop to listen to others, you realize that every mind is a universe unto itself. Each of the women who joined me today shines with her own light: she has her own struggles, her dreams, her ways of loving, and a wisdom that brings something irreplaceable to my life.

No two lives are alike, and that is where the magic lies. Remembering our personal worth—and recognizing it in those we love—doesn’t require grand events; it’s cultivated in the present, in a sincere hug or sharing a meal on any given afternoon here in Valencia.

I am infinitely grateful for these moments that allow me to slow down, connect from the heart, and celebrate the precious presence of the women who inspire me to be better every day. 💛

title.title: I provided emergency ATM service.
title.body:
> ![IMG20260510114519.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeiPuwb49msNqzYb1tA1iiNJTuVXbNarcqb2mXSJSUE2m/IMG20260510114519.jpg) The ATM booths of Dutch-Bangla Bank (DBBL) are constantly serving thousands of people. And behind the scenes, technical engineers like us have to work behind the scenes to keep this service running. Recently, I had to rush there after receiving an emergency call from a booth. Today, I am sharing with you the experience of that technical visit and successfully repairing the machine. ![IMG20260510114515.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcZjRXyJSVWTLDZNkm6888gfzsLsQwnqucrSmfTsWWYHP/IMG20260510114515.jpg) Due to professional responsibilities, I always have to be ready as soon as I receive news of any mechanical malfunction. That day, an urgent complaint came from an ATM booth (machine number: 005749) of Dutch-Bangla Bank. Although customers were able to withdraw money at the booth, they were not getting any receipt or slip at the end of the transaction. Receipts are a very important part of banking transactions, so I quickly rushed to the spot with a tool bag to solve the problem. Upon reaching the booth, I first diagnosed the machine and checked the entire mechanism inside. It turned out that the main problem was in the receipt printer inside the ATM. Due to a paper jam or some mechanical blockage, the printer was not able to print the slip even though it was receiving data. As an engineer, working with such sensitive hardware requires perfect attention and skill. I carefully opened the printer module. Then I cleaned the paper roll stuck inside, checked the printer sensors and set up the entire printing unit properly again. A slight carelessness could have damaged the internal gears or sensors, so the work had to be done very carefully and efficiently. After repairing the printer, the entire ATM system was initialized again. To ensure that the work was done perfectly, I myself performed a test transaction (Last Transaction). While the machine was processing, the screen displayed the message Your Transaction is being Processed Please wait... as usual and within a few seconds a receipt for a cash dispense count was successfully printed. I took the receipt in my hand and saw that all the counting data of the note dispense and rejected amount of Cassette-1 and Cassette-2 dated 10/05/26 were printed perfectly. ![IMG20260510185655.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQma96TAcJiehgSLuC3AB89u6KJwo6YLCMjtxwuRbkAobp5/IMG20260510185655.jpg) The professional satisfaction of that moment when the machine becomes fully operational again after solving a complex technical problem with my own hands is truly different. Being able to reduce the suffering of customers and make a busy ATM booth operational again is the greatest value of my work as an engineer. Don't forget to share your feedback in the comments! This was my arrangement for today. I hope you liked the pictures I took and the nature observations. Wishing everyone good health, I bid you farewell here today. |

title.title: A Walk Through the Sindoni Tower: Beautiful Moments of Reflection  (Esp/Eng)
title.body: > [Esp] ¡Saludos amados, espero se encuentren de buena salud! Para nadie es secreto que mientras hago mis largas caminatas son mis momentos grandiosos en los que me organizo internamente, en los que me trazo planes, reflexiono sobre cómo están sucediendo las cosas, busco respuestas y si no las encuentro suelto las interrogantes por el camino para que no me estanquen. Queridos, la humildad nos hace grandes, la humildad nos abre puertas, ser humildes con lo que tenemos o tuvimos ante los demás nos ayuda a ser realmente auténticos, agradecidos y estar con verdadera paz, porque de hipocresías esta lleno el mundo. Ser humildes no es es dejar que los demás nos falten el respeto o nos traten como si no tuviéramos valor en el mundo personas que se creen superiores por cosas vacías y superfluas. Mucho me ha sucedido, que por mi condición humilde de personalidad, muchas personas que viven de apariencia buscan minimizarme y eso solo habla de la pobreza espiritual que tienen. En mi largo camino de aprendizajes comprendí que no es mi problema realmente, yo no soy el problema, el problema es de la persona que te agrede o minimiza, tiene que trabajar mucho.

> [Eng] Greetings, my dears, I hope you are all in good health! It’s no secret that my long walks are my favourite moments—times when I get my thoughts in order, make plans, reflect on how things are going, seek answers, and if I don’t find them, I let the questions go along the way so they don’t hold me back. My dears, humility makes us great; humility opens doors for us. Being humble about what we have or had in the eyes of others helps us to be truly authentic, grateful and at peace, because the world is full of hypocrisy. Being humble does not mean letting others disrespect us or treat us as if we had no value in the world—people who believe themselves superior because of empty and superfluous things. It has often happened to me that, because of my humble nature, many people who live for appearances seek to belittle me, and that only speaks to their spiritual poverty. On my long journey of learning, I have come to understand that it is not really my problem; I am not the problem. The problem lies with the person who attacks or belittles you; they have a lot of work to do. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EoptKcSpuHX9Nd9fZbkXiFR6TUY6rg1i8dWxtwvmusuSYCqEMWayJAeCVYEtb3PCWSV.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpNnyKQRWNUrvgUvy8pVqNJAVBe7YgpyyXN5MfkNQuKyQwnjHqRE2XX7Y9hxTjcUEfX.png)

>

[Esp]

He aprendido durante mi recorrido por la vida, que tu pasado no te define, lo que viviste, superaste, perdiste o soltaste, si no ejerces todo lo que estudiaste no puedes decir que eres profesional (es mi percepción) porque tener un título solo por tenerlo no tiene sentido. Si bien con tantos títulos académicos que puedo tener, al no ejercer los principales, no puedo decir que soy administrador en contaduría y finanzas, aunque si ejerzo algunos otros ligados a la informática, aprendí que todo es pasado, lo que tuve que pudo ser mucho, ese pasado no me necesita y el no poder ejercer mis carreras no debe frustrarme más,bien reza el dicho \

He cambiado de formas de presentarme en público, porque actualmente solo soy creadora de contenido, astróloga y tarotista, es innecesario que nombre mis demás títulos académicos, es innecesario contar si quiera todo lo que pasó por mis manos, eso aprendí. Aunque a veces hay personas que por lo humilde de mi vestir y mi hablar poco técnico tienden a decir cosas que siento pena por ellos. Tu pasado no te define, lo que eres hoy, es lo que importa... Generalmente cuando hablo con personas que necesitan un guía espiritual, cuento mi vivencia, pero solo desde la forma de motivarlos a mejorar como personas y tener esperanza.

> [Eng] I have learnt throughout my life that your past does not define you—what you experienced, overcame, lost or let go of. If you do not put into practice everything you studied, you cannot call yourself a professional (in my view), because having a degree just for the sake of having it makes no sense. Although I may hold many academic qualifications, as I do not practise the main ones, I cannot claim to be an accountant or financial administrator; yet, whilst I do practise others related to IT, I have learnt that everything is in the past. What I had could have been so much, but that past does not need me, and not being able to practise my chosen careers should no longer frustrate me. As the saying goes, ‘my past does not need me, my present and future do’ I have changed the way I present myself in public, because currently I am only a content creator, astrologer and tarot reader; it is unnecessary for me to mention my other academic qualifications, it is unnecessary to even recount everything that has passed through my hands – that is what I have learnt. Although sometimes there are people who, because of my humble dress and my non-technical way of speaking, tend to say things that make me feel sorry for them. Your past does not define you; what you are today is what matters... Generally, when I speak to people who need spiritual guidance, I share my experiences, but only to motivate them to improve as people and to have hope.
---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/23xL11BNfcRMpk7cboEgJLDuVHVXvY4BqHPrpy6Letj7QaSrJCUGaGoxKwVJieoyDyTmS.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/Epzxd5Ksr9CTqkrvDCxEntH83fUVUeZ1bN7hkvrnjxFPNSQ9CrqQhkDki8HTew5dtwX.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpQwHMp3WJQedpAqEeLxmRFFdvv7s1EQnhLkfWXXqsTByy1yChM2PMgtXhwYF4gaMqF.png) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-05-22 at 5.12.08 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/EpGT3ySX3835WJV1piBzkJEeg3QyGrBJdrVXFpbxkPNmxq27oBCkAjLxqCYE16ZDdbW.jpeg)

> [Esp] En los últimos talleres de holística que tuve recientemente (Gestión emocional y mental) aprendí que hay mucha gente herida en el mundo, hay mucha gente triste en el mundo, mucha gente sintiéndose sola, mucha gente necesitada, asi como hay mucha gente deprimida en el mundo, hay mucha gente resentida y otras llenas de envidia, que si no canalizan bien esas energías irán a desquitarse con alguien inocente, a todos nos ha pasado esto: ser el parabrisas y otros el insecto. Es mejor dedicarse a sanar, soltar lo que nos produce estrés y ansiedad, identificar lo que nos atrasa y encontrar el equilibrio. No juzguemos, continuemos, solo la persona sabe la carga que lleva, en algún momento la suelta, a veces cargamos con cosas que ya no vibran con nuestra energía o que ni siquiera son nuestras. Ahora vibro desde la gratitud, la gratitud nos abre muchas puertas y nos da serenidad. Es importante vivir sin máscaras, sin juzgar a la gente, sin etiquetar a la gente, pues solo debes ocuparte de ti mismo y ya eso es un desgaste de energía suficiente, tampoco podemos echar lo que es nuestra responsabilidad en los demás. Ahora siempre escribo a mis seguidores: tres cosas que no debes negociar por nada en este mundo: Tu paz mental, tu paz emocional y tu bienestar físico. Ser empático para mí es tener conocimiento de las razones por la que una persona puede tener ciertas conductas, comprender su dolor y sus traumas, es respetar, pero por ninguna razón es dejar que esas conductas nos afecten. Sino imagínense los psiquiatras y psicólogos lo afectados que estuvieran por cada paciente que llega a su consultorio, estas personas (los profesionales) se han forjado con hierro, no solo con sus estudios que les otorgan el conocimiento, sino porque aprenden a canalizar la energía.

> [Eng] In the holistic workshops I attended recently (Emotional and Mental Management), I learnt that there are many wounded people in the world, many sad people, many feeling lonely, many in need, just as there are many depressed people in the world; there are many resentful people and others full of envy, who, if they do not channel those energies properly, will take it out on someone innocent; we have all been in this situation: being the windscreen and others the insect. It is better to focus on healing, letting go of what causes us stress and anxiety, identifying what is holding us back, and finding balance. Let us not judge; let us move on. Only the person themselves knows the burden they carry; at some point they let it go. Sometimes we carry things that no longer resonate with our energy or that are not even ours. Now I vibrate from a place of gratitude; gratitude opens many doors for us and gives us serenity. It is important to live without masks, without judging people, without labelling people, for you should only concern yourself with yourself, and that alone is enough of an energy drain; nor can we shift what is our responsibility onto others. Now I always write to my followers: three things you must never compromise on for anything in this world: your peace of mind, your emotional peace and your physical well-being. For me, being empathetic means being aware of the reasons why a person might behave in certain ways, understanding their pain and their traumas; it is about respect, but under no circumstances does it mean letting those behaviours affect us. Just imagine how affected psychiatrists and psychologists would be by every patient who comes into their consulting room; these professionals have forged themselves with iron, not only through their studies which give them knowledge, but because they learn to channel their energy. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/equipodelta/244ocpLNRZzSveX1FJw3sCCytyf77zQaDL4sgAea8csi8V3eq4pcPqhcBcvFk7YSBaukq.png)

> [Esp] Y así, mientras visitaba las instalaciones de la grandiosa Torre Sindoni de Maracay no solo disfruté del lugar y lo que me ofrecía, de su buena energía, pues es un icono de mi pueblo, el punto de referencia, la brújula que me ayuda a encontrarme cuando me pierdo por esas calles me me meto al azar, disfruté del encuentro conmigo misma, del repaso por mis clases y viendo la forma que puedo aplicarlas en mi vida para seguir mejorando y creciendo, para al fin poder ser un eslabón más de una cadena de ayuda a crecer como persona. Quién iba a pensar que esta torre construida por Filippo Sindoni en 1999 dejaría un gran legado y sería parte de lo que nos identifica como estado. Filippo quien falleció trágicamente en el año 2006 en un hecho que conmocionó a todos los aragüeños, quizá no imaginó lo que su torre de 125 metros de altura y 32 pisos, significaría tanto para muchas personas y para mí desde el punto de vista energético y espiritual pues su forma de prima rectangular estilizada y su impoluto color ladrillo lo convierte en un poderoso rascacielos de energía positiva, para mí, es una joya, es un inmenso cristal de cuarzo lluvia de oro, que me conecta con la abundancia, con el autoestima, que me ayuda a disipar pensamientos negativos, que me conecta con la madre tierra y recibir la energía de la sanación, que me proporciona seguridad y confianza, que además a muchos nos inspira como hoy, me inspiró a crear estas reflexiones y esta publicación. Espero las palabras lleguen a quien lo necesita y sean aceptadas sin tergiversar su intención, solo desde el poderoso camino de la superación personal. ### Mente sana, cuerpo sano, corazón sano

> [Eng] And so, whilst visiting the magnificent Torre Sindoni in Maracay, I not only enjoyed the place and all it had to offer, its positive energy, as it is an icon of my town, the landmark, the compass that helps me find my way when I get lost in those streets I wander into at random, but I also enjoyed the encounter with myself, reviewing my lessons and seeing how I can apply them in my life to keep improving and growing, so that I can finally become another link in a chain that helps others grow as people. Who would have thought that this tower, built by Filippo Sindoni in 1999, would leave such a great legacy and become part of what defines us as a state?Filippo, who died tragically in 2006 in an incident that shocked everyone in Aragua, perhaps never imagined what his 125-metre-high, 32-storey tower would mean to so many people and to me from an energetic and spiritual point of view, as its stylised rectangular shape and pristine brick colour make it a powerful skyscraper of positive energy; for me, it is a jewel, an immense golden rain quartz crystal (goldstone), which connects me to abundance and self-esteem, which helps me dispel negative thoughts, which connects me to Mother Earth and allows me to receive healing energy, which provides me with security and confidence, and which, moreover, inspires many of us, just as today it inspired me to create these reflections and this post. I hope these words reach those who need them and are received without distorting their intention, but solely through the powerful path of self-improvement. ### Healthy mind, healthy body, healthy heart

title.title: Những khó khăn trên hành trình xây dựng thương hiệu nội thất
title.body:
Xây dựng một thương hiệu nội thất chưa bao giờ là hành trình dễ dàng. Đằng sau những công trình hoàn thiện chỉn chu là rất nhiều áp lực, thử thách và cả những bài học được tích lũy qua từng giai đoạn phát triển.

Đối với một ⏩⏩ [công ty tư vấn thiết kế nội thất](https://noithatthuanbinh.vn/), khó khăn không chỉ đến từ sự cạnh tranh của thị trường mà còn nằm ở việc làm sao để giữ vững chất lượng và tạo được niềm tin với khách hàng. Mỗi dự án đều có những yêu cầu riêng về thẩm mỹ, công năng, ngân sách và tiến độ. Vì vậy, đội ngũ cần liên tục cập nhật xu hướng, nâng cao chuyên môn và tìm ra giải pháp phù hợp cho từng không gian khác nhau.



![thiet-ke-noi-that-phong-ngu-doc-dao.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/3554fcf288d6bcdfe9c061534b9a345682f1ac5fd588eeeea986d91ce21fac79)

Bên cạnh đó, áp lực trong việc đảm bảo chất lượng thi công cũng là một thách thức lớn. Từ vật liệu, kỹ thuật hoàn thiện đến sự phối hợp giữa các bộ phận, mọi công đoạn đều cần được kiểm soát chặt chẽ để mang đến kết quả tốt nhất. Chỉ cần một chi tiết nhỏ thiếu chỉn chu cũng có thể ảnh hưởng đến trải nghiệm và sự hài lòng của khách hàng.

Tuy nhiên, chính những khó khăn ấy lại trở thành động lực để thương hiệu ngày càng hoàn thiện hơn. Mỗi thử thách là một cơ hội để học hỏi, cải thiện quy trình và khẳng định giá trị bằng sự nghiêm túc trong nghề.

Hành trình xây dựng thương hiệu nội thất không chỉ là câu chuyện phát triển doanh nghiệp, mà còn là hành trình tạo dựng niềm tin bằng chất lượng và sự tận tâm trong từng công trình.

---

There is a kind of mystery in the name of this card that also fits its gameplay. Many times it is seen that this card is able to change the pace of the match through strategy rather than direct power. This card can be very effective for those who like to play the game according to a plan and with patience. One of the good aspects of this card is its consistent magic damage and ability to adapt to the team. Magic attacks can usually ignore the opponent's armor and directly hit health, which is why it becomes very effective in many situations. It can also continue to attack for a long time from a safe position, which helps the team to gradually advance. Many times this card plays an important role in the last moments of the match and puts pressure on the opponent. However, it also has some limitations. Its health and defense are not very strong, due to which it can have problems against fast attackers or sniper type units. In addition, to fully implement it, it is necessary to have a strong tank in front. If there is no proper support, this card can quickly become a target for the opponent. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmf5XcecqaC47n3xjUuufZa2rYGbuNeqeissYS6ohTQDwg/image.png) This is a strategic and effective magic card that can make a big difference in your gameplay if used correctly. It is especially suitable for those who are patient and like to play matches according to plan. With the right team combination and strategy, this card can greatly increase your chances of winning. I hope my review will be helpful to you and you will be able to perform better using this card.

title.title: Muy buenos días, buenas tardes, buenas noches, esta soy yo 😊.
title.body:
«De Campechuela para el mundo: mis raíces, mis pasiones y mis 16 primaveras»

Hola, soy una adolescente cubana de 16 años, nacida y criada en el hermoso municipio de Campechuela, en la provincia de Granma. Una tierra de gente humilde, de calor caribeño y de amaneceres que huelen a mar y a caña. Pero antes de contarte quién soy hoy, déjame llevarte de la mano por los caminos de mi infancia, porque todo lo que soy se forjó en esos primeros años.

Crecí en un hogar lleno de risas y canciones, bajo el amor infinito de mis padres: Mirelis y Eliécer. Ellos me enseñaron que la vida se baila, se escribe y se canta, aunque a veces duela. Mi mamá, con su ternura, y mi papá, con su fuerza callada, construyeron un nido donde mis hermanos y yo aprendimos a soñar. Hablo de Lisbety, mi hermana cómplice, la que siempre me presta un hombro y un consejo. Y del menor, Leyser, ese travieso de ojos brillantes que con solo una travesura nos roba las preocupaciones. Con ellos aprendí el valor de compartir el pan, el juego y los secretos al atardecer.

Mis recuerdos más bellos tienen sabor a mango biche con sal, a correr descalza por los patios, a las tardes de lluvia en que mi abuela sacaba el viejo tocadiscos. Y fue en una de esas tardes que descubrí mi primer amor: el baile. No importa si es son, salsa o reguetón; mi cuerpo se enciende cuando la música empieza. Es como si los pies recordaran algo que la mente olvida. Pero el baile no es lo único que me mueve; también lo hace la palabra escrita. Escribo versos libres, cuentos cortos, cartas que nunca envío. Escribo para entenderme, para dejarle al mundo un pedacito de mi alma de adolescente.

Sin embargo, si hay una pasión que me define, esa es cantar. Canto en la ducha, en el cuarto a oscuras, en el balcón cuando nadie escucha. Canto boleros que me enseñó mi mamá, canciones de amor propio que invento sobre la marcha. Para mí, cantar es respirar dos veces: una para vivir y otra para sentir. Es mi refugio y mi grito de libertad. Sueño con subirme a un escenario algún día, no para que me aplaudan, sino para que mi voz abrace a quien la necesite.

Y aunque parezca que solo vivo de arte, también me encanta estudiar. El colegio es mi segundo hogar. Me fascina aprender historia, biología, literatura… Cada libro nuevo es un amigo, cada problema de matemáticas un acertijo que quiero resolver. A mis 16 años, sé que la educación es la llave para salir al mundo sin perderme a mí misma.

Así que ya sabes: soy una campechuelense de pies a cabeza, con la música en la sangre, un cuaderno en la mochila y una familia que es mi faro. Voy bailando entre los recuerdos de mi infancia, escribiendo mi presente y cantándole al futuro. Porque aquí, en este pedacito de Cuba, una chica de 16 años está lista para brillar. ¿Me acompañas? 🎶📖✨

title.title: 碰到新租客
title.body:
在一面墙铺满的美丽的蔷薇花上面，竟然还有一棵高高的槐花树，下面有好几个小美女在给槐树拍照， 惹的我也情不自禁的拿起手机拍了两站，还真是惊艳！
![槐树.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbooUKoZ5iwpbe6woVaHbirEYJGF7wfiVpkuUcMQbFcHp/%E6%A7%90%E6%A0%91.jpg)

![槐花.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmauDYhPeAN1dWwhucdQ3sdWtYP44PSNuEY82a5LoEeYH8/%E6%A7%90%E8%8A%B1.jpg)

前天晚上将近10点钟了，接到一个电话，是一个女人的电话，问我是否有个房子要出租，还租吗？是的，我确实之前的老房子一直空置着，还没有合适的租房客。 

上一个租房的人退房之后，已经将近一年了，还没有租出去，原因很简单，经济不好，打工的人也很少留这里了，房价下调，老房子即使房租很便宜也还是没有人问询。 

我的正规的两室一小厅的房子，面积有70平，因为楼层有些高，又没有电梯，装修也是上世纪90年代的，因此价格上也已经到了最优惠的地步。 

女人跟我聊了几句，问了大致的情况，我们约好第二天的下午见面，看看房子情况。 第二天，女人骑着一个电动小摩托车来了，原来她就是在附近的一个药店工作。 

房子她看了一下，感觉很满意。 然后就开始谈价格，又将自己的处境和现状跟我说了一下，让我在原来的基础上在便宜点儿。 其实这个房子的价格现在已经是很低了，因为我跟同类的房子在线价格比对过，最后说1200元每个月，如果同意就跟我签订合同😭 

女人说她带着孩子， 夫妻两人闹矛盾，现在处于冷静期，孩子上初中，自己虽然有工作，但是经济不好，现在工资也不如以前高了，暂时还拿不出那么多的钱。

我看她说的诚恳，觉得一个女人带着孩子也确实不容易，房子能租就还是租吧，即使价格确实有些低了，但是也比空着强吧，于是也就答应了，再次约好再找个时间将这个事儿定下来。 

今天准备到老房子那，再收拾一下，如果她确实想租的话，就敲定下来。哎，现在的房屋市场也确实不怎么好。 我将钥匙放在一个中介那，中介的人说，这样的房子碰到合适的就赶紧租吧，因为确实很难租，老房子卖没人买，租也无人问津！

我不知道房地产市场咋一下就这样了呢？19年当时买房还很高，如今一下就降了这么多，几乎是拦腰下跌了一半，地脚好的还好些， 碰到边远的跌的就更狠了！

哎， 总是有人欢喜有人忧，如今想买房子的或者是租房子的应该高兴了，毕竟要比原来省下好多的钱，但是租房的或者买房的人依然觉得还是很贵，这到底是怎么了呢？

希望这次碰到的房租客能一切顺利吧！

title.title: Bitcoin Pizza Day 2026
title.body:
![646FD812-4305-4F72-9FD3-F777DB56D864\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23ydA5i2uF93pG841JeceSyLfoCvnpU59EJxeunUGgmg2hcdkUycs9qG2x3LBH4hr9Sf1.jpeg)

May 22 was Bitcoin Pizza Day. What kind of pizza did you eat this year?

At our home, it has become a yearly tradition to bake pizza and eat it while watching a movie. This year, I also made a Bitcoin cookie cutter and used it to cut cheese for the topping 😊 The pizza itself was a classic combination of tomato sauce, summer vegetables, mushrooms, and cheese.

![E5DAD61B-A887-41FC-96F7-E78CC6F26E21\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23vsX3PxhAoC8STQtzfDtMwAh2ZzkRoxTnnNB1P9VVPZ36tkn8R5X4TJqDLAKVtnwDjQg.jpeg)

It has been more than a month since I got my 3D printer, and especially recently, I’ve become much more comfortable making 3D data myself. The cookie cutter was also something I could make pretty quickly, with only a few small mistakes along the way.

![952DD7E9-F42D-423A-A587-351774D180CF\_1\_201\_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23wqpjfL66Fku1R95ofm2F1jUFbiodBftwkW4ipetxyCT7uqr7qpx3hLSWwiDhG2kekLu.jpeg)

The crypto world seems rather quiet lately, but maybe that’s exactly why fun community traditions like Pizza Day are important — just enjoying good food and spending time together.

Have a wonderful weekend everyone!

This weekend, I’ll be enjoying the big annual gothic festival held here in my city 🖤

<center>🍊 🍊 🍊</center>
![646FD812-4305-4F72-9FD3-F777DB56D864_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23ydA5i2uF93pG841JeceSyLfoCvnpU59EJxeunUGgmg2hcdkUycs9qG2x3LBH4hr9Sf1.jpeg)

5月22日はビットコインピザデー。みなさんは今年のピザデーにどんなピザを食べましたか？我が家は毎年恒例、自宅でピザ焼いて、今年は自作のビットコインクッキーカッターでチーズを切ってのせて食べました。ピザ自体はトマトソースに夏野菜とマッシュルーム、チーズの定番のピザです。

![E5DAD61B-A887-41FC-96F7-E78CC6F26E21_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23vsX3PxhAoC8STQtzfDtMwAh2ZzkRoxTnnNB1P9VVPZ36tkn8R5X4TJqDLAKVtnwDjQg.jpeg)

3Dプリンタが来て一ヶ月以上が経って、特にここ最近ではデータ作りにも慣れてきて、クッキーカッターもちょっとの失敗はありつつパパッと作れました。

![952DD7E9-F42D-423A-A587-351774D180CF_1_201_a.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/akipponn/23wqpjfL66Fku1R95ofm2F1jUFbiodBftwkW4ipetxyCT7uqr7qpx3hLSWwiDhG2kekLu.jpeg)

クリプト界隈は静かなようですが、そんなときこそピザデーみたいなみんなでわいわい楽しんで過ごすのがよいのかもしれません。

それではみなさん素敵な週末を！私は今週末は我が街で開催されている年に一度の大きなゴシックフェスティバルを楽しんできます🖤

title.title: 【大阪】🇯🇵 一兰拉面 Ichiran Ramen
title.body:
想当年，我去台湾旅游的时候就已经听说过鼎鼎大名的「一兰拉面」了，连马来西亚在两年前也有商家摆过仿「一兰拉面」的快闪店 (pop-up store)，当时没机会去吃，现在来到日本终于有机会吃到了。 ---
**大阪五天四夜之旅
18/5/2026 - 22/5/2026
第一天**
--- 我们光顾的「一兰拉面」是位于道顿堀的那间。 🗺️ Google Map 🔍 📍 [ICHIRAN Dotonbori - South Building (一蘭 道頓堀店別館)](https://maps.app.goo.gl/md4QZY7djQ5F3ZfTA) ![Ichiran Ramen](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48JAHehkC2QtJPUWo4Uzu22EuHoqH3KNc2K9Xv6RZcS7aE49fNrq8tjq37iT3jmiMn.jpeg) 来到大阪第一天的晚餐，原本是打算吃“蛋包饭”的，可是去的那间店没位置了，排队的人还挺多，后面就改去吃「一兰拉面」了。我万万没想到的是，我在拉面店门口没看到什么人，走进去才知道里面也在排队！来都来了，排着等吧…… 所幸的是人流很快，店员分工明确，会问你想要在单人座位台座(有隔板)用餐还是桌子(容纳多人)用餐？我和米特两个人想坐一起，就选了“桌子”。 | ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23vhuRaB5EUn59XAjkHsoho5bBGUMfta18ruZ7jmdtEF4TKejr8xEGcG9tQz8SMdwRtyv.jpeg) | ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23wC9VNP4AVWcEcfmcfuR6EGBkqTwDpLq2ub4DYUCWQatRMKa9kEiRs4ZXWPiiUUJqdxm.jpeg) | |-|-| 我们在这种点餐机上点餐和付款，之后就等电梯上二楼。 一楼这里是那种单人座有隔板，前面是帘子，面上桌的时候帘子被卷上去，店员把面拿给你的那种。 ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/EpQxhvn4VkNxNAopBpS9DWdYk4kmZDsCUkgfvsQRnRtkMhLrHcxX6sbxPTP8x7cZsqa.jpeg) 二楼是这种可容纳多人的桌位…… | ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23w2qBckNusSFCc2yAKkRE3p85NUNcDcjo5CvK1LJNrNvedBmmXBXS4t7mZiBZtsuP9t6.jpeg) | ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/23wqq7JaQrnriBnjQ6TeBidWVd41zTxvM6eKpqTKZMHA81WEyTjps1Th5tEgs2Y5uTpHQ.jpeg) | |-|-| 在二楼的，你要把上面这两种单拿去给下图的柜台…… ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lovelemon/48VFSPVwamHf3uhumYeyTcGgzWnec7sX7DqckMn7k1e8S9FXrZviwDkk5jaHe6kcpm.jpeg) 这让我感觉像是完全自助式，自己拿单去“受付口”，然后食物好了就去“提供口”拿餐，吃完后拿回去“返却口”放置。 title.body: > ## Hello, everyone. I welcome you to my blog. The major reason a lot of people rushed to join the crypto space is to make some money for themselves; for some, the crypto space is just for them to make some extra money, while for some, it is their only source of income, and the Hive space turns out to be one of those spaces people rush to join because they heard it was paying, but lately things have not been as good as they used to be. The price of Hive dropped so badly to the point that so many people, both old and new members, felt discouraged, and so they could not bear it anymore, and they had to leave. ![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmVxJ5ZBxMXhH4TzL4vTEiFM2h41GYW21qaVPDT94Y9ksj/1779508443935.png) *Image was generated using chrome* The price of Hive affected the reward system so badly, and I can tell you for free that those who are still here are really consistent, and the price of Hive is not what determines their level of consistency and loyalty to the platform, and they have proven that they did come for the crypto but stayed for the community because when we all leave when times are bad, who will ensure that the platform bounces back? Once the price of Hive and other crypto coins is back up, you will see a lot of people returning and making their way back to come enjoy what the platform has to offer. I have experienced Hive at $1 before and I think a bit above a dollar before, but I just started my Hive journey then, so I was not a part of the bull run; I just saw it play out before my eyes but was not a partaker, and indeed it was a season of reward for those who were holders. My first reaction when Hive reaches one dollar again is not to sell it off first; we all know that crypto is volatile; it can do more, and at the same time it can go lower. I think my first reaction will be excitement and gladness that finally Hive users are about to experience good times again. No doubt that I will sell some holdings to reward and compensate myself for staying through the downs and now the ups; a little reward won't hurt. Instead, I would be glad that I stayed. My first reaction won't be to sell it off even though I know I will hear those voices advising me to do so, but I am not giving in; I need to see if it can go higher than that. title.body:

![oCumg6LFqP0onMaM_IMG_20260521_073612.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/oCumg6LFqP0onMaM_IMG_20260521_073612/oCumg6LFqP0onMaM_IMG_20260521_073612.webp)
![b9KSV1ebSVczXQyF_IMG_20260521_073649.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/b9KSV1ebSVczXQyF_IMG_20260521_073649/b9KSV1ebSVczXQyF_IMG_20260521_073649.webp)
![eCu521O5jHdVO2xN_IMG_20260521_073529.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/snowli/images/eCu521O5jHdVO2xN_IMG_20260521_073529/eCu521O5jHdVO2xN_IMG_20260521_073529.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

5月20日，号称是情人节，我本来想给帅哥买束花，后来转念一想，他好像对这种东西也不感冒。后来我又转成买一束回家。我就去美团上面看，发现也不贵，贵在运费，19元，本来想让我爸去拿，但是搜了一下路程，来回20公里，我直接就放弃了，这钱还是让骑手赚吧。

挑好了花，就该选祝福语了，一开始我选了一条给母亲的祝福语，后来想想，只给我老妈不给我老爸，怎么行，后来又选了一条给父母的。祝福语搞定了之后就付款了。因为在村里无法精准填写地址，骑手到了附近之后，找不到路，我就加了他微信视频通话给他指路。

这个骑手还是专业的，我一边说他一边骑，接收指令无误，很快就到家门口了。但是我不确定谁在家，就给我爸打电话，结果他不接。骑手通过微信告诉我，有个老人，要不要叫他签收。我说什么老人，叫他拍照给我，我说那是我爸。然后他反问我：不能让他知道吗？我说给他，那是给他们买的哈哈哈。

这个骑手真的是太有故事了。

后来我爸拿到花，就问我要不要拆开包装，也是太可爱了。我说等我妈回来让她看看先再处理。然后我老妈回来之后，就说下次不用买这种不实用的东西，还说我爸晒稻谷下雨了没及时收，淋湿了，她很烦。我安慰了一下她，叫她不要想太多。隔天我爸就给我发了花的图片，放在一个我没见过的桶里，原来是装花的那个座桶。我爸还问我要不要施肥，太逗了。。。。。。

看来我还是花送少了。。。。。。
