links.title: Sasha's Story, In Search of Meaning
links.body:
Good evening, dear friends of Buskeria, I hope you had a great day today. To wrap things up, I'm going to share the story I've written for you. Nothing better than reading a little before bed, right? Haha. I wrote it about Sasha, a singer who becomes very famous, but along the way she forgets something. I hope you enjoy it, let's begin.

> Buenas noches estimados amigos de Buskeria, espero que hayan tenido un gran día hoy. Para cerrar este día les voy a compartir la historia que he escrito para ustedes, nada mejor que leer un poco antes de dormir verdad. Jaja. La escribí sobre Sasha, ella es una cantante que llega a ser muy famosa, pero que por el camino se olvida de algo. Espero que les guste, arrancamos.

<div class=\

> ![1779371443182.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23zknQxw92HuevEz1YycQ1DaDFWJw7nG3hP3QTKkiL12116mdR3oxkKu7K54eJx4F1t17.jpg) Image created by me in canva How exciting! Everyone had finally prepared and studied music. It had been five amazing years, full of knowledge that they could now finally put to use and conquer the world that awaited them. Sasha had made many friends while learning, most of them classmates. The atmosphere was wonderful; everyone was excited to become musicians and singers, and they shared the same goals. Having become such good friends, they promised to never forget each other and to stay in touch. They created a WhatsApp group to share their achievements and motivate the others to do the same and never give up. The dynamic they had was fantastic. Before they could even process it, Sasha had gone way ahead. This was because the others were focused on creating their own projects, bands, and buying their instruments. She did something different: she landed a collaboration with a very famous singer from Buskeria. Perhaps it was just luck that she was chosen. But no, it was more about what the singer wanted. She wanted a talented collaborator who wouldn't steal the show. And Sasha was perfect for the role. Thanks to that collaboration on a music video, she achieved overnight fame—and huge fame at that, not just emerging talent. > Que emoción ya todos por fin se habían preparado y estudiado música, habían sido 5 años grandiosos llenos de conocimiento que ahora por fin podían explotar y con el comerse el mundo que los estaba esperando. Sasha había hecho muchos amigos mientras aprendía, la mayoría eran compañeros de clase. Era muy bonito el aire que se respiraba ahora, todos estaban emocionados por hacerse músicos y cantantes, tenían los mismos objetivos. Como se habían hecho buenos amigos se prometieron nunca olvidarse y mantenerse en contacto. Crearon un grupo de whatsapp para ir contando los logro que iba consiguiendo cada uno y de esa forma motivar al resto a hacer lo mismo y nunca rendirse, era genial la dinámica que tenían. > Antes de que todos siquiera pudieran procesarlo Sasha se les adelantó mucho. Y eso fue porque los demás estaban concentrados en crear sus proyectos, bandas, comprar sus instrumentos. Ella hizo algo distinto consiguió una colaboración con una cantante muy famosa de Buskeria. Tal vez fue cosa de la suerte que fuera elegida. Pero no, fue cosa más de lo que quería la cantante. Quería como acompañante a alguien con talento pero que no se llevara el protagonismo de la canción. Y Sasha era perfecta para el papel. Gracias a esa colaboración en un video musical consiguió la fama de un día para otro, y una gran fama, nada de ser emergente.

> ![pexels-starter-cam-2850860-4387718.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23t76t9qgzFV3CGAvSfWcrqp5aFUpY8CQWaSrVWxmZs9WRq15LbgfdpzHfkSqvEoQy36R.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) The others couldn't believe it, but they were genuinely happy for her. They were good friends, and what could be better than being happy when your friend is successful, even if it happens before you? Sasha would tell the group how amazing it was to be famous and all the opportunities it opened up. She motivated them to do the same. Far from weakening, their friendship grew stronger during that time. As Sasha's career rapidly took off, she collaborated with more successful artists, which amplified her own personal success. She truly broke through when she released her first albums. With that, her fame skyrocketed; she became a beloved star, listened to by everyone. It was at this point that her friendship with her original friends began to weaken and fade, but not through any fault of their own. She paid them less and less attention. She no longer joined the group chat to congratulate others on their achievements; she only did so to boast about how well she was doing and how far behind they were. At one point, she even called some of them losers for not having grown as quickly as she had. Fame began to corrupt her without her realizing it. The others tried to warn her about what would happen if she didn't change her attitude. But she took offense and left the group. > Los demás no podían creerlo pero estaban realmente contentos por ella, eran buenos amigos, y que mejor que estar feliz porque tu amigo sea exitoso aunque sea primero que tu. Sasha les contaba en el grupo lo increíble que era ser famoso, y todas las oportunidades que tenia. Los motivaba a hacer lo mismo. La amistad lejos de debilitarse se fortaleció en ese momento. Mientras Sasha iba subiendo rápidamente, hizo más colaboraciones con más gente exitosa, lo cual multiplicó su propio éxito personal. Acabó de romperla cuando lanzó sus primeros disco. Y ya con eso si su fama se fue por cielos, era una estrella muy querida y escuchada por todos. > Fue aquí donde la amistad de ella con sus amigos originales se fue debilitando y perdiendo, pero no por culpa de ellos, de ella misma. Cada vez les prestaba menos atención, ya no entraba al grupo para felicitar a otros por lo que conseguían, lo hacia solo para decir lo bien que le iba a ella, y lo atrás que estaban ellos. En algún momento llegó a llamar a algunos perdedores por no haber crecido tan rápido como ella. La fama comenzó a corromperla sin darse cuenta. Los demás intentaron advertirla de lo que le pasaría si no cambiaba esa actitud. Pero ella se ofendió y se fue del grupo.

> ![pexels-diego-fioravanti-1869704070-31849162.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23wCUczzM9HdLGCP2N9frncBetb2vzmurQNLiB9cFo1qCXFenDYUabaDVHL8v9nFPVndj.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) That was the beginning of her great downfall, one that would be brutal and self-inflicted. Without her friends as a guide, she allowed herself to be blinded by ambition, fame, and money. Her songs became ways of expressing why she was better than others and why everyone else was inferior in every way. In her music videos, she began appearing adorned with jewelry to project a superior status. She criticized everyone else for being less successful and repeated the same thing: they're losers. She even went so far as to say that no one could ever reach her. A grave mistake for the future that awaited them. She felt invincible because of the number of friends she had, who told her everything she wanted to hear. This began to attract negative attention from the music industry. The best musicians distanced themselves from her, considering her a negative influence. They didn't want to be tainted and have their reputations tarnished. Her disproportionate spending on music videos and jewelry led to bankruptcy, and some poor decisions in her music career triggered a downward spiral that caused her to plummet, initially. All those friends left, they never warned her about anything because they only wanted to take advantage of her by telling her what she wanted to hear. > Fue ese el comienzo de su gran caída, una que sería brutal y causada por si misma. Sin sus amigos como guía se dejó segar por la ambición, la fama y el dinero. Sus canciones pasaron a ser formas de expresar por que era mejor que otros y por que los demás eran menores en todo sentido. En sus videos musicales empezó a salir llena de joyas para aparentar un estatus superior. Criticaba a todos los demás por tener menos éxito y repetía lo mismo, son perdedores. Llegó a decir que nadie la alcanzaría. Grave error para el futuro que les esperaba. Se sentía invencible por la cantidad de amigos que tenia y le decían todo lo que quería escuchar. > Esto empezó a atraer atención negativa de la industria musical. Los mejores músicos se alejaron de ella por considerarla una influencia negativa. No querían verse contagiados y manchar su reputación. Sus gastos desproporcionados en videos musicales y joyas la llevaron a la quiebra y unas malas decisiones en la música hicieron que llegara una mala racha haciendo que callera hasta el suelo, al comienzo. Todos esos amigos se fueron, nunca le advirtieron nada porque solo querían aprovecharse de ella diciéndole lo que quería oír.

> ![pexels-mart-production-7699365.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tmDqoMPrMPAxTBCVBH7vXfTeZ7koxK4sVapDajt8bjFpDDXjW3bnxmHSqqNztKhRd7C.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) Without friends, without money, without fame, and with her reputation tarnished, she was harshly corrected by the universe that had once given her opportunities. That was the price. Now, paradoxically, she was minor compared to all those she had used to mock. But even the most wicked always get a second chance. Her former friends want their friend back, the original Sasha. To help her grow again. Sasha learned her lesson the hard way, so now she won't reject the helping hand being extended to her. She'll have much to reflect on if she doesn't want to fall again. > Sin amigos, sin dinero, sin fama y con la reputación manchada fue corregida duramente por el universo que una vez le había dado las oportunidades. Ese fue el costo. Ahora lo paradójico ella era menor en comparación con todo los que usó para burlarse de ellos. Pero siempre incluso el más malvado tiene un segunda chance. Sus antiguos amigos del grupo quieren de vuelta a su amiga, a la Sasha original. Para ayudarla a crecer de nuevo. Sasha aprendió la lección por las malas, por eso ahora no desechará la mano amiga que le están extendiendo. Tendrá mucho en lo que reflexionar si no quiere caer de nuevo.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2693).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xVMPM7QUTC27QmyzhMsRV7p1ubidfJd6xAzufeg5BtiDuNB9rYhZnkaXEFnThyE6neP.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

links.title: Making ground beef with green beans.[Esp-Eng]
links.body:
>    
<hr>
Feliz y bendecido fin de semana, un gusto compartir una vez más con ustedes, hoy les quiero compartir una fácil y nutritiva receta de carne de res molida con vainitas ideal para acompañar con el contorno de nuestra preferencia aquí les dejo el paso a paso de esta sencilla receta.

>Have a happy and blessed weekend! It’s a pleasure to share with you once again. Today I’d like to share an easy and nutritious recipe for ground beef with green beans—perfect to serve with your favorite side dish. Here’s a step-by-step guide to this simple recipe.



<hr>

![GridArt_20260522_152746148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eo6Mtate4eFDYzRDW4Kibp9UaHGVTMGFvi47wQ1evrqsCQivHJYLnebthMB1kw7FSou.jpg)



<hr>

# <center> *INGREDIENTES/INGREDIENTS* </center>

<div class = \

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EogPqh4FJW3Vab4JVoyZCuiAfpHCN3zLTV5bz42LyAcGNdgNLRSmL6h1vnqB2uy4G3W.jpg - 350 de carne molida - 150 gramos de vainitas - 1 cebolla - 3 ajíes dulces - 4 dientes de ajo - 1 tomate - 2 cucharadas de pasta de tomate - Orégano - 1 cucharada de maicena - Sal y pimienta al gusto - Aceite de oliva >- 350 grams ground beef >- 150 grams green beans >- 1 onion >- 3 sweet peppers >- 4 cloves garlic >- 1 tomato >- 2 tablespoons tomato paste >- Oregano >- 1 tablespoon cornstarch >- Salt and pepper to taste >- Olive oil
#
*PREPARACIÓN/PREPARATION*
Lo primero que haremos es lavar bien los vegetales que vamos a usar picamos finamente con la ayuda de un procesador de alimentos el tomate, cebolla y ajíes, picamos finamente el ajo y cortamos las vainitas diagonal y la cocinamos al vapor hasta que esté al dente, si lo prefieren la pueden sancochar o saltear. >First, wash the vegetables thoroughly. Using a food processor, finely chop the tomato, onion, and bell peppers. Finely chop the garlic, and cut the green beans diagonally. Steam them until al dente; if you prefer, you can blanch or sauté them instead.
![GridArt_20260522_153141761.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoiXCapURgmkNX6DnptwtyqzPSCYATG1fv9AMCFSz9rcd3HJ5UVW9SwzWXZMo8Cwz1q.jpg)
En un sartén colocamos un chorrito de aceite de oliva y agregamos el ajo removemos y agregamos la carne mezclamos y cocinamos hasta dorar, luego le agregamos el aliño removemos y sofreímos. >Heat a splash of olive oil in a skillet, add the garlic, stir, then add the meat. Mix well and cook until browned. Next, add the seasoning, stir, and sauté.
![GridArt_20260522_153827472.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eo24f7smUPFTJnweoUnrrWkzPZ2isnhp7r2rWyrd92eafWFq6gRkhqQ4ehyxnqFCQ8C.jpg)
Añadimos sal, pimienta y salsa de soya seguimos salteando y luego le agregamos las vainitas y mezclamos. >Add salt, pepper, and soy sauce; continue sautéing, then add the green beans and stir.
![GridArt_20260522_154054279.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/Eo6KRS4cPRMD8HhvBV2uiEZcWDf9g3ZsmciaTHBp1saar3wy4acPT77cY6Yy3br7ZU9.jpg)
Le agregamos la pasta de tomate, una taza de agua donde disolvemoss la maicena mezclamos cocinamos por unos minutos y por último le añadimos orégano y lo dejamos por un par de minutos más. >Add the tomato paste and a cup of water in which you’ve dissolved the cornstarch, stir, cook for a few minutes, and finally add oregano and let it simmer for a couple more minutes.
![GridArt_20260522_154405648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoEpxveTL3y333TkFYwsPbKVARvZE1QbHhzqagEj5XkM4cbaYt4o1vskWfQ3GypNAEC.jpg)
Una vez lista la carne servimos caliente acompañada con el contorno de nuestra preferencia yo combiné en esta oportunidad con pasta para disfrutar de un balanceado almuerzo. >Once the meat is ready, serve it hot with your choice of side dish. This time, I paired it with pasta to enjoy a balanced lunch.
![GridArt_20260522_152924625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/indelvalle65/EoCja9i5X2KEke2V2fvKaz5YPTxZN6aQy4jNSiZEgYRS1MmV8s2i6XZBWsx1LnkQ7ns.jpg)
Espero que esta sencilla receta que les comparto el día de hoy sea de su completo agrado hasta la próxima y muchas bendiciones. >I hope you enjoy this simple recipe I’m sharing with you today. Until next time, and many blessings.

Tienes mucha razón, amiga, y qué bueno que hayas elegido esa frase de la canción de Fito Páez.
Aquí en Cuba se está viendo la falta de sensibilidad en las personas como nunca antes en mi vida, aunque todavía hay momentos que te recuerdan lo contrario. El otro día iba caminando y dos hombres en una moto resbalaron y cayeron al suelo en una zona llena de motoristas que se dedican a hacer de “taximoto”. Enseguida todos corrieron a auxiliar a los caídos. Yo iba pasando y pensé precisamente en eso: el instinto de las personas de ayudar a sus semejantes, y qué bonito se ve realmente cuando ocurre.
Por eso entiendo lo que dices en tu post sobre la solidaridad en situaciones difíciles, como la que cuentas de una enfermedad grave, como las que se viven en Venezuela, Cuba y muchos otros lugares. A veces parece que todo se enfría, pero en momentos así siempre aparece ese lado humano que nos recuerda que no todo está perdido.

Gracias por el post.

![bPM1Qv5OUX5SmR1f_IMG_9588.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/acactus1013/images/bPM1Qv5OUX5SmR1f_IMG_9588/bPM1Qv5OUX5SmR1f_IMG_9588.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>


在这住了二十多年的老房子里，如今妈妈忽然在屋里栽种了些蔬菜，我望着眼前的一幕，心里不由得生出感慨。

这套房子，是父母当年在小城买的第一套房，记得我高一那年，每次过来，总能看见父母忙着亲手装修屋子，那时终于可以不用过住校生活，年少的我心里自然觉得很舒畅。时光匆匆流转，二十余年一晃而过，如今这老屋，也只剩妈妈偶尔前来小住。

小区里不少以前的邻居早已陆续搬走，如今我甚至连隔壁住户是怎样的人都不认识，唯有门上贴着的大红喜字，我猜大概是住着一对年轻夫妇。

今天下午我要监考，时间比较紧凑，便索性到老屋这边吃饭休息，这里离学校近，骑车的话几分钟就能到。亲身感受过骑行通勤的便捷后，我心里也生出疑惑，没结婚时一直住在这儿，当初竟从没想过骑车上班，若是早些开始骑车，能省下多少时间啊！

抵达家中，妈妈早已备好饭菜。她兴致勃勃地告诉我，住了二十多年，总算想着在阳台种上瓜果蔬菜，还兴奋拉着我前去观赏。枝头已然结出青涩的小番茄，青椒长势喜人，黄瓜也悄然绽开了花朵，唯独茄子还迟迟不见长势。

母亲本是农民出身，却少有机会再下地劳作。如今在自家阳台打理一方小菜园，于她而言也格外新奇。其实栽些蔬果并非只为收获吃的，这份藏在方寸阳台间的心意，大抵是心底割舍不下的乡土情怀吧。

---

title.title: Top Các Dòng Nệm Nhu Cầu Mát Được Ưa Chuộng Hiện Nay
title.body:
Nệm nhu cầu mát đang trở thành lựa chọn được nhiều người quan tâm, đặc biệt trong điều kiện thời tiết nóng ẩm tại Việt Nam. Một chiếc nệm có khả năng thoáng khí tốt không chỉ giúp cơ thể dễ chịu hơn khi ngủ mà còn góp phần cải thiện chất lượng giấc ngủ và sức khỏe lâu dài. Hiện nay, nhiều dòng nệm hiện đại được tích hợp công nghệ làm mát, hỗ trợ lưu thông không khí và hạn chế tích nhiệt, mang lại cảm giác thư giãn suốt đêm dài.

Các dòng nệm làm mát phổ biến trên thị trường hiện nay thường bao gồm nệm foam, nệm cao su thiên nhiên và nệm lò xo túi độc lập. Mỗi loại đều sở hữu những ưu điểm riêng nhằm đáp ứng đa dạng nhu cầu sử dụng. Nệm foam hiện đại được cải tiến với cấu trúc bọt khí mở, giúp tăng khả năng thoát nhiệt và hạn chế bí bách khi nằm lâu. Một số mẫu còn được bổ sung gel lạnh hoặc lớp áo vải cooling giúp bề mặt luôn mát mẻ, phù hợp với người hay ra mồ hôi khi ngủ.

Trong khi đó, nệm cao su thiên nhiên lại được yêu thích nhờ khả năng đàn hồi tốt, độ bền cao và hệ thống lỗ thoáng khí tự nhiên giúp không khí lưu thông hiệu quả. Đây là dòng nệm phù hợp với người ưu tiên cảm giác êm ái nhưng vẫn muốn có sự nâng đỡ chắc chắn cho cột sống. Một số sản phẩm còn tích hợp công nghệ kháng khuẩn, hỗ trợ bảo vệ sức khỏe và mang đến không gian ngủ sạch sẽ hơn.

Ngoài chất liệu, độ dày của nệm cũng là yếu tố quan trọng ảnh hưởng đến trải nghiệm nghỉ ngơi. Những dòng nệm dày từ 15cm đến 20cm hiện được nhiều gia đình lựa chọn vì có khả năng nâng đỡ cơ thể tốt, đồng thời tạo cảm giác êm ái và sang trọng cho không gian phòng ngủ. Đặc biệt, các mẫu nệm làm mát đa tầng đang trở thành xu hướng nhờ sự kết hợp giữa công nghệ tản nhiệt và thiết kế hỗ trợ nâng đỡ toàn diện.

Bên cạnh việc chọn đúng chất liệu, người dùng cũng nên chú ý đến kích thước nệm phù hợp với giường ngủ và nhu cầu sử dụng thực tế. Một chiếc nệm phù hợp không chỉ giúp ngủ ngon hơn mà còn hỗ trợ hạn chế đau lưng, giảm áp lực lên vai gáy và cải thiện tinh thần sau mỗi ngày làm việc căng thẳng. Với những người sống tại khu vực nóng bức hoặc sử dụng điều hòa thường xuyên, nệm có khả năng thoáng khí và điều hòa nhiệt độ sẽ là giải pháp lý tưởng cho giấc ngủ chất lượng hơn.

Hiện nay, Vua Nệm là một trong những hệ thống bán lẻ cung cấp đa dạng các dòng nệm nhu cầu mát với nhiều mức giá và công nghệ khác nhau. Người dùng có thể dễ dàng tìm thấy các sản phẩm phù hợp từ những thương hiệu nổi tiếng như Gummi, Goodnight, Comfy hay Liên Á. Ngoài ra, các chính sách như ngủ thử, trả góp và bảo hành chính hãng cũng giúp khách hàng yên tâm hơn khi lựa chọn sản phẩm cho gia đình mình.

title.title: Is the second season of Dandadan better than the first?
title.body:
>

Hey, Hive friends! I’m still here, posting two days in a row—something this profile has never seen before. I’ve been using my free time to catch up and watch the second season of Dandadan; it’s been almost a year since I reviewed the first season, so it’s time to talk a little about the second. You already know the story: Okarun has his two testicles stolen, and together with his friends, they must find them, while facing ghosts and aliens along the way. The first season ended on a cliffhanger, with Jiji and Okarun discovering a hidden hole inside Jiji’s house that seemed to lead to a strange place, only to find out in this second season that it was the burrow of a giant worm. This season covers three story arcs: the first wraps up the arc from the previous season (the curse in Jiji’s house), and the other two are new: the Evil Eye arc (the spirit that takes over Jiji’s body) and the third arc, which ends with another cliffhanger and introduces a new character who’s actually pretty cool. ||| |-|-| https://i0.wp.com/inbetweendrafts.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/GvBZ9VkXYAAdMsJ.jpeg?fit=1920%2C1080&ssl=1|https://i0.wp.com/inbetweendrafts.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/GvHMr97WoAA9lJ6.jpeg?resize=1536%2C864&ssl=1 I have to say I really liked the conclusion of the first arc because it adds a touch of mystery to the story—like the enemies might return in the future—but what really stole the show, without a doubt, is the second arc, where they use a truly epic tactic to perform an exorcism on Jiji: some really powerful metal music. Although there was a bit of controversy regarding the song, the issue was quickly resolved, so we can listen to the song on Spotify without any problems. Here we also see how Okarun matures under Turbo Grandma’s training, as he wants to be stronger and not rely on others, gaining more stamina and strength when he transforms. This later helps resolve the issue with Mal de Ojo, as he realizes the boy is just a child who only wants to play, leading him to strike a deal where they fight once a week but he can’t hurt anyone else. A somewhat simple solution, but one that can be convincing, if you ask me. ||| |-|-| https://cdn.oneesports.gg/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Anime_Dandadan_MomoAyase_JijiEnjoji_KenTakakura_Episode12_Season1.jpg|https://doublesama.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Dandadan-Season-2-Episode-10-Kinta-Miko-and-Muko-seeing-Momo-and-Okarun-accidentally-kiss-1024x576.webp

> What intrigues me the most is the third arc in question: we’re introduced to a character who, at first glance, seems weak, but whose obsession with robots gives him an imagination capable of recreating a Gundam; honestly, it’s an interesting concept: pitting a giant robot against a Kaiju, which, by the way, is clearly inspired by Godzilla. If I didn’t misunderstand, I think there was even a small change from the manga so it wouldn’t look too similar—you know, copyright issues. The way the season ended struck me as a bit funny, with the alien girl kissing Okarun out of nowhere (Momo will surely end up jealous). I guess we’ll find out the reason later, and the guys will have to help her get back to her planet or something like that. Personally, I found the whole season really entertaining. What do you think? Did you think it was as good as the first one? Let me know in the comments below. -------------------
![mg1 gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mig1/23ydTE7KBDPXbs6M6cpiwKB1CFTmB5utWUiXj4peUHBj5xUReooi8Ycb5t5XTGUgt4Zib.gif) *Thanks for reading my post and see you next time <3*
##
ESPAÑOL
https://a.storyblok.com/f/178900/1280x720/9befa24fa7/dan-da-dan-season-2-trailer-1-okarun.jpg
¡Hola amigos de Hive! Aún ando por acá, dos días consecutivos publicando, lo nunca antes visto en este perfil. Aprovechando mi tiempo libre, me he actualizado y vi la segunda temporada de Dandadan; hace un año prácticamente que les hice la reseña de la primera temporada, pues toca hablar un poco de la segunda. La historia ya se la saben: a Okarun le roban sus dos testículos y junto a sus amigos deberán encontrarlos, mientras en el camino se enfrentan a fantasmas y extraterrestres. La primera temporada culminó con un cliffhanger, donde Jiji y Okarun descubren un agujero oculto dentro de la casa de Jiji que parecía llevar a un lugar extraño, para luego descubrir en esta segunda temporada que se trataba de la madriguera de un gusano gigante. En esta temporada se tratan tres arcos: el primero culmina el arco de la temporada anterior (la maldición en la casa de Jiji) y los otros dos sí serían nuevos: el del Mal de Ojo (el espíritu que se adueña del cuerpo de Jiji) y el tercer arco, que termina con otro cliffhanger, donde también se nos presenta un personaje nuevo, que es bastante cool la verdad. ||| |-|-| https://i0.wp.com/inbetweendrafts.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/GvBZ9VkXYAAdMsJ.jpeg?fit=1920%2C1080&ssl=1|https://i0.wp.com/inbetweendrafts.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/GvHMr97WoAA9lJ6.jpeg?resize=1536%2C864&ssl=1 He de decir que me gustó bastante la conclusión del primer arco porque le dan un toque misterioso al asunto, como que los enemigos pueden volver en el futuro, pero lo que se llevó todo el show sin dudas es el segundo arco, donde para hacerle un exorcismo a Jiji hacen uso de un recurso muy épico: música metal muy potente. Aunque hubo un poco de polémica respecto a la canción, se llegó a resolver rápido el asunto, por lo que podremos escuchar la canción en Spotify sin problemas. Acá también vemos cómo madura Okarun al ser entrenado por la Turbo Abuela, ya que quiere ser más fuerte y no depender de los demás, consiguiendo más resistencia y fuerza cuando se transforma, lo que luego permite solucionar el problema de Mal de Ojo, al darse cuenta de que es solo un niño y que lo único que quiere es jugar, decidiendo hacer un trato donde luchen una vez a la semana pero no puede hacerle daño a nadie más. Una solución un poco sencilla pero que puede llegar a convencer, si me lo preguntas a mí. ||| |-|-| https://cdn.oneesports.gg/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Anime_Dandadan_MomoAyase_JijiEnjoji_KenTakakura_Episode12_Season1.jpg|https://doublesama.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/Dandadan-Season-2-Episode-10-Kinta-Miko-and-Muko-seeing-Momo-and-Okarun-accidentally-kiss-1024x576.webp

> Lo que más me intriga es el tercer arco en cuestión: se nos presenta un personaje que a primera vista se ve como alguien débil, pero su fijación por los robots le proporciona una imaginación capaz de recrear un Gundam; la verdad, un concepto interesante: enfrentar un robot gigante contra un Kaiju, que por cierto tiene una clara inspiración en Godzilla. Si no entendí mal, creo que hasta hubo un pequeño cambio con respecto al manga para que no se pareciera, ya saben, problemas de derechos de autor. La forma de terminar la temporada se me hizo un poco chistosa con eso de la chica alien besando a Okarun de la nada (seguro Momo termina celosa). Supongo que más adelante sabremos la razón y los muchachos tendrán que ayudarla para que regrese a su planeta o algo por el estilo. A mí particularmente se me hizo muy divertida toda esta temporada. ¿Tú qué opinas? ¿Te pareció tan buena como la primera? Te leo acá en los comentarios. -------------------
![mg1 gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mig1/23ydTE7KBDPXbs6M6cpiwKB1CFTmB5utWUiXj4peUHBj5xUReooi8Ycb5t5XTGUgt4Zib.gif) *Gracias por leer mi post y nos vemos en la próxima <3*
####

title.title: 多想並不是壞事
title.body: >Unsplash 前面提過最近在看小說玄鑑仙族，在並非絕對優勢的情況下，身為主角家族的李家，只能多思多慮，謹慎小心，並不是那種富貴險中求，每次都能成功的路線，有時候短時間就需要思考很多層面的事情，感覺無時無刻都在進行腦內博弈。 我也不知道訓練腦力這種說法的原理，而腦力這種東西也因不同人的定義，涵蓋的事物也不一定相同，問了AI大致上是，在思考時有機會建立腦內神經元連結，也許就是以往沒有道路連結的兩地，突然建了一條道路。 我自己的想像是原本想事情可能是A>B>C>D，如果建立了新的神經元，也許就創造了一條捷徑，直接可以從A>D，之後要想到EF的時候，就可以A>D>E>F，不用從頭再來過，但是不是真的這樣，我也沒那種專業知識來查證😂 AI還有寫到，隨著年紀增長，神經元是會老化的，所以有時候想事情會變得不通順，所以要趁還沒老化前，盡量建立神經元網路，就像是現實交通有替代道路一樣，不至於一條路斷了，就要繞一大段路，或到不了目的地。 所以舉一反三的聯想力是蠻重要的，算是建立自己腦內的資料庫，建立多種路徑來尋找答案，人總是會老化，不管身體或腦袋，都需要有一定程度的訓練，有時候天馬行空一點也沒關係，也許就是開發新路徑的契機。 --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@azazqwe/5gyci9)

title.title: Phone Photography Contest - #113  | Un lugar mágico 🌿 A magical place 🌿
title.body:
> Holaa amigos de la comunidad #FeelGood, hoy me sumo a la iniciativa [Phone Photography Contest](https://peakd.com/hive-190931/@untilwelearn/phone-photography-contest-113) para mostrarles estas fotos que tomé a principios de año y que siempre me llevan a un estado de paz y tranquilidad Para mi, la naturaleza es el lugar que más tranquilidad y conexión me transmite, es un lugar donde me siento plena y feliz, por eso, siempre que tengo la oportunidad voy al Ávila, aquí en Caracas, caminar por sus senderos puede ser a veces un desafío pero cuando en la subida haces conciencia del lugar donde estás, de los sonidos que te rodean, de la flora, siempre se vuelve una experiencia mágica. Recuerdo que fui en febrero con un corazón roto, una mente atormentada y un pecho adolorido, sin embargo, al estar ahí sentada frente a la Cruz del Ávila, rodeada de pájaros y el sonido del viento atravesando la copa de los árboles sentí un abrazo al alma y la certeza de que al final, todo iba a estar bien. Además ese día el árboles y el cielo estaban hermosos, aquí les comparto algunas fotos, muchas gracias por leerme y apoyar este post amigos, un abrazo. 💜

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/23wM4jXfMM7DUrE5Egr3QKnjVXeCDhpiP5arQ45fgz2X5zBhxRsT2sTrSGBXAkpYguVnK.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aimara08/23xVCdLM7hK32P9g2weVkQo7ryh9yiUpzZW9yDtmnCTMeB2H1mVS9bKkncKAfaeAoHEWJ.png)

> >Hiiii, friends of the #Feelgood community! Today I’m joining the Phone Photography Contest to share these photos I took earlier this year—they always bring me a sense of peace and tranquility >For me, nature is the place that brings me the most peace and connection; it’s a place where I feel fulfilled and happy. That’s why, whenever I get the chance, I go to Ávila, here in Caracas. Walking its trails can sometimes be a challenge, but when you become aware of where you are during the climb—of the sounds around you, of the flora—it always turns into a magical experience. I remember going there in February with a broken heart, a tormented mind, and a heavy heart. Yet, sitting there in front of the Cross of Ávila, surrounded by birds and the sound of the wind rustling through the treetops, I felt a hug for my soul and the certainty that, in the end, everything would be okay. >Plus, the trees and the sky were beautiful that day. Here are some photos I’d like to share with you. Thank you so much for reading and supporting this post, friends. Hugs. 💜

title.title: The Last Activity Before Starting A New One
title.body:
It's been a while everybody. I missed writing here in hive specially here in @asean.hive I know everyone is fine and doing well. For my today's blog let me share the last activity of my kids before they have their vacation. 

![429.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/EoGxWWYcxCspPyRyZcAgCzbiXsgHRHtygJrcMELHeBqg8T3JhwQMafU9wGW8TwTWqem.jpg)

![428.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/Eoc7UT95AkM4ZKLdc5rwkPTY6Y23UuS9AaeAqxu6nZa9b3EUboZajvLEzSVSo6wP5ju.jpg)

<div class=\

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/242hWMB7VoUgLZMUfVJ6oYfpAui9D7wyEHBVDGvKdJdJV2bYqEmVn8jheXNTcPYV77A72.jpg Every year our school celebrates **Field Day or National Arts Month.** It is one of the activities that many students look forward to because they get to show their talents, creativity, and teamwork. The boy besides Jeffria is her partner. This year was also special for my children because they both participated in the event. My daughter Jeffria is in Grade 1, and their group wore red costumes with beautiful flower designs. When I first saw her wearing the outfit, I felt very proud. The costume looked simple but very attractive, and it really suited the theme of their performance. The children looked so cute while standing together on the stage. I could see how excited they were while waiting for their turn. And when they perform the teachers was all amazed. ![367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/244yASuX6hT64VvtTMBdQbuKNabnmHJ85GZ6bziCDG4zs35coG9n1ZvHiM1m38nh7CVo4.jpg) When the results were announced, their group won the **Best Costume.** I was very happy for them because I know that their home room teacher and my co-parents put effort into preparing everything. Seeing our children smile and celebrate their small victory made the day even more memorable. ![416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23xL5JtR7bpo5Jx6umcL13LZFEAwfehroxZXnDFSidgnSuX6GBh6z8fTeWX3NinApv9a1.jpg) My son, who is in Grade 5, also joined the activity. Their group wore blue costumes and carried pom-poms for their performance. Even though their costume did not win, I could clearly see how much effort they put into their presentation. They practiced their routine and tried their best to perform well in front of everyone.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23zGqKTK2i7vaNhvuyUPKpFZDBn3MZqioU4qpt1yRo6ZeQ6he8ozAaBiMochgJ4PBv54L.jpg Watching both of my children participate in the event made me feel proud as a parent. It was not just about winning awards or being recognized. What made me happiest was seeing their confidence and excitement while they were performing. Activities like this help children express themselves and enjoy their time in school. I also appreciate the teachers and the school for organizing events like this. These activities give students a chance to build memories with their classmates and experience something different from their daily lessons.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/usagigallardo015/23xAZuVPDSx1hfbsMqX6GzeQjvhoT4GwnTFMw1F6nFb1ZjPuuMo5qFEdN6Z8vUeLEviDn.jpg At the end of the day, we went home feeling tired but happy. For me, moments like this are very special. Seeing my children enjoy their school activities and do their best is already a big reward for me as a their mom.. *Thank you for reading my blog..* *@usagigallardo015*

body.title: A rewarding weekend outing with my husband in search of gifts for the family.
body.body:
>
![1001742727.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKCGJTRJQuXWaPkihmFXtDxVTKNLtnCSa4uVkHYJxTzBdPSNP17sFBQuNBadqAy.jpg)
Feliz viernes tengan todos mis queridísimos hivers lectores espero que estén teniendo un feliz inicio de fin de semana aprovechando y buscando la oportunidad para compartir con la familia y seres queridos, fin de semana de paseo con mi esposo en busca de regalos para la familia. El fin de semana pasado específicamente el día sábado por la tarde, mi esposo me invitó para salir a pasear al centro comercial, nos enfocamos en recorrer los pasillos del centro comercial y cuando llegamos a una de mis tiendas favoritas rápidamente accedí a entrar en busca de algunas prendas de vestir ideales para obsequiar a los próximos cumpleañeros del mes en la familia. Mientras buscábamos los regalos perfectos para ellos, de igual manera fuimos consiguiendo cosas de nuestro gusto e interés y fuimos intercambiando ideas y gustos, en la cual todos quedáramos conforme además de ir conociendo y reforzando nuestra relación de pareja, siempre hay que buscar durante el fin de semana el tiempo para una salida en pareja, consolidar los vínculos entre nosotros y disfrutar de la maravillosa compañía.
![1001742725.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKNJyRHudNTB2xDbgRmxWuzXtQen3Ra227p7MkrWS8skFMz3fUVCkRNUXvyAzAb.jpg)
![1001742724.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKYMg8LXUfDmSdCeJBENZ3GdFTHGTD3x14riKfFKLpPH57NW1Lvkq8YsLuYkkB2.jpg)
![1001742726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AKGa3atJoNurRcd48f3gyHe8X9hEAZTqoGRLmPxCKEJKu6Wxo5QMySm986vqF3V.jpg)
Gracias por acompañarme aquí y hasta otra oportunidad. Gracias por leerme y su valioso apoyo. Las fotos son mías @cielitorojo con mi Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Traducido con el traductor Deepl
>Happy Friday to all my dearest Hivers readers! I hope you're having a wonderful start to the weekend, taking advantage of the opportunity to spend time with family and loved ones. This past weekend, my husband and I went shopping for gifts for the family. >Last weekend, specifically on Saturday afternoon, my husband invited me to go for a walk at the mall. We focused on browsing the mall's corridors, and when we arrived at one of my favorite stores, I quickly agreed to go in and look for some clothes that would be perfect gifts for the family members celebrating their birthdays this month. >While we were looking for the perfect gifts for them, we also found things we liked and were interested in, and we exchanged ideas and preferences until everyone was happy. We also spent time getting to know each other better and strengthening our relationship. It's always important to make time for a date night on the weekend to strengthen our bond and enjoy each other's wonderful company. >Thank you for joining me here and see you another time. Thanks for reading me and your valuable support. >The photos are of me @cielitorojo with my Tecno Spark 10 Pro. Translated with Deepl translator.

body.title: Pulsera de nudo plano con mostacillas, cristal checo y la inicial del personaje Drazing[Esp-Eng]
body.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hola comunidad #holozing, es un placer saludaros a todos y desearos un feliz y bendecido viernes. Hoy voy a compartir un fan art inspirado en un personaje conocido como Drazing. Mi fan art es una pulsera de nudo plano hecha con hilo piel de serpiente, mostacillas, cristales checos y la inicial (D) del nombre del personaje. Sin más preámbulos, les invito a que me acompañéis en esta fascinante creación y pongáis manos a la obra con el hilo.

> **
ENGLISH
** Hello, #holozing community! It’s a pleasure to greet you all and wish you a happy and blessed Friday. Today I’m going to share some fan art inspired by a character known as Drazing. My fan art is a flat knot bracelet made with snakeskin cord, beads, Czech glass beads, and the initial (D) of the character’s name. Without further ado, I invite you to join me in this fascinating creation and get started with the cord. ![1000462532.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpEHqva7Dx9sjuvH4czoiEWinU1Mv7wGGKNnR8QC3H2wsCnxNWA2btgm4ZXw8vgFHH4.jpg) ![1000394625.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23uEvCAetb73qHJhFQWVSCn6iWMZj4rpDh9WVPJBJeJ5NNU59kyc7W8XuUexefhK8oc3e.png) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)
> Los materiales que utilicé para realizar esta hermosa pulsera son los siguientes, a saber: Hilo Tijera Encendedor Cinta métrica Cinta adhesiva

> The materials I used to make this beautiful bracelet are as follows, namely: Thread Scissors Lighter Measuring tape Adhesive tape ![1000462435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wqnwzZAdhQjy8jCYysnMKgH1kN5ZeqrY5Q1M4tXXKbTCptRuktHaL3ko3qxqLRhKGUR.jpg)
> Para empezar esta preciosa joya empecé cortando dos hebras de hilo de 40 cm que utilizaré como base para nuestra pulsera

> To begin this beautiful jewelry I started by cutting two 40cm strands of thread which I will use as the base for our bracelet. ![1000462443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wWrjQxx87yMVFFsG4TL3bpgvuYn9bD8iKBjPZgaNFTqxaaoaVC8THPaG8v1Q783agmU.jpg)
> Después corté una hebra de hilo de 130cm para realizar el tejido plano de la pulsera.

> Then I cut a 130cm strand of thread to make the flat weave of the bracelet. ![1000462444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpEHrp8w5ESaLqLwy3dxtaRN8t7xAwNGB4KabCuH1ASgGMHyBLby3tXacr7AJCbbQbx.jpg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

> Inicié la pulsera realizando nudos planos de la siguiente manera: Primero tomé el hilo derecho, lo pasé por encima de la base , hice una forna de P, luego tomé el hilo izquierdo, lo pase por encima del hilo derecho (que estaba del lado izquierdo) , seguidamente lo pasé por dejado de la base y lo saqué por dentro del hilo derecho (la forma de P). Después estiré el hilo de cada lado uniformemente para hacer el nudo. Con los dedos se presiona para que quede igual de ambos lados Así comenzamos nuestro tejido.

> Started the bracelet by making flat knots in the following way: First I took the right strand, passed it over the base, made a P shape, then took the left strand, passed it over the right strand (which was on the left side), then passed it over the base and pulled it through the inside of the right strand (the P shape). Then I stretched the thread on each side evenly to make the knot. With your fingers you press it so that it is even on both sides and so we begin our weaving ![1000462546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23vi1oNF9L1TuaguQDwdge5ABX9FE5FmRNGuJeWBXmapbemDNXSkxv4cxSFAEStFMvcD5.jpg)

> Ahora tomé el hilo del lado izquierdo y lo pasé por encima del hilo base, formé una especie de cuatro, luego pasé el hilo del lado derecho por encima del hilo izquierdo que tenemos en el lado derecho, después lo pasé por debajo del hilo base y lo saqué por el interior o argolla del hilo izquierdo como nos lo señala la imagen. Seguidamente con los dedos presioné para que de ambos lados tengan similitud.

> Now I took the thread on the left side and passed it over the base thread, I formed a kind of four, then I passed the thread on the right side over the left thread that we have on the right side, then I passed it under the base thread and took it out through the inside or ring of the left thread as shown in the image. Then I pressed with my fingers so that both sides have similarity ![1000462547.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23uFW45ebW8vLczoYv1y8v7EGUdXSoHtcnAzPLJJa1DdAC5RjzyDbYsgAvyDa6p6kTbBE.jpg)
> Seguí realizando siete nudos planos completos hasta llegar a 7cm

> I continued making seven complete flat knots until I reached 7 cm. ![1000462459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23vsSQ23vFNpBCXvCMAWsWLhJpopMgVXBHGB4bTc3ztFwrqHUU7YtKTMK14mkKZ3Z6t5W.jpg)
> Luego introduje dos mostacillas por los hilos anudadores y la letra inicial del nombre Drazing.

> Then I threaded two beads onto the knotting threads and the initial letter of the name Drazing ![1000462548.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23u697vhFRzx6jJY491S91xSnhtdyDT6Y3q1aN48zboDJmss384gGSegu2So4QJySuai9.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)
> Seguí realizando el mismo procedimiento hasta llegar a la medida deseada.

> Continue following the same procedure until you reach the desired size. ![1000462467.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23vsScbEBkhVktbRz2yXTEs55xvtB329wgh4QPBMmpbWWRvC3btsWcXArpzFwD694CcvZ.jpg)
> Después de llegar a la medida deseada corté los hilos sobrantes y sellé

> After reaching the desired size I cut the excess threads and sealed ![1000462468.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23w2qGMeDkjuGPoS9cLWwGLNjtZPMn14ac1B11AmfD4xUZioULiB6ATj6mc3YqNgSQ9GR.jpg)
> Así quedó esta hermosa pulsera para Drazing

> This is how this beautiful bracelet turned out for Drazing ![1000462533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoK5tPYYEKAvRhWea7qseq3MMbzmRcy2rJuDt5FMeuH5HYmmJpsVQuEwQyvyc8kR9iy.jpg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)
> Con ayuda del cielo. Bendiciones!!

> ![1000394312.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/AK6Vk812x5PsthBq5c7Hx2CBDfpw1dSqZiznUyVBa4TB7eFCHbrkEzKbMaEi9ny.png) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

body.title: A wild cat appeared - Look but don’t touch.
body.body: Animals can't express their feelings in words, but they convey a lot through their eyes, movements, and sounds. Wagging the tail is a sign of happiness, Whining or whimpering may indicate pain, while soft growls or meows may indicate a desire for attention or play, the eyes express their love fear and pain. Understanding their \

is humanity.  Since they can not speak, it is our responsibility to understand their needs. But it is not so easy as it sounds for every individual. It happened to me today morning, when a wild cat blocked our way at home.


![1000284756.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EoK8Dv5GE7q3Aj4Z7WoVSZAM7Jfs2iKSJ8KbRikLgFerTRoqTiwBaeWGKv75xYSXrTA.jpg)

Wild cats are inherently cautious. Their primary reaction to a human is to flee, hide, or maintain a safe distance. Feral cats are unsocialized and will actively avoid human contact. This one always run away seeing us. But today she behaved differently. Even getting closer to her she did not responded and stay lying on the surface. It is very unusual for me. I hesitated to get closer to her, but after my friendly approach she stayed lied. 


![1000284757.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EoAc7nuMCh2Mf91FnsQwuRihTgNzU4UUBURiDKPJWBHurRaDHKSjBaKWgb1hPNawHbc.jpg)

![1000284755.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/EoCk3K93i2yCNGAxWLc2EQC2SDSMKK4SYLMQPvTRZ5DjtaNmjuYzGJqRBVeb8kWzanA.jpg)


She appeared to be pregnant, but her unusual behavior does surprises me. Either she wants to convey something or warns us against any something. I tried to get friendlier but she stayed lying there. Earlier she used to run away seeing me or any other person at home. I thought she might be hungry so fed her with with cooked churns which she happily accepts. It allowed me to click few pictures by getting up and close.


![1000284780.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/48SqeQjEzSH9s6Ttch7MdGuugHYEns7KuyhrKRQ2c14ScwQcjZp1MFbJ6so21GDtcC.jpg)


![1000284752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8VJmonb5uheZytVVWQUWdqEfRZVckd6GadLo9YS1gtnhEzcEqRbpatC6Y3dqqwXVy.jpg)

![1000284778.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23tvtz7n4FbRRFkQpgR6wSG71pGyixe9wggJYQZSNgV3y4F3e2zQ8oLB3fSdcWCeQkudz.jpg)

![1000284781.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23uR3C2btCwJ5Y9N8GETSsKXVvPz1YoEcyz4AetbmL3ehF473vkHtiqEZgraYUNWLEnDH.jpg)

![1000284782.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23uFgJrdxjwQG1SLJGavUQZANX7LqqyuABpvGfcuCC4654uaPJ6x3Y9Eh6ZWS3wESa4MS.jpg)

There are various belief that were associated with feral cats in India. Some consider it as in auspicious while some consider them as a divine mount of goddess shasti. But being a human it is our responsibility to take care of anyon3 in distress and this cat appeared to be one of such and try my best to understand, before she ran away, seeing other people surrounding her. 



**In good faith - Peace!!**



![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《我携骄阳拥抱于你》（淮文x梁雯晶）
body.body:
![IMG_5208](https://s1.img-e.com/20260404/69d120a5afd63.jpeg)

打开这部剧的理由是男女主我最近都看过他们的剧，女主演了很火的《朝阳似我》，男主则在《春港夜雨》中作为男配有着不俗的表现，我对这部剧的期待值还挺高的。

从剧情的角度来说，这是个女主被男主温柔守候治愈乃至救赎的故事。女主少年时代父母去世她受到很大的刺激一度换上失语症，男配算是她青梅竹马陪伴她走过15年。

大学毕业后他跟女主求婚结婚，婚后则开始出轨等骚操作。他对待女主的方式像极了PUA大师，各种贬低她的价值并将她限制在家里断绝同外界的联系，各种吸她的血。

男配的父母非但不加组织还乐见其成，因为这样他们可以顺理成章吞并女主家的公司。女主的人设讨喜在于她发现以后立马分手离婚丝毫不拖泥带水，内心非常强大。

淮文的演技在之前就见识到了，她有种剧抛脸的演技。在那部剧里他是不择手段处事圆滑的王牌经纪人，在这部剧里他细腻的演技将这个角色诠释得很棒，完全征服了我。

男女主的人设和感情戏都很棒，看他们的互动很像春日里的一场踏青。相比较下男女配的人设则过于公式化，看完最大的感觉是不要因为一个男人对你好就踏入婚姻。

总的来说，我觉得还是蛮不错的一部剧，推荐看。


（本篇完）

body.title: Reflections Repeated in Silence. Entry Reflection Hunters contest-SMARP- round 272 [EN/ES]
body.body:
- - - 
### Reflections Repeated in Silence
---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXebbnEtZnqgvvgz56ZTA98ZMRpCYGxFsqyYG8enhtVD7/screenshot_20260522_192252_01.jpg)

---

Hello #ShadowHunters community,
Once again I’m taking part in this reflections contest, this time in round #272.
Special thanks to @olgavita for hosting this wonderful reflections contest.

Some reflections appear in places we see every day, yet they still manage to surprise us.

This time, inside a bathroom, I noticed how two washbasins resting beneath a mirror created an interesting visual effect. What normally feels ordinary suddenly became a composition of repeated forms and quiet symmetry.

The mirror reflected the sinks, the light, and part of the surrounding space, doubling the scene and giving it unexpected depth. The surfaces seemed to continue beyond their physical limits, as if the room briefly expanded through reflection.

I paused for a moment to observe how simple objects can transform when reflected back at us. The curves of the washbasins, the clean lines, and the balance between light and shadow created a calm atmosphere that felt almost geometric.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQP8jyzPQH1LeSCgV1kn1yMdRtfwW5heVGGtqqrmpJVae/screenshot_20260522_192257_01.jpg)

---

There was nothing extravagant in the scene, and perhaps that is what made it interesting. Reflections often reveal beauty hidden inside routine, turning familiar spaces into something worth looking at again.

Sometimes, all it takes is a mirror to remind us that even the simplest places can hold another perspective.
- - - 
I declare that the images shared in this post are my own, captured with my mobile phone.
Since my native language is Spanish, I used Google Translate for the English version.
- - - 
***Thank you for welcoming me into your light,
and for allowing me to explore with you the poetry of reflections***.

- - -

https://vote.hive.uno/@thebbhproject

Support the witness and vote for TheBbhProject carried out by @bradleyarrow


- - - 
***Spanish Version***
- - - 

### Reflejos repetidos en silencio

- - -

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmXebbnEtZnqgvvgz56ZTA98ZMRpCYGxFsqyYG8enhtVD7/screenshot_20260522_192252_01.jpg)

---

Hola comunidad de #ShadowHunters,
Una vez más participo en este concurso de reflejos, esta vez en la ronda #272.
Agradecimiento especial a @olgavita por organizar este maravilloso concurso de reflejos.

Algunos reflejos aparecen en lugares que vemos todos los días, y aun así logran sorprendernos.

Esta vez, dentro de un baño, noté cómo dos lavamanos colocados bajo un espejo creaban un efecto visual interesante. Lo que normalmente parece algo cotidiano se transformó en una composición de formas repetidas y silenciosa simetría.

El espejo reflejaba los lavamanos, la luz y parte del espacio alrededor, duplicando la escena y dándole una profundidad inesperada. Las superficies parecían continuar más allá de sus límites físicos, como si el lugar se expandiera por un instante a través del reflejo.

Me detuve un momento a observar cómo objetos tan simples pueden transformarse cuando son devueltos hacia nosotros por un espejo. Las curvas de los lavamanos, las líneas limpias y el equilibrio entre luz y sombra creaban una atmósfera tranquila, casi geométrica.

---

![](https://i.ecency.com/DQmQP8jyzPQH1LeSCgV1kn1yMdRtfwW5heVGGtqqrmpJVae/screenshot_20260522_192257_01.jpg)

---

No había nada extravagante en la escena, y quizás precisamente ahí estaba su interés. Los reflejos muchas veces revelan una belleza escondida dentro de la rutina, convirtiendo espacios familiares en algo digno de mirar nuevamente.

A veces, todo lo que hace falta es un espejo para recordarnos que incluso los lugares más simples pueden contener otra perspectiva.

- - - 
Declaro que las imágenes compartidas en este post son de mi propiedad, capturadas con mi móvil.
Como mi lengua materna es el español, utilicé Google Translate para la versión en inglés.
- - - 
***Gracias por recibirme en su luz,
y por permitirme explorar con ustedes la poesía de los reflejos***.
- - -

body.title: Más de Todo [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>

Más de Todo. Continuamos ofreciendo nuevas rutinas de ejercicios, para que todos se animen a cambiar sus vidas para mejor. La sesión de hoy está demasiado variada, porque aunque tendremos movimientos que parecen enfocados en el núcleo; definitivamente vamos activar todos los grupos musculares de nuestro cuerpo. Acción predominante para el abdomen, con rasgos integrales que generan muchos beneficios relacionados a la tonificación, control, equilibrio y fuerza corporal. No se diga más, así que vente conmigo y dale movimiento a tu vida. >More of Everything. We continue to offer new exercise routines to inspire everyone to change their lives for the better. Today’s session is incredibly varied, because even though we’ll be doing movements that seem to focus on the core, we’ll definitely be engaging every muscle group in our bodies. The focus is on the abdomen, with comprehensive elements that provide many benefits related to toning, control, balance, and overall strength. Enough said so come with me and get your life moving.

![1000461701.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AJoKHmy1DPV3XGSspFVu7XyLUbXSov2eZX8yiMizSMDmPoV9KDA4jpfYaWZgsYn.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **RODILLAZOS ALTERNOS MÁS DOBLE GOLPE FRONTAL Y LATERAL**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de la cadera, con brazos en posición de combate. >[**Warm-up 1**, **ALTERNATING KNEE LIFTS WITH DOUBLE FRONT AND SIDE STRIKES**]() >[Stance]() >Feet hip-width apart, arms in a fighting stance.
![1000461667.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/EogNpr1jYBun6ZxPLZyiWLzeZ51Vr9sdASzUpRn15PQxv1oM7ocMQNUtZYv451GejEc.gif)
[Ejecución]() Elevamos las rodillas de forma alterna y continua; al mismo tiempo, damos doble golpe frontal y luego y doble golpe lateral. 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >We lift our knees alternately and continuously; at the same time, we perform two front kicks followed by two side kicks. 3 minutes of exercise.
![1000461673.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/EogNrtPSt788W6gdJbti77VW7zBeu2mAryGaD84YyzHFwYVxQLbgqQCqcTRg7tHVWh3.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **GIROS LATERALES CON EXTENSIÓN DE BRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Piernas al ancho de hombros; codos flexionados con brazos a los lados. >[**Warm-up 2**, **SIDE TWISTS WITH ARM EXTENSION**]() >[Stance]() >Feet shoulder-width apart; elbows bent with arms at your sides.
![1000461675.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/EokdeJjHYHeZUgoRiqby4QfU4Esa7MK5RZaoskhFPjB5YnijtH9jDXGmsdx7APyz7gY.gif)
[Ejecución]() Iniciando desde la posición indicada; flexionamos el torso hacia adelante y extendemos los codos, llevando los brazos hacia abajo. Subimos y realizamos el mismo movimiento al centro y hacia el lado opuesto. Serian 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Starting from the position shown, bend your torso forward and extend your elbows, bringing your arms down. Come back up and repeat the same movement toward the center and then to the opposite side. This exercise should take 3 minutes.
![1000461679.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/EoiWG5cvukyqYCZ8ZU7x2N7917aYKWjabjwHNNgQX5WzoUgZRvvUV6B77svmvNJA3PM.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **PLANCHA LATERAL MÁS RODILLA A CODO**]() [Postura]() Nos acostamos en el piso apoyados de la parte lateral del cuerpo. Colocamos el antebrazo inferior para apoyo y elevamos el cuerpo. La pierna superior queda delante de la otra. El codo del brazo superior se flexiona y se ubica el brazo a nivel de la cabeza. >[**Station 1**, **SIDE PLANK WITH KNEE TO ELBOW**]() >[Position]() >Lie on the floor, resting on your side. Place your lower forearm on the floor for support and lift your body. The top leg is positioned in front of the other. Bend the elbow of the top arm and bring the arm up to head level.
![1000461681.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/EoAc8rruKYpNMPc7EKDr65oJMHR6wQt8wQzaLaSyfSbvWMGctuovbVaChw9MXxixK8B.gif)
![1000461685.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/EoeGKWJsBZCzVYcS3x9FxVvGuGoERX6672cfm62y3mX7VKYR1UmPu2eG3WqMbdyBMQT.gif)
[Ejecución]() La tensión que se siente en todo el cuerpo es increíble; hay que tener control y equilibrio corporal. El núcleo se activa en gran medida; piernas y brazos se tonifican. Ahora; manteniendo la postura indicada; vamos dando rodillazos y codazos al mismo tiempo. Podemos realizar 20 repeticiones en 4 series por lado. >[Execution]() >The tension you feel throughout your entire body is incredible; you need to maintain control and balance. Your core is heavily engaged, and your legs and arms get toned. Now, while maintaining the correct posture, alternate between knee and elbow taps. You can do 20 repetitions in 4 sets per side.
![1000461683.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/EoCjY46PMqdCuB9saRtu31Mothu9Hr4EMxei2nLLXw6AVNNPKfGoGL2wwRCur73XkaE.gif)
![1000461687.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/Eoc8WjqXqukU13zvDb6nkRGFj5oeVbWmXicCcREcerxa3Td84atmDviyjxKB2ZPUC96.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **GIROS SEMI CIRCULARES DE PIERNA EN PLANCHA CON APOYO DE RODILLA**]() [Postura]() Manos en el piso; apoyamos una rodilla, la otra pierna queda extendida y cruzada en dirección hacia la otra pierna. >[**Station 2**, **SEMI-CIRCULAR LEG ROTATIONS IN PLANK POSITION WITH ONE KNEE ON THE GROUND**]() >[Position]() >Hands on the floor; rest one knee on the ground, with the other leg extended and crossed toward the other leg.
![1000461689.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/EoGyx5PXLAtrwcsk9Cf55FQWMKFLP93LewSfwkVgmbnd968UKdLMsS3tKuje3EejExR.gif)
![1000461693.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/EoK7MGd1NUrVQkCqJCzpAjjy1BtaveVej1TwYV5vu7WtGCVo5Gu5AWfTPFeGfnTSpmi.gif)
[Ejecución]() Tren superior en tensión; núcleo contraído mientras trabajan las piernas. Activos en la postura indicada; procedemos a realizar movimiento semi circulares con la pierna extendida. La llevamos de un lado a otro en 20 repeticiones, 4 series por pierna. >[Execution]() >Keep your upper body taut; engage your core while working your legs. Maintain the position shown; perform semicircular movements with your leg extended. Move it from side to side for 20 repetitions, 4 sets per leg.
![1000461691.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/EoK7DApnqMaRxRBcmR2qPtyWB2GApNHA7Hws222h63qEbrATMVsWYGF9k1jCy7k3r1K.gif)
![1000461695.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmiguelacho/Eoc8WjqY6ehabbwvkdiXs95YVYmkmQ6B6tG7XtX9fbCjva4Dw7cGqP1DR4WgEefSRMZ.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **PUENTE CON APOYO DE PARED**]() [Postura]() Nos acostamos en el piso boca arriba; flexionamos las rodillas y ubicamos la punta de los pies en la pared, un poco más arriba del nivel de la cadera. Manos en suelo a los lados. >[**Station 3**, **WALL-SUPPORTED BRIDGE**]() [Position]() Lie on your back on the floor; bend your knees and place the tops of your feet against the wall, slightly above hip level. Place your hands on the floor at your sides.
![1000461697.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/milik80/EoEqbcgkNBVkxAXBUHwWNC85XMgxfNLExXNsP6JwM7b6Hq22zrUYLFGNZKvco3SYGLf.gif)
[Ejecución]() Acción directa en núcleo y tren inferior; excelente tensión a nivel de la espalda. Para llevar a cabo el movimiento; damos pasos hacia arriba, hasta quedar totalmente con piernas extendidas y cuerpo alineado. Quedamos apoyados de la parte alta de la espalda; bajamos y realizamos el ejercicio en 20 repeticiones por 4 series. >[Execution]() >Targets the core and lower body; provides excellent engagement of the back muscles. body.title: After Swimming
body.body:
We're done from swimming at that time in Palauig, Zambales. I actually love swimming, and I'm thankful that the host congregation took us there. There we are with the squad took pictures at the huge stones. Yes, there are a lot of stones surrounding the river. 

The river is quite far from the town proper. You have to travel in some elevated areas as it's surrounded by mountains. It's not cold in the surroundings though despite trees all around, or probably the summer is just so cruel. What's important is we enjoyed the place.
